	internal class WinControlWrapper : IWinControlWrapper, IDisposable
	{
		private class FormEx : Form
		{
			protected override CreateParams CreateParams
			{
				get
				{
					CreateParams createParams = base.CreateParams;
					createParams.ExStyle |= 128;
					return createParams;
				}
			}

			protected override bool ShowWithoutActivation => true;

			public FormEx()
			{
				base.ShowInTaskbar = false;
			}
		}

		private Form dummyForm;

		private Form DummyForm
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsDummyFormExists)
				{
					dummyForm = CreateDummyForm();
					dummyForm.Show();
				}
				return dummyForm;
			}
		}

		private bool IsDummyFormExists => dummyForm != null;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Control WinControl { get; }

		public object Control => WinControl;

		public RectangleF Bounds => WinControl.Bounds;

		public System.Drawing.Size Size
		{
			get
			{
				return WinControl.Size;
			}
			set
			{
				WinControl.Size = value;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler SizeChanged
		{
			add
			{
				WinControl.SizeChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				WinControl.SizeChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		private static Form CreateDummyForm()
		{
			Form form = new FormEx();
			form.FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.None;
			form.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.Manual;
			form.Location = new System.Drawing.Point(-100, -100);
			form.Size = new System.Drawing.Size(1, 1);
			return form;
		}

		public WinControlWrapper(object winControl)
		{
			WinControl = winControl as System.Windows.Forms.Control;
		}

		public void ForceHandle()
		{
			IntPtr handle = WinControl.Handle;
		}

		public void ClearDataBindings()
		{
			WinControl.DataBindings.Clear();
		}

		public System.Drawing.Image GetImage(WinControlDrawMethod_Utils drawMethod, WinControlImageType_Utils imageType)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return XRControlPaint.GetControlImage(WinControl, drawMethod, imageType);
		}

		public void ValidateControlForm(System.Drawing.Color reportPageColor)
		{
			Form form = null;
			if (WinControl.Parent == null)
			{
				try
				{
					form = WinControl.FindForm();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				if (form == null)
				{
					AddControlToDummyForm(WinControl);
					form = WinControl.FindForm();
				}
			}
			if (form != null && IsDummyFormExists && form == DummyForm)
			{
				form.BackColor = ((reportPageColor != System.Drawing.Color.Transparent) ? reportPageColor : System.Drawing.Color.White);
			}
		}

		private void AddControlToDummyForm(System.Windows.Forms.Control control)
		{
			try
			{
				DummyForm.Controls.Add(control);
			}
			catch (ArgumentException ex)
			{
				Tracer.TraceError("DXperience.Reporting", (object)ex);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveFromDummyForm()
		{
			if (IsDummyFormExists)
			{
				if (DummyForm.Controls.Contains(WinControl))
				{
					DummyForm.Controls.Remove(WinControl);
				}
				DummyForm.Dispose();
				dummyForm = null;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (dummyForm != null)
			{
				dummyForm.Dispose();
				dummyForm = null;
			}
		}
	}

		private class DashStyle : IDisposable
		{
			private System.Drawing.Brush brush;

			private float dash;

			private float spell;

			public System.Drawing.Brush Brush => brush;

			public float Dash => dash;

			public float Spell => spell;

			public DashStyle(System.Drawing.Brush brush, float dash, float spell)
			{
				this.brush = brush;
				this.dash = dash;
				this.spell = spell;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				if (brush != null)
				{
					brush.Dispose();
					brush = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public static void DrawReversibleFrame(Rectangle rect, System.Drawing.Color color, FrameStyle style, System.Windows.Forms.Control control)
		{
			rect = control.RectangleToClient(rect);
			int nDrawMode;
			System.Drawing.Color c;
			if ((double)color.GetBrightness() < 0.5)
			{
				nDrawMode = 10;
				c = System.Drawing.Color.White;
			}
			else
			{
				nDrawMode = 7;
				c = System.Drawing.Color.Black;
			}
			IntPtr dCEx = GetDCEx(new HandleRef(null, control.Handle), NullHandleRef, 1027);
			IntPtr intPtr = ((style != FrameStyle.Dashed) ? CreatePen(0, 2, ColorTranslator.ToWin32(color)) : CreatePen(2, 1, ColorTranslator.ToWin32(color)));
			int nDrawMode2 = SetROP2(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), nDrawMode);
			IntPtr handle = SelectObject(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), new HandleRef(null, GetStockObject(5)));
			IntPtr handle2 = SelectObject(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), new HandleRef(null, intPtr));
			SetBkColor(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), ColorTranslator.ToWin32(c));
			DrawRectangle(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Right, rect.Bottom);
			SetROP2(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), nDrawMode2);
			SelectObject(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), new HandleRef(null, handle));
			SelectObject(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), new HandleRef(null, handle2));
			if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				DeleteObject(new HandleRef(null, intPtr));
			}
			ReleaseDC(NullHandleRef, new HandleRef(null, dCEx));
		}

		public static void FillReversibleRectangle(Rectangle rectangle, System.Drawing.Color backColor, System.Windows.Forms.Control control)
		{
			rectangle = control.RectangleToClient(rectangle);
			int colorRop = GetColorRop(backColor, 10813541, 5898313);
			int colorRop2 = GetColorRop(backColor, 6, 6);
			IntPtr dCEx = GetDCEx(new HandleRef(null, control.Handle), NullHandleRef, 1027);
			IntPtr handle = CreateSolidBrush(ColorTranslator.ToWin32(backColor));
			int nDrawMode = SetROP2(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), colorRop2);
			IntPtr handle2 = SelectObject(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), new HandleRef(null, handle));
			PatBlt(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), rectangle.X, rectangle.Y, rectangle.Width, rectangle.Height, colorRop);
			SetROP2(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), nDrawMode);
			SelectObject(new HandleRef(null, dCEx), new HandleRef(null, handle2));
			DeleteObject(new HandleRef(null, handle));
			ReleaseDC(NullHandleRef, new HandleRef(null, dCEx));
		}

		private static int GetColorRop(System.Drawing.Color color, int darkROP, int lightROP)
		{
			if ((double)color.GetBrightness() < 0.5)
			{
				return darkROP;
			}
			return lightROP;
		}

		public static void DrawGrid(Graphics gr, Rectangle bounds, SizeF pixelsBetweenDots, System.Drawing.Color foreColor)
		{
			using System.Drawing.Brush brush = new SolidBrush(foreColor);
			RectangleF clipBounds = RectangleF.Intersect(gr.ClipBounds, bounds);
			PointF firstDrawnPoint = GetFirstDrawnPoint(clipBounds, bounds, pixelsBetweenDots);
			for (float num = firstDrawnPoint.X; num < clipBounds.Right; num += pixelsBetweenDots.Width)
			{
				for (float num2 = firstDrawnPoint.Y; num2 < clipBounds.Bottom; num2 += pixelsBetweenDots.Height)
				{
					gr.FillRectangle(brush, (int)Math.Round(num), (int)Math.Round(num2), 1, 1);
				}
			}
		}

		private static PointF GetFirstDrawnPoint(RectangleF clipBounds, Rectangle controlBounds, SizeF pixelsBetweenDots)
		{
			float num = (float)Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(clipBounds.Y - (float)controlBounds.Top, 0f) / pixelsBetweenDots.Height);
			float num2 = (float)Math.Ceiling(Math.Max(clipBounds.X - (float)controlBounds.Left, 0f) / pixelsBetweenDots.Width);
			return new PointF((float)controlBounds.Left + pixelsBetweenDots.Width * num2, (float)controlBounds.Top + pixelsBetweenDots.Height * num);
		}

		public static void DrawBorder(Graphics gr, RectangleF rect, System.Drawing.Brush brush, float borderWidth, BorderSide sides)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0095: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a6: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (borderWidth != 0f && (int)sides != 0)
			{
				float num = Math.Min(borderWidth, rect.Width);
				RectangleF rect2 = new RectangleF(rect.Location, new SizeF(num, rect.Height));
				if ((sides & 1) > 0)
				{
					gr.FillRectangle(brush, rect2);
				}
				if ((sides & 4) > 0)
				{
					rect2.Offset(rect.Width - num, 0f);
					gr.FillRectangle(brush, rect2);
				}
				num = Math.Min(borderWidth, rect.Height);
				rect2 = new RectangleF(rect.Location, new SizeF(rect.Width, num));
				if ((sides & 2) > 0)
				{
					gr.FillRectangle(brush, rect2);
				}
				if ((sides & 8) > 0)
				{
					rect2.Offset(0f, rect.Height - num);
					gr.FillRectangle(brush, rect2);
				}
			}
		}

		public static System.Drawing.Image GetControlImage(System.Windows.Forms.Control ctl, WinControlDrawMethod_Utils drawMethod, WinControlImageType_Utils imageType)
		{
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ctl == null || ctl.Size.Width <= 0 || ctl.Size.Height <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			System.Drawing.Image image = (((int)imageType == 0) ? ((System.Drawing.Image)MetafileCreator.CreateInstance((RectangleF)new Rectangle(System.Drawing.Point.Empty, ctl.Size), MetafileFrameUnit.Pixel)) : ((System.Drawing.Image)new Bitmap(ctl.Size.Width, ctl.Size.Height)));
			using (Graphics gr = Graphics.FromImage(image))
			{
				DrawWinControl(ctl, gr, drawMethod);
			}
			if ((int)imageType == 0)
			{
				image = EmfMetafilePatcher.PatchResolution((Metafile)image, 96, true);
			}
			return image;
		}

		private static bool EnableControlStyle(System.Windows.Forms.Control control, bool enable, int style)
		{
			bool flag = (bool)InvokeMethod(control, "GetStyle", new object[1] { style });
			if (flag != enable)
			{
				InvokeMethod(control, "SetStyle", new object[2] { style, enable });
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private static bool EnableDoubleBuffer(System.Windows.Forms.Control control, bool enable)
		{
			return EnableControlStyle(control, enable, 131072);
		}

		{

		}

		private static void DrawWinControlWMPaintRecursive(System.Windows.Forms.Control control, IntPtr hdc, Rectangle rect)
		{

			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown

			{
				SIZE val = new SIZE(0, 0);
				Win32.SetViewportOrgEx(hdc, rect.X, rect.Y, val);
				Message message = Message.Create(control.Handle, 20, hdc, IntPtr.Zero);
				InvokeMethod(control, "WndProc", new object[1] { message });
				message = Message.Create(control.Handle, 15, hdc, IntPtr.Zero);
				InvokeMethod(control, "WndProc", new object[1] { message });
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			foreach (System.Windows.Forms.Control item in GetChildControlsWithCorrectZOrder(control))
			{
				if ((control.Visible && item.Visible) || !control.Visible)

					Rectangle bounds = item.Bounds;
					bounds.Offset(rect.Location);
					DrawWinControlWMPaintRecursive(item, hdc, bounds);
				}
			}
			EnableAllPaintingInWmPaint(control, enable2);
			EnableDoubleBuffer(control, enable);
		}

		private static IList GetChildControlsWithCorrectZOrder(System.Windows.Forms.Control control)
		{
			int count = control.Controls.Count;
			List<System.Windows.Forms.Control> list = new List<System.Windows.Forms.Control>(count);
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				list.Add(control.Controls[num]);
			}
			return list;
		}

		}

		private static void DrawWinControl(System.Windows.Forms.Control control, Graphics gr, WinControlDrawMethod_Utils drawMethod)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (control == null || control.IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			PaintEventArgs e = new PaintEventArgs(gr, new Rectangle(0, 0, control.Width, control.Height));
			IntPtr hdc = gr.GetHdc();
			try
			{
				switch ((int)drawMethod)
				{
				case 3:
					DrawWinControlWMPrintRecursive(control, hdc, e.ClipRectangle);
					break;
				case 1:
					DrawWinControlWMPrint(control, hdc);
					break;
				case 2:
					DrawWinControlWMPaintRecursive(control, hdc, e.ClipRectangle);
					break;
				default:
					DrawWinControlWMPaint(control, hdc);
					break;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			gr.ReleaseHdc(hdc);
		}

		private static object InvokeMethod(System.Windows.Forms.Control control, string method, object[] args)
		{
			MethodInfo method2 = control.GetType().GetMethod(method, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			if (method2 != null)
			{
				return method2.Invoke(control, args);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static void DrawTriangleDown(Graphics gr, Rectangle rect, bool center)
		{
			rect = CalcTriangleRect(rect, center);
			rect.Height = 1;
			while (rect.Width > 0)
			{
				gr.FillRectangle(SystemBrushes.ControlText, rect);
				rect.Y++;
				rect.X++;
				rect.Width -= 2;
			}
		}

		private static Rectangle CalcTriangleRect(Rectangle baseRect, bool center)
		{
			Rectangle result = new Rectangle(System.Drawing.Point.Empty, new System.Drawing.Size(9, 4));
			result.Offset(0, (baseRect.Height - result.Height) / 2);
			if (center)
			{
				result.X = (baseRect.Right - result.Width) / 2;
			}
			else
			{
				result.X = baseRect.Right - result.Width - 8;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Printing

	public class PrinterItem : IPrinterItem
	{
		private SafeGetter<string> fullName;

		private SafeGetter<string> location;

		private SafeGetter<string> comment;

		private SafeGetter<string> printerDocumentsInQueue;

		private SafeGetter<string> displayName;

		private SafeGetter<PrinterStatus> printerStatus;

		private PrinterType printerType;

		public string Location => location.Value;

		public string Comment => comment.Value;

		public string PrinterDocumentsInQueue => printerDocumentsInQueue.Value;

		public string Status => printerStatus.Value.GetString();

		public string DisplayName => displayName.Value;

		public string FullName => fullName.Value;

		public PrinterType PrinterType
		{
			get
			{
				PrinterStatus value = printerStatus.Value;
				if (value.HasStatus(PrinterStatus.Offline) || value.HasStatus(PrinterStatus.ServerOffline))
				{
					printerType |= PrinterType.Offline;
				}
				return printerType;
			}
		}

		public PrinterItem(string fullName, string displayName, string location, string comment, string printerDocumentsInQueue, PrinterStatus status)
		{
			this.fullName = new SafeGetter<string>(() => fullName, "Undefined Printer");
			this.displayName = new SafeGetter<string>(() => displayName, "Undefined Printer");
			this.location = new SafeGetter<string>(() => location, "Undefined Location");
			this.comment = new SafeGetter<string>(() => comment, string.Empty);
			this.printerDocumentsInQueue = new SafeGetter<string>(() => printerDocumentsInQueue, "0");
			printerStatus = new SafeGetter<PrinterStatus>(() => status, PrinterStatus.NotAvailable);
		}

		public PrinterItem(PrintQueue printQueue, bool isFax, bool isNetwork, bool isDefault, bool isOffline)
		{
			fullName = new SafeGetter<string>(() => printQueue.FullName, "Undefined Printer");
			location = new SafeGetter<string>(() => printQueue.Location, "Undefined Location");
			comment = new SafeGetter<string>(() => printQueue.Comment, string.Empty);
			printerDocumentsInQueue = new SafeGetter<string>(() => printQueue.NumberOfJobs.ToString(), "0");
			if (isNetwork)
			{
				displayName = new SafeGetter<string>(delegate
				{
					string arg = printQueue.HostingPrintServer.Name.Replace("\\", string.Empty);
					return string.Format(PreviewStringIdExtensions.GetString((PreviewStringId)672), printQueue.Name, arg);
				}, "Undefined Printer");
			}
			else
			{
				displayName = new SafeGetter<string>(() => printQueue.Name, "Undefined Printer");
			}
			printerStatus = new SafeGetter<PrinterStatus>(() => (PrinterStatus)printQueue.QueueStatus, PrinterStatus.NotAvailable);
			InitPrinterTypeFlags(isFax, isNetwork, isDefault, isOffline);
		}

		internal void InitPrinterTypeFlags(bool isFax, bool isNetwork, bool isDefault, bool isOffline)
		{
			if (isFax)
			{
				printerType |= PrinterType.Fax;
			}
			if (isNetwork)
			{
				printerType |= PrinterType.Network;
			}
			if (isDefault)
			{
				printerType |= PrinterType.Default;
			}
			if (isOffline)
			{
				printerType |= PrinterType.Offline;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class SafeGetter
	{
		public static T Get<T>(Func<T> get, T defaultValue, bool? catchException = null)
		{
			return New(get, defaultValue, catchException).Value;
		}

		public static T Get<T>(Task<T> task, T defaultValue, bool? catchException = null)
		{
			return New(task, defaultValue, catchException).Value;
		}

		public static SafeGetter<T> New<T>(Func<T> get, T defaultValue, bool? catchException = null)
		{
			return new SafeGetter<T>(get, defaultValue, GetActualCatchException(catchException));
		}

		public static SafeGetter<T> New<T>(Task<T> task, T defaultValue, bool? catchException = null)
		{
			bool actualCatchException = GetActualCatchException(catchException);
			Func<T> get = delegate
			{
				if (task.IsFaulted && actualCatchException)
				{
					Tracer.TraceError("DXperience.Reporting", (object)task.Exception.GetBaseException());
					return defaultValue;
				}
				return task.Result;
			};
			return new SafeGetter<T>(get, defaultValue, actualCatchException);
		}

		private static bool GetActualCatchException(bool? catchException)
		{
			if (!catchException.HasValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return catchException.Value;
		}
	}
	internal class SafeGetter<T>
	{
		private readonly Func<T> get;

		private readonly T defaultValue;

		private readonly bool catchException;

		private bool hasValue;

		private T value;

		public T Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (!hasValue)
				{
					try
					{
						value = get();
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						Tracer.TraceError("DXperience.Reporting", (object)ex);
						if (!catchException)
						{
							throw;
						}
						value = defaultValue;
					}
					hasValue = true;
				}
				return value;
			}
		}

		public SafeGetter(Func<T> get, T defaultValue)
			: this(get, defaultValue, catchException: true)
		{
		}

		internal SafeGetter(Func<T> get, T defaultValue, bool catchException)
		{
			this.get = get;
			this.defaultValue = defaultValue;
			this.catchException = catchException;
		}
	}
	public class PrinterItemContainer : IPrinterItemContainer
	{
		private class PrinterItemList : IReadOnlyList<PrinterItem>, IReadOnlyCollection<PrinterItem>, IEnumerable<PrinterItem>, IEnumerable
		{
			private PrinterItemContainer container;

			private IList<PrinterItem> printerItems;

			private int? printerCount;

			private IList<PrinterItem> PrinterItems
			{
				get
				{
					if (printerItems == null)
					{
						printerItems = container.GetPrinterItems();
					}
					return printerItems;
				}
			}

			public int Count
			{
				get
				{
					if (printerItems != null)
					{
						return printerItems.Count;
					}
					if (!printerCount.HasValue)
					{
						printerCount = container.GetPrinterCount();
					}
					return printerCount.Value;
				}
			}

			public PrinterItem this[int index] => PrinterItems[index];

			public PrinterItemList(PrinterItemContainer container)
			{
				this.container = container;
			}

			public IEnumerator<PrinterItem> GetEnumerator()
			{
				return PrinterItems.GetEnumerator();
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return PrinterItems.GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		private PrinterItemList printerItems;

		private string defaultPrinterName;

		public string DefaultPrinterName
		{
			get
			{
				if (defaultPrinterName == null)
				{
					defaultPrinterName = GetDefaultPrinterName();
				}
				return defaultPrinterName;
			}
		}

		public IReadOnlyList<PrinterItem> Items => printerItems;

		IReadOnlyList<IPrinterItem> IPrinterItemContainer.Items => (IReadOnlyList<IPrinterItem>)printerItems;

		private static int SizeOfStruct
		{
			get
			{
				if (IntPtr.Size == 8)
				{
					return IntPtr.Size * 2 + Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(int)) + 4;
				}
				return IntPtr.Size * 2 + Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(int));
			}
		}

		public PrinterItemContainer()
		{
			printerItems = new PrinterItemList(this);
		}

		private string GetDefaultPrinterName()
		{
			string defaultPrinterNameUsingWinApi = GetDefaultPrinterNameUsingWinApi();
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(defaultPrinterNameUsingWinApi))
			{
				return defaultPrinterNameUsingWinApi;
			}
			return GetDefaultPrinterNameUsingServer();
		}

		private List<PrinterItem> GetPrinterItems()
		{
			List<PrinterItem> list = GetPrinterItemsUsingWinApi();
			if (list == null)
			{
				list = GetPrinterItemsUsingServer();
			}
			Comparison<PrinterItem> comparison = (PrinterItem item1, PrinterItem item2) => Comparer<string>.Default.Compare(item1.DisplayName, item2.DisplayName);
			list.Sort(comparison);
			return list;
		}

		private int GetPrinterCount()
		{
			try
			{
				int? printersWinApi = GetPrintersWinApi();
				if (printersWinApi.HasValue)
				{
					return printersWinApi.Value;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return GetPrinterItemsUsingServer().Count;
		}

		private string GetDefaultPrinterNameUsingServer()
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			try
			{
				using LocalPrintServer localPrintServer = new LocalPrintServer();
				result = localPrintServer.DefaultPrintQueue.FullName;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return result;
		}

		private List<PrinterItem> GetPrinterItemsUsingServer()
		{
			List<PrinterItem> list = new List<PrinterItem>();
			try
			{
				using LocalPrintServer localPrintServer = new LocalPrintServer();
				List<string> fullNamesOfSpecifiedTypes = GetFullNamesOfSpecifiedTypes(localPrintServer, new EnumeratedPrintQueueTypes[2]
				{
					EnumeratedPrintQueueTypes.WorkOffline,
					EnumeratedPrintQueueTypes.Connections
				});
				List<string> fullNamesOfSpecifiedTypes2 = GetFullNamesOfSpecifiedTypes(localPrintServer, new EnumeratedPrintQueueTypes[2]
				{
					EnumeratedPrintQueueTypes.Fax,
					EnumeratedPrintQueueTypes.Connections
				});
				using (PrintQueueCollection printQueueCollection = localPrintServer.GetPrintQueues(new EnumeratedPrintQueueTypes[1] { EnumeratedPrintQueueTypes.Local }))
				{
					foreach (PrintQueue item in printQueueCollection)
					{
						list.Add(new PrinterItem(item, fullNamesOfSpecifiedTypes2.Contains(item.FullName), isNetwork: false, object.Equals(item.FullName, DefaultPrinterName), fullNamesOfSpecifiedTypes.Contains(item.FullName)));
					}
				}
				using PrintQueueCollection printQueueCollection2 = localPrintServer.GetPrintQueues(new EnumeratedPrintQueueTypes[1] { EnumeratedPrintQueueTypes.Connections });
				foreach (PrintQueue item2 in printQueueCollection2)
				{
					list.Add(new PrinterItem(item2, fullNamesOfSpecifiedTypes2.Contains(item2.FullName), isNetwork: true, object.Equals(item2.FullName, DefaultPrinterName), fullNamesOfSpecifiedTypes.Contains(item2.FullName)));
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<string> GetFullNamesOfSpecifiedTypes(LocalPrintServer printServer, EnumeratedPrintQueueTypes[] enumerationFlag)
		{
			using PrintQueueCollection source = printServer.GetPrintQueues(enumerationFlag);
			return source.Select((PrintQueue item) => item.FullName).ToList();
		}

		[DllImport("winspool.drv", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
		private static extern int EnumPrinters(int flags, string name, int level, IntPtr pPrinterEnum, int cbBuf, out int pcbNeeded, out int pcReturned);

		[DllImport("winspool.drv", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
		private static extern bool GetDefaultPrinter(StringBuilder pszBuffer, ref int size);

		[DllImport("winspool.drv", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
		private static extern int OpenPrinter(string pPrinterName, out IntPtr phPrinter, IntPtr pDefault);

		[DllImport("winspool.drv", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
		private static extern int OpenPrinter2(string pPrinterName, out IntPtr phPrinter, IntPtr pDefault, IntPtr pOptions);

		[DllImport("winspool.drv", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
		private static extern bool GetPrinter(IntPtr hPrinter, int level, IntPtr dwBuf, int size, ref int dwNeeded);

		[DllImport("winspool.drv", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode, SetLastError = true)]
		private static extern int ClosePrinter(IntPtr hPrinter);

		private List<PrinterItem> GetPrinterItemsUsingWinApi()
		{
			List<PRINTER_INFO_4> printers = GetPrinters();
			if (printers == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<PrinterItem> list = new List<PrinterItem>();
			foreach (PRINTER_INFO_4 item2 in printers)
			{
				PrinterItem item = CreatePrinterItem(item2);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static List<PRINTER_INFO_4> GetPrinters()
		{
			int sizeOfStruct = SizeOfStruct;
			List<PRINTER_INFO_4> list = new List<PRINTER_INFO_4>();
			try
			{
				EnumPrinters(6, null, 4, IntPtr.Zero, 0, out var pcbNeeded, out var pcReturned);
				IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(pcbNeeded);
				if (EnumPrinters(6, null, 4, intPtr, pcbNeeded, out pcbNeeded, out pcReturned) == 0)
				{
					Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr);
					return null;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < pcReturned; i++)
				{
					IntPtr ptr = (IntPtr)checked((long)intPtr + i * sizeOfStruct);
					PRINTER_INFO_4 item = (PRINTER_INFO_4)Marshal.PtrToStructure(ptr, typeof(PRINTER_INFO_4));
					list.Add(item);
				}
				Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr);
				return list;
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static int? GetPrintersWinApi()
		{
			if (EnumPrinters(6, null, 4, IntPtr.Zero, 0, out var pcbNeeded, out var _) == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return pcbNeeded / SizeOfStruct;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static string GetDefaultPrinterNameUsingWinApi()
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(256);
			int size = stringBuilder.Capacity;
			try
			{
				if (GetDefaultPrinter(stringBuilder, ref size))
				{
					result = stringBuilder.ToString(0, size - 1);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return result;
		}

		private PrinterItem CreatePrinterItem(PRINTER_INFO_4 pi4)
		{
			PRINTER_INFO_2 pi5;
			PrinterItem printerItem = ((!TryGetPrinterInfo2(pi4.pPrinterName, out pi5)) ? new PrinterItem(pi4.pPrinterName, GetPrinterDisplayName(pi4.pServerName, pi4.pPrinterName, (PrinterAttributes)pi4.Attributes), "Undefined Location", string.Empty, "0", PrinterStatus.NotAvailable) : new PrinterItem(pi5.pPrinterName, GetPrinterDisplayName(pi5.pServerName, pi5.pPrinterName, (PrinterAttributes)pi5.Attributes), pi5.pLocation, pi5.pComment, pi5.cJobs.ToString(), (PrinterStatus)pi5.Status));
			PrinterAttributes attributes = (PrinterAttributes)pi4.Attributes;
			printerItem.InitPrinterTypeFlags(HasAttribute(attributes, PrinterAttributes.PRINTER_ATTRIBUTE_FAX), HasAttribute(attributes, PrinterAttributes.PRINTER_ATTRIBUTE_NETWORK), object.Equals(pi4.pPrinterName, DefaultPrinterName), HasAttribute(attributes, PrinterAttributes.PRINTER_ATTRIBUTE_WORK_OFFLINE));
			return printerItem;
		}

		private static string GetPrinterDisplayName(string pServerName, string pPrinterName, PrinterAttributes attributes)
		{
			if (HasAttribute(attributes, PrinterAttributes.PRINTER_ATTRIBUTE_NETWORK) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(pServerName) && pPrinterName.IndexOf(pServerName) == 0)
			{
				string arg = pServerName.Replace("\\", string.Empty);
				string text = pPrinterName.Substring(pServerName.Length);
				text = text.Replace("\\", string.Empty);
				return string.Format(PreviewStringIdExtensions.GetString((PreviewStringId)672), text, arg);
			}
			return pPrinterName;
		}

		private static bool HasAttribute(PrinterAttributes attributes, PrinterAttributes attribute)
		{
			return (attributes & attribute) == attribute;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static bool TryGetPrinterInfo2(string printerName, out PRINTER_INFO_2 pi2)
		{
			pi2 = default(PRINTER_INFO_2);
			bool result = false;
			IntPtr phPrinter = IntPtr.Zero;
			int dwNeeded = 0;
			try
			{
				OpenPrinter(printerName, out phPrinter, IntPtr.Zero);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (phPrinter == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				PRINTER_OPTIONS structure = new PRINTER_OPTIONS
				{
					Size = Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(PRINTER_OPTIONS)),
					Flags = PrinterOptionFlags.PRINTER_OPTION_NO_CACHE
				};
				IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocCoTaskMem(structure.Size);
				Marshal.StructureToPtr(structure, intPtr, fDeleteOld: false);
				OpenPrinter2(printerName, out phPrinter, IntPtr.Zero, intPtr);
				Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(intPtr);
				if (phPrinter == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			GetPrinter(phPrinter, 2, IntPtr.Zero, 0, ref dwNeeded);
			if (dwNeeded > 0)
			{
				IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(dwNeeded);
				GetPrinter(phPrinter, 2, intPtr2, dwNeeded, ref dwNeeded);
				if (dwNeeded > 0)
				{
					pi2 = (PRINTER_INFO_2)Marshal.PtrToStructure(intPtr2, typeof(PRINTER_INFO_2));
					result = true;
				}
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr2);
			}
			ClosePrinter(phPrinter);
			return result;
		}
	}

	public class PrintEditorController
	{
		private string oldPrinterName;

		private IPrintForm form;

		private PrintDocument document;

		private static FieldInfo fi_pageSorce;

		private PrinterSettings PrinterSettings => document.PrinterSettings;

		private PageSettings PageSettings => document.DefaultPageSettings;

		private bool IsValidPrinterSettings => PrinterSettings.IsValid;

		public PrintEditorController(IPrintForm form)
		{
			this.form = form;
		}

		public void LoadForm(PrinterItemContainer printerItemContainer)
		{
			document = form.Document;
			TaskScheduler scheduler = TaskScheduler.FromCurrentSynchronizationContext();
			string text = document.PrinterSettings.PrinterName;
			bool isValidPrinterSettings = IsValidPrinterSettings;
			oldPrinterName = text;
			if (!isValidPrinterSettings && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(printerItemContainer.DefaultPrinterName))
			{
				text = (oldPrinterName = printerItemContainer.DefaultPrinterName);
				PrinterSettings.PrinterName = text;
				isValidPrinterSettings = IsValidPrinterSettings;
			}
			foreach (PrinterItem item in printerItemContainer.Items)
			{
				form.AddPrinterItem(item);
			}
			form.SetSelectedPrinter(text);
			if (document is IPrintDocumentExtension)
			{
				IPrintForm printForm = form;
				PrintDocument printDocument = document;
				printForm.PageRangeText = ((IPrintDocumentExtension)((printDocument is IPrintDocumentExtension) ? printDocument : null)).PageRange;
			}
			else if (PrinterSettings.MaximumPage == 1)
			{
				form.PageRangeText = string.Empty;
				form.AllowSomePages = false;
			}
			else
			{
				form.PageRangeText = new PageScope(PrinterSettings.FromPage, PrinterSettings.ToPage).PageRange;
			}
			PrintHelper.GetPrintRangeAsync(PrinterSettings).ContinueWith(delegate(Task<PrintRange> t)
			{
				form.SetPrintRange(SafeGetter.Get(t, PrintRange.AllPages));
			}, scheduler);
			PrintHelper.GetPrintToFileAsync(PrinterSettings).ContinueWith((Task<bool> t) => form.PrintToFile = SafeGetter.Get(t, defaultValue: false), scheduler);
			PrintHelper.GetPrintFileNameAsync(PrinterSettings).ContinueWith((Task<string> t) => form.PrintFileName = SafeGetter.Get(t, string.Empty), scheduler);
			if (isValidPrinterSettings)
			{
				PrintHelper.GetCollateAsync(PrinterSettings).ContinueWith((Task<bool> t) => form.Collate = SafeGetter.Get(t, defaultValue: true), scheduler);
				PrintHelper.GetCopiesAsync(PrinterSettings).ContinueWith((Task<short> t) => form.Copies = SafeGetter.Get<short>(t, 1), scheduler);
			}
		}

		private PrinterSettingsStub SavePrinterSettings()
		{
			fi_pageSorce = fi_pageSorce ?? NativeField<PageSettings>.Ensure("paperSource");
			PaperSource paperSource = ((fi_pageSorce == null) ? PageSettings.PaperSource : ((PaperSource)fi_pageSorce.GetValue(PageSettings)));
			if (!PrinterSettings.CanDuplex)
			{
				return new PrinterSettingsStub(PrinterSettings.Copies, PrinterSettings.Collate, paperSource, PrinterSettings.Duplex);
			}
			return new PrinterSettingsStub(PrinterSettings.Copies, PrinterSettings.Collate, paperSource);
		}

		private void RestorePrinterSetting(PrinterSettingsStub settingsStub)
		{
			PrinterSettings.Copies = settingsStub.Copies;
			PrinterSettings.Collate = settingsStub.Collate;
			PageSettings.PaperSource = settingsStub.PaperSource;
			if (settingsStub.CanDuplex)
			{
				PrinterSettings.Duplex = settingsStub.Duplex;
			}
		}

		private void ApplyPrinterSettingFromForm()
		{
			PrinterSettings.Copies = form.Copies;
			PrinterSettings.Collate = form.Collate;
			if (form.CanDuplex)
			{
				PrinterSettings.Duplex = form.Duplex;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(form.PaperSource))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PaperSource paperSource in PrinterSettings.PaperSources)
			{
				if (paperSource.SourceName == form.PaperSource)
				{
					PageSettings.PaperSource = paperSource;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ApplyPrinterSettingToForm()
		{
			form.Copies = PrinterSettings.Copies;
			form.Collate = PrinterSettings.Collate;
			if (form.CanDuplex)
			{
				form.Duplex = PrinterSettings.Duplex;
			}
			form.PaperSource = PageSettings.PaperSource.SourceName;
		}

		public void ShowPrinterPreferences(IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			PrinterSettingsStub settingsStub = SavePrinterSettings();
			ApplyPrinterSettingFromForm();
			try
			{
				new PrinterPreferences().ShowPrinterProperties(PageSettings, hwnd);
				ApplyPrinterSettingToForm();
			}
			finally
			{
				RestorePrinterSetting(settingsStub);
			}
		}

		public void AssignPrinterSettings()
		{
			PrinterSettings.Copies = form.Copies;
			PrinterSettings.Collate = form.Collate;
			PrinterSettings.PrintToFile = form.PrintToFile;
			if (form.PrintToFile)
			{
				PrinterSettings.PrintFileName = form.PrintFileName;
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(form.PaperSource))
			{
				foreach (PaperSource paperSource in PrinterSettings.PaperSources)
				{
					if (paperSource.SourceName == form.PaperSource)
					{
						PageSettings.PaperSource = paperSource;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (form.PrintRange == PrintRange.SomePages)
			{
				if (document is IPrintDocumentExtension)
				{
					PrintDocument printDocument = document;
					((IPrintDocumentExtension)((printDocument is IPrintDocumentExtension) ? printDocument : null)).PageRange = form.PageRangeText;
				}
				PageScope pageScope = new PageScope(form.PageRangeText, PrinterSettings.MaximumPage);
				PrinterSettings.FromPage = pageScope.FromPage;
				PrinterSettings.ToPage = pageScope.ToPage;
			}
			PrinterSettings.PrintRange = form.PrintRange;
			if (form.CanDuplex && form.Duplex != Duplex.Default)
			{
				PrinterSettings.Duplex = form.Duplex;
			}
		}

		public void CancelPrinterSettings()
		{
			PrinterSettings.PrinterName = oldPrinterName;
		}
	}

		[DllImport("kernel32.dll")]
		[return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
		private static extern bool GlobalUnlock(IntPtr hMem);

		[DllImport("kernel32.dll")]

		[DllImport("winspool.Drv", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.StdCall, EntryPoint = "DocumentPropertiesW", ExactSpelling = true, SetLastError = true)]
		private static extern int DocumentProperties(IntPtr hwnd, IntPtr hPrinter, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] string pDeviceName, IntPtr pDevModeOutput, IntPtr pDevModeInput, int fMode);

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void ShowPrinterProperties(PrinterSettings settings, IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			ShowPrinterProperties(settings.DefaultPageSettings, hwnd);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void ShowPrinterProperties(PageSettings defaultPageSettings, IntPtr hwnd)
		{
			PrinterSettings printerSettings = defaultPageSettings.PrinterSettings;
			if (!printerSettings.IsValid)
			{
				throw new InvalidPrinterException(printerSettings);
			}
			IntPtr hdevmode = printerSettings.GetHdevmode(defaultPageSettings);
			IntPtr intPtr = GlobalLock(hdevmode);
			if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				GlobalFree(hdevmode);
				return;
			}
			int cb = DocumentProperties(hwnd, IntPtr.Zero, printerSettings.PrinterName, IntPtr.Zero, intPtr, 0);
			IntPtr intPtr2 = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(cb);
			int num = DocumentProperties(hwnd, IntPtr.Zero, printerSettings.PrinterName, intPtr2, intPtr, 14);
			GlobalUnlock(hdevmode);
			if (num == 1)
			{
				ApplyDevModeData(defaultPageSettings, intPtr2);
			}
			GlobalFree(hdevmode);
			Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr2);
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyDevModeData(PageSettings pageSettings, IntPtr devModeData)
		{
			pageSettings.PrinterSettings.SetHdevmode(devModeData);
			pageSettings.SetHdevmode(devModeData);
		}
	}

	public static class PrintQueueStatusConverter
	{
		private static Dictionary<PrinterStatus, PreviewStringId> stringIds;

		static PrintQueueStatusConverter()
		{
			stringIds = new Dictionary<PrinterStatus, PreviewStringId>();
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.None, (PreviewStringId)694);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.Paused, (PreviewStringId)689);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.Error, (PreviewStringId)676);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.PendingDeletion, (PreviewStringId)690);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.PaperJam, (PreviewStringId)686);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.PaperOut, (PreviewStringId)687);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.ManualFeed, (PreviewStringId)679);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.PaperProblem, (PreviewStringId)688);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.Offline, (PreviewStringId)682);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.IOActive, (PreviewStringId)678);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.Busy, (PreviewStringId)673);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.Printing, (PreviewStringId)692);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.OutputBinFull, (PreviewStringId)684);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.NotAvailable, (PreviewStringId)680);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.Waiting, (PreviewStringId)699);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.Processing, (PreviewStringId)693);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.Initializing, (PreviewStringId)677);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.WarmingUp, (PreviewStringId)700);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.TonerLow, (PreviewStringId)697);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.NoToner, (PreviewStringId)681);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.PagePunt, (PreviewStringId)685);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.UserIntervention, (PreviewStringId)698);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.OutOfMemory, (PreviewStringId)683);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.DoorOpen, (PreviewStringId)674);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.ServerUnknown, (PreviewStringId)696);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.PowerSave, (PreviewStringId)691);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.ServerOffline, (PreviewStringId)695);
			stringIds.Add(PrinterStatus.DriverUpdateNeeded, (PreviewStringId)675);
		}

		public static string GetString(this PrinterStatus printQueueStatus)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			XtraLocalizer<PreviewStringId> active = PreviewLocalizer.Active;
			if (printQueueStatus == PrinterStatus.None)
			{
				return active.GetLocalizedString(stringIds[PrinterStatus.None]);
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (PrinterStatus value in Enum.GetValues(typeof(PrinterStatus)))
			{
				if (value != PrinterStatus.None && printQueueStatus.HasStatus(value))
				{
					list.Add(active.GetLocalizedString(stringIds[value]));
				}
			}
			if (list.Count != 1)
			{
				return string.Join(", ", list);
			}
			return list[0];
		}

		internal static bool HasStatus(this PrinterStatus status, PrinterStatus flag)
		{
			return (status & flag) == flag;
		}
	}

	public static class RegistryHelper
	{
		private class SimpleStorage : IXtraSerializable
		{
			private string data = "";

			[XtraSerializableProperty]
			public string Data
			{
				get
				{
					return data;
				}
				set
				{
					data = ((value == null) ? "" : value);
				}
			}

			public string[] GetData()
			{
				ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(Regex.Split(data, "\r\n"));
				for (int num = arrayList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (arrayList[num].Equals(""))
					{
						arrayList.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				return arrayList.ToArray(typeof(string)) as string[];
			}

			public void SetData(string[] items)
			{
				data = string.Join("\r\n", items);
			}

			void IXtraSerializable.OnStartDeserializing(LayoutAllowEventArgs e)
			{
			}

			void IXtraSerializable.OnEndDeserializing(string restoredVersion)
			{
			}

			void IXtraSerializable.OnStartSerializing()
			{
			}

			void IXtraSerializable.OnEndSerializing()
			{
			}
		}

		public static string[] LoadRegistryValue(string registryPath, string registryKey)
		{
			if (registryKey.Length == 0)
			{
				return new string[0];
			}
			XtraSerializer val = (XtraSerializer)(object)new RegistryXtraSerializer();
			SimpleStorage simpleStorage = new SimpleStorage();
			val.DeserializeObject((object)simpleStorage, registryPath, registryKey);
			return simpleStorage.GetData();
		}

		public static void SaveRegistryValue(string[] items, string registryPath, string registryKey)
		{
			if (registryKey.Length != 0)
			{
				XtraSerializer val = (XtraSerializer)(object)new RegistryXtraSerializer();
				SimpleStorage simpleStorage = new SimpleStorage();
				simpleStorage.SetData(items);
				val.SerializeObject((object)simpleStorage, registryPath, registryKey);
			}
		}

		public static void DeleteRegistryValue(string item, string registryPath, string registryKey)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(LoadRegistryValue(registryPath, registryKey));
			arrayList.Remove(item);
			SaveRegistryValue(arrayList.ToArray(typeof(string)) as string[], registryPath, registryKey);
		}

		public static bool AddRegistryValue(string item, string registryPath, string registryKey)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(LoadRegistryValue(registryPath, registryKey));
			if (!arrayList.Contains(item))
			{
				arrayList.Add(item);
				SaveRegistryValue(arrayList.ToArray(typeof(string)) as string[], registryPath, registryKey);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static void SetRegistryValues(string keyPath, object[] values)
		{
			try
			{
				RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey(keyPath);
				for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
				{
					registryKey.SetValue("item" + i, values[i]);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public static object[] GetRegistryValues(string keyPath)
		{
			try
			{
				RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(keyPath);
				if (registryKey != null)
				{
					string[] valueNames = registryKey.GetValueNames();
					object[] array = new object[valueNames.Length];
					for (int i = 0; i < valueNames.Length; i++)
					{
						array[i] = registryKey.GetValue(valueNames[i]);
					}
					return array;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return new object[0];
		}

		public static bool SetRegistryValue(string keyPath, string name, object val)
		{
			try
			{
				RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey(keyPath);
				registryKey.SetValue(name, val);
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static object GetRegistryValue(string keyPath, string name, object defaultValue)
		{
			try
			{
				RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(keyPath);
				if (registryKey == null)
				{
					return defaultValue;
				}
				return registryKey.GetValue(name, defaultValue);
			}
			catch
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Core
{
	public static class ApplicationThemeHelper
	{
		private const string PreloadProviderName = "DevExpress.Xpf.Core.Native.PreloadProvider";

		private static string applicationThemeName;

		private static bool coreAssemblyLoaded;

		private static bool? isWebApp;

		private static bool? isInDesignMode;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static bool UseLegacyDefaultTheme
		{
			get
			{
				return CompatibilitySettings.LegacyDefaultTheme == LegacyDefaultTheme.DeepBlue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!CompatibilitySettings.IsSealed)
				{
					CompatibilitySettings.LegacyDefaultTheme = (value ? new LegacyDefaultTheme?(LegacyDefaultTheme.DeepBlue) : CompatibilitySettings.LegacyDefaultTheme);
				}
			}
		}

		public static bool UseDefaultSvgImages { get; set; }

		public static ConfigurationUserLevel ConfigurationUserLevel { get; set; }

		internal static bool IsWebApp
		{
			get
			{
				bool? flag = isWebApp;
				if (!flag.HasValue)
				{
					bool? flag2 = (isWebApp = GetIsWebApp());
					return flag2.Value;
				}
				return flag == true;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsInDesignMode
		{
			get
			{
				bool? flag = isInDesignMode;
				if (!flag.HasValue)
				{
					bool? flag2 = (isInDesignMode = DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(new DependencyObject()));
					return flag2.Value;
				}
				return flag == true;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the name of the theme applied to the entire application.")]
		public static string ApplicationThemeName
		{
			get
			{
				return applicationThemeName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(applicationThemeName == value))
				{
					applicationThemeName = value;
					if (!CompatibilitySettings.UseLightweightThemes && !coreAssemblyLoaded)
					{
						coreAssemblyLoaded = DXAssemblies.XpfCore != null;
					}
					ApplicationThemeHelper.ApplicationThemeNameChanged?.Invoke(null, new ApplicationThemeNameChangedEventArgs(value));
				}
			}
		}

		public static event EventHandler<ApplicationThemeNameChangedEventArgs> ApplicationThemeNameChanged;

		static ApplicationThemeHelper()
		{
			applicationThemeName = null;
			coreAssemblyLoaded = false;
			ConfigurationUserLevel = ConfigurationUserLevel.PerUserRoaming;
			UseDefaultSvgImages = true;
		}

		private static string GetDefaultThemeName()
		{
			if (CompatibilitySettings.UseLightweightThemes)
			{
				return "Office2019Colorful";
			}
			Assembly xpfCore = DXAssemblies.XpfCore;
			if (xpfCore == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(xpfCore, "DevExpress.Xpf.Core.Theme", false, (bool?)null);
			if (knownType == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			FieldInfo field = knownType.GetField("Default", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
			if (field == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			object value = field.GetValue(null);
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return value.GetType().GetProperty("Name", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public).GetValue(value, new object[0]) as string;
		}

		public static void UpdateApplicationThemeName()
		{
			if ((CompatibilitySettings.UseLightweightThemes || !UseLegacyDefaultTheme) && !IsWebApp && !IsInDesignMode && (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ApplicationThemeName) || !(ApplicationThemeName != GetDefaultThemeName())))
			{
				Configuration config = GetConfig();
				string text = ((config == null) ? null : ConfigurationHelper.GetApplicationThemeNameFromConfig(config));
				ApplicationThemeName = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? GetDefaultThemeName() : text);
			}
		}

		public static void SaveApplicationThemeName()
		{
			try
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ApplicationThemeName))
				{
					bool useNetCoreVersionFormat = false;
					ConfigurationHelper.SaveApplicationThemeNameToConfig(GetConfig(), ApplicationThemeName, useNetCoreVersionFormat);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public static void Preload(params PreloadCategories[] preloadCategories)
		{
			PreloadInternal(GetPreloadRoot(preloadCategories));
		}

		public static Task PreloadAsync(params PreloadCategories[] preloadCategories)
		{
			return StartPreloadTaskOnSTAThread(delegate
			{
				PreloadInternal(GetPreloadRoot(preloadCategories));
			});
		}

		public static void Preload(Func<System.Windows.Controls.UserControl> createAction)
		{
			PreloadInternal(createAction());
		}

		public static void Preload<T>(bool runTypeInitializers = false) where T : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, new()
		{
			PreloadInternal(new T());
		}

		public static Task PreloadAsync(Func<System.Windows.Controls.UserControl> createAction)
		{
			return StartPreloadTaskOnSTAThread(delegate
			{
				PreloadInternal(createAction());
			});
		}

		public static Task PreloadAsync<T>() where T : System.Windows.Controls.UserControl, new()
		{
			return StartPreloadTaskOnSTAThread(delegate
			{
				PreloadInternal(new T());
			});
		}

		private static void PreloadInternal(Visual visual)
		{
			InvisibleWindow invisibleWindow = new InvisibleWindow
			{
				Content = visual
			};
			invisibleWindow.Show();
			invisibleWindow.Close();
		}

		private static Visual GetPreloadRoot(PreloadCategories[] preloadCategories)
		{
			Grid grid = new Grid();
			grid.BeginInit();
			foreach (PreloadCategories category in preloadCategories)
			{
				Assembly assembly = GetAssembly(category);
				Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(assembly, "DevExpress.Xpf.Core.Native.PreloadProvider", false, (bool?)null);
				IPreloadSupport preloadSupport = (IPreloadSupport)knownType.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes).Invoke(null);
				foreach (FrameworkElement item in preloadSupport.GetConfiguredTree())
				{
					grid.Children.Add(item);
				}
			}
			grid.EndInit();
			return grid;
		}

		private static Task StartPreloadTaskOnSTAThread(Action action)
		{
			TaskCompletionSource<object> completionSource = new TaskCompletionSource<object>();
			Thread thread = new Thread((ThreadStart)delegate
			{
				try
				{
					action();
					completionSource.SetResult(null);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					if (ex is OperationCanceledException)
					{
						completionSource.SetCanceled();
					}
					else
					{
						completionSource.SetException(ex);
					}
				}
			});
			thread.Name = "DevExpress Preload Resources Thread";
			thread.IsBackground = true;
			thread.SetApartmentState(ApartmentState.STA);
			thread.Priority = ThreadPriority.BelowNormal;
			thread.Start();
			return completionSource.Task;
		}

		private static Configuration GetConfig()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().Location))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ConfigurationManager.OpenExeConfiguration(ConfigurationUserLevel);
		}

		private static bool GetIsWebApp()
		{
			return AppDomain.CurrentDomain.SetupInformation.AppDomainManagerType?.ToLower().StartsWith("system.web") ?? false;
		}
	}

		private static void AssignCompatibilityModeDefaultValues(CompatibilityMode value)
		{
			CheckSealed();
			switch (value)
			{
			case CompatibilityMode.v17_2:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V17_2();
				break;
			case CompatibilityMode.v18_1:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V18_1();
				break;
			case CompatibilityMode.v18_2:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V18_2();
				break;
			case CompatibilityMode.v19_1:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V19_1();
				break;
			case CompatibilityMode.v19_2:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V19_2();
				break;
			case CompatibilityMode.v20_1:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V20_1();
				break;
			case CompatibilityMode.v20_2:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V20_2();
				break;
			case CompatibilityMode.v21_1:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V21_1();
				break;
			case CompatibilityMode.v21_2:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V21_2();
				break;
			case CompatibilityMode.v22_1:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V22_1();
				break;
			case CompatibilityMode.v22_2:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V22_2();
				break;
			case CompatibilityMode.v23_1:
				AssignCompatibilityMode_V23_1();
				break;
			default:
				AssignCompatibilityModeLatest();
				break;
			}
			Seal();
		}

		private static T GetProperty<T>(T value)
		{
			Seal();
			return value;
		}

		private static void SetProperty<T>(ref T container, T value, Action<T> action = null)
		{
			CheckSealed();
			if (!object.Equals(container, value))
			{
				container = value;
				action?.Invoke(value);
			}
		}

	public static class ConfigurationHelper
	{
		public const string SettingsNamespace = "DXThemeManager";

		private const string ApplicationThemeNameSettingsName = "ApplicationThemeName";

		public const string UserSettingsGroupName = "userSettings";

		private static Configuration LoadConfiguration(string appConfigPath)
		{
			return ConfigurationManager.OpenMappedExeConfiguration(new ExeConfigurationFileMap
			{
				ExeConfigFilename = appConfigPath
			}, ConfigurationUserLevel.None);
		}

		private static UserSettingsGroup GetUserSettingsGroup(Configuration configuration)
		{
			UserSettingsGroup userSettingsGroup = configuration.GetSectionGroup("userSettings") as UserSettingsGroup;
			if (userSettingsGroup == null)
			{
				userSettingsGroup = new UserSettingsGroup();
				configuration.SectionGroups.Add("userSettings", userSettingsGroup);
			}
			return userSettingsGroup;
		}

		private static ClientSettingsSection GetClientSection(Configuration configuration)
		{
			return configuration.Sections["DXThemeManager"] as ClientSettingsSection;
		}

		private static ClientSettingsSection GetClientSection(ConfigurationSectionGroup userSettingsGroup)
		{
			return userSettingsGroup.Sections["DXThemeManager"] as ClientSettingsSection;
		}

		private static ClientSettingsSection CreateClientSection(Configuration config)
		{
			ClientSettingsSection clientSettingsSection = CreateClientSection();
			config.Sections.Add("DXThemeManager", clientSettingsSection);
			return clientSettingsSection;
		}

		private static ClientSettingsSection CreateClientSection(UserSettingsGroup userSettingsGroup)
		{
			ClientSettingsSection clientSettingsSection = CreateClientSection();
			userSettingsGroup.Sections.Add("DXThemeManager", clientSettingsSection);
			return clientSettingsSection;
		}

		private static ClientSettingsSection CreateClientSection()
		{
			ClientSettingsSection clientSettingsSection = new ClientSettingsSection();
			clientSettingsSection.SectionInformation.AllowExeDefinition = ConfigurationAllowExeDefinition.MachineToLocalUser;
			clientSettingsSection.SectionInformation.RequirePermission = false;
			return clientSettingsSection;
		}

		public static string GetApplicationThemeNameFromConfig(string appConfigPath)
		{
			return GetApplicationThemeNameFromConfig(LoadConfiguration(appConfigPath));
		}

		internal static string GetApplicationThemeNameFromConfig(Configuration configuration)
		{
			ClientSettingsSection clientSection = GetClientSection(configuration);
			string applicationThemeName = GetApplicationThemeName(clientSection);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(applicationThemeName))
			{
				return applicationThemeName;
			}
			UserSettingsGroup userSettingsGroup = GetUserSettingsGroup(configuration);
			return GetApplicationThemeName(GetClientSection(userSettingsGroup));
		}

		private static string GetApplicationThemeName(ClientSettingsSection clientSection)
		{
			SettingElement settingElement = clientSection?.Settings.Get("ApplicationThemeName");
			if (settingElement != null && settingElement.Value != null && settingElement.Value.ValueXml != null)
			{
				return settingElement.Value.ValueXml.InnerText;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static void RemoveThemeNameFromConfig(string appConfigPath, bool useNetCoreVersionFormat = false)
		{
			RemoveThemeNameFromConfig(LoadConfiguration(appConfigPath), useNetCoreVersionFormat);
		}

		internal static void RemoveThemeNameFromConfig(Configuration conf, bool useNetCoreVersionFormat)
		{
			if (useNetCoreVersionFormat)
			{
				ClientSettingsSection clientSection = GetClientSection(conf);
				if (clientSection != null)
				{
					conf.Sections.Remove(clientSection.SectionInformation.SectionName);
				}
				conf.Save(ConfigurationSaveMode.Modified);
			}
			else if (conf.GetSectionGroup("userSettings") is UserSettingsGroup userSettingsGroup)
			{
				if (userSettingsGroup.Sections["DXThemeManager"] is ClientSettingsSection)
				{
					userSettingsGroup.Sections.Remove("ApplicationThemeName");
				}
				conf.SectionGroups.Remove("userSettings");
				conf.Save(ConfigurationSaveMode.Modified);
			}
		}

		public static void SaveApplicationThemeNameToConfig(string appConfigPath, string themeName, bool useNetCoreVersionFormat = false)
		{
			SaveApplicationThemeNameToConfig(LoadConfiguration(appConfigPath), themeName, useNetCoreVersionFormat);
		}

		internal static void SaveApplicationThemeNameToConfig(Configuration configuration, string themeName, bool useNetCoreVersionFormat)
		{
			ClientSettingsSection clientSettingsSection = null;
			if (useNetCoreVersionFormat)
			{
				ConfigurationSectionGroup sectionGroup = configuration.GetSectionGroup("userSettings");
				if (sectionGroup != null)
				{
					clientSettingsSection = GetClientSection(sectionGroup);
				}
				if (clientSettingsSection == null)
				{
					clientSettingsSection = GetClientSection(configuration) ?? CreateClientSection(configuration);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UserSettingsGroup userSettingsGroup = GetUserSettingsGroup(configuration);
				clientSettingsSection = GetClientSection(userSettingsGroup) ?? CreateClientSection(userSettingsGroup);
			}
			SaveApplicationThemeName(themeName, clientSettingsSection);
			configuration.Save(ConfigurationSaveMode.Modified);
		}

		private static void SaveApplicationThemeName(string themeName, ClientSettingsSection clientSection)
		{
			SettingElement settingElement = new SettingElement("ApplicationThemeName", SettingsSerializeAs.String);
			XmlElement xmlElement = SafeXml.CreateDocument().CreateElement("value");
			xmlElement.InnerText = themeName;
			settingElement.Value.ValueXml = xmlElement;
			clientSection.Settings.Add(settingElement);
		}
	}
	internal class InvisibleWindow : ContentControl
	{
		private enum SetWindowPosFlags
		{
			SWP_NOSIZE = 1,
			SWP_NOMOVE = 2,
			SWP_NOZORDER = 4,
			SWP_NOREDRAW = 8,
			SWP_NOACTIVATE = 16,
			SWP_FRAMECHANGED = 32,
			SWP_SHOWWINDOW = 64,
			SWP_HIDEWINDOW = 128,
			SWP_NOCOPYBITS = 256,
			SWP_NOOWNERZORDER = 512,
			SWP_NOSENDCHANGING = 1024,
			SWP_DRAWFRAME = 32,
			SWP_NOREPOSITION = 512,
			SWP_DEFERERASE = 8192,
			SWP_ASYNCWINDOWPOS = 16384
		}

		private static readonly System.Windows.Size sizeSmall = new System.Windows.Size(800.0, 600.0);

		private HwndSource hwnd;

		public void Show()
		{
			CreateHandle();
			SetSize(sizeSmall);
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			base.Content = null;
			if (hwnd != null)
			{
				hwnd.Dispose();
				hwnd = null;
			}
		}

		[DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Auto)]
		private static extern bool SetWindowPos(IntPtr hWnd, IntPtr hWndInsertAfter, int x, int y, int Width, int Height, SetWindowPosFlags flags);

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void SetSize(System.Windows.Size size)
		{
			if (hwnd != null)
			{
				SetWindowPos(hwnd.Handle, IntPtr.Zero, 0, 0, (int)size.Width, (int)size.Height, (SetWindowPosFlags)48);
			}
		}

		private void CreateHandle()
		{
			if (hwnd == null)
			{
				HwndSourceParameters parameters = new HwndSourceParameters("Hidden Window");
				parameters.SetSize(int.MinValue, int.MinValue);
				parameters.SetPosition(int.MinValue, int.MinValue);
				parameters.WindowStyle = 13565952;
				hwnd = new HwndSource(parameters);
				hwnd.RootVisual = this;
			}
		}
	}

	public class ToastNotificationFailedException : Exception
	{
		public override string Message => base.InnerException.Message;

		public int ErrorCode { get; private set; }

		public ToastNotificationFailedException(Exception inner, int errorCode)
			: base(null, inner)
		{
			ErrorCode = errorCode;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		internal static ToastNotificationFailedException ToException(int hResult)
		{
			try
			{
				Marshal.ThrowExceptionForHR(hResult);
				return null;
			}
			catch (Exception inner)
			{
				return new ToastNotificationFailedException(inner, hResult);
			}
		}
	}
