	public class WinRTToastNotificationFactory : IPredefinedToastNotificationFactory
	{
		private class WinRTToastNotificationContentFactory : IPredefinedToastNotificationContentFactory, IPredefinedToastNotificationContentFactoryGeneric
		{
			public IPredefinedToastNotificationContent CreateContent(string bodyText, string id = null)
			{
				return WinRTToastNotificationContent.Create(bodyText, id);
			}

			public IPredefinedToastNotificationContent CreateOneLineHeaderContent(string headlineText, string bodyText)
			{
				return WinRTToastNotificationContent.CreateOneLineHeader(headlineText, bodyText);
			}

			public IPredefinedToastNotificationContent CreateTwoLineHeaderContent(string headlineText, string bodyText, string id = null)
			{
				return WinRTToastNotificationContent.CreateTwoLineHeader(headlineText, bodyText, id);
			}

			public IPredefinedToastNotificationContent CreateOneLineHeaderContent(string headlineText, string bodyText1, string bodyText2, string id = null)
			{
				return WinRTToastNotificationContent.CreateOneLineHeader(headlineText, bodyText1, bodyText2, id);
			}

			public IPredefinedToastNotificationContent CreateToastGeneric(string headlineText, string bodyText1, string bodyText2, string id = null)
			{
				return WinRTToastNotificationContent.CreateToastGeneric(headlineText, bodyText1, bodyText2, id);
			}
		}

		private readonly string appId;

		private IPredefinedToastNotificationContentFactory factoryCore;

		private IPredefinedToastNotificationContentFactory DefaultFactory
		{
			get
			{
				if (factoryCore == null)
				{
					factoryCore = CreateContentFactory();
				}
				return factoryCore;
			}
		}

		public double ImageSize => WindowsVersionProvider.IsWin10AnniversaryUpdateOrHigher ? 48 : 90;

		public WinRTToastNotificationFactory(string appId)
		{
			this.appId = appId;
		}

		public IPredefinedToastNotification CreateToastNotification(IPredefinedToastNotificationContent content)
		{
			return new WinRTToastNotification(content, () => ToastNotificationManager.CreateToastNotificationAdapter(appId));
		}

		public IPredefinedToastNotification CreateToastNotification(string bodyText, string id = null)
		{
			return CreateToastNotification(DefaultFactory.CreateContent(bodyText, id));
		}

		public IPredefinedToastNotification CreateToastNotificationOneLineHeaderContent(string headlineText, string bodyText)
		{
			return CreateToastNotification(DefaultFactory.CreateOneLineHeaderContent(headlineText, bodyText));
		}

		public IPredefinedToastNotification CreateToastNotificationOneLineHeaderContent(string headlineText, string bodyText1, string bodyText2, string id = null)
		{
			return CreateToastNotification(DefaultFactory.CreateOneLineHeaderContent(headlineText, bodyText1, bodyText2, id));
		}

		public IPredefinedToastNotification CreateToastNotificationTwoLineHeader(string headlineText, string bodyText, string id = null)
		{
			return CreateToastNotification(DefaultFactory.CreateTwoLineHeaderContent(headlineText, bodyText, id));
		}

		public virtual IPredefinedToastNotificationContentFactory CreateContentFactory()
		{
			return new WinRTToastNotificationContentFactory();
		}
	}
	public class WinRTToastNotification : IPredefinedToastNotification
	{
		internal delegate void TypedEventHandler<TSender, TResult>(TSender sender, TResult args);

		private class ToastNotificationHandlerInfo<THandler>
		{
			public EventRegistrationToken Token;

			public THandler Handler { get; private set; }

			public ToastNotificationHandlerInfo(Func<THandler> initializer)
			{
				Handler = initializer();
			}
		}

		private class ToastNotificationHandler<THandler>
		{
			private List<THandler> handlers;

			private WinRTToastNotification toast;

			public ToastNotificationHandler(WinRTToastNotification toast)
			{
				handlers = new List<THandler>();
				this.toast = toast;
			}

			public void Subscribe(THandler handler)
			{
				handlers.Add(handler);
			}

			public void Unsubscribe(THandler handler)
			{
				handlers.Remove(handler);
			}

			protected int InvokeCore<TArgs>(IToastNotification sender, TArgs args, Action<THandler, WinRTToastNotification, TArgs> action)
			{
				lock (this)
				{
					using (toast.Content)
					{
						handlers.ForEach(delegate(THandler h)
						{
							action(h, toast, args);
						});
						handlers.Clear();
					}
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private sealed class HandlerDismissed : ToastNotificationHandler<TypedEventHandler<IPredefinedToastNotification, ToastDismissalReason>>, ITypedEventHandler_IToastNotification_Dismissed
		{
			public HandlerDismissed(WinRTToastNotification sender)
				: base(sender)
			{
			}

			public int Invoke(IToastNotification sender, IToastDismissedEventArgs args)
			{
				return InvokeCore(sender, args, delegate(TypedEventHandler<IPredefinedToastNotification, ToastDismissalReason> h, WinRTToastNotification s, IToastDismissedEventArgs a)
				{
					h(s, a.Reason);
				});
			}
		}

		private sealed class HandlerActivated : ToastNotificationHandler<TypedEventHandler<IPredefinedToastNotification, string>>, ITypedEventHandler_IToastNotification_Activated
		{
			public HandlerActivated(WinRTToastNotification sender)
				: base(sender)
			{
			}

			public int Invoke(IToastNotification sender, IInspectable args)
			{
				return InvokeCore(sender, GetActivationString(args as IToastActivatedEventArgs), delegate(TypedEventHandler<IPredefinedToastNotification, string> h, WinRTToastNotification s, string a)
				{
					h(s, a);
				});
			}

			private string GetActivationString(IToastActivatedEventArgs args)
			{
				HSTRING args2 = default(HSTRING);
				args?.GetArguments(out args2);
				return args2.GetString();
			}
		}

		private sealed class HandlerFailed : ToastNotificationHandler<TypedEventHandler<IPredefinedToastNotification, ToastNotificationFailedException>>, ITypedEventHandler_IToastNotification_Failed
		{
			public HandlerFailed(WinRTToastNotification sender)
				: base(sender)
			{
			}

			public int Invoke(IToastNotification sender, IToastFailedEventArgs args)
			{
				return InvokeCore(sender, args, delegate(TypedEventHandler<IPredefinedToastNotification, ToastNotificationFailedException> h, WinRTToastNotification s, IToastFailedEventArgs a)
				{
					h(s, ToastNotificationFailedException.ToException(a.Error));
				});
			}
		}

		private ToastNotificationHandlerInfo<HandlerDismissed> handlerDismissed;

		private ToastNotificationHandlerInfo<HandlerActivated> handlerActivated;

		private ToastNotificationHandlerInfo<HandlerFailed> handlerFailed;

		private IPredefinedToastNotificationContent contentCore;

		private Lazy<IToastNotificationAdapter> adapterCore;

		private IToastNotification Notification;

		private const uint WPN_E_TOAST_NOTIFICATION_DROPPED = 2151547399u;

		public IPredefinedToastNotificationContent Content => contentCore;

		internal IToastNotificationAdapter Adapter => adapterCore.Value;

		internal event TypedEventHandler<IPredefinedToastNotification, ToastDismissalReason> Dismissed
		{
			add
			{
				handlerDismissed.Handler.Subscribe(value);
			}
			remove
			{
				handlerDismissed.Handler.Unsubscribe(value);
			}
		}

		internal event TypedEventHandler<IPredefinedToastNotification, string> Activated
		{
			add
			{
				handlerActivated.Handler.Subscribe(value);
			}
			remove
			{
				handlerActivated.Handler.Unsubscribe(value);
			}
		}

		internal event TypedEventHandler<IPredefinedToastNotification, ToastNotificationFailedException> Failed
		{
			add
			{
				handlerFailed.Handler.Subscribe(value);
			}
			remove
			{
				handlerFailed.Handler.Unsubscribe(value);
			}
		}

		internal WinRTToastNotification(IPredefinedToastNotificationContent content, Func<IToastNotificationAdapter> adapterRoutine)
		{
			if (content == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("content");
			}
			adapterCore = new Lazy<IToastNotificationAdapter>(adapterRoutine);
			contentCore = content;
			handlerDismissed = new ToastNotificationHandlerInfo<HandlerDismissed>(() => new HandlerDismissed(this));
			handlerActivated = new ToastNotificationHandlerInfo<HandlerActivated>(() => new HandlerActivated(this));
			handlerFailed = new ToastNotificationHandlerInfo<HandlerFailed>(() => new HandlerFailed(this));
		}

		public Task<ToastNotificationResultInternal> ShowAsync()
		{
			if (Notification == null)
			{
				Notification = Adapter.Create(Content.Info);
			}
			Subscribe();
			object state = ToastActivationAsyncState.Create();
			TaskCompletionSource<ToastNotificationResultInternal> source = new TaskCompletionSource<ToastNotificationResultInternal>(state);
			Activated += delegate(IPredefinedToastNotification s, string args)
			{
				Unsubscribe();
				ToastActivationAsyncState.SetActivationArgs(source.Task, args);
				source.SetResult(ToastNotificationResultInternal.Activated);
			};
			Dismissed += delegate(IPredefinedToastNotification s, ToastDismissalReason reason)
			{
				Unsubscribe();
				if ((ulong)reason <= 2uL)
				{
					switch (reason)
					{
					case ToastDismissalReason.ApplicationHidden:
						source.SetResult(ToastNotificationResultInternal.ApplicationHidden);
						break;
					case ToastDismissalReason.TimedOut:
						source.SetResult(ToastNotificationResultInternal.TimedOut);
						break;
					case ToastDismissalReason.UserCanceled:
						source.SetResult(ToastNotificationResultInternal.UserCanceled);
						break;
					}
				}
			};
			Failed += delegate(IPredefinedToastNotification s, ToastNotificationFailedException exception)
			{
				Unsubscribe();
				if (exception.ErrorCode == -2143419897)
				{
					source.SetResult(ToastNotificationResultInternal.Dropped);
				}
				else
				{
					source.SetException(exception);
				}
			};
			ComFunctions.Safe(delegate
			{
				Adapter.Show(Notification);
			}, delegate(COMException ce)
			{
				Unsubscribe();
				source.SetException(new ToastNotificationFailedException(ce, ce.ErrorCode));
			});
			return source.Task;
		}

		public void Hide()
		{
			if (Notification != null)
			{
				Adapter.Hide(Notification);
			}
		}

		private void Subscribe()
		{
			if (Notification != null)
			{
				Notification.AddDismissed(handlerDismissed.Handler, out handlerDismissed.Token);
				Notification.AddActivated(handlerActivated.Handler, out handlerActivated.Token);
				Notification.AddFailed(handlerFailed.Handler, out handlerFailed.Token);
			}
		}

		private void Unsubscribe()
		{
			if (Notification != null)
			{
				Notification.RemoveDismissed(handlerDismissed.Token);
				Notification.RemoveActivated(handlerActivated.Token);
				Notification.RemoveFailed(handlerFailed.Token);
			}
		}
	}
	public static class ToastActivationAsyncState
	{
		private sealed class State
		{
			public string Arguments;
		}

		internal static object Create()
		{
			return new State();
		}

		internal static void SetActivationArgs(Task<ToastNotificationResultInternal> task, string args)
		{
			((State)task.AsyncState).Arguments = args;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static string ActivationArgs(this Task<ToastNotificationResultInternal> task)
		{
			return ((State)task.AsyncState).Arguments;
		}
	}
	[ClassInterface(ClassInterfaceType.None)]
	[ComSourceInterfaces(typeof(INotificationActivationCallback))]
	public abstract class ToastNotificationActivatorBase : INotificationActivationCallback
	{
		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static class UnsafeRegistrator
		{
			private static int? cookie;

			internal static void Register(Type activatorType)
			{
				CheckType(activatorType);
				if (!cookie.HasValue)
				{
					cookie = new RegistrationServices().RegisterTypeForComClients(activatorType, RegistrationClassContext.LocalServer, RegistrationConnectionType.MultipleUse);
				}
			}

			internal static void Unregister()
			{
				if (cookie.HasValue)
				{
					new RegistrationServices().UnregisterTypeForComClients(cookie.Value);
					cookie = null;
				}
			}
		}

		void INotificationActivationCallback.Activate(string appUserModelId, string invokedArgs, NOTIFICATION_USER_INPUT_DATA[] data, uint dataCount)
		{
			int num = ((data != null) ? Math.Min((int)dataCount, data.Length) : 0);
			Dictionary<string, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, string>(num);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				dictionary.Add(data[i].Key, data[i].Value);
			}
			OnActivate(invokedArgs, dictionary);
		}

		public abstract void OnActivate(string arguments, Dictionary<string, string> data);

		internal static void Register(Type activatorType)
		{
			if (!FrameworkVersions.IsNetCore3AndAbove())
			{
				UnsafeRegistrator.Register(activatorType);
			}
		}

		internal static void Unregister()
		{
			if (!FrameworkVersions.IsNetCore3AndAbove())
			{
				UnsafeRegistrator.Unregister();
			}
		}

		internal static void CheckType(Type activatorType)
		{
			if (activatorType == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("activatorType");
			}
			if (!activatorType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(ToastNotificationActivatorBase)))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"{activatorType.Name} must inherit from {typeof(ToastNotificationActivatorBase).Name}.");
			}
			if (activatorType.IsAbstract)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException($"{activatorType.Name} must provide its own implementation.");
			}
		}
	}
	internal class WinRTToastNotificationContent : IPredefinedToastNotificationContent, IDisposable, IPredefinedToastNotificationContentGeneric
	{
		private class WinRTToastNotificationInfo : IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo, IPredefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric
		{
			public ToastTemplateType ToastTemplateType { get; set; }

			public string[] Lines { get; set; }

			public string Id { get; set; }

			public string ImagePath { get; set; }

			public string AppLogoImagePath { get; set; }

			public string HeroImagePath { get; set; }

			public ImageCropType AppLogoImageCrop { get; set; }

			public NotificationDuration Duration { get; set; }

			public PredefinedSound Sound { get; set; }

			public string AttributionText { get; set; }

			public DateTimeOffset? DisplayTimestamp { get; set; }

			public Action<XmlDocument> UpdateToastContent { get; set; }
		}

		private string[] lines = new string[3];

		private string id;

		private ToastTemplateType type;

		private string imagePath;

		internal string tempImagePath;

		private string appLogoImagePath;

		private string tempAppLogoImagePath;

		private string heroImagePath;

		private string tempHeroImagePath;

		private ImageCropType appLogoImageCrop;

		private PredefinedSound sound;

		private NotificationDuration duration;

		private string attributionText = string.Empty;

		private DateTimeOffset? displayTimestamp;

		private Action<XmlDocument> updateToastContent;

		public IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo Info => new WinRTToastNotificationInfo
		{
			ToastTemplateType = type,
			Lines = lines,
			Id = id,
			ImagePath = imagePath,
			AppLogoImagePath = appLogoImagePath,
			HeroImagePath = heroImagePath,
			AppLogoImageCrop = appLogoImageCrop,
			Duration = duration,
			Sound = sound,
			AttributionText = attributionText,
			DisplayTimestamp = displayTimestamp,
			UpdateToastContent = updateToastContent
		};

		public bool IsAssigned { get; set; }

		private WinRTToastNotificationContent()
		{
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			RemoveTempFile(tempImagePath);
			tempImagePath = null;
			RemoveTempFile(tempAppLogoImagePath);
			tempAppLogoImagePath = null;
			RemoveTempFile(tempHeroImagePath);
			tempHeroImagePath = null;
			updateToastContent = null;
		}

		public static WinRTToastNotificationContent Create(string bodyText, string id = null)
		{
			return Create(ToastTemplateType.ToastText01, id, bodyText);
		}

		public static WinRTToastNotificationContent CreateOneLineHeader(string headlineText, string bodyText)
		{
			return Create(ToastTemplateType.ToastText02, null, headlineText, bodyText);
		}

		public static WinRTToastNotificationContent CreateTwoLineHeader(string headlineText, string bodyText, string id = null)
		{
			return Create(ToastTemplateType.ToastText03, id, headlineText, bodyText);
		}

		public static WinRTToastNotificationContent CreateOneLineHeader(string headlineText, string bodyText1, string bodyText2, string id = null)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(bodyText2))
			{
				return Create(ToastTemplateType.ToastText04, id, headlineText, bodyText1, bodyText2);
			}
			return Create(ToastTemplateType.ToastText02, id, headlineText, bodyText1);
		}

		public static WinRTToastNotificationContent CreateToastGeneric(string headlineText, string bodyText1, string bodyText2, string id = null)
		{
			return Create(ToastTemplateType.ToastGeneric, id, headlineText, bodyText1, bodyText2);
		}

		private static WinRTToastNotificationContent Create(ToastTemplateType type, string id, params string[] lines)
		{
			return new WinRTToastNotificationContent
			{
				type = type,
				id = id,
				lines = lines
			};
		}

		private static void SetNodeValueString(string str, IXmlDocument xmldoc, IXmlNode node)
		{
			IXmlText newTextNode;
			using (HSTRING data = HSTRING.FromString(str))
			{
				ComFunctions.CheckHRESULT(xmldoc.CreateTextNode(data, out newTextNode));
			}
			AppendNode(node, (IXmlNode)newTextNode);
		}

		private static void SetImageSrc(IXmlDocument xmldoc, string imagePath)
		{
			IXmlNode node = GetNode(xmldoc, "image");
			IXmlNode node2;
			using (HSTRING name = HSTRING.FromString("src"))
			{
				ComFunctions.CheckHRESULT(node.Attributes.GetNamedItem(name, out node2));
			}
			SetNodeValueString(imagePath, xmldoc, node2);
		}

		public void SetAppLogoImageCrop(ImageCropType appLogoImageCrop)
		{
			this.appLogoImageCrop = appLogoImageCrop;
		}

		public void SetSound(PredefinedSound sound)
		{
			this.sound = sound;
		}

		public void SetDuration(NotificationDuration duration)
		{
			this.duration = duration;
		}

		public void SetAttributionText(string attributionText)
		{
			this.attributionText = attributionText;
		}

		public void SetDisplayTimestamp(DateTimeOffset? displayTimestamp)
		{
			this.displayTimestamp = displayTimestamp;
		}

		public void SetImage(string imagePath)
		{
			SetImage(imagePath, ImagePlacement.Inline);
		}

		public void SetImage(string imagePath, ImagePlacement placement)
		{
			CheckImagePath(imagePath);
			switch (placement)
			{
			case ImagePlacement.Inline:
				UpdateTemplateType();
				this.imagePath = imagePath;
				break;
			case ImagePlacement.AppLogo:
				appLogoImagePath = imagePath;
				break;
			case ImagePlacement.Hero:
				heroImagePath = imagePath;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTemplateType()
		{
			if (type != ToastTemplateType.ToastGeneric)
			{
				if (type == ToastTemplateType.ToastText01)
				{
					type = ToastTemplateType.ToastImageAndText01;
				}
				if (type == ToastTemplateType.ToastText02)
				{
					type = ToastTemplateType.ToastImageAndText02;
				}
				if (type == ToastTemplateType.ToastText03)
				{
					type = ToastTemplateType.ToastImageAndText03;
				}
				if (type == ToastTemplateType.ToastText04)
				{
					type = ToastTemplateType.ToastImageAndText04;
				}
			}
			else if (!ToastNotificationManager.IsGenericTemplateSupported)
			{
				type = ToastTemplateType.ToastImageAndText04;
			}
		}

		public void SetImage(byte[] image)
		{
			SetImage(new MemoryStream(image));
		}

		public void SetImage(Stream stream)
		{
			SetImage(System.Drawing.Image.FromStream(stream));
		}

		public void SetImage(System.Drawing.Image image)
		{
			SetImage(image, ImagePlacement.Inline);
		}

		public void SetImage(System.Drawing.Image image, ImagePlacement placement)
		{
			string tempPath = GetTempPath();
			switch (placement)
			{
			case ImagePlacement.Inline:
				if (tempImagePath != null)
				{
					RemoveTempFile(tempImagePath);
					tempImagePath = null;
				}
				tempImagePath = tempPath;
				break;
			case ImagePlacement.AppLogo:
				if (tempAppLogoImagePath != null)
				{
					RemoveTempFile(tempAppLogoImagePath);
					tempAppLogoImagePath = null;
				}
				tempAppLogoImagePath = tempPath;
				break;
			case ImagePlacement.Hero:
				if (tempHeroImagePath != null)
				{
					RemoveTempFile(tempHeroImagePath);
					tempHeroImagePath = null;
				}
				tempHeroImagePath = tempPath;
				break;
			}
			SaveImageToFile(image, tempPath);
			SetImage(tempPath, placement);
		}

		private static string GetTempPath()
		{
			string tempPath = Path.GetTempPath();
			string empty = string.Empty;
			do
			{
				empty = tempPath + Guid.NewGuid().ToString() + ".png";
			}
			while (File.Exists(empty));
			return empty;
		}

		private void SaveImageToFile(System.Drawing.Image image, string path)
		{
			image.Save(path, ImageFormat.Png);
		}

		private bool IsSupportedExtension(string imagePath)
		{
			string[] array = new string[4] { ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".gif" };
			string extension = Path.GetExtension(imagePath);
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string value in array2)
			{
				if (extension.Equals(value, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CheckImagePath(string imagePath)
		{
			FileInfo fileInfo = new FileInfo(imagePath);
			if (fileInfo.Exists)
			{
				if (!IsSupportedExtension(fileInfo.Extension))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Unsupported file type");
				}
				if (fileInfo.Length > 204800 && !WindowsVersionProvider.IsWin10FallCreatorsUpdateOrHigher)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("File must have size less or equal to 200 KB");
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool IsLoopingSound(PredefinedSound sound)
		{
			return sound >= PredefinedSound.Notification_Looping_Alarm;
		}

		public void SetUpdateToastContentAction(Action<XmlDocument> updateToastContentAction)
		{
			updateToastContent = updateToastContentAction;
		}

		internal static IXmlDocument GetDocument(IToastNotificationManager manager, IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			IXmlDocument templateContent = manager.GetTemplateContent(GetToastTemplateType(info));
			if (ToastNotificationManager.IsGenericTemplateSupported)
			{
				UpdateTemplate(templateContent, info);
				UpdateAttributionText(templateContent, info);
				UpdateDisplayTimestamp(templateContent, info);
				UpdateAppLogoImage(info, templateContent);
				UpdateHeroImage(info, templateContent);
			}
			UpdateText(templateContent, info);
			UpdateInlineImage(info, templateContent);
			UpdateSound(templateContent, info);
			UpdateDuration(templateContent, info);
			UpdateContent(templateContent, info);
			AddId(templateContent, info);
			return templateContent;
		}

		private static void UpdateContent(IXmlDocument xmldoc, IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			string xml = ToastNotificationManager.GetXml((IXmlNodeSerializer)xmldoc);
			XmlDocument xmlDocument = SafeXml.CreateDocument(xml);
			IPredefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric = info as IPredefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric;
			if (predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.UpdateToastContent != null)
			{
				predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.UpdateToastContent(xmlDocument);
			}
			predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.UpdateToastContent = null;
			ToastNotificationManager.LoadXml((IXmlDocumentIO)xmldoc, xmlDocument.OuterXml);
		}

		private static ToastTemplateType GetToastTemplateType(IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			if (info.ToastTemplateType != ToastTemplateType.ToastGeneric)
			{
				return info.ToastTemplateType;
			}
			return ToastTemplateType.ToastText04;
		}

		private static void UpdateTemplate(IXmlDocument xmldoc, IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			if (info.ToastTemplateType == ToastTemplateType.ToastGeneric)
			{
				SetAttribute(xmldoc, "binding", "template", "ToastGeneric");
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateText(IXmlDocument xmldoc, IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			IXmlNodeList nodes = GetNodes(xmldoc, "text");
			for (uint num = 0u; num < info.Lines.Length; num++)
			{
				SetNodeValueString(info.Lines[num] ?? string.Empty, xmldoc, GetNode(nodes, num));
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateAttributionText(IXmlDocument xmldoc, IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			IPredefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric = info as IPredefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric;
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.AttributionText))
			{
				IXmlElement xmlElement = CreateElement(xmldoc, "text");
				IXmlNode node = GetNode(xmldoc, "binding");
				IXmlNode node2 = AppendNode(node, (IXmlNode)xmlElement);
				SetAttribute(node2, "placement", "attribution");
				SetNodeValueString(predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.AttributionText, xmldoc, node2);
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateDisplayTimestamp(IXmlDocument xmldoc, IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			IPredefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric = info as IPredefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric;
			if (predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.DisplayTimestamp.HasValue)
			{
				IXmlNode node = GetNode(xmldoc, "toast");
				string attributeValue = predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.DisplayTimestamp.Value.ToLocalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ");
				SetAttribute(node, "displayTimestamp", attributeValue);
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateInlineImage(IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info, IXmlDocument content)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.ImagePath))
			{
				string absoluteUri = new Uri(info.ImagePath).AbsoluteUri;
				if (info.ToastTemplateType == ToastTemplateType.ToastGeneric)
				{
					CreateInlineImageNode(content, absoluteUri);
				}
				else
				{
					SetImageSrc(content, absoluteUri);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void AddId(IXmlDocument xmldoc, IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.Id))
			{
				SetAttribute(xmldoc, "toast", "launch", info.Id);
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateAppLogoImage(IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info, IXmlDocument content)
		{
			IPredefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric = info as IPredefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.AppLogoImagePath) && info.ToastTemplateType == ToastTemplateType.ToastGeneric)
			{
				string absoluteUri = new Uri(predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.AppLogoImagePath).AbsoluteUri;
				IXmlNode node = CreateInlineImageNode(content, absoluteUri);
				SetAttribute(node, "placement", "appLogoOverride");
				if (predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.AppLogoImageCrop == ImageCropType.Circle)
				{
					SetAttribute(node, "hint-crop", "circle");
				}
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateHeroImage(IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info, IXmlDocument content)
		{
			IPredefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric = info as IPredefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.HeroImagePath) && info.ToastTemplateType == ToastTemplateType.ToastGeneric)
			{
				string absoluteUri = new Uri(predefinedToastNotificationInfoGeneric.HeroImagePath).AbsoluteUri;
				IXmlNode node = CreateInlineImageNode(content, absoluteUri);
				SetAttribute(node, "placement", "hero");
			}
		}

		private static IXmlNode CreateInlineImageNode(IXmlDocument content, string imagePath)
		{
			IXmlNode node = GetNode(content, "binding");
			IXmlElement xmlElement = CreateElement(content, "image");
			IXmlNode xmlNode = AppendNode(node, (IXmlNode)xmlElement);
			SetAttribute(xmlNode, "src", imagePath);
			return xmlNode;
		}

		private static void UpdateSound(IXmlDocument content, IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			if (info.Sound != PredefinedSound.Notification_Default)
			{
				SetSound(content, info.Sound);
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateDuration(IXmlDocument xmldoc, IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			NotificationDuration notificationDuration = info.Duration;
			if (IsLoopingSound(info.Sound))
			{
				notificationDuration = NotificationDuration.Long;
			}
			if (notificationDuration != NotificationDuration.Default)
			{
				SetAttribute(xmldoc, "toast", "duration", "long");
			}
		}

		private static void SetAttribute(IXmlDocument xmldoc, string tagName, string attributeName, string attributeValue)
		{
			IXmlNode node = GetNode(xmldoc, tagName);
			SetAttribute(node, attributeName, attributeValue);
		}

		private static void SetAttribute(IXmlNode node, string attributeName, string attributeValue)
		{
			SetAttribute((IXmlElement)node, attributeName, attributeValue);
		}

		private static void SetAttribute(IXmlElement node, string attributeName, string attributeValue)
		{
			using HSTRING attributeName2 = HSTRING.FromString(attributeName);
			using HSTRING attributeValue2 = HSTRING.FromString(attributeValue);
			ComFunctions.CheckHRESULT(node.SetAttribute(attributeName2, attributeValue2));
		}

		private static void SetSound(IXmlDocument xmldoc, PredefinedSound sound)
		{
			string attributeValue = "ms-winsoundevent:" + sound.ToString().Replace("_", ".");
			IXmlElement xmlElement = CreateElement(xmldoc, "audio");
			if (sound == PredefinedSound.NoSound)
			{
				SetAttribute(xmlElement, "silent", "true");
			}
			else
			{
				SetAttribute(xmlElement, "src", attributeValue);
				SetAttribute(xmlElement, "loop", IsLoopingSound(sound).ToString().ToLower());
			}
			IXmlNode node = GetNode(xmldoc, "toast");
			AppendNode(node, (IXmlNode)xmlElement);
		}

		private static IXmlNode GetNode(IXmlDocument xmldoc, string tagName)
		{
			IXmlNodeList nodes = GetNodes(xmldoc, tagName);
			return GetNode(nodes, 0u);
		}

		private static IXmlNode GetNode(IXmlNodeList nodes, uint index)
		{
			ComFunctions.CheckHRESULT(nodes.Item(index, out var node));
			return node;
		}

		private static IXmlNodeList GetNodes(IXmlDocument xmldoc, string tagName)
		{
			using HSTRING tagName2 = HSTRING.FromString(tagName);
			ComFunctions.CheckHRESULT(xmldoc.GetElementsByTagName(tagName2, out var elements));
			return elements;
		}

		private static IXmlElement CreateElement(IXmlDocument xmldoc, string elementName)
		{
			using HSTRING name = HSTRING.FromString(elementName);
			ComFunctions.CheckHRESULT(xmldoc.CreateElement(name, out var element));
			return element;
		}

		private static IXmlNode AppendNode(IXmlNode parentNode, IXmlNode childNode)
		{
			ComFunctions.CheckHRESULT(parentNode.AppendChild(childNode, out var appendedChild));
			return appendedChild;
		}

		private void RemoveTempFile(string filePath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (File.Exists(filePath))
				{
					File.Delete(filePath);
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
	}

	internal class SqlServerDetector : IDisposable
	{
		internal class RegistryKeyProxy : IDisposable
		{
			private readonly RegistryKey _key;

			public virtual int SubKeyCount
			{
				get
				{
					if (_key != null)
					{
						return _key.SubKeyCount;
					}
					return 0;
				}
			}

			protected RegistryKeyProxy()
			{
			}

			public RegistryKeyProxy(RegistryKey key)
			{
				_key = key;
			}

			public static implicit operator RegistryKeyProxy(RegistryKey key)
			{
				return new RegistryKeyProxy(key);
			}

			public virtual string[] GetSubKeyNames()
			{
				if (_key != null)
				{
					return _key.GetSubKeyNames();
				}
				return new string[0];
			}

			public virtual RegistryKeyProxy OpenSubKey(string name)
			{
				return new RegistryKeyProxy((_key == null) ? null : _key.OpenSubKey(name));
			}

			public virtual void Dispose()
			{
				if (_key != null)
				{
					_key.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private readonly RegistryKeyProxy _localMachine;

		internal SqlServerDetector(RegistryKeyProxy localMachine)
		{
			_localMachine = localMachine;
		}

		public virtual string GetLocalDBVersionInstalled()
		{
			RegistryKeyProxy registryKeyProxy = OpenLocalDBInstalledVersions(useWow6432Node: false);
			if (registryKeyProxy.SubKeyCount == 0)
			{
				registryKeyProxy = OpenLocalDBInstalledVersions(useWow6432Node: true);
			}
			List<Tuple<decimal, string>> list = new List<Tuple<decimal, string>>();
			string[] subKeyNames = registryKeyProxy.GetSubKeyNames();
			foreach (string text in subKeyNames)
			{
				if (decimal.TryParse(text, NumberStyles.AllowDecimalPoint, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out var result))
				{
					list.Add(Tuple.Create(result, text));
				}
			}
			Tuple<decimal, string> tuple = list.OrderByDescending((Tuple<decimal, string> v) => v.Item1).FirstOrDefault();
			if (tuple == null || tuple.Item2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (tuple.Item1 >= 12.0m)
			{
				return "mssqllocaldb";
			}
			return "v" + tuple.Item2;
		}

		private RegistryKeyProxy OpenLocalDBInstalledVersions(bool useWow6432Node)
		{
			RegistryKeyProxy registryKeyProxy = _localMachine.OpenSubKey("SOFTWARE");
			if (useWow6432Node)
			{
				registryKeyProxy = registryKeyProxy.OpenSubKey("Wow6432Node");
			}
			return registryKeyProxy.OpenSubKey("Microsoft").OpenSubKey("Microsoft SQL Server Local DB").OpenSubKey("Installed Versions");
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			_localMachine.Dispose();
		}
	}

		{
			public string Patch(string connectionString)
			{
				DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder
				{
					ConnectionString = connectionString
				};
				string text = (string)(dbConnectionStringBuilder["Data Source"] = GetSqlServerInstanceName());
				if (!text.ToUpper().Contains(".\\SQLEXPRESS"))
				{
					dbConnectionStringBuilder.Remove("User Instance");
				}
				return dbConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString;
			}
		}

		private sealed class ConnectionStringAndDefaultConnectionFactoryPatcherConfigRecord : IInternalConfigRecord
		{
			private readonly IInternalConfigRecord internalRecord;

			private const string ConnectionStringsSectionName = "connectionStrings";

			private const string EntityFrameworkConnectionStringProviderName = "System.Data.EntityClient";

			private const string EntityFrameworkSectionName = "entityFramework";

			private ConnectionStringsSection connectionStringsSection;

			string IInternalConfigRecord.ConfigPath => internalRecord.ConfigPath;

			string IInternalConfigRecord.StreamName => internalRecord.StreamName;

			bool IInternalConfigRecord.HasInitErrors => internalRecord.HasInitErrors;

			private ConnectionStringsSection ConnectionStringSection
			{
				get
				{
					if (connectionStringsSection == null)
					{
						connectionStringsSection = CreateConnectionStringsSection();
					}
					return connectionStringsSection;
				}
			}

			private object EntityFrameworkSection
			{
				get

					if (entityFrameworkSection == null)
					{
						entityFrameworkSection = CreateEntityFrameworkSection();
					}
					return entityFrameworkSection;
				}
			}

			public ConnectionStringAndDefaultConnectionFactoryPatcherConfigRecord(IInternalConfigRecord innerRecord)

				internalRecord = innerRecord;
			}

			void IInternalConfigRecord.ThrowIfInitErrors()
			{
				internalRecord.ThrowIfInitErrors();
			}

			void IInternalConfigRecord.Remove()
			{
				internalRecord.Remove();
			}

			private ConnectionStringsSection CreateConnectionStringsSection()
			{
				ConnectionStringsSection connectionStringsSection = (ConnectionStringsSection)internalRecord.GetSection("connectionStrings");
				ConnectionStringsSection connectionStringsSection2 = new ConnectionStringsSection();
				foreach (ConnectionStringSettings item in connectionStringsSection.ConnectionStrings.Cast<ConnectionStringSettings>())
				{
					ConnectionStringSettings settings = new ConnectionStringSettings(item.Name, PatchConnectionString(item.ConnectionString, item.ProviderName == "System.Data.EntityClient"), item.ProviderName);
					connectionStringsSection2.ConnectionStrings.Add(settings);
				}
				return connectionStringsSection2;
			}

			private object CreateEntityFrameworkSection()
			{
				return ConfigureEntityFrameworkDefaultConnectionFactory(delegate(string factoryTypeName, string[] factoryParameters)
				{
					object section = internalRecord.GetSection("entityFramework");
					Type type = section.GetType();
					string text = (string)type.GetMethod("SerializeSection", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic).Invoke(section, new object[3] { null, "entityFramework", 2 });
					XmlDocument xmlDocument = SafeXml.CreateDocument(text);
					XmlElement xmlElement = xmlDocument.DocumentElement.ChildNodes.OfType<XmlElement>().FirstOrDefault((XmlElement x) => x.Name == "defaultConnectionFactory");
					xmlElement?.ParentNode.RemoveChild(xmlElement);
					XmlElement xmlElement2 = xmlDocument.CreateElement("defaultConnectionFactory");
					xmlElement2.SetAttribute("type", $"System.Data.Entity.Infrastructure.{factoryTypeName}, EntityFramework");
					xmlDocument.DocumentElement.PrependChild(xmlElement2);
					if (factoryParameters.Length != 0)
					{
						XmlElement xmlElement3 = xmlDocument.CreateElement("parameters");
						foreach (string value in factoryParameters)
						{
							XmlElement xmlElement4 = xmlDocument.CreateElement("parameter");
							xmlElement4.SetAttribute("value", value);
							xmlElement3.AppendChild(xmlElement4);
						}
						xmlElement2.AppendChild(xmlElement3);
					}
					MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
					xmlDocument.Save(memoryStream);
					memoryStream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
					XmlReader xmlReader = SafeXml.CreateReader((Stream)memoryStream);
					object obj = Activator.CreateInstance(type, nonPublic: true);
					type.GetMethod("DeserializeSection", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic).Invoke(obj, new object[1] { xmlReader });
					return obj;
				});
			}

			object IInternalConfigRecord.GetSection(string configKey)
			{
				if (!(configKey == "connectionStrings"))
				{
					if (configKey == "entityFramework")
					{
						return EntityFrameworkSection;
					}
					return internalRecord.GetSection(configKey);
				}
				return ConnectionStringSection;
			}

			object IInternalConfigRecord.GetLkgSection(string configKey)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}

			void IInternalConfigRecord.RefreshSection(string configKey)
			{
				if (!(configKey == "connectionStrings"))
				{
					if (configKey == "entityFramework")
					{
						entityFrameworkSection = null;
					}
					else
					{
						internalRecord.RefreshSection(configKey);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					connectionStringsSection = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private static readonly string currentUserName;

		private static readonly string networkServiceLocalizedName;

		private static SqlServerDetector detector;

		private static SqlServerDetector Detector
		{
			get
			{
				if (detector == null)
				{
					detector = new SqlServerDetector(Registry.LocalMachine);

		public static string LocalDbVersion => Detector.GetLocalDBVersionInstalled();

		public static bool IsSqlExpressInstalled => RegistryViewer.Current.GetMultiSzValue(RegistryHive.LocalMachine, "SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft SQL Server", "InstalledInstances")?.Contains("SQLEXPRESS") ?? false;

		public static bool IsLocalDbInstalled => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(LocalDbVersion);

		private static bool IsExecutingUnderService
		{
			get
			{
				if (!currentUserName.StartsWith("IIS APPPOOL\\", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					return string.Equals(currentUserName, networkServiceLocalizedName, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		static DbEngineDetector()
		{
			currentUserName = WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent().Name;
			networkServiceLocalizedName = new SecurityIdentifier(WellKnownSidType.NetworkServiceSid, null).Translate(typeof(NTAccount)).Value;
		}

		public static string[] GetSclCEInstalledVersions()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			string text = "SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Microsoft SQL Server Compact Edition\\";
			if (RegistryViewer.Current.IsKeyExists(RegistryHive.LocalMachine, text + "v3.5"))
			{
				list.Add("v3.5");
			}
			if (RegistryViewer.Current.IsKeyExists(RegistryHive.LocalMachine, text + "v4.0"))
			{
				list.Add("v4.0");
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static string PatchInnerString(string connectionString, bool entitySyntax, PatchSimpleString patchFunction)
		{
			if (entitySyntax)
			{
				DbConnectionStringBuilder dbConnectionStringBuilder = new DbConnectionStringBuilder
				{
					ConnectionString = connectionString
				};
				dbConnectionStringBuilder["provider connection string"] = patchFunction.Patch("");
				return dbConnectionStringBuilder.ConnectionString;
			}
			return patchFunction.Patch(connectionString);
		}

		public static string PatchConnectionString(string rawConnectionString, bool entitySyntax = false)
		{
			if (rawConnectionString.ToLower().Contains("sqlite"))
			{
				return rawConnectionString;
			}
			PatchSimpleString patchFunction = new PatchSimpleString();
			return PatchInnerString(rawConnectionString, entitySyntax, patchFunction);
		}

		public static string SelectConnectionStringName(string sqlexpressName, string localdbName)
		{
			string localDbVersion = LocalDbVersion;
			if (IsSqlExpressInstalled)
			{
				return sqlexpressName;
			}
			if (localDbVersion != null)
			{
				return localdbName;
			}
			return sqlexpressName;
		}

		public static string GetSqlServerInstanceName()
		{
			string localDbVersion = LocalDbVersion;
			if (localDbVersion != null && !IsExecutingUnderService)
			{
				return "(localdb)\\" + localDbVersion;
			}
			if (IsSqlExpressInstalled)
			{
				return ".\\SQLEXPRESS";
			}
			return "(local)";
		}

		public static bool PatchConnectionStringsAndConfigureEntityFrameworkDefaultConnectionFactory()
		{
			PatchAppConfigConnectionStringsAndDefaultConnectionFactory();
			return ConfigureEntityFrameworkDefaultConnectionFactory(ConfigureDefaultConnectionFactory);
		}

		private static T ConfigureEntityFrameworkDefaultConnectionFactory<T>(Func<string, string[], T> configure)
		{
			string localDbVersion = LocalDbVersion;
			if (localDbVersion != null)
			{
				return configure("LocalDbConnectionFactory", new string[1] { localDbVersion });
			}
			return configure("SqlConnectionFactory", new string[0]);
		}

		private static bool ConfigureDefaultConnectionFactory(string connectionFactoryTypeName, string[] connectionFactoryArguments)
		{
			object obj = CreateDbConfiguration();
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type type = obj.GetType();
			Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(type.Assembly, "System.Data.Entity.Infrastructure." + connectionFactoryTypeName, false, (bool?)null);
			object obj2 = Activator.CreateInstance(knownType, connectionFactoryArguments);
			MethodInfo method = type.GetMethod("SetDefaultConnectionFactory", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			method.Invoke(obj, new object[1] { obj2 });
			MethodInfo method2 = type.GetMethod("SetConfiguration", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public);
			method2.Invoke(null, new object[1] { obj });
			return true;
		}

		private static object CreateDbConfiguration()
		{
			Assembly entityFrameworkAssembly = GetEntityFrameworkAssembly();
			if (entityFrameworkAssembly == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(entityFrameworkAssembly, "System.Data.Entity.DbConfiguration", false, (bool?)null);
			ConstructorInfo constructor = knownType.GetConstructor(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, Type.EmptyTypes, null);
			return constructor.Invoke(new object[0]);
		}

		private static Assembly GetEntityFrameworkAssembly()
		{
			return SafeTypeResolver.GetOrLoadAssembly("EntityFramework", false);
		}

		private static void PatchAppConfigConnectionStringsAndDefaultConnectionFactory()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(ConfigurationManager);
			Type nestedType = typeFromHandle.GetNestedType("InitState", BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			object value = nestedType.GetEnumValues().GetValue(0);
			FieldInfo field = typeFromHandle.GetField("s_initState", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			field.SetValue(null, value);
			FieldInfo field2 = typeFromHandle.GetField("s_configSystem", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(typeFromHandle.Assembly, "System.Configuration.ClientConfigurationSystem", false, (bool?)null);
			field2.SetValue(null, null);
			Type knownType2 = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(typeFromHandle.Assembly, "System.Configuration.Internal.InternalConfigSettingsFactory", false, (bool?)null);
			IInternalConfigSettingsFactory internalConfigSettingsFactory = (IInternalConfigSettingsFactory)Activator.CreateInstance(knownType2, nonPublic: true);
			IInternalConfigSystem internalConfigSystem = (IInternalConfigSystem)Activator.CreateInstance(knownType, nonPublic: true);
			FieldInfo field3 = knownType.GetField("_configRoot", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			IInternalConfigRoot internalRoot = (IInternalConfigRoot)field3.GetValue(internalConfigSystem);
			field3.SetValue(internalConfigSystem, new ConnectionStringAndDefaultConnectionFactoryPatcherConfigRoot(internalRoot));
			internalConfigSettingsFactory.SetConfigurationSystem(internalConfigSystem, initComplete: false);
		}

			public const int KEY_WOW64_RES = 768;

			public const int KEY_READ = 131097;

			public static extern uint RegQueryValueEx(IntPtr hKey, string lpValueName, int lpReserved, ref RType lpType, byte[] pvData, ref uint pcbData);

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static IntPtr OpenRegistryKey(RegistryHive hkey, string subkey, ResigtryAccess access)
		{
			if (Import.RegOpenKeyEx(HkeyToPtr(hkey), subkey, 0, (int)access, out var hkResult) != 0)
			{
				return IntPtr.Zero;
			}
			return hkResult;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static void CloseRegistryKey(IntPtr key)
		{
			Import.RegCloseKey(key);
		}

		private static IntPtr HkeyToPtr(RegistryHive hkey)
		{
			if (hkey != RegistryHive.CurrentUser)
			{
				return Import.HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE;
			}
			return Import.HKEY_CURRENT_USER;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static string[] ReadRegistryKeyMultiSzValue(IntPtr key, string name)
		{
			Import.RType lpType = Import.RType.RegMultiSz;
			uint pcbData = 0u;
			if (Import.RegQueryValueEx(key, name, 0, ref lpType, null, ref pcbData) != 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[pcbData];
			if (Import.RegQueryValueEx(key, name, 0, ref lpType, array, ref pcbData) != 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			string text = Encoding.Unicode.GetString(array, 0, (int)pcbData);
			int num = -1;
			while (true)
			{
				int num2 = num + 1;
				num = text.IndexOf('\0', num2);
				if (num <= num2)
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add(text.Substring(num2, num - num2));
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public static string ReadRegistryKeySzValue(IntPtr key, string name)
		{
			Import.RType lpType = Import.RType.RegSz;
			uint pcbData = 0u;
			if (Import.RegQueryValueEx(key, name, 0, ref lpType, null, ref pcbData) != 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			byte[] array = new byte[pcbData];
			if (Import.RegQueryValueEx(key, name, 0, ref lpType, array, ref pcbData) != 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Encoding.Unicode.GetString(array, 0, (int)pcbData);
		}

	public class WinApiRegistryKey : DisposableBase
	{
		private IntPtr handle;

		public bool Exists => handle != IntPtr.Zero;

		public WinApiRegistryKey(RegistryHive hive, string key, WinApiRegistryHelper.ResigtryAccess access)
		{
			handle = WinApiRegistryHelper.OpenRegistryKey(hive, key, access);
		}

		protected override void DisposeUnmanaged()
		{
			if (handle != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				WinApiRegistryHelper.CloseRegistryKey(handle);
			}
			handle = IntPtr.Zero;
			((DisposableBase)this).DisposeUnmanaged();
		}

		public string[] GetMultiSzValue(string name)
		{
			if (!Exists)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return WinApiRegistryHelper.ReadRegistryKeyMultiSzValue(handle, name);
		}

		public string GetSzValue(string name)
		{
			if (!Exists)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return WinApiRegistryHelper.ReadRegistryKeySzValue(handle, name);
		}
	}
	public class WinApiRegistryMultiKey : DisposableBase
	{
		private List<WinApiRegistryKey> keys = new List<WinApiRegistryKey>();

		public bool Exists => keys.Count > 0;

		public WinApiRegistryMultiKey(RegistryHive hive, string key, WinApiRegistryHelper.ResigtryAccess access)
		{
			WinApiRegistryKey winApiRegistryKey = new WinApiRegistryKey(hive, key, access | WinApiRegistryHelper.ResigtryAccess.WOW64_32Key);
			if (winApiRegistryKey.Exists)
			{
				keys.Add(winApiRegistryKey);
			}
			winApiRegistryKey = new WinApiRegistryKey(hive, key, access | WinApiRegistryHelper.ResigtryAccess.WOW64_64Key);
			if (winApiRegistryKey.Exists)
			{
				keys.Add(winApiRegistryKey);
			}
		}

		protected override void DisposeManaged()
		{
			foreach (WinApiRegistryKey key in keys)
			{
				((DisposableBase)key).Dispose();
			}
			keys.Clear();
			((DisposableBase)this).DisposeManaged();
		}

		public string[] GetMultiSzValue(string name)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (WinApiRegistryKey key in keys)
			{
				string[] multiSzValue = key.GetMultiSzValue(name);
				if (multiSzValue != null)
				{
					list.AddRange(multiSzValue);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public string GetSzValue(string name)
		{
			foreach (WinApiRegistryKey key in keys)
			{
				string szValue = key.GetSzValue(name);
				if (szValue != null)
				{
					return szValue;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class RegistryViewerBase
	{
		public abstract bool IsKeyExists(RegistryHive hive, string key);

		public abstract string[] GetMultiSzValue(RegistryHive hive, string key, string name);

		public abstract string GetSzValue(RegistryHive hive, string key, string name);
	}
	public class RegistryViewer : RegistryViewerBase
	{
		public static RegistryViewer Current = new RegistryViewer();

		public override bool IsKeyExists(RegistryHive hive, string key)
		{
			WinApiRegistryMultiKey wKey = GetWKey(hive, key);
			try
			{
				return wKey.Exists;
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)wKey)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public override string[] GetMultiSzValue(RegistryHive hive, string key, string name)
		{
			WinApiRegistryMultiKey wKey = GetWKey(hive, key);
			try
			{
				return wKey.GetMultiSzValue(name);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)wKey)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public override string GetSzValue(RegistryHive hive, string key, string name)
		{
			WinApiRegistryMultiKey wKey = GetWKey(hive, key);
			try
			{
				return wKey.GetSzValue(name);
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)wKey)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private WinApiRegistryMultiKey GetWKey(RegistryHive hive, string key)
		{
			key = key.Replace('/', '\\');
			return new WinApiRegistryMultiKey(hive, key, WinApiRegistryHelper.ResigtryAccess.Read);
		}
	}

	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	public struct HSTRING : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly IntPtr handle;

		public static HSTRING FromString(string str)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(IntPtr.Size);
			try
			{
				Marshal.ThrowExceptionForHR(WindowsCreateString(str, str.Length, intPtr));
				return Marshal.PtrToStructure<HSTRING>(intPtr);
			}
			finally
			{
				Marshal.FreeHGlobal(intPtr);
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (!(handle == IntPtr.Zero))
			{
				Marshal.ThrowExceptionForHR(WindowsDeleteString(handle));
			}
		}

		public string GetString()
		{
			if (handle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			uint length;
			if (WindowsGetStringLen(handle) != 0)
			{
				return Marshal.PtrToStringUni(WindowsGetStringRawBuffer(handle, out length));
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		[DllImport("api-ms-win-core-winrt-string-l1-1-0.dll", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.StdCall)]
		private static extern int WindowsCreateString([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] string sourceString, int length, [Out] IntPtr hstring);

		[DllImport("api-ms-win-core-winrt-string-l1-1-0.dll", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.StdCall)]
		private static extern int WindowsDeleteString([In] IntPtr hstring);

		[DllImport("api-ms-win-core-winrt-string-l1-1-0.dll", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.StdCall)]
		private static extern uint WindowsGetStringLen([In] IntPtr hstring);

		[DllImport("api-ms-win-core-winrt-string-l1-1-0.dll", CallingConvention = CallingConvention.StdCall)]
		private static extern IntPtr WindowsGetStringRawBuffer([In] IntPtr hstring, out uint length);
	}

	[StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 4)]
	internal struct PropertyKey : IEquatable<PropertyKey>
	{
		private Guid formatId;

		private int propertyId;

		public Guid FormatId => formatId;

		public int PropertyId => propertyId;

		public PropertyKey(Guid formatId, int propertyId)
		{
			this.formatId = formatId;
			this.propertyId = propertyId;
		}

		public PropertyKey(string formatId, int propertyId)
		{
			this.formatId = new Guid(formatId);
			this.propertyId = propertyId;
		}

		public bool Equals(PropertyKey other)
		{
			return other.Equals((object)this);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return propertyId * 5381 + formatId.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(obj is PropertyKey propertyKey))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (propertyKey.formatId.Equals(formatId))
			{
				return propertyKey.propertyId == propertyId;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator ==(PropertyKey propKey1, PropertyKey propKey2)
		{
			return propKey1.Equals(propKey2);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(PropertyKey propKey1, PropertyKey propKey2)
		{
			return !propKey1.Equals(propKey2);
		}

		private static Dictionary<Type, Action<PropVariant, Array, uint>> GenerateVectorActions()
		{
			Dictionary<Type, Action<PropVariant, Array, uint>> dictionary = new Dictionary<Type, Action<PropVariant, Array, uint>>();
			dictionary.Add(typeof(short), delegate(PropVariant pv, Array array, uint i)
			{
				PropVariantNativeMethods.PropVariantGetInt16Elem(pv, i, out var pnVal);
				array.SetValue(pnVal, i);

			dictionary.Add(typeof(ushort), delegate(PropVariant pv, Array array, uint i)
			{
				PropVariantNativeMethods.PropVariantGetUInt16Elem(pv, i, out var pnVal);
				array.SetValue(pnVal, i);
			});
			dictionary.Add(typeof(int), delegate(PropVariant pv, Array array, uint i)
			{
				PropVariantNativeMethods.PropVariantGetInt32Elem(pv, i, out var pnVal);
				array.SetValue(pnVal, i);
			});
			dictionary.Add(typeof(uint), delegate(PropVariant pv, Array array, uint i)
			{
				PropVariantNativeMethods.PropVariantGetUInt32Elem(pv, i, out var pnVal);
				array.SetValue(pnVal, i);
			});
			dictionary.Add(typeof(long), delegate(PropVariant pv, Array array, uint i)
			{
				PropVariantNativeMethods.PropVariantGetInt64Elem(pv, i, out var pnVal);

	[CLSCompliant(false)]
	public interface IToastNotificationAdapter
	{
		IToastNotification Create(IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info);

		void Show(IToastNotification notification);

		void Hide(IToastNotification notification);
	}
	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	public static class ToastNotificationManager
	{
		private class ToastNotificationAdapter : IToastNotificationAdapter
		{
			private string appId;

			private IToastNotifier notifier;

			private IToastNotificationFactory factory;

			private IToastNotificationManager manager;

			public ToastNotificationAdapter(string appId, IToastNotificationManager manager)
			{
				this.appId = appId;
				this.manager = manager;
			}

			IToastNotification IToastNotificationAdapter.Create(IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
			{
				IXmlDocument document = GetDocument(manager, info);
				if (factory == null)
				{
					factory = ComFunctions.RoGetActivationFactory<IToastNotificationFactory>();
				}
				ComFunctions.CheckHRESULT(factory.CreateToastNotification(document, out var notification));
				return notification;
			}

			void IToastNotificationAdapter.Show(IToastNotification notification)
			{
				if (notifier == null)
				{
					using HSTRING applicationId = HSTRING.FromString(appId);
					ComFunctions.CheckHRESULT(manager.CreateToastNotifierWithId(applicationId, out notifier));
				}
				if (notifier != null && notification != null)
				{
					notifier.Show(notification);
				}
			}

			void IToastNotificationAdapter.Hide(IToastNotification notification)
			{
				if (notifier == null)
				{
					using HSTRING applicationId = HSTRING.FromString(appId);
					ComFunctions.CheckHRESULT(manager.CreateToastNotifierWithId(applicationId, out notifier));
				}
				if (notifier != null && notification != null)
				{
					notifier.Hide(notification);
				}
			}
		}

		private class EmptyToastNotificationAdapter : IToastNotificationAdapter
		{
			IToastNotification IToastNotificationAdapter.Create(IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
			{
				return null;
			}

			void IToastNotificationAdapter.Show(IToastNotification notification)
			{
			}

			void IToastNotificationAdapter.Hide(IToastNotification notification)
			{
			}
		}

		private static Version Win8Version = new Version(6, 2, 9200, 0);

		private static IToastNotificationManager defaultManager;

		private static bool IsWin8OrHigher
		{
			get
			{
				OperatingSystem oSVersion = Environment.OSVersion;
				if (oSVersion.Platform == PlatformID.Win32NT)
				{
					return oSVersion.Version >= Win8Version;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsGenericTemplateSupported => WindowsVersionProvider.IsWin10AnniversaryUpdateOrHigher;

		public static bool AreToastNotificationsSupported => IsWin8OrHigher;

		internal static IToastNotificationManager GetDefaultManager()
		{
			if (defaultManager == null)
			{
				defaultManager = ComFunctions.RoGetActivationFactory<IToastNotificationManager>();
			}
			return defaultManager;
		}

		internal static IXmlDocument GetDocument(IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			return GetDocument(GetDefaultManager(), info);
		}

		internal static IXmlDocument GetDocument(IToastNotificationManager manager, IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			return WinRTToastNotificationContent.GetDocument(manager, info);
		}

		internal static string GetXml(IPredefinedToastNotificationInfo info)
		{
			return GetXml((IXmlNodeSerializer)GetDocument(info));
		}

		internal static string GetXml(IXmlNodeSerializer content)
		{
			content.GetXml(out var xml);
			return xml.GetString();
		}

		internal static void LoadXml(IXmlDocumentIO content, string xml)
		{
			using HSTRING xml2 = HSTRING.FromString(xml);
			content.LoadXml(xml2);
		}

		internal static IToastNotificationAdapter CreateToastNotificationAdapter(string appID)
		{
			if (!AreToastNotificationsSupported)
			{
				return new EmptyToastNotificationAdapter();
			}
			return new ToastNotificationAdapter(appID, GetDefaultManager());
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Utils

	public class ResourceImageHelper : ResourceImageHelperCore
	{
		public static Cursor CreateCursorFromResources(string name, Assembly asm)
		{
			using Stream stream = asm.GetManifestResourceStream(name);
			return new Cursor(stream);
		}

		public static ImageList CreateImageListFromResources(string name, Assembly asm, System.Drawing.Size size)
		{
			return CreateImageListFromResources(name, asm, size, System.Drawing.Color.Magenta);
		}

		public static ImageList CreateImageListFromResources(string name, Assembly asm, System.Drawing.Size size, System.Drawing.Color transparent)
		{
			return CreateImageListFromResources(name, asm, size, transparent, ColorDepth.Depth8Bit);
		}

		public static void FillImageListFromResources(ImageList images, string name, Assembly asm, System.Drawing.Color transparent)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = ResourceImageHelperCore.CreateBitmapFromResources(name, asm);
			bitmap.MakeTransparent(transparent);
			images.Images.AddStrip(bitmap);
		}

		public static void FillImageListFromResources(ImageList images, string name, Type type)
		{
			FillImageListFromResources(images, ResourceStreamHelper.GetResourceName(type, name), type.Assembly);
		}

		public static void FillImageListFromResources(ImageList images, string name, Assembly asm)
		{
			FillImageListFromResources(images, name, asm, images.TransparentColor);
		}

		public static ImageList CreateImageListFromResources(string name, Assembly asm, System.Drawing.Size size, System.Drawing.Color transparent, ColorDepth depth)
		{
			if (transparent == System.Drawing.Color.Empty)
			{
				transparent = System.Drawing.Color.Magenta;
			}
			ImageList imageList = new ImageList();
			imageList.ColorDepth = depth;
			imageList.ImageSize = (size.IsEmpty ? new System.Drawing.Size(16, 16) : size);
			FillImageListFromResources(imageList, name, asm, transparent);
			return imageList;
		}
	}
	public static class WindowsVersionProvider
	{
		private sealed class WindowsVersionInfo
		{
			private const string RegistryVersionKey = "SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion";

			public int CurrentBuild { get; set; }

			public int CurrentMajorVersionNumber { get; set; }

			public int CurrentMinorVersionNumber { get; set; }

			public Version CurrentVersion { get; set; }

			public string ProductName { get; set; }

			public int ReleaseID { get; set; }

			public static bool TryCreate(out WindowsVersionInfo vi)
			{
				vi = null;
				try
				{
					using RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey("SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion", writable: false);
					if (registryKey != null)
					{
						WindowsVersionInfo windowsVersionInfo = new WindowsVersionInfo();
						windowsVersionInfo.CurrentBuild = GetRegistryKeyValue(registryKey, "CurrentBuild", ConvertToInt32FromString, int.MinValue);
						windowsVersionInfo.CurrentMajorVersionNumber = GetRegistryKeyValue(registryKey, "CurrentMajorVersionNumber", ConvertToInt32FromHex, int.MinValue);
						windowsVersionInfo.CurrentMinorVersionNumber = GetRegistryKeyValue(registryKey, "CurrentMinorVersionNumber", ConvertToInt32FromHex, int.MinValue);
						windowsVersionInfo.CurrentVersion = GetRegistryKeyValue(registryKey, "CurrentVersion", ConvertToVersion, null);
						windowsVersionInfo.ProductName = GetRegistryKeyValue(registryKey, "ProductName", ConvertToString, string.Empty);
						windowsVersionInfo.ReleaseID = GetRegistryKeyValue(registryKey, "ReleaseId", ConvertToInt32FromString, int.MinValue);
						vi = windowsVersionInfo;
						return true;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				return false;
			}

			private static string ConvertToString(object value)
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return value.ToString();
			}

			private static int ConvertToInt32FromString(object value)
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					return int.MinValue;
				}
				return int.Parse(value.ToString());
			}

			private static int ConvertToInt32FromHex(object value)
			{
				if (value == null)
				{
					return int.MinValue;
				}
				return int.Parse(value.ToString(), NumberStyles.HexNumber);
			}

			private static Version ConvertToVersion(object value)
			{
				Version result = new Version();
				if (value != null)
				{
					Version.TryParse(value.ToString(), out result);
					return result;
				}
				return result;
			}

			private static T GetRegistryKeyValue<T>(RegistryKey key, string subKeyName, Func<object, T> convert, T defaultVal)
			{
				if (key != null)
				{
					object value = key.GetValue(subKeyName);
					if (value != null)
					{
						return convert(value);
					}
				}
				return defaultVal;
			}
		}

		private static readonly WindowsVersionInfo DefaultWindowsVersionInfo = new WindowsVersionInfo();

		private static WindowsVersionInfo info;

		private static WindowsVersionInfo WinVersionInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (info == null && !WindowsVersionInfo.TryCreate(out info))
				{
					return DefaultWindowsVersionInfo;
				}
				return info;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsWindows10
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(WinVersionInfo.ProductName))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return WinVersionInfo.ProductName.IndexOf("windows 10", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsWindows11
		{
			get
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(WinVersionInfo.ProductName))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (WinVersionInfo.ProductName.IndexOf("windows 10", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
				{
					return WinVersionInfo.CurrentBuild >= 22000;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsWin10AnniversaryUpdateOrHigher
		{
			get
			{
				if (WinVersionInfo.CurrentMajorVersionNumber <= 10)
				{
					if (WinVersionInfo.CurrentMajorVersionNumber == 10)
					{
						return WinVersionInfo.CurrentBuild >= 14393;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsWin10FallCreatorsUpdateOrHigher => WinVersionInfo.ReleaseID >= 1709;

		public static bool IsWin10SpringCreatorsUpdateOrHigher => WinVersionInfo.ReleaseID >= 1803;

		public static bool IsWinSupportsAcrylicEffect
		{
			get
			{
				if (WinVersionInfo.ReleaseID >= 1803)
				{
					return WinVersionInfo.CurrentBuild >= 17064;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsWinSupportsMicaEffect
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsWindows11)
				{
					return WinVersionInfo.CurrentBuild >= 22523;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static bool IsWindows10Build1903OrHigher => WinVersionInfo.ReleaseID >= 1903;

		public static bool IsWindows10Build1809OrHigher => WinVersionInfo.ReleaseID >= 1809;
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Utils.Helpers
{
	public static class SystemEventsHelper
	{
		public static class Diagnostics
		{
			public static class HealthMonitor
			{
				[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
				public const int DefaultTimeout = 9000;

				[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
				public static bool AutoStartMonitoringOnTryCreateOnProperThread = false;

				[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
				public static int MonitoringOnTryCreateOnProperThreadTimeout = 20000;

				public static Task Run()
				{
					return Run(null, 9000, CancellationToken.None);
				}

				public static Task Run(int heartBeatTimeout)
				{
					return Run(null, heartBeatTimeout, CancellationToken.None);
				}

				public static Task Run(Action<string> alarmListener)
				{
					return Run(alarmListener, 9000, CancellationToken.None);
				}

				public static Task Run(Action<string> alarmListener, int heartBeatTimeout)
				{
					return Run(alarmListener, heartBeatTimeout, CancellationToken.None);
				}

				public static async Task Run(Action<string> alarmListener, int heartBeatTimeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
				{
					AutoStartMonitoringOnTryCreateOnProperThread = true;
					await AwaitSystemEventsAvailabilityAsync(heartBeatTimeout, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					Thread eventThread = await QuerySystemEventsThreadAsync().ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					string onceAliveInfo = ZombieContextsDetector.GetThreadString(eventThread);
					while (true)
					{
						cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
						Task probingTask;
						try
						{
							probingTask = QuerySystemEventsProbingAsync();
						}
						catch (Exception e)
						{
							NotifyThreadInvokeThrownException(alarmListener, e);
							break;
						}
						foreach (int item in ChopTimeout(heartBeatTimeout))
						{
							await Task.Delay(item, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							if (probingTask.IsCompleted)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
						if (!probingTask.IsCompleted)
						{
							NotifyThreadNotPumping(alarmListener, eventThread, onceAliveInfo);
							await probingTask.ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							NotifyThreadPumpingAgain(alarmListener);
						}
					}
				}

				private static void NotifyThreadInvokeThrownException(Action<string> alarmListener, Exception e)
				{
					string obj = $"SystemEvents thread status: {e}";
					alarmListener?.Invoke(obj);
				}

				private static void NotifyThreadPumpingAgain(Action<string> alarmListener)
				{
					try
					{
						throw new WarningException("SystemEvents thread status: Ok");
					}
					catch (WarningException)
					{
					}
					alarmListener?.Invoke("SystemEvents thread status: Ok");
				}

				private static void NotifyThreadNotPumping(Action<string> alarmListener, Thread systemEventsThread, string onceAliveInfo)
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("SystemEvents thread status: frozen");
					if (onceAliveInfo != null)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append("; Original thread state: " + onceAliveInfo);
					}
					string text = ZombieContextsDetector.GetThreadString(systemEventsThread);
					if (text != null)
					{
						if (text == onceAliveInfo)
						{
							text = "(same)";
						}
						stringBuilder.Append("; Current thread state: " + text);
					}
					string text2 = stringBuilder.ToString();
					try
					{
						throw new WarningException(text2);
					}
					catch (WarningException)
					{
					}
					alarmListener?.Invoke(text2);
				}

				private static Task<Thread> QuerySystemEventsThreadAsync()
				{
					TaskCompletionSource<Thread> tcsSysEventsThread = new TaskCompletionSource<Thread>();
					SystemEvents.InvokeOnEventsThread((Action)delegate
					{
						tcsSysEventsThread.SetResult(Thread.CurrentThread);
					});
					return tcsSysEventsThread.Task;
				}

				private static Task QuerySystemEventsProbingAsync()
				{
					TaskCompletionSource<bool> tcsSysEventsProbing = new TaskCompletionSource<bool>();
					SystemEvents.InvokeOnEventsThread((Action)delegate
					{
						tcsSysEventsProbing.SetResult(result: true);
					});
					return tcsSysEventsProbing.Task;
				}
			}

			public static class FrozenHandlerDetector
			{
				[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
				public const int DefaultTimeout = 5000;

				public static Task Run()
				{
					return Run(null, 5000, CancellationToken.None);
				}

				public static Task Run(int zombieTimeout)
				{
					return Run(null, zombieTimeout, CancellationToken.None);
				}

				public static Task Run(Action<string> alarmListener)
				{
					return Run(alarmListener, 5000, CancellationToken.None);
				}

				public static Task Run(Action<string> alarmListener, int zombieTimeout)
				{
					return Run(alarmListener, zombieTimeout, CancellationToken.None);
				}

				public static async Task Run(Action<string> alarmListener, int zombieTimeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
				{
					Func<Tuple<object, SynchronizationContext, Delegate>[]> workDataExtractor = CreateWorkDataExtractor();
					Func<IGrouping<SynchronizationContext, Tuple<object, Delegate>>[], string> barkDataGetter = CreateBarkDataGetter();
					await AwaitSystemEventsAvailabilityAsync(zombieTimeout, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
					string prevBarkData = null;
					while (true)
					{
						cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
						Tuple<object, SynchronizationContext, Delegate>[] array = workDataExtractor();
						string text;
						if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
						{
							await Task.Delay(GetSmallTimeoutSlice(zombieTimeout), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
							text = null;
						}
						else
						{
							IGrouping<SynchronizationContext, Tuple<object, Delegate>>[] compressed = array.ToLookup((Tuple<object, SynchronizationContext, Delegate> t) => t.Item2, (Tuple<object, SynchronizationContext, Delegate> t) => Tuple.Create(t.Item1, t.Item3)).ToArray();
							TaskCompletionSource<TaskStatus>[] completionSources = CreateProbingSources(compressed);
							Task<TaskStatus>[] probingTasks = completionSources.Select((TaskCompletionSource<TaskStatus> s) => s.Task).ToArray();
							Task<TaskStatus[]> aggregator = Task.WhenAll(probingTasks);
							foreach (int item in ChopTimeout(zombieTimeout))
							{
								await Task.Delay(item, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
								if (aggregator.IsCompleted)
								{
									break;
								}
							}
							if (aggregator.IsCompleted)
							{
								text = null;
							}
							else
							{
								TaskCompletionSource<TaskStatus>[] array2 = completionSources;
								foreach (TaskCompletionSource<TaskStatus> taskCompletionSource in array2)
								{
									taskCompletionSource.TrySetResult(TaskStatus.Canceled);
								}
								IGrouping<SynchronizationContext, Tuple<object, Delegate>>[] arg = compressed.Where((IGrouping<SynchronizationContext, Tuple<object, Delegate>> g, int i) => probingTasks[i].Result == TaskStatus.Canceled).ToArray();
								text = barkDataGetter(arg);
							}
						}
						if (text != prevBarkData)
						{
							prevBarkData = text;
							if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
							{
								NotifyTargetsAvailableAgain(alarmListener);
							}
							else
							{
								NotifyTargetsUnavailable(alarmListener, text);
							}
						}
					}
				}

				private static TaskCompletionSource<TaskStatus>[] CreateProbingSources(IGrouping<SynchronizationContext, Tuple<object, Delegate>>[] compressed)
				{
					TaskCompletionSource<TaskStatus>[] completionSources = new TaskCompletionSource<TaskStatus>[compressed.Length];
					for (int i = 0; i < compressed.Length; i++)
					{
						completionSources[i] = new TaskCompletionSource<TaskStatus>();
					}
					SendOrPostCallback d = delegate(object state)
					{
						completionSources[(int)state].TrySetResult(TaskStatus.RanToCompletion);
					};
					for (int num = 0; num < compressed.Length; num++)
					{
						SynchronizationContext key = compressed[num].Key;
						try
						{
							key.Post(d, num);
						}
						catch
						{
							completionSources[num].TrySetResult(TaskStatus.Faulted);
						}
					}
					return completionSources;
				}
