				private static Func<IGrouping<SynchronizationContext, Tuple<object, Delegate>>[], string> CreateBarkDataGetter()
				{
					Func<object, string> eventTagsDecoder = CreateEventTagsDecoder();
					Func<SynchronizationContext, string> syncContextDecoder = CreateSyncContextDecoder();
					return (IGrouping<SynchronizationContext, Tuple<object, Delegate>>[] toBark) => (toBark == null || toBark.Length == 0) ? null : string.Join(", ", from g in toBark
						select "Zombielike context " + syncContextDecoder(g.Key) + " with affected delegate(s): " + string.Join(", ", from t in g
							group t.Item2 by t.Item1 into hg
							select new
							{
								Key = hg.Key,
								KeyName = eventTagsDecoder(hg.Key),
								Delegates = hg.Select(DecodeDelegate).ToArray()
							} into t
							orderby t.KeyName, t.Key.GetHashCode()
							select t.KeyName + " -> (" + string.Join(", ", from x in t.Delegates
								group x by x into x
								select new
								{
									Key = x.Key,
									Count = x.Count()
								} into x
								orderby x.Key
								select (x.Count != 1) ? (x.Key + "(x" + x.Count + ")") : x.Key) + ")") into s
						orderby s
						select s);
				}

				private static Func<object, string> CreateEventTagsDecoder()
				{
					Dictionary<object, string> eventTags = (from fi in typeof(SystemEvents).GetFields(BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic)
						where fi.FieldType == typeof(object)
						select new
						{
							FieldName = fi.Name,
							Key = fi.GetValue(null)
						} into p
						where p.Key != null
						where p.Key.GetType() == typeof(object)
						where !p.FieldName.EndsWith("LockObject", StringComparison.Ordinal)
						select p).ToDictionary(p => p.Key, p => p.FieldName);
					return delegate(object tag)
					{
						if (tag == null)
						{
							return "(null)";
						}
						string value;
						return (!eventTags.TryGetValue(tag, out value)) ? "(unknown)" : value;
					};
				}

				private static string DecodeDelegate(Delegate @delegate)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					string text;
					try
					{
						object target = @delegate.Target;
						if (target == null)
						{
							text = "(static)";
							flag = true;
						}
						else
						{
							string text2 = target.ToString();
							string text3 = target.GetType().ToString();
							text = ((!(text2 == text3)) ? ("(" + text3 + "[" + text2 + "])") : ("(" + text3 + ")"));
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						text = ex.GetType().FullName;
					}
					string text4;
					try
					{
						MethodInfo method = @delegate.Method;
						text4 = ((!flag) ? method.Name : $"{method.DeclaringType}.{method.Name}");
					}
					catch (Exception ex2)
					{
						text4 = ex2.GetType().FullName;
					}
					return text + "." + text4;
				}

				private static Func<SynchronizationContext, string> CreateSyncContextDecoder()
				{
					Func<SynchronizationContext, string> basic = delegate(SynchronizationContext sc)
					{
						if (sc == null)
						{
							return "(null)";
						}
						string text = sc.GetType().ToString();
						string text2 = sc.ToString();
						return (text == text2) ? text : (text + "(" + text2 + ")");
					};
					PropertyInfo threadFld = typeof(WindowsFormsSynchronizationContext).GetProperty("DestinationThread", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
					if (threadFld == null)
					{
						return basic;
					}
					return delegate(SynchronizationContext sc)
					{
						string text = basic(sc);
						if (sc is WindowsFormsSynchronizationContext obj)
						{
							Thread thread = (Thread)threadFld.GetValue(obj);
							string threadString = ZombieContextsDetector.GetThreadString(thread);
							if (threadString != null)
							{
								return text + "(DestThread: " + threadString + ")";
							}
						}
						return text;
					};
				}

				private static Func<Tuple<object, SynchronizationContext, Delegate>[]> CreateWorkDataExtractor()
				{
					FieldInfo handlersFld = NativeField<SystemEvents>.StaticRequired("_handlers");
					Type type = handlersFld.FieldType.GetGenericArguments()[1];
					Type type2 = type.GetGenericArguments()[0];
					FieldInfo syncContextFld = NativeField.Ensure(type2, "_syncContext");
					Func<object, SynchronizationContext> getSyncContextFromSEII = (object seii) => (SynchronizationContext)syncContextFld.GetValue(seii);
					FieldInfo delegateFld = NativeField.Required(type2, "_delegate");
					Func<object, Delegate> getDelegateFromSEII = (object seii) => (Delegate)delegateFld.GetValue(seii);
					object eventLockObject = NativeField<SystemEvents>.StaticRequired("eventLockObject").GetValue(null);
					Func<IDictionary> getHandlers = () => (IDictionary)handlersFld.GetValue(null);
					return delegate
					{
						lock (eventLockObject)
						{
							IDictionary handlers = getHandlers();
							if (handlers == null)
							{
								return (Tuple<object, SynchronizationContext, Delegate>[])null;
							}
							return (from t in (from object k in handlers.Keys
									select new DictionaryEntry(k, handlers[k])).SelectMany((DictionaryEntry de) => from object seii in (IList)de.Value
									select Tuple.Create(de.Key, getSyncContextFromSEII(seii), getDelegateFromSEII(seii)))
								where t.Item2 != null
								select t).ToArray();
						}
					};
				}
			}

			private const int TimeoutSlicingGranularity = 5;

			private static IEnumerable<int> ChopTimeout(int totalTimeout)
			{
				int timeLeft = totalTimeout;
				int i = 5;
				while (i >= 1)
				{
					int currentSlice = timeLeft / i;
					if (currentSlice != 0)
					{
						yield return currentSlice;
						timeLeft -= currentSlice;
					}
					int num = i - 1;
					i = num;
				}
			}

			private static int GetSmallTimeoutSlice(int fullTimeOut)
			{
				return Math.Max(fullTimeOut / 5, 10);
			}

			private static async Task AwaitSystemEventsAvailabilityAsync(int timeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
			{
				FieldInfo systemEventsField = NativeField<SystemEvents>.StaticRequired("systemEvents");
				while (systemEventsField.GetValue(null) == null)
				{
					await Task.Delay(GetSmallTimeoutSlice(timeout), cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(continueOnCapturedContext: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private static int once;

		private static int properThreadOnce;

		public static void TryCreateOnCurrent()
		{
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref once, 1, 0) == 0)
			{
				TryCreateOnCurrentCore();
			}
		}

		public static void TryCreateOnDedicated()
		{
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref once, 1, 0) == 0)
			{
				Thread thread = new Thread(TryCreateOnCurrentCore);
				thread.Start();
				thread.Join();
			}
		}

		private static void TryCreateOnCurrentCore()
		{
			try
			{
				SystemEvents.InvokeOnEventsThread((MethodInvoker)delegate
				{
				});
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public static void TryCreateOnProperThread()
		{
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref properThreadOnce, 1, 0) != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId == 1)
			{
				TryCreateOnCurrent();
			}
			else
			{
				TryCreateOnDedicated();
			}
			if (!Diagnostics.HealthMonitor.AutoStartMonitoringOnTryCreateOnProperThread)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				Diagnostics.HealthMonitor.Run(Diagnostics.HealthMonitor.MonitoringOnTryCreateOnProperThreadTimeout);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public static void InvokeOnProperSystemEventsThread(Action action)
		{
			TryCreateOnProperThread();
			SystemEvents.InvokeOnEventsThread(action);
		}

	public class SplashScreenManagerSynchronizationContext : SynchronizationContext, IDisposable
	{
		public static int DelegateExecutionWarningThreshold = 40;

		public static int SendPostCycleWarningThreshold = 100;

		private SynchronizationContext RealContext;

		private const int StateInit = 0;

		private const int StateUsed = 1;

		private const int StateDisposed = 2;

		private int State;

		private int InvocationsInTheAir;

		private const string GenericAdvice = "Splash, overlay and wait forms are designed to notify users that an application is busy or about a progress of ongoing long-running process. If you need to interact with those forms from code, use the SplashScreenManager.SendCommand method. Avoid using heavy\u00a0and stateful user-interactive controls within those forms and long-running code within related threads.";

		private static int _durationIsSlowThrownOnce;

		private static int _SendPostWarningThrownOnce;

		public SplashScreenManagerSynchronizationContext()
		{
			State = 0;
			RealContext = new WindowsFormsSynchronizationContext();
			InvocationsInTheAir = 0;
		}

		public override void Post(SendOrPostCallback d, object state)
		{
			SynchronizationContext synchronizationContext = Volatile.Read(ref RealContext);
			NotifyUse();
			Interlocked.Increment(ref InvocationsInTheAir);
			int grounded = 0;
			Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
			try
			{
				synchronizationContext.Post(delegate
				{
					try
					{
						ExecuteInTheSplashWaitContextCore(d, state);
					}
					finally
					{
						if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref grounded, 1, 0) == 0)
						{
							Interlocked.Decrement(ref InvocationsInTheAir);
						}
					}
					NotifyDurationTotal(sw.ElapsedMilliseconds);
				}, null);
			}
			catch
			{
				if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref grounded, 1, 0) == 0)
				{
					Interlocked.Decrement(ref InvocationsInTheAir);
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		private void ExecuteInTheSplashWaitContextCore(SendOrPostCallback d, object state)
		{
			Stopwatch stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
			d(state);
			NotifyDurationOfCallback(stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds);
		}

		public override void Send(SendOrPostCallback d, object state)
		{
			SynchronizationContext synchronizationContext = Volatile.Read(ref RealContext);
			NotifyUse();
			Interlocked.Increment(ref InvocationsInTheAir);
			Stopwatch stopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
			try
			{
				synchronizationContext.Send(delegate
				{
					ExecuteInTheSplashWaitContextCore(d, state);
				}, null);
			}
			finally
			{
				Interlocked.Decrement(ref InvocationsInTheAir);
			}
			NotifyDurationTotal(stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds);
		}

		public virtual void Dispose()
		{
			int num = Interlocked.Exchange(ref State, 2);
			if (num != 2)
			{
				(Interlocked.Exchange(ref RealContext, null) as IDisposable)?.Dispose();
				int inTheAir = Interlocked.Exchange(ref InvocationsInTheAir, 0);
				NotifyInvocationsInTheAirOnDispose(inTheAir);
			}
		}

		private void NotifyDurationTotal(long elapsedMilliseconds)
		{
			if (elapsedMilliseconds > DelegateExecutionWarningThreshold && Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _durationIsSlowThrownOnce, 1, 0) == 0)
			{
				try
				{
					throw new WarningException("Slow send/post roundtrip time (" + elapsedMilliseconds + "ms). Splash, overlay and wait forms are designed to notify users that an application is busy or about a progress of ongoing long-running process. If you need to interact with those forms from code, use the SplashScreenManager.SendCommand method. Avoid using heavy\u00a0and stateful user-interactive controls within those forms and long-running code within related threads.");
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private void NotifyDurationOfCallback(long elapsedMilliseconds)
		{
			if (elapsedMilliseconds > SendPostCycleWarningThreshold && Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _durationIsSlowThrownOnce, 1, 0) == 0)
			{
				try
				{
					throw new WarningException("Long running send/post callback (" + elapsedMilliseconds + "ms). Splash, overlay and wait forms are designed to notify users that an application is busy or about a progress of ongoing long-running process. If you need to interact with those forms from code, use the SplashScreenManager.SendCommand method. Avoid using heavy\u00a0and stateful user-interactive controls within those forms and long-running code within related threads.");
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		private void NotifyInvocationsInTheAirOnDispose(int inTheAir)
		{
			if (inTheAir == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				throw new WarningException("Pending send/post callback(s) (" + inTheAir + ") on dispose. Splash, overlay and wait forms are designed to notify users that an application is busy or about a progress of ongoing long-running process. If you need to interact with those forms from code, use the SplashScreenManager.SendCommand method. Avoid using heavy\u00a0and stateful user-interactive controls within those forms and long-running code within related threads.");
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		private void NotifyUse()
		{
			if (Volatile.Read(ref State) == 2)
			{
				throw new InvalidAsynchronousStateException(string.Format("Object disposed: {0}. {1}", GetType(), "Splash, overlay and wait forms are designed to notify users that an application is busy or about a progress of ongoing long-running process. If you need to interact with those forms from code, use the SplashScreenManager.SendCommand method. Avoid using heavy\u00a0and stateful user-interactive controls within those forms and long-running code within related threads."));
			}
			if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref State, 1, 0) != 0 || Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _SendPostWarningThrownOnce, 1, 0) != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				throw new WarningException(string.Format("Send or Post invoked for captured {0}. {1}", GetType(), "Splash, overlay and wait forms are designed to notify users that an application is busy or about a progress of ongoing long-running process. If you need to interact with those forms from code, use the SplashScreenManager.SendCommand method. Avoid using heavy\u00a0and stateful user-interactive controls within those forms and long-running code within related threads."));
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Utils.Serializing

	public class RegistryXtraSerializer : XtraSerializer
	{
		private static readonly string[] BaseKeyNames = new string[5] { "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT", "HKEY_CURRENT_USER", "HKEY_USERS", "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE", "HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG" };

		private static readonly RegistryKey[] BaseKeys = new RegistryKey[5]
		{
			Registry.ClassesRoot,
			Registry.CurrentUser,
			Registry.Users,
			Registry.LocalMachine,
			Registry.CurrentConfig
		};

		private static RegistryKey GetBaseKey(string path)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < BaseKeyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				if (path.StartsWith(BaseKeyNames[i], StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					return BaseKeys[i];
				}
			}
			return Registry.CurrentUser;
		}

		private static string GetPath(string path)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < BaseKeyNames.Length; i++)
			{
				if (path.StartsWith(BaseKeyNames[i], StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					path = path.Remove(0, BaseKeyNames[i].Length);
					break;
				}
			}
			while (path.Length > 0 && path[0] == '\\')
			{
				path = path.Remove(0, 1);
			}
			return path;
		}

		protected override bool Serialize(string path, IXtraPropertyCollection props, string appName)
		{
			appName += "Data";
			RegistryKey baseKey = GetBaseKey(path);
			string text = GetPath(path);
			if (text.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!text.EndsWith("\\", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				text += "\\";
			}
			DeleteKey(baseKey, text, appName, appName);
			using (RegistryKey key = baseKey.CreateSubKey(text + appName))
			{
				SerializeLevel(key, props);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void SerializeLevel(RegistryKey key, IXtraPropertyCollection props)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (XtraPropertyInfo item in (IEnumerable)props)
			{
				XtraPropertyInfo p = item;
				SerializeProperty(key, p);
			}
		}

		private void SerializeProperty(RegistryKey key, XtraPropertyInfo p)
		{
			RegistryKey registryKey = key;
			if (p.IsKey)
			{
				registryKey = key.CreateSubKey(p.Name);
			}
			try
			{
				object obj = p.Value;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					Type type = obj.GetType();
					if (!type.IsPrimitive || type == typeof(float) || type == typeof(double))
					{
						obj = ObjectConverter.ObjectToString(obj);
					}
				}
				if (!p.IsKey || obj != null)
				{
					registryKey.SetValue(p.IsKey ? null : p.Name, (obj == null) ? "~Xtra#NULL" : obj);
				}
				if (p.IsKey)
				{
					SerializeLevel(registryKey, p.ChildProperties);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (p.IsKey)
				{
					registryKey.Close();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override IXtraPropertyCollection Deserialize(string path, string appName, IList objects)
		{
			appName += "Data";
			RegistryKey baseKey = GetBaseKey(path);
			string text = GetPath(path);
			if (text.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!text.EndsWith("\\", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				text += "\\";
			}
			using RegistryKey registryKey = baseKey.OpenSubKey(text + appName);
			if (registryKey == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return DeserializeLevel(registryKey);
		}

		private IXtraPropertyCollection DeserializeLevel(RegistryKey key)
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_007a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string[] valueNames = key.GetValueNames();
			string[] subKeyNames = key.GetSubKeyNames();
			IXtraPropertyCollection val = (IXtraPropertyCollection)new XtraPropertyCollection(valueNames.Length + subKeyNames.Length);
			string[] array = valueNames;
			foreach (string text in array)
			{
				val.Add(new XtraPropertyInfo(text, (Type)null, CheckNullValue(key.GetValue(text))));
			}
			string[] array2 = subKeyNames;
			foreach (string text2 in array2)
			{
				using RegistryKey registryKey = key.OpenSubKey(text2);
				XtraPropertyInfo val2 = new XtraPropertyInfo(text2, (Type)null, CheckNullValue(registryKey.GetValue(null)), true);
				val.Add(val2);
				val2.ChildProperties.AddRange((ICollection)DeserializeLevel(registryKey));
			}
			return val;
		}

		private static void DeleteKey(RegistryKey key, string relPath, string keyName, string appName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(appName) || keyName != appName)
			{
				return;
			}
			using (RegistryKey registryKey = key.OpenSubKey(relPath + keyName))
			{
				if (registryKey == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			key.DeleteSubKeyTree(relPath + keyName);
		}

		private static object CheckNullValue(object val)
		{
			string text = val as string;
			if (!(text == "~Xtra#NULL"))
			{
				return val;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class DxHtmlParser
	{
		private delegate bool TryParseToEnumDelegate<T>(char ch, out T result) where T : struct;

		private TryParseToEnumDelegate<CssListStyleType> listStyleDelegate;

		private DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<DxHtmlException> exceptionsCore = new DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<DxHtmlException>();

		private string template;

		private int templateLength;

		private int currentIndex;

		private int startIndexTextElement = -1;

		private int startIndexWhiteSpace = -1;

		private int sbTextCurrentIndex = -1;

		internal IDxHtmlAttribute ParseImgTagAttributes(ImgTag tag, char ch, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value)
		{
			int remainder = templateLength - currentIndex;
			switch (ch)

			case 'a':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckAlt(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 3;
					ParseValueToString(ref tag.Alt, tag, mode, value);
					return tag.Alt;
				}
				break;
			case 's':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSRC(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 3;
					ParseValueToString(ref tag.Src, tag, mode, value);
					return tag.Src;
				}
				break;
			case 'w':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckWidth(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 5;
					ParseValueToFloat(ref tag.Width, tag, mode, value);
					return tag.Width;

				break;
			case 'h':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckHeight(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 6;
					ParseValueToFloat(ref tag.Height, tag, mode, value);
					return tag.Height;

				break;
			}
			return ParseDefaultTagAttributesCore(tag, ch, remainder, mode, value);
		}

		private IDxHtmlAttribute ParseDefaultTagAttributesCore(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, char ch, int remainder, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value, bool allowCustomAttribute = false)
		{
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'a':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckAria(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 4;
					return ParseAriaAttributes(tag, mode, value);
				}
				break;
			case 'c':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckClass(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 5;
					ParseClassesValue(tag, mode, value);
					return tag.Class;
				}
				break;
			case 's':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckStyle(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 5;
					ParseValueToString(ref tag.Style, tag, mode, value);
					return tag.Style;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSlot(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 4;
					ParseValueToString(ref tag.Slot, tag, mode, value);
					return tag.Slot;
				}
				break;
			case 'i':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckID(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 2;
					ParseValueToString(ref tag.Id, tag, mode, value);
					if (!tag.Id.IsDefault && !tag.Id.IsBindable)
					{
						tag.IdStyleSet = styleSheetCore.GetIDStyleSet(tag.Id.GetValue(null, null));
					}
					return tag.Id;
				}
				break;
			case 't':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTitle(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 5;
					ParseValueToString(ref tag.Title, tag, mode, value);
					return tag.Title;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTabIndex(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 8;
					ParseValueToInt(ref tag.TabIndex, tag, mode, value);
					return tag.TabIndex;
				}
				break;
			case 'h':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckHidden(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 6;
					ParseValueToBool(ref tag.Hidden, tag, mode, value);
					return tag.Hidden;
				}
				break;
			case 'd':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckData(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 4;
					return ParseDataAttributesCore(tag, mode, value);
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckDxClass(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 8;
					ParseValueToString(ref tag.DxClass, tag, mode, value);
					tag.CreateClassConditions();
					if (tag.ClassConditions.Count > 0)
					{
						tag.BindableAttributeCount++;
					}
					return tag.DxClass;
				}
				break;
			case 'r':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRole(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					currentIndex += 4;
					ParseValueToString(ref tag.Role, tag, mode, value);
					return tag.Role;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (allowCustomAttribute)
			{
				return ParseCustomAttributesCore(null, tag, mode, value);
			}
			SkipAttribute();
			return null;
		}

		private DxHtmlObjectAttribute ParseAriaAttributes(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value)
		{
			if (currentIndex == templateLength)
			{
				SkipAttribute();
				return null;
			}
			return ParseCustomAttributesCore("aria", tag, mode, value);
		}

		private DxHtmlObjectAttribute ParseDataAttributesCore(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value)
		{
			if (currentIndex == templateLength)
			{
				SkipAttribute();
				return null;
			}
			return ParseCustomAttributesCore("data", tag, mode, value);
		}

		private DxHtmlObjectAttribute ParseCustomAttributesCore(string prefix, DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value)
		{
			if (CheckPCEN_Name(prefix, template, templateLength, prefix != null, ref currentIndex, out var name))
			{
				if (value == null && mode == ParseAttributeMode.Set)
				{
					if (tag.RemoveCustomAttribute(name))
					{
						changedAttributeCore = name;
					}
					return null;
				}
				DxHtmlObjectAttribute attribute = tag.GetCustomAttribute(name);
				if (ParseValueToObject(ref attribute, tag, mode, value, name))
				{
					tag.AddCustomAttribute(name, attribute);
				}
				return attribute;
			}
			SkipAttribute();
			return null;
		}

		private void ParseClassesValue(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case ParseAttributeMode.Default:
				break;
			case ParseAttributeMode.Parse:
			{
				if (!tag.Class.IsDefault || !FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
				{
					break;
				}
				string fieldName = string.Empty;
				int num = currentIndex;
				switch (CheckFieldName(ch, ref fieldName))
				{
				case CssParsingResult.Closed:
					tag.Class = new DxHtmlStringAttribute(string.Empty, fieldName, "classname");
					tag.BindableAttributeCount += tag.Class.Bindable;
					break;
				case CssParsingResult.Continue:
				{
					if (num != currentIndex)
					{
						SkipInvalidValue(ch);
						break;
					}
					int num2 = ParseClassesValueCore(tag, new DxHtmlDictionary<string, CssStyleSet>(), ch);
					tag.Class = new DxHtmlStringAttribute(template.Substring(num, num2 - num), string.Empty, "classname");
					break;
				}
				}
				break;
			}
			default:
			{
				string result = template;
				SetAttributeValue(ref tag.Class, tag, DxHtmlStringAttribute.TryConvertValue(value, ref result), result, "classname", DxHtmlStringAttribute.Factory);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		internal void ParseClassesValue(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, string @class, CssStyleSheet styleSheet)
		{
			exceptionsCore.Clear();
			template = @class;
			currentIndex = 0;
			templateLength = @class.Length;
			styleSheetCore = styleSheet;
			ParseClassesValueCore(tag, new DxHtmlDictionary<string, CssStyleSet>(), '"');
			Reset();
		}

		private int ParseClassesValueCore(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, DxHtmlDictionary<string, CssStyleSet> selectors, char endSymbol)
		{
			if (styleSheetCore == null)
			{
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.TextIndexOf(template, endSymbol, ref currentIndex))
				{
					currentIndex++;
				}
				return currentIndex;
			}
			int startIndex = currentIndex;
			while (currentIndex < templateLength)
			{
				char c = template[currentIndex];
				if (c == endSymbol)
				{
					FindClassStyleSet(selectors, startIndex);
					startIndex = currentIndex++;
					tag.ClassStyleSets = selectors;
					return startIndex;
				}
				if (char.IsWhiteSpace(c))
				{
					FindClassStyleSet(selectors, startIndex);
					DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(template, template[currentIndex], ref currentIndex, templateLength);
					startIndex = currentIndex;
				}
				else
				{
					currentIndex++;
				}
			}
			FindClassStyleSet(selectors, startIndex);
			ThrowMissingQuotesException(currentIndex);
			tag.ClassStyleSets = selectors;
			return currentIndex;
		}

		private void FindClassStyleSet(DxHtmlDictionary<string, CssStyleSet> selectors, int _startIndex)
		{
			if (_startIndex != currentIndex)
			{
				string text = template.Substring(_startIndex, currentIndex - _startIndex);
				if (!selectors.Contains(text))
				{
					selectors.Add(text, styleSheetCore.GetClassStyleSet(text));
				}
			}
		}

		private bool FindStartSymbolOfValue(out char ch)
		{
			return FindStartSymbolOfValueCore(out ch, isFlag: false) == CssParsingResult.Continue;
		}

		private CssParsingResult FindStartSymbolOfValueCore(out char ch, bool isFlag)
		{
			ch = ' ';
			if (currentIndex >= templateLength)
			{
				if (isFlag)
				{
					ThrowMissingEndSymbolException(currentIndex);
					return CssParsingResult.Closed;
				}
				ThrowMissingEqualException(currentIndex);
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			int num = currentIndex;
			ch = DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(template, template[currentIndex], ref currentIndex, templateLength);
			if (currentIndex == templateLength)
			{
				if (isFlag)
				{
					ThrowMissingEndSymbolException(currentIndex);
					return CssParsingResult.Closed;
				}
				ThrowMissingEqualException(currentIndex);
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			if (ch != '=')
			{
				if (IsEndTagSymbol(ch))
				{
					if (isFlag)
					{
						return CssParsingResult.Closed;
					}
					ThrowMissingEqualException(currentIndex);
					return CssParsingResult.Exception;
				}
				if (num == currentIndex)
				{
					SkipAttribute();
					return CssParsingResult.Exception;
				}
				if (isFlag)
				{
					return CssParsingResult.Closed;
				}
				ThrowMissingEqualException(currentIndex);
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			currentIndex++;
			startIndexCore = currentIndex;
			if (currentIndex >= templateLength)
			{
				ThrowInvalidValueException();
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			ch = DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(template, template[currentIndex], ref currentIndex, templateLength);
			if (currentIndex >= templateLength)
			{
				ThrowInvalidValueException();
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			if (ch == '\'' || ch == '"')
			{
				currentIndex++;
				return CssParsingResult.Continue;
			}
			ThrowMissingQuotesException(currentIndex);
			return CssParsingResult.Exception;
		}

		private CssParsingResult CheckFieldName(char endSymbol, ref string fieldName)
		{
			HtmlExceptionType exceptionType = HtmlExceptionType.None;
			CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckFieldName(template, templateLength, endSymbol, ref fieldName, ref currentIndex, ref exceptionType);
			if (cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Exception)
			{
				switch (exceptionType)
				{
				case HtmlExceptionType.InvalidValue:
					ThrowInvalidValueException();
					break;
				case HtmlExceptionType.MissingQuotes:
					ThrowMissingQuotesException(currentIndex);
					break;
				}
			}
			return cssParsingResult;
		}

		private bool ParseValueToObject(ref DxHtmlObjectAttribute attribute, DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value, string name)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case ParseAttributeMode.Default:
				return false;
			case ParseAttributeMode.Parse:
			{
				if (attribute != null && !attribute.IsDefault)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string fieldName = string.Empty;
				object @object = null;
				if (TryParseToObject(ref @object, ref fieldName))
				{
					attribute = new DxHtmlObjectAttribute(@object, fieldName, name);
					tag.BindableAttributeCount += attribute.Bindable;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			default:
			{
				object result = null;
				SetAttributeValue(ref attribute, tag, DxHtmlObjectAttribute.TryConvertValue(value, ref result), result, name, DxHtmlObjectAttribute.Factory);
				return true;
			}
			}
		}

		private bool TryParseToObject(ref object @object, ref string fieldName)
		{
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return false;
			}
			char endSymbol = ch;
			int startIndex = currentIndex;
			CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = CheckFieldName(endSymbol, ref fieldName);
			if (cssParsingResult != CssParsingResult.Continue)
			{
				return cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Closed;
			}
			string @string = string.Empty;
			if (FindAttributeValue(startIndex, endSymbol, ref @string))
			{
				@object = @string;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ParseValueToString(ref DxHtmlStringAttribute attribute, DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case ParseAttributeMode.Default:
				break;
			case ParseAttributeMode.Parse:
				if (attribute.IsDefault)
				{
					string fieldName = string.Empty;
					string @string = string.Empty;
					if (TryParseToString(ref @string, ref fieldName))
					{
						attribute = new DxHtmlStringAttribute(@string, fieldName, attribute.Name);
						tag.BindableAttributeCount += attribute.Bindable;
					}
				}
				break;
			default:
			{
				string result = string.Empty;
				SetAttributeValue(ref attribute, tag, DxHtmlStringAttribute.TryConvertValue(value, ref result), result, attribute.Name, DxHtmlStringAttribute.Factory);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private bool TryParseToString(ref string @string, ref string fieldName)
		{
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return false;
			}
			char endSymbol = ch;
			int startIndex = currentIndex;
			CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = CheckFieldName(endSymbol, ref fieldName);
			if (cssParsingResult != CssParsingResult.Continue)
			{
				return cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Closed;
			}
			return FindAttributeValue(startIndex, endSymbol, ref @string);
		}

		private bool FindAttributeValue(int startIndex, char endSymbol, ref string @string, bool ignoreCase = false)
		{
			if (ignoreCase)
			{
				return FindAttributeValueIgnoreCase(startIndex, endSymbol, ref @string);
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.TextIndexOf(template, endSymbol, ref currentIndex))
			{
				int num = currentIndex - startIndex;
				currentIndex++;
				if (num == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.Substring(template, startIndex, num, ref @string);
			}
			ThrowMissingQuotesException(currentIndex);
			return false;
		}

		private bool FindAttributeValueIgnoreCase(int startIndex, char endSymbol, ref string @string)
		{
			while (currentIndex < templateLength)
			{
				char ch = template[currentIndex];
				if (ch == endSymbol)
				{
					@string = builderCore.ToString();
					builderCore.Clear();
					currentIndex++;
					return true;
				}
				ToLower(ref ch);
				builderCore.Append(ch);
				currentIndex++;
			}
			@string = builderCore.ToString();
			builderCore.Clear();
			ThrowMissingQuotesException(currentIndex);
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseListStyleTypeValue(char endSymbol, out CssListStyleType type)
		{
			string @string = string.Empty;
			type = CssListStyleType.Decimal;
			if (!FindAttributeValue(currentIndex, endSymbol, ref @string))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (@string)
			{
			case "1":
				type = CssListStyleType.Decimal;
				return true;
			case "a":
				type = CssListStyleType.LowerAlpha;
				return true;
			case "A":
				type = CssListStyleType.UpperAlpha;
				return true;
			case "i":
				type = CssListStyleType.LowerRoman;
				return true;
			case "I":
				type = CssListStyleType.UpperRoman;
				return true;
			default:
				ThrowInvalidValueException();
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void ParseValueToBool(ref DxHtmlBooleanAttribute attribute, DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case ParseAttributeMode.Default:
				break;
			case ParseAttributeMode.Parse:
				if (attribute.IsDefault)
				{
					string fieldName = string.Empty;
					bool @bool = false;
					if (TryParseToBool(ref @bool, ref fieldName))
					{
						attribute = new DxHtmlBooleanAttribute(@bool, fieldName, attribute.Name);
						tag.BindableAttributeCount += attribute.Bindable;
					}
				}
				break;
			default:
			{
				bool result = false;
				SetAttributeValue(ref attribute, tag, DxHtmlBooleanAttribute.TryConvertValue(value, ref result), result, attribute.Name, DxHtmlBooleanAttribute.Factory);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private bool TryParseToBool(ref bool @bool, ref string fieldName)
		{
			char ch;
			switch (FindStartSymbolOfValueCore(out ch, isFlag: true))
			{
			case CssParsingResult.Exception:
				return false;
			case CssParsingResult.Closed:
				@bool = true;
				return @bool;
			default:
			{
				char endSymbol = ch;
				CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = CheckFieldName(endSymbol, ref fieldName);
				if (cssParsingResult != CssParsingResult.Continue)
				{
					return cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Closed;
				}
				SkipInvalidValue(endSymbol);
				return false;
			}
			}
		}

		private void ParseValueToFloat(ref DxHtmlNumberAttribute attribute, DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case ParseAttributeMode.Default:
				break;
			case ParseAttributeMode.Parse:
				if (attribute.IsDefault)
				{
					string fieldName = string.Empty;
					float @float = attribute.Value;
					if (TryParseToFloat(ref @float, ref fieldName))
					{
						attribute = new DxHtmlNumberAttribute(@float, fieldName, attribute.Name);
						tag.BindableAttributeCount += attribute.Bindable;
					}
				}
				break;
			default:
			{
				float result = 0f;
				SetAttributeValue(ref attribute, tag, DxHtmlNumberAttribute.TryConvertValue(value, ref result), result, attribute.Name, DxHtmlNumberAttribute.Factory);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private bool TryParseToFloat(ref float @float, ref string fieldName)
		{
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return false;
			}
			char c = ch;
			int num = currentIndex;
			CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = CheckFieldName(c, ref fieldName);
			if (cssParsingResult != CssParsingResult.Continue)
			{
				return cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Closed;
			}
			if (num != currentIndex)
			{
				SkipInvalidValue(c);
				return false;
			}
			if (DxHtmlValueParser.TryParseFloat(template, template[currentIndex], templateLength, ref currentIndex, ref @float))
			{
				if (currentIndex == templateLength)
				{
					ThrowMissingQuotesException(currentIndex);
					return false;
				}
				if (c != template[currentIndex])
				{
					ThrowMissingQuotesException(currentIndex);
					return false;
				}
				currentIndex++;
				return true;
			}
			SkipInvalidValue(c);
			return false;
		}

		private void ParseValueToInt(ref DxHtmlIntegerAttribute attribute, DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case ParseAttributeMode.Default:
				break;
			case ParseAttributeMode.Parse:
				if (attribute.IsDefault)
				{
					string fieldName = string.Empty;
					int @int = 0;
					if (TryParseToInt(ref @int, ref fieldName))
					{
						attribute = new DxHtmlIntegerAttribute(@int, fieldName, attribute.Name);
						tag.BindableAttributeCount += attribute.Bindable;
					}
				}
				break;
			default:
			{
				int result = 0;
				SetAttributeValue(ref attribute, tag, DxHtmlIntegerAttribute.TryConvertValue(value, ref result), result, attribute.Name, DxHtmlIntegerAttribute.Factory);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private bool TryParseToInt(ref int @int, ref string fieldName)
		{
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return false;
			}
			char c = ch;
			int num = currentIndex;
			CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = CheckFieldName(c, ref fieldName);
			if (cssParsingResult != CssParsingResult.Continue)
			{
				return cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Closed;
			}
			if (num != currentIndex)
			{
				SkipInvalidValue(c);
				return false;
			}
			if (DxHtmlValueParser.TryParseInt(template, template[currentIndex], templateLength, ref currentIndex, ref @int, allowRound: false))
			{
				if (currentIndex == templateLength)
				{
					ThrowMissingQuotesException(currentIndex);
					return false;
				}
				if (c != template[currentIndex])
				{
					ThrowMissingQuotesException(currentIndex);
					return false;
				}
				currentIndex++;
				return true;
