			SkipInvalidValue(c);
			return false;
		}

		private void ParseValueToEnum<T>(ref DxHtmlEnumAttribute<T> attribute, DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value, TryParseToEnumDelegate<T> tryParse = null) where T : struct
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case ParseAttributeMode.Default:
				break;
			case ParseAttributeMode.Parse:
				if (attribute.IsDefault)
				{
					string fieldName = string.Empty;
					T @enum = default(T);
					if (TryParseToEnum(ref @enum, ref fieldName, tryParse))
					{
						attribute = new DxHtmlEnumAttribute<T>(@enum, fieldName, attribute.Name);
						tag.BindableAttributeCount += attribute.Bindable;
					}
				}
				break;
			default:
			{
				T result = default(T);
				SetAttributeValue(ref attribute, tag, DxHtmlEnumAttribute<T>.TryConvertValue(value, ref result), result, attribute.Name, DxHtmlEnumAttribute<T>.Factory);
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private bool TryParseToEnum<T>(ref T @enum, ref string fieldName, TryParseToEnumDelegate<T> tryParse) where T : struct
		{
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return false;
			}
			char c = ch;
			int num = currentIndex;
			CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = CheckFieldName(c, ref fieldName);
			if (cssParsingResult != CssParsingResult.Continue)
			{
				return cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Closed;
			}
			if (num != currentIndex)
			{
				SkipInvalidValue(c);
				return false;
			}
			if (tryParse != null)
			{
				if (tryParse(c, out @enum))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				string @string = string.Empty;
				if (!FindAttributeValue(num, c, ref @string, ignoreCase: true))
				{
					return false;
				}
				Type typeFromHandle = typeof(T);
				string[] names = Enum.GetNames(typeFromHandle);
				for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
				{
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.EqualString(names[i], @string))
					{
						@enum = (T)Enum.ToObject(typeFromHandle, i);
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SetAttributeValue<U, T>(ref U attribute, DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, bool result, T value, string name, Func<T, string, U> creater) where U : DxHtmlAttribute<T>
		{
			if (result)
			{
				if (SetAttributeValue(ref attribute, tag, value, name, creater))
				{
					changedAttributeCore = name;
				}
				else if (attribute != null)
				{
					tag.BindableAttributeCount -= attribute.Bindable;
					changedAttributeCore = name;
					attribute = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool SetAttributeValue<U, T>(ref U attribute, DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, T value, string name, Func<T, string, U> creater) where U : DxHtmlAttribute<T>
		{
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				tag.BindableAttributeCount -= attribute.Bindable;
				if (!attribute.IsBindable && attribute.Equals(value))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			attribute = creater(value, name);
			return true;
		}

		private bool ParseDefaultTagEventsCore(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, char ch, int remainder)
		{
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnKeyDown(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 9;
				tag.OnKeyDown = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnKeyUp(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 7;
				tag.OnKeyUp = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnKeyPress(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 10;
				tag.OnKeyPress = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnClick(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 7;
				tag.OnClick = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnMouseUp(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 9;
				tag.OnMouseUp = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnMouseDown(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 11;
				tag.OnMouseDown = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnMouseMove(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 11;
				tag.OnMouseMove = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnMouseOver(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 11;
				tag.OnMouseOver = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnMouseOut(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 10;
				tag.OnMouseOut = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnDbClick(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 9;
				tag.OnDbClick = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnFocus(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 7;
				tag.OnFocus = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnBlur(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 6;
				tag.OnBlur = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckOnLoad(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				currentIndex += 6;
				tag.OnLoad = ParseEventValue();
				return true;
			}
			SkipAttribute();
			return false;
		}

		private DxHtmlActionExpression ParseEventValue()
		{
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return null;
			}
			char c = ch;
			int num = currentIndex;
			while (currentIndex < templateLength)
			{
				ch = template[currentIndex];
				if (ch == c)
				{
					if (num == currentIndex)
					{
						ThrowInvalidValueException();
						return null;
					}
					currentIndex++;
					return new DxHtmlActionWithTwoArgsExpression(template.Substring(num, currentIndex - num - 1));
				}
				if (ch == '(')
				{
					return ParseEventParamValue(c, num);
				}
				currentIndex++;
			}
			ThrowInvalidValueException();
			return null;
		}

		private DxHtmlActionExpression ParseEventParamValue(char endSymbol, int startIndex)
		{
			currentIndex++;
			if (currentIndex == templateLength)
			{
				ThrowInvalidValueException();
				return null;
			}
			string methodName = template.Substring(startIndex, currentIndex - startIndex - 1);
			char c = DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(template, template[currentIndex], ref currentIndex, templateLength);
			if (c == 'e')
			{
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckEvent(template, currentIndex, templateLength - currentIndex))
				{
					currentIndex += 5;
					if (ParseEndEventValue(endSymbol))
					{
						currentIndex++;
						return new DxHtmlActionWithOneArgExpression(methodName);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (ParseEndEventValue(endSymbol))
			{
				currentIndex++;
				return new DxHtmlActionExpression(methodName);
			}
			SkipInvalidValue(endSymbol);
			return null;
		}

		private bool ParseEndEventValue(char endSymbol)
		{
			if (currentIndex == templateLength)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (template[currentIndex] == ')')
			{
				currentIndex++;
				if (currentIndex == templateLength)
				{
					ThrowMissingQuotesException(currentIndex);
					return false;
				}
				if (template[currentIndex] == endSymbol)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool SkipInvalidAttributeCore(char ch)
		{
			switch (ch)
			{
			case '>':
				return true;
			case '=':
				if (FindStartSymbolOfValue(out ch))
				{
					SkipInvalidValue(ch, allowThrow: false);
				}
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void SkipAttribute()
		{
			int num = startIndexCore;
			currentIndex++;
			while (currentIndex < template.Length)
			{
				char c = template[currentIndex];
				if (char.IsWhiteSpace(c))
				{
					DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(template, c, ref currentIndex, templateLength);
					if (SkipInvalidAttributeCore(c))
					{
						startIndexCore = num;
					}
					ThrowUnknownAttributeException();
					return;
				}
				if (SkipInvalidAttributeCore(c))
				{
					startIndexCore = num;
					ThrowUnknownAttributeException();
					return;
				}
				currentIndex++;
			}
			ThrowUnknownAttributeException();
		}

		private void SkipInvalidValue(char endSymbol, bool allowThrow = true)
		{
			DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.TextIndexOf(template, endSymbol, ref currentIndex);
			if (allowThrow)
			{
				ThrowInvalidValueException();
			}
			currentIndex++;
		}

		private void ThrowDoctypeException()
		{
			DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.TextIndexOf(template, '>', ref currentIndex);
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.DoctypeFound, startIndexCore, currentIndex - startIndexCore, ValidationLevel != HtmlValidationLevel.Low);
		}

		private bool CheckTagName(string tagName)
		{
			if (tagName.Length < templateLength - currentIndex)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < tagName.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.EqualChars(template[currentIndex], tagName[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
					currentIndex++;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SkipTagContent(string tag)
		{
			while (currentIndex <= templateLength && DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.TextIndexOf(template, '<', ref currentIndex))
			{
				currentIndex++;
				if (currentIndex == templateLength)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (template[currentIndex] != '/')
				{
					continue;
				}
				currentIndex++;
				if (CheckTagName(tag))
				{
					if (currentIndex == templateLength)
					{
						break;
					}
					char c = DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(template, template[currentIndex], ref currentIndex, templateLength);
					if (c == '>')
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private CssParsingResult SkipTagAttributes(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, char ch)
		{
			int num = currentIndex;
			ch = DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(template, ch, ref currentIndex, templateLength);
			if (currentIndex == templateLength)
			{
				ThrowMissingEndSymbolException(currentIndex);
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			if (CheckEndTag(tag, ch, out var isClosed))
			{
				if (!isClosed)
				{
					return CssParsingResult.Continue;
				}
				return CssParsingResult.Closed;
			}
			if (num == currentIndex)
			{
				ThrowUnknownTagException();
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			while (currentIndex < templateLength)
			{
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.TextIndexOf(template, '>', ref currentIndex))
				{
					if (IsEndTagSymbol(template[currentIndex - 1]))
					{
						return CssParsingResult.Closed;
					}
					return CssParsingResult.Continue;
				}
				currentIndex++;
			}
			ThrowMissingEndSymbolException(currentIndex);
			return CssParsingResult.Exception;
		}

		private void ThrowStyleException()
		{
			switch (SkipTagAttributes(fakeTagCore, template[currentIndex]))
			{
			case CssParsingResult.Exception:
				return;
			case CssParsingResult.Continue:
				SkipTagContent("style");
				break;
			}
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.StyleFound, startIndexCore, currentIndex - startIndexCore, ValidationLevel != HtmlValidationLevel.Low);
		}

		private void ThrowScriptException()
		{
			switch (SkipTagAttributes(fakeTagCore, template[currentIndex]))
			{
			case CssParsingResult.Exception:
				return;
			case CssParsingResult.Continue:
				SkipTagContent("script");
				break;
			}
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.ScriptFound, startIndexCore, currentIndex - startIndexCore, ValidationLevel != HtmlValidationLevel.Low);
		}

		private void ThrowMissingEqualException(int startIndex)
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.MissingEqual, startIndex, 1, ValidationLevel != HtmlValidationLevel.Low);
		}

		private void ThrowMissingQuotesException(int startIndex)
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.MissingQuotes, startIndex, 1, ValidationLevel != HtmlValidationLevel.Low);
		}

		private void ThrowMissingClosedTagException(int startIndex)
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.MissingClosedTag, startIndex, 1, ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private void ThrowMissingEndSymbolException(int startIndex)
		{
			ThrowCriticalException(HtmlExceptionType.MissingEndSymbol, startIndex);
		}

		private void ThrowInvalidValueException()
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.InvalidValue, startIndexCore, currentIndex - startIndexCore, ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private void ThrowUnknownAttributeException()
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.UnknownAttribute, startIndexCore, currentIndex - startIndexCore, ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private void ThrowTagIsNotSelfClosingException(string name)
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.TagIsNotSelfClosing, startIndexCore, currentIndex - startIndexCore, ValidationLevel != HtmlValidationLevel.Low);
		}

		private void ThrowInvalidClosingTagException(string name)
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.InvalidClosingTag, startIndexCore, currentIndex - startIndexCore, ValidationLevel != HtmlValidationLevel.Low);
			DxHtmlDocumentNode parent = currentNodeCore;
			while (parent.Parent != null && parent.TagName != name)
			{
				parent = parent.Parent;
			}
			if (parent.TagName == name)
			{
				currentNodeCore = parent.Parent;
			}
		}

		private void ThrowUnknownTagException()
		{
			DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.TextIndexOf(template, '>', ref currentIndex);
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.UnknownTag, startIndexCore, currentIndex - startIndexCore, ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private void ThrowCriticalException(HtmlExceptionType exception, int startIndex)
		{
			ThrowException(exception, startIndex, templateLength - startIndex, ValidationLevel != HtmlValidationLevel.Low);
			if (templateLength - startIndex > 0)
			{
				bodyNodeCore.CreateChild(new TextElementTag
				{
					Text = template.Substring(startIndex)
				});
			}
			currentIndex = templateLength;
		}

		private void ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType exception, int index, int length, bool @throw)
		{
			if (@throw)
			{
				throw new Exception(exception.ToString());
			}
			exceptionsCore.Add(new DxHtmlException(index, length, exception));
		}

		internal string SetAttribute(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, string attributeName, object value)
		{
			changedAttributeCore = null;
			UpdateAttribute(tag, attributeName, ParseAttributeMode.Set, value);
			return changedAttributeCore;
		}

		internal IDxHtmlAttribute GetAttribute(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, string attributeName)
		{
			return UpdateAttribute(tag, attributeName, ParseAttributeMode.Default, null);
		}

		private IDxHtmlAttribute UpdateAttribute(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, string attributeName, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value)
		{
			exceptionsCore.Clear();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			template = attributeName;
			templateLength = attributeName.Length;
			char ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(attributeName[0]);
			IDxHtmlAttribute dxHtmlAttribute = tag.ParseAttribute(this, ch, mode, value);
			Reset();
			if (dxHtmlAttribute != null && !dxHtmlAttribute.IsDefault)
			{
				return dxHtmlAttribute;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public DxHtmlDocumentRootNode Parse(string template)
		{
			return Parse(template, null);
		}

		public DxHtmlDocumentRootNode Parse(string template, CssStyleSheet styleSheet)
		{
			exceptionsCore.Clear();
			if (template == null)
			{
				template = string.Empty;
			}
			Initialize(template, styleSheet);
			DxHtmlDocumentRootNode dxHtmlDocumentRootNode = ParseCore();
			Reset();
			dxHtmlDocumentRootNode.TemplateHash = template.GetHashCode();
			return dxHtmlDocumentRootNode;
		}

		private DxHtmlDocumentRootNode ParseCore()
		{
			while (currentIndex < templateLength)
			{
				char c = template[currentIndex];
				if (currentIndex < templateLength - 2)
				{
					switch (c)
					{
					case '&':
						ParseSpecialSymbol();
						break;
					case '<':
						startIndexCore = currentIndex;
						currentIndex++;
						if (template[currentIndex] == '/')
						{
							CloseTag();
							break;
						}
						if (template[currentIndex] == '!')
						{
							currentIndex++;
							if (ParseDoctype() || SkipComment())
							{
								break;
							}
							ThrowUnknownTagException();
						}
						ParseTag();
						break;
					default:
						StartTextElement();
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					StartTextElement();
				}
				currentIndex++;
			}
			EndTextElement(templateLength + 1);
			if (currentNodeCore != bodyNodeCore && currentNodeCore != bodyNodeCore.RootElement)
			{
				ThrowMissingClosedTagException(currentIndex);
			}
			return bodyNodeCore.RootElement;
		}

		private bool ParseDoctype()
		{
			if (currentIndex == templateLength)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckDoctype(template, currentIndex, templateLength - currentIndex))
			{
				EndTextElement(currentIndex - 1);
				currentIndex += 7;
				ThrowDoctypeException();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool SkipComment()
		{
			if (currentIndex + 1 >= templateLength)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (template[currentIndex] != '-' && template[currentIndex + 1] != '-')
			{
				return false;
			}
			EndTextElement(currentIndex - 1);
			currentIndex += 2;
			while (currentIndex < templateLength)
			{
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.TextIndexOf(template, '>', ref currentIndex) && template[currentIndex - 1] == '-' && template[currentIndex - 2] == '-')
				{
					return true;
				}
				currentIndex++;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ParseTag()
		{
			int remainder = templateLength - currentIndex;
			string tagName = string.Empty;
			int index = currentIndex;
			if (startIndexWhiteSpace != -1)
			{
				index = startIndexWhiteSpace;
			}
			EndTextElement(index);
			Func<DxHtmlDocumentTag> func = ParseTagCore(template, remainder, ref currentIndex, ref tagName, allowSpecialTag: true);
			if (func == null)
			{
				if (!ParseSpecialTag(tagName))
				{
					ThrowUnknownTagException();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (templateLength - currentIndex < 1)
			{
				ThrowMissingEndSymbolException(currentIndex);
				return;
			}
			DxHtmlDocumentTag dxHtmlDocumentTag = func();
			dxHtmlDocumentTag.PositionInCode = startIndexCore;
			dxHtmlDocumentTag.StyleSet = styleSheetCore.GetTagStyleSet(dxHtmlDocumentTag.Name);
			switch (ParseAttributes(dxHtmlDocumentTag, template[currentIndex]))
			{
			case CssParsingResult.Exception:
				break;
			case CssParsingResult.Closed:
				currentNodeCore.CreateChild(dxHtmlDocumentTag);
				break;
			default:
				currentNodeCore = currentNodeCore.CreateChild(dxHtmlDocumentTag);
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool ParseSpecialTag(string tag)
		{
			if (templateLength - currentIndex < 1)
			{
				ThrowMissingEndSymbolException(currentIndex);
				return true;
			}
			switch (tag)
			{
			case "body":
				bodyNodeCore.Tag.PositionInCode = startIndexCore;
				ParseAttributes(bodyNodeCore.Tag, template[currentIndex]);
				bodyNodeCore.UpdateTag();
				return true;
			case "html":
				ParseAttributes(fakeTagCore, template[currentIndex]);
				return true;
			case "style":
				ThrowStyleException();
				return true;
			case "script":
				ThrowScriptException();
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static Func<DxHtmlDocumentTag> ParseDefaultTagCore(string template, char ch, int remainder, int currentIndex, ref string tagName, bool allowSpecialTag = false)
		{
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'd':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckDiv(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "div";
					return DivTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckL(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "dl";
					return DlTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckDt(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "dt";
					return DtTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckDd(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "dd";
					return DdTag.Create;
				}
				return null;
			case 'o':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckL(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "ol";
					return OlTag.Create;
				}
				return null;
			case 'l':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckLi(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "li";
					return LiTag.Create;
				}
				return null;
			case 'i':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckImg(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "img";
					return ImgTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckInput(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "input";
					return InputTag.Create;
				}
				tagName = "i";
				return ITag.Create;
			case 'p':
				tagName = "p";
				return PTag.Create;
			case 'b':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckBody(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "body";
					return null;
				}
				if (remainder > 1 && DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'r'))
				{
					tagName = "br";
					return BrTag.Create;
				}
				tagName = "b";
				return BTag.Create;
			case 'h':
			{
				Func<HTag> func = ((remainder > 1) ? ParseHeaderStyle(template, currentIndex, ref tagName) : null);
				if (func != null)
				{
					return func;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckHtml(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "html";
					return null;
				}
				return null;
			}
			case 'a':
				tagName = "a";
				return ATag.Create;
			case 'u':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckL(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "ul";
					return UlTag.Create;
				}
				tagName = "u";
				return UTag.Create;
			case 't':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTr(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "tr";
					return TrTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTd(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "td";
					return TdTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTable(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "table";
					return TableTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckThead(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "thead";
					return TheadTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTh(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "th";
					return ThTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTbody(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "tbody";
					return TbodyTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTfoot(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "tfoot";
					return TfootTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTemplate(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "template";
					return TemplateTag.Create;
				}
				return null;
			case 'c':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckColgroup(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "colgroup";
					return ColgroupTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckCol(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "col";
					return ColTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckCaption(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "caption";
					return CaptionTag.Create;
				}
				return null;
			case 's':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSlot(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "slot";
					return SlotTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSpan(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "span";
					return SpanTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSup(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "sup";
					return SupTag.Create;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSub(template, currentIndex, remainder))
				{
					tagName = "sub";
					return SubTag.Create;
				}
				if (allowSpecialTag)
				{
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckStyle(template, currentIndex, remainder))
					{
						tagName = "style";
						return null;
					}
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckScript(template, currentIndex, remainder))
					{
						tagName = "script";
						return null;
					}
				}
				tagName = "s";
				return STag.Create;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal static Func<DxHtmlDocumentTag> ParseTagCore(string template, int remainder, ref int currentIndex, ref string tagName, bool allowSpecialTag = false)
		{
			int num = currentIndex;
			char ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(template[num]);
			Func<DxHtmlDocumentTag> result = ParseDefaultTagCore(template, ch, remainder, num, ref tagName, allowSpecialTag);
			currentIndex = num + tagName.Length;
			if (!DxHtmlDocument.HasCustomTags)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (ParseCustomTag(template, ref currentIndex, ref tagName))
			{
				string name = tagName;
				return () => new CustomTag(name);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static bool CheckPCEN_Name(string prefix, string template, int templateLength, bool hasHyphen, ref int currentIndex, out string name)
		{
			StaticBuilder.Clear();
			StaticBuilder.Append(prefix);
			bool isHyphen = false;
			name = string.Empty;
			while (currentIndex < templateLength)
			{
				char ch = template[currentIndex];
				if (!CheckPCEN_Char(ref ch, ref isHyphen, allowUpper: true))
				{
					break;
				}
				StaticBuilder.Append(ch);
				currentIndex++;
			}
			if ((hasHyphen && !isHyphen) || StaticBuilder.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			name = StaticBuilder.ToString();
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool CheckCustomTagName(string tagName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tagName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsLower(tagName[0]))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool isHyphen = false;
			for (int i = 1; i < tagName.Length; i++)
			{
				char ch = tagName[i];
				if (!CheckPCEN_Char(ref ch, ref isHyphen, allowUpper: false))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return isHyphen;
		}

		private static bool ToLower(ref char ch)
		{
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsUpper(ch))
			{
				ch += ' ';
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckPCEN_Char(ref char ch, ref bool isHyphen, bool allowUpper)
		{
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsLower(ch))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (allowUpper && ToLower(ref ch))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ch < '-')
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ch <= '9' && ch != '/' && ch != '.')
			{
				isHyphen |= ch == '-';
				return true;
			}
			if (ch != '·' && ch != '_' && (ch < 'À' || ch > 'Ö') && (ch < 'Ø' || ch > 'ö'))
			{
				if (ch >= 'ø')
				{
					return ch <= 'ÿ';
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ParseCustomTag(string template, ref int currentIndex, ref string tagName)
		{
			StaticBuilder.Clear();
			if (tagName.Length == 0 && !DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsSymbol(template[currentIndex]))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (currentIndex == template.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = currentIndex;
			char ch = template[num];
			bool isHyphen = false;
			if (!CheckPCEN_Char(ref ch, ref isHyphen, allowUpper: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			StaticBuilder.Append(tagName);
			StaticBuilder.Append(ch);
			while (++num < template.Length)
			{
				ch = template[num];
				if (!CheckPCEN_Char(ref ch, ref isHyphen, allowUpper: true))
				{
					break;
				}
				StaticBuilder.Append(ch);
			}
			if (!isHyphen)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string text = StaticBuilder.ToString();
			if (DxHtmlDocument.HasCustomTag(text))
			{
				tagName = text;
				currentIndex = num;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ParseSpecialSymbol()
		{
			int num = templateLength - currentIndex - 1;
			if (CheckGt(num, out var count))
			{
				Append('>', count);
				currentIndex += count;
			}
			else if (CheckLt(num, out count))
			{
				Append('<', count);
				currentIndex += count;
			}
			else if (CheckNbsp(num, out count))
			{
				Append('\u00a0', count);
				currentIndex += count;
			}
			else if (num > 2 && CharEqual(1, '#'))
			{
				count = ReadUnicodeSymbol(currentIndex, out var unicodeSymbol);
				Append(unicodeSymbol, count - 1);
				currentIndex += count - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				StartTextElement();
			}
		}

		private int ReadUnicodeSymbol(int index, out char unicodeSymbol)
		{
			int num = 0;
			index += 2;
			unicodeSymbol = ' ';
			if (currentIndex == templateLength)
			{
				return 2;
			}
			char c = template[index];
			if (c == 'x' || c == 'X')
			{
				index++;
				while (index < templateLength)
				{
					c = template[index];
					if (c == ';' || c == '<')
					{
						if (c == ';')
						{
							index++;
						}
						unicodeSymbol = UtfNumberToChar(num);
						return index - currentIndex;
					}
					int num2 = 0;
					num2 = ((c < '0' || c > '9') ? (10 + ((c >= 'a') ? (c - 97) : (c - 65))) : (c - 48));
					index++;
					if (num2 < 0 || num2 > 15)
					{
						return index - currentIndex;
					}
					num = num * 16 + num2;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				while (index < templateLength)
				{
					c = template[index];
					if (c == ';' || c == '<')
					{
						if (c == ';')
						{
							index++;
						}
						unicodeSymbol = UtfNumberToChar(num);
						return index - currentIndex;
					}
					int num3 = c - 48;
					index++;
					if (num3 < 0 || num3 > 9)
					{
						return index - currentIndex;
					}
					num = num * 10 + num3;
				}
			}
			unicodeSymbol = UtfNumberToChar(num);
			return templateLength - currentIndex;
		}

		private char UtfNumberToChar(int value)
		{
			if (value < 0 || value > 65535)
			{
				return '\ufffd';
			}
			return (char)value;
		}

		private bool CheckGt(int remainder, out int count)
		{
			count = 2;
			bool flag = remainder >= 2 && CharEqual(1, 'g') && CharEqual(2, 't');
			if (flag && remainder > 2 && CharEqual(3, ';'))
			{
				count++;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool CheckLt(int remainder, out int count)
		{
			count = 2;
			bool flag = remainder >= 2 && CharEqual(1, 'l') && CharEqual(2, 't');
			if (flag && remainder > 2 && CharEqual(3, ';'))
			{
				count++;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool CheckNbsp(int remainder, out int count)
		{
			count = 4;
			bool flag = remainder >= 4 && CharEqual(1, 'n') && CharEqual(2, 'b') && CharEqual(3, 's') && CharEqual(4, 'p');
			if (flag && remainder > 4 && CharEqual(5, ';'))
			{
				count++;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool CharEqual(int offset, char cmpChar)
		{
			return template[currentIndex + offset] == cmpChar;
		}

		private CssParsingResult ParseAttributes(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, char ch)
		{
			int num = currentIndex;
			ch = DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(template, ch, ref currentIndex, templateLength);
			if (currentIndex == templateLength)
			{
				ThrowMissingEndSymbolException(currentIndex);
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			if (CheckEndTag(tag, ch, out var isClosed))
			{
				if (!isClosed)
				{
					return CssParsingResult.Continue;
				}
				return CssParsingResult.Closed;
			}
			if (num == currentIndex)
			{
				ThrowUnknownTagException();
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			do
			{
				startIndexCore = currentIndex;
				if (!tag.ParseEvent(this, ch))
				{
					tag.ParseAttribute(this, ch, ParseAttributeMode.Parse, null);
				}
				if (currentIndex < templateLength)
				{
					ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(template, template[currentIndex], ref currentIndex, templateLength));
					continue;
				}
				ThrowMissingEndSymbolException(currentIndex);
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			while (!CheckEndTag(tag, ch, out isClosed));
			if (!isClosed)
			{
				return CssParsingResult.Continue;
			}
			return CssParsingResult.Closed;
		}

		private static Func<HTag> ParseHeaderStyle(string template, int currentIndex, ref string name)
		{
			switch (char.ToLowerInvariant(template[currentIndex + 1]))
			{
			case '1':
				name = "h1";
				return HTag.CreateH1;
			case '2':
				name = "h2";
				return HTag.CreateH2;
			case '3':
				name = "h3";
				return HTag.CreateH3;
			case '4':
				name = "h4";
				return HTag.CreateH4;
			case '5':
				name = "h5";
				return HTag.CreateH5;
			case '6':
				name = "h6";
				return HTag.CreateH6;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private void CloseTag()
		{
			int startIndex = currentIndex;
			int index = currentIndex;
			if (startIndexWhiteSpace != -1)
			{
				index = startIndexWhiteSpace;
			}
			EndTextElement(index);
			currentIndex++;
			string tagName = string.Empty;
			ParseTagCore(template, templateLength - currentIndex, ref currentIndex, ref tagName);
			if (tagName == string.Empty)
			{
				ThrowUnknownTagException();
			}
			else
			{
				if (currentIndex >= templateLength)
				{
					return;
				}
				char c = template[currentIndex];
				if (char.IsWhiteSpace(c))
				{
					c = DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(template, c, ref startIndex, templateLength);
				}
				if (c != '>')
				{
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsSymbol(c) || DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsNumber(c))
					{
						ThrowUnknownTagException();
					}
					else
					{
						ThrowMissingEndSymbolException(currentIndex);
					}
				}
				else if (currentNodeCore.TagName == tagName)
				{
					currentNodeCore = currentNodeCore.Parent;
					if (currentNodeCore == bodyNodeCore.RootElement)
					{
						currentNodeCore = bodyNodeCore;
					}
				}
				else if (!(tagName == "html"))
				{
					ThrowInvalidClosingTagException(tagName);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsEndTagSymbol(char ch)
		{
			if (ch != '>')
			{
				return ch == '/';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckEndTag(DxHtmlDocumentTag tag, char ch, out bool isClosed)
		{
			bool flag = (isClosed = tag.IsSelfClosing);
			if (ch == '>')
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (templateLength - currentIndex > 1 && ch == '/' && template[++currentIndex] == '>')
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					ThrowTagIsNotSelfClosingException(tag.Name);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void Initialize(string text, CssStyleSheet styleSheet)
		{
			template = text;
			templateLength = text.Length;
			DxHtmlDocumentRootNode dxHtmlDocumentRootNode = new DxHtmlDocumentRootNode(new RootTag(), styleSheet);
			styleSheetCore = dxHtmlDocumentRootNode.StyleSheet;
			bodyNodeCore = dxHtmlDocumentRootNode.Body;
			currentNodeCore = bodyNodeCore;
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			template = string.Empty;
			templateLength = 0;
			bodyNodeCore = null;
			currentNodeCore = null;
			startIndexTextElement = -1;
			sbTextCurrentIndex = -1;
			startIndexTextInTextElement = -1;
			endIndexTextInTextElement = -1;
			currentIndex = 0;
			styleSheetCore = null;
			builderCore.Clear();
		}

		private void CreateTextElement(string text, List<string> fields, HtmlTextType textType = HtmlTextType.Text)
		{
			currentNodeCore.CreateChild(new TextElementTag
			{
				Text = text,
				Fields = fields?.ToArray(),
				TextType = textType
			});
		}

		private void StartTextElement()
		{
			startIndexWhiteSpace = -1;
			if (!IsTextElement)
			{
				startIndexTextElement = currentIndex;
				sbTextCurrentIndex = 0;
				startIndexTextInTextElement = -1;
				endIndexTextInTextElement = -1;
			}
			char c = template[currentIndex];
			bool flag = char.IsWhiteSpace(c);
			if (startIndexTextInTextElement == -1 && !flag)
			{
				startIndexTextInTextElement = sbTextCurrentIndex;
			}
			if (startIndexTextInTextElement != -1 && !flag)
			{
				endIndexTextInTextElement = sbTextCurrentIndex;
			}
			sbTextCurrentIndex++;
		}

		private void EndTextElement(int index)
		{
			startIndexWhiteSpace = -1;
			if (IsTextElement)
			{
				int num = index - startIndexTextElement - 1;
				int startIndex = startIndexTextElement;
				int startTextIndex = 0;
				if (startIndexTextInTextElement != -1)
				{
					startTextIndex = startIndexTextInTextElement;
				}
				int endTextIndex = Math.Max(0, num - 1);
				if (endIndexTextInTextElement != -1)
				{
					endTextIndex = endIndexTextInTextElement;
				}
				startIndexTextElement = -1;
				sbTextCurrentIndex = -1;
				startIndexTextInTextElement = -1;
				endIndexTextInTextElement = -1;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					Append(startIndex, num);
				}
				if (builderCore.Length > 0)
				{
					ParseStringBuilder(num, startTextIndex, endTextIndex);
					builderCore.Clear();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ParseStringBuilder(int length, int startTextIndex, int endTextIndex)
		{
			if (length < 4 || builderCore[startTextIndex] != '$')
			{
				CreateTextElement(builderCore.ToString(), null);
			}
			else if (builderCore[endTextIndex] == '}')
			{
				SimpleParseStringBuilder(endTextIndex, startTextIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				ParseStringBuilderCore(endTextIndex, 0, startTextIndex);
			}
		}

		private void SimpleParseStringBuilder(int currentIndex, int startTextIndex)
		{
			int num = --currentIndex;
			bool flag = true;
			while (currentIndex > 0)
			{
				if (builderCore[currentIndex] == ':')
				{
					num = currentIndex - 1;
					flag = false;
				}
				if (builderCore[currentIndex] == '{')
				{
					int num2 = currentIndex + 1;
					string text = builderCore.ToString(num2, num - currentIndex);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						ParseStringBuilderCore(--currentIndex, 0, startTextIndex);
						return;
					}
					if (currentIndex == 1 && flag)
					{
						CreateTextElement(builderCore.ToString(1, builderCore.Length - 1), new List<string> { text }, HtmlTextType.Field);
						return;
					}
					builderCore.Remove(num2, num - currentIndex);
					builderCore.Insert(num2, 0);
					fields.Add(text);
					ParseStringBuilderCore(--currentIndex, 1, startTextIndex);
					return;
				}
				currentIndex--;
			}
			CreateTextElement(builderCore.ToString(), null);
		}

		private void ParseStringBuilderCore(int currentIndex, int position, int startTextIndex)
		{
			while (currentIndex > 1)
			{
				if (builderCore[currentIndex] == '}')
				{
					int num = --currentIndex;
					while (currentIndex > 0)
					{
						if (builderCore[currentIndex] == ':')
						{
							num = currentIndex - 1;
						}
						if (builderCore[currentIndex] == '{')
						{
							int num2 = currentIndex + 1;
							string text = builderCore.ToString(num2, num - currentIndex);
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
							{
								builderCore.Remove(num2, num - currentIndex);
								builderCore.Insert(num2, position);
								position++;
								fields.Add(text);
							}
							break;
						}
						currentIndex--;
					}
				}
				currentIndex--;
			}
			if (fields.Count == 0)
			{
				CreateTextElement(builderCore.ToString(), null);
				return;
			}
			builderCore.Remove(startTextIndex, 1);
			CreateTextElement(builderCore.ToString(0, builderCore.Length), fields, HtmlTextType.Format);
			fields = new List<string>();
		}

		private void Append(char _char, int offset = 0)
		{
			if (IsTextElement)
			{
				Append(startIndexTextElement, currentIndex - startIndexTextElement);
			}
			builderCore.Append(_char);
			startIndexTextElement = currentIndex + 1 + offset;
			sbTextCurrentIndex++;
		}

		private void Append(int startIndex, int count)
		{
			builderCore.Append(template, startIndex, count);
		}

		private bool IsSeparator(char ch)
		{
			if (ch == '\\' || ch == '/')
			{
				return false;
			}
			return StringExtensions.GetUnicodeCategory(ch) == UnicodeCategory.OtherPunctuation;
		}
	}
	public class ClassConditionParser
	{
		private enum SearchState
		{
			Start,
			FieldStart,
			FieldEnd,
			BranchStart,
			BranchEnd,
			SkipToEnd
		}

		private static ClassConditionParser instance;

		private SearchState state;

		public static ClassConditionParser Default
		{
			get
			{
				if (instance == null)
				{
					instance = new ClassConditionParser();
				}
				return instance;
			}
		}

		public List<ClassCondition> Parse(string txt)
		{
			List<ClassCondition> list = new List<ClassCondition>();
			state = SearchState.Start;
			ClassCondition classCondition = null;
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < txt.Length; i++)
			{
				if (state == SearchState.SkipToEnd)
				{
					continue;
				}
				char c = txt[i];
				if (state == SearchState.Start)
				{
					if (c == '{')
					{
						state = SearchState.FieldStart;
					}
				}
				else if (state == SearchState.FieldStart)
				{
					if (!char.IsWhiteSpace(c) && c != ';')
					{
						if (num < 0)
						{
							num = i;
						}
						state = SearchState.FieldEnd;
					}
				}
				else if (state == SearchState.FieldEnd)
				{
					if (c == '}' || c == ':' || c == ';')
					{
						string fieldName = txt.Substring(num, i - num).TrimEnd();
						classCondition = new ClassCondition(fieldName);
						list.Add(classCondition);
						num = -1;
						switch (c)
						{
						case '}':
							classCondition = null;
							state = SearchState.SkipToEnd;
							break;
						case ';':
							classCondition = null;
							state = SearchState.FieldStart;
							break;
						default:
							state = SearchState.BranchStart;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (state == SearchState.BranchStart)
				{
					if (char.IsWhiteSpace(c))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (c == '}')
					{
						if (num2 < 0)
						{
							classCondition?.AddBranch(new ClassConditionBranch(null));
						}
						state = SearchState.SkipToEnd;
					}
					else if (num2 < 0 && (c == ',' || c == ';'))
					{
						classCondition?.AddBranch(new ClassConditionBranch(null));
						if (c == ';')
						{
							classCondition = null;
							state = SearchState.FieldStart;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (num2 < 0)
						{
							num2 = i;
						}
						state = SearchState.BranchEnd;
					}
				}
				else if (state == SearchState.BranchEnd && (c == '}' || c == ',' || c == ';'))
				{
					string classes = txt.Substring(num2, i - num2).Trim();
					classCondition?.AddBranch(new ClassConditionBranch(classes));
					num2 = -1;
					switch (c)
					{
					case ';':
						classCondition = null;
						state = SearchState.FieldStart;
						break;
					case ',':
						state = SearchState.BranchStart;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public class ClassCondition
	{
		private List<ClassConditionBranch> branches;

		public string FieldName { get; }

		public ClassCondition(string fieldName)
		{
			FieldName = fieldName;
			branches = new List<ClassConditionBranch>();
		}

		internal void AddBranch(ClassConditionBranch branch)
		{
			branches.Add(branch);
		}

		public string GetClassByFieldValue(object val)
		{
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (val is bool)
			{
				return GetClassByBool((bool)val);
			}
			if (val is Enum)
			{
				return GetClassByEnum((Enum)val);
			}
			if (val is string)
			{
				return val.ToString();
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private string GetClassByBool(bool input)
		{
			if (input)
			{
				if (branches.Count <= 0)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return branches[0].Class;
			}
			if (branches.Count <= 1)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return branches[1].Class;
		}

		private string GetClassByEnum(Enum input)
		{
			if (branches.Count > 0)
			{
				return GetClassByEnumValueIndex(input);
			}
			Type type = input.GetType();
			if (type.IsDefined(typeof(FlagsAttribute), inherit: false))
			{
				return input.ToString().Replace(",", "");
			}
			return input.ToString();
		}

		private string GetClassByEnumValueIndex(Enum input)
		{
			if (branches.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = input.GetType();
			string[] names = Enum.GetNames(type);
			string text = input.ToString();
			if (type.IsDefined(typeof(FlagsAttribute), inherit: false))
			{
				return GetClassByFlagsEnumNames(text, names);
			}
			int index = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
			{
				if (names[i] == text)
				{
					index = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			return GetClassByIndex(index, 0);
		}

		private string GetClassByFlagsEnumNames(string valueNames, string[] enumNames)
		{
			string[] array = valueNames.Replace(" ", "").Split(new char[1] { ',' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < enumNames.Length; i++)
			{
				for (int j = num; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					if (enumNames[i] == array[j])
					{
						string[] array2 = GetClassByIndex(i, 0).Split(new char[1] { ' ' }, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
						for (int k = 0; k < array2.Length; k++)
						{
							hashSet.Add(array2[k]);
						}
						num = j + 1;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (hashSet.Count <= 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return string.Join(" ", hashSet.ToArray());
		}

		private string GetClassByIndex(int index, int defaultIndex = -1)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (index > branches.Count - 1)
			{
				if (defaultIndex == -1)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (branches.Count <= defaultIndex)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return branches[defaultIndex].Class;
			}
			return branches[index].Class;
		}
	}
	internal class ClassConditionBranch
	{
		public string Class { get; }

		public ClassConditionBranch(string classes)
		{
			Class = ((classes == null) ? string.Empty : classes);
		}
	}

		IDxHtmlSupportCombinator IDxHtmlSupportCombinator.Parent => ParentElement;

		internal override DxHtmlNodeList InternalChildren => internalChildrenCore;

		protected override bool AllowEventListener => true;

		protected override bool ReadOnly => tagCore.IsSelfClosing;

		protected T GetAttributeValue<T>(DxHtmlAttribute<T> attribute)
		{
			if (attributesAreDirtyCore)
			{
				return attribute.GetValue(RootElement, this);
			}
			return attribute.Value;
		}

		protected void SetAttributeValue<U, T>(ref U attribute, T value, Func<T, string, U> creater) where U : DxHtmlAttribute<T>
		{
			if (DxHtmlParser.SetAttributeValue(ref attribute, tagCore, value, attribute.Name, creater))
			{
				OnAttributeChanged(attribute.Name);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeAttributes(bool isCalc)
		{
			if (attributesAreDirtyCore)
			{
				InitializeAttributesCore();
				if (isCalc)
				{
					attributesAreDirtyCore = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeAttributesCore()
		{
			if (Tag.BindableAttributeCount == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			tagCore.TabIndex.ForceValue(RootElement, this);
			tagCore.Title.ForceValue(RootElement, this);
			tagCore.Id.ForceValue(RootElement, this);
			tagCore.Hidden.ForceValue(RootElement, this);
			tagCore.Class.ForceValue(RootElement, this);
			ApplyDxClass();
			if (tagCore.Slot.IsBindable)
			{
				string oldValue = saveSlot;
				saveSlot = Slot;
				tagCore.Slot.ForceValue(RootElement, this);
				if (saveSlot != tagCore.Slot.Value)
				{
					OnSlotChanged(oldValue);
				}
			}
			if (styleIsBindableCore)
			{
				string text = Style;
				tagCore.Style.ForceValue(RootElement, this);
				if (text != tagCore.Style.Value)
				{
					CssParser.Default.ParseStyle(tagCore.Style.Value, styleCore);
				}
				SetDirtyStyle();
			}
		}

		private void ApplyDxClass()
		{
			if (tagCore.ClassConditions == null || tagCore.ClassConditions.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < tagCore.ClassConditions.Count; i++)
			{
				ClassCondition classCondition = tagCore.ClassConditions[i];
				object value = RootElement.ActualClient.GetValue(classCondition.FieldName, this);
				string classByFieldValue = classCondition.GetClassByFieldValue(value);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(classByFieldValue))
				{
					if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(' ');
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(classByFieldValue);
				}
			}
			string text = stringBuilder.ToString();
			if (ConditionClassValue == text)
			{
				return;
			}
			stringBuilder.Clear();
			if (tagCore.Class.IsDefault)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(text);
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(tagCore.Class.Value);
				if (text.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(' ');
					stringBuilder.Append(text);
				}
			}
			ConditionClassValue = text;
			UpdateStyleSets(stringBuilder.ToString(), fastUpdate: true);
			ResetCombinatorsStyleSetRecursive();
		}

		private void LoadAttributeChanges()
		{
			if (attributeChanges != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < attributeChanges.Count; i++)
				{
					OnAttributeChangedCore(attributeChanges[i]);
				}
				attributeChanges = null;
			}
		}

		private void SaveAttributeChanges(string name)
		{
			if (attributeChanges == null)
			{
				attributeChanges = new List<string>();
			}
			attributeChanges.Add(name);
		}

		protected virtual void OnAttributeChanged(string name)
		{
			if (RootElement == null)
			{
				SaveAttributeChanges(name);
			}
			else
			{
				OnAttributeChangedCore(name);
			}
		}

		private void OnSlotChanged(string oldValue)
		{
			DxHtmlElement parentElement = ParentElement;
			if (parentElement != null && parentElement.ShadowRoot != null)
			{
				parentElement.ShadowRoot.RemoveSlotContent(oldValue, this);
				parentElement.ShadowRoot.AddSlotContent(this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnAttributeChangedCore(string name)
		{
			if (name == "classname")
			{
				UpdateStyleSets(tagCore.Class.Value);
			}
			RootElement.Invalidate(DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.AttributeChanged);
		}

		private void UpdateStyleSets(string classValue, bool fastUpdate = false)
		{
			DxHtmlParser.Default.ParseClassesValue(tagCore, classValue, RootElement.RootNode.StyleSheet);
			RecreateStyleSet();
			if (attributeChanges == null)
			{
				if (fastUpdate)
				{
					ResetStyleSet(resetConditionStyleSets: false);
				}
				else
				{
					RootElement.RefreshCondition(this);
				}
			}
		}

		private void RecreateStyleSet()
		{
			originalStyleSetCore = new CssStyleSet();
			computedStyleSetCore = originalStyleSetCore;
		}

		private void ResetCombinatorsStyleSetRecursive()
		{
			if (Tag.HasCombinators)
			{
				RecreateStyleSet();
				ResetStyleSet(resetConditionStyleSets: false);
			}
			foreach (DxHtmlElement child in Children)
			{
				child.ResetCombinatorsStyleSetRecursive();
			}
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal static DxHtmlRootElement ParseAndCreateHierarchy(string text)
		{
			return ParseAndCreateHierarchy(text, null);
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal static DxHtmlRootElement ParseAndCreateHierarchy(string text, CssStyleSheet styleSheet)
		{
			DxHtmlDocumentRootNode dxHtmlDocumentRootNode = DxHtmlParser.Default.Parse(text, styleSheet);
			if (dxHtmlDocumentRootNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new DxHtmlRootElement(dxHtmlDocumentRootNode, null);
		}

		public DxHtmlElement(DxHtmlDocumentNode documentNode)
			: base(documentNode)
		{
			childrenCore = new DxHtmlChildrenCollection(this);
			computedStyleCore = new CssStyle();
			internalChildrenCore = base.ChildNodes;
			InitializeElement();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		public void SetAttribute(string attributeName, object value)
		{
			string text = DxHtmlParser.Default.SetAttribute(CloneTag<DxHtmlDocumentTag>(), attributeName, value);
			if (text != null)
			{
				OnAttributeChanged(text);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		public object GetAttribute(string attributeName)
		{
			return DxHtmlParser.Default.GetAttribute(tagCore, attributeName)?.GetValue(RootElement, this);
		}

		public void ForEach(Action<DxHtmlElement> action, Predicate<DxHtmlElement> predicate = null)
		{
			if (NodeType < DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
			{
				return;
			}
			using DxHtmlElementIterator dxHtmlElementIterator = new DxHtmlElementIterator();
			dxHtmlElementIterator.Prepare(base.ChildNodes);
			while (dxHtmlElementIterator.MoveNext())
			{
				DxHtmlElement currentElement = dxHtmlElementIterator.CurrentElement;
				if (predicate == null || predicate(currentElement))
				{
					action(currentElement);
				}
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlElement FindElement(Predicate<DxHtmlElement> predicate)
		{
			if (NodeType < DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using (DxHtmlElementIterator dxHtmlElementIterator = new DxHtmlElementIterator())
			{
				dxHtmlElementIterator.Prepare(base.ChildNodes);
				while (dxHtmlElementIterator.MoveNext())
				{
					DxHtmlElement currentElement = dxHtmlElementIterator.CurrentElement;
					if (predicate(currentElement))
					{
						return currentElement;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public DxHtmlElement FindElementById(string id)
		{
			return GetElementById(id);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public DxHtmlElement GetElementById(string id)
		{
			if (NodeType < DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using (DxHtmlElementIterator dxHtmlElementIterator = new DxHtmlElementIterator())
			{
				dxHtmlElementIterator.Prepare(base.ChildNodes);
				while (dxHtmlElementIterator.MoveNext())
				{
					DxHtmlElement currentElement = dxHtmlElementIterator.CurrentElement;
					if (currentElement.Id == id)
					{
						return currentElement;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public IEnumerable<DxHtmlElement> FindElementsByClass(string @class)
		{
			return GetElementsByClass(@class);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public IEnumerable<DxHtmlElement> GetElementsByClass(string @class)
		{
			if (NodeType < DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<DxHtmlElement> list = new List<DxHtmlElement>();
			using DxHtmlElementIterator dxHtmlElementIterator = new DxHtmlElementIterator();
			dxHtmlElementIterator.Prepare(base.ChildNodes);
			while (dxHtmlElementIterator.MoveNext())
			{
				DxHtmlElement currentElement = dxHtmlElementIterator.CurrentElement;
				if (currentElement.DocumentNode.ContainsClass(@class))
				{
					list.Add(currentElement);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public IEnumerable<DxHtmlElement> FindElementsByTag(string name)
		{
			return GetElementsByTagName(name);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public IEnumerable<DxHtmlElement> GetElementsByTagName(string name)
		{
			List<DxHtmlElement> list = new List<DxHtmlElement>();
			if (NodeType < DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
			{
				return list;
			}
			string text = name.ToLower();
			using DxHtmlElementIterator dxHtmlElementIterator = new DxHtmlElementIterator();
			dxHtmlElementIterator.Prepare(base.ChildNodes);
			while (dxHtmlElementIterator.MoveNext())
			{
				DxHtmlElement currentElement = dxHtmlElementIterator.CurrentElement;
				if (currentElement.NodeName == text)
				{
					list.Add(currentElement);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public DxHtmlElement FindInputElement(string fieldName)
		{
			if (NodeType < DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using (DxHtmlElementIterator dxHtmlElementIterator = new DxHtmlElementIterator())
			{
				dxHtmlElementIterator.Prepare(base.ChildNodes);
				while (dxHtmlElementIterator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (dxHtmlElementIterator.CurrentElement is DxHtmlInputElement dxHtmlInputElement && dxHtmlInputElement.FieldName == fieldName)
					{
						return dxHtmlInputElement;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		public DxHtmlDocumentFragment FindTemplate(string templateId)
		{
			if (!(GetElementById(templateId) is DxHtmlTemplateElement dxHtmlTemplateElement))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return dxHtmlTemplateElement.Content;
		}

		public virtual bool Focus(bool value)
		{
			if (!IsFocusable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return RootElement.OnFocusedChanged(value ? this : null);
		}

		public virtual bool Select(bool value)
		{
			if (!SetDynamicStateCore(CssDynamicState.Select, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!SetDirtyStyle(computedStyleSetCore.Select))
			{
				return ConditionIndex > -1;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		public virtual void SetInnerText(string text)
		{
			DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = this;
			if (TagName == ":root")
			{
				dxHtmlElement = RootElement.Body;
			}
			dxHtmlElement.ClearChildrenCore();
			DxHtmlTextElement node = DxHtmlDocument.CreateTextNode(text);
			dxHtmlElement.AppendChild(node);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		public virtual void SetInnerHtml(string htmlTemplate)
		{
			DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = this;
			if (TagName == ":root")
			{
				dxHtmlElement = RootElement.Body;
			}
			dxHtmlElement.ClearChildrenCore();
			DxHtmlDocumentRootNode dxHtmlDocumentRootNode = DxHtmlParser.Default.Parse(htmlTemplate, RootElement?.RootNode.StyleSheet);
			RootElement?.LockCondition();
			if (CreateHierarchy(dxHtmlDocumentRootNode.Body, dxHtmlElement))
			{
				dxHtmlElement.Update();
			}
			RootElement?.RecalcPlainIndexes();
			RootElement?.UnlockCondition(Children[0]);
		}

		public CssStyle GetComputedStyle()
		{
			CalcCurrentStyleSet();
			CalcCurrentStyle(calcChildren: false);
			return computedStyleCore;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetDirtyStyle()
		{
			styleIsReadyCore = false;
		}

		protected bool SetDirtyStyle(CssStyle style)
		{
			if (style == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SetDirtyStyle();
			return true;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void CalcStyle()
		{
			CalcStyleCore();
		}

		protected virtual void CalcStyleCore()
		{
			CalcCurrentStyleSet();
			CalcCurrentStyle();
			if (computedStyleCore.Display == CssDisplay.ListItem)
			{
				computedStyleCore.CheckMarker();
				computedStyleCore.Marker.MergeParent(computedStyleCore, computedStyleCore);
				computedStyleCore.Marker.SetDisplay(CssDisplay.Inline);
			}
			if (ReadOnly)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (computedStyleCore.Before != null)
			{
				base.ViewInfo.Children.AddBefore(GetContentInfo(computedStyleCore.Before));
				if (computedStyleCore.Before.MainProperties.Display.IsEmpty)
				{
					computedStyleCore.Before.SetDisplay(CssDisplay.Inline);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.ViewInfo.Children.AddBefore(null);
			}
			if (computedStyleCore.After != null)
			{
				base.ViewInfo.Children.AddAfter(GetContentInfo(computedStyleCore.After));
				if (computedStyleCore.After.MainProperties.Display.IsEmpty)
				{
					computedStyleCore.After.SetDisplay(CssDisplay.Inline);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.ViewInfo.Children.AddAfter(null);
			}
		}

		private DxHtmlElementInfoBase GetContentInfo(CssStyle style)
		{
			CssContent content = style.MainProperties.Content;
			if (content.ContentType == CssContentType.None || string.IsNullOrEmpty(content.Value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (content.ContentType == CssContentType.Image)
			{
				return new DxHtmlImagePseudoElementInfo(content.Value, content.IsBindable, style, base.ViewInfo);
			}
			return new DxHtmlTextPseudoElementInfo(content.Value, content.IsBindable, style, base.ViewInfo);
		}

		internal void ResetStyleSet(bool resetConditionStyleSets = true)
		{
			if (resetConditionStyleSets)
			{
				activeConditionStyleSets?.Clear();
			}
			tagCore.Apply(this);
			SetDirtyStyle();
			styleSetIsReadyCore = false;
		}

		protected void CalcCurrentStyleSet()
		{
			if (styleSetIsReadyCore)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (activeConditionStyleSets != null && activeConditionStyleSets.Count > 0)
			{
				computedStyleSetCore = new CssStyleSet();
				foreach (CssStyleSet value in activeConditionStyleSets.Values)
				{
					computedStyleSetCore.Merge(value);
				}
				computedStyleSetCore.Merge(originalStyleSetCore);
			}
			else
			{
				computedStyleSetCore = originalStyleSetCore;
			}
			SetDirtyStyle();
			styleSetIsReadyCore = true;
		}

		protected void CalcCurrentStyle(bool calcChildren = true)
		{
			if (!styleIsReadyCore)
			{
				CalcCurrentStyleCore(ParentElement?.computedStyleCore);
				if (calcChildren)
				{
					CalcChildrenStyle();
				}
			}
		}

		private void CalcChildrenStyle()
		{
			if (base.ChildNodes.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			using DxHtmlNodeIterator dxHtmlNodeIterator = new DxHtmlNodeIterator();
			dxHtmlNodeIterator.Prepare(base.ChildNodes);
			while (dxHtmlNodeIterator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (dxHtmlNodeIterator.CurrentNode is DxHtmlElementBase dxHtmlElementBase)
				{
					dxHtmlElementBase.UpdateCurrentStyle();
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateCurrentStyle()
		{
			CalcCurrentStyleSet();
			CalcCurrentStyleCore(ParentElement.computedStyleCore);
		}

		private void CalcCurrentStyleCore(CssStyle parentStyle)
		{
			styleIsReadyCore = true;
			computedStyleCore.Reset(computedStyleSetCore.Normal);
			if (IsLink)
			{
				if ((dynamicStateCore & CssDynamicState.Visited) == CssDynamicState.Visited)
				{
					computedStyleCore.AutoInheritedProperties.MergeForeColor(computedStyleSetCore.Visited.AutoInheritedProperties.ForeColor);
				}
				computedStyleCore.Merge(computedStyleSetCore.Link);
			}
			CalcCurrentStyleCore();
			CalcCustomStyleCore();
			computedStyleCore.Merge(styleCore);
			computedStyleCore.MergeParent(parentStyle, RootElement.computedStyleCore);
		}

		protected virtual void CalcCustomStyleCore()
		{
			if (!computedStyleSetCore.HasCustomStates() || internalsCore == null || internalsCore.States.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (string state in internalsCore.States)
			{
				if (computedStyleSetCore.TryCustomState(state, out var style))
				{
					computedStyleCore.Merge(style);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CalcCurrentStyleCore()
		{
			MergeStyleSetToStyle(computedStyleSetCore, computedStyleCore);
		}

		protected void MergeStyleSetToStyle(CssStyleSet styleSet, CssStyle style)
		{
			if (dynamicStateCore > CssDynamicState.Normal)
			{
				if ((dynamicStateCore & CssDynamicState.Hover) == CssDynamicState.Hover)
				{
					style.Merge(styleSet.Hover);
				}
				if ((dynamicStateCore & CssDynamicState.Active) == CssDynamicState.Active)
				{
					style.Merge(styleSet.Active);
				}
				if ((dynamicStateCore & CssDynamicState.Focus) == CssDynamicState.Focus)
				{
					style.Merge(styleSet.Focus);
				}
				if ((dynamicStateCore & CssDynamicState.FocusWithin) == CssDynamicState.FocusWithin)
				{
					style.Merge(styleSet.FocusWithin);
				}
				if ((dynamicStateCore & CssDynamicState.Select) == CssDynamicState.Select)
				{
					style.Merge(styleSet.Select);
				}
			}
			if (Disabled)
			{
				style.Merge(styleSet.Disabled);
			}
			if (Invalid)
			{
				computedStyleCore.Merge(computedStyleSetCore.Invalid);
			}
		}

		internal void ActivateStyleSet(CssStyleSet styleSet, int key)
		{
			if (activeConditionStyleSets == null)
			{
				activeConditionStyleSets = new Dictionary<int, CssStyleSet>();
			}
			activeConditionStyleSets[key] = styleSet;
			styleSetIsReadyCore = false;
		}

		internal void DeactivateStyleSet(int index)
		{
			if (activeConditionStyleSets != null)
			{
				activeConditionStyleSets.Remove(index);
				styleSetIsReadyCore = false;
			}
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ResetDynamicState()
		{
			if (ResetDynamicStateCore())
			{
				return;
			}
			SetDirtyStyle();
			using DxHtmlElementIterator dxHtmlElementIterator = new DxHtmlElementIterator();
			dxHtmlElementIterator.Prepare(base.ChildNodes);
			while (dxHtmlElementIterator.MoveNext())
			{
				dxHtmlElementIterator.CurrentElement.ResetDynamicStateCore();
			}
		}

		protected void SetDisabledState(bool value)
		{
			if (ParentElement != null && !value && ParentElement.Disabled)
			{
				value = true;
			}
			SetStateRecursive(CssDynamicState.Disabled, value);
		}

		protected void SetInvalidState(bool value)
		{
			if (ParentElement != null && !value && ParentElement.Invalid)
			{
				value = true;
			}
			SetStateRecursive(CssDynamicState.Invalid, value);
		}

		private void SetStateRecursive(CssDynamicState state, bool value)
		{
			if (!SetDynamicStateCore(state, value))
			{
				return;
			}
			SetDirtyStyle();
			using DxHtmlElementIterator dxHtmlElementIterator = new DxHtmlElementIterator();
			dxHtmlElementIterator.Prepare(base.ChildNodes);
			while (dxHtmlElementIterator.MoveNext())
			{
				dxHtmlElementIterator.CurrentElement.SetDynamicStateCore(state, value);
			}
		}

		internal void SetDynamicState(CssDynamicState state, bool value)
		{
			if (SetDynamicStateCore(state, value))
			{
				SetDirtyStyle();
			}
		}

		internal bool SetHoverState(bool value, ref bool hasStyle)
		{
			if (SetDynamicStateCore(CssDynamicState.Hover, value))
			{
				hasStyle |= SetDirtyStyle(ComputedStyleSet.Hover) | (ConditionIndex > -1);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool SetActiveState(bool value)
		{
			if (!SetActiveStateCore(value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (IsLink)
			{
				flag = SetVisitedStateCore();
			}
			flag |= SetParentActiveState(value);
			return SetDirtyStyle(computedStyleSetCore.Active) || ConditionIndex > -1 || flag;
		}

		private bool SetParentActiveState(bool value)
		{
			DxHtmlElement parentElement = ParentElement;
			bool flag = false;
			while (parentElement != null && parentElement.SetActiveStateCore(value))
			{
				flag |= parentElement.SetDirtyStyle(parentElement.computedStyleSetCore.Active) | (parentElement.ConditionIndex > -1);
				parentElement = parentElement.ParentElement;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool SetActiveStateCore(bool value)
		{
			return SetDynamicStateCore(CssDynamicState.Active, value);
		}

		internal bool SetFocusState(bool value, DxHtmlElement parent)
		{
			if (parent == this)
			{
				return SetDynamicStateCore(CssDynamicState.Focus, value);
			}
			if (!SetDynamicStateCore(CssDynamicState.FullFocus, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = SetParentFocusWithinState(value, parent);
			return SetDirtyStyle(computedStyleSetCore.Focus) || SetDirtyStyle(computedStyleSetCore.FocusWithin) || ConditionIndex > -1 || flag;
		}

		private bool SetParentFocusWithinState(bool value, DxHtmlElement newFocus)
		{
			DxHtmlElement parentElement = ParentElement;
			bool flag = false;
			while (parentElement != newFocus && parentElement.SetFocusWithinStateCore(value))
			{
				flag |= parentElement.SetDirtyStyle(parentElement.computedStyleSetCore.FocusWithin) | (parentElement.ConditionIndex > -1);
				parentElement = parentElement.ParentElement;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool SetFocusWithinStateCore(bool value)
		{
			return SetDynamicStateCore(CssDynamicState.FocusWithin, value);
		}

		private bool SetVisitedStateCore()
		{
			DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = this;
			while (dxHtmlElement.ParentElement != null && dxHtmlElement.ParentElement.IsLink)
			{
				dxHtmlElement = dxHtmlElement.ParentElement;
			}
			if (dxHtmlElement.SetDynamicStateCore(CssDynamicState.Visited, value: true))
			{
				dxHtmlElement.SetDirtyStyle();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ResetDynamicStateCore()
		{
			if (dynamicStateCore < CssDynamicState.Hover)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CssDynamicState cssDynamicState = dynamicStateCore;
			dynamicStateCore = (isLinkCore ? CssDynamicState.Link : CssDynamicState.Normal);
			if (cssDynamicState == dynamicStateCore)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SetDirtyStyle();
			RootElement.OnStateChanged(this);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal bool SetDynamicStateCore(CssDynamicState state, bool value)
		{
			CssDynamicState cssDynamicState = dynamicStateCore;
			dynamicStateCore = (value ? (dynamicStateCore |= state) : (dynamicStateCore &= ~state));
			if (cssDynamicState == dynamicStateCore)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RootElement?.OnStateChanged(this);
			return true;
		}

		protected void EnableLink()
		{
			isLinkCore = true;
			dynamicStateCore |= CssDynamicState.Link;
		}

		void IDxHtmlSupportCombinator.AddCombinator(List<Tuple<CssSelector, IDxHtmlSupportCombinator>> tuples, CssStyleSet styleSet)
		{
			DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicCondition> dxHtmlReadOnlyCollection = new DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicCondition>();
			for (int i = 0; i < tuples.Count; i++)
			{
				Tuple<CssSelector, IDxHtmlSupportCombinator> tuple = tuples[i];
				int index = tuple.Item2.CheckConditionIndex();
				CssSelector item = tuple.Item1;
				CssDynamicCondition cssDynamicCondition = new CssDynamicCondition(item, index);
				cssDynamicCondition.CheckDefault((DxHtmlElement)tuple.Item2);
				dxHtmlReadOnlyCollection.Add(cssDynamicCondition);
			}
			CssDynamicStyleSet value = new CssDynamicStyleSet(dxHtmlReadOnlyCollection, styleSet);
			RootElement.RegisterConditions(this, new DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicStyleSet> { value });
		}

		void IDxHtmlSupportCombinator.AddCombinator(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator element, CssSelector selector, CssStyleSet styleSet)
		{
			int index = element.CheckConditionIndex();
			DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicCondition> condition = new DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicCondition>
			{
				new CssDynamicCondition(selector, index)
			};
			CssDynamicStyleSet value = new CssDynamicStyleSet(condition, styleSet);
			RootElement.RegisterConditions(this, new DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicStyleSet> { value });
		}

		string IDxHtmlSupportCombinator.GetId()
		{
			if (tagCore.Id.IsDefault || tagCore.Id.IsBindable)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return tagCore.Id.GetValue(null, this);
		}

		string IDxHtmlSupportCombinator.GetTagName()
		{
			return TagName;
		}

		bool IDxHtmlSupportCombinator.ContainsClass(string @class)
		{
			return tagCore.ContainsClass(@class);
		}

		int IDxHtmlSupportCombinator.CheckConditionIndex()
		{
			if (ConditionIndex != -1)
			{
				return ConditionIndex;
			}
			ConditionIndex = RootElement.GetConditionIndex();
			return ConditionIndex;
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeElement()
		{
			DxHtmlDocumentNode documentNode = base.DocumentNode;
			if (documentNode.Tag.HasBinding)
			{
				CloneTag<DxHtmlDocumentTag>();
			}
			else
			{
				tagCore = documentNode.Tag;
			}
			attributesAreDirtyCore = tagCore.HasBinding;
			ConditionIndex = documentNode.ConditionIndex;
			originalStyleSetCore = documentNode.StyleSet;
			computedStyleSetCore = originalStyleSetCore;
			styleIsBindableCore = tagCore.Style.IsBindable;
			styleCore = new CssStyle();
			styleCore.SetOwner(this);
			CssParser.Default.ParseStyle(tagCore.Style.GetValue(null, this), styleCore);
		}

		internal T CloneTag<T>() where T : DxHtmlDocumentTag
		{
			if (tagIsCloneCore)
			{
				return (T)tagCore;
			}
			tagCore = base.DocumentNode.Tag.Clone();
			tagIsCloneCore = true;
			return (T)tagCore;
		}

		internal void BeforeCalc()
		{
			InitializeAttributes(isCalc: true);
			CalcStyleCore();
		}

		internal void AfterCalc()
		{
			attributesAreDirtyCore = tagCore.HasBinding;
		}

		protected override void Load()
		{
			base.Load();
			if (ParentElement != null && ParentElement.isLinkCore)
			{
				isLinkCore = true;
			}
			LoadAttributeChanges();
		}

		protected override DxHtmlElementInfoBase CreateViewInfo()
		{
			return new DxHtmlElementInfo(this);
		}

		protected override void ResetCore()
		{
			activeConditionStyleSets = null;
			SetDirtyStyle();
			styleSetIsReadyCore = false;
			InitializeElement();
			ResetDynamicStateCore();
			base.ResetCore();
		}

		internal DxHtmlElement FindParent(Predicate<DxHtmlElement> predicate)
		{
			DxHtmlElement parentElement;
			for (parentElement = ParentElement; parentElement != null; parentElement = parentElement.ParentElement)
			{
				if (predicate(parentElement))
				{
					return parentElement;
				}
			}
			return parentElement;
		}

		protected override DxHtmlNode CloneCore()
		{
			return new DxHtmlElement(base.DocumentNode);
		}

		protected override void Assign(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			base.Assign(node);
			DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = node as DxHtmlElement;
			DxHtmlDocumentTag dxHtmlDocumentTag = dxHtmlElement.tagCore;
			tagCore = (dxHtmlDocumentTag.HasBinding ? dxHtmlDocumentTag.Clone() : dxHtmlDocumentTag);
			ConditionClassValue = dxHtmlElement.ConditionClassValue;
		}

		public static bool HasId(DxHtmlElement element, string id, bool includeAncestors = true)
		{
			while (element != null)
			{
				bool flag = element.Id == id;
				if (flag || !includeAncestors)
				{
					return flag;
				}
				element = element.ParentElement;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool HasClassName(DxHtmlElement element, string @class, bool includeAncestors = true)
		{
			while (element != null)
			{
				bool flag = element.DocumentNode.ContainsClass(@class);
				if (flag || !includeAncestors)
				{
					return flag;
				}
				element = element.ParentElement;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool HasTag(DxHtmlElement element, string tagName, bool includeAncestors = true)
		{
			while (element != null)
			{
				bool flag = element.TagName.Equals(tagName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
				if (flag || !includeAncestors)
				{
					return flag;
				}
				element = element.ParentElement;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnConnected()
		{
			ConnectedCallback();
		}

		protected virtual void ConnectedCallback()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void DisconnectedCallback()
		{
		}

		internal ElementInternals AttachInternals()
		{
			if (internalsCore == null)
			{
				internalsCore = new ElementInternals();
				internalsCore.States.StateChanged += OnCustomStateChanged;
			}
			return internalsCore;
		}

		private void OnCustomStateChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			SetDirtyStyle();
			RootElement?.OnStateChanged(this);
		}

		internal void DetachInternals()
		{
			if (internalsCore != null)
			{
				internalsCore.States.StateChanged -= OnCustomStateChanged;
				internalsCore = null;
				SetDirtyStyle();
				RootElement?.OnStateChanged(this);
			}
		}

		internal DxHtmlShadowElement AttachShadow(DxHtmlShadowMode mode)
		{
			if (mode == DxHtmlShadowMode.Open)
			{
				if (shadowRootCore == null)
				{
					shadowRootCore = new DxHtmlShadowElement(this);
				}
				shadowRootCore.AddSlotContents(base.ChildNodes);
				internalChildrenCore = shadowRootCore.ChildNodes;
				return shadowRootCore;
			}
			shadowRootCore.ClearSlotContents();
			internalChildrenCore = base.ChildNodes;
			shadowRootCore = null;
			return shadowRootCore;
		}

		protected override void OnItemAddedCore(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			base.OnItemAddedCore(node);
			if (node.NodeType >= DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
			{
				DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = (DxHtmlElement)node;
				if (shadowRootCore != null)
				{
					shadowRootCore.AddSlotContent(dxHtmlElement);
				}
				dxHtmlElement.ConnectedCallback();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnItemRemovedCore(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			base.OnItemRemovedCore(node);
			if (node.NodeType >= DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
			{
				DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = (DxHtmlElement)node;
				if (shadowRootCore != null)
				{
					shadowRootCore.RemoveSlotContent(dxHtmlElement);
				}
				dxHtmlElement.DisconnectedCallback();
			}
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = false)]
	public class DxHtmlTargetTypeAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Type, HashSet<Type>> dxHtmlTargetTypes = new ConcurrentDictionary<Type, HashSet<Type>>();

		private readonly Type serviceProviderType;

		private readonly string displayName;

		public string DisplayName => displayName;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void RegisterDxHtmlTargetType(Type type, Type serviceProviderType)
		{
			HashSet<Type> orAdd = dxHtmlTargetTypes.GetOrAdd(type, (Type x) => new HashSet<Type>());
			if (orAdd != null && serviceProviderType != null)
			{
				orAdd.Add(serviceProviderType);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static IReadOnlyCollection<KeyValuePair<Type, HashSet<Type>>> GetDxHtmlTargetTypes()
		{
			KeyValuePair<Type, HashSet<Type>>[] array = new KeyValuePair<Type, HashSet<Type>>[dxHtmlTargetTypes.Count];
			((ICollection<KeyValuePair<Type, HashSet<Type>>>)dxHtmlTargetTypes).CopyTo(array, 0);
			return (IReadOnlyCollection<KeyValuePair<Type, HashSet<Type>>>)(object)array;
		}

		public DxHtmlTargetTypeAttribute()
			: this(string.Empty, null)
		{
		}

		public DxHtmlTargetTypeAttribute(string displayName)
			: this(displayName, null)
		{
		}

		public DxHtmlTargetTypeAttribute(string displayName, Type serviceProviderType)
		{
			this.displayName = displayName;
			this.serviceProviderType = serviceProviderType;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void LoadDxHtmlTargetTypes(IReadOnlyCollection<Assembly> assemblies, Predicate<Assembly> filter = null, bool useParallelLoading = false)
		{
			if (assemblies == null || assemblies.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<Assembly> enumerable = ((filter == null) ? assemblies.Where((Assembly x) => !x.IsDynamic) : assemblies.Where((Assembly x) => !x.IsDynamic && !filter(x)));
			if (useParallelLoading)
			{
				OrderablePartitioner<Assembly> source = Partitioner.Create(enumerable.ToArray(), loadBalance: true);
				Parallel.ForEach(source, delegate(Assembly asm)
				{
					LoadDxHtmlTargetTypes(asm);
				});
				return;
			}
			foreach (Assembly item in enumerable)
			{
				LoadDxHtmlTargetTypes(item);
			}
		}

		private static void LoadDxHtmlTargetTypes(Assembly asm)
		{
			Type[] types = GetTypes(asm);
			foreach (Type type in types)
			{
				if (type == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					IEnumerable<DxHtmlTargetTypeAttribute> customAttributes = type.GetCustomAttributes<DxHtmlTargetTypeAttribute>(inherit: true);
					if (customAttributes == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (DxHtmlTargetTypeAttribute item in customAttributes)
					{
						RegisterDxHtmlTargetType(type, item.serviceProviderType ?? type);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static string GetDisplayName(Type type, Type serviceProviderType)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			IEnumerable<DxHtmlTargetTypeAttribute> customAttributes = type.GetCustomAttributes<DxHtmlTargetTypeAttribute>(inherit: true);
			if (customAttributes != null)
			{
				serviceProviderType = serviceProviderType ?? type;
				foreach (DxHtmlTargetTypeAttribute item in customAttributes)
				{
					Type type2 = item.serviceProviderType ?? type;
					if (serviceProviderType == type2)
					{
						string value = item.DisplayName;
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
						{
							break;
						}
						return item.DisplayName;
					}
				}
				return MasterDetailHelper.SplitPascalCaseString(type.Name);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private static Type[] GetTypes(Assembly asm)
		{
			try
			{
				return asm.GetTypes();
			}
			catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException ex)
			{
				return ex.Types;
			}
		}
	}
