		}

		public static DxHtmlElement CreateElement(string tagName)
		{
			int currentIndex = 0;
			string tagName2 = string.Empty;
			Func<DxHtmlDocumentTag> func = DxHtmlParser.ParseTagCore(tagName, tagName.Length, ref currentIndex, ref tagName2);
			if (func == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = (DxHtmlElement)new DxHtmlDocumentNode(func()).CreateNode();
			dxHtmlElement.ResetStyleSet();
			return dxHtmlElement;
		}

		public static DxHtmlTextElement CreateTextNode(string text)
		{
			TextElementTag textElementTag = new TextElementTag
			{
				Text = text
			};
			DxHtmlDocumentNode dxHtmlDocumentNode = new DxHtmlDocumentNode(textElementTag);
			textElementTag.Apply(dxHtmlDocumentNode);
			return new DxHtmlTextElement(dxHtmlDocumentNode);
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]

		}

		private bool ParseCursorValueCore(char ch, ref CssCursors value)
		{
			int remainder = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'a':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckAuto(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))

					currentIndexCore += 4;

				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckAlias(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))

					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckAll_Scroll(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))

				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					value = CssCursors.Default;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'c':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckCopy(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssCursors.Copy;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckCol_Resize(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))

					currentIndexCore += 10;
					value = CssCursors.ColResize;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckCell(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssCursors.Cell;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckContext_Menu(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 12;
					value = CssCursors.ContextMenu;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckCrosshair(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 9;
					value = CssCursors.Crosshair;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'e':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.Check_Resize(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 8;
					value = CssCursors.EResize;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckEw_Resize(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 9;

					return true;

			case 'g':

					currentIndexCore += 4;

				}
				break;
			case 'h':

				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssCursors.Help;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'm':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckMove(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssCursors.Move;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'n':

				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssCursors.None;

					return true;
				}

				{
					currentIndexCore += 9;

				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckNesw_Resize(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))

					currentIndexCore += 11;
					value = CssCursors.NeswResize;
					return true;

				{
					currentIndexCore += 11;

					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'p':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckPointer(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))

					currentIndexCore += 8;
					value = CssCursors.Progress;

			case 'r':

				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSw_Resize(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))

					currentIndexCore += 9;

			case 't':

				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssCursors.Text;

				}
				break;
			case 'v':

		private void ParseUserSelectValue(CssAutoInheritedProperties properties)
		{
			if (FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				CssUserSelect value = CssUserSelect.Auto;
				CssPropertyInheritance res = CssPropertyInheritance.None;
				if (!ParseUserSelectValueCore(ch, ref value) && !CheckInheritance(templateCore, currentIndexCore, ref res))
				{
					ThrowInvalidValueException();
				}
				else if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: false, out ch) == CssParsingResult.Closed)
				{
					properties.SetUserSelect(new CssProperty<CssUserSelect>(value, res, currentWeightCore));
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ParseUserSelectValueCore(char ch, ref CssUserSelect value)
		{
			int remainder = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'n':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckUserSelectNone(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssUserSelect.None;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'a':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckUserSelectAuto(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssUserSelect.Auto;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckUserSelectAll(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 3;
					value = CssUserSelect.All;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 't':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckUserSelectText(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssUserSelect.Text;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'c':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckUserSelectContain(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					value = CssUserSelect.Contain;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ParseVisibilityValue(CssAutoInheritedProperties properties)

				}
			}
		}

		private bool ParseVisibilityValueCore(char ch, ref CssVisibility value)
		{
			int remainder = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'v':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckVisible(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					value = CssVisibility.Visible;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'h':

		}

		private void ParseDisplayValue(CssMainProperties properties)
		{
			if (FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				CssDisplay value = CssDisplay.Inline;
				CssPropertyInheritance res = CssPropertyInheritance.None;
				if (!ParseDisplayValueCore(ch, ref value) && !CheckInheritance(templateCore, currentIndexCore, ref res))
				{
					ThrowInvalidValueException();
				}
				else if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: false, out ch) == CssParsingResult.Closed)
				{
					properties.SetDisplay(new CssProperty<CssDisplay>(value, res, currentWeightCore));
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ParseDisplayValueCore(char ch, ref CssDisplay value)
		{
			int num = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'b':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckBlock(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					value = CssDisplay.Block;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'c':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckContents(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 8;
					value = CssDisplay.Contents;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'f':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckFlex(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssDisplay.Flex;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'i':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckInline(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					value = CssDisplay.Inline;
					ParseDisplayInlineValueCore(num - 6, ref value);
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 't':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTable(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					value = CssDisplay.Table;
					ParseDisplayParseTableValueCore(num - 5, ref value);
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'g':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckGrid(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssDisplay.Grid;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'n':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckNone(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssDisplay.None;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'l':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckListItem(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 9;
					value = CssDisplay.ListItem;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'r':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRunIn(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					value = CssDisplay.RunIn;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ParseDisplayInlineValueCore(int remainder, ref CssDisplay value)
		{
			if (remainder < 4 || templateCore[currentIndexCore] != '-')
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (char.ToLowerInvariant(templateCore[++currentIndexCore]))
			{
			case 'b':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckBlock(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					value = CssDisplay.InlineBlock;
				}
				break;
			case 'f':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckFlex(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssDisplay.InlineFlex;
				}
				break;
			case 'g':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckGrid(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssDisplay.InlineGrid;
				}
				break;
			case 't':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTable(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					value = CssDisplay.InlineTable;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ParseDisplayParseTableValueCore(int remainder, ref CssDisplay value)
		{
			if (remainder < 4 || templateCore[currentIndexCore] != '-')
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (char.ToLowerInvariant(templateCore[++currentIndexCore]))
			{
			case 'c':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckCaption(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					value = CssDisplay.TableCaption;
				}
				else if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckCell(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssDisplay.TableCell;
				}
				else if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckColumn(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					value = CssDisplay.TableColumn;
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.Check_Group(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder - 7))
					{
						currentIndexCore += 6;
						value = CssDisplay.TableColumnGroup;
					}
				}
				break;
			case 'r':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRow(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 3;
					value = CssDisplay.TableRow;
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.Check_Group(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder - 3))
					{
						currentIndexCore += 6;
						value = CssDisplay.TableRowGroup;
					}
				}
				break;
			case 'h':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckHeader(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.Check_Group(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder - 3))
					{
						currentIndexCore += 6;
						value = CssDisplay.TableHeaderGroup;
					}
				}
				break;
			case 'f':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckFooter(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.Check_Group(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder - 3))
					{
						currentIndexCore += 6;
						value = CssDisplay.TableFooterGroup;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool ParseUnitValueTypeCore(int startIndex, int remainder, ref CssUnitValueType value)
		{
			if (remainder < 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			char c = char.ToLowerInvariant(templateCore[startIndex]);
			char c2 = char.ToLowerInvariant(templateCore[startIndex + 1]);
			switch (remainder)
			{
			case 2:
				switch (c)
				{
				case 'e':
					if (c2 == 'm')
					{
						value = CssUnitValueType.Em;
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case 'p':
					switch (c2)
					{
					case 'x':
						value = CssUnitValueType.Px;
						return true;
					case 't':
						value = CssUnitValueType.Pt;
						return true;
					case 'c':
						value = CssUnitValueType.Pc;
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case 'i':
					if (c2 == 'n')
					{
						value = CssUnitValueType.In;
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case 'c':
					if (c2 == 'm')
					{
						value = CssUnitValueType.Cm;
						return true;
					}
					break;
				case 'm':
					if (c2 == 'm')
					{
						value = CssUnitValueType.Mm;
						return true;
					}
					break;
				}
				return false;
			case 3:
				if (c2 == 'e' && DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.EqualChars(templateCore[startIndex + 2], 'm'))
				{
					value = CssUnitValueType.Rem;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckNoScaling(templateCore, startIndex, remainder))
			{
				value = CssUnitValueType.NoScaling;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

				{

				else if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: false, out ch) == CssParsingResult.Closed)

		private bool ParseFontWeightValueCore(char ch, ref CssFontWeight value)
		{
			int num = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'n':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckNormal(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					value = CssFontWeight.Normal;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'b':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckBolder(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					value = CssFontWeight.Bolder;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckBold(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssFontWeight.Bold;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'l':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckLighter(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					value = CssFontWeight.Lighter;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsNumber(ch))
			{
				CssFontWeight cssFontWeight = CssFontWeight.N100;
				switch (ch)
				{
				case '0':
					return false;
				case '2':
					cssFontWeight = CssFontWeight.N200;
					break;
				case '3':
					cssFontWeight = CssFontWeight.N300;
					break;
				case '4':
					cssFontWeight = CssFontWeight.N400;
					break;
				case '5':
					cssFontWeight = CssFontWeight.N500;
					break;
				case '6':
					cssFontWeight = CssFontWeight.N600;
					break;
				case '7':
					cssFontWeight = CssFontWeight.N700;
					break;
				case '8':
					cssFontWeight = CssFontWeight.N800;
					break;
				case '9':
					cssFontWeight = CssFontWeight.N900;
					break;
				}
				if (num > 2 && templateCore[currentIndexCore + 1] == '0' && templateCore[currentIndexCore + 2] == '0')
				{
					currentIndexCore += 3;
					value = cssFontWeight;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

				CssFlexDirection value = CssFlexDirection.Row;

		private bool ParseFlexDirectionValueCore(char ch, ref CssFlexDirection value)
		{
			int num = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'r':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRow(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 3;
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.Check_Reverse(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num - 3))
					{
						currentIndexCore += 8;
						value = CssFlexDirection.RowReverse;
					}
					else
					{
						value = CssFlexDirection.Row;
					}
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'c':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckColumn(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.Check_Reverse(templateCore, currentIndexCore, num - 6))
					{
						currentIndexCore += 8;
						value = CssFlexDirection.ColumnReverse;
					}
					else
					{
						value = CssFlexDirection.Column;
					}
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ParseWhiteSpaceValue(CssTextProperties properties)
		{
			if (FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				CssWhiteSpace value = CssWhiteSpace.Normal;
				CssPropertyInheritance res = CssPropertyInheritance.None;
				if (!ParseWhiteSpaceValueCore(ch, ref value) && !CheckInheritance(templateCore, currentIndexCore, ref res))
				{
					ThrowInvalidValueException();
				}
				else if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: false, out ch) == CssParsingResult.Closed)
				{
					properties.SetWhiteSpace(new CssProperty<CssWhiteSpace>(value, res, currentWeightCore));
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ParseWhiteSpaceValueCore(char ch, ref CssWhiteSpace value)
		{
			int remainder = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			if (ch == 'n')
			{
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckNormal(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					value = CssWhiteSpace.Normal;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckNowrap(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					value = CssWhiteSpace.NoWrap;
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (ch == 'p' && DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckPre(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
			{
				currentIndexCore += 3;
				if (templateCore[currentIndexCore] != '-')
				{
					value = CssWhiteSpace.Pre;
					return true;
				}
				currentIndexCore++;
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckWrap(templateCore, currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssWhiteSpace.PreWrap;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckLine(templateCore, currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					value = CssWhiteSpace.PreLine;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseOverflowValueCore(ref CssOverflow value, ref CssPropertyInheritance inheritance)
		{
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!ParseOverflowValueCore(ch, ref value) && !CheckInheritance(templateCore, currentIndexCore, ref inheritance))
			{
				ThrowInvalidValueException();
				return false;
			}
			return CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: false, out ch) == CssParsingResult.Closed;
		}

		private bool ParseOverflowValueCore(char ch, ref CssOverflow value)
		{
			int remainder = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'v':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckVisible(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					value = CssOverflow.Visible;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'h':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckHidden(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					value = CssOverflow.Hidden;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

					properties.SetTextOverflow(new CssProperty<CssTextOverflow>(value, res, currentWeightCore));
				}
			}
		}

			}

		private bool ParsePositionValueCore(char ch, ref CssPosition value)

				{
					currentIndexCore += 8;
					value = CssPosition.Absolute;
					return true;

				break;

				break;

				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseBackgroundPositionCore(ref CssProperty<CssBackgroundPosition> position)
		{
			char c = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
			int remainder = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			switch (char.ToLowerInvariant(c))
			{
			case 'l':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckLeft(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					position = new CssProperty<CssBackgroundPosition>(CssBackgroundPosition.Left, currentWeightCore);
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 't':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTop(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 3;
					position = new CssProperty<CssBackgroundPosition>(CssBackgroundPosition.Top, currentWeightCore);
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'r':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRight(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					position = new CssProperty<CssBackgroundPosition>(CssBackgroundPosition.Right, currentWeightCore);
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'b':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckBottom(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					position = new CssProperty<CssBackgroundPosition>(CssBackgroundPosition.Bottom, currentWeightCore);
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'c':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckCenter(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					position = new CssProperty<CssBackgroundPosition>(CssBackgroundPosition.Center, currentWeightCore);
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ParseBackgroundRepeatValueCore(char ch, ref CssBackgroundRepeat value)
		{
			int remainder = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'r':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRepeatX(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 8;
					value = CssBackgroundRepeat.RepeatX;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRepeatY(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 8;
					value = CssBackgroundRepeat.RepeatY;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRepeat(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					value = CssBackgroundRepeat.Repeat;
					return true;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRound(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					value = CssBackgroundRepeat.Round;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 's':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSpace(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					value = CssBackgroundRepeat.Space;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case 'n':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckNoRepeat(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 9;
					value = CssBackgroundRepeat.NoRepeat;
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void SetProperty(CssStyle style, string property, string value)
		{
			exceptionsCore.Clear();
			templateCore = property + ": " + value + ";";
			templateLengthCore = templateCore.Length;
			currentIndexCore = 0;
			currentWeightCore = int.MaxValue;
			ParsePropertiesCore(style, templateCore[0], templateLengthCore);
			Reset();
		}

		public void ParseStyle(string style, CssStyle cssStyle)
		{
			exceptionsCore.Clear();
			cssStyle.SetString(style);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(style))
			{
				templateCore = style;
				templateLengthCore = style.Length;
				currentWeightCore = 65536000;
				currentIndexCore = 0;
				ParseProperties(cssStyle);
				Reset();
			}
		}

		public CssStyleSheet Parse(string template)
		{
			exceptionsCore.Clear();
			templateCore = ((template == null) ? string.Empty : template);
			templateLengthCore = templateCore.Length;
			currentIndexCore = 0;
			styleSheetCore = new CssStyleSheet();
			ParseCore();
			Reset();
			return styleSheetCore;
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			selectorManager.Clear();
			templateCore = string.Empty;
			startIndexCore = (templateLengthCore = (currentIndexCore = 0));
			positionCore = 1;
		}

		protected void ParseCore()
		{
			while (currentIndexCore < templateLengthCore)
			{
				char c = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
				if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
				{
					break;
				}
				startIndexCore = currentIndexCore;
				switch (c)
				{
				case '#':
					ParseID();
					break;
				case '.':
					ParseClass();
					break;
				case ':':
					ParseSelector();
					break;
				default:
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsSymbol(c))
					{
						ParseTag(c);
					}
					else
					{
						SkipInvalidSelectorName(c);
					}
					break;
				}
				currentIndexCore++;
			}
			currentIndexCore = templateLengthCore;
			ThrowEmptySelectorException();
		}

		private char SkipCommentAndWhitespace(string text, ref int currentIndex, int length)
		{
			if (currentIndex >= length)
			{
				return '\0';
			}
			while (currentIndex < length)
			{
				DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(text, text[currentIndex], ref currentIndex, length);
				if (currentIndex >= length)
				{
					return '\0';
				}
				char c = text[currentIndex];
				if (c == '/' && currentIndex < length - 1)
				{
					switch (text[currentIndex + 1])
					{
					case '*':
						SkipUntil(text, currentIndex + 2, new char[2] { '*', '/' }, out currentIndex, length);
						break;
					case '/':
						SkipUntilEOL(text, currentIndex + 2, out currentIndex, length);
						break;
					default:
						return c;
					}
					continue;
				}
				return c;
			}
			if (currentIndex >= length)
			{
				return '\0';
			}
			return text[currentIndex];
		}

		private void SkipUntilEOL(string text, int startIndex, out int outIndex, int length)
		{
			while (startIndex < length)
			{
				if (text[startIndex] == '\r')
				{
					startIndex++;
					break;
				}
				if (text[startIndex] == '\n')
				{
					startIndex++;
					outIndex = startIndex;
					return;
				}
				startIndex++;
			}
			outIndex = startIndex;
			if (startIndex != length && text[startIndex] == '\n')
			{
				startIndex++;
				outIndex = startIndex;
			}
		}

		private void SkipUntil(string text, int startIndex, char[] stopChars, out int outIndex, int length)
		{
			for (int i = startIndex; i <= length - stopChars.Length; i++)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				for (int j = 0; j < stopChars.Length; j++)
				{
					if (text[i + j] != stopChars[j])
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					outIndex = i + stopChars.Length;
					return;
				}
			}
			outIndex = length;
		}

		private void ParseClass()
		{
			ParseClassCore(new CssClassSelector());
		}

		private void ParseClassCore(CssSelector selector)
		{
			int num = ++currentIndexCore;
			if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
			{
				ThrowInvalidSelectorNameException();
				return;
			}
			char ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
			if (!ValidateSelectorName(ref ch))
			{
				SkipInvalidSelectorName(ch);
			}
			else if (!ThrowMissingCurlyBracketsException(currentIndexCore))
			{
				ParsePseudoClass(ch, templateCore.Substring(num, currentIndexCore - num), selector);
			}
		}

		private void ParseID()
		{
			ParseClassCore(new CssIDSelector());
		}

		private void ParseSelector()
		{
			currentIndexCore++;
			if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
			{
				ThrowInvalidSelectorNameException();
				return;
			}
			switch (char.ToLowerInvariant(templateCore[currentIndexCore]))
			{
			case ':':
				ParsePseudoElement();
				break;
			case 'r':
				ParseRootPseudoClass();
				break;
			default:
				SkipInvalidSelectorName(templateCore[currentIndexCore]);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ParseRootPseudoClass()
		{
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRoot(templateCore, currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore))
			{
				currentIndexCore += "root".Length;
				if (!ThrowMissingCurlyBracketsException(currentIndexCore))
				{
					ParsePseudoClass(templateCore[currentIndexCore], ":root", new CssTagSelector());
				}
			}
		}

		private void ParsePseudoElement()
		{
			int num = currentIndexCore;
			while (templateCore[num] == ':')
			{
				if (++num == templateLengthCore)
				{
					ThrowInvalidSelectorNameException();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSelection(templateCore, num, templateLengthCore - num))
			{
				currentIndexCore--;
				if (!ThrowMissingCurlyBracketsException(currentIndexCore))
				{
					ParsePseudoClass(templateCore[currentIndexCore], "selection", new CssTagSelector());
				}
			}
		}

		private void ParseTag(char ch)
		{
			string tagName = string.Empty;
			DxHtmlParser.ParseTagCore(templateCore, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore, ref currentIndexCore, ref tagName);
			if (tagName != string.Empty)
			{
				if (!ThrowMissingCurlyBracketsException(currentIndexCore))
				{
					ParsePseudoClass(templateCore[currentIndexCore], tagName, new CssTagSelector());
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SkipInvalidSelectorName(ch);
			}
		}

		private void ParseProperties()
		{
			if (selectorManager.IsEmpty)
			{
				SkipStyleSet();
				return;
			}
			CssStyle style = selectorManager.GetStyle(styleSheetCore, ref currentWeightCore);
			currentIndexCore++;
			ParseProperties(style);
			selectorManager.ApplyStyle(styleSheetCore, style);
			currentWeightCore = 0;
		}

		private CssPseudoClass ParseCustomPseudoClass(CssSelector selector, out string customState)
		{
			customState = null;
			if (++currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
			{
				return CssPseudoClass.Unknown;
			}
			char c = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
			if (c != '-')
			{
				return CssPseudoClass.Unknown;
			}
			if (++currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
			{
				return CssPseudoClass.Unknown;
			}
			if (DxHtmlParser.CheckPCEN_Name("--", templateCore, templateLengthCore, hasHyphen: false, ref currentIndexCore, out customState))
			{
				return CssPseudoClass.Normal;
			}
			return CssPseudoClass.Unknown;
		}

		private void ParsePseudoClass(char ch, string selectorName, CssSelector selector)
		{
			selector.Name = selectorName;
			if (ch == ':')
			{
				if (++currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
				{
					ThrowInvalidSelectorNameException();
					return;
				}
				startIndexCore = currentIndexCore;
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				switch (ParsePseudoElement(ref ch, selector))
				{
				case CssParsingResult.Exception:
					return;
				case CssParsingResult.Continue:
				{
					CssPseudoClass cssPseudoClass = CssPseudoClass.Normal;
					string customState = null;
					cssPseudoClass = ((ch != '-') ? ParsePseudoClass(ch, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore) : ParseCustomPseudoClass(selector, out customState));
					if (cssPseudoClass == CssPseudoClass.Unknown && string.IsNullOrEmpty(customState))
					{
						SkipInvalidSelectorName(ch);
						return;
					}
					selector.PseudoClass = cssPseudoClass;
					selector.CustomState = customState;
					selector.Weight += 10;
					if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
					{
						ThrowMissingLeftCurlyBracketException();
						return;
					}
					ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
					if (ch == ':')
					{
						if (++currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
						{
							ThrowInvalidSelectorNameException();
							return;
						}
						ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
						switch (ParsePseudoElement(ref ch, selector))
						{
						case CssParsingResult.Exception:
							return;
						case CssParsingResult.Continue:
							SkipInvalidSelectorName(ch);
							return;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			int startIndex = currentIndexCore;
			ch = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
			if (!ThrowMissingCurlyBracketsException(currentIndexCore) && !ValidateSelectorSeparator(ch, selector))
			{
				ParseCombinator(ch, startIndex, selector);
			}
		}

		private CssParsingResult ParsePseudoElement(ref char ch, CssSelector selector)
		{
			if (ch == ':')
			{
				if (++currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
				{
					ThrowInvalidSelectorNameException();
					return CssParsingResult.Exception;
				}
				startIndexCore = currentIndexCore;
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				CssPseudoElement cssPseudoElement = ParsePseudoElement(ch, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore);
				if (cssPseudoElement == CssPseudoElement.None)
				{
					SkipInvalidSelectorName(ch);
					return CssParsingResult.Exception;
				}
				selector.PseudoElement = cssPseudoElement;
				selector.Weight++;
				if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
				{
					ThrowMissingLeftCurlyBracketException();
					return CssParsingResult.Exception;
				}
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				return CssParsingResult.Closed;
			}
			return CssParsingResult.Continue;
		}

		private void ParseCombinator(char ch, int startIndex, CssSelector selector)
		{
			switch (ch)
			{
			case '>':
				selectorManager.AddCombinator(selector, CssChildCombinator.Combinator);
				return;
			case '+':
				selectorManager.AddCombinator(selector, CssNextSiblingCombinator.Combinator);
				return;
			case '~':
				selectorManager.AddCombinator(selector, CssSubsequentSiblingCombinator.Combinator);
				return;
			}
			if (startIndex != currentIndexCore)
			{
				selectorManager.AddCombinator(selector, CssDescendantCombinator.Combinator);
				currentIndexCore--;
			}
			else
			{
				SkipInvalidSelectorName(ch);
			}
		}

		private bool ValidateSelectorSeparator(char ch, CssSelector selector)
		{
			switch (ch)
			{
			case '{':
				AddSelector(selector);
				positionCore++;
				ParseProperties();
				return true;
			case ',':
				AddSelector(selector);
				positionCore++;
				return true;
			case '}':
				selectorManager.Clear();
				ThrowMissingSelectorException(selector);
				ThrowMissingLeftCurlyBracketException();
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void AddSelector(CssSelector selector)
		{
			if (!ThrowMissingSelectorException(selector))
			{
				selectorManager.Add(selector, positionCore);
			}
		}

		private void SkipStyleSet()
		{
			selectorManager.Clear();
			DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.TextIndexOf(templateCore, '}', ref currentIndexCore);
		}

		private void SkipInvalidSelectorName(char ch)
		{
			if (ValidateSelectorSeparator(ch, null))
			{
				return;
			}
			while (++currentIndexCore < templateLengthCore)
			{
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				if (ValidateSelectorSeparator(ch, null))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			ThrowInvalidSelectorNameException();
		}

		private bool ValidateSelectorName(ref char ch)
		{
			if (!CheckSymbolInName(ch))
			{
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsNumber(ch))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ch != '-')
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (++currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				if (!CheckSymbolInName(ch))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (++currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
			}
			while (CheckAdvancedSymbolInName(ch) && ++currentIndexCore < templateLengthCore)
			{
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckSymbolInName(char ch)
		{
			if (!DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsSymbol(ch))
			{
				return ch == '_';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckAdvancedSymbolInName(char ch)
		{
			if (!CheckSymbolInName(ch) && !DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsNumber(ch))
			{
				return ch == '-';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private CssPseudoElement ParsePseudoElement(char ch, int remainder)
		{
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'm':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckMarker(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					return CssPseudoElement.Marker;
				}
				break;
			case 'b':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckBefore(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					return CssPseudoElement.Before;
				}
				break;
			case 'a':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckAfter(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					return CssPseudoElement.After;
				}
				break;
			case 's':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSelection(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += "selection".Length;
					return CssPseudoElement.Selection;
				}
				break;
			}
			return CssPseudoElement.None;
		}

		private CssPseudoClass ParsePseudoClass(char ch, int remainder)
		{
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(ch);
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'h':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckHover(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					return CssPseudoClass.Hover;
				}
				break;
			case 'f':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckFocus(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.Check_Within(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
					{
						currentIndexCore += 7;
						return CssPseudoClass.FocusWithin;
					}
					return CssPseudoClass.Focus;
				}
				break;
			case 'a':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckActive(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					return CssPseudoClass.Active;
				}
				break;
			case 's':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSelect(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					return CssPseudoClass.Select;
				}
				break;
			case 'd':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckDisabled(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 8;
					return CssPseudoClass.Disabled;
				}
				break;
			case 'v':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckVisited(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					return CssPseudoClass.Visited;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckValid(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					return CssPseudoClass.Valid;
				}
				break;
			case 'l':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckLink(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					return CssPseudoClass.Link;
				}
				break;
			case 'i':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckInvalid(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					return CssPseudoClass.Invalid;
				}
				break;
			case 'c':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckChecked(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					return CssPseudoClass.Checked;
				}
				break;
			}
			return CssPseudoClass.Unknown;
		}

		private void ParseProperties(CssStyle style)
		{
			while (currentIndexCore < templateLengthCore)
			{
				SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
				if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
				{
					ThrowMissingRightCurlyBracketException();
					return;
				}
				char c = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				if (c == '}')
				{
					return;
				}
				if (c == '.' && styleSheetCore != null)
				{
					ParseMixin(style);
				}
				else
				{
					ParsePropertiesCore(style, char.ToLowerInvariant(c), templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore);
				}
				if (currentIndexCore >= templateLengthCore)
				{
					ThrowMissingRightCurlyBracketException();
					return;
				}
				if (templateCore[currentIndexCore] == '}')
				{
					return;
				}
				currentIndexCore++;
			}
			ThrowMissingRightCurlyBracketException();
		}

		private void ParseMixin(CssStyle style)
		{
			startIndexCore = currentIndexCore;
			int num = ++currentIndexCore;
			if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
			{
				ThrowUnknownPropertyException();
				return;
			}
			char ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
			if (!ValidateSelectorName(ref ch))
			{
				ThrowInvalidValueException();
			}
			else if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: false, out ch) == CssParsingResult.Closed)
			{
				CssStyleSet classStyleSet = styleSheetCore.GetClassStyleSet(templateCore.Substring(num, currentIndexCore - num));
				if (classStyleSet != null && classStyleSet.Normal != null)
				{
					style.Assign(classStyleSet.Normal, currentWeightCore);
				}
			}
		}

					return;

				break;
			case 'd':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckDisplay(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					ParseDisplayValue(style.MainProperties);
					return;

				{

					return;
				}
				break;
			case 'f':

					return;

				break;
			case 'w':

					return;

		private bool CheckSubProperties(out char ch, bool allowFullProperty = false)
		{
			if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
			{
				ch = ' ';
				ThrowUnknownPropertyException();
				return false;
			}
			ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
			if (ch != '-')
			{
				if (!allowFullProperty)
				{
					ThrowUnknownPropertyException();
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (++currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
			{
				ThrowUnknownPropertyException();
				return false;
			}
			ch = char.ToLowerInvariant(templateCore[currentIndexCore]);
			return true;
		}

		private void ParseBackgroundProperty(CssStyle style)
		{
			currentIndexCore += 10;
			if (!CheckSubProperties(out var ch))
			{
				return;
			}
			int remainder = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'c':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckColor(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					ParseBackgroundColorValue(style.MainProperties);
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 'i':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckImage(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					ParseBackgroundImageValue(style);
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 'p':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckPosition(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 8;
					ParseBackgroundPositionValue(style);
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 's':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSize(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					ParseBackgroundSizeValue(style);
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 'r':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRepeat(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					ParseBackgroundRepeatValue(style);
					return;
				}
				break;
			}
			ThrowUnknownPropertyException();
		}

		private void ParseBoxShadowProperties(CssStyle style)
		{
			currentIndexCore += 10;
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return;
			}
			CssPropertyInheritance res = CssPropertyInheritance.None;
			if (CheckInheritance(templateCore, currentIndexCore, ref res))
			{
				if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: false, out ch) == CssParsingResult.Closed)
				{
					style.BoxShadow.SetInset(new CssProperty<bool>(value: false, res, currentWeightCore));
					style.BoxShadow.SetColor(new CssColor(res, currentWeightCore));
					style.BoxShadow.SetOffsetX(new CssUnit(res, currentWeightCore));
					style.BoxShadow.SetOffsetY(new CssUnit(res, currentWeightCore));
					style.BoxShadow.SetBlurRadius(new CssUnit(res, currentWeightCore));
					style.BoxShadow.SetSpreadDistance(new CssUnit(res, currentWeightCore));
				}
				return;
			}
			int startIndex = currentIndexCore;
			CssProperty<bool> cssProperty = null;
			CssUnit[] array = new CssUnit[4];
			CssColor res2 = null;
			int num = -1;
			bool flag = false;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag2 = false;
			while (!flag)
			{
				int remainder = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				if (num2 > 6)
				{
					ThrowInvalidValueException(currentIndexCore);
					return;
				}
				if (!DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.IsNumber(ch) && ch != '-')
				{
					if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckInset(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
					{
						currentIndexCore += 5;
						if (cssProperty != null)
						{
							ThrowInvalidValueException(currentIndexCore);
							return;
						}
						cssProperty = new CssProperty<bool>(value: true, res, currentWeightCore);
						char ch2;
						switch (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: true, out ch2))
						{
						case CssParsingResult.Exception:
							return;
						case CssParsingResult.Closed:
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						num2++;
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (res2 != null)
						{
							ThrowInvalidValueException(currentIndexCore);
							return;
						}
						switch (ParseColorValueCore(ch, ref res2, isNotLastValue: true))
						{
						case CssParsingResult.Exception:
							return;
						case CssParsingResult.Closed:
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						num2++;
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					CssUnit value = null;
					CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = TryParseUnitValueCore(ch, ref value, isNotLastValue: true);
					if (cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Exception)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (flag2 || num >= array.Length - 1 || (num == 1 && value != null && value.Value < 0f))
					{
						ThrowInvalidValueException(currentIndexCore);
						return;
					}
					array[++num] = value;
					if (cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Closed)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					num2++;
				}
			}
			if (num < 1)
			{
				ThrowMissingValueException(startIndex);
				return;
			}
			if (cssProperty != null)
			{
				style.BoxShadow.SetInset(cssProperty);
			}
			if (res2 != null)
			{
				style.BoxShadow.SetColor(res2);
			}
			if (array[0] != null)
			{
				style.BoxShadow.SetOffsetX(array[0]);
			}
			if (array[1] != null)
			{
				style.BoxShadow.SetOffsetY(array[1]);
			}
			if (array[2] != null)
			{
				style.BoxShadow.SetBlurRadius(array[2]);
			}
			if (array[3] != null)
			{
				style.BoxShadow.SetSpreadDistance(array[3]);
			}
		}

		private void ParseBorderProperties(CssStyle style)
		{
			currentIndexCore += 6;
			if (!CheckSubProperties(out var ch, allowFullProperty: true))
			{
				ParseBorderValues(style);
				return;
			}
			int remainder = templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore;
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 't':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckTop(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 3;
					if (!CheckSubProperties(out ch, allowFullProperty: true))
					{
						ParseBorderValues(style.TopBorder);
					}
					else
					{
						ParseTopBorderProperties(ch, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore, style);
					}
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 'r':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRight(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					if (!CheckSubProperties(out ch, allowFullProperty: true))
					{
						ParseBorderValues(style.RightBorder);
					}
					else
					{
						ParseBorderProperties(ch, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore, style.RightBorder);
					}
					return;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckRadius(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					ParseBorderAllRadius(style);
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 'l':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckLeft(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 4;
					if (!CheckSubProperties(out ch, allowFullProperty: true))
					{
						ParseBorderValues(style.LeftBorder);
					}
					else
					{
						ParseBorderProperties(ch, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore, style.LeftBorder);
					}
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 'b':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckBottom(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 6;
					if (!CheckSubProperties(out ch, allowFullProperty: true))
					{
						ParseBorderValues(style.BottomBorder);
					}
					else
					{
						ParseBottomBorderProperties(ch, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore, style);
					}
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 'c':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckColor(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					ParseBorderAllColor(style);
					return;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckCollapse(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 8;
					ParseBorderCollapseValue(style.AutoInheritedProperties);
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 's':
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckStyle(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 5;
					ParseBorderAllStyle(style);
					return;
				}
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckSpacing(templateCore, currentIndexCore, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					ParseSpacingValue(style.AutoInheritedProperties);
					return;
				}
				break;
			case 'w':

		private bool CheckEndSymbolsOfValue(char ch)
		{
			if (ch != ';')
			{
				return ch == '}';
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool FindStartSymbolOfValue(out char ch)
		{
			ch = ' ';
			if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
			{
				ThrowMissingColonException(currentIndexCore);
				return false;
			}
			int num = currentIndexCore;
			ch = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
			if (ch != ':')
			{
				if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore || currentIndexCore != num)
				{
					ThrowMissingColonException(num);
					return false;
				}
				ThrowUnknownPropertyException();
				return false;
			}
			currentIndexCore++;
			ch = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
			if (currentIndexCore >= templateLengthCore)
			{
				ThrowMissingValueException(currentIndexCore);
				return false;
			}
			startIndexCore = currentIndexCore;
			return true;
		}

		private CssParsingResult FindEndSymbolsOfValueWithWhiteSpace(ref int endIndex, bool isNotLastValue)
		{
			while (currentIndexCore < templateLengthCore)
			{
				char c = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				if (CheckEndSymbolsOfValue(c))
				{
					endIndex = currentIndexCore;
					return CssParsingResult.Closed;
				}
				if (char.IsWhiteSpace(c))
				{
					endIndex = currentIndexCore;
					currentIndexCore++;
					if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
					{
						return CssParsingResult.Closed;
					}
					c = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
					if (CheckEndSymbolsOfValue(c))
					{
						return CssParsingResult.Closed;
					}
					if (isNotLastValue)
					{
						return CssParsingResult.Continue;
					}
					if (currentIndexCore >= templateLengthCore)
					{
						return CssParsingResult.Closed;
					}
					ThrowInvalidValueException();
					return CssParsingResult.Exception;
				}
				currentIndexCore++;
			}
			endIndex = currentIndexCore;
			return CssParsingResult.Closed;
		}

		private CssParsingResult FindEndSymbolsOfValueWithSeparator(ref int endIndex, char separator, bool isNotLastValue = false)
		{
			while (currentIndexCore < templateLengthCore)
			{
				char c = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				if (c == separator)
				{
					endIndex = currentIndexCore;
					return CssParsingResult.Continue;
				}
				if (CheckEndSymbolsOfValue(c))
				{
					endIndex = currentIndexCore;
					return CssParsingResult.Closed;
				}
				if (char.IsWhiteSpace(c))
				{
					endIndex = currentIndexCore;
					currentIndexCore++;
					if (currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)
					{
						return CssParsingResult.Closed;
					}
					c = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
					if (CheckEndSymbolsOfValue(c))
					{
						return CssParsingResult.Closed;
					}
					if (c == separator || isNotLastValue)
					{
						return CssParsingResult.Continue;
					}
					if (currentIndexCore >= templateLengthCore)
					{
						return CssParsingResult.Closed;
					}
					ThrowInvalidValueException();
					return CssParsingResult.Exception;
				}
				currentIndexCore++;
			}
			endIndex = currentIndexCore;
			return CssParsingResult.Closed;
		}

		private CssParsingResult CheckPropertyIsClosed(bool isNotLastValue, out char ch)
		{
			ch = ' ';
			if (currentIndexCore < templateLengthCore)
			{
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				if (CheckEndSymbolsOfValue(ch))
				{
					return CssParsingResult.Closed;
				}
				int num = currentIndexCore;
				ch = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
				if (num == currentIndexCore)
				{
					if (isNotLastValue)
					{
						return CssParsingResult.Continue;
					}
					ThrowInvalidValueException();
					return CssParsingResult.Exception;
				}
				if (CheckEndSymbolsOfValue(ch))
				{
					return CssParsingResult.Closed;
				}
				if (isNotLastValue)
				{
					return CssParsingResult.Continue;
				}
				if (currentIndexCore < templateLengthCore)
				{
					ThrowInvalidValueException();
					return CssParsingResult.Exception;
				}
			}
			return CssParsingResult.Closed;
		}

		private bool CheckSeparation(char separator)
		{
			char c = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
			if (c != separator)
			{
				c = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
				if (c != separator)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return ++currentIndexCore < templateLengthCore;
		}

		private bool CheckUnitAuto(char ch)
		{
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.EqualChars(ch, 'a') && DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckAuto(templateCore, currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore))
			{
				currentIndexCore += 4;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckUnitCover(char ch)
		{
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.EqualChars(ch, 'c') && DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckObjectFitCover(templateCore, currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore))
			{
				currentIndexCore += 5;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckUnitContain(char ch)
		{
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.EqualChars(ch, 'c') && DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckObjectFitContain(templateCore, currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore))
			{
				currentIndexCore += 7;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CheckInheritance(string value, int index, ref CssPropertyInheritance res)
		{
			if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.EqualChars(value[index], 'i'))
			{
				int remainder = value.Length - index;
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckInherit(value, index, remainder))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 7;
					res = CssPropertyInheritance.Inherit;
					return true;
				}

		private bool ParseFontFamilyValueCore(char ch, ref string familyProperty)

				{

				}
				if (++currentIndexCore == templateLengthCore)

			if (TryParseUnitValueCore(ch, ref value, CssUnitAuto.Length, isNotLastValue: false, allowNumber: false, null, allowUnit, allowIntegerOnly) == CssParsingResult.Closed)

		private bool ParseTextDecorationValuesCore(ref CssColor color, ref CssProperty<CssTextDecorationStyle> decorationStyle, ref CssProperty<CssTextDecorationLine> decorationLine)
		{
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return false;
			}
			CssPropertyInheritance res = CssPropertyInheritance.None;
			if (CheckInheritance(templateCore, currentIndexCore, ref res))
			{
				if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: false, out ch) == CssParsingResult.Closed)
				{
					decorationStyle = new CssProperty<CssTextDecorationStyle>(CssTextDecorationStyle.Solid, res, currentWeightCore);
					color = new CssColor(System.Drawing.Color.Black, res, currentWeightCore);
					decorationLine = new CssProperty<CssTextDecorationLine>(CssTextDecorationLine.None, res, currentWeightCore);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			int num = 3;
			while (num > 0)
			{
				CssTextDecorationLine value = CssTextDecorationLine.None;
				if (decorationLine == null && ParseTextDecorationLineValueCore(ch, ref value))
				{
					CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: true, out ch);
					if (cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Exception)
					{
						return false;
					}
					decorationLine = new CssProperty<CssTextDecorationLine>(value, currentWeightCore);
					if (cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Closed)
					{
						return true;
					}
					num--;
					continue;
				}
				CssTextDecorationStyle value2 = CssTextDecorationStyle.Solid;
				if (decorationStyle == null && ParseTextDecorationStyleValueCore(ch, ref value2))
				{
					CssParsingResult cssParsingResult2 = CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: true, out ch);
					if (cssParsingResult2 == CssParsingResult.Exception)
					{
						return false;
					}
					decorationStyle = new CssProperty<CssTextDecorationStyle>(value2, currentWeightCore);
					if (cssParsingResult2 == CssParsingResult.Closed)
					{
						return true;
					}
					num--;
					continue;
				}
				if (color == null)
				{
					switch (ParseColorValueCore(ch, ref color, isNotLastValue: true))
					{
					case CssParsingResult.Exception:
						return false;
					case CssParsingResult.Closed:
						return true;
					}
					ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
					num--;
					continue;
				}
				ThrowInvalidValueException();
				return false;
			}
			ThrowInvalidValueException();
			return false;
		}

		private void ParseBackgroundImageValue(CssStyle style)
		{
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			CssBackgroundImagePropertiesCollection backgroundImages = style.BackgroundImages;
			while (!CheckEndSymbolsOfValue(ch))
			{
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckUrl(templateCore, currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore - currentIndexCore))
				{
					currentIndexCore += 3;
					string uri;
					CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = ParseUrlValue(out uri, ref ch);
					if (cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Exception)
					{
						ThrowInvalidValueException(currentIndexCore);
					}
					CssBackgroundImageProperties orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties = GetOrCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties(style, num++);
					orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetImagePath(new CssProperty<string>(uri, currentWeightCore));
				}
				else
				{
					SkipInvalidSelectorName(ch);
				}
				if (ch == ',')
				{
					currentIndexCore++;
					ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				}
				if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: true, out ch) == CssParsingResult.Closed)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ParseBackgroundPositionValue(CssStyle style)
