			{
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				CssProperty<CssBackgroundPosition> position = PropertyDefaultValues.CssBackgroundPositionHorz;
				CssProperty<CssBackgroundPosition> position2 = PropertyDefaultValues.CssBackgroundPositionVert;
				CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> cssUnit = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(0f, CssUnitValueType.Percentage, position.Value, currentWeightCore);
				CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> cssUnit2 = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(0f, CssUnitValueType.Percentage, position2.Value, currentWeightCore);
				if (ParseBackgroundPositionCore(ref position))
				{
					cssUnit = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(position.Value, currentWeightCore);
					if (templateCore[currentIndexCore] == ',')
					{
						cssUnit2 = ((cssUnit.UnitType != CssBackgroundPosition.Center) ? new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(CssBackgroundPosition.Center, currentWeightCore) : cssUnit);
					}
					else
					{
						DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(templateCore, templateCore[currentIndexCore], ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
						if (ParseBackgroundPositionCore(ref position2))
						{
							cssUnit2 = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(position2.Value, currentWeightCore);
							DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(templateCore, templateCore[currentIndexCore], ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
							TryParseBackgroundPositionValue(ref cssUnit2, isNotLastValue: true);
						}
						else
						{
							if (position.Value != CssBackgroundPosition.Center)
							{
								TryParseBackgroundPositionValue(ref cssUnit, isNotLastValue: true);
							}
							DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(templateCore, templateCore[currentIndexCore], ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
							if (ParseBackgroundPositionCore(ref position2))
							{
								DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(templateCore, templateCore[currentIndexCore], ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
								cssUnit2 = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(position2.Value, currentWeightCore);
								TryParseBackgroundPositionValue(ref cssUnit2, isNotLastValue: true, allowNumber: false, ',');
							}
							else
							{
								cssUnit2 = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(CssBackgroundPosition.Center, currentWeightCore);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					cssUnit = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(position.Value, currentWeightCore);
					CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = TryParseBackgroundPositionValue(ref cssUnit, isNotLastValue: true, allowNumber: false, ',');
					if (ParseBackgroundPositionCore(ref position2))
					{
						DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(templateCore, templateCore[currentIndexCore], ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
					}
					cssUnit2 = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(position2.Value, currentWeightCore);
					if (templateCore[currentIndexCore] != ',' && CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: true, out ch) != CssParsingResult.Closed)
					{
						if (TryParseBackgroundPositionValue(ref cssUnit2, isNotLastValue: true, allowNumber: false, ',') == CssParsingResult.Exception)
						{
							cssUnit2 = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(0f, CssUnitValueType.Percentage, CssBackgroundPosition.Top, currentWeightCore);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						cssUnit2 = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(CssBackgroundPosition.Center, currentWeightCore);
					}
				}
				CssBackgroundImageProperties orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties = GetOrCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties(style, style.BackgroundImages.PositionCount++);
				if (cssUnit.UnitType == CssBackgroundPosition.Bottom || cssUnit.UnitType == CssBackgroundPosition.Top || cssUnit2.UnitType == CssBackgroundPosition.Left || cssUnit2.UnitType == CssBackgroundPosition.Right)
				{
					orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetPositionHorz(cssUnit2);
					orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetPositionVert(cssUnit);
				}
				else
				{
					orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetPositionHorz(cssUnit);
					orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetPositionVert(cssUnit2);
				}
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				if (ch == ',')
				{
					currentIndexCore++;
				}
				DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.SkipWhiteSpace(templateCore, templateCore[currentIndexCore], ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
				if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: true, out ch) == CssParsingResult.Closed)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private CssParsingResult TryParseBackgroundPositionValue(ref CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> value, bool isNotLastValue = false, bool allowNumber = false, char? separator = null)
		{
			char ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
			CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = TryParseUnitValueCore(ch, ref value, value.UnitType, isNotLastValue, allowNumber, separator);
			if (cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Exception)
			{
				ThrowInvalidValueException(currentIndexCore);
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			return CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue, out ch);
		}

		private void ParseBackgroundSizeValue(CssStyle style)
		{
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return;
			}
			CssBackgroundImagePropertiesCollection backgroundImages = style.BackgroundImages;
			while (!CheckEndSymbolsOfValue(ch))
			{
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				CssBackgroundImageProperties orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties = GetOrCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties(style, style.BackgroundImages.SizeCount++);
				CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize> value = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundSizeWidth;
				CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = TryParseBackgroundSizeValue(ch, ref value, isNotLastValue: true, allowNumber: false, ',');
				if (cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Exception)
				{
					ThrowInvalidValueException(currentIndexCore);
				}
				orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetWidth(new CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize>(value, currentWeightCore));
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				if (ch == ',')
				{
					orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.CheckSize();
					currentIndexCore++;
					ch = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
					continue;
				}
				if (cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Closed)
				{
					orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.CheckSize();
					break;
				}
				value = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundSizeHeight;
				cssParsingResult = TryParseBackgroundSizeValue(ch, ref value, isNotLastValue: true, allowNumber: false, ',');
				if (cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Exception)
				{
					ThrowInvalidValueException(currentIndexCore);
				}
				orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetHeight(new CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize>(value, currentWeightCore));
				orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.CheckSize();
				ch = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
				if (ch == ',')
				{
					currentIndexCore++;
					ch = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
				}
				if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: true, out ch) != CssParsingResult.Closed)
				{
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private CssParsingResult TryParseBackgroundSizeValue(char ch, ref CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize> value, bool isNotLastValue = false, bool allowNumber = false, char? separator = null)
		{
			CssPropertyInheritance res = CssPropertyInheritance.None;
			if (CheckInheritance(templateCore, currentIndexCore, ref res))
			{
				CssParsingResult cssParsingResult = CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: false, out ch);
				if (cssParsingResult == CssParsingResult.Closed)
				{
					value = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize>(0f, CssUnitValueType.Px, CssBackgroundSize.Length, res, currentWeightCore);
				}
				return cssParsingResult;
			}
			switch (ch)
			{
			case 'a':
				if (CheckUnitAuto(ch))
				{
					value = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize>(0f, CssUnitValueType.Px, CssBackgroundSize.Auto, CssPropertyInheritance.None, currentWeightCore);
				}
				else
				{
					SkipInvalidSelectorName(ch);
				}
				break;
			case 'c':
				if (CheckUnitContain(ch))
				{
					value = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize>(0f, CssUnitValueType.Px, CssBackgroundSize.Contain, CssPropertyInheritance.None, currentWeightCore);
				}
				else if (CheckUnitCover(ch))
				{
					value = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize>(0f, CssUnitValueType.Px, CssBackgroundSize.Cover, CssPropertyInheritance.None, currentWeightCore);
				}
				else
				{
					SkipInvalidSelectorName(ch);
				}
				break;
			default:
				return TryParseUnitValueCore(ch, ref value, CssBackgroundSize.Length, isNotLastValue, allowNumber, separator);
			}
			return CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue, out ch);
		}

		private void ParseBackgroundRepeatValue(CssStyle style)
		{
			if (!FindStartSymbolOfValue(out var ch))
			{
				return;
			}
			CssBackgroundImagePropertiesCollection backgroundImages = style.BackgroundImages;
			while (!CheckEndSymbolsOfValue(ch))
			{
				ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				CssBackgroundRepeat value = CssBackgroundRepeat.NoRepeat;
				CssPropertyInheritance res = CssPropertyInheritance.None;
				if (!ParseBackgroundRepeatValueCore(ch, ref value) && !CheckInheritance(templateCore, currentIndexCore, ref res))
				{
					ThrowInvalidValueException();
					break;
				}
				CssBackgroundImageProperties orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties = GetOrCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties(style, style.BackgroundImages.RepeatCount++);
				orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetRepeatHorz(new CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat>(value, currentWeightCore));
				ch = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
				if (ch == ',' || ch == ';')
				{
					switch (value)
					{
					case CssBackgroundRepeat.RepeatX:
						orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetRepeatVert(new CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat>(CssBackgroundRepeat.NoRepeat, currentWeightCore));
						break;
					case CssBackgroundRepeat.RepeatY:
						orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetRepeatHorz(new CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat>(CssBackgroundRepeat.NoRepeat, currentWeightCore));
						break;
					default:
						orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetRepeatVert(new CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat>(value, currentWeightCore));
						break;
					}
					if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: true, out ch) == CssParsingResult.Closed)
					{
						break;
					}
					currentIndexCore++;
					ch = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
					continue;
				}
				value = CssBackgroundRepeat.NoRepeat;
				res = CssPropertyInheritance.None;
				if (!ParseBackgroundRepeatValueCore(ch, ref value) && !CheckInheritance(templateCore, currentIndexCore, ref res))
				{
					ThrowInvalidValueException();
					break;
				}
				orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetRepeatVert(new CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat>(value, currentWeightCore));
				if (orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.RepeatHorz.Value == CssBackgroundRepeat.NoRepeat && orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.RepeatVert.Value == CssBackgroundRepeat.Repeat)
				{
					orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetRepeatVert(new CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat>(CssBackgroundRepeat.RepeatY, currentWeightCore));
				}
				if (orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.RepeatVert.Value == CssBackgroundRepeat.NoRepeat && orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.RepeatHorz.Value == CssBackgroundRepeat.Repeat)
				{
					orCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties.SetRepeatHorz(new CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat>(CssBackgroundRepeat.RepeatX, currentWeightCore));
				}
				ch = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
				if (ch == ',')
				{
					currentIndexCore++;
					ch = SkipCommentAndWhitespace(templateCore, ref currentIndexCore, templateLengthCore);
				}
				if (CheckPropertyIsClosed(isNotLastValue: true, out ch) != CssParsingResult.Closed)
				{
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private CssBackgroundImageProperties GetOrCreateCssBackgroundImageProperties(CssStyle style, int index)
		{
			if (index < style.BackgroundImages.Count)
			{
				return style.BackgroundImages[index];
			}
			CssBackgroundImageProperties cssBackgroundImageProperties = new CssBackgroundImageProperties(style);
			style.BackgroundImages.Add(cssBackgroundImageProperties);
			return cssBackgroundImageProperties;
		}

		private void SkipProperty()
		{
			while (currentIndexCore < templateLengthCore)
			{
				char ch = templateCore[currentIndexCore];
				if (CheckEndSymbolsOfValue(ch))
				{
					break;
				}
				currentIndexCore++;
			}
		}

		private void ThrowMissingColonException(int startIndex)
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.MissingColon, startIndex, 1, DxHtmlParser.ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
			SkipProperty();
		}

		private void ThrowUnknownPropertyException()
		{
			SkipProperty();
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.UnknownCssProperty, startIndexCore, currentIndexCore - startIndexCore - 1, DxHtmlParser.ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private void ThrowMissingValueException(int startIndex)
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.MissingPropertyValue, startIndex, 1, DxHtmlParser.ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private void ThrowInvalidValueException()
		{
			SkipProperty();
			ThrowInvalidValueException(startIndexCore);
		}

		private void ThrowInvalidValueException(int index)
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.InvalidValue, index, currentIndexCore - index, DxHtmlParser.ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private void ThrowMissingQuotesException(int startIndex)
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.MissingQuotes, startIndex, 1, DxHtmlParser.ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private void ThrowEmptySelectorException()
		{
			if (selectorManager.HasCombinators)
			{
				ThrowMissingSelectorException();
			}
			if (!selectorManager.IsEmpty)
			{
				ThrowMissingCurlyBracketsException();
			}
		}

		private bool ThrowMissingSelectorException(CssSelector selector)
		{
			if (selector != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (currentIndexCore - startIndexCore == 0)
			{
				ThrowMissingSelectorException();
			}
			else
			{
				ThrowInvalidSelectorNameException();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void ThrowMissingSelectorException()
		{
			selectorManager.ClearCombinators();
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.MissingSelector, currentIndexCore, 1, DxHtmlParser.ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private void ThrowInvalidSelectorNameException()
		{
			selectorManager.ClearCombinators();
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.InvalidSelectorName, startIndexCore, currentIndexCore - startIndexCore, DxHtmlParser.ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private void ThrowMissingLeftCurlyBracketException()
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.MissingLeftCurlyBracket, currentIndexCore, 1, DxHtmlParser.ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private bool ThrowMissingCurlyBracketsException(int index)
		{
			if (index == templateLengthCore)
			{
				ThrowMissingCurlyBracketsException();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ThrowMissingCurlyBracketsException()
		{
			selectorManager.Clear();
			ThrowMissingLeftCurlyBracketException();
			ThrowMissingRightCurlyBracketException();
		}

		private void ThrowMissingRightCurlyBracketException()
		{
			ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType.MissingRightCurlyBracket, currentIndexCore, 1, DxHtmlParser.ValidationLevel == HtmlValidationLevel.Higth);
		}

		private void ThrowCriticalException(HtmlExceptionType exception, int startIndex)
		{
			ThrowException(exception, startIndex, templateLengthCore, DxHtmlParser.ValidationLevel != HtmlValidationLevel.Low);
			currentIndexCore = templateLengthCore;
		}

		private void ThrowException(HtmlExceptionType exception, int index, int length, bool @throw)
		{
			if (@throw)
			{
				throw new Exception(exception.ToString());
			}
			exceptionsCore.Add(new DxHtmlException(index, length, exception));
		}
	}
	public class CssStyleSheet
	{
		private static CssStyleSheet defaultStyleSheetCore = new CssStyleSheet(isDefault: true);

		private bool isDefaultCore;

		private Dictionary<string, CssStyleSet> classesCore = new Dictionary<string, CssStyleSet>();

		private Dictionary<string, CssStyleSet> idsCore = new Dictionary<string, CssStyleSet>();

		private Dictionary<string, CssStyleSet> tagsCore = new Dictionary<string, CssStyleSet>();

		public static CssStyleSheet Default => defaultStyleSheetCore;

		public int ClassesCount => classesCore.Count;

		public int IDsCount => idsCore.Count;

		public int TagsCount => tagsCore.Count;

		private CssStyleSheet(bool isDefault)
		{
			isDefaultCore = isDefault;
		}

		public CssStyleSheet()
			: this(isDefault: false)
		{
		}

		internal CssStyleSet GetOrCreateClassStyleSet(string name)
		{
			return GetOrCreateStyleSet(name, classesCore);
		}

		internal CssStyleSet GetOrCreateIdStyleSet(string name)
		{
			return GetOrCreateStyleSet(name, idsCore);
		}

		internal CssStyleSet GetOrCreateTagStyleSet(string name)
		{
			return GetOrCreateStyleSet(name, tagsCore);
		}

		private CssStyleSet GetOrCreateStyleSet(string name, Dictionary<string, CssStyleSet> stylesSet)
		{
			if (!stylesSet.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				value = new CssStyleSet();
				stylesSet.Add(name, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public CssStyleSet GetClassStyleSet(string name)
		{
			classesCore.TryGetValue(name, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public CssStyleSet GetIDStyleSet(string id)
		{
			idsCore.TryGetValue(id, out var value);
			return value;
		}

		public CssStyleSet GetTagStyleSet(string tagName)
		{
			tagsCore.TryGetValue(tagName, out var value);
			return value;
		}
	}
	public sealed class CssStyleSet
	{
		private CssStyle normalCore;

		private CssStyle hoverCore;

		private CssStyle activeCore;

		private CssStyle focusCore;

		private CssStyle linkCore;

		private CssStyle visitedCore;

		private CssStyle disabledCore;

		private CssStyle selectCore;

		private CssStyle focusWithinCore;

		private CssStyle invalidCore;

		private CssStyle validCore;

		private CssStyle checkedCore;

		private Dictionary<string, CssStyle> customStatesCore;

		internal DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssCombinatorStyleSet> CombinatorStyleSetCollection;

		public CssStyle Normal => normalCore;

		public CssStyle Hover => hoverCore;

		public CssStyle Active => activeCore;

		public CssStyle Focus => focusCore;

		public CssStyle Select => selectCore;

		public CssStyle Link => linkCore;

		public CssStyle Visited => visitedCore;

		public CssStyle Disabled => disabledCore;

		public CssStyle Invalid => invalidCore;

		public CssStyle FocusWithin => focusWithinCore;

		public CssStyle Valid => validCore;

		public CssStyle Checked => checkedCore;

		public bool HasCustomStates()
		{
			if (customStatesCore != null)
			{
				return customStatesCore.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool TryCustomState(string state, out CssStyle style)
		{
			style = null;
			if (customStatesCore == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return customStatesCore.TryGetValue(state, out style);
		}

		internal void CheckNormalStyle()
		{
			GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref normalCore);
		}

		internal void CheckLinkStyle()
		{
			CheckNormalStyle();
			GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref linkCore);
			GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref visitedCore);
		}

		internal CssCombinatorStyleSet GetOrCreateCombinatorStyle(CssCombinatorsSelectorBase selector)
		{
			if (CombinatorStyleSetCollection == null)
			{
				CombinatorStyleSetCollection = new DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssCombinatorStyleSet>();
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < CombinatorStyleSetCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					CssCombinatorStyleSet cssCombinatorStyleSet = CombinatorStyleSetCollection[i];
					if (cssCombinatorStyleSet.Equals(selector))
					{
						return cssCombinatorStyleSet;
					}
				}
			}
			CssCombinatorStyleSet cssCombinatorStyleSet2 = new CssCombinatorStyleSet(new CssStyleSet(), selector);
			CombinatorStyleSetCollection.Add(cssCombinatorStyleSet2);
			return cssCombinatorStyleSet2;
		}

		internal CssStyle GetOrCreateStyle(string customState)
		{
			if (customStatesCore == null)
			{
				customStatesCore = new Dictionary<string, CssStyle>();
			}
			if (!customStatesCore.TryGetValue(customState, out var value))
			{
				value = new CssStyle();
				customStatesCore.Add(customState, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal CssStyle GetOrCreateStyle(CssPseudoClass state)
		{
			return state switch
			{
				CssPseudoClass.Normal => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref normalCore), 
				CssPseudoClass.Hover => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref hoverCore), 
				CssPseudoClass.Active => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref activeCore), 
				CssPseudoClass.Focus => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref focusCore), 
				CssPseudoClass.Select => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref selectCore), 
				CssPseudoClass.Link => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref linkCore), 
				CssPseudoClass.Visited => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref visitedCore), 
				CssPseudoClass.Disabled => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref disabledCore), 
				CssPseudoClass.FocusWithin => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref focusWithinCore), 
				CssPseudoClass.Checked => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref checkedCore), 
				CssPseudoClass.Invalid => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref invalidCore), 
				CssPseudoClass.Valid => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref validCore), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private CssStyle GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref CssStyle style)
		{
			if (style == null)
			{
				style = new CssStyle();
			}
			return style;
		}

		internal void Apply(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator element)
		{
			if (CombinatorStyleSetCollection != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < CombinatorStyleSetCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					CombinatorStyleSetCollection[i].Apply(element);
				}
			}
			element.StyleSet.Merge(this);
		}

		public void Merge(CssStyleSet styleSet)
		{
			if (styleSet == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			MergeStyle(ref normalCore, styleSet.normalCore);
			MergeStyle(ref hoverCore, styleSet.hoverCore);
			MergeStyle(ref activeCore, styleSet.activeCore);
			MergeStyle(ref focusCore, styleSet.focusCore);
			MergeStyle(ref linkCore, styleSet.linkCore);
			MergeStyle(ref visitedCore, styleSet.visitedCore);
			MergeStyle(ref disabledCore, styleSet.disabledCore);
			MergeStyle(ref selectCore, styleSet.selectCore);
			MergeStyle(ref invalidCore, styleSet.invalidCore);
			MergeStyle(ref validCore, styleSet.validCore);
			MergeStyle(ref checkedCore, styleSet.checkedCore);
			MergeStyle(ref focusWithinCore, styleSet.focusWithinCore);
			if (!styleSet.HasCustomStates())
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CssStyle> item in styleSet.customStatesCore)
			{
				CssStyle dest = GetOrCreateStyle(item.Key);
				MergeStyle(ref dest, item.Value);
			}
		}

		internal static void MergeStyle(ref CssStyle dest, CssStyle source)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				if (dest == null)
				{
					dest = source.Clone();
				}
				else
				{
					dest.Merge(source);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CssCombinatorStyleSet
	{
		public readonly CssStyleSet StyleSet;

		public readonly CssCombinatorsSelectorBase Selector;

		internal CssCombinatorStyleSet(CssStyleSet styleSet, CssCombinatorsSelectorBase selector)
		{
			StyleSet = styleSet;
			Selector = selector;
		}

		internal bool Equals(CssCombinatorsSelectorBase selector)
		{
			return Selector.Equals(selector);
		}

		public void Apply(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator element)
		{
			Selector.Apply(element, StyleSet);
		}
	}
	public class CssStyle
	{
		private DxHtmlElement ownerCore;

		private string styleCore;

		private CssStyle markerCore;

		private CssStyle beforeCore;

		private CssStyle afterCore;

		internal T GetValueOrDefault<T>(CssProperty<T> property, DxHtmlAttribute<T> attribute)
		{
			if (property.IsSpecified)
			{
				return property.Value;
			}
			if (!attribute.IsDefault)
			{
				return attribute.Value;
			}
			return property.Value;
		}

		internal System.Drawing.FontStyle GetFontStyle()
		{
			System.Drawing.FontStyle fontStyle = System.Drawing.FontStyle.Regular;
			if (FontWeight == CssFontWeight.Bold || FontWeight == CssFontWeight.Bolder)
			{
				fontStyle |= System.Drawing.FontStyle.Bold;
			}
			if (FontStyle == CssFontStyle.Italic)
			{
				fontStyle |= System.Drawing.FontStyle.Italic;
			}
			if (TextDecorationLine == CssTextDecorationLine.LineThrough)
			{
				fontStyle |= System.Drawing.FontStyle.Strikeout;
			}
			if (TextDecorationLine == CssTextDecorationLine.Underline)
			{
				fontStyle |= System.Drawing.FontStyle.Underline;
			}
			return fontStyle;
		}

		public void Reset(CssStyle style)
		{
			Assign(style);
		}

		public void SetProperty(string property, string value)
		{
			CssParser.Default.SetProperty(this, property, value);
			if (ownerCore != null)
			{
				ownerCore.SetDirtyStyle();
				ownerCore.RootElement?.Invalidate(DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.StyleChanged);
			}
		}

		public void SetDisplay(CssDisplay value)
		{
			SetProperty(delegate(CssStyle x)
			{
				x.MainProperties.SetDisplay(new CssProperty<CssDisplay>(value, int.MaxValue));
			});
		}

		public void SetVisibility(CssVisibility value)
		{
			SetProperty(delegate(CssStyle x)
			{
				x.AutoInheritedProperties.SetVisibility(new CssProperty<CssVisibility>(value, int.MaxValue));
			});
		}

		public void SetForeColor(string dxColor, float opacity)
		{
			SetProperty(delegate(CssStyle x)
			{
				x.AutoInheritedProperties.SetForeColor(new CssColor(dxColor, opacity, int.MaxValue));
			});
		}

		public void SetForeColor(string dxColor)
		{
			SetProperty(delegate
			{
				SetForeColor(dxColor, 1f);
			});
		}

		{
			SetProperty(delegate(CssStyle x)
			{
				x.AutoInheritedProperties.SetForeColor(new CssColor(color, int.MaxValue));
			});
		}

		public void SetBackgroundColor(string dxColor, float opacity)
		{

				x.MainProperties.SetBackgroundColor(new CssColor(dxColor, opacity, int.MaxValue));

			SetProperty(delegate(CssStyle x)

				x.MainProperties.SetBackgroundColor(new CssColor(color, int.MaxValue));
			});
		}

		private void SetProperty(Action<CssStyle> setProperty)
		{
			setProperty(this);
			if (ownerCore != null)
			{
				ownerCore.SetDirtyStyle();
				ownerCore.RootElement?.Invalidate(DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.StyleChanged);
			}
		}

		internal void SetString(string style)
		{
			styleCore = style;
		}

		internal void SetOwner(DxHtmlElement owner)
		{
			ownerCore = owner;
		}

		public static explicit operator CssStyle(string style)
		{
			CssStyle cssStyle = new CssStyle();
			CssParser.Default.ParseStyle(style, cssStyle);
			return cssStyle;
		}

		public static implicit operator string(CssStyle style)
		{
			return style.styleCore;
		}

		public CssStyle()
		{
			FlexProperties = new CssFlexProperties();
			FontProperties = new CssFontProperties();
			Padding = new CssPaddingProperties(CssUnit.Empty);
			Margin = new CssMarginProperties(PropertyDefaultValues.AutoEmptyUnit);
			MinSize = new CssSizeProperties();
			MaxSize = new CssSizeProperties();
			LeftBorder = new CssBorderProperties(this);
			TopBorder = new CssBorderProperties(this);
			RightBorder = new CssBorderProperties(this);
			BottomBorder = new CssBorderProperties(this);
			Radius = new CssBorderRadiusProperties();
			BoxShadow = new CssBoxShadowProperties();
			AutoInheritedProperties = new CssAutoInheritedProperties();
			TextProperties = new CssTextProperties();
			MainProperties = new CssMainProperties();
			BackgroundImages = new CssBackgroundImagePropertiesCollection();
		}

		internal void CheckMarker()
		{
			if (markerCore == null)
			{
				markerCore = new CssStyle();
			}
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssStyle parent, CssStyle root)
		{
			if (parent != null)
			{
				MergeParentCore(parent, root);
				Selection.MergeParentCore(parent.Selection, root.Selection);
				Selection.MainProperties.MergeParentBackground(parent.Selection.MainProperties, root.Selection.MainProperties);
			}
		}

		private void MergeParentCore(CssStyle parent, CssStyle root)
		{
			FontProperties.MergeParent(parent.FontProperties, root.FontProperties);
			TextProperties.MergeParent(parent.TextProperties, root.TextProperties);
			AutoInheritedProperties.MergeParent(parent.AutoInheritedProperties, root.AutoInheritedProperties);
			FlexProperties.MergeParent(parent.FlexProperties, root.FlexProperties);
			MainProperties.MergeParent(parent.MainProperties, root.MainProperties);
			BackgroundImages.MergeParent(parent.BackgroundImages, root.BackgroundImages);
			LeftBorder.MergeParent(parent.LeftBorder, root.LeftBorder);
			RightBorder.MergeParent(parent.RightBorder, root.RightBorder);
			TopBorder.MergeParent(parent.TopBorder, root.TopBorder);
			BottomBorder.MergeParent(parent.BottomBorder, root.BottomBorder);
			BoxShadow.MergeParent(parent.BoxShadow, root.BoxShadow);
			Radius.MergeParent(parent.Radius, root.Radius);
			MinSize.MergeParent(parent.MinSize, root.MinSize);
			MaxSize.MergeParent(parent.MaxSize, root.MaxSize);
			Padding.MergeParent(parent.Padding, root.Padding);
			Margin.MergeParent(parent.Margin, root.Margin);
		}

		public void Merge(CssStyle style)
		{
			if (style != null)
			{
				FontProperties.Merge(style.FontProperties);
				TextProperties.Merge(style.TextProperties);
				AutoInheritedProperties.Merge(style.AutoInheritedProperties);
				FlexProperties.Merge(style.FlexProperties);
				MainProperties.Merge(style.MainProperties);
				BackgroundImages.Merge(style.BackgroundImages);
				LeftBorder.Merge(style.LeftBorder);
				RightBorder.Merge(style.RightBorder);
				TopBorder.Merge(style.TopBorder);
				BottomBorder.Merge(style.BottomBorder);
				BoxShadow.Merge(style.BoxShadow);
				Radius.Merge(style.Radius);
				MinSize.Merge(style.MinSize);
				MaxSize.Merge(style.MaxSize);
				Padding.Merge(style.Padding);
				Margin.Merge(style.Margin);
				CssStyleSet.MergeStyle(ref markerCore, style.markerCore);
				CssStyleSet.MergeStyle(ref beforeCore, style.beforeCore);
				CssStyleSet.MergeStyle(ref afterCore, style.afterCore);
				CssStyleSet.MergeStyle(ref selectionCore, style.selectionCore);
			}
		}

		public CssStyle Clone()
		{
			CssStyle cssStyle = new CssStyle();
			cssStyle.Assign(this);
			return cssStyle;
		}

		public void Assign(CssStyle cssStyle)
		{
			if (cssStyle != null)
			{
				FontProperties.Assign(cssStyle.FontProperties);
				TextProperties.Assign(cssStyle.TextProperties);
				AutoInheritedProperties.Assign(cssStyle.AutoInheritedProperties);
				FlexProperties.Assign(cssStyle.FlexProperties);
				MainProperties.Assign(cssStyle.MainProperties);
				BackgroundImages.Assign(cssStyle.BackgroundImages);
				LeftBorder.Assign(cssStyle.LeftBorder);
				RightBorder.Assign(cssStyle.RightBorder);
				TopBorder.Assign(cssStyle.TopBorder);
				BottomBorder.Assign(cssStyle.BottomBorder);
				Radius.Assign(cssStyle.Radius);
				MinSize.Assign(cssStyle.MinSize);
				MaxSize.Assign(cssStyle.MaxSize);
				Padding.Assign(cssStyle.Padding);
				Margin.Assign(cssStyle.Margin);
				BoxShadow.Assign(cssStyle.BoxShadow);
				AssignPseudoClass(ref markerCore, cssStyle.markerCore);
				AssignPseudoClass(ref beforeCore, cssStyle.beforeCore);
				AssignPseudoClass(ref afterCore, cssStyle.afterCore);
				AssignPseudoClass(ref selectionCore, cssStyle.selectionCore);
			}
		}

		private void AssignPseudoClass(ref CssStyle style, CssStyle source)
		{
			if (source != null)
			{
				if (style == null)
				{
					style = source.Clone();
				}
				else
				{
					style.Assign(source);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Assign(CssStyle cssStyle, int weight)
		{
			if (cssStyle != null)
			{
				FontProperties.Assign(cssStyle.FontProperties, weight);
				TextProperties.Assign(cssStyle.TextProperties, weight);
				AutoInheritedProperties.Assign(cssStyle.AutoInheritedProperties, weight);
				FlexProperties.Assign(cssStyle.FlexProperties, weight);
				MainProperties.Assign(cssStyle.MainProperties, weight);
				BackgroundImages.Assign(cssStyle.BackgroundImages, weight);
				LeftBorder.Assign(cssStyle.LeftBorder, weight);
				RightBorder.Assign(cssStyle.RightBorder, weight);
				TopBorder.Assign(cssStyle.TopBorder, weight);
				BottomBorder.Assign(cssStyle.BottomBorder, weight);
				Radius.Assign(cssStyle.Radius, weight);
				MinSize.Assign(cssStyle.MinSize, weight);
				MaxSize.Assign(cssStyle.MaxSize, weight);
				Padding.Assign(cssStyle.Padding, weight);
				Margin.Assign(cssStyle.Margin, weight);
				BoxShadow.Assign(cssStyle.BoxShadow, weight);
			}
		}

		internal CssStyle GetOrCreateStyle(CssPseudoElement state)
		{
			return state switch
			{
				CssPseudoElement.Marker => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref markerCore), 
				CssPseudoElement.Before => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref beforeCore), 
				CssPseudoElement.After => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref afterCore), 
				CssPseudoElement.Selection => GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref selectionCore), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private CssStyle GetOrCreateStyleCore(ref CssStyle style)
		{
			if (style == null)
			{
				style = new CssStyle();
			}
			return style;
		}
	}

	public class DxHtmlElementMouseEventArgs : DxHtmlElementEventArgs
	{
		public DxHtmlHitInfo HitInfo { get; }

		public Rectangle Bounds => HitInfo.Bounds;

		public int X => MouseArgs.X;

		public int Y => MouseArgs.Y;

		public int Clicks => MouseArgs.Clicks;

		public MouseButtons Button => MouseArgs.Button;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public MouseEventArgs MouseArgs { get; }

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool IsClick
		{
			get
			{
				if (MouseArgs.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
				{
					return Bounds.Contains(MouseArgs.Location);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public virtual object SourceItem { get; }

		public DxHtmlElementMouseEventArgs(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs mouseArgs)
			: this(hitInfo, mouseArgs, null)
		{
		}

		public DxHtmlElementMouseEventArgs(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs mouseArgs, object sourceItem)
			: base(hitInfo.Root, hitInfo.Element)
		{
			MouseArgs = mouseArgs;
			HitInfo = hitInfo;
			base.Bubbles = true;
			SourceItem = sourceItem;
		}

		public DxHtmlElementMouseEventArgs(MouseEventArgs mouseArgs)
		{
			MouseArgs = mouseArgs;
			base.Bubbles = true;
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlElementEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private DxHtmlNode currentTargetCore;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public DxHtmlRootElement RootElement { get; }

		public bool Bubbles { get; internal set; }

		public DxHtmlNode Target { get; }

		public DxHtmlNode CurrentTarget
		{
			get
			{
				return currentTargetCore;
			}
			internal set
			{
				currentTargetCore = value;
				if (value != null && value.ElementIndex >= 0)
				{
					Element = (DxHtmlElement)value;
				}
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlElement Element { get; private set; }

		public string ElementId => Element?.Id;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public string NodeName => CurrentTarget.NodeName;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public string TagName => NodeName;

		public bool CancelBubble { get; set; }

		public bool SuppressOwnerEvent { get; set; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public DxHtmlElementEventArgs(DxHtmlRootElement rootElement, DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			Target = (CurrentTarget = node);
			RootElement = rootElement;
		}

		public DxHtmlElementEventArgs(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			Target = (CurrentTarget = node);
			if (node != null)
			{
				RootElement = node.RootElement;
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlElementEventArgs()
		{
		}

		public bool HasId(string id, bool includeAncestors = true)
		{
			return DxHtmlElement.HasId(Element, id, includeAncestors);
		}

		public bool HasClassName(string @class, bool includeAncestors = true)
		{
			return DxHtmlElement.HasClassName(Element, @class, includeAncestors);
		}

		public bool HasTag(string tagName, bool includeAncestors = true)
		{
			return DxHtmlElement.HasTag(Element, tagName, includeAncestors);
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ParentHasId(string id)
		{
			return DxHtmlElement.HasId(Element?.ParentElement, id);
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ParentHasClassName(string @class)
		{
			return DxHtmlElement.HasClassName(Element?.ParentElement, @class);
		}

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ParentHasTag(string tagName)
		{
			return DxHtmlElement.HasTag(Element?.ParentElement, tagName);
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlException : IEquatable<DxHtmlException>
	{
		public int Index { get; }

		public int Length { get; }

		public string Message { get; }

		public string FormattedMessage { get; }

		public HtmlExceptionType Type { get; }

		public DxHtmlException(int index, int length, HtmlExceptionType type)
		{
			Index = index;
			Length = ((length == 0) ? 1 : length);
			Type = type;
			Message = DxHtmlExceptionStrings.GetString(type);
			FormattedMessage = DxHtmlExceptionStrings.GetStringFormatted(type);
		}

		public bool Equals(DxHtmlException other)
		{
			if (other.Index == Index && other.Length == Length)
			{
				return Type == other.Type;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class DxHtmlExceptionStrings
	{
		private static Dictionary<HtmlExceptionType, string> strings = new Dictionary<HtmlExceptionType, string>
		{
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.MissingLeftCurlyBracket,
				"{ expected"
			},
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.MissingRightCurlyBracket,
				"} expected"
			},
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.MissingQuotes,
				"\" expected"
			},
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.MissingColon,
				": expected"
			},
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.MissingPropertyValue,
				"Value expected"
			},
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.MissingSelector,
				"Selector expected"
			},
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.InvalidSelectorName,
				"Unknown selector"
			},
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.UnknownCssProperty,
				"Unknown property"
			},
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.InvalidValue,
				"Unknown value"
			}
		};

		private static Dictionary<HtmlExceptionType, string> stringsWithFormat = new Dictionary<HtmlExceptionType, string>
		{
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.InvalidSelectorName,
				"Unknown selector: \"{1}\". See <href={0}>CSS Selectors.</href>"
			},
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.UnknownCssProperty,
				"Unknown property: \"{1}\". See <href={0}>CSS Properties.</href>"
			},
			{
				HtmlExceptionType.InvalidValue,
				"Unknown value: \"{1}\". See <href={0}>CSS Properties.</href>"
			}
		};

		public static string GetString(HtmlExceptionType type)
		{
			string value = string.Empty;
			strings.TryGetValue(type, out value);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return type.ToString();
		}

		public static string GetStringFormatted(HtmlExceptionType type)
		{
			string value = string.Empty;
			stringsWithFormat.TryGetValue(type, out value);
			return value;
		}
	}

				{
					if (InputControl != null)

						return InputControl.Enabled;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

			inputTag.ControlName.ForceValue(RootElement, this);
			inputTag.Value.ForceValue(RootElement, this);
			base.InitializeAttributesCore();

		{

			return dxHtmlControlHost.GetControl(Name, typeCore);
		}

		{
			base.InitializeAttributes(isCalc);
			if (repositoryIdCore == int.MinValue && inputControlCore == null && RootElement != null && isCalc)
			{
				inputControlCore = GetInputControl();
				if (inputControlCore == null && RootElement.RepositoryHelper != null)
				{
					repositoryIdCore = RootElement.RepositoryHelper.CreateRepositoryItem(this);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void CalcCurrentStyleCore()
		{
			base.CalcCurrentStyleCore();
			CalcOriginalStyle();
		}

		private void CalcOriginalStyle()
		{
			CssStyleSet cssStyleSet = ((IDxHtmlSupportCombinator)this)?.StyleSet;
			if (cssStyleSet != null)
			{
				originalStyle.Reset(cssStyleSet.Normal);
				MergeStyleSetToStyle(cssStyleSet, originalStyle);
			}
		}

		protected override DxHtmlElementInfoBase CreateViewInfo()
		{
			return new DxHtmlInputElementInfo(this);
		}

		protected override DxHtmlNode CloneCore()
		{
			return new DxHtmlInputElement(base.DocumentNode);
		}
	}

	public abstract class DxHtmlNode
	{
		private Dictionary<string, List<DxHtmlEvent>> eventsCore;

		private DxHtmlRootElement rootCore;

		private int nodeLevelCore;

		private int nodeIndexCore = -1;

		private int elementIndexCore = -1;

		private int plainIndexCore;

		private DxHtmlNodeList childNodesCore;

		private DxHtmlNode parentNodeCore;

		private DxHtmlElement parentElementCore;

		private bool indexIsDirtyCore;

		internal int saveIndexCore;

		private int lockUpdateCore;

		private int forceUpdateCountCore;

		public virtual DxHtmlRootElement RootElement
		{
			get
			{
				return rootCore;
			}
			internal set
			{
				rootCore = value;
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlNodeList ChildNodes => childNodesCore;

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int NodeIndex => nodeIndexCore;

		public abstract string NodeName { get; }

		public abstract DxHtmlNodeType NodeType { get; }

		public DxHtmlNode ParentNode => parentNodeCore;

		public virtual DxHtmlElement ParentElement => parentElementCore;

		protected internal int NodeLevel => nodeLevelCore;

		protected internal int PlainIndex => plainIndexCore;

		protected virtual bool AllowEventListener => false;

		protected virtual bool ReadOnly => true;

		internal virtual DxHtmlNodeList InternalChildren => childNodesCore;

		internal virtual int ElementIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return elementIndexCore;
			}
			set
			{
				elementIndexCore = value;
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlNode()
		{
			childNodesCore = new DxHtmlNodeList(this);
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetCore();
		}

		public void AddEventListener(string type, Action listener)
		{
			AddEventListenerCore(type, new DxHtmlEvent(listener, 0));
		}

		public void AddEventListener(string type, Action<DxHtmlElementEventArgs> listener)
		{
			AddEventListenerCore(type, new DxHtmlEvent(listener, 1));
		}

		public void AddEventListener(string type, Action<object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs> listener)
		{
			AddEventListenerCore(type, new DxHtmlEvent(listener, 2));
		}

		public void RemoveEventListener(string type, Action listener)
		{
			RemoveEventListenerCore(type, new DxHtmlEvent(listener, 0));
		}

		public void RemoveEventListener(string type, Action<DxHtmlElementEventArgs> listener)
		{
			RemoveEventListenerCore(type, new DxHtmlEvent(listener, 1));
		}

		public void RemoveEventListener(string type, Action<object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs> listener)
		{
			RemoveEventListenerCore(type, new DxHtmlEvent(listener, 2));
		}

		public bool DispatchEvent(string type, DxHtmlElementEventArgs e)
		{
			return DispatchEventCore(type, e);
		}

		public void AppendChildren(IEnumerable<DxHtmlNode> nodes)
		{
			if (!ReadOnly)
			{
				BeginUpdate();
				AppendChildrenCore(nodes);
				EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void AppendChild(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			if (node.NodeType == DxHtmlNodeType.DocumentFragmentNode)
			{
				AppendChildren(node.ChildNodes.ToArray());
			}
			else if (CanAppend(node))
			{
				node.Remove();
				RootElement?.LockCondition();
				AppendChildCore(node);
				Update();
				RootElement?.UnlockCondition(node as DxHtmlElement);
			}
		}

		public void Remove()
		{
			if (ParentNode != null)
			{
				DxHtmlNode parentNode = ParentNode;
				parentNode.RemoveChildCore(nodeIndexCore);
				parentNode.Update();
			}
		}

		public void InsertChild(int index, DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			if (CanAppend(node))
			{
				InsertChildCore(index, node);
				Update();
			}
		}

		public void InsertBefore(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			if (parentNodeCore != null)
			{
				parentNodeCore.InsertChild(NodeIndex, node);
			}
		}

		public void InsertAfter(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			if (parentNodeCore != null)
			{
				parentNodeCore.InsertChild(NodeIndex + 1, node);
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlNode CloneNode(bool deep = true)
		{
			DxHtmlNode dxHtmlNode = CloneCore();
			dxHtmlNode.Assign(this);
			if (deep)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < childNodesCore.Count; i++)
				{
					dxHtmlNode.AppendChildCore(childNodesCore[i].CloneNode());
				}
			}
			return dxHtmlNode;
		}

		public void RemoveChild(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			if (!ReadOnly)
			{
				RemoveChildCore(node);
				Update();
			}
		}

		public void RemoveChildren(IEnumerable<DxHtmlNode> nodes)
		{
			if (ReadOnly)
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdate();
			foreach (DxHtmlNode node in nodes)
			{
				RemoveChild(node);
			}
			EndUpdate();
		}

		public void RemoveChild(int index)
		{
			if (!ReadOnly)
			{
				RemoveChildCore(index);
				Update();
			}
		}

		public void ClearChildren()
		{
			if (!ReadOnly)
			{
				ClearChildrenCore();
				Update();
			}
		}

		public void Update()
		{
			if (lockUpdateCore > 0)
			{
				forceUpdateCountCore++;
				return;
			}
			if (indexIsDirtyCore)
			{
				UpdateIndexes();
			}
			forceUpdateCountCore = 0;
			UpdateCore();
			if (RootElement != null)
			{
				RootElement.Invalidate(DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.LayoutChanged);
			}
		}

		protected internal void SetPlainIndex(int value)
		{
			plainIndexCore = value;
		}

		private void AddEventListenerCore(string type, DxHtmlEvent listener)
		{
			if (!AllowEventListener)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (eventsCore == null)
			{
				eventsCore = new Dictionary<string, List<DxHtmlEvent>>();
			}
			if (eventsCore.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				if (!value.Contains(listener))
				{
					value.Add(listener);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				value = new List<DxHtmlEvent>();
				value.Add(listener);
				eventsCore.Add(type, value);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveEventListenerCore(string type, DxHtmlEvent listener)
		{
			if (eventsCore != null && eventsCore.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				int num = value.IndexOf(listener);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					value.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool DispatchEventCore(string type, DxHtmlElementEventArgs e)
		{
			if (eventsCore == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (eventsCore.TryGetValue(type, out var value))
			{
				e.CurrentTarget = this;
				for (int i = 0; i < value.Count; i++)
				{
					value[i].Invoke(this, e);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnItemRemoved(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			node.nodeIndexCore = -1;
			node.parentNodeCore = null;
			OnItemRemovedCore(node);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemRemovedCore(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			node.parentElementCore = null;
			if (RootElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			node.Unload();
			if (node.childNodesCore.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			using DxHtmlNodeIterator dxHtmlNodeIterator = new DxHtmlNodeIterator();
			dxHtmlNodeIterator.Prepare(node.childNodesCore);
			while (dxHtmlNodeIterator.MoveNext())
			{
				dxHtmlNodeIterator.CurrentNode.Unload();
			}
		}

		internal void OnItemAdded(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			node.parentNodeCore = this;
			OnItemAddedCore(node);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemAddedCore(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			if (NodeType > DxHtmlNodeType.DocumentNode)
			{
				node.parentElementCore = (DxHtmlElement)this;
			}
			node.RootElement = RootElement;
			if (RootElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			node.Load();
			if (node.childNodesCore.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			using DxHtmlNodeIterator dxHtmlNodeIterator = new DxHtmlNodeIterator();
			dxHtmlNodeIterator.Prepare(node.childNodesCore);
			while (dxHtmlNodeIterator.MoveNext())
			{
				dxHtmlNodeIterator.CurrentNode.UpdateElement();
			}
		}

		protected internal void InsertChildCore(int index, DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			if (index > childNodesCore.Count)
			{
				index = childNodesCore.Count;
			}
			UpdateIndexes(index, 1);
			node.nodeIndexCore = index;
			childNodesCore.Insert(index, node);
		}

		private void AppendChildrenCore(IEnumerable<DxHtmlNode> nodes)
		{
			foreach (DxHtmlNode node in nodes)
			{
				AppendChild(node);
			}
		}

		protected internal void AppendChildCore(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			node.nodeIndexCore = childNodesCore.Count;
			childNodesCore.Add(node);
		}

		protected internal void RemoveChildCore(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			UpdateIndexes(node.nodeIndexCore + 1, -1);
			childNodesCore.RemoveAt(node.nodeIndexCore);
		}

		private void RemoveChildCore(int index)
		{
			if (this != RootElement && index >= 0 && index < childNodesCore.Count)
			{
				UpdateIndexes(index + 1, -1);
				childNodesCore.RemoveAt(index);
			}
		}

		protected void ClearChildrenCore()
		{
			for (int num = childNodesCore.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				childNodesCore.RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanAppend(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			if (!ReadOnly && node.NodeName != ":root" && node.NodeName != "body")
			{
				return node.ParentNode != this;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateIndexes(int index, int delta)
		{
			if (lockUpdateCore > 0)
			{
				indexIsDirtyCore = true;
				return;
			}
			for (int i = index; i < childNodesCore.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlNode dxHtmlNode = childNodesCore[i];
				dxHtmlNode.nodeIndexCore += delta;
				if (dxHtmlNode.NodeType == DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
				{
					dxHtmlNode.elementIndexCore += delta;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIndexes()
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < childNodesCore.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlNode dxHtmlNode = childNodesCore[i];
				dxHtmlNode.nodeIndexCore = i;
				if (dxHtmlNode.NodeType == DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
				{
					dxHtmlNode.elementIndexCore = num++;
				}
			}
			indexIsDirtyCore = false;
		}

		protected void BeginUpdate()
		{
			lockUpdateCore++;
		}

		protected void EndUpdate()
		{
			if (lockUpdateCore != 0 && --lockUpdateCore == 0 && forceUpdateCountCore > 0)
			{
				Update();
			}
		}

		protected void CancelUpdate()
		{
			if (lockUpdateCore > 0)
			{
				forceUpdateCountCore = 0;
				lockUpdateCore = 0;
			}
		}

		protected bool CreateHierarchy(DxHtmlDocumentNode documentNode, DxHtmlNode node, int? nodeLevel = null)
		{
			if (!nodeLevel.HasValue)
			{
				nodeLevel = node.NodeLevel + 1;
				RootElement?.ResetPlainIndexCounter();
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < documentNode.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlDocumentNode documentNode2 = documentNode.Children[i];
				DxHtmlNode dxHtmlNode = node.CreateChildrenCore(documentNode2);
				if (dxHtmlNode != null)
				{
					if (RootElement != null)
					{
						RootElement.CheckElementFocusable(dxHtmlNode);
					}
					dxHtmlNode.nodeLevelCore = nodeLevel.Value;
					if (RootElement != null)
					{
						dxHtmlNode.plainIndexCore = RootElement.NextPlainIndex();
					}
					if (dxHtmlNode.ChildNodes.Count > 0)
					{
						RootElement.UpdateChildPlainIndexes(dxHtmlNode.ChildNodes);
					}
					OnAfterCreatingHierarchy(dxHtmlNode);
					CreateHierarchy(documentNode2, dxHtmlNode, nodeLevel + 1);
				}
			}
			return documentNode.Children.Count > 0;
		}

		protected virtual void OnAfterCreatingHierarchy(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
		}

		protected abstract DxHtmlNode CloneCore();

		protected virtual void Assign(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
		}

		protected virtual DxHtmlNode CreateChildrenCore(DxHtmlDocumentNode documentNode)
		{
			DxHtmlElementBase dxHtmlElementBase = documentNode.CreateNode();
			AppendChildCore(dxHtmlElementBase);
			return dxHtmlElementBase;
		}

		protected abstract void ResetCore();

		protected virtual void UpdateElement()
		{
			RootElement = parentNodeCore.RootElement;
			Load();
		}

		protected virtual void Unload()
		{
			RootElement = null;
		}

		protected virtual void Load()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateCore()
		{
		}
	}

		internal bool recalcLogicalIndixes = true;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		public int Length => base.Count;

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int ElementCount => elementCountCore;

		public DxHtmlNodeList(DxHtmlNode owner)
		{
			ownerCore = owner;
		}

		protected override void OnItemAdded(DxHtmlNode node, int index)
		{
			if (node.NodeType > DxHtmlNodeType.DocumentNode)
			{
				node.ElementIndex = elementCountCore;
				elementCountCore++;
			}
			ownerCore?.OnItemAdded(node);
			base.OnItemAdded(node, index);
		}

		protected override void OnItemRemoved(DxHtmlNode value, int index)
		{
			if (value.NodeType > DxHtmlNodeType.DocumentNode)
			{
				value.ElementIndex = -1;
				elementCountCore--;
			}
			ownerCore?.OnItemRemoved(value);
			base.OnItemRemoved(value, index);
		}

		protected override void OnCleared()
		{
			elementCountCore = 0;
			base.OnCleared();
		}

		protected override int IndexOfCore(DxHtmlNode value)
		{
			return value.NodeIndex;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(DxHtmlNode value, int index, CollectionChangedAction collectionChangedAction)
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.OnCollectionChanged(value, index, collectionChangedAction);
			recalcLogicalIndixes = true;
		}
	}

		internal sealed class ServiceContainer : IServiceProvider
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<Type, object> registry = new Dictionary<Type, object>();

			internal void Reset()
			{
				registry.Clear();
			}

			internal void Register<T>(T obj) where T : class
			{
				registry[typeof(T)] = obj;
			}

			public object GetService(Type serviceType)
			{
				if (!registry.TryGetValue(serviceType, out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value;
			}

			internal T Get<T>() where T : class
			{
				if (!registry.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out var value))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return value as T;
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureClientDetails()
		{
			IDxHtmlClient dxHtmlClient = clientServices.Get<IDxHtmlClient>();
			if (dxHtmlClient != null)
			{
				DxHtmlClientDetails dxHtmlClientDetails = dxHtmlClient as DxHtmlClientDetails;
				if (dxHtmlClientDetails == null)
				{
					dxHtmlClientDetails = new DxHtmlClientDetails(dxHtmlClient);
					clientServices.Register((IDxHtmlClient)dxHtmlClientDetails);
					clientServices.Register(dxHtmlClientDetails);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void FreeClientDetails()
		{
			IDxHtmlClient dxHtmlClient = clientServices.Get<IDxHtmlClient>();
			DxHtmlClientDetails dxHtmlClientDetails = clientServices.Get<DxHtmlClientDetails>();
			if (dxHtmlClient != null && dxHtmlClientDetails != null && dxHtmlClient == dxHtmlClientDetails)
			{
				clientServices.Register(dxHtmlClientDetails.GetActualClient());
				clientServices.Register<DxHtmlClientDetails>(null);
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlHitInfo CalcHitInfo(System.Drawing.Point location)

			{
				return new DxHtmlHitInfo(this, null, location);
			}
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = ViewInfo.CalcHitInfo(location);
			if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Element == this)
			{
				return new DxHtmlHitInfo(this, null, location);
			}
			return new DxHtmlHitInfo(this, dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Element, location);
		}

		public override bool Focus(bool value)
		{
			if (!SetDynamicStateCore(CssDynamicState.FullFocus, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!SetDirtyStyle(base.ComputedStyleSet.Focus))
			{
				return ConditionIndex > -1;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal void UpdateChildPlainIndexes(DxHtmlNodeList nodes)
		{
			if (nodes != null && nodes.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Count; i++)
				{
					DxHtmlNode dxHtmlNode = nodes[i];
					dxHtmlNode.SetPlainIndex(NextPlainIndex());
					UpdateChildPlainIndexes(dxHtmlNode.ChildNodes);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CheckElementFocusable(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			if (node.ElementIndex >= 0 && node.RootElement != null)
			{
				DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = (DxHtmlElement)node;
				if (dxHtmlElement.IsFocusable)
				{
					focusableElementsCore.Add(dxHtmlElement);
					maxTabIndex = Math.Max(maxTabIndex, dxHtmlElement.TabIndex);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < node.ChildNodes.Count; i++)
				{
					DxHtmlNode node2 = node.ChildNodes[i];
					CheckElementFocusable(node2);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CheckIsVisibleRecursive(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase viewInfo = element.ViewInfo;
			DxHtmlElement parentElement = element.ParentElement;
			if (viewInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!viewInfo.IsVisible || !viewInfo.IsDisplayed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parentElement != null)
			{
				return CheckIsVisibleRecursive(parentElement);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool FocusOnMouseDown(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			if (element != focusedElementCore)
			{
				RepositoryHelper?.CloseEditor();
			}
			if (element == null)
			{
				if (hiddenFocusCore != null)
				{
					return hiddenFocusCore.Focus(value: true);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (element.IsFocusable)
			{
				return element.Focus(value: true);
			}
			for (element = element.ParentElement; element != null; element = element.ParentElement)
			{
				if (element.IsFocusable)
				{
					return element.Focus(value: true);
				}
			}
			if (focusedElementCore != null)
			{
				return focusedElementCore.Focus(value: false);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Focus(IDxHtmlControl htmlControl)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < focusableElementsCore.Count; i++)
			{
				if (focusableElementsCore[i] is DxHtmlInputElement { IsFocusable: not false } dxHtmlInputElement && dxHtmlInputElement.InputControl == htmlControl)
				{
					if (dxHtmlInputElement.Focus(value: true))
					{
						Invalidate(DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.StyleChanged);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool FocusNextCore()
		{
			if (focusableElementsCore.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = focusedIndexCore;
			bool result = false;
			do
			{
				num++;
				if (num == focusableElementsCore.Count)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = focusableElementsCore[num];
				if (dxHtmlElement.IsFocusable && CheckIsVisibleRecursive(dxHtmlElement))
				{
					if (dxHtmlElement.Focus(value: true))
					{
						focusedIndexCore = num;
						result = true;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			while (num != focusedIndexCore);
			return result;
		}

		private bool FocusPrevCore()
		{
			if (focusableElementsCore.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = focusedIndexCore;
			bool result = false;
			do
			{
				num--;
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = focusableElementsCore.Count - 1;
				}
				DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = focusableElementsCore[num];
				if (dxHtmlElement.IsFocusable && CheckIsVisibleRecursive(dxHtmlElement))
				{
					if (dxHtmlElement.Focus(value: true))
					{
						focusedIndexCore = num;
						result = true;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			while (num != focusedIndexCore);
			return result;
		}

		internal bool FocusOnTab(bool shift)
		{
			if (shift)
			{
				return FocusPrevCore();
			}
			return FocusNextCore();
		}

		private void FinalizeFocusableElements()
		{
			focusableElementsCore.Sort(delegate(DxHtmlElement x, DxHtmlElement y)
			{
				int num = x.TabIndex;
				if (num == 0)
				{
					num = maxTabIndex + 1 + x.PlainIndex;
				}
				int num2 = y.TabIndex;
				if (num2 == 0)
				{
					num2 = maxTabIndex + 1 + y.PlainIndex;
				}
				return num - num2;
			});
		}

		internal bool OnFocusedChanged(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (focusedElementCore != null)
			{
				if (focusedElementCore is DxHtmlInputElement && focusedElementCore != element)
				{
					bool focusLeave = !(element is DxHtmlInputElement);
					if (RepositoryHelper != null && !RepositoryHelper.CloseEditor(focusLeave))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (element == null)
				{
					flag |= focusedElementCore.SetFocusState(value: false, null);
				}
				else
				{
					DxHtmlElement parent = element.FindParent((DxHtmlElement x) => (x.DynamicState & CssDynamicState.FocusWithin) > CssDynamicState.Normal);
					focusedElementCore.SetFocusState(value: false, parent);
					flag |= element.SetFocusState(value: true, parent);
				}
				Callback?.OnBlur(element, focusedElementCore);
			}
			else
			{
				if (element == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				flag |= element.SetFocusState(value: true, null);
			}
			DxHtmlElement oldFocus = focusedElementCore;
			focusedElementCore = element;
			focusedIndexCore = focusableElementsCore.IndexOf(element);
			if (element != null)
			{
				Callback?.OnFocus(element, oldFocus);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal void CheckShowEditor(bool shouldSendMouseEvent)
		{
			if (focusedElementCore is DxHtmlInputElement)
			{
				DxHtmlInputElement dxHtmlInputElement = (DxHtmlInputElement)focusedElementCore;
				RepositoryHelper?.ShowEditor(dxHtmlInputElement, ((InputTag)dxHtmlInputElement.Tag).Value.FieldName, shouldSendMouseEvent);
			}
		}

		internal void OnStateChanged(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			if (conditionsCountCore > 0)
			{
				conditionManagerCore.CheckChanges(element);
			}
			Invalidate(DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.StyleChanged);
		}

		internal void RefreshCondition(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			if (lockConditionCore <= 0 && element != null && conditionManagerCore.RefreshCondition(element))
			{
				Invalidate(DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.StyleChanged);
			}
		}

		internal void LockCondition()
		{
			lockConditionCore++;
		}

		internal void UnlockCondition(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			if (lockConditionCore != 0 && --lockConditionCore == 0)
			{
				RefreshCondition(element);
			}
		}

		internal int GetConditionIndex()
		{
			return conditionsCountCore++;
		}

		internal void RegisterConditions(DxHtmlElement element, DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicStyleSet> conditions)
		{
			conditionManagerCore.Register(element, conditions);
		}

		protected override void OnAfterCreatingHierarchy(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			if (node.ElementIndex >= 0)
			{
				DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = (DxHtmlElement)node;
				if (conditionsCountCore > 0)
				{
					conditionManagerCore.Register(dxHtmlElement, dxHtmlElement.DocumentNode.Conditions);
				}
			}
		}

		internal int NextPlainIndex()
		{
			return ++currentPlainIndexCore;
		}

		internal void ResetPlainIndexCounter()
		{
			currentPlainIndexCore = 0;
		}

		internal void RegisterCustomElement(DxHtmlCustomElement element)
		{
			if (customElements == null)
			{
				customElements = new List<DxHtmlCustomElement>();
			}
			customElements.Add(element);
		}

		internal void UnregisterCustomElement(DxHtmlCustomElement element)
		{
			if (customElements != null)

				customElements.Remove(element);
			}
		}

		protected override void ResetCore()
		{
			Client = null;
			Callback = null;
			Context = null;
			layoutChangeActionsCore = DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None;
			using (DxHtmlNodeIterator dxHtmlNodeIterator = new DxHtmlNodeIterator())
			{
				dxHtmlNodeIterator.Prepare(base.ChildNodes);
				while (dxHtmlNodeIterator.MoveNext())
				{
					dxHtmlNodeIterator.CurrentNode.Reset();
				}
			}
			base.ResetCore();
		}

		protected override DxHtmlElementInfoBase CreateViewInfo()
		{
			return new DxHtmlRootElementInfo(this);
		}

		protected override void CalcStyleCore()
		{
			base.CalcStyleCore();
			OnLoad();
		}

		private void OnLoad()
		{
			if (!isLoadedCore)
			{
				Callback?.OnLoad(Body);
				isLoadedCore = true;
			}
		}

		private void CheckChangeActions()
		{
			if ((layoutChangeActionsCore & DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.DataSourceChanged) != DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None)
			{
				UpdateCustomElementsAttributes();
				RecalcPlainIndexes();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCustomElementsAttributes()
		{
			if (customElements != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < customElements.Count; i++)
				{
					customElements[i].OnAttributeChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RecalcPlainIndexes()
		{
			ResetPlainIndexCounter();
			UpdateChildPlainIndexes(base.ChildNodes);
		}

		private void ClearChangeActions()
		{
			layoutChangeActionsCore = DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None;
		}

		protected override DxHtmlNode CloneCore()
		{
			return new DxHtmlRootElement(RootNode, Client)
			{
				repositoryHelperCore = repositoryHelperCore,
				contextCore = contextCore,
				Callback = Callback
			};
		}

		{

		}

	public class DxHtmlHitInfo
	{
		private DxHtmlElement elementCore;

		private DxHtmlElementBase actualElementCore;

		private DxHtmlRootElement rootCore;

		private Rectangle[] containerElementBoundsCore;

		private string hrefCore;

		private string titleCore;

		private bool? inSelectionCore;

		public bool IsEmpty => elementCore == null;

		public System.Drawing.Point Location { get; private set; }

		public string Href
		{
			get
			{
				if (hrefCore == null)
				{
					hrefCore = GetHref(elementCore);
				}
				return hrefCore;
			}
		}

		public string Title
		{
			get
			{
				if (titleCore == null)
				{
					titleCore = GetTitle(elementCore);
				}
				return titleCore;
			}
			internal set
			{
				titleCore = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public DxHtmlElementInfo ElementInfo => (DxHtmlElementInfo)elementCore.ViewInfo;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public DxHtmlRootElement Root => rootCore;

		public DxHtmlElement Element => elementCore;

		public Rectangle Bounds { get; }

		public bool IsContainer { get; }

		public Rectangle[] ContainerElementBounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (containerElementBoundsCore == null)
				{
					if (!IsContainer)
					{
						containerElementBoundsCore = new Rectangle[1] { Bounds };
					}
					else
					{
						containerElementBoundsCore = GetContainerElementBounds(ElementInfo, Bounds.Location, new List<Rectangle>()).ToArray();
					}
				}
				return containerElementBoundsCore;
			}
		}

		public Rectangle ContainerElementBoundsCombined
		{
			get
			{
				Rectangle[] containerElementBounds = ContainerElementBounds;
				Rectangle rectangle = containerElementBounds[0];
				for (int i = 1; i < containerElementBounds.Length; i++)
				{
					rectangle = Rectangle.Union(rectangle, containerElementBounds[i]);
				}
				return rectangle;
			}
		}

		public string TagName { get; }

		public bool InLink { get; }

		public bool InSelection
		{
			get
			{
				bool? flag = inSelectionCore;
				if (!flag.HasValue)
				{
					bool? flag2 = (inSelectionCore = CheckHitInSelection());
					return flag2.Value;
				}
				return flag == true;
			}
		}

		public CssStyle CurrentStyle { get; }

		public bool Disabled { get; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public DxHtmlElementBase ActualElement
		{
			get
			{
				return actualElementCore;
			}
			internal set
			{
				actualElementCore = value;
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlHitInfo(DxHtmlRootElement root, DxHtmlElementBase element, System.Drawing.Point location)
		{
			Location = location;
			actualElementCore = element;
			rootCore = root;
			elementCore = GetElement(actualElementCore);
			if (elementCore != null)
			{
				IsContainer = elementCore.ViewInfo.IsContentContainer;
				Bounds = new Rectangle(ElementInfo.GetAbsolutePoint(System.Drawing.Point.Empty), ElementInfo.Size);
				InLink = elementCore.IsLink;
				Disabled = elementCore.Disabled;
				TagName = elementCore.TagName;
				CurrentStyle = elementCore.Style;
			}
		}

		private DxHtmlElement GetElement(DxHtmlElementBase actualElement)
		{
			DxHtmlNode dxHtmlNode = actualElement;
			if (dxHtmlNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			while (dxHtmlNode.ParentNode != null && dxHtmlNode.NodeType < DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
			{
				dxHtmlNode = dxHtmlNode.ParentNode;
			}
			return dxHtmlNode as DxHtmlElement;
		}

		private string GetHref(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			if (InLink)
			{
				while (element.ParentElement != null && element.ParentElement.IsLink)
				{
					element = element.ParentElement;
				}
				if (element != null)
				{
					return ((DxHtmlAnchorElement)element).Href;
				}
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal static string GetTitle(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			for (DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = element; dxHtmlElement != null; dxHtmlElement = dxHtmlElement.ParentElement)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dxHtmlElement.Title))
				{
					return dxHtmlElement.Title;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private List<Rectangle> GetContainerElementBounds(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, System.Drawing.Point offset, List<Rectangle> boundsList)
		{
			if (elementInfo.IsContentContainer)
			{
				foreach (DxHtmlElementInfoBase child in elementInfo.Children)
				{
					GetContainerElementBounds(child, new System.Drawing.Point(offset.X + child.X, offset.Y + child.Y), boundsList);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				boundsList.Add(new Rectangle(offset, elementInfo.Size));
			}
			return boundsList;
		}

		private bool CheckHitInSelection()
		{
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = ActualElement?.ViewInfo;
			if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase == null || !dxHtmlElementInfoBase.HasSelectedContent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			System.Drawing.Point relativePoint = dxHtmlElementInfoBase.GetRelativePoint(Location);
			if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase.IsContentContainer)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Children.Count; i++)
				{
					DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase2 = dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Children[i];
					System.Drawing.Point pt = relativePoint;
					pt.Offset(-dxHtmlElementInfoBase2.X, -dxHtmlElementInfoBase2.Y);
					if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase2.SelectionBounds.Contains(pt))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			return dxHtmlElementInfoBase.SelectionBounds.Contains(relativePoint);
		}

		public bool HasId(string elementId, bool includeAncestors = true)
		{
			if (!IsEmpty)
			{
				return DxHtmlElement.HasId(elementCore, elementId, includeAncestors);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool HasClassName(string className, bool includeAncestors = true)
		{
			if (!IsEmpty)
			{
				return DxHtmlElement.HasClassName(elementCore, className, includeAncestors);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool HasTag(string tagName, bool includeAncestors = true)
		{
			if (!IsEmpty)
			{
				return DxHtmlElement.HasTag(elementCore, tagName, includeAncestors);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class DxHtmlShadowElement : DxHtmlNode
	{
		private DxHtmlSlotContentCollection defaultSlotContentCore = new DxHtmlSlotContentCollection();

		private Dictionary<string, DxHtmlSlotContentCollection> slotContentCollectionCore = new Dictionary<string, DxHtmlSlotContentCollection>();

		public override DxHtmlNodeType NodeType => DxHtmlNodeType.ShadowNode;

		public override string NodeName => "Shadow";

		public DxHtmlShadowElement(DxHtmlElement parent)
		{
		}

		protected override DxHtmlNode CloneCore()
		{
			return new DxHtmlShadowElement(ParentElement);
		}

		internal DxHtmlNodeList FindSlotContents(string name, DxHtmlNodeList fallBack)
		{
			DxHtmlSlotContentCollection dxHtmlSlotContentCollection = FindSlotContentsCore(name);
			if (dxHtmlSlotContentCollection == null || dxHtmlSlotContentCollection.Owner != null)
			{
				return fallBack;
			}
			dxHtmlSlotContentCollection.AssignOwner((DxHtmlSlotElement)fallBack.Owner);
			return dxHtmlSlotContentCollection;
		}

		private DxHtmlSlotContentCollection FindSlotContentsCore(string name)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return defaultSlotContentCore;
			}
			if (slotContentCollectionCore.TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void AddSlotContent(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			AddSlotContentCore(element);
		}

		private void AddSlotContentCore(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			string slot = element.Slot;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(slot))
			{
				defaultSlotContentCore.Add(element);
				return;
			}
			if (!slotContentCollectionCore.TryGetValue(slot, out var value))
			{
				value = new DxHtmlSlotContentCollection();
				slotContentCollectionCore.Add(slot, value);
			}
			value.Add(element);
		}

		internal void RemoveSlotContent(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			RemoveSlotContentCore(element.Slot, element);
		}

		internal void RemoveSlotContent(string slotName, DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			RemoveSlotContentCore(slotName, element);
		}

		private void RemoveSlotContentCore(string slotName, DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			DxHtmlSlotContentCollection value;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(slotName))
			{
				defaultSlotContentCore.Remove(element);
			}
			else if (slotContentCollectionCore.TryGetValue(slotName, out value))
			{
				value.Remove(element);
				if (value.Count == 0)
				{
					slotContentCollectionCore.Remove(slotName);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddSlotContents(DxHtmlNodeList collection)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < collection.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlNode dxHtmlNode = collection[i];
				if (dxHtmlNode.NodeType == DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
				{
					AddSlotContentCore((DxHtmlElement)dxHtmlNode);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ClearSlotContents()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, DxHtmlSlotContentCollection> item in slotContentCollectionCore)
			{
				if (item.Value.Owner != null)
				{
					item.Value.AssignOwner(null);
				}
			}
			slotContentCollectionCore.Clear();
		}

		protected override void OnAfterCreatingHierarchy(DxHtmlNode element)
		{
			if (element.NodeName == "slot")
			{
				((DxHtmlSlotElement)element).ActivateSlot(this);
			}
		}

		protected override void ResetCore()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlTemplateElement : DxHtmlElement
	{
		private DxHtmlDocumentFragment contentCore = new DxHtmlDocumentFragment();

		public DxHtmlDocumentFragment Content => contentCore;

		public override bool IsFocusable => false;

		public DxHtmlTemplateElement(DxHtmlDocumentNode documentNode)
			: base(documentNode)
		{
		}

		protected override DxHtmlNode CreateChildrenCore(DxHtmlDocumentNode documentNode)
		{
			DxHtmlElementBase dxHtmlElementBase = documentNode.CreateNode();
			contentCore.AppendChildCore(dxHtmlElementBase);
			return dxHtmlElementBase;
		}

		protected override DxHtmlElementInfoBase CreateViewInfo()
		{
			return new DxHtmlTemplateElementInfo(this);
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlCustomElement : DxHtmlElement
	{

		public new DxHtmlCustomElementInfo ViewInfo => (DxHtmlCustomElementInfo)base.ViewInfo;

		internal DxHtmlComponent Component => componentCore;

		public DxHtmlCustomElement(DxHtmlDocumentNode node)
			: base(node)

			componentCore.SetElement(this);
		}

		protected override void ConnectedCallback()
		{
			RootElement?.RegisterCustomElement(this);
			componentCore.ConnectedCallback();
		}

		protected override void DisconnectedCallback()
		{
			componentCore.DisconnectedCallback();
			RootElement?.UnregisterCustomElement(this);
		}

			base.OnAttributeChanged(name);

		}

		protected override DxHtmlNode CloneCore()

		}

		internal void OnAttributeChanged()
		{
			OnAttributeChanged(string.Empty);
		}
	}
