namespace DevExpress.Utils.Html.Painter
{
	public class DxHtmlElementPainter
	{
		protected DxHtmlElementBorder[] ElementBorders { get; }

		protected virtual bool CanDrawInnerBackground => false;

		public DxHtmlElementPainter()
		{
			ElementBorders = (DxHtmlElementBorder[])Enum.GetValues(typeof(DxHtmlElementBorder));
		}

		public void Draw(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			if (BeginDraw(drawArgs))
			{
				DrawElement(drawArgs);
				DrawContent(drawArgs);
				EndDraw(drawArgs);
			}
		}

		private bool BeginDraw(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			if (drawArgs.IsRootDrawing)
			{
				drawArgs.UpdateClipBounds();
				DrawBottomPositionedElements(drawArgs);
			}
			if (!CanDrawElement(drawArgs))
			{
				OnAbortElementDrawing(drawArgs);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanDrawElement(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			if (drawArgs.ElementInfo.IsDisplayed && drawArgs.ElementInfo.IsVisible)
			{
				if (drawArgs.ElementInfo.HasPosition)
				{
					return drawArgs.IsPositionedElementDrawing;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnAbortElementDrawing(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
		}

		private void EndDraw(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			drawArgs.ReleaseContentClip();
			if (drawArgs.IsRootDrawing)
			{
				DrawTopPositionedElements(drawArgs);
			}
		}

		private void DrawTopPositionedElements(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			DrawPositionedElements(drawArgs, drawArgs.PositionedElements.GetTopZOrderedElements());
		}

		private void DrawBottomPositionedElements(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			DrawPositionedElements(drawArgs, drawArgs.PositionedElements.GetBottomZOrderedElements());
		}

		private void DrawPositionedElements(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs, IEnumerable<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> elements)
		{
			foreach (DxHtmlElementInfoBase element in elements)
			{
				DrawPositionedElement(element, drawArgs);
			}
		}

		private void DrawPositionedElement(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			System.Drawing.Point location = drawArgs.PositionedElements.AppendOffsetFromRoot(elementInfo, drawArgs.Location);
			DxHtmlElementDrawArgs dxHtmlElementDrawArgs = new DxHtmlElementDrawArgs(drawArgs.GfxCache, elementInfo, location);
			dxHtmlElementDrawArgs.IsPositionedElementDrawing = true;
			elementInfo.Painter.Draw(dxHtmlElementDrawArgs);
			dxHtmlElementDrawArgs.IsPositionedElementDrawing = false;
		}

		private void DrawSelection(DxHtmlSelectionLayer layer, DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			if (drawArgs.ElementInfo.HasSelectedContent && layer == drawArgs.ElementInfo.ContentSelectionLayer && (!drawArgs.IsContentContainer || CanDrawContentContainer(drawArgs)))
			{
				Rectangle absoluteBounds = drawArgs.GetAbsoluteBounds(drawArgs.ElementInfo.SelectionBounds);
				if (!drawArgs.RectIsClipped(absoluteBounds))
				{
					((IGraphicsCache)drawArgs.GfxCache).FillRectangle(drawArgs.ElementInfo.SelectionBackColor, absoluteBounds);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawContent(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			foreach (DxHtmlElementInfoBase child in drawArgs.ElementInfo.Children)
			{
				DrawChild(child, drawArgs);
			}
			DrawSelection(DxHtmlSelectionLayer.Foreground, drawArgs);
		}

		private void DrawChild(DxHtmlElementInfoBase childElementInfo, DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			System.Drawing.Point absoluteLocation = drawArgs.GetAbsoluteLocation(childElementInfo.Location);
			DxHtmlElementDrawArgs dxHtmlElementDrawArgs = new DxHtmlElementDrawArgs(drawArgs.GfxCache, childElementInfo, absoluteLocation);
			dxHtmlElementDrawArgs.DrawingOrder = drawArgs.DrawingOrder;
			dxHtmlElementDrawArgs.ClipBounds = drawArgs.ClipBounds;
			childElementInfo.Painter.Draw(dxHtmlElementDrawArgs);
		}

		private void DrawElement(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			if (!drawArgs.ElementInfo.CustomDraw(drawArgs))
			{
				DrawElementSpanItems(drawArgs);
				if (!drawArgs.IsContentContainer || CanDrawContentContainer(drawArgs))
				{
					DrawSelection(DxHtmlSelectionLayer.Background, drawArgs);
					DrawElementComponents(drawArgs);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DrawElementSpanItems(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			EnsureDrawOrder(drawArgs, drawArgs.ElementInfo.SpanItems);
			DrawOrderedItems(drawArgs);
		}

		private void EnsureDrawOrder(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs, DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<DxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo> elementSpanItems)
		{
			if (elementSpanItems.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo elementSpanItem in elementSpanItems)
			{
				System.Drawing.Point absoluteLocation = drawArgs.GetAbsoluteLocation(elementSpanItem.Location);
				drawArgs.DrawingOrder.Add(elementSpanItem.StartItem, new DxHtmlElementDrawArgs(drawArgs.GfxCache, elementSpanItem, absoluteLocation));
			}
		}

		private void DrawOrderedItems(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			List<DxHtmlElementDrawArgs> list = drawArgs.DrawingOrder.ExtractDrawArgsList(drawArgs.ElementInfo);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (DxHtmlElementDrawArgs item in list)
			{
				item.ElementInfo.Painter.Draw(item);
			}
		}

		private bool CanDrawContentContainer(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo = drawArgs.ElementInfo;
			if (elementInfo?.ParentElementInfo == null || elementInfo.IsTextElement)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (elementInfo.ParentElementInfo.Style.Display != CssDisplay.Flex && elementInfo.ParentElementInfo.Style.Display != CssDisplay.InlineFlex)
			{
				return elementInfo.IsOutOfLayoutFlow;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void DrawElementComponents(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			if (CanDrawElementComponents(drawArgs))
			{
				DrawBackgroundAndBorders(drawArgs);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanDrawElementComponents(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo = drawArgs.ElementInfo;
			DxHtmlElementBordersInfo borders = elementInfo.Borders;
			bool flag = elementInfo.BackColor.A > 0;
			if (!(!borders.IsEmpty || flag) && !elementInfo.HasBackgroundImage && !elementInfo.HasShadow)
			{
				return drawArgs.ShouldClipContent;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void DrawBackgroundAndBorders(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rectangle rectangle = EnsureCorrectSize(drawArgs.GetAbsoluteBounds());
			DxHtmlElementBordersInfo borders = drawArgs.ElementInfo.Borders;
			DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses = AdjustCornerRadiuses(drawArgs.ElementInfo.CornerRadiuses, rectangle);
			bool flag = !dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.IsEmpty;
			if (flag)
			{
				drawArgs.SetHightQualityPaintMode();
			}
			if (!borders.IsEmpty)
			{
				DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses insideCornerRadiuses = GetInsideCornerRadiuses(dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses, borders);
				DxHtmlElementGeometry elementGeometry = GetElementGeometry(drawArgs, rectangle, dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses);
				DxHtmlElementGeometry insideElementGeometry = GetInsideElementGeometry(drawArgs, rectangle, insideCornerRadiuses, borders.ToPadding());
				DxHtmlElementGeometry dxHtmlElementGeometry = DxHtmlElementGeometry.Union(drawArgs.GfxCache, elementGeometry, insideElementGeometry);
				DxHtmlElementGeometry backgroundGeometry = (HasOpaqueBorders(borders) ? insideElementGeometry : elementGeometry);
				DrawShadowLayer(drawArgs, elementGeometry, isBottomLayer: true);
				DrawBackground(drawArgs, backgroundGeometry, flag, isInnerGeometry: false);
				DrawBackgroundImages(drawArgs, backgroundGeometry, flag, isInnerGeometry: false);
				DrawShadowLayer(drawArgs, insideElementGeometry, isBottomLayer: false);
				if (CanDrawInnerBackground)
				{
					DrawBackground(drawArgs, insideElementGeometry, flag, isInnerGeometry: true);
					DrawBackgroundImages(drawArgs, insideElementGeometry, flag, isInnerGeometry: true);
				}
				DrawBorders(drawArgs, borders, dxHtmlElementGeometry, rectangle, insideElementGeometry.Bounds, insideCornerRadiuses);
				drawArgs.ClipContent(insideElementGeometry, flag);
				dxHtmlElementGeometry.Dispose();
				elementGeometry.Dispose();
				insideElementGeometry.Dispose();
			}
			else
			{
				DxHtmlElementGeometry dxHtmlElementGeometry2 = (flag ? GetElementGeometry(drawArgs, rectangle, dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses) : new DxHtmlElementGeometry(null, rectangle, null));
				DrawShadowLayer(drawArgs, dxHtmlElementGeometry2, isBottomLayer: true);
				DrawBackground(drawArgs, dxHtmlElementGeometry2, flag, isInnerGeometry: false);
				DrawBackgroundImages(drawArgs, dxHtmlElementGeometry2, flag, isInnerGeometry: false);
				DrawShadowLayer(drawArgs, dxHtmlElementGeometry2, isBottomLayer: false);
				drawArgs.ClipContent(dxHtmlElementGeometry2, flag);
				dxHtmlElementGeometry2.Dispose();
			}
			drawArgs.RestorePaintMode();
		}

		private Rectangle EnsureCorrectSize(Rectangle rect)
		{
			if (rect.Width < 0)
			{
				rect.Width = 0;
			}
			if (rect.Height < 0)
			{
				rect.Height = 0;
			}
			return rect;
		}

		private bool HasOpaqueBorders(DxHtmlElementBordersInfo borders)
		{
			if (borders.CommonColor.HasValue)
			{
				return borders.CommonColor.Value.A == byte.MaxValue;
			}
			if (borders.Left.Width > 0 && borders.Left.Color.A < byte.MaxValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (borders.Right.Width > 0 && borders.Right.Color.A < byte.MaxValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (borders.Bottom.Width > 0 && borders.Bottom.Color.A < byte.MaxValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (borders.Top.Width > 0 && borders.Top.Color.A < byte.MaxValue)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual void DrawShadowLayer(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs, DxHtmlElementGeometry backgroundGeometry, bool isBottomLayer)
		{
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo = drawArgs.ElementInfo;
			if (elementInfo.Width > 0 && elementInfo.Height > 0 && elementInfo.HasShadow && (isBottomLayer ^ elementInfo.Shadow.IsInset))
			{
				backgroundGeometry.DrawShadow(drawArgs.GfxCache, elementInfo);
			}
		}

		private void DrawBorders(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs, DxHtmlElementBordersInfo borders, DxHtmlElementGeometry bordersGeometry, Rectangle outerBounds, RectangleF innerBounds, DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses insideCornerRadiuses)
		{
			if (borders.CommonColor.HasValue)
			{
				System.Drawing.Brush solidBrush = ((IGraphicsCache)drawArgs.GfxCache).GetSolidBrush(borders.CommonColor.Value);
				bordersGeometry.Fill(drawArgs.GfxCache, solidBrush, usePath: true);
				return;
			}
			DxHtmlElementBorder[] elementBorders = ElementBorders;
			foreach (DxHtmlElementBorder dxHtmlElementBorder in elementBorders)
			{
				DxHtmlElementBorderInfo dxHtmlElementBorderInfo = borders[dxHtmlElementBorder];
				if (dxHtmlElementBorderInfo.Width != 0)
				{
					System.Drawing.Brush solidBrush2 = ((IGraphicsCache)drawArgs.GfxCache).GetSolidBrush(dxHtmlElementBorderInfo.Color);
					IDxGraphicsPath borderClipPath = GetBorderClipPath(drawArgs, dxHtmlElementBorder, outerBounds, innerBounds, insideCornerRadiuses);
					drawArgs.GfxCache.PushClip(borderClipPath, outerBounds);
					bordersGeometry.Fill(drawArgs.GfxCache, solidBrush2, usePath: true);
					drawArgs.GfxCache.PopClip();
					((IDisposable)borderClipPath).Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void FillBorders(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, System.Drawing.Brush brush, DxHtmlElementGeometry bordersGeometry, bool usePath)
		{
			bordersGeometry.Fill(cache, brush, usePath);
		}

		protected virtual void DrawBackground(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs, DxHtmlElementGeometry backgroundGeometry, bool usePath, bool isInnerGeometry)
		{
			backgroundGeometry.Fill(drawArgs.GfxCache, ((IGraphicsCache)drawArgs.GfxCache).GetSolidBrush(drawArgs.ElementInfo.BackColor), usePath);
		}

		private RectangleF GetClipRect(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			if (drawArgs.ClipBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return drawArgs.ElementInfo.GetAbsoluteBounds();
			}
			return RectangleF.Intersect(drawArgs.ClipBounds, drawArgs.ElementInfo.GetAbsoluteBounds());
		}

		protected virtual void DrawBackgroundImages(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs, DxHtmlElementGeometry backgroundGeometry, bool usePath, bool isInnerGeometry)
		{
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo = drawArgs.ElementInfo;
			foreach (CssBackgroundImageProperties backgroundImage in elementInfo.Style.BackgroundImages)
			{
				if (!backgroundImage.HasImagePath)
				{
					continue;
				}
				RectangleF client = new RectangleF(System.Drawing.Point.Empty, backgroundGeometry.Bounds.Size);
				HashSet<RectangleF> imageRects = elementInfo.GetBackgroundImageInfo(drawArgs.GfxCache, client, backgroundImage.ImagePath.Value).ImageRects;
				ColorMatrix colorMatrix = ((elementInfo.Opacity < 1f) ? new ColorMatrix
				{
					Matrix33 = elementInfo.Opacity
				} : null);
				IGraphicsClipState val = ((IGraphicsCache)drawArgs.GfxCache).SaveAndSetClip(GetClipRect(drawArgs), false);
				try
				{
					object image = elementInfo.GetImage(backgroundImage.ImagePath.Value, elementInfo.RootElement.ActualClient, isBindable: false);
					foreach (RectangleF item in imageRects)
					{
						backgroundGeometry.DrawImage(drawArgs.GfxCache, image, drawArgs.GetAbsoluteBounds(Rectangle.Round(item)), elementInfo.Opacity, usePath);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((IGraphicsCache)drawArgs.GfxCache).RestoreClip(val);
				}
			}
		}

		protected DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses AdjustCornerRadiuses(DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses cornerRadiuses, Rectangle rect)
		{
			float val = (float)rect.Width / (cornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Width + cornerRadiuses.TopRight.Width);
			val = Math.Min(val, (float)rect.Width / (cornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Width + cornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Width));
			val = Math.Min(val, (float)rect.Height / (cornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Height + cornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Height));
			val = Math.Min(val, (float)rect.Height / (cornerRadiuses.TopRight.Height + cornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Height));
			if (val < 1f)
			{
				DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses = cornerRadiuses.Clone();
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Width *= val;
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Height *= val;
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopRight.Width *= val;
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopRight.Height *= val;
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Width *= val;
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Height *= val;
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Width *= val;
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Height *= val;
				return dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses;
			}
			return cornerRadiuses;
		}

		private DxHtmlElementGeometry GetElementGeometry(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs, RectangleF rect, DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses radiuses)
		{
			IDxHtmlGraphicsCache gfxCache = drawArgs.GfxCache;
			IDxGraphicsPath val = gfxCache.CreateDxPath();
			val.StartFigure();
			bool flag = radiuses.TopLeft.Width == 0f || radiuses.TopLeft.Height == 0f;
			bool flag2 = radiuses.TopRight.Width == 0f || radiuses.TopRight.Height == 0f;
			bool flag3 = radiuses.BottomRight.Width == 0f || radiuses.BottomRight.Height == 0f;
			bool flag4 = radiuses.BottomLeft.Width == 0f || radiuses.BottomLeft.Height == 0f;
			RectangleF bounds = rect;
			if (!flag)
			{
				RectangleF rectangleF = AddNormalizedArc(gfxCache, val, rect, radiuses.TopLeft, (IDxGraphicsPath p, SizeF d) => AddArc(p, rect.X, rect.Y, d.Width, d.Height, 180f, 90f));
				bounds.X = Math.Max(bounds.X, rectangleF.X);
				bounds.Y = Math.Max(bounds.Y, rectangleF.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				val.AddLine(rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Right - Math.Min(rect.Width, (!flag2) ? radiuses.TopLeft.Width : 0f), rect.Y);
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				RectangleF rectangleF2 = AddNormalizedArc(gfxCache, val, rect, radiuses.TopRight, (IDxGraphicsPath p, SizeF d) => AddArc(p, rect.Right - d.Width, rect.Y, d.Width, d.Height, 270f, 90f));
				bounds.Width = Math.Min(bounds.Right - bounds.X, rectangleF2.Right - bounds.X);
				bounds.Y = Math.Max(bounds.Y, rectangleF2.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					val.AddLine(rect.X + Math.Min(rect.Width, radiuses.TopLeft.Width), rect.Y, rect.Right, rect.Y);
				}
				val.AddLine(rect.Right, rect.Y, rect.Right, rect.Bottom - Math.Min(rect.Height, (!flag3) ? radiuses.BottomRight.Height : 0f));
			}
			if (!flag3)
			{
				RectangleF rectangleF3 = AddNormalizedArc(gfxCache, val, rect, radiuses.BottomRight, (IDxGraphicsPath p, SizeF d) => AddArc(p, rect.Right - d.Width, rect.Bottom - d.Height, d.Width, d.Height, 0f, 90f));
				bounds.Width = Math.Min(bounds.Right - bounds.X, rectangleF3.Right - bounds.X);
				bounds.Height = Math.Min(bounds.Bottom - bounds.Y, rectangleF3.Bottom - bounds.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!flag2)
				{
					val.AddLine(rect.Right, rect.Bottom, rect.Right, rect.Y + Math.Min(rect.Height, radiuses.TopRight.Height));
				}
				val.AddLine(rect.Right, rect.Bottom, rect.X + Math.Min(rect.Width, (!flag4) ? radiuses.BottomLeft.Width : 0f), rect.Bottom);
			}
			if (!flag4)
			{
				RectangleF rectangleF4 = AddNormalizedArc(gfxCache, val, rect, radiuses.BottomLeft, (IDxGraphicsPath p, SizeF d) => AddArc(p, rect.X, rect.Bottom - d.Height, d.Width, d.Height, 90f, 90f));
				bounds.X = Math.Max(bounds.X, rectangleF4.X);
				bounds.Height = Math.Max(bounds.Bottom - bounds.Y, rectangleF4.Bottom - bounds.Y);
			}
			else
			{
				if (!flag3)
				{
					val.AddLine(rect.Right - Math.Min(rect.Width, radiuses.BottomRight.Width), rect.Bottom, rect.X, rect.Bottom);
				}
				val.AddLine(rect.X, rect.Bottom, rect.X, rect.Y + Math.Min(rect.Height, (!flag) ? radiuses.TopLeft.Height : 0f));
			}
			val.CloseFigure();
			return new DxHtmlElementGeometry(val, bounds, radiuses);
		}

		private RectangleF AddArc(IDxGraphicsPath path, float x, float y, float width, float height, float startAngle, float sweepAngle)
		{
			path.AddArc(x, y, width, height, startAngle, sweepAngle);
			return new RectangleF(x, y, width, height);
		}

		private RectangleF AddNormalizedArc(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, IDxGraphicsPath path, RectangleF bounds, SizeF cornerRadiuses, Func<IDxGraphicsPath, SizeF, RectangleF> addArcAction)
		{
			SizeF arg = new SizeF(cornerRadiuses.Width * 2f, cornerRadiuses.Height * 2f);
			if ((float)(int)(cornerRadiuses.Width + 0.5f) <= bounds.Width && (float)(int)(cornerRadiuses.Height + 0.5f) <= bounds.Height)
			{
				return addArcAction(path, arg);
			}
			IDxGraphicsPath val = cache.CreateDxPath();
			addArcAction(val, arg);
			val.Flatten((IDxMatrix)null, 0.001f);
			List<PointF> list = val.PathPoints.ToList();
			List<byte> list2 = val.PathTypes.ToList();
			((IDisposable)val).Dispose();
			for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				PointF pointF = list[num];
				if (pointF.X < bounds.X || pointF.X > bounds.Right || pointF.Y < bounds.Y || pointF.Y > bounds.Bottom)
				{
					list.RemoveAt(num);
					list2.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return addArcAction(path, arg);
			}
			list[0] = NormalizePoint(list[0], bounds);
			list[list.Count - 1] = NormalizePoint(list[list.Count - 1], bounds);
			val = cache.CreateDxPath(list.ToArray(), list2.ToArray());
			RectangleF bounds2 = val.GetBounds();
			path.AddPath(val, true);
			((IDisposable)val).Dispose();
			return bounds2;
		}

		private PointF NormalizePoint(PointF point, RectangleF bounds)
		{
			System.Drawing.Point point2 = new System.Drawing.Point((int)(point.X + 0.5f), (int)(point.Y + 0.5f));
			if ((float)point2.X == bounds.X || (float)(point2.X + 1) == bounds.X || (float)(point2.X - 1) == bounds.X)
			{
				point.X = bounds.X;
			}
			if ((float)point2.X == bounds.Right || (float)(point2.X + 1) == bounds.Right || (float)(point2.X - 1) == bounds.Right)
			{
				point.X = bounds.Right;
			}
			if ((float)point2.Y == bounds.Y || (float)(point2.Y + 1) == bounds.Y || (float)(point2.Y - 1) == bounds.Y)
			{
				point.Y = bounds.Y;
			}
			if ((float)point2.Y == bounds.Bottom || (float)(point2.Y + 1) == bounds.Bottom || (float)(point2.Y - 1) == bounds.Bottom)
			{
				point.Y = bounds.Bottom;
			}
			return point;
		}

		protected DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses GetInsideCornerRadiuses(DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses radiuses, DxHtmlElementBordersInfo borders)
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return GetInsideCornerRadiuses(radiuses, borders.ToPadding());
		}

		protected DxHtmlElementGeometry GetInsideElementGeometry(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs, Rectangle rect, DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses insideCornerRadiuses, PortablePadding padding)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(rect.X + ((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Left, rect.Y + ((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Top, rect.Width - ((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Left - ((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Right, rect.Height - ((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Top - ((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Bottom);
			return GetElementGeometry(drawArgs, rectangle, insideCornerRadiuses);
		}

		protected DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses GetInsideCornerRadiuses(DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses radiuses, PortablePadding padding)
		{
			DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses = new DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses();
			dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopLeft = new SizeF(Math.Max(0f, radiuses.TopLeft.Width - (float)((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Left), Math.Max(0f, radiuses.TopLeft.Height - (float)((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Top));
			dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopRight = new SizeF(Math.Max(0f, radiuses.TopRight.Width - (float)((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Right), Math.Max(0f, radiuses.TopRight.Height - (float)((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Top));
			dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomLeft = new SizeF(Math.Max(0f, radiuses.BottomLeft.Width - (float)((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Left), Math.Max(0f, radiuses.BottomLeft.Height - (float)((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Bottom));
			dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomRight = new SizeF(Math.Max(0f, radiuses.BottomRight.Width - (float)((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Right), Math.Max(0f, radiuses.BottomRight.Height - (float)((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Bottom));
			return dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses;
		}

		private IDxGraphicsPath GetBorderClipPath(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs, DxHtmlElementBorder border, Rectangle outerRect, RectangleF innerRect, DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses innerCornerRadiuses)
		{
			DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses = new DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses();
			if (innerCornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Width > 0f && innerCornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Height > 0f)
			{
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Width = Math.Min(innerCornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Width, innerRect.Width);
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Height = Math.Min(innerCornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Height, innerRect.Height);
			}
			if (innerCornerRadiuses.TopRight.Width > 0f && innerCornerRadiuses.TopRight.Height > 0f)
			{
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopRight.Width = Math.Min(innerCornerRadiuses.TopRight.Width, innerRect.Width);
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopRight.Height = Math.Min(innerCornerRadiuses.TopRight.Height, innerRect.Height);
			}
			if (innerCornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Width > 0f && innerCornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Height > 0f)
			{
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Width = Math.Min(innerCornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Width, innerRect.Width);
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Height = Math.Min(innerCornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Height, innerRect.Height);
			}
			if (innerCornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Width > 0f && innerCornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Height > 0f)
			{
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Width = Math.Min(innerCornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Width, innerRect.Width);
				dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Height = Math.Min(innerCornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Height, innerRect.Height);
			}
			PointF pointF = new PointF(outerRect.X, outerRect.Y);
			PointF pointF2 = new PointF(outerRect.Right, outerRect.Y);
			PointF pointF3 = new PointF(outerRect.X, outerRect.Bottom);
			PointF pointF4 = new PointF(outerRect.Right, outerRect.Bottom);
			PointF pointF5 = new PointF(innerRect.X + dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Width, innerRect.Y + dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopLeft.Height);
			PointF pointF6 = new PointF(innerRect.X + dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Width, innerRect.Bottom - dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomLeft.Height);
			PointF pointF7 = new PointF(innerRect.Right - dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopRight.Width, innerRect.Top + dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.TopRight.Height);
			PointF pointF8 = new PointF(innerRect.Right - dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Width, innerRect.Bottom - dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.BottomRight.Height);
			IDxGraphicsPath val = drawArgs.GfxCache.CreateDxPath();
			PointF[] array = new PointF[4];
			if (border == DxHtmlElementBorder.Left)
			{
				array[0] = pointF3;
				array[1] = pointF;
				array[2] = pointF5;
				array[3] = pointF6;
			}
			if (border == DxHtmlElementBorder.Top)
			{
				array[0] = pointF;
				array[1] = pointF2;
				array[2] = pointF7;
				array[3] = pointF5;
			}
			if (border == DxHtmlElementBorder.Right)
			{
				array[0] = pointF7;
				array[1] = pointF2;
				array[2] = pointF4;
				array[3] = pointF8;
			}
			if (border == DxHtmlElementBorder.Bottom)
			{
				array[0] = pointF3;
				array[1] = pointF6;
				array[2] = pointF8;
				array[3] = pointF4;
			}
			val.AddPolygon(array);
			return val;
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlElementGeometry : IDisposable
	{
		public IDxGraphicsPath Path { get; }

		public RectangleF Bounds { get; }

		internal DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses Radiuses { get; }

		public static DxHtmlElementGeometry Union(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementGeometry first, DxHtmlElementGeometry second)
		{
			IDxGraphicsPath val = cache.CreateDxPath();
			if (first.Path != null)
			{
				val.AddPath(first.Path, false);
			}
			if (second.Path != null)
			{
				val.AddPath(second.Path, false);
			}
			RectangleF bounds = RectangleF.Union(first.Bounds, second.Bounds);
			return new DxHtmlElementGeometry(val, bounds, null);
		}

		public DxHtmlElementGeometry(IDxGraphicsPath path, RectangleF bounds, DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses radiuses)
		{
			Path = path;
			Bounds = bounds;
			Radiuses = radiuses;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			((IDisposable)Path)?.Dispose();
		}

		public void Fill(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, System.Drawing.Brush brush, bool usePath)
		{
			if (usePath)
			{
				cache.FillPath(brush, Path);
			}
			else
			{
				((IGraphicsCache)cache).FillRectangle(brush, Bounds);
			}
		}

		public void PushClip(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, bool usePath)
		{
			if (usePath)
			{
				cache.PushClip(Path, Bounds);
			}
			else
			{
				cache.PushClip(Bounds);
			}
		}

		public void PopClip(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache)
		{
			cache.PopClip();
		}

		public void DrawShadow(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
			IDxGraphicsPath val = Path;
			bool flag = false;
			if (val == null)
			{
				flag = true;
				val = cache.CreateDxPath();
				val.AddRectangle(Bounds);
			}
			elementInfo.Shadow.Draw(cache, val, Rectangle.Round(Bounds), Radiuses);
			if (flag)
			{
				((IDisposable)val).Dispose();
			}
		}

		public void DrawImage(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, object image, Rectangle rect, float opacity, bool usePath)
		{
			DrawImage(cache, image, null, rect, opacity, usePath);
		}

		public void DrawImage(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, object image, ISvgPaletteProvider svgPaletteProvider, Rectangle rect, float opacity, bool usePath)
		{
			System.Drawing.Image image2 = cache.GetImage(image, rect.Size, svgPaletteProvider);
			ColorMatrix matrix = ((opacity < 1f) ? new ColorMatrix
			{
				Matrix33 = opacity
			} : null);
			if (usePath)
			{
				cache.FillPath(Path, image2, rect, matrix);
			}
			else
			{
				cache.DrawImage(image2, rect, matrix);
			}
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlElementDrawArgs
	{
		private IDxHtmlGraphicsCache gfxCache;

		private SmoothingMode savedSmoothingMode;

		private PixelOffsetMode savedPixelOffsetMode;

		private bool paintModeSaved;

		public readonly System.Drawing.Point Location;

		public readonly DxHtmlElementInfoBase ElementInfo;

		public bool ContentClipped;

		public bool IsPositionedElementDrawing;

		public DxHtmlElementDrawingOrder DrawingOrder;

		public IDxHtmlGraphicsCache GfxCache => gfxCache;

		public DxHtmlRootElementInfo RootElementInfo => ElementInfo.RootElementInfo;

		public DxHtmlPositionedElementsInfo PositionedElements => RootElementInfo.PositionedElements;

		public bool ShouldClipContent
		{
			get
			{
				if (ElementInfo.Style.OverflowX != CssOverflow.Hidden)
				{
					return ElementInfo.Style.OverflowY == CssOverflow.Hidden;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsRootDrawing => ElementInfo.RootElementInfo == ElementInfo;

		public bool IsContentContainer => ElementInfo.IsContentContainer;

		public RectangleF ClipBounds { get; internal set; }

		public DxHtmlElementDrawArgs(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache gfxCache, DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, System.Drawing.Point location)
		{
			this.gfxCache = gfxCache;
			Location = location;
			ElementInfo = elementInfo;
			DrawingOrder = new DxHtmlElementDrawingOrder();
		}

		public void UpdateClipBounds()
		{
			ClipBounds = ((IGraphicsCache)gfxCache).GetClipBounds();
		}

		public bool RectIsClipped(Rectangle rect)
		{
			if (ClipBounds != RectangleF.Empty)
			{
				if (!((float)rect.Top > ClipBounds.Bottom))
				{
					return (float)rect.Bottom < ClipBounds.Top;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public System.Drawing.Point GetAbsoluteLocation(System.Drawing.Point point)
		{
			point.Offset(Location);
			return point;
		}

		public Rectangle GetAbsoluteBounds(Rectangle rect)
		{
			rect.Offset(Location);
			return rect;
		}

		public void SetHightQualityPaintMode()
		{
			savedSmoothingMode = ((IGraphicsCache)gfxCache).SmoothingMode;
			savedPixelOffsetMode = gfxCache.PixelOffsetMode;
			((IGraphicsCache)gfxCache).SmoothingMode = SmoothingMode.HighQuality;
			gfxCache.PixelOffsetMode = PixelOffsetMode.Half;
			paintModeSaved = true;
		}

		public void RestorePaintMode()
		{
			if (paintModeSaved)
			{
				((IGraphicsCache)gfxCache).SmoothingMode = savedSmoothingMode;
				gfxCache.PixelOffsetMode = savedPixelOffsetMode;
				paintModeSaved = false;
			}
		}

		public void ClipContent(DxHtmlElementGeometry contentGeometry, bool hasCornerRadius)
		{
			if (ShouldClipContent)
			{
				contentGeometry.PushClip(gfxCache, hasCornerRadius);
				ContentClipped = true;
			}
		}

		public void ReleaseContentClip()
		{
			if (ContentClipped)
			{
				gfxCache.PopClip();
				ContentClipped = false;
			}
		}

		public Rectangle GetAbsoluteBounds(System.Drawing.Size size)
		{
			return new Rectangle(Location, size);
		}

		public Rectangle GetAbsoluteBounds()
		{
			return new Rectangle(Location, ElementInfo.Size);
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlElementDrawingOrder
	{
		private Dictionary<DxHtmlElementInfoBase, List<DxHtmlElementDrawArgs>> itemsOrder;

		public DxHtmlElementDrawingOrder()
		{
			itemsOrder = new Dictionary<DxHtmlElementInfoBase, List<DxHtmlElementDrawArgs>>();
		}

		public void Add(DxHtmlElementInfoBase drawingStartTarget, DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			if (!itemsOrder.TryGetValue(drawingStartTarget, out var value))
			{
				value = new List<DxHtmlElementDrawArgs>();
				itemsOrder.Add(drawingStartTarget, value);
			}
			value.Add(drawArgs);
		}

		public List<DxHtmlElementDrawArgs> ExtractDrawArgsList(DxHtmlElementInfoBase drawingStartTarget)
		{
			if (itemsOrder.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (itemsOrder.TryGetValue(drawingStartTarget, out var value))
			{
				itemsOrder.Remove(drawingStartTarget);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlTextElementPainter : DxHtmlElementPainter
	{
		protected override void DrawElementComponents(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			base.DrawElementComponents(drawArgs);
			DxHtmlTextElementInfoBase dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase = (DxHtmlTextElementInfoBase)drawArgs.ElementInfo;
			Rectangle absoluteBounds = drawArgs.GetAbsoluteBounds(dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.ClientRectangle);
			if (dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.Font == null || dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.IsWhiteSpace || drawArgs.RectIsClipped(absoluteBounds))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.HasSelectedContent && dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase is DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo && dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo.TextRuns.Length != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo.TextRuns.Length; i++)
				{
					DxHtmlTextRun dxHtmlTextRun = dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo.TextRuns[i];
					Rectangle absoluteBounds2 = drawArgs.GetAbsoluteBounds(dxHtmlTextRun.Bounds);
					drawArgs.GfxCache.DrawString(dxHtmlTextRun.Text, dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.Font, dxHtmlTextRun.ForeColor, absoluteBounds2, dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.TabWidth);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				System.Drawing.Color foreColor = (dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.HasSelectedContent ? dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.SelectionForeColor : dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.ForeColor);
				drawArgs.GfxCache.DrawString(dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.Text, dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.Font, foreColor, absoluteBounds, dxHtmlTextElementInfoBase.TabWidth);
			}
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlListPainter : DxHtmlElementPainter
	{
		protected override void DrawElementComponents(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			base.DrawElementComponents(drawArgs);
			DxHtmlOrderedListInfoCore dxHtmlOrderedListInfoCore = (DxHtmlOrderedListInfoCore)drawArgs.ElementInfo;
			for (int i = 0; i < dxHtmlOrderedListInfoCore.MarkerInfos.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlOrderedListInfoCore.MarkerInfo markerInfo = dxHtmlOrderedListInfoCore.MarkerInfos[i];
				Rectangle absoluteBounds = drawArgs.GetAbsoluteBounds(dxHtmlOrderedListInfoCore.GetMarkerBounds(markerInfo));
				if (!drawArgs.RectIsClipped(absoluteBounds))
				{
					drawArgs.GfxCache.DrawString(markerInfo.Text, markerInfo.Marker.Font, markerInfo.Marker.ForeColor, absoluteBounds);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlImagePainter : DxHtmlElementPainter
	{
		protected override bool CanDrawInnerBackground => true;

		protected override bool CanDrawElementComponents(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			DxHtmlImageElementInfoBase dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase = drawArgs.ElementInfo as DxHtmlImageElementInfoBase;
			if (!base.CanDrawElementComponents(drawArgs))
			{
				return dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.Image != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void DrawBackground(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs args, DxHtmlElementGeometry backgroundGeometry, bool usePath, bool isInnerGeometry)
		{
			//IL_00c4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0107: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!isInnerGeometry)
			{
				base.DrawBackground(args, backgroundGeometry, usePath, isInnerGeometry);
			}
			if (!isInnerGeometry && !args.ElementInfo.Borders.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			DxHtmlImageElementInfoBase dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase = (DxHtmlImageElementInfoBase)args.ElementInfo;
			if (dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.Image == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle absoluteBounds = args.GetAbsoluteBounds(dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.ImageBounds);
			Rectangle absoluteBounds2 = args.GetAbsoluteBounds(dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.ClientRectangle);
			if (dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.PlaceholderImageUsed && dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.Borders.IsEmpty)
			{
				using System.Drawing.Pen pen = new System.Drawing.Pen(dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.PlaceholderColor)
				{
					DashStyle = System.Drawing.Drawing2D.DashStyle.Dash
				};
				((IGraphicsCache)args.GfxCache).DrawRectangle(pen, absoluteBounds2);
			}
			bool flag = !usePath && CanClip(absoluteBounds2, absoluteBounds);
			if (flag)
			{
				args.GfxCache.PushClip(absoluteBounds2);
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (usePath && dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.Padding != PortablePadding.Empty)
			{
				flag2 = true;
				Rectangle absoluteBounds3 = args.GetAbsoluteBounds();
				DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses radiuses = AdjustCornerRadiuses(dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.CornerRadiuses, absoluteBounds3);
				DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses insideCornerRadiuses = GetInsideCornerRadiuses(radiuses, dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.ContentPadding);
				backgroundGeometry = GetInsideElementGeometry(args, absoluteBounds3, insideCornerRadiuses, dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.ContentPadding);
			}
			backgroundGeometry.DrawImage(args.GfxCache, dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.Image, dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.GetSvgPalette(), absoluteBounds, dxHtmlImageElementInfoBase.Opacity, usePath);
			if (flag2)
			{
				backgroundGeometry.Dispose();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				args.GfxCache.PopClip();
			}
		}

		private bool CanClip(Rectangle bounds, Rectangle innerRect)
		{
			if (innerRect.X >= bounds.X && innerRect.Right <= bounds.Right && innerRect.Top >= bounds.Top)
			{
				return innerRect.Bottom > bounds.Bottom;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlInputPainter : DxHtmlElementPainter
	{
		protected override void DrawElementComponents(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			DxHtmlInputElement dxHtmlInputElement = drawArgs.ElementInfo.Element as DxHtmlInputElement;
			UpdateControlBounds(drawArgs);
			base.DrawElementComponents(drawArgs);
			if (dxHtmlInputElement.IsRepositoryItem)
			{
				DrawRepositoryItem(dxHtmlInputElement, drawArgs);
			}
		}

		private void DrawRepositoryItem(DxHtmlInputElement inputElement, DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			Rectangle absoluteBounds = drawArgs.GetAbsoluteBounds(inputElement.ViewInfo.ClientRectangle);
			IGraphicsCache graphicsCache = (drawArgs.GfxCache as GraphicsCacheDxHtmlWrapperBase).GraphicsCache;
			inputElement.RootElement.RepositoryHelper?.Draw(graphicsCache, inputElement, absoluteBounds, inputElement.InputTag.Value.FieldName);
		}

		private void UpdateControlBounds(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			DxHtmlInputElementInfo dxHtmlInputElementInfo = drawArgs.ElementInfo as DxHtmlInputElementInfo;
			dxHtmlInputElementInfo.UpdateControlBounds(drawArgs.Location);
		}

		protected override void OnAbortElementDrawing(DxHtmlElementDrawArgs drawArgs)
		{
			if (!drawArgs.ElementInfo.IsDisplayed)
			{
				UpdateControlBounds(drawArgs);
			}
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Utils.Html.Layout
{
	public abstract class DxHtmlElementLayout
	{
		private struct Distance
		{
			public static readonly int Max = 1073741823;

			public static readonly Distance Default = new Distance(Max, Max);

			public int XDistance { get; set; }

			public int YDistance { get; set; }

			public Distance(int xDistance, int yDistance)
			{
				XDistance = xDistance;
				YDistance = yDistance;
			}
		}

		public virtual DxHtmlElementInfoBase CalcHitInfo(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, System.Drawing.Point location)
		{
			location.Offset(-elementInfo.X, -elementInfo.Y);
			DxHtmlChildInfoCollectionBase children = elementInfo.Children;
			for (int num = children.Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
			{
				DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = children[num];
				if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase.IsVisible && dxHtmlElementInfoBase.IsDisplayed && !dxHtmlElementInfoBase.HasPosition)
				{
					if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase.IsContentContainer)
					{
						DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase2 = dxHtmlElementInfoBase.CalcHitInfo(location);
						if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase2 != null && dxHtmlElementInfoBase2 != dxHtmlElementInfoBase)
						{
							return dxHtmlElementInfoBase2;
						}
						if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase.SpanItems.Count > 0)
						{
							System.Drawing.Point pt = location;
							pt.Offset(-dxHtmlElementInfoBase.X, -dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Y);
							for (int i = 0; i < dxHtmlElementInfoBase.SpanItems.Count; i++)
							{
								DxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo dxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo = dxHtmlElementInfoBase.SpanItems[i];
								if (dxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo.Bounds.Contains(pt))
								{
									return dxHtmlElementInfoBase;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					else if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Bounds.Contains(location))
					{
						return dxHtmlElementInfoBase.CalcHitInfo(location);
					}
				}
			}
			return elementInfo;
		}

		internal virtual DxHtmlElementInfoBase FindClosestChild(DxHtmlElementInfoBase element, System.Drawing.Point point)
		{
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase result = element;
			Distance distance = Distance.Default;
			for (int i = 0; i < element.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = element.Children[i];
				if (CanProcess(dxHtmlElementInfoBase) && PointIsCloserToRect(point, dxHtmlElementInfoBase, ref distance))
				{
					result = ((!(dxHtmlElementInfoBase is DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo)) ? dxHtmlElementInfoBase : dxHtmlElementInfoBase.ParentElementInfo);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool PointIsCloserToRect(System.Drawing.Point point, DxHtmlElementInfoBase element, ref Distance distance)
		{
			Rectangle bounds = element.Bounds;
			int num = point.X - bounds.X;
			int num2 = point.X - bounds.Right;
			int num3 = point.Y - bounds.Y;
			int num4 = point.Y - bounds.Bottom;
			int num5 = ((num < 0 || num2 > 0) ? Math.Min(Math.Abs(num), Math.Abs(num2)) : 0);
			int num6 = ((num3 < 0 || num4 > 0) ? Math.Min(Math.Abs(num3), Math.Abs(num4)) : 0);
			if (num5 <= distance.XDistance)
			{
				if (num5 < distance.XDistance)
				{
					distance.YDistance = Distance.Max;
				}
				if (num6 < distance.YDistance)
				{
					distance.XDistance = num5;
					distance.YDistance = num6;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool CanProcess(DxHtmlElementInfoBase element)
		{
			if (element.Width <= 0 || element.Height <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsLogical(element);
		}

		protected bool IsLogical(DxHtmlElementInfoBase element)
		{
			if (!element.IsWhiteSpace)
			{
				return true;
			}
			CssTextProperties textProperties = element.Style.TextProperties;
			CssWhiteSpace value = textProperties.WhiteSpace.Value;
			if (value != CssWhiteSpace.Pre)
			{
				return value == CssWhiteSpace.PreWrap;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		protected virtual System.Drawing.Size CalcElement(DxHtmlElementInfoBase element, IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, bool columnLayout, int offsetX = 0, int offsetY = 0, int forcedWidth = -1, int forcedHeight = -1)
		{
			//IL_02a8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02c1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02c6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			args.ApplyOwnMarginsBeforeLayout = false;
			element.Calc(cache, args);
			args.ApplyOwnMarginsBeforeLayout = true;
			System.Drawing.Size size = element.Size;
			if (forcedWidth > -1)
			{
				if (forcedWidth > size.Width || (!columnLayout && CalcFlexBasis(element, args) == forcedWidth) || element.PredefinedSize.Width + element.NonClientSize.Width == forcedWidth)
				{
					size.Width = forcedWidth;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (element.StyleWidth.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length)
				{
					size.Width = element.PredefinedSize.Width + element.NonClientSize.Width;
				}
				if (element.Style.FlexBasis.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length && !columnLayout)
				{
					size.Width = CalcFlexBasis(element, args) + element.NonClientSize.Width;
				}
				if (element.HasMaxWidth && size.Width > element.MaxSize.Width)
				{
					size.Width = element.MaxSize.Width + element.NonClientSize.Width;
				}
				if (element.HasMinWidth && size.Width < element.MinSize.Width)
				{
					size.Width = element.MinSize.Width + element.NonClientSize.Width;
				}
			}
			if (forcedHeight > -1)
			{
				if (forcedHeight > size.Height || (columnLayout && CalcFlexBasis(element, args) == forcedHeight) || element.PredefinedSize.Height + element.NonClientSize.Height == forcedHeight)
				{
					size.Height = forcedHeight;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (element.StyleHeight.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length)
				{
					size.Height = element.PredefinedSize.Height + element.NonClientSize.Height;
				}
				if (element.Style.FlexBasis.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length && columnLayout)
				{
					size.Height = CalcFlexBasis(element, args) + element.NonClientSize.Height;
				}
				if (element.HasMaxHeight && size.Height > element.MaxSize.Height)
				{
					size.Height = element.MaxSize.Height + element.NonClientSize.Height;
				}
				if (element.HasMinHeight && size.Height < element.MinSize.Height)
				{
					size.Height = element.MinSize.Height + element.NonClientSize.Height;
				}
			}
			System.Drawing.Point location = element.Location;
			PortablePadding margin = GetMargin(element);
			location.X = ((PortablePadding)(ref margin)).Left + offsetX;
			margin = GetMargin(element);
			location.Y = ((PortablePadding)(ref margin)).Top + offsetY;
			element.Bounds = new Rectangle(location, size);
			return size;
		}

		private List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> GetVisibleChildren(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
			List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> excludedChildren = null;
			return GetVisibleChildrenCore(elementInfo, ref excludedChildren, fillExcludedChildren: false);
		}

		private List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> GetVisibleChildren(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, out List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> excludedChildren)
		{
			excludedChildren = null;
			return GetVisibleChildrenCore(elementInfo, ref excludedChildren, fillExcludedChildren: true);
		}

		private List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> GetVisibleChildrenCore(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, ref List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> excludedChildren, bool fillExcludedChildren)
		{
			List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> list = new List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase>(elementInfo.Children);
			for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = list[num];
				if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Hidden || dxHtmlElementInfoBase.IsWhiteSpace || dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Style.Display == CssDisplay.None || dxHtmlElementInfoBase.IsOutOfLayoutFlow)
				{
					list.RemoveAt(num);
					if (fillExcludedChildren)
					{
						if (excludedChildren == null)
						{
							excludedChildren = new List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase>();
						}
						excludedChildren.Add(dxHtmlElementInfoBase);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> CombineTextRuns(List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> children, DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
			List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> list = new List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase>(children.Count);
			int i = 0;
			while (i < children.Count)
			{
				DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = children[i];
				if (!dxHtmlElementInfoBase.IsTextElement && dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Element.NodeName != "br")
				{
					list.Add(dxHtmlElementInfoBase);
					i++;
					continue;
				}
				int j;
				for (j = i + 1; j < children.Count && (children[j].IsTextElement || children[j].IsWhiteSpace || children[j].Element.NodeName == "br"); j++)
				{
				}
				if (j - i == 1)
				{
					list.Add(dxHtmlElementInfoBase);
					i++;
					continue;
				}
				DxHtmlDocumentTag tag = new DxHtmlDocumentTag("div", CssDisplay.InlineBlock);
				DxHtmlDocumentNode documentNode = new DxHtmlDocumentNode(tag);
				DxHtmlElementBase dxHtmlElementBase = new DxHtmlAnonymousElement(documentNode, elementInfo);
				DxHtmlElementInfoBase item = new DxHtmlAnonymousElementInfo(dxHtmlElementBase, elementInfo);
				for (; i < j; i++)
				{
					dxHtmlElementBase.ChildNodes.Add(children[i].Element);
				}
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override System.Drawing.Size CalcCore(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = elementInfo.Style.FlexDirection == CssFlexDirection.Column || elementInfo.Style.FlexDirection == CssFlexDirection.ColumnReverse;
			bool flag2 = elementInfo.useAutoWidthCore;
			bool flag3 = elementInfo.useAutoHeightCore;
			if (!forceArgsWidth)
			{
				if (elementInfo.useAutoWidthCore)
				{
					int width = args.Width;
					PortablePadding margin = GetMargin(elementInfo);
					args.Width = width - ((PortablePadding)(ref margin)).Horizontal;
				}
				if (elementInfo.Style.FlexBasis.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length)
				{
					args.Width = CalcFlexBasis(elementInfo, args);
				}
				else if (elementInfo.StyleWidth.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length && !elementInfo.useAutoWidthCore && args.Width > elementInfo.PreferredSize.Width)
				{
					args.Width = elementInfo.PreferredSize.Width;
					flag2 = false;
				}
				if (elementInfo.HasMinWidth && args.Width < elementInfo.MinSize.Width)
				{
					args.Width = elementInfo.MinSize.Width;
					flag2 = false;
				}
				if (elementInfo.HasMaxWidth && args.Width > elementInfo.MaxSize.Width)
				{
					args.Width = elementInfo.MaxSize.Width;
					flag2 = false;
				}
			}
			if (!forceArgsHeight)
			{
				if (elementInfo.StyleHeight.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length)
				{
					args.Height = elementInfo.PredefinedSize.Height;
					flag3 = false;
				}
				else
				{
					args.Height = 0;
				}
				if (elementInfo.HasMinHeight && args.Height < elementInfo.MinSize.Height)
				{
					args.Height = elementInfo.MinSize.Height;
					flag3 = false;
				}
				if (elementInfo.HasMaxHeight && args.Height > elementInfo.MaxSize.Height)
				{
					args.Height = elementInfo.MaxSize.Height;
					flag3 = false;
				}
			}
			List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> visibleChildren = GetVisibleChildren(elementInfo, out var excludedChildren);
			if (excludedChildren != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < excludedChildren.Count; i++)
				{
					DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = excludedChildren[i];
					dxHtmlElementInfoBase.BeforeCalc();
					if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase.IsOutOfLayoutFlow)
					{
						dxHtmlElementInfoBase.CheckPosition();
					}
					if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase.IsWhiteSpace)
					{
						dxHtmlElementInfoBase.CalcProperties(cache, args);
					}
					dxHtmlElementInfoBase.AfterCalc();
				}
			}
			if (visibleChildren.Count == 0)
			{
				elementInfo.Width = ((!flag2) ? args.Width : 0);
				elementInfo.Height = ((!flag3) ? args.Height : 0);
				return elementInfo.Size;
			}
			visibleChildren = CombineTextRuns(visibleChildren, elementInfo);
			int minElementWidth = -1;
			int minElementHeight = -1;
			bool flag4 = forceArgsWidth;
			bool flag5 = forceArgsHeight;
			forceArgsWidth = false;
			forceArgsHeight = false;
			System.Drawing.Size size;
			if (flag)
			{
				size = CalcColumnLayout(elementInfo, visibleChildren, cache, args, ref minElementHeight);
				minElementWidth = size.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				size = CalcRowLayout(elementInfo, visibleChildren, cache, args, ref minElementWidth);
			}
			forceArgsWidth = flag4;
			forceArgsHeight = flag5;
			return elementInfo.Size = CutElementInfoSize(elementInfo, size, minElementWidth, flag);
		}

		private System.Drawing.Size CutElementInfoSize(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, System.Drawing.Size size, int minChildrenWidth, bool columnLayout)
		{
			System.Drawing.Size result = size;
			if (!forceArgsWidth)
			{
				if (result.Width < minChildrenWidth)
				{
					result.Width = minChildrenWidth;
				}
				if (elementInfo.StyleWidth.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length)
				{
					result.Width = elementInfo.PredefinedSize.Width;
				}
				if (elementInfo.HasMaxWidth && result.Width > elementInfo.MaxSize.Width)
				{
					result.Width = elementInfo.MaxSize.Width;
				}
				if (elementInfo.HasMinWidth && result.Width < elementInfo.MinSize.Width)
				{
					result.Width = elementInfo.MinSize.Width;
				}
			}
			if (!forceArgsHeight)
			{
				bool flag = columnLayout && elementInfo.StyleHeight.ValueType == CssUnitValueType.Percentage;
				if (elementInfo.StyleHeight.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length && !flag)
				{
					result.Height = elementInfo.PredefinedSize.Height;
				}
				if (elementInfo.HasMaxHeight && result.Height > elementInfo.MaxSize.Height && (elementInfo.Style.MaxSize.Height.ValueType != CssUnitValueType.Percentage || elementInfo.MaxSize.Height > 0))
				{
					result.Height = elementInfo.MaxSize.Height;
				}
				if (elementInfo.HasMinHeight && result.Height < elementInfo.MinSize.Height)
				{
					result.Height = elementInfo.MinSize.Height;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private System.Drawing.Size FastCalcColumnLayout(List<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> children, IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, ref int minElementHeight)

		private bool IsDefinite(DxHtmlElementInfoBase element, CssUnit<CssFontSize> fontSize)
		{
			switch (fontSize.UnitType)
			{
			case CssFontSize.Medium:
			case CssFontSize.XXsmall:
			case CssFontSize.Xsmall:
			case CssFontSize.Small:
			case CssFontSize.Large:
			case CssFontSize.Xlarge:
			case CssFontSize.XXlarge:
				return true;
			case CssFontSize.Smaller:
			case CssFontSize.Larger:
				return IsDefinite(element.ParentElementInfo, element.ParentElementInfo.Style.FontSize);
			default:
				if (fontSize.UnitType == CssFontSize.Length)
				{
					switch (fontSize.ValueType)
					{
					case CssUnitValueType.Number:
					case CssUnitValueType.Px:
					case CssUnitValueType.In:
					case CssUnitValueType.Cm:
					case CssUnitValueType.Mm:
					case CssUnitValueType.Pt:
					case CssUnitValueType.Pc:
					case CssUnitValueType.Em:
						return true;
					case CssUnitValueType.Rem:
						return IsDefinite(element, element.RootElement.Style.FontSize);
					case CssUnitValueType.Percentage:
						return IsDefinite(element.ParentElementInfo, element.ParentElementInfo.Style.FontSize);
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsDefinite(DxHtmlElementInfoBase element, Func<DxHtmlElementInfoBase, CssUnit<CssUnitAuto>> unitProvider)
		{
			CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> cssUnit = unitProvider(element);
			if (cssUnit.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Auto)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (cssUnit.ValueType)
			{
			case CssUnitValueType.Number:
			case CssUnitValueType.Px:
			case CssUnitValueType.In:
			case CssUnitValueType.Cm:
			case CssUnitValueType.Mm:
			case CssUnitValueType.Pt:
			case CssUnitValueType.Pc:
				return true;
			case CssUnitValueType.Em:
				return IsDefinite(element, element.Style.FontSize);
			case CssUnitValueType.Rem:
				return IsDefinite(element, element.RootElement.Style.FontSize);
			case CssUnitValueType.Percentage:
				return IsDefinite(element.ParentElementInfo, unitProvider);
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private System.Drawing.Size CalcContainerAvailableSize(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)

		private float CalcFreeSpace(List<int> line, List<FlexItem> flexItems)
		{

		protected virtual System.Drawing.Size CalcElement(DxHtmlElementInfoBase element, IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, bool columnLayout, int offsetX = 0, int offsetY = 0, int forcedWidth = -1, int forcedHeight = -1)
		{

				{
					size.Width = forcedWidth;
				}

			{
				if (element.StyleWidth.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length)
				{
					size.Width = element.PredefinedSize.Width + element.NonClientSize.Width;
				}
				if (element.Style.FlexBasis.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length && !columnLayout)
				{
					size.Width = CalcFlexBasis(element, args) + element.NonClientSize.Width;
				}
				if (element.HasMaxWidth && size.Width > element.MaxSize.Width)
				{
					size.Width = element.MaxSize.Width + element.NonClientSize.Width;
				}
				if (element.HasMinWidth && size.Width < element.MinSize.Width)
				{
					size.Width = element.MinSize.Width + element.NonClientSize.Width;
				}
			}
			if (forcedHeight > -1)
			{
				if (forcedHeight > size.Height || (columnLayout && CalcFlexBasis(element, args) == forcedHeight) || element.PredefinedSize.Height + element.NonClientSize.Height == forcedHeight)
				{

				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (element.StyleHeight.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length)

		}

		private int CalcFlexBasis(DxHtmlElementInfoBase element, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{

	public class DxHtmlFlowLayout : DxHtmlElementLayout
	{
		protected override System.Drawing.Size CalcCore(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DxHtmlChildInfoCollectionBase children = elementInfo.Children;

			{

				if (item.IsOutOfLayoutFlow)
				{
					item.CheckPosition();
					LayoutForegroundItem(item, dxHtmlInlineLayoutContext);
					item.AfterCalc();
					continue;
				}
				DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs = args.Clone();

				if (item.Style.Display == CssDisplay.Inline || item.Style.Display == CssDisplay.Contents)
				{
					item.LineIndex = dxHtmlInlineLayoutContext.LineIndex;

				}
				else

				}

				{

			return result;
		}
	}
	internal class DxHtmlInlineLayoutContext
	{

		public int LineBottomMargin;

		public DxHtmlElementInfoBase Item
		{
			get
			{
				return item;
			}
			set
			{
				PrevItem = item;
				bool isLastOfLine = value == null || !value.IsInline;
				if (item == null || CheckIsLogicalItem(item, isLastOfLine))
				{
					PrevLogicalItem = item;
				}
				item = value;
			}
		}

		public bool ItemIsLogical
		{
			get
			{
				if (Item != null)
				{
					return CheckIsLogicalItem(Item);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		{
			Location = startLocation;

			EndedSpans = new List<DxHtmlElementSpanLayoutInfo>();
			EnteredSpans = new List<DxHtmlElementSpanLayoutInfo>();
			StartItem = startItem;
		}

		public bool CheckIsLogicalItem(DxHtmlElementInfoBase item, bool isLastOfLine = false)
		{
			if (item.IsWhiteSpace)
			{
				if (!item.Size.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (isLastOfLine)
					{
						return !(item as DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo).CanNormalized;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public System.Drawing.Point TranslateToRelativePoint(System.Drawing.Point point, DxHtmlElementInfoBase client)
		{
			System.Drawing.Point absolutePoint = StartItem.GetAbsolutePoint(point);
			return client.GetRelativePoint(absolutePoint);
		}

		protected override System.Drawing.Size CalcCore(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			if (!elementInfo.useAutoWidthCore && elementInfo.StyleWidth.ValueType == CssUnitValueType.Percentage)
			{
				args.Width -= elementInfo.NonClientSize.Width;
			}
			if (!elementInfo.useAutoHeightCore && elementInfo.StyleHeight.ValueType == CssUnitValueType.Percentage)
			{
				args.Height -= elementInfo.NonClientSize.Height;
			}
			System.Drawing.Size borderSpacing = CalcBorderSpacing(elementInfo, args);
			args.UseBestFit = true;
			bool flag = CanUseAutoWidth(elementInfo, args);
			HtmlTableLayoutInfo htmlTableLayoutInfo = (HtmlTableLayoutInfo)elementInfo.LayoutInfo;
			elementInfo.useBestFitCore = flag;
			bool flag2 = !elementInfo.Borders.IsEmpty;
			if (!htmlTableLayoutInfo.IsReady)

				List<RowSpanInfo> rowSpans = new List<RowSpanInfo>();

							DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase2 = dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Children[j];
							if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase2.Style.Display == CssDisplay.TableRow)
							{
								dxHtmlElementInfoBase2.Font = elementInfo.Font;
								CalcTableRow(cache, dxHtmlElementInfoBase2, num++, args, htmlTableLayoutInfo, rowSpans, borderSpacing);
							}
						}
					}
					else if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Style.Display == CssDisplay.TableRow)
					{
						dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Font = elementInfo.Font;
						CalcTableRow(cache, dxHtmlElementInfoBase, num++, args, htmlTableLayoutInfo, rowSpans, borderSpacing);
					}
				}
				htmlTableLayoutInfo.IsReady = true;
			}
			List<Length> list = htmlTableLayoutInfo.ColumnWidths.ToList();
			List<int> list2 = htmlTableLayoutInfo.RowHeights.ToList();
			List<CellInfo> cellInfos = htmlTableLayoutInfo.CellInfos;
			int num2 = args.Width - borderSpacing.Width;
			int num3 = list.Sum((Length x) => x.Value);
			bool flag3 = !flag || num3 > num2;
			if (flag3)
			{
				List<int> columnWidthIndexes = Enumerable.Range(0, list.Count).ToList();
				bool flag4 = true;
				int num4 = num2;
				while (columnWidthIndexes.Count > 0 && flag4)
				{
					float num5 = list.Where((Length x, int item) => columnWidthIndexes.Contains(item)).Sum((Length x) => x.Value);
					flag4 = false;
					for (int num6 = columnWidthIndexes.Count - 1; num6 >= 0; num6--)
					{
						int index = columnWidthIndexes[num6];
						int value = list[index].Value;
						if (value != 0)
						{
							float num7 = (float)value / num5;
							int num8 = (int)((float)num4 * num7 + 0.5f);
							int minValue = list[index].MinValue;
							int num9 = ((num8 < minValue) ? minValue : num8);
							list[index] = new Length(num9, minValue);
							if (num9 != num8)
							{
								columnWidthIndexes.RemoveAt(num6);
								num4 -= num9;
								flag4 = true;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				int num10 = list.Sum((Length x) => x.Value);
				int num11 = list.Sum((Length x) => x.MinValue);
				if (num10 > num11)
				{
					Length value2 = list[list.Count - 1];
					value2.Value += num2 - num10;
					list[list.Count - 1] = value2;
				}
			}
			int num12 = -1;
			int num13 = cellInfos.Count - 1;
			int num14 = 0;
			bool flag5 = false;
			for (int num15 = cellInfos.Count - 1; num15 >= -1; num15--)
			{
				CellInfo cellInfo = ((num15 == -1) ? null : cellInfos[num15]);
				int num16 = cellInfo?.RowIndex ?? (-1);
				if (num12 == -1)
				{
					num12 = num16;
				}
				bool flag6 = num12 != num16 || num16 == -1;
				if (flag3 && flag6)
				{
					if (flag5)
					{
						CellInfo[] array = cellInfos.Skip(num15 + 1).Take(num13 - num15).ToArray();
						CellInfo[] array2 = array;
						foreach (CellInfo cellInfo2 in array2)
						{
							list2[cellInfo2.RowIndex] = num14;
						}
					}
					num13 = num15;
					num14 = 0;
					flag5 = false;
				}
				if (num16 != -1)
				{
					Rectangle cellBounds = GetCellBounds(cellInfo, list, list2, borderSpacing, args);
					DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs = args.Clone();
					dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs.Width = cellBounds.Width;
					cellInfo.ContentHeight = cellInfo.ElementInfo.Calc(cache, dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs).Height;
					if (!flag3)
					{
						CenterCellContentByVertical(cellInfo, cellBounds.Height);
					}
					num14 = Math.Max(num14, cellInfo.ElementInfo.Height);
					if (num14 > cellBounds.Height)
					{
						flag5 = true;
					}
					cellInfo.ElementInfo.Bounds = cellBounds;
					num12 = num16;
				}
			}
			if (flag3)
			{
				foreach (CellInfo item in cellInfos)
				{
					Rectangle cellBounds2 = GetCellBounds(item, list, list2, borderSpacing, args);
					item.ElementInfo.Bounds = cellBounds2;
					CenterCellContentByVertical(item, cellBounds2.Height);
				}
			}
			return new System.Drawing.Size(list.Sum((Length x) => x.Value) + borderSpacing.Width, list2.Sum() + borderSpacing.Height);
		}

		private System.Drawing.Size CalcBorderSpacing(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			System.Drawing.Size empty = System.Drawing.Size.Empty;
			empty.Width = elementInfo.Style.BorderHorizontalSpacing.GetRoundValue(args.Size - elementInfo.NonClientSize, args.Width, elementInfo.RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, elementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, elementInfo.RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Width);
			empty.Height = elementInfo.Style.BorderVerticalSpacing.GetRoundValue(args.Size - elementInfo.NonClientSize, args.Height, elementInfo.RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, elementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, elementInfo.RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Height);
			return empty;
		}

		private bool CanUseAutoWidth(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			if (elementInfo.StyleWidth.UnitType != CssUnitAuto.Auto)
			{
				if (args.UseMaxWidth)
				{
					return elementInfo.StyleWidth.ValueType == CssUnitValueType.Percentage;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CenterCellContentByVertical(CellInfo cellInfo, int cellHeight)
		{
			int y = (int)((float)(cellHeight - cellInfo.ContentHeight) / 2f + 0.5f);
			cellInfo.ElementInfo.OffsetChildren(0, y);
		}

		private Rectangle GetCellBounds(CellInfo cellInfo, List<Length> columnWidth, List<int> rowHeight, System.Drawing.Size borderSpacing, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			Rectangle result = new Rectangle(args.Location, System.Drawing.Size.Empty);
			result.X += columnWidth.Take(cellInfo.ColIndex).Sum((Length x) => x.Value) + borderSpacing.Width;
			result.Y += rowHeight.Take(cellInfo.RowIndex).Sum() + borderSpacing.Height;
			result.Width = columnWidth.Skip(cellInfo.ColIndex).Take(cellInfo.ColSpan).Sum((Length x) => x.Value) - borderSpacing.Width;
			result.Height = rowHeight.Skip(cellInfo.RowIndex).Take(cellInfo.RowSpan).Sum() - borderSpacing.Height;
			return result;
		}

		private void CalcTableRow(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementInfoBase row, int index, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, HtmlTableLayoutInfo layoutInfo, List<RowSpanInfo> rowSpans, System.Drawing.Size borderSpacing)
		{
			((DxHtmlElementInfo)row).BeforeCalc();
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase[] cells = GetCells(row);
			int columnIndex = 0;
			foreach (DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase in cells)
			{
				CombineBackgrounds(row, dxHtmlElementInfoBase);
				dxHtmlElementInfoBase.CalcProperties(cache, args);
				CellInfo cellInfo = GetCellInfo(dxHtmlElementInfoBase);
				cellInfo.RowInfo = row;
				layoutInfo.CellInfos.Add(cellInfo);
				DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs = args.Clone();
				dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs.Width = int.MaxValue;
				dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs.UseMaxWidth = true;
				dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs.UseLeftTextAlign = true;
				dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs.IgnoreRelativeSize = true;
				System.Drawing.Size size = cellInfo.ElementInfo.Calc(cache, dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs) + borderSpacing;
				if (!dxHtmlElementInfoBase.useAutoWidthCore)
				{
					size.Width = dxHtmlElementInfoBase.PreferredSize.Width + dxHtmlElementInfoBase.NonClientSize.Width;
				}
				if (!dxHtmlElementInfoBase.useAutoHeightCore)
				{
					size.Height = dxHtmlElementInfoBase.PreferredSize.Height + dxHtmlElementInfoBase.NonClientSize.Height;
				}
				dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs.UseMaxWidth = false;
				dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs.Width = 0;
				System.Drawing.Size size2 = cellInfo.ElementInfo.Calc(cache, dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs) + borderSpacing;
				cellInfo.ElementInfo.EnsurePreferredSize(dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs, DxHtmlElementDimensions.Width);
				if (!cellInfo.ElementInfo.useAutoWidthCore)
				{
					size2.Width = dxHtmlElementCalculationArgs.Width;
					if (size.Width < size2.Width)
					{
						size.Width = size2.Width;
					}
				}
				RowSpanInfo rowSpanInfo;
				do
				{
					rowSpanInfo = rowSpans.FirstOrDefault((RowSpanInfo x) => x.ColIndex == columnIndex);
					if (rowSpanInfo != null)
					{
						columnIndex += rowSpanInfo.ColSpan;
					}
				}
				while (rowSpanInfo != null);
				int num = (cellInfo.ColIndex = columnIndex);
				cellInfo.RowIndex = index;
				int num2 = layoutInfo.ColumnWidths.Skip(columnIndex).Take(cellInfo.ColSpan).Sum((Length x) => x.Value);
				int num3 = layoutInfo.ColumnWidths.Skip(columnIndex).Take(cellInfo.ColSpan).Sum((Length x) => x.MinValue);
				bool flag = true;
				for (; columnIndex < num + cellInfo.ColSpan; columnIndex++)
				{
					if (columnIndex >= layoutInfo.ColumnWidths.Count)
					{
						Length item = new Length
						{
							Value = (flag ? (size.Width / cellInfo.ColSpan) : 0),
							MinValue = (flag ? (size2.Width / cellInfo.ColSpan) : 0)
						};
						layoutInfo.ColumnWidths.Add(item);
					}
					else
					{
						flag = false;
						float num4 = (float)layoutInfo.ColumnWidths[columnIndex].Value / (float)num2;
						float num5 = (float)layoutInfo.ColumnWidths[columnIndex].MinValue / (float)num3;
						Length value = new Length
						{
							Value = Math.Max(layoutInfo.ColumnWidths[columnIndex].Value, (int)((float)size.Width * num4 + 0.5f)),
							MinValue = Math.Max(layoutInfo.ColumnWidths[columnIndex].MinValue, (int)((float)size2.Width * num5 + 0.5f))
						};
						layoutInfo.ColumnWidths[columnIndex] = value;
					}
				}
				if (cellInfo.RowSpan > 1)
				{
					RowSpanInfo item2 = new RowSpanInfo
					{
						ColIndex = num,
						ColSpan = cellInfo.ColSpan,
						RowSpan = cellInfo.RowSpan,
						RowIndex = index,
						RowHeight = size.Height
					};
					rowSpans.Add(item2);
				}
				else if (index >= layoutInfo.RowHeights.Count)
				{
					layoutInfo.RowHeights.Add(size.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					layoutInfo.RowHeights[index] = Math.Max(layoutInfo.RowHeights[index], size.Height);
				}
			}
			for (int num6 = rowSpans.Count - 1; num6 >= 0; num6--)
			{
				RowSpanInfo rowSpanInfo2 = rowSpans[num6];
				if (--rowSpanInfo2.RowSpan <= 0)
				{
					rowSpans.Remove(rowSpanInfo2);
				}
				int num7 = layoutInfo.RowHeights.Skip(rowSpanInfo2.RowIndex).Take(index - rowSpanInfo2.RowIndex + 1).Sum();
				for (int num8 = rowSpanInfo2.RowIndex; num8 <= index; num8++)
				{
					float num9 = (float)layoutInfo.RowHeights[num8] / (float)num7;
					layoutInfo.RowHeights[num8] = Math.Max(layoutInfo.RowHeights[num8], (int)((float)rowSpanInfo2.RowHeight * num9 + 0.5f));
				}
			}
		}

		private void CombineBackgrounds(DxHtmlElementInfoBase rowElementInfo, DxHtmlElementInfoBase cellElementInfo)
		{
			if (cellElementInfo.Style.BackgroundColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				cellElementInfo.Style.MainProperties.SetBackgroundColor(rowElementInfo.Style.BackgroundColor);
			}
		}

		private DxHtmlElementInfoBase[] GetCells(DxHtmlElementInfoBase row)
		{
			return row.Children.Where((DxHtmlElementInfoBase x) => x.Style.Display == CssDisplay.TableCell).ToArray();
		}

		private CellInfo GetCellInfo(DxHtmlElementInfoBase cell)
		{
			CellInfo cellInfo = new CellInfo();
			cellInfo.ElementInfo = cell;
			if (cell.Element is DxHtmlTableCellElement dxHtmlTableCellElement)
			{
				cellInfo.ColSpan = Math.Max(1, dxHtmlTableCellElement.ColSpan);
				cellInfo.RowSpan = Math.Max(1, dxHtmlTableCellElement.RowSpan);
			}
			else
			{
				cellInfo.RowSpan = 1;
				cellInfo.ColSpan = 1;
			}
			return cellInfo;
		}

		public override DxHtmlElementInfoBase CalcHitInfo(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo, System.Drawing.Point location)
		{
			System.Drawing.Point pt = location;
			location.Offset(-elementInfo.X, -elementInfo.Y);
			DxHtmlChildInfoCollectionBase children = elementInfo.Children;
			for (int num = children.Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
			{
				DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = children[num];
				if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase.IsVisible && dxHtmlElementInfoBase.IsDisplayed && !dxHtmlElementInfoBase.HasPosition)
				{
					DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase2 = CalcHitInfo(dxHtmlElementInfoBase, location);
					if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase2 != null)
					{
						return dxHtmlElementInfoBase2;
					}
				}
			}
			if (elementInfo.Bounds.Contains(pt))
			{
				return elementInfo;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool CheckIsTableStructureTag(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
			if (elementInfo.Style.Display != CssDisplay.TableHeaderGroup && elementInfo.Style.Display != CssDisplay.TableFooterGroup)
			{
				return elementInfo.Style.Display == CssDisplay.TableRowGroup;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override DxHtmlElementLayoutInfo CreateInfo(SizeF scaleFactor, bool isDirectXPaint)
		{
			return new HtmlTableLayoutInfo(scaleFactor, isDirectXPaint);
		}
	}

	public abstract class DxHtmlElementInfoBase
	{

		private bool hasMaxHeightCore;

		private bool needUpdateClientRect;

		private static Dictionary<long, DxHtmlElementTextMetrics> textMetricsStorageCore;

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public Rectangle AbsoluteBounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (!absoluteBoundsCore.HasValue)
				{
					absoluteBoundsCore = GetAbsoluteBounds();
				}
				return absoluteBoundsCore.Value;
			}
		}

		public int ZIndex { get; private set; }

		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				return indexCore ?? Element.NodeIndex;
			}
			internal set
			{
				indexCore = value;
			}
		}

		public Font Font { get; internal set; }

		public DxHtmlElementBase Element => elementCore;

		public virtual DxHtmlRootElement RootElement => elementCore.RootElement;

		public virtual DxHtmlElementInfoBase ParentElementInfo => parentElementInfoCore;

		public virtual DxHtmlRootElementInfo RootElementInfo => rootElementInfoCore;

		public DxHtmlChildInfoCollectionBase Children => childrenCore;

		public abstract CssStyle Style { get; }

		internal virtual CssTextAlign InternalTextAlign => Style.TextAlign;

		public CssUserSelect UserSelect
		{
			get
			{
				if (Style != null)
				{
					CssAutoInheritedProperties autoInheritedProperties = Style.AutoInheritedProperties;
					if (autoInheritedProperties != null && autoInheritedProperties.UserSelect != null)
					{
						return autoInheritedProperties.UserSelect.Value;
					}
				}
				return PropertyDefaultValues.UserSelect.Value;
			}
		}

		public bool CanSelectContent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Selectable)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (UserSelect)
				{
				case CssUserSelect.None:
					return false;
				case CssUserSelect.Auto:
					if (Style.Before != null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (Style.After != null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return RootElementInfo.AllowSelection;
				case CssUserSelect.Text:
				case CssUserSelect.All:
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual bool Selectable => false;

		public virtual bool CanStartSelection => Selectable;

		public bool HasSelectedContent { get; protected set; }

		public virtual DxHtmlSelectionLayer ContentSelectionLayer => DxHtmlSelectionLayer.Background;

		public bool HasBackgroundImage
		{
			get
			{
				if (Style != null)
				{
					return Style.BackgroundImages.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}

		}

		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cursor.Url))
			{
				return DxHtmlResourceProvider.Current.GetCursor(cursor.Value);
			}
			return DxHtmlResourceProvider.Current.GetCursor(cursor.Url);
		}

		protected internal virtual System.Drawing.Size Calc(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			absoluteBoundsCore = null;
			SpanItems.Clear();
			BeforeCalc();
			if (CheckIsDisplayed())
			{
				CheckPosition();
				CheckLayoutInfo(cache, args);
				CalcProperties(cache, args);
				CalcBounds(cache, args);
				CalcClientBounds();
				OnCalcComplete(cache, args);
			}
			AfterCalc();
			return Bounds.Size;
		}

		private bool CheckIsDisplayed()
		{
			if (IsDisplayed)
			{
				return true;
			}
			clientRectangleCore = (boundsCore = Rectangle.Empty);
			PreferredSize = (predefinedSizeCore = (nonClientSizeCore = System.Drawing.Size.Empty));
			clientLocationCore = System.Drawing.Point.Empty;
			return false;
		}

		private void CheckLayoutInfo(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			if (args.LayoutChangeActions != DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.Resize && args.LayoutChangeActions != DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None)
			{
				LayoutInfo?.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void CalcProperties(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			bool flag = CheckIsPrecalculated();
			if (!flag || lastCalulatedSize != args.Size)
			{
				CalcFont(cache, args);
				if (!flag)
				{
					CalcTextMetrics(cache, args);
				}
				CalcPredefinedSize(cache, args);
				CalcMargin(cache, args);
				CalcPadding(cache, args);
				CalcContentPadding();
				CalcNonClientSize();
				CalcMinMaxSize(cache, args);
				CalcCornerRadius(cache, args);
				if (!flag)
				{
					CalcOpacity(cache, args);
					CalcColors(cache, args);
				}
				CalcBorders(cache, args);
				CalcShadow(cache, args);
				CalcContentPadding();
				CalcNonClientSize();
				CalcClientLocation();
				lastCalulatedSize = args.Size;
			}
			if (!flag && HasValidInternalId)
			{
				MarkAsPrecalculated();
			}
		}

		protected bool CheckIsPrecalculated()
		{
			if (HasValidInternalId)
			{
				return RootElementInfo.PrecalculatedElementsIds.Contains(InternalId);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void MarkAsPrecalculated()
		{
			RootElementInfo.PrecalculatedElementsIds.Add(InternalId);
		}

		private void CalcShadow(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			if (Shadow != null || Style.BoxShadow.HasChanges)
			{
				if (Shadow == null)
				{
					Shadow = cache.CreateShadow();
					Shadow.SetOwner(this);
				}
				Shadow.Calc(cache, args);
			}
		}

		protected internal void CheckPosition()
		{
			int zIndex = ZIndex;
			CssPosition cssPosition = positionCore;
			positionCore = Position;
			if (HasPosition)
			{
				Location = System.Drawing.Point.Empty;
				ZIndex = ((!Style.ZIndex.IsEmpty) ? ((int)Style.ZIndex.Value) : 0);
			}
			if (positionCore != cssPosition)
			{
				if (HasPosition)
				{
					RootElementInfo.PositionedElements.Add(this);
				}
				else
				{
					RootElementInfo.PositionedElements.Remove(this);
				}
			}
			else if (HasPosition && ZIndex != zIndex)
			{
				RootElementInfo.PositionedElements.ResetZOrder();
			}
		}

		protected internal void CalcPositioningMargin(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			//IL_014d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0152: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int roundValue = Style.Top.GetRoundValue(args.Size, args.Height, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Height);
			int roundValue2 = Style.Bottom.GetRoundValue(args.Size, args.Height, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Height);
			int roundValue3 = Style.Left.GetRoundValue(args.Size, args.Width, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Width);
			int roundValue4 = Style.Right.GetRoundValue(args.Size, args.Width, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Width);
			positioningMarginCore = new PortablePadding(roundValue3, roundValue, roundValue4, roundValue2);
		}
