		protected virtual void CalcFont(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			Font = GetFont(cache, args);
		}

		protected virtual DxHtmlElementTextMetrics CalcTextMetricsCore(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache)
		{
			long fontKey = GetFontKey(Font, ((IGraphicsCache)cache).DeviceDpi);
			DxHtmlElementTextMetrics value = null;
			lock (((ICollection)Storage).SyncRoot)
			{
				if (!Storage.TryGetValue(fontKey, out value))
				{
					if (!RootElement.ActualContext.TryGetMeasuredString(" Wg", Font, ((IGraphicsCache)cache).DeviceDpi, out var measuredString))
					{
						measuredString = RootElement.ActualContext.MeasureString(" Wg", " Wg", Font, cache, isRtl: false);
					}
					int interCharacterSpacing = measuredString.CharPositionToX(0, trailingEdge: true);
					int height = measuredString.Size.Height;
					if (!Storage.TryGetValue(fontKey, out value))
					{
						value = new DxHtmlElementTextMetrics((IGraphicsCache)cache, Font, interCharacterSpacing, height);
						Storage.Add(fontKey, value);
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal static long GetFontKey(Font font, int dpi)
		{
			return FontHelper.GetFontHashCode(font) ^ dpi;
		}

		private PortablePadding CalcMarginCore(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0144: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0149: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0127: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0187: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PortablePadding result = Style.Margin.Calc(args.Size, args.Size, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor);
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase parentElementInfo = ParentElementInfo;
			if ((Style.Display == CssDisplay.Inline || Style.Display == CssDisplay.Contents) && parentElementInfo != null && parentElementInfo.IsContentContainer)
			{
				int index = Index;
				CssWhiteSpace value = Style.TextProperties.WhiteSpace.Value;
				bool flag = value == CssWhiteSpace.PreWrap || value == CssWhiteSpace.Pre;
				int num = ((!flag) ? parentElementInfo.Children.FirstLogicalItemIndex : 0);
				int num2 = (flag ? (parentElementInfo.Children.Length - 1) : parentElementInfo.Children.LastLogicalItemIndex);
				bool flag2 = parentElementInfo.ParentElementInfo == null || (parentElementInfo.ParentElementInfo.Style.Display != CssDisplay.Flex && parentElementInfo.ParentElementInfo.Style.Display != CssDisplay.InlineFlex);
				PortablePadding val;
				if (index == num)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						int left = ((PortablePadding)(ref result)).Left;
						val = parentElementInfo.Margin;
						((PortablePadding)(ref result)).Left = left + ((PortablePadding)(ref val)).Left;
					}
					int left2 = ((PortablePadding)(ref result)).Left;
					val = parentElementInfo.ContentPadding;
					((PortablePadding)(ref result)).Left = left2 + ((PortablePadding)(ref val)).Left;
				}
				if (index == num2)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						int right = ((PortablePadding)(ref result)).Right;
						val = parentElementInfo.Margin;
						((PortablePadding)(ref result)).Right = right + ((PortablePadding)(ref val)).Right;
					}
					int right2 = ((PortablePadding)(ref result)).Right;
					val = parentElementInfo.ContentPadding;
					((PortablePadding)(ref result)).Right = right2 + ((PortablePadding)(ref val)).Right;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		protected void CalcMinMaxSize(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)

			maxSizeCore = Style.MaxSize.Calc(size, args.Size, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Height);
			hasMinWidthCore = Style.MinSize.HasWidth;
			hasMinHeightCore = Style.MinSize.HasHeight;

		}

		private void CalcOpacity(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			Opacity = 1f;
			if (!Style.MainProperties.Opacity.IsEmpty)
			{
				Opacity = Style.Opacity;
			}
			if (ParentElementInfo != null)
			{
				Opacity *= ParentElementInfo.Opacity;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CalcColors(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			BackColor = ApplyOpacityOnColor(Style.BackgroundColor.GetColor(cache), Opacity);
			ForeColor = ApplyOpacityOnColor(Style.ForeColor.GetColor(cache, RootElementInfo.DefaultForeColor), Opacity);
			SelectionBackColor = Style.Selection.BackgroundColor.GetColor(cache, RootElementInfo.DefaultSelectionBackColor);
			SelectionForeColor = Style.Selection.ForeColor.GetColor(cache, RootElementInfo.DefaultSelectionForeColor);
		}

		internal System.Drawing.Color ApplyOpacityOnColor(System.Drawing.Color color, float opacity)
		{
			if (opacity == 1f)
			{
				return color;
			}
			float num = (int)(color.IsEmpty ? byte.MaxValue : color.A);
			int alpha = (int)(num * opacity);
			return System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(alpha, color);
		}

		private void CalcCornerRadius(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			if (!Style.Radius.IsEmpty)
			{
				System.Drawing.Size size = args.Size - NonClientSize;
				CalcLeftCornerRadiuses(cache, args, size);
				CalcRightCornerRadiuses(cache, args, size);
			}
		}

			CornerRadiuses.BottomLeft = Style.Radius.CalcBottomLeft(size, args.Size.Height, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Height);
		}

		protected virtual void CalcRightCornerRadiuses(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, System.Drawing.Size size)
		{
			CornerRadiuses.TopRight = Style.Radius.CalcTopRight(size, args.Size.Width, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Width);
			CornerRadiuses.BottomRight = Style.Radius.CalcBottomRight(size, args.Size.Height, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Height);
		}

		private void CalcBorders(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			CalcBorder(cache, Borders.Left, Style.LeftBorder, args, isHorizontal: true);
			CalcBorder(cache, Borders.Top, Style.TopBorder, args, isHorizontal: false);
			CalcBorder(cache, Borders.Right, Style.RightBorder, args, isHorizontal: true);
			CalcBorder(cache, Borders.Bottom, Style.BottomBorder, args, isHorizontal: false);
			Borders.CalcCommonColor();
		}

		protected bool CanRecalcBackImageRects(string id, RectangleF client)
		{
			if (BackgroundImages.TryGetValue(id, out var value) && !value.IsChanged(client, Style.BackgroundImages[id]))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal BackgroundImageInfo GetBackgroundImageInfo(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, RectangleF client, string id)
		{
			if (CanRecalcBackImageRects(id, client))
			{
				Style.BackgroundImages.Synchronize();
				CalcBackImageRects(cache, client, id);
			}
			return BackgroundImages[id];
		}

		public void CalcBackImageRects(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, RectangleF client, string id)
		{
			if (!BackgroundImages.TryGetValue(id, out var value))
			{
				value = new BackgroundImageInfo();
				BackgroundImages[id] = value;
			}
			CssBackgroundImageProperties cssBackgroundImageProperties = Style.BackgroundImages[id];
			if (!cssBackgroundImageProperties.HasImagePath)
			{
				return;
			}
			value.Clear();
			value.ClientRectangle = client;
			object image = GetImage(cssBackgroundImageProperties.ImagePath.Value, RootElement.ActualClient, isBindable: false);
			if (image == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SizeF image2 = CalcBackgroundImageSize(cache, cssBackgroundImageProperties, image, client);
			if (!image2.IsEmpty)
			{
				PointF pointF = cssBackgroundImageProperties.CalcBackgroundImageLocation(client.Size, Size.Width, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Width);
				PointF start = new PointF(CalcBackgroundImageHorzPosition(cssBackgroundImageProperties.PositionHorz, client, pointF.X, image2.Width), CalcBackgroundImageVertPosition(cssBackgroundImageProperties.PositionVert, client, pointF.Y, image2.Height));
				FillOperation fillOperationHorz = GetFillOperationHorz(cssBackgroundImageProperties.RepeatHorz.Value);
				FillOperation fillOperationVert = GetFillOperationVert(cssBackgroundImageProperties.RepeatVert.Value);
				fillOperationHorz(value.ImageRects, client, start, image2);
				RectangleF[] array = new RectangleF[value.ImageRects.Count];
				value.ImageRects.CopyTo(array);
				RectangleF[] array2 = array;
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					RectangleF rectangleF = array2[i];
					fillOperationVert(value.ImageRects, client, rectangleF.Location, rectangleF.Size);
				}
			}
		}

		private FillOperation GetFillOperationHorz(CssBackgroundRepeat repeat)
		{
			switch (repeat)
			{
			case CssBackgroundRepeat.Repeat:
			case CssBackgroundRepeat.RepeatX:
				return FillRepeatX;
			case CssBackgroundRepeat.Space:
				return FillSpaceX;
			case CssBackgroundRepeat.Round:
				return FillRoundX;
			default:
				return FillNoRepeat;
			}
		}

		private FillOperation GetFillOperationVert(CssBackgroundRepeat repeat)
		{
			switch (repeat)
			{
			case CssBackgroundRepeat.Repeat:
			case CssBackgroundRepeat.RepeatY:
				return FillRepeatY;
			case CssBackgroundRepeat.Space:
				return FillSpaceY;
			case CssBackgroundRepeat.Round:
				return FillRoundY;
			default:
				return FillNoRepeat;
			}
		}

		private float CalcDelta(float client, float size)
		{
			int num = (int)(client / size);
			return (client - size * (float)num) / (float)num;
		}

		private void FillSpaceX(HashSet<RectangleF> rects, RectangleF client, PointF start, SizeF image)
		{
			float delta = CalcDelta(client.Width, image.Width);
			FillXCore(rects, client, start, image, delta);
		}

		private void FillSpaceY(HashSet<RectangleF> rects, RectangleF client, PointF start, SizeF image)
		{
			float delta = CalcDelta(client.Height, image.Height);
			FillYCore(rects, client, start, image, delta);
		}

		private void FillRoundX(HashSet<RectangleF> rects, RectangleF client, PointF start, SizeF image)
		{
			image.Width += CalcDelta(client.Width, image.Width);
			image.Height += CalcDelta(client.Height, image.Height);
			FillXCore(rects, client, start, image, 0f);
		}

		private void FillRoundY(HashSet<RectangleF> rects, RectangleF client, PointF start, SizeF image)
		{
			FillYCore(rects, client, start, image, 0f);
		}

		private void FillRepeatX(HashSet<RectangleF> rects, RectangleF client, PointF start, SizeF image)
		{
			FillXCore(rects, client, start, image, 0f);
		}

		private void FillRepeatY(HashSet<RectangleF> rects, RectangleF client, PointF start, SizeF image)
		{
			FillYCore(rects, client, start, image, 0f);
		}

		private void FillXCore(HashSet<RectangleF> rects, RectangleF client, PointF start, SizeF image, float delta)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF(start, image);
			do
			{
				rects.Add(rectangleF);
				rectangleF.X += image.Width + delta;
			}
			while (!RectangleF.Intersect(client, rectangleF).IsEmpty);
			rectangleF = new RectangleF(start, image);
			do
			{
				rects.Add(rectangleF);
				rectangleF.X -= image.Width + delta;
			}
			while (!RectangleF.Intersect(client, rectangleF).IsEmpty);
		}

		private void FillYCore(HashSet<RectangleF> rects, RectangleF client, PointF start, SizeF image, float delta)
		{
			RectangleF rectangleF = new RectangleF(start, image);
			do
			{
				rectangleF.Y += image.Height + delta;
				rects.Add(rectangleF);
			}
			while (!RectangleF.Intersect(client, rectangleF).IsEmpty);
			rectangleF = new RectangleF(start, image);
			do
			{
				rectangleF.Y -= image.Height + delta;
				rects.Add(rectangleF);
			}
			while (!RectangleF.Intersect(client, rectangleF).IsEmpty);
		}

		private void FillNoRepeat(HashSet<RectangleF> rects, RectangleF client, PointF start, SizeF image)
		{
			rects.Add(new RectangleF(start, image));
		}

		private CssBackgroundSize CheckBackgroundImageSize(CssBackgroundImageProperties backgroundImage)
		{
			if (backgroundImage.Width.UnitType == backgroundImage.Height.UnitType)
			{
				return backgroundImage.Width.UnitType;
			}
			return CssBackgroundSize.Length;
		}

		private SizeF CalcBackgroundImageSize(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, CssBackgroundImageProperties backgroundImage, object image, RectangleF client)
		{
			System.Drawing.Size imageSize = cache.GetImageSize(image);
			switch (CheckBackgroundImageSize(backgroundImage))
			{
			case CssBackgroundSize.Auto:
				return imageSize;
			case CssBackgroundSize.Cover:
				return EnlargeBackgroundImageSize(client.Width > client.Height, client, imageSize);
			case CssBackgroundSize.Contain:
				return EnlargeBackgroundImageSize(client.Width < client.Height, client, imageSize);
			default:
			{
				SizeF result = backgroundImage.CalcBackgroundImageSize(client.Size, Size.Width, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Width);
				if (backgroundImage.Width.UnitType == CssBackgroundSize.Auto)
				{
					result.Width = result.Height;
				}
				if (backgroundImage.Height.UnitType == CssBackgroundSize.Auto)
				{
					result.Height = result.Width;
				}
				return result;
			}
			}
		}

		private SizeF EnlargeBackgroundImageSize(bool condition, RectangleF client, SizeF image)
		{
			if (image.Width == 0f || image.Height == 0f)
			{
				return System.Drawing.Size.Empty;
			}
			float num = (condition ? (client.Width / image.Width) : (client.Height / image.Height));
			return new SizeF(image.Width * num, image.Height * num);
		}

		private float CalcBackgroundImageHorzPosition(CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> position, RectangleF client, float x, float width)
		{
			return position.UnitType switch
			{
				CssBackgroundPosition.Center => (client.Width - width) / 2f, 
				CssBackgroundPosition.Right => client.Right - width - x, 
				_ => x, 
			};
		}

		private float CalcBackgroundImageVertPosition(CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> position, RectangleF client, float y, float height)
		{
			return position.UnitType switch
			{
				CssBackgroundPosition.Center => (client.Height - height) / 2f, 
				CssBackgroundPosition.Bottom => client.Bottom - height - y, 
				_ => y, 
			};
		}

		internal virtual void CalcBorder(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementBorderInfo borderInfo, CssBorderProperties cssBorderInfo, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, bool isHorizontal)
		{
			borderInfo.Clear();
			if (cssBorderInfo.AllowBorder && cssBorderInfo.Style.Value != CssBorderStyle.None)
			{
				float containerSize = (isHorizontal ? args.Width : args.Height);
				float scaleFactor = (isHorizontal ? RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Width : RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Height);
				borderInfo.Width = (int)(cssBorderInfo.CalcWidth(args.Size - NonClientSize, containerSize, RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, TextMetrics.FontSize, scaleFactor) + 0.49f);
				System.Drawing.Color color = cssBorderInfo.Color.GetColor(cache, ForeColor);
				if (!cssBorderInfo.Color.IsEmpty)
				{
					color = ApplyOpacityOnColor(color, Opacity);
				}
				borderInfo.Color = color;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CalcBounds(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			Location = args.Location;
			UpdateArgs(ref args);
			System.Drawing.Size size = CalcContent(cache, args);
			System.Drawing.Size size2 = size + NonClientSize;
			Size = size2;
		}

		protected virtual System.Drawing.Size CalcContent(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			return Layout.Calc(cache, this, args.Clone());
		}

		private void UpdateArgs(ref DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			args = args.Clone();
			EnsureClientBounds(args);
			EnsurePreferredSize(args);
		}

		private void EnsureClientBounds(DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			args.Location = ClientLocation;
			args.Size -= NonClientSize;
		}

		internal void EnsurePreferredSize(DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, DxHtmlElementDimensions includedDimensions = DxHtmlElementDimensions.All)
		{
			GetIncludedSizeValues(includedDimensions, out var widthIncluded, out var heightIncluded);
			if (widthIncluded)
			{
				useAutoWidthCore = true;
				int width = 0;
				if (!args.UseAutoSize)
				{
					if (StyleWidth.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length && CanSetSizeValue(args, StyleWidth, isHorizontal: true))
					{
						args.Width = (args.UseWidthAsPreferred ? args.Width : PredefinedSize.Width);
						useAutoWidthCore = false;
					}
					if (!args.UseWidthAsPreferred)
					{
						if (HasMinWidth && args.Width < MinSize.Width + NonClientSize.Width && CanSetSizeValue(args, Style.MinSize.Width, isHorizontal: true))
						{
							args.Width = MinSize.Width;
							useAutoWidthCore = false;
						}
						if (HasMaxWidth && args.Width > MaxSize.Width + NonClientSize.Width && CanSetSizeValue(args, Style.MaxSize.Width, isHorizontal: true))
						{
							args.Width = MaxSize.Width;
							useAutoWidthCore = false;
						}
					}
				}
				if (args.ForceSetPreferredWidth)
				{
					useAutoWidthCore = false;
				}
				if (!useAutoWidthCore)
				{
					width = args.Width;
				}
				preferredSizeCore.Width = width;
			}
			if (heightIncluded)
			{
				useAutoHeightCore = true;
				int height = 0;
				if (!args.UseAutoSize)
				{
					if (StyleHeight.UnitType == CssUnitAuto.Length && CanSetSizeValue(args, StyleHeight, isHorizontal: false))
					{
						args.Height = (args.UseHeightAsPreferred ? args.Height : PredefinedSize.Height);
						useAutoHeightCore = false;
					}
					if (!args.UseHeightAsPreferred)
					{
						if (HasMinHeight && args.Height < MinSize.Height + NonClientSize.Height && CanSetSizeValue(args, Style.MinSize.Height, isHorizontal: false))
						{
							args.Height = MinSize.Height;
							useAutoHeightCore = false;
						}
						if (HasMaxHeight && args.Height > MaxSize.Height + NonClientSize.Height && CanSetSizeValue(args, Style.MaxSize.Height, isHorizontal: false))
						{
							args.Height = MaxSize.Height;
							useAutoHeightCore = false;
						}
					}
				}
				if (args.ForceSetPreferredHeight)
				{
					useAutoHeightCore = false;
				}
				if (!useAutoHeightCore)
				{
					height = args.Height;
				}
				preferredSizeCore.Height = height;
			}
			args.UseAutoSize = false;
			args.UseSizeAsPreferred = false;
			args.ForceSetPreferredSize = false;
		}

		private void GetIncludedSizeValues(DxHtmlElementDimensions includedDimensions, out bool widthIncluded, out bool heightIncluded)
		{
			widthIncluded = (includedDimensions & DxHtmlElementDimensions.Width) == DxHtmlElementDimensions.Width;
			heightIncluded = (includedDimensions & DxHtmlElementDimensions.Height) == DxHtmlElementDimensions.Height;
		}

		private bool CanSetSizeValue(DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, CssUnit cssUnit, bool isHorizontal)
		{
			if ((isHorizontal && args.IgnoreRelativeWidth) || (!isHorizontal && args.IgnoreRelativeHeight))
			{
				return cssUnit.ValueType != CssUnitValueType.Percentage;
			}
			return true;
		}

			clientRectangleCore = new Rectangle(ClientLocation, Size - NonClientSize);

		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			System.Drawing.Point empty = System.Drawing.Point.Empty;
			if (IsContentContainer)
			{
				return empty;
			}
			PortablePadding contentPadding;
			if (Style.Display != CssDisplay.Inline)
			{
				int y = empty.Y;
				contentPadding = ContentPadding;
				empty.Y = y + ((PortablePadding)(ref contentPadding)).Top;

			int x = empty.X;

		}

		protected virtual Font GetFont(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			return GetFont(Style, cache, args, ParentElementInfo.Font);
		}

		protected Font GetFont(CssStyle style, IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, Font parentFont)
		{
			CssFontProperties fontProperties = style.FontProperties;
			CssTextProperties textProperties = style.TextProperties;
			Font font = RootElementInfo.Font;
			if (!CheckFontIsSpecified(style))
			{
				return parentFont;
			}
			if (fontProperties.IsAbsoluteSize)
			{
				font = RootElementInfo.DefaultFont;
			}
			GraphicsUnit unit = fontProperties.GetUnit(parentFont, font);
			if (fontProperties.Family.IsEmpty)
			{
				return cache.GetFont(parentFont, fontProperties.CalcFontSize(args.Size, font.Size, parentFont.Size, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Height), style.GetFontStyle(), unit);
			}
			return cache.GetFont(parentFont, style.FontFamily, fontProperties.CalcFontSize(args.Size, font.Size, parentFont.Size, RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Height), style.GetFontStyle(), unit);
		}

		protected bool CheckFontIsSpecified(CssStyle style)
		{
			if (!style.FontProperties.HasChanges)
			{
				return style.TextProperties.CheckPropertyChanged(CssTextPropertyName.TextDecorationLine);
			}
			return true;
		}

		}

		private PortablePadding CalcContentPaddingCore()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PortablePadding padding = Padding;
			int num = ((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Left + Borders.Left.Width;
			padding = Padding;
			int num2 = ((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Top + Borders.Top.Width;
			padding = Padding;
			int num3 = ((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Right + Borders.Right.Width;
			padding = Padding;
			return new PortablePadding(num, num2, num3, ((PortablePadding)(ref padding)).Bottom + Borders.Bottom.Width);
		}

		public System.Drawing.Point GetRelativePoint(System.Drawing.Point absPoint)
		{
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = this;
			System.Drawing.Point result = absPoint;
			while (dxHtmlElementInfoBase != null)
			{
				result.Offset(-dxHtmlElementInfoBase.X, -dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Y);
				dxHtmlElementInfoBase = dxHtmlElementInfoBase.ParentElementInfo;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public System.Drawing.Point GetAbsolutePoint(System.Drawing.Point relativePoint)
		{
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = this;
			System.Drawing.Point result = relativePoint;
			while (dxHtmlElementInfoBase != null)
			{
				result.Offset(dxHtmlElementInfoBase.Location);
				dxHtmlElementInfoBase = dxHtmlElementInfoBase.ParentElementInfo;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public System.Drawing.Point TranslatePointTo(System.Drawing.Point point, DxHtmlElementInfoBase target)
		{
			return target.GetRelativePoint(GetAbsolutePoint(point));
		}

		public System.Drawing.Point TranslatePointToRoot(System.Drawing.Point point)
		{
			return RootElementInfo.GetRelativePoint(GetAbsolutePoint(point));
		}

		public System.Drawing.Point TranslateLocationTo(DxHtmlElementInfoBase target)
		{
			return target.GetRelativePoint(GetAbsolutePoint(System.Drawing.Point.Empty));
		}

		public System.Drawing.Point TranslateLocationToRoot()
		{
			return RootElementInfo.GetRelativePoint(GetAbsolutePoint(System.Drawing.Point.Empty));
		}

		public Rectangle GetRelativeRect(Rectangle absoluteRect)
		{
			return new Rectangle(GetRelativePoint(absoluteRect.Location), absoluteRect.Size);
		}

		public Rectangle GetAbsoluteRect(Rectangle relativeRect)
		{
			return new Rectangle(GetAbsolutePoint(relativeRect.Location), relativeRect.Size);
		}

		public Rectangle TranslateRectTo(Rectangle rect, DxHtmlElementInfoBase target)
		{
			return target.GetRelativeRect(GetAbsoluteRect(rect));
		}

		public Rectangle GetAbsoluteBounds()
		{
			return GetAbsoluteRect(new Rectangle(System.Drawing.Point.Empty, Size));
		}

		public Rectangle TranslateBoundsTo(DxHtmlElementInfoBase target)
		{
			return TranslateRectTo(new Rectangle(System.Drawing.Point.Empty, Size), target);
		}

		public Rectangle TranslateBoundsToRoot()
		{
			return TranslateBoundsTo(RootElementInfo);
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			LayoutInfo?.Clear();
			Font = null;
			textMetricsCore = DxHtmlElementTextMetrics.Default;
			Shadow?.Dispose();
			Shadow = null;
			parentIsLink = null;
		}

		{
			layoutInfoCore = null;
		}

		protected virtual DxHtmlChildInfoCollectionBase CreateChildInfoCollection()
		{
			return new DxHtmlChildInfoCollection(elementCore);
		}

		public object GetImage(string imageId, IDxHtmlClient client, bool isBindable)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(imageId))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (imageId[0] == '#')
			{
				return DxHtmlResourceProvider.Current.GetImage(imageId);
			}
			object image = client.GetImage(imageId, isBindable, elementCore);
			if (isBindable && image is string)
			{
				image = client.GetImage((string)image, field: false, elementCore);
			}
			if (image is System.Drawing.Image || image is SvgImage)
			{
				return image;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void AllocId()
		{
			if (parentElementInfoCore == null)
			{
				parentElementInfoCore = ((DxHtmlElementBase)elementCore.ParentNode).ViewInfo;
			}
			if (RootElement != null)
			{
				rootElementInfoCore = RootElement.ViewInfo;
			}
			RootElementInfo.AllocId(out internalIdCore);
		}

		internal void ReleaseId()
		{
			RootElementInfo.ReleaseId(ref internalIdCore);
			rootElementInfoCore = null;
			parentElementInfoCore = null;
		}

	internal class DxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo : DxHtmlElementInfoBase
	{
		private DxHtmlElementInfoBase owner;

		private Rectangle contentBounds;

		public override CssPosition Position => CssPosition.Static;

		public override CssStyle Style => owner.Style;

		public DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition Type { get; set; }

		public DxHtmlElementInfoBase StartItem { get; set; }

		public override DxHtmlElementInfoBase ParentElementInfo => owner.ParentElementInfo;

		public override DxHtmlRootElementInfo RootElementInfo => owner.RootElementInfo;

		public override DxHtmlElementPainter Painter => DxHtmlElementPainterRepository.GetDefault();

		public DxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo(DxHtmlElementInfoBase owner, Rectangle bounds)
			: base(owner.Element)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			contentBounds = bounds;
		}

		internal override void CalcBorder(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementBorderInfo borderInfo, CssBorderProperties cssBorderInfo, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, bool isHorizontal)
		{
			if (((Type != DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition.Start && Type != DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition.Inside) || borderInfo.Type != DxHtmlElementBorder.Right) && ((Type != DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition.End && Type != DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition.Inside) || borderInfo.Type != DxHtmlElementBorder.Left))
			{
				base.CalcBorder(cache, borderInfo, cssBorderInfo, args, isHorizontal);
			}
		}

		protected override DxHtmlChildInfoCollectionBase CreateChildInfoCollection()
		{
			return new DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfoCollection(base.Element);
		}

		protected override void CalcLeftCornerRadiuses(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, System.Drawing.Size size)
		{
			if (Type != DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition.End && Type != DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition.Inside)
			{
				base.CalcLeftCornerRadiuses(cache, args, size);
			}
		}

		protected override void CalcRightCornerRadiuses(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args, System.Drawing.Size size)
		{
			if (Type != DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition.Start && Type != DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition.Inside)
			{
				base.CalcRightCornerRadiuses(cache, args, size);
			}
		}

		protected override void CalcBounds(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			System.Drawing.Point location = contentBounds.Location;
			location.Offset(0, -base.ClientLocation.Y);

	public class DxHtmlImageElementInfoBase : DxHtmlElementInfo
	{
		public object Image { get; set; }

		public Rectangle ImageBounds { get; protected set; }

		public virtual bool PlaceholderImageUsed => false;

		public System.Drawing.Color PlaceholderColor { get; protected set; }

		public override bool Selectable => true;

		public override DxHtmlSelectionLayer ContentSelectionLayer => DxHtmlSelectionLayer.Foreground;

		public DxHtmlImageElementInfoBase(DxHtmlElement element)
			: base(element)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void EnsureImage(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnCalcComplete(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			ImageBounds = CalcImageBounds(cache, base.ClientRectangle);
		}

		protected virtual Rectangle CalcImageBounds(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (Image == null)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			CssObjectFit cssObjectFit = (PlaceholderImageUsed ? CssObjectFit.ScaleDown : Style.MainProperties.ObjectFit.UnitType);
			if (cssObjectFit == CssObjectFit.Fill)
			{
				return bounds;
			}
			System.Drawing.Size imageSize = cache.GetImageSize(Image);
			float val = (float)bounds.Width / (float)imageSize.Width;
			float val2 = (float)bounds.Height / (float)imageSize.Height;
			switch (cssObjectFit)
			{
			case CssObjectFit.Contain:
			{
				float num3 = Math.Min(val, val2);
				return CenterRectangle(bounds, num3 * (float)imageSize.Width, num3 * (float)imageSize.Height);
			}
			case CssObjectFit.Cover:
			{
				float num2 = Math.Max(val, val2);
				return CenterRectangle(bounds, num2 * (float)imageSize.Width, num2 * (float)imageSize.Height);
			}
			case CssObjectFit.None:
				return CenterRectangle(bounds, imageSize.Width, imageSize.Height);
			case CssObjectFit.ScaleDown:
			{
				float num = Math.Min(val, val2);
				if (num > 1f)
				{
					return CenterRectangle(bounds, imageSize.Width, imageSize.Height);
				}
				return CenterRectangle(bounds, num * (float)imageSize.Width, num * (float)imageSize.Height);
			}
			default:
				return base.ClientRectangle;
			}
		}

		private Rectangle CenterRectangle(Rectangle bounds, float width, float height)
		{
			float num = (float)bounds.X + ((float)bounds.Width - width) * 0.5f;
			float num2 = (float)bounds.Y + ((float)bounds.Height - height) * 0.5f;
			return new Rectangle((int)Math.Ceiling(num), (int)Math.Ceiling(num2), (int)Math.Ceiling(width), (int)Math.Ceiling(height));
		}

		protected override System.Drawing.Size CalcContent(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			EnsureImage(cache);
			System.Drawing.Size empty = System.Drawing.Size.Empty;
			if (Image == null)
			{
				return empty;
			}
			empty = cache.GetImageSize(Image);
			if (!useAutoWidthCore)
			{
				empty.Width = PreferredSize.Width;
			}
			if (!useAutoHeightCore)
			{
				empty.Height = PreferredSize.Height;
			}
			return empty;
		}

		public virtual ISvgPaletteProvider GetSvgPalette()
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

		private static DxHtmlListItemMarker TryGetMarkerElement(int itemNumber, CssListStyleType style, IDxHtmlClient client, CssContent content, DxHtmlElementBase owner)
		{
			if (markerCacheCore == null)

				markerCacheCore = new Dictionary<string, DxHtmlListItemMarker>();

			string key;
			string text;
			if (content.ContentType == CssContentType.Text)

				key = content.IsBindable + content.Value;
				text = ((!content.IsBindable) ? content.Value : client.GetDisplayValue(content.Value, owner));

			else
			{
				key = (text = GetMarkerByNumber(itemNumber, style));
			}
			if (!markerCacheCore.TryGetValue(key, out var value))

				value = new DxHtmlListItemMarker(new DxHtmlDocumentNode(new TextElementTag
				{
					Text = text
				}));

		}

		public void CalcItem(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementInfoBase itemElementInfo, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{

			}
			else

				dxHtmlListItemMarkerInfo.CalcProperties(cache, args);

				MarkerInfos.Add(new MarkerInfo(text, size, dxHtmlListItemMarkerInfo));
			}

		}

		private static string GetMarkerByNumber(int number, CssListStyleType type)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case CssListStyleType.Circle:
				return "◦ ";
			case CssListStyleType.Square:
				return "▪ ";
			case CssListStyleType.Disc:
				return "• ";
			case CssListStyleType.LowerAlpha:
			case CssListStyleType.UpperAlpha:
			{
				if (number <= 0)
				{
					return number + " ";
				}
				bool flag = type == CssListStyleType.LowerAlpha;
				int num3 = (flag ? 97 : 65);
				int num4 = (flag ? 122 : 90);
				int num5 = num4 - num3 + 1;
				StringBuilder stringBuilder2 = new StringBuilder();
				int num6 = number / num5;
				int num7 = number % num5;
				for (int i = 0; i < num6; i++)
				{
					stringBuilder2.Append((char)(num3 + i));
				}
				stringBuilder2.Append((char)(num3 + num7 - 1));
				return stringBuilder2.ToString() + ". ";
			}
			case CssListStyleType.LowerRoman:
			case CssListStyleType.UpperRoman:
			{
				if (number <= 0)
				{
					return number + " ";
				}
				SortedList<int, string> sortedList = ((type != CssListStyleType.LowerRoman) ? new SortedList<int, string>
				{
					{ 1, "I" },
					{ 4, "IV" },
					{ 5, "V" },
					{ 9, "IX" },
					{ 10, "X" },
					{ 40, "XL" },
					{ 50, "L" },
					{ 90, "XC" },
					{ 100, "C" },
					{ 400, "CD" },
					{ 500, "D" },
					{ 900, "CM" },
					{ 1000, "M" }
				} : new SortedList<int, string>
				{
					{ 1, "i" },
					{ 4, "iv" },
					{ 5, "v" },
					{ 9, "ix" },
					{ 10, "x" },
					{ 40, "xl" },
					{ 50, "l" },
					{ 90, "xc" },
					{ 100, "c" },
					{ 400, "cd" },
					{ 500, "d" },
					{ 900, "cm" },
					{ 1000, "m" }
				});
				int num = sortedList.Count - 1;
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				while (number > 0)
				{
					int num2 = sortedList.Keys[num];
					if (number >= num2)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(sortedList.Values[num]);
						number -= num2;
					}
					else
					{
						num--;
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(".");
				return stringBuilder.ToString() + " ";
			}
			default:
				return number + ". ";
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> GetTopZOrderedElements(bool inReverseOrder = false)
		{
			EnsureZOrder();
			if (firstTopElementZIndex >= 0)
			{
				int index = (inReverseOrder ? (elementInfos.Count - 1) : firstTopElementZIndex);
				int step = ((!inReverseOrder) ? 1 : (-1));
				for (int count = elementInfos.Count - firstTopElementZIndex; count > 0; count--)
				{
					yield return zOrderedElementInfos[index];
					index += step;
				}
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> GetBottomZOrderedElements(bool inReverseOrder = false)
		{
			EnsureZOrder();
			if (firstTopElementZIndex != 0 && Count != 0)
			{
				int num = ((firstTopElementZIndex > 0) ? (firstTopElementZIndex - 1) : (Count - 1));
				int index = (inReverseOrder ? num : 0);
				int step = ((!inReverseOrder) ? 1 : (-1));
				for (int count = ((firstTopElementZIndex > 0) ? firstTopElementZIndex : Count); count > 0; count--)
				{
					yield return zOrderedElementInfos[index];
					index += step;
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResetZOrder()
		{
			zOrderIsReady = false;
			firstTopElementZIndex = -1;
		}

		private void EnsureZOrder()
		{
			if (zOrderIsReady)
			{
				return;
			}
			zOrderedElementInfos.Clear();
			firstTopElementZIndex = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < elementInfos.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = elementInfos[i];
				int num = elementInfos.Count;
				int num2 = 0;
				while (num2 < zOrderedElementInfos.Count)
				{
					DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase2 = zOrderedElementInfos[num2];
					if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase2.ZIndex > dxHtmlElementInfoBase.ZIndex)
					{

					i++;
				}
				zOrderedElementInfos.Insert(num, dxHtmlElementInfoBase);
				UpdateFirstTopElementZIndex(dxHtmlElementInfoBase, num);
			}
			zOrderIsReady = true;
		}

			});

		}

				base.Height = Math.Max(size.Height, size2.Height);

		}

		private void CheckGraphicsCache(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache)
		{
			SizeF scaleFactor = cache.ScaleFactor;
			if (((IGraphicsCache)cache).UseDirectXPaint != UseDirectX || !(scaleFactor == ScaleFactor))
			{
				ScaleFactor = scaleFactor;
				UseDirectX = ((IGraphicsCache)cache).UseDirectXPaint;
				RootElement.ActualContext.ResetCache();
			}
		}

		protected override Font GetFont(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			CssFontProperties fontProperties = Style.FontProperties;
			CssTextProperties textProperties = Style.TextProperties;
			Font defaultFont = DefaultFont;
			if (!fontProperties.HasChanges && !textProperties.CheckPropertyChanged(CssTextPropertyName.TextDecorationLine))
			{
				return defaultFont;
			}
			GraphicsUnit unit = fontProperties.GetUnit(defaultFont, defaultFont);
			if (fontProperties.Family.IsEmpty)
			{
				return cache.GetFont(defaultFont, fontProperties.CalcFontSize(args.Size, defaultFont.Size, defaultFont.Size, ScaleFactor.Height), Style.GetFontStyle(), unit);
			}
			return cache.GetFont(defaultFont, Style.FontFamily, fontProperties.CalcFontSize(args.Size, defaultFont.Size, defaultFont.Size, ScaleFactor.Height), Style.GetFontStyle(), unit);
		}

		internal bool AllocId(out ulong? id)
		{
			id = null;
			if (ReleasedIds.Count > 0)
			{
				id = ReleasedIds.Pop();
				return true;
			}
			if (nextIdCore <= ulong.MaxValue)
			{
				id = nextIdCore++;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ReleaseId(ref ulong? id)
		{
			if (id.HasValue)
			{
				ReleasedIds.Push(id.Value);
				id = null;
			}
		}

		private System.Drawing.Color CorrectDefaultColor(System.Drawing.Color color)
		{

				return color;
			}
			return System.Drawing.Color.Black;
		}

		protected internal override void CalcSelectionBounds()
		{

			selectionBoundsCore = Rectangle.Empty;
			if (!Parent.HasSelectedContent)

				selectionBoundsCore = base.ClientRectangle;
			}
			else
			{
				if (Parent.SelectionLength == 0 || (!IsSelectionStart && !IsSelectionEnd))
				{
					return;
				}
				base.HasSelectedContent = true;
				bool flag = Parent.TextInfo.TrimmedInfo != null && displayLengthCore.HasValue;

					num4 = ((!IsWhiteSpace || num3 != startIndexCore + num - 1) ? CharPositionToX(num3, trailingEdge: true) : base.ClientRectangle.Right);
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = startIndexCore + num - 1;
					num4 = ((!IsWhiteSpace) ? CharPositionToX(num3, trailingEdge: true) : base.ClientRectangle.Right);
				}
				selectionBoundsCore = new Rectangle(base.ClientRectangle.X + num2, base.ClientRectangle.Y, num4 - num2, base.ClientRectangle.Height);
				if (selectionStart < startIndexCore && num3 >= startIndexCore + num)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (selectionStart > startIndexCore && num3 < startIndexCore + num - 1)
				{
					textRunsCore = new DxHtmlTextRun[3];

					{
						Bounds = new Rectangle(base.ClientRectangle.X, base.ClientRectangle.Y, selectionBoundsCore.X - base.ClientRectangle.X, base.ClientRectangle.Height)
					};
					textRunsCore[1] = new DxHtmlTextRun(this, selectionStart, num3 - selectionStart + 1, isSelected: true)
					{

					};
					textRunsCore[2] = new DxHtmlTextRun(this, num3 + 1, num - (num3 - startIndexCore) - 1, isSelected: false, flag)
					{
						Bounds = new Rectangle(selectionBoundsCore.Right, base.ClientRectangle.Y, base.ClientRectangle.Width - selectionBoundsCore.Right, base.ClientRectangle.Height)

				}

					};
					textRunsCore[1] = new DxHtmlTextRun(this, selectionStart, num3 - selectionStart + 1, isSelected: true)
					{
						Bounds = selectionBoundsCore
					};
					if (flag)
					{
						textRunsCore[2] = new DxHtmlTextRun(this, 0, 0, isSelected: false, isTrimmed: true)
						{
							Bounds = new Rectangle(selectionBoundsCore.Right, base.ClientRectangle.Y, base.ClientRectangle.Width - selectionBoundsCore.Right, base.ClientRectangle.Height)
						};
					}
				}
				else
				{
					textRunsCore = new DxHtmlTextRun[2];
					textRunsCore[0] = new DxHtmlTextRun(this, selectionStart, num3 - selectionStart + 1, isSelected: true)

		protected internal override void SelectContent(bool value)
		{
			base.SelectContent(value);
			try
			{
				if (!value)
				{
					return;
				}
				DxHtmlSelection selection = RootElement.Selection;
				if (selection.QuerySelectAll(base.Element))
				{
					SelectAll();
				}
				else if (selection.InsideElement(base.Element))
				{
					int val = selection.StartCaretPosition ?? CalcSelectionRangeIndex(selection.StartPoint);
					int val2 = selection.EndCaretPosition ?? CalcSelectionRangeIndex(selection.EndPoint);
					int num = Math.Min(val, val2);
					int num2 = Math.Max(val, val2);
					if (selection.SelectionMode != TextSelectionMode.Character)
					{
						num = GetWordStartIndex(Text, num, Text.Length);
						num2 = GetWordEndIndex(Text, num2, Text.Length);
					}

					selectionLength = num2 - num;
				}
				else
				{
					int num3 = (selection.HasCaretPosition(base.Element) ? selection.GetCaretPosition(base.Element) : CalcSelectionRangeIndex(selection.QueryCursorPoint(base.Element)));
					bool flag = selection.IsBackwardRelativeTo(base.Element);
					if (selection.SelectionMode != TextSelectionMode.Character)
					{
						num3 = ((!flag) ? GetWordStartIndex(Text, num3, Text.Length) : GetWordEndIndex(Text, num3, Text.Length));
					}
					selectionStart = ((!flag) ? num3 : 0);
					selectionLength = (flag ? num3 : (Text.Length - num3));
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				CalcSelectionBounds();
			}
		}

		private int GetWordStartIndex(string text, int charIndex, int length)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int num;
			for (num = charIndex; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (num < length)
				{
					char ch = text[num];
					bool flag2 = DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckIsWordChar(ch);
					if (flag2 || flag)
					{
						flag = true;
						if (!flag2)
						{
							num = Math.Min(charIndex, num + 1);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return Math.Max(0, num);
		}

		private int GetWordEndIndex(string text, int charIndex, int length)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int i;
			for (i = charIndex; i < length; i++)
			{
				char ch = text[i];
				if (!DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckIsWordChar(ch) || flag)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return i;
		}

		private void SelectAll()
		{

			selectionLength = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Text)) ? Text.Length : 0);
		}

		private int CalcSelectionRangeIndex(System.Drawing.Point pt)
		{
			pt = GetRelativePoint(pt);
			DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo = FindClosestLineBlock(pt);
			if (dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo != null)
			{
				if (pt.X > dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo.X && pt.X < dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo.Bounds.Right)
				{
					bool trailingEdge;
					int num = dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo.GetCaretPositionByX(pt.X - dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo.X, out trailingEdge);
					if (trailingEdge)
					{
						num++;
					}
					return num;
				}
				return dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo.StartIndex + dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo.Text.Length;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo FindClosestLineBlock(System.Drawing.Point pt)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo = null;
			DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo result = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Children.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo2 = base.Children[i] as DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo;
				if (num2 != dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo2.LineIndex)
				{
					num2 = dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo2.LineIndex;
					if (num > pt.Y)
					{
						break;
					}
					result = dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo;
					num = 0;
				}
				if (pt.X > dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo2.X)
				{
					result = dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo2;
				}
				num = Math.Max(dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo2.Bounds.Bottom, num);
				dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo = dxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo2;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal override void CalcProperties(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{

			Font font = base.Font;
			base.CalcProperties(cache, args);
			if (flag)
			{

			}
			string text = TextElement.Tag.GetText(RootElement.ActualClient, base.Element);
			string text2 = rawTextCore;
			CssWhiteSpace whiteSpaceMode = WhiteSpaceMode;
			int num = deviceDpiCore;
			rawTextCore = text;
			deviceDpiCore = ((IGraphicsCache)cache).DeviceDpi;
			WhiteSpaceMode = Style.TextProperties.WhiteSpace.Value;
			CalcTextOverflow(cache, args);
			TextInfo.TrimmedInfo = trimmedTextInfoCore;
			bool flag2 = text2 != rawTextCore;
			if (flag2 || whiteSpaceMode != WhiteSpaceMode)
			{
				TextInfo.Text = ProcessTextFormatting(text);
			}
			if (text.Length < 50)
			{
				if (flag2 || whiteSpaceMode != WhiteSpaceMode)
				{
					TextInfo.MeasureString = RootElement.ActualContext.MeasureString<DxHtmlTextMetadata>(TextInfo.Text, base.Font, cache, out TextInfo.TextMetadata, isRtl: false);
				}
				else if (font != base.Font || num != deviceDpiCore)
				{
					TextInfo.MeasureString = RootElement.ActualContext.MeasureString(TextInfo.Text, base.Font, cache, isRtl: false);
				}
			}
			else if (flag2 || whiteSpaceMode != WhiteSpaceMode || font != base.Font || num != deviceDpiCore)
			{
				if (!RootElement.ActualContext.TryGetMeasuredString<DxHtmlTextMetadata>(TextInfo.Text, base.Font, ((IGraphicsCache)cache).DeviceDpi, out TextInfo.MeasureString, out TextInfo.TextMetadata))
				{
					TextInfo.MeasureString = RootElement.ActualContext.MeasureString<DxHtmlTextMetadata>(TextInfo.Text, TextInfo.Text, base.Font, cache, out TextInfo.TextMetadata, isRtl: false);
				}
				else if (TextInfo.MeasureString == null)
				{
					TextInfo.MeasureString = RootElement.ActualContext.MeasureString(TextInfo.Text, TextInfo.Text, base.Font, cache, isRtl: false);
				}
			}
			if (text2 != null && flag2)
			{
				isWhitespaceCore = CheckIsWhitespaceText(text);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CalcTextOverflow(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			if (ParentElementInfo != null && !ParentElementInfo.Style.TextProperties.OverflowX.IsEmpty && ParentElementInfo.Style.TextProperties.OverflowX.Value == CssOverflow.Hidden)
			{
				CssTextOverflow textOverflow = ParentElementInfo.Style.TextOverflow;
				if (textOverflowCore == textOverflow)
				{
					return false;
				}
				textOverflowCore = textOverflow;
				trimmedTextInfoCore = null;
				if (textOverflowCore == CssTextOverflow.Ellipsis && !RootElement.ActualContext.TryGetMeasuredString("...", base.Font, ((IGraphicsCache)cache).DeviceDpi, out trimmedTextInfoCore))
				{
					trimmedTextInfoCore = RootElement.ActualContext.MeasureString("...", "...", base.Font, cache, isRtl: false);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CalcElement(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			LineBlocks.Clear();
			if (!TextInfo.IsEmpty)
			{
				DxHtmlInlineLayoutContext inlineLayoutContext = args.InlineLayoutContext;
				int lineWidth = inlineLayoutContext?.LineWidth ?? args.Width;
				int lineOffset = ((inlineLayoutContext != null) ? (inlineLayoutContext.Location.X - inlineLayoutContext.LineOriginX) : 0);
				int num = inlineLayoutContext?.LineItems.Count ?? 0;
				CssTextAlign cssTextAlign = ParentElementInfo?.InternalTextAlign ?? InternalTextAlign;
				CssTextAlign textAlign = ((!args.UseLeftTextAlign) ? cssTextAlign : CssTextAlign.Left);
				bool prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace = inlineLayoutContext == null || inlineLayoutContext.LineItems.Count == 0 || inlineLayoutContext.PrevItemHasEndWhiteSpace;
				switch (WhiteSpaceMode)
				{
				case CssWhiteSpace.Pre:
					DoLayoutWithPreserveWhiteSpaces();
					break;
				case CssWhiteSpace.NoWrap:
					DoLayoutWithoutWrap(ref prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace);
					break;
				case CssWhiteSpace.PreWrap:
					DoLayoutWithWrapAndPreserveWhiteSpaces(textAlign, lineOffset, lineWidth);
					break;
				case CssWhiteSpace.PreLine:
					DoLayoutWithWrapAndPreserveNewLines(textAlign, lineOffset, lineWidth, ref prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace);
					break;
				default:
					DoLayoutWithWrapAndCollapseWhiteSpaces(textAlign, lineOffset, lineWidth, ref prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace);
					break;
				}
				if (inlineLayoutContext != null)
				{
					inlineLayoutContext.PrevItemHasEndWhiteSpace = prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override System.Drawing.Size CalcContent(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			CalcElement(cache, args);
			return base.CalcContent(cache, args);
		}

		private void DoLayoutWithoutWrap(ref bool prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace)
		{
			DxHtmlTextLine dxHtmlTextLine = TextInfo.Lines[0];
			int num = dxHtmlTextLine.WordsRanges.Length;
			bool flag = prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace;

				AddTextLineBlock(first, wordEndIndex, isStartLineElement: false, isEndLineElement: false, isEndOfLogicalLine: false, value);
				prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace = characterRange.First + characterRange.Length < dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First + dxHtmlTextLine.Range.Length;
			}
			else
			{
				int first2 = dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First;
				int wordEndIndex2 = dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First + dxHtmlTextLine.Range.Length - 1;
				if (flag)
				{
					AddTextLineBlock(first2, first2 - 1);
				}
				else
				{
					AddTextLineBlock(first2, wordEndIndex2, isStartLineElement: false, isEndLineElement: false, isEndOfLogicalLine: false, first2 - 1);
				}
				prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace = true;
			}
		}

		private void DoLayoutWithPreserveWhiteSpaces()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < TextInfo.Lines.Length; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlTextLine dxHtmlTextLine = TextInfo.Lines[i];
				AddTextLineBlock(dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First, dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First + dxHtmlTextLine.Range.Length - 1, isStartLineElement: false, isEndOfLogicalLine: dxHtmlTextLine.Ended, isEndLineElement: dxHtmlTextLine.Ended);
			}
		}

		private void DoLayoutWithWrapAndPreserveNewLines(CssTextAlign textAlign, int lineOffset, int lineWidth, ref bool prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < TextInfo.Lines.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					lineOffset = 0;
				}
				DxHtmlTextLine dxHtmlTextLine = TextInfo.Lines[i];
				bool flag = i == TextInfo.Lines.Length - 1;
				if (dxHtmlTextLine.WordsRanges.Length != 0)
				{
					TextLineLayoutFlags textLineLayoutFlags = TextLineLayoutFlags.CollapseEndWhiteSpaces;
					if (textAlign == CssTextAlign.Justify)
					{
						textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.JustifyAlignUsed;
					}
					if (dxHtmlTextLine.Ended)
					{
						textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.LineEnded;
						textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.LogicalLineEnded;
					}
					if (i == 0)
					{
						textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.FirstLine;
					}
					if (i == TextInfo.Lines.Length - 1)
					{
						textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.LastLine;
					}
					if (prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace || i > 0)
					{
						textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.RemoveStartWhiteSpaces;
					}
					DoLayoutWords(dxHtmlTextLine.Range, dxHtmlTextLine.WordsRanges, lineOffset, lineWidth, textLineLayoutFlags);
					CharacterRange characterRange = dxHtmlTextLine.WordsRanges[dxHtmlTextLine.WordsRanges.Length - 1];
					prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace = characterRange.First + characterRange.Length < dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First + dxHtmlTextLine.Range.Length;
				}
				else
				{
					int first = dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First;
					int num = dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First + dxHtmlTextLine.Range.Length - 1;
					if (!prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace)
					{
						AddTextLineBlock(first, num, isStartLineElement: false, isEndOfLogicalLine: dxHtmlTextLine.Ended, isEndLineElement: dxHtmlTextLine.Ended, collapsedEndIndex: first - 1);
					}
					else
					{
						AddTextLineBlock(first, first - 1, isStartLineElement: false, isEndOfLogicalLine: dxHtmlTextLine.Ended, isEndLineElement: dxHtmlTextLine.Ended);
					}
					prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void DoLayoutWithWrapAndPreserveWhiteSpaces(CssTextAlign textAlign, int lineOffset, int lineWidth)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < TextInfo.Lines.Length; i++)
			{
				if (i > 0)
				{
					lineOffset = 0;
				}
				DxHtmlTextLine dxHtmlTextLine = TextInfo.Lines[i];
				if (dxHtmlTextLine.WordsRanges.Length != 0)
				{
					TextLineLayoutFlags textLineLayoutFlags = TextLineLayoutFlags.PreserveWhiteSpaces;
					if (textAlign == CssTextAlign.Justify)
					{
						textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.JustifyAlignUsed;
					}
					if (dxHtmlTextLine.Ended)
					{
						textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.LineEnded;
						textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.LogicalLineEnded;
					}
					if (i == 0)
					{
						textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.FirstLine;
					}
					if (i == TextInfo.Lines.Length - 1)
					{
						textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.LastLine;
					}
					DoLayoutWords(dxHtmlTextLine.Range, dxHtmlTextLine.WordsRanges, lineOffset, lineWidth, textLineLayoutFlags);
				}
				else
				{
					AddTextLineBlock(dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First, dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First + dxHtmlTextLine.Range.Length - 1, isStartLineElement: false, dxHtmlTextLine.Ended, dxHtmlTextLine.Ended);
				}
			}
		}

		private void DoLayoutWithWrapAndCollapseWhiteSpaces(CssTextAlign textAlign, int lineOffset, int lineWidth, ref bool prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace)
		{
			if (TextInfo.Lines.Length == 0)

				return;
			}

			int num = dxHtmlTextLine.WordsRanges.Length;
			if (num > 0)
			{

				if (textAlign == CssTextAlign.Justify)
				{
					textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.JustifyAlignUsed;
				}
				if (prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace)
				{
					textLineLayoutFlags |= TextLineLayoutFlags.RemoveStartWhiteSpaces;
				}
				DoLayoutWords(dxHtmlTextLine.Range, dxHtmlTextLine.WordsRanges, lineOffset, lineWidth, textLineLayoutFlags);
				CharacterRange characterRange = dxHtmlTextLine.WordsRanges[num - 1];
				prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace = characterRange.First + characterRange.Length < dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First + dxHtmlTextLine.Range.Length;
			}
			else
			{
				int first = dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First;
				int wordEndIndex = dxHtmlTextLine.Range.First + dxHtmlTextLine.Range.Length - 1;
				if (prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace)
				{
					AddTextLineBlock(first, first - 1);
				}
				else
				{
					AddTextLineBlock(first, wordEndIndex, isStartLineElement: false, isEndLineElement: false, isEndOfLogicalLine: false, first - 1);
				}
				prevItemHasEndWhiteSpace = true;
			}
		}

		private void AddTextLineBlock(int wordIndex, int wordEndIndex, bool isStartLineElement = false, bool isEndLineElement = false, bool isEndOfLogicalLine = false, int? collapsedEndIndex = null)
		{
			LineBlocks.Add(CreateTextLineBlock(wordIndex, wordEndIndex, isStartLineElement, isEndLineElement, isEndOfLogicalLine, collapsedEndIndex));
		}

		private int BreakWordIntoLines(int wordIndex, int wordEndIndex, int lineWidth, HorizontalPadding padding, bool canAddLastLine = true)
		{
			int num = wordEndIndex - wordIndex + 1;
			int num2 = num;
			int num3 = padding.All + TextInfo.GetWidthOfCharRange(wordIndex, num2);
			int result = -1;
			do
			{
				if (num3 <= lineWidth || num2 == 1)
				{
					int num4 = wordIndex;
					int wordEndIndex2 = wordIndex + num2 - 1;
					wordIndex += num2;
					num2 = num - num2;
					num = num2;
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						num3 = TextInfo.GetWidthOfCharRange(wordIndex, num2) + padding.Right;
					}
					if (num2 > 0 || canAddLastLine)
					{
						AddTextLineBlock(num4, wordEndIndex2, isStartLineElement: false, num2 > 0);
					}
					if (num2 == 0)
					{
						result = num4;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (num == num2)
					{
						num3 -= padding.Right;
					}
					num3 -= TextInfo.GetCharacterWidth(wordIndex + num2 - 1);
					num2--;
				}
			}
			while (num2 > 0);
			return result;
		}

		private DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo CreateTextLineBlock(int lineStartIndex, int endWordIndex, bool isStartLineElement, bool isEndLineElement, bool isEndOfLogicalLine, int? collapsedEndIndex)
		{
			int? normalizedLength = (collapsedEndIndex.HasValue ? new int?(collapsedEndIndex.Value - lineStartIndex + 1) : ((int?)null));
			return new DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo(this, lineStartIndex, endWordIndex - lineStartIndex + 1, isStartLineElement, isEndLineElement, normalizedLength, isEndOfLogicalLine);
		}

		private string ProcessTextFormatting(string text)
		{
			switch (WhiteSpaceMode)
			{
			case CssWhiteSpace.PreLine:
				return MergeWhitespaces(text, keepNewLines: true);
			case CssWhiteSpace.Pre:
			case CssWhiteSpace.PreWrap:
				return text;
			default:
				return MergeWhitespaces(text);
			}
		}

		private string MergeWhitespaces(string text, bool keepNewLines = false)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (char c in text)
			{
				if (DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckIsWordChar(c))
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(" ");
						flag = false;
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(c);
					continue;
				}
				flag = true;
				if (keepNewLines)
				{
					bool flag2 = NewLineChars[num] == c;
					bool flag3 = num == NewLineChars.Length - 1;
					if ((flag2 && flag3) || c == '\n')
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(NewLineChars);
						num = 0;
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						num = (flag2 ? (num + 1) : 0);
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" ");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override DxHtmlChildInfoCollectionBase CreateChildInfoCollection()
		{
			return new DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfoCollection(base.Element);
		}

	public class DxHtmlTextPseudoElementInfo : DxHtmlTextElementInfo
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<string, DxHtmlTextPseudoElement> textCacheCore;

		private DxHtmlElementInfoBase parentInfoCore;

		private CssStyle styleCore;

		public override DxHtmlElementInfoBase ParentElementInfo => parentInfoCore;

		public override CssStyle Style => styleCore;

		public override DxHtmlRootElement RootElement => parentInfoCore.RootElement;

		public override DxHtmlRootElementInfo RootElementInfo => parentInfoCore.RootElementInfo;

		private static DxHtmlTextPseudoElement TryGetTextElement(string text, bool isBindable)
		{
			if (textCacheCore == null)
			{
				textCacheCore = new Dictionary<string, DxHtmlTextPseudoElement>();
			}
			string key = isBindable + text;
			if (!textCacheCore.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
			{
				HtmlTextType textType = HtmlTextType.Text;
				string[] fields = null;
				if (isBindable)
				{
					textType = HtmlTextType.Field;
					fields = new string[1] { text };
				}
				value = new DxHtmlTextPseudoElement(new DxHtmlDocumentNode(new TextElementTag
				{
					Text = text,
					Fields = fields,
					TextType = textType
				}));
				textCacheCore.Add(key, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public DxHtmlTextPseudoElementInfo(string text, bool isBindable, CssStyle style, DxHtmlElementInfoBase parent)
			: base(TryGetTextElement(text, isBindable))
		{
			parentInfoCore = parent;
			styleCore = style;
		}
	}

		public int GetWidthOfCharRange(int start, int length, CharRangeWidthCalcArgs args = null)
		{
			args = args ?? CharRangeWidthCalcArgs.Empty;
			bool flag = args.OverflowProcessInfo != null && TrimmedInfo != null;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = MeasureString.GetCharacterWidth(0);
			bool flag2 = args.ProcessAsSeparateTextLine && MeasureString.HasDynamicTabWidth && MeasureString.TabStopWidth > 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
			{
				int index = start + i;
				int num4 = MeasureString.GetCharacterWidth(index);
				if (flag2 && Text[index] == '\t')
				{
					num4 = MeasureString.TabStopWidth - num % MeasureString.TabStopWidth;
					flag2 = false;
				}
				num += num4;
				if (flag && i < args.OverflowProcessInfo.TextLength)
				{
					int num5 = args.OverflowProcessInfo.LineWidth - num;
					if (num5 - TrimmedInfo.Size.Width >= 0)
					{
						num2 = i;
						num3 = num;
					}
					if (num5 < 0)
					{
						args.OverflowProcessInfo.Processed = true;
						args.OverflowProcessInfo.DisplayedTextLength = num2 + 1;
						args.OverflowProcessInfo.OverflowedTextWidth = num3 + TrimmedInfo.Size.Width;
						flag = false;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public int GetCharacterWidth(int index)
		{
			return MeasureString.GetCharacterWidth(index);
		}

		public int GetCaretPositionByX(int x, int startIndex, int length, out bool trailingEdge)
		{
			return MeasureString.GetCaretPositionByX(x, startIndex, length, out trailingEdge);
		}

		public int CharPositionToX(int position, bool trailingEdge)
		{
			return MeasureString.CharPositionToX(position, trailingEdge);
		}

		public string GetSubstring(int start, int length, int? displayLength = null)
		{
			if (TrimmedInfo != null && displayLength.HasValue)
			{
				if (displayLength == 0)
				{
					return TrimmedInfo.Text;
				}
				return Text.Substring(start, displayLength.Value) + TrimmedInfo.Text;
			}
			return Text.Substring(start, length);
		}

		public System.Drawing.Size GetSubstringSize(int start, int length, CharRangeWidthCalcArgs args = null)
		{
			int height = ((args == null || !args.CollapseHeightForEmptyRange || length != 0) ? MeasureString.Size.Height : 0);
			return new System.Drawing.Size(GetWidthOfCharRange(start, length, args), height);
		}
	}

		{
			DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicCondition> dxHtmlReadOnlyCollection = new DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicCondition>();
			for (int i = 0; i < tuples.Count; i++)
			{
				Tuple<CssSelector, IDxHtmlSupportCombinator> tuple = tuples[i];
				int index = tuple.Item2.CheckConditionIndex();
				CssSelector item = tuple.Item1;
				dxHtmlReadOnlyCollection.Add(new CssDynamicCondition(item, index));
			}
			CssDynamicStyleSet value = new CssDynamicStyleSet(dxHtmlReadOnlyCollection, styleSet);
			if (conditionsCore == null)
			{
				conditionsCore = new DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicStyleSet> { value };
			}
			else

			}
		}

		{

			{
				new CssDynamicCondition(selector, index)
			};

			if (conditionsCore == null)
			{
				conditionsCore = new DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicStyleSet> { value };
			}
			else
			{
				conditionsCore.Add(value);
			}
		}

	public class DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<T> : IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable
	{
		protected readonly List<T> innerListCore;

		public int Count => innerListCore.Count;

		public T this[int index] => innerListCore[index];

		public DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection(IEnumerable<T> collection)
		{
			innerListCore = new List<T>(collection);
		}

		public DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection()
		{
			innerListCore = new List<T>();
		}

		internal void Add(T value)
		{
			AddCore(Count, value);
		}

		protected virtual void AddCore(int index, T value)
		{
			innerListCore.Add(value);
			OnItemAdded(value, index);
		}

		internal void Insert(int index, T value)
		{
			innerListCore.Insert(index, value);
			OnItemAdded(value, index);
		}

		internal void Remove(T value)
		{
			int num = IndexOfCore(value);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				RemoveCore(value, num);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemAdded(T value, int index)
		{
			OnCollectionChanged(value, index, (CollectionChangedAction)0);
		}

		protected virtual int IndexOfCore(T value)
		{
			return innerListCore.IndexOf(value);
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveCore(T value, int index)
		{
			innerListCore.RemoveAt(index);
			OnItemRemoved(value, index);
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemRemoved(T value, int index)
		{
			OnCollectionChanged(value, index, (CollectionChangedAction)1);
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			ClearCore();
		}

		protected virtual void ClearCore()
		{
			innerListCore.Clear();
			OnCleared();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCleared()
		{
			OnCollectionChanged(default(T), -1, (CollectionChangedAction)3);
		}

		internal void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveAtCore(index);
		}

		protected virtual void RemoveAtCore(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index <= Count)
			{
				RemoveCore(innerListCore[index], index);
			}
		}

		public bool Contains(T value)
		{
			return innerListCore.Contains(value);
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerListCore.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCollectionChanged(T value, int index, CollectionChangedAction collectionChangedAction)
		{
		}
	}
