	public class DxHtmlChildrenCollection : IEnumerable<DxHtmlElement>, IEnumerable
	{
		private DxHtmlNode ownerCore;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual DxHtmlNode Owner => ownerCore;

		public int Length => ownerCore.ChildNodes.ElementCount;

		public DxHtmlElement this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				DxHtmlNodeList childNodes = ownerCore.ChildNodes;
				if (childNodes.ElementCount == 0 || index >= childNodes.ElementCount)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int num = index;
				DxHtmlNode dxHtmlNode;
				while (true)
				{
					dxHtmlNode = childNodes[num];
					if (dxHtmlNode.ElementIndex == index)
					{
						break;
					}
					num++;
				}
				return (DxHtmlElement)dxHtmlNode;
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlChildrenCollection(DxHtmlNode owner)
		{
			ownerCore = owner;
		}

		public IEnumerator<DxHtmlElement> GetEnumerator()
		{
			DxHtmlNodeList childNodes = ownerCore.ChildNodes;
			for (int i = 0; i < childNodes.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlNode dxHtmlNode = childNodes[i];
				if (dxHtmlNode.ElementIndex >= 0)
				{
					yield return (DxHtmlElement)dxHtmlNode;
				}
			}
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	internal class DxHtmlElementIterator : DxHtmlNodeIterator
	{
		public DxHtmlElement CurrentElement => (DxHtmlElement)currentNodeCore;

		protected override bool CanVisitChildren(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			return node.ChildNodes.ElementCount > 0;
		}

		public override bool MoveNext()
		{
			CalcPreOrderIndex();
			while (currentNodeCore != null)
			{
				if (currentNodeCore.ElementIndex < 0)
				{
					CalcPreOrderIndex();
					continue;
				}
				return true;
			}
			Reset();
			return false;
		}

		public override bool MoveInOrder()
		{
			CalcInOrderIndex();
			while (currentNodeCore != null)
			{
				if (currentNodeCore.ElementIndex < 0)
				{
					CalcInOrderIndex();
					continue;
				}
				return true;
			}
			Reset();
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class DxHtmlNodeIterator : IDisposable, IEnumerator
	{
		private int currentIndex = -1;

		internal DxHtmlNode currentNodeCore;

		private DxHtmlNodeList currentNodeListCore;

		private DxHtmlNodeList sourceNodeListCore;

		private Func<DxHtmlNode, bool> canVisitChildren = (DxHtmlNode x) => true;

		public DxHtmlNode CurrentNode => currentNodeCore;

		protected int CurrentIndex => currentIndex;

		protected DxHtmlNodeList CurrentNodeList => currentNodeListCore;

		object IEnumerator.Current => currentNodeCore;

		public void Prepare(DxHtmlNode node, DxHtmlNodeList children, Func<DxHtmlNode, bool> canVisitChildren = null)
		{
			if (children != null)
			{
				Prepare(children, canVisitChildren);
				if (node != null)
				{
					currentIndex = node.NodeIndex;
					currentNodeCore = node;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Prepare(DxHtmlNodeList children, Func<DxHtmlNode, bool> canVisitChildren = null)
		{
			currentNodeListCore = (sourceNodeListCore = children);
			currentNodeCore = null;
			currentIndex = -1;
			if (canVisitChildren != null)
			{
				this.canVisitChildren = canVisitChildren;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanVisitChildren(DxHtmlNode node)
		{
			return node.ChildNodes.Length > 0;
		}

		protected void CalcPreOrderIndex()
		{
			if (currentNodeListCore == null || currentNodeListCore.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (currentIndex == -1)
			{
				currentIndex = 0;
				currentNodeCore = currentNodeListCore[currentIndex];
				return;
			}
			DxHtmlNode dxHtmlNode = currentNodeCore;
			if (canVisitChildren(dxHtmlNode) && CanVisitChildren(dxHtmlNode))
			{
				dxHtmlNode.saveIndexCore = currentIndex;
				currentNodeListCore = dxHtmlNode.ChildNodes;
				currentIndex = 0;
				currentNodeCore = currentNodeListCore[currentIndex];
				return;
			}
			currentIndex++;
			while (true)
			{
				if (currentIndex == currentNodeListCore.Length)
				{
					if (currentNodeListCore == sourceNodeListCore)
					{
						currentIndex = -1;
						currentNodeCore = null;
						break;
					}
					currentIndex = currentNodeListCore.Owner.saveIndexCore + 1;
					currentNodeListCore = currentNodeListCore.Owner.ParentNode.ChildNodes;
				}
				else
				{
					currentNodeCore = currentNodeListCore[currentIndex];
					if (currentNodeCore != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected void CalcInOrderIndex()
		{
			if (currentNodeListCore == null || currentNodeListCore.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (currentIndex == 0)
			{
				if (currentNodeListCore == sourceNodeListCore)
				{
					currentIndex = -1;
					currentNodeCore = null;
					return;
				}
				DxHtmlNode owner = currentNodeListCore.Owner;
				currentNodeListCore = owner.ParentNode.ChildNodes;
				currentIndex = owner.saveIndexCore;
				currentNodeCore = owner;
				return;
			}
			if (currentIndex == -1)
			{
				currentIndex = currentNodeListCore.Length;
			}
			currentIndex--;
			currentNodeCore = currentNodeListCore[currentIndex];
			while (canVisitChildren(currentNodeCore) && CanVisitChildren(currentNodeCore))
			{
				currentNodeCore.saveIndexCore = currentIndex;
				currentNodeListCore = currentNodeCore.ChildNodes;
				currentIndex = currentNodeListCore.Length - 1;
				currentNodeCore = currentNodeListCore[currentIndex];
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			currentIndex = -1;
			currentNodeCore = null;
			if (sourceNodeListCore != null)
			{
				currentNodeListCore = sourceNodeListCore;
			}
			else
			{
				currentNodeListCore = null;
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			currentIndex = -1;
			currentNodeCore = null;
			currentNodeListCore = (sourceNodeListCore = null);
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			Clear();
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public virtual bool MoveNext()
		{
			CalcPreOrderIndex();
			if (currentNodeCore != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Reset();
			return false;
		}

		public virtual bool MoveInOrder()
		{
			CalcInOrderIndex();
			if (currentNodeCore != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Reset();
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlHandler
	{
		private int clickCountCore;

		private DxHtmlHitInfo hoveredHitInfoCore;

		private DxHtmlHitInfo capturedHitInfoCore;

		private IDxHtmlCallbackHandler callbackCore;

		private DxHtmlSelectionHandler selectionHandler;

		protected internal IDxHtmlCallbackHandler Callback => callbackCore;

		public DxHtmlElement HoveredElement => hoveredHitInfoCore?.Element;

		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public DxHtmlHitInfo HoveredHitInfo => hoveredHitInfoCore;

		internal DxHtmlSelectionHandler SelectionHandler => selectionHandler;

		internal bool IsContentSelection => SelectionHandler.InProcess;

		public DxHtmlHandler(IDxHtmlCallbackHandler callBack)
		{
			callbackCore = callBack;
			selectionHandler = new DxHtmlSelectionHandler(this);
		}

		public void OnResize(DxHtmlRootElement root)
		{
			root?.Invalidate(OnElementResize());
		}

		public void OnMouseMove(DxHtmlRootElement root, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (root == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DxHtmlHitInfo dxHtmlHitInfo = root.CalcHitInfo(e.Location);
			if (dxHtmlHitInfo.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (hoveredHitInfoCore != null)
				{
					OnMouseOut(root, null, e);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (hoveredHitInfoCore == null)
				{
					OnMouseOver(root, dxHtmlHitInfo, null, e);
				}
				else if (hoveredHitInfoCore.Element != dxHtmlHitInfo.Element)
				{
					DxHtmlElement targetParent = dxHtmlHitInfo.Element.FindParent((DxHtmlElement x) => (x.DynamicState & CssDynamicState.Hover) > CssDynamicState.Normal);
					OnMouseOut(root, targetParent, e);
					OnMouseOver(root, dxHtmlHitInfo, targetParent, e);
				}
				else if (dxHtmlHitInfo.Element is DxHtmlInputElement)
				{
					int repositoryId = ((DxHtmlInputElement)dxHtmlHitInfo.Element).RepositoryId;
					if (repositoryId != int.MinValue)
					{
						dxHtmlHitInfo.ElementInfo.RootElement.RepositoryHelper?.OnMouseMove(repositoryId, e.Location, e.Button, forceInvalidate: true);
					}
				}
				if (hoveredHitInfoCore != null)
				{
					hoveredHitInfoCore.ActualElement = dxHtmlHitInfo.ActualElement;
				}
			}
			selectionHandler.OnMouseMove(root, dxHtmlHitInfo, e);
			callbackCore.OnMouseMove(dxHtmlHitInfo, e);
		}

		public void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			System.Drawing.Point position = Cursor.Position;
			if (hoveredHitInfoCore != null)
			{
				OnMouseOut(hoveredHitInfoCore.Root, null, new MouseEventArgs(MouseButtons.None, 0, position.X, position.Y, 0));
			}
			selectionHandler.OnMouseLeave();
		}

		public void OnMouseDown(DxHtmlRootElement root, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (root != null)
			{
				DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo = root.CalcHitInfo(e.Location);
				selectionHandler.OnMouseDown(root, hitInfo, e);
				root.Invalidate(OnElementMouseDown(hitInfo, e));
			}
		}

		public void OnMouseUp(DxHtmlRootElement root, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (root != null)
			{
				DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo = root.CalcHitInfo(e.Location);
				selectionHandler.OnMouseUp(root, hitInfo, e);
				root.Invalidate(OnElementMouseUp(hitInfo, e));
			}
		}

		public void OnKeyDown(DxHtmlRootElement root, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (root != null)
			{
				if (root.ActiveElement != null)
				{
					OnElementKeyDown(root.ActiveElement, e);
				}
				if (e.KeyData == Keys.Tab || e.KeyData == (Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift))
				{
					root.Invalidate(FocusOnTab(root, (e.KeyData & Keys.Shift) != 0));
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnKeyUp(DxHtmlRootElement root, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (root.ActiveElement != null)
			{
				OnElementKeyUp(root.ActiveElement, e);
			}
		}

		public void OnKeyPress(DxHtmlRootElement root, KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			if (root.ActiveElement != null)
			{
				OnElementKeyPress(root.ActiveElement, e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnElementKeyDown(DxHtmlElement element, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			callbackCore.OnKeyDown(element, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnElementKeyUp(DxHtmlElement element, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			callbackCore.OnKeyUp(element, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnElementKeyPress(DxHtmlElement element, KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			callbackCore.OnKeyPress(element, e);
		}

		protected virtual DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions OnElementResize()
		{
			return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.Resize;
		}

		protected virtual void OnMouseOver(DxHtmlRootElement root, DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, DxHtmlElement targetParent, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			root.Invalidate(OnElementMouseOver(hitInfo, targetParent, e));
		}

		protected virtual DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions OnElementMouseOver(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, DxHtmlElement targetParent, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			bool hasStyle = false;
			hitInfo.Title = DxHtmlHitInfo.GetTitle(hitInfo.Element);
			if (!SetHoverState(hitInfo.Element, targetParent, value: true, ref hasStyle))
			{
				if (hitInfo.Element == targetParent)
				{
					hoveredHitInfoCore = hitInfo;
				}
				callbackCore.OnMouseOver(hitInfo, e);
				return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None;
			}
			hoveredHitInfoCore = hitInfo;
			int repositoryId = ((hitInfo.Element is DxHtmlInputElement) ? ((DxHtmlInputElement)hitInfo.Element).RepositoryId : int.MinValue);
			hitInfo.ElementInfo.RootElement.RepositoryHelper?.OnMouseMove(repositoryId, e.Location, e.Button, forceInvalidate: false);
			callbackCore.OnMouseOver(hitInfo, e);
			if (!hasStyle)
			{
				return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None;
			}
			return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.StyleChanged;
		}

		private void OnElementMouseOverCore(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!hitInfo.Disabled)
			{
				callbackCore.OnMouseOver(hitInfo, e);
			}
		}

		private bool SetHoverState(DxHtmlElement element, DxHtmlElement targetParent, bool value, ref bool hasStyle)
		{
			DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = element;
			bool result = false;
			while (dxHtmlElement != targetParent && dxHtmlElement != null && dxHtmlElement.SetHoverState(value, ref hasStyle))
			{
				dxHtmlElement = dxHtmlElement.ParentElement;
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual void OnMouseOut(DxHtmlRootElement root, DxHtmlElement targetParent, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			root.Invalidate(OnElementMouseOut(targetParent, e));
		}

		protected virtual DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions OnElementMouseOut(DxHtmlElement targetParent, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			bool hasStyle = false;
			SetHoverState(hoveredHitInfoCore.Element, targetParent, value: false, ref hasStyle);
			DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo = hoveredHitInfoCore;
			hoveredHitInfoCore = null;
			OnElementMouseOutCore(hitInfo, e);
			if (!hasStyle)
			{
				return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None;
			}
			return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.StyleChanged;
		}

		private void OnElementMouseOutCore(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!hitInfo.Disabled)
			{
				callbackCore.OnMouseOut(hitInfo, e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions OnElementMouseDown(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (hitInfo.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (!hitInfo.Root.FocusOnMouseDown(null))
				{
					return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None;
				}
				return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.StyleChanged;
			}
			bool flag = hitInfo.Element.SetActiveState(value: true);
			capturedHitInfoCore = hitInfo;
			clickCountCore = e.Clicks;
			if (!(flag | OnElementMouseDownCore(hitInfo, e)))
			{
				return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None;
			}
			return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.StyleChanged;
		}

		private bool OnElementMouseDownCore(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!capturedHitInfoCore.Disabled)
			{
				callbackCore.OnMouseDown(hitInfo, e);
				return hitInfo.Root.FocusOnMouseDown(hitInfo.Element);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions OnElementMouseUp(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (capturedHitInfoCore == null)
			{
				return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None;
			}
			DxHtmlHitInfo dxHtmlHitInfo = capturedHitInfoCore;
			if (!hitInfo.IsEmpty && hitInfo.Element == dxHtmlHitInfo.Element && !hitInfo.Disabled)
			{
				if (clickCountCore == 1)
				{
					OnElementMouseClickCore(dxHtmlHitInfo, e);
				}
				else if (clickCountCore == 2)
				{
					OnElementMouseDoubleClickCore(dxHtmlHitInfo, new MouseEventArgs(e.Button, clickCountCore, e.X, e.Y, e.Delta));
				}
			}
			clickCountCore = 0;
			bool flag = dxHtmlHitInfo.Element.SetActiveState(value: false);
			capturedHitInfoCore = null;
			OnElementMouseUpCore(dxHtmlHitInfo, e);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None;
			}
			return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.StyleChanged;
		}

		private void OnElementMouseDoubleClickCore(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!hitInfo.Disabled)
			{
				callbackCore.OnMouseDoubleClick(hitInfo, e);
			}
		}

		private void OnElementMouseClickCore(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!hitInfo.Disabled)
			{
				callbackCore.OnMouseClick(hitInfo, e);
			}
		}

		private void OnElementMouseUpCore(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!hitInfo.Disabled)
			{
				callbackCore.OnMouseUp(hitInfo, e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions FocusOnTab(DxHtmlRootElement root, bool shift)
		{
			if (!root.FocusOnTab(shift))
			{
				return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.None;
			}
			return DxHtmlLayoutChangeActions.StyleChanged;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DxHtmlContextBase : IDxHtmlCallbackHandler, IDxHtmlContext
	{
		private Dictionary<string, DxHtmlMeasuredStringCache> measuredStrings = new Dictionary<string, DxHtmlMeasuredStringCache>();

		private DxHtmlHandler handlerCore;

		private static Func<DxHtmlElement, DxHtmlActionExpression> GetMouseUp = (DxHtmlElement element) => element.Tag.OnMouseUp;

		private static Func<DxHtmlElement, DxHtmlActionExpression> GetMouseMove = (DxHtmlElement element) => element.Tag.OnMouseMove;

		private static Func<DxHtmlElement, DxHtmlActionExpression> GetMouseOver = (DxHtmlElement element) => element.Tag.OnMouseOver;

		private static Func<DxHtmlElement, DxHtmlActionExpression> GetMouseDown = (DxHtmlElement element) => element.Tag.OnMouseDown;

		private static Func<DxHtmlElement, DxHtmlActionExpression> GetMouseClick = (DxHtmlElement element) => element.Tag.OnClick;

		private static Func<DxHtmlElement, DxHtmlActionExpression> GetMouseDoubleClick = (DxHtmlElement element) => element.Tag.OnDbClick;

		private static Func<DxHtmlElement, DxHtmlActionExpression> GetMouseOut = (DxHtmlElement element) => element.Tag.OnMouseOut;

		private static Func<DxHtmlElement, DxHtmlActionExpression> GetKeyDown = (DxHtmlElement element) => element.Tag.OnKeyDown;

		private static Func<DxHtmlElement, DxHtmlActionExpression> GetKeyUp = (DxHtmlElement element) => element.Tag.OnKeyUp;

		private static Func<DxHtmlElement, DxHtmlActionExpression> GetKeyPress = (DxHtmlElement element) => element.Tag.OnKeyPress;

		private bool cursorCaptured;

		private DxHtmlEventBinder binderCore;

		protected DxHtmlHandler Handler => handlerCore;

		protected virtual bool AllowStringCache => true;

		public bool IsContentSelection => handlerCore.IsContentSelection;

		protected abstract object SenderCore { get; }

		public DxHtmlContextBase()
		{
			handlerCore = new DxHtmlHandler(this);
		}

		void IDxHtmlContext.ResetCache()
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, DxHtmlMeasuredStringCache> measuredString in measuredStrings)
			{
				measuredString.Value.ResetCache();
			}
		}

		private bool TryGetMeasuredStringCache(string key, out DxHtmlMeasuredStringCache stringCache)
		{
			return measuredStrings.TryGetValue(key, out stringCache);
		}

		bool IDxHtmlContext.TryGetMeasuredString<T>(string key, Font font, int dpi, out DxHtmlMeasuredString measuredString, out T textMetadata)
		{
			if (TryGetMeasuredStringCache(key, out var stringCache))
			{
				stringCache.TryGetValue(DxHtmlElementInfoBase.GetFontKey(font, dpi), out measuredString);
				textMetadata = (T)stringCache.TextMetadata;
				return true;
			}
			measuredString = null;
			textMetadata = default(T);
			return false;
		}

		bool IDxHtmlContext.TryGetTextMetadata<T>(string key, Font font, out T textMetadata)
		{
			if (TryGetMeasuredStringCache(key, out var stringCache))
			{
				textMetadata = (T)stringCache.TextMetadata;
				return true;
			}
			textMetadata = default(T);
			return false;
		}

		bool IDxHtmlContext.TryGetMeasuredString(string key, Font font, int dpi, out DxHtmlMeasuredString measuredString)
		{
			if (TryGetMeasuredStringCache(key, out var stringCache) && stringCache.TryGetValue(DxHtmlElementInfoBase.GetFontKey(font, dpi), out measuredString))
			{
				return true;
			}
			measuredString = null;
			return false;
		}

		DxHtmlMeasuredString IDxHtmlContext.MeasureString(string key, string text, Font font, IDxHtmlGraphicsCache graphics, bool isRtl)
		{
			if (AllowStringCache)
			{
				if (!TryGetMeasuredStringCache(key, out var stringCache))
				{
					stringCache = new DxHtmlMeasuredStringCache(text);
					measuredStrings.Add(key, stringCache);
				}
				DxHtmlMeasuredString dxHtmlMeasuredString = graphics.MeasureString(text, font, isRtl);
				if (!dxHtmlMeasuredString.IsEmpty)
				{
					stringCache.SaveValue(DxHtmlElementInfoBase.GetFontKey(font, ((IGraphicsCache)graphics).DeviceDpi), dxHtmlMeasuredString);
				}
				return dxHtmlMeasuredString;
			}
			return graphics.MeasureString(text, font, isRtl);
		}

		DxHtmlMeasuredString IDxHtmlContext.MeasureString<T>(string key, string text, Font font, IDxHtmlGraphicsCache graphics, out T textMetadata, bool isRtl)
		{
			if (AllowStringCache)
			{
				if (!TryGetMeasuredStringCache(key, out var stringCache))
				{
					stringCache = new DxHtmlMeasuredStringCache(text);
					measuredStrings.Add(key, stringCache);
				}
				DxHtmlMeasuredString dxHtmlMeasuredString;
				if (stringCache.TextMetadata != null)
				{
					textMetadata = (T)stringCache.TextMetadata;
					dxHtmlMeasuredString = graphics.MeasureString(text, font, isRtl);
				}
				else
				{
					dxHtmlMeasuredString = graphics.MeasureString<T>(text, font, isRtl, out textMetadata);
					stringCache.TextMetadata = textMetadata;
				}
				if (!dxHtmlMeasuredString.IsEmpty)
				{
					stringCache.SaveValue(DxHtmlElementInfoBase.GetFontKey(font, ((IGraphicsCache)graphics).DeviceDpi), dxHtmlMeasuredString);
				}
				return dxHtmlMeasuredString;
			}
			return graphics.MeasureString<T>(text, font, isRtl, out textMetadata);
		}

		DxHtmlMeasuredString IDxHtmlContext.MeasureString<T>(string text, Font font, IDxHtmlGraphicsCache graphics, out T textMetadata, bool isRtl)
		{
			return graphics.MeasureString<T>(text, font, isRtl, out textMetadata);
		}

		DxHtmlMeasuredString IDxHtmlContext.MeasureString(string text, Font font, IDxHtmlGraphicsCache graphics, bool isRtl)
		{
			return graphics.MeasureString(text, font, isRtl);
		}

		public virtual DxHtmlRootElement Get(DxHtmlDocumentRootNode rootNode, IDxHtmlClient client)
		{
			DxHtmlRootElement dxHtmlRootElement = new DxHtmlRootElement(rootNode, client);
			dxHtmlRootElement.Callback = this;
			dxHtmlRootElement.Context = this;
			return dxHtmlRootElement;
		}

		public DxHtmlRootElement Get(string text, CssStyleSheet styleSheet, IDxHtmlClient client)
		{
			DxHtmlDocumentRootNode dxHtmlDocumentRootNode = DxHtmlParser.Default.Parse(text, styleSheet);
			if (dxHtmlDocumentRootNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DxHtmlRootElement dxHtmlRootElement = new DxHtmlRootElement(dxHtmlDocumentRootNode, client);
			dxHtmlRootElement.Callback = this;
			dxHtmlRootElement.Context = this;
			return dxHtmlRootElement;
		}

		protected internal DxHtmlSelectionRange GetSelection(DxHtmlRootElement root)
		{
			IDxHtmlSelection selection = root.Selection;
			return selection.Current;
		}

		protected internal void RestoreSelection(DxHtmlRootElement root, DxHtmlSelectionRange range)
		{
			if (!range.IsEmpty)
			{
				IDxHtmlSelection selection = root.Selection;
				selection.Current = range;
				Handler.SelectionHandler.RestoreStateFrom(root);
			}
		}

		public void StartSelection(DxHtmlRootElement root, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (root != null)
			{
				DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo = root.CalcHitInfo(e.Location);
				Handler.SelectionHandler.OnMouseDown(root, hitInfo, e);
			}
		}

		public void SyncFocusedElement(DxHtmlRootElement srcRoot, DxHtmlRootElement destRoot)
		{
			DxHtmlElement srcFocused = srcRoot?.ActiveElement;
			if (srcFocused == null || destRoot == srcRoot || destRoot == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DxHtmlDocumentRootNode dxHtmlDocumentRootNode = destRoot.DocumentNode as DxHtmlDocumentRootNode;
			DxHtmlDocumentRootNode dxHtmlDocumentRootNode2 = srcRoot.DocumentNode as DxHtmlDocumentRootNode;
			if (dxHtmlDocumentRootNode.TemplateHash == dxHtmlDocumentRootNode2.TemplateHash)
			{
				destRoot.FindElement((DxHtmlElement x) => x.PlainIndex == srcFocused.PlainIndex)?.Focus(value: true);
			}
		}

		public void OnResize(DxHtmlRootElement root)
		{
			handlerCore.OnResize(root);
		}

		public void OnGotFocus(DxHtmlRootElement root)
		{
		}

		public void OnLostFocus(DxHtmlRootElement root)
		{
		}

		public void OnMouseMove(DxHtmlRootElement root, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			handlerCore.OnMouseMove(root, e);
		}

		public void OnMouseUp(DxHtmlRootElement root, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			handlerCore.OnMouseUp(root, e);
		}

		public void OnMouseDown(DxHtmlRootElement root, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			handlerCore.OnMouseDown(root, e);
		}

		public void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			handlerCore.OnMouseLeave();
		}

		public void OnKeyPress(DxHtmlRootElement root, KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			handlerCore.OnKeyPress(root, e);
		}

		public void OnKeyUp(DxHtmlRootElement root, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			handlerCore.OnKeyUp(root, e);
		}

		public void OnKeyDown(DxHtmlRootElement root, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			handlerCore.OnKeyDown(root, e);
		}

		public void CheckShowEditor(DxHtmlRootElement root, bool shouldSendMouseEvent)
		{
			root?.CheckShowEditor(shouldSendMouseEvent);
		}

		protected abstract object GetContainerCore();

		protected virtual Cursor GetCursor(DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				return element.GetCursor();

			return Cursors.Default;
		}

		protected abstract void SetCursor(DxHtmlElementBase element);

		void IDxHtmlCallbackHandler.SetCursorCapture(bool capture)
		{
			cursorCaptured = capture;
		}

		private void UpdateCursor(DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			if (!cursorCaptured)
			{
				SetCursor(element);
			}
		}

		void IDxHtmlCallbackHandler.OnMouseOut(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCursor(null);
			OnMouseOutCallback(hitInfo, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMouseOutCallback(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseMouseOut(CreateMouseEventArgs(hitInfo, e));
		}

		protected void RaiseMouseOut(DxHtmlElementMouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!FireBubbleAction(e, GetMouseOut, "mouseout"))
			{
				RaiseMouseOutCore(e);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void RaiseMouseOutCore(DxHtmlElementMouseEventArgs e);

		void IDxHtmlCallbackHandler.OnMouseDown(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseDownCallback(hitInfo, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMouseDownCallback(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)

		void IDxHtmlCallbackHandler.OnMouseOver(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)

			UpdateCursor(hitInfo.Element);

				RaiseMouseUpCore(e);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void RaiseMouseUpCore(DxHtmlElementMouseEventArgs e);

		void IDxHtmlCallbackHandler.OnMouseClick(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (hitInfo.InLink)
			{
				RaiseOpenLink(hitInfo, e);
			}
			OnMouseClickCallback(hitInfo, e);
		}

		protected void RaiseOpenLink(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(hitInfo.Href))
			{
				return;
			}
			DxHtmlOpenLinkEventArgs e2 = CreateOpenLinkArgs(hitInfo, e);
			RaiseOpenLinkCore(e2);
			if (!e2.Handled && Uri.IsWellFormedUriString(hitInfo.Href, UriKind.Absolute))
			{
				SafeProcess.Start(hitInfo.Href, null, delegate(ProcessStartInfo x)
				{
					x.WindowStyle = ProcessWindowStyle.Normal;
				});
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseOpenLinkCore(DxHtmlOpenLinkEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnMouseClickCallback(DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseMouseClick(CreateMouseEventArgs(hitInfo, e));
		}

		protected void RaiseMouseClick(DxHtmlElementMouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!FireBubbleAction(e, GetMouseClick, "click"))
			{
				RaiseMouseClickCore(e);
			}
		}

		private bool FireBubbleAction(DxHtmlElementEventArgs e, Func<DxHtmlElement, DxHtmlActionExpression> action, string type)
		{
			DxHtmlElement element = e.Element;
			for (DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = element; dxHtmlElement != null; dxHtmlElement = (DxHtmlElement)(e.CurrentTarget = dxHtmlElement.ParentElement))
			{
				FireAction(e, action(dxHtmlElement));
				dxHtmlElement.DispatchEvent(type, e);
				if (e.CancelBubble || e.SuppressOwnerEvent)
				{
					return e.SuppressOwnerEvent;
				}
			}
			e.CurrentTarget = element;
			e.Bubbles = false;
			return false;
		}

		private void FireAction(DxHtmlElementEventArgs e, DxHtmlActionExpression @delegate)
		{
			if (@delegate != null)
			{
				if (binderCore == null)
				{
					binderCore = new DxHtmlEventBinder(GetContainerCore());
				}
				binderCore.DoDelegate(SenderCore, e, @delegate);
			}
		}

	[DXBrowsable(false)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class DxHtmlMeasuredString
	{
		public readonly int Length;

		public readonly string Text;

		private DxHtmlStringInfo stringInfoCore;

		public readonly DxHtmlStringInfo[] StringInfos;

		public readonly System.Drawing.Size Size;

		public bool IsEmpty => stringInfoCore == null;

		public int TabStopWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsEmpty)
				{
					return stringInfoCore.TabStopWidth;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		public bool HasDynamicTabWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsEmpty)
				{
					return stringInfoCore.HasDynamicTabWidth;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlMeasuredString()
		{
		}

		public DxHtmlMeasuredString(string text, System.Drawing.Size size, DxHtmlStringInfo[] stringInfos)
		{
			StringInfos = stringInfos;
			Size = size;
			Length = text.Length;
			stringInfoCore = stringInfos[0];
			Text = text;
		}

		public int GetCharacterWidth(int index)
		{
			DxHtmlCharInfo charInfo = GetCharInfo(index);
			return charInfo.Width;
		}

		public int CharPositionToX(int index, bool trailingEdge)
		{
			DxHtmlCharInfo charInfo = GetCharInfo(index);
			if (charInfo.IsInSequence)
			{
				int index2 = index - charInfo.IndexInSequence;
				charInfo = GetCharInfo(index2);
			}
			if (!trailingEdge)
			{
				return charInfo.X;
			}
			return charInfo.X1;
		}

		public int GetCaretPositionByX(int x, int start, int length, out bool trailingEdge)
		{
			trailingEdge = false;
			if (x < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = start; i < start + length; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlCharInfo charInfo = GetCharInfo(i);
				if (i == start)
				{
					num = charInfo.X;
				}
				int num2 = charInfo.X - num;
				int num3 = charInfo.X1 - num;
				if (x < num2 || x > num3)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (num3 - x < x - num2)
				{
					trailingEdge = true;
				}
				if (charInfo.IsInSequence)
				{
					int num4 = i - charInfo.IndexInSequence;
					if (trailingEdge)
					{
						return num4 + charInfo.SequenceLength - 1;
					}
					return num4;
				}
				return i;
			}
			trailingEdge = true;
			return start + length - 1;
		}

		public bool RangeInSameSequence(int start, int end)
		{
			DxHtmlCharInfo charInfo = GetCharInfo(start);
			DxHtmlCharInfo charInfo2 = GetCharInfo(end);
			if (charInfo.IsInSequence && charInfo2.IsInSequence)
			{
				int num = start - charInfo.IndexInSequence;
				int num2 = end - charInfo2.IndexInSequence;
				return num == num2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private DxHtmlCharInfo GetCharInfo(int index)
		{
			if (stringInfoCore.Length > index)
			{
				return stringInfoCore[index];
			}
			int num = index / stringInfoCore.Length;
			int index2 = index % stringInfoCore.Length;
			return StringInfos[num][index2];
		}
	}

	public interface IDxHtmlTextAnalyzer : IDisposable
	{
		void Analyze(char ch, int index, bool forceWordStart = false, bool forceWordEnd = false);
	}
	internal class DxHtmlTextMetadata : IDxHtmlTextMetadata
	{
		private class DxHtmlTextAnalyzer : IDxHtmlTextAnalyzer, IDisposable
		{
			private static char[] newLineChars;

			protected char SoftHyphen = '\u00ad';

			protected char Hyphen = '-';

			private int textLength;

			private int wordStartIndex = -1;

			private DxHtmlTextMetadata textMetadata;

			private List<DxHtmlTextLine> lines;

			private List<CharacterRange> wordsRanges;

			private int newLineProcessIndex;

			private int lineStartIndex;

			private static char[] NewLineChars => newLineChars ?? (newLineChars = Environment.NewLine.ToCharArray());

			public DxHtmlTextAnalyzer(string text, DxHtmlTextMetadata textMetadata)
			{
				textLength = text.Length;
				lines = new List<DxHtmlTextLine>();
				wordsRanges = new List<CharacterRange>();
				this.textMetadata = textMetadata;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				textMetadata.linesCore = lines.ToArray();
				textMetadata = null;
			}

			void IDxHtmlTextAnalyzer.Analyze(char ch, int index, bool forceWordStart, bool forceWordEnd)
			{
				bool flag = CheckIsWordChar(ch);
				bool flag2 = ch == Hyphen || ch == SoftHyphen;
				bool flag3 = flag && (index == textLength - 1 || flag2);
				if (forceWordStart || forceWordEnd)
				{
					if (wordStartIndex > -1)
					{
						int num = index - wordStartIndex;
						if (forceWordEnd)
						{
							num++;
						}
						CharacterRange item = new CharacterRange(wordStartIndex, num);
						wordsRanges.Add(item);
					}
					wordStartIndex = -1;
				}
				if ((flag || forceWordStart) && wordStartIndex == -1 && !forceWordEnd)
				{
					wordStartIndex = index;
				}
				if (!flag || flag3)
				{
					if (wordStartIndex > -1)
					{
						int num2 = (flag3 ? index : (index - 1));
						CharacterRange item2 = new CharacterRange(wordStartIndex, num2 - wordStartIndex + 1);
						wordsRanges.Add(item2);
					}
					wordStartIndex = -1;
				}
				bool flag4 = NewLineChars[newLineProcessIndex] == ch;
				bool flag5 = newLineProcessIndex == NewLineChars.Length - 1;
				bool flag6 = ch == '\n';
				if ((flag4 && flag5) || flag6)
				{
					int num3 = index - lineStartIndex + 1;
					CharacterRange range = new CharacterRange(Length: (!(flag4 && flag5)) ? (num3 - 1) : (num3 - NewLineChars.Length), First: lineStartIndex);
					lines.Add(new DxHtmlTextLine(range, wordsRanges.ToArray(), ended: true));
					wordsRanges.Clear();
					lineStartIndex = index + 1;
					newLineProcessIndex = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					newLineProcessIndex = (flag4 ? (newLineProcessIndex + 1) : 0);
					if (index == textLength - 1)
					{
						CharacterRange range2 = new CharacterRange(lineStartIndex, index - lineStartIndex + 1);
						DxHtmlTextLine item3 = new DxHtmlTextLine(range2, wordsRanges.ToArray(), ended: false);
						lines.Add(item3);
					}
				}
			}

			private bool CheckIsWordChar(char ch)
			{
				return DxHtmlWordValidationHelper.CheckIsWordChar(ch);
			}
		}

		private DxHtmlTextLine[] linesCore;

		public DxHtmlTextLine[] Lines => linesCore;

		public DxHtmlTextMetadata()
		{
			linesCore = new DxHtmlTextLine[0];
		}

		IDxHtmlTextAnalyzer IDxHtmlTextMetadata.BeginAnalyze(string text)
		{
			return new DxHtmlTextAnalyzer(text, this);
		}
	}

	[DXBrowsable(false)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public sealed class DxHtmlBooleanAttribute : DxHtmlAttribute<bool>
	{
		internal static Func<bool, string, DxHtmlBooleanAttribute> Factory = (bool value, string name) => new DxHtmlBooleanAttribute(value, string.Empty, name);

		internal static bool TryConvertValue(object value, ref bool result)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				result = false;
				return true;
			}
			if (value is bool)
			{
				result = (bool)value;
				return true;
			}
			if (DxHtmlAttribute<bool>.IsNumeric(value.GetType()))
			{
				result = (decimal)value > 0m;
				return true;
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				return bool.TryParse((string)value, out result);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DxHtmlBooleanAttribute(bool @default, string fieldName, string name)
			: base(@default, fieldName, name)
		{
		}

		internal DxHtmlBooleanAttribute(bool @default, string name)
			: base(@default, name)
		{
		}

		public DxHtmlBooleanAttribute(DxHtmlBooleanAttribute source)
			: base((DxHtmlAttribute<bool>)source)
		{
		}

		protected override bool TryConvertValueCore(object value, ref bool result)
		{
			return TryConvertValue(value, ref result);
		}

		protected override bool Equals(bool oldValue, bool newValue)
		{
			return oldValue == newValue;
		}

		protected override DxHtmlAttribute<bool> CloneCore()
		{
			return new DxHtmlBooleanAttribute(this);
		}
	}
	[DXBrowsable(false)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public sealed class DxHtmlIntegerAttribute : DxHtmlAttribute<int>
	{
		internal static Func<int, string, DxHtmlIntegerAttribute> Factory = (int value, string name) => new DxHtmlIntegerAttribute(value, string.Empty, name);

		internal static bool TryConvertValue(object value, ref int result)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				result = 0;
				return true;
			}
			if (value is int)
			{
				result = (int)value;
				return true;
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				return int.TryParse((string)value, out result);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DxHtmlIntegerAttribute(int @default, string fieldName, string name)
			: base(@default, fieldName, name)
		{
		}

		internal DxHtmlIntegerAttribute(int @default, string name)
			: base(@default, name)
		{
		}

		public DxHtmlIntegerAttribute(DxHtmlIntegerAttribute source)
			: base((DxHtmlAttribute<int>)source)
		{
		}

		protected override bool TryConvertValueCore(object value, ref int result)
		{
			return TryConvertValue(value, ref result);
		}

		protected override bool Equals(int oldValue, int newValue)
		{
			return oldValue == newValue;
		}

		protected override DxHtmlAttribute<int> CloneCore()
		{
			return new DxHtmlIntegerAttribute(this);
		}
	}

			return oldValue == newValue;

	[DXBrowsable(false)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public sealed class DxHtmlEnumAttribute<T> : DxHtmlAttribute<T> where T : struct
	{
		internal static Func<T, string, DxHtmlEnumAttribute<T>> Factory = (T value, string name) => new DxHtmlEnumAttribute<T>(value, string.Empty, name);

		internal static bool TryConvertValue<U>(object value, ref U result) where U : struct
		{
			if (!typeof(U).IsEnum)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				result = default(U);
				return true;
			}
			if (value is U)
			{
				result = (U)value;
				return true;
			}
			if (value is string)
			{
				return Enum.TryParse<U>((string)value, out result);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DxHtmlEnumAttribute(T @default, string fieldName, string name)
			: base(@default, fieldName, name)
		{
		}

		internal DxHtmlEnumAttribute(T @default, string name)
			: base(@default, name)
		{
		}

		public DxHtmlEnumAttribute(DxHtmlEnumAttribute<T> source)
			: base((DxHtmlAttribute<T>)source)
		{
		}

		protected override bool TryConvertValueCore(object value, ref T result)
		{
			return TryConvertValue(value, ref result);
		}

		protected override bool Equals(T oldValue, T newValue)
		{
			return EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected override DxHtmlAttribute<T> CloneCore()
		{
			return new DxHtmlEnumAttribute<T>(this);
		}
	}
	[DXBrowsable(false)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public abstract class DxHtmlAttribute<T> : IDxHtmlAttribute
	{
		private static class AttributeFlags
		{
			public const int Bindable = 1;

			public const int Default = 251658240;
		}

		private T valueCore;

		private int flags;

		private readonly string fieldNameCore = string.Empty;

		private readonly string nameCore = string.Empty;

		private object fieldValueCore;

		internal int Bindable => flags & 1;

		public bool IsDefault => (flags & 0xF000000) != 0;

		public bool IsBindable => (flags & 1) != 0;

		public string FieldName => fieldNameCore;

		public string Name => nameCore;

		public T Value => valueCore;

		internal DxHtmlAttribute(T @default, string name)
		{
			flags = 251658240;
			valueCore = @default;
			nameCore = name;
		}

		public DxHtmlAttribute(DxHtmlAttribute<T> source)
		{
			fieldValueCore = source.fieldValueCore;
			fieldNameCore = source.fieldNameCore;
			flags = source.flags;
			valueCore = source.valueCore;
			nameCore = source.nameCore;
		}

		public DxHtmlAttribute(T @default, string fieldName, string name)
		{
			valueCore = @default;
			fieldNameCore = fieldName;
			nameCore = name;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
			{
				flags = 1;
			}
		}

		public T GetValue(DxHtmlRootElement root, DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			if (root == null || !IsBindable)
			{
				return valueCore;
			}
			object value = root.ActualClient.GetValue(fieldNameCore, element);
			if (value == fieldValueCore)
			{
				return valueCore;
			}
			fieldValueCore = value;
			TryConvertValueCore(value, ref valueCore);
			return valueCore;
		}

		internal void ForceValue(DxHtmlRootElement root, DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			GetValue(root, element);
		}

		object IDxHtmlAttribute.GetValue(DxHtmlRootElement root, DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			return GetValue(root, element);
		}

		IDxHtmlAttribute IDxHtmlAttribute.Clone()
		{
			return CloneCore();
		}

		protected abstract DxHtmlAttribute<T> CloneCore();

		protected abstract bool TryConvertValueCore(object value, ref T result);

		public bool Equals(T newValue)
		{
			return Equals(valueCore, newValue);
		}

		protected abstract bool Equals(T oldValue, T newValue);

		protected static bool IsNumeric(Type type)
		{
			Type defaultType;
			return IsNumeric(type, out defaultType);
		}

		protected static bool IsNumeric(Type type, out NumberStyles? styles)
		{
			styles = null;
			if (IsFloatingPoint(type))
			{
				styles = NumberStyles.Float;
			}
			if (IsInteger(type))
			{
				styles = NumberStyles.Integer;
			}
			if (IsDecimal(type))
			{
				styles = NumberStyles.Number;
			}
			return styles.HasValue;
		}

		protected static bool IsNumeric(Type type, out Type defaultType)
		{
			defaultType = null;
			if (IsFloatingPoint(type))
			{
				defaultType = typeof(float);
			}
			if (IsInteger(type))
			{
				defaultType = typeof(int);
			}
			if (IsDecimal(type))
			{
				defaultType = typeof(decimal);
			}
			return defaultType != null;
		}

		protected static bool IsFloatingPoint(Type type)
		{
			if (!(type == typeof(float)) && !(type == typeof(float?)) && !(type == typeof(double)))
			{
				return type == typeof(double?);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected static bool IsInteger(Type type)
		{
			if (!(type == typeof(byte)) && !(type == typeof(byte?)) && !(type == typeof(ushort)) && !(type == typeof(ushort?)) && !(type == typeof(uint)) && !(type == typeof(uint?)) && !(type == typeof(ulong)) && !(type == typeof(ulong?)) && !(type == typeof(sbyte)) && !(type == typeof(sbyte?)) && !(type == typeof(short)) && !(type == typeof(short?)) && !(type == typeof(int)) && !(type == typeof(int?)) && !(type == typeof(long)))
			{
				return type == typeof(long?);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected static bool IsDecimal(Type type)
		{
			if (!(type == typeof(decimal)))
			{
				return type == typeof(decimal?);
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal interface IDxHtmlAttribute
	{
		bool IsBindable { get; }

		bool IsDefault { get; }

		object GetValue(DxHtmlRootElement root, DxHtmlElementBase element);

		IDxHtmlAttribute Clone();
	}

	internal static class DxHtmlWordValidationHelper
	{
		public static bool CheckInitial(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 6 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'n') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'i') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 't') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'i') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'a'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 6], 'l');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckInherit(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 6 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'n') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'h') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'e') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'r') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'i'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 6], 't');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckRoot(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 3 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'o') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'o'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 't');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckNoScaling(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 8 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'o') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 's') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'c') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'a') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'l') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 6], 'i') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 7], 'n'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 8], 'g');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckVisible(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 6 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'i') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 's') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'i') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'b') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'l'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 6], 'e');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckHidden(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 5 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'i') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'd') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'd') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'e'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'n');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckNormal(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 5 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'o') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'r') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'm') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'a'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'l');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckData(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 3 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'a') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 't'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'a');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckDxClass(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 7 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'x') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], '-') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'c') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'l') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'a') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 6], 's'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 7], 's');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckBreakWord(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 9 && CheckBreak(template, currentIndex, remainder) && template[currentIndex + 5] == '-' && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 6], 'w'))
			{
				return CheckWord(template, currentIndex + 6, remainder);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckBreak(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 4 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'r') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'e') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'a'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'k');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckCenter(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 5 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'e') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'n') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 't') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'e'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'r');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckBold(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 3 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'o') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'l'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'd');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckBolder(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 5 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'o') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'l') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'd') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'e'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'r');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckLighter(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 6 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'i') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'g') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'h') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 't') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'e'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 6], 'r');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckMedium(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 5 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'e') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'd') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'i') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'u'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'm');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckSmallCaps(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 9 && CheckSmall(template, currentIndex, remainder) && template[currentIndex + 5] == '-' && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 6], 'c'))
			{
				return CheckCaps(template, currentIndex + 6, remainder);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckCaps(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 3 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'a') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'p'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 's');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckSmall(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 4 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'm') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'a') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'l'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'l');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckSmaller(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 6 && CheckSmall(template, currentIndex, remainder) && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'e'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 6], 'r');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckXsmall(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 6 && template[currentIndex + 1] == '-' && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 's'))
			{
				return CheckSmall(template, currentIndex + 2, remainder);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckXXsmall(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 7 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'x'))
			{
				return CheckXsmall(template, currentIndex + 1, remainder);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckLarge(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 4 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'a') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'r') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'g'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'e');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckLarger(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 5 && CheckLarge(template, currentIndex, remainder))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'r');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckXlarge(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 6 && template[currentIndex + 1] == '-' && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'l'))
			{
				return CheckLarge(template, currentIndex + 2, remainder);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckXXlarge(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 7 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'x'))
			{
				return CheckXlarge(template, currentIndex + 1, remainder);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckItalic(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 5 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 't') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'a') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'l') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'i'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'c');
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool CheckOblique(string template, int currentIndex, int remainder)
		{
			if (remainder > 6 && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 1], 'b') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 2], 'l') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 3], 'i') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 4], 'q') && EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 5], 'u'))
			{
				return EqualChars(template[currentIndex + 6], 'e');
			}

		public static bool TextIndexOf(string text, char symbol, ref int currentIndex)
		{
			int num = text.IndexOf(symbol, currentIndex);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				currentIndex = text.Length;
				return false;
			}
			currentIndex = num;
			return true;
		}

		public static bool EqualString(string varString, string constStr)
		{
			if (varString.Length != constStr.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < constStr.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!EqualChars(varString[i], constStr[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool EqualChars(char varChar, char constChar)
		{
			return char.ToLowerInvariant(varChar) == constChar;
		}

		public static bool IsSymbol(char ch)
		{
			if (!IsLower(ch))
			{
				return IsUpper(ch);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsUpper(char ch)
		{
			if (ch >= 'A')
			{
				return ch <= 'Z';
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsLower(char ch)
		{
			if (ch >= 'a')
			{
				return ch <= 'z';
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsNumber(char ch)
		{
			if (ch >= '0')
			{
				return ch <= '9';
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsLatin(char ch)
		{
			return ch <= 'ÿ';
		}

		public static bool CheckIsWordChar(char ch)
		{
			if (IsLatin(ch))
			{
				if (ch <= ' ' || ch > '~')
				{
					return ch >= '\u00a0';
				}
				return true;
			}
			UnicodeCategory unicodeCategory = char.GetUnicodeCategory(ch);
			if ((uint)(unicodeCategory - 11) <= 3u)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static char SkipNewLine(string template, ref int startIndex, int length)
		{
			int num = startIndex;
			char c = template[num];
			while (c == '\n')
			{
				if (num > 0 && template[num - 1] == '\r')
				{
					num++;
				}
				else if (num < length - 1 && template[length + 1] == '\r')
				{
					num += 2;
				}
				else
				{
					c = '\r';
				}
			}
			startIndex = num;
			return c;
		}

		public static char SkipWhiteSpace(string template, char ch, ref int startIndex, int length)
		{
			int num = startIndex;
			while (char.IsWhiteSpace(ch) && ++num < length)
			{
				ch = template[num];
			}
			startIndex = num;
			return ch;
		}

		public static CssParsingResult CheckFieldName(string template, int templateLength, char? endSymbol, ref string fildName, ref int currentIndex, ref HtmlExceptionType exceptionType)
		{
			if (templateLength == currentIndex)
			{
				exceptionType = HtmlExceptionType.InvalidValue;
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			if (template[currentIndex] != '$')
			{
				return CssParsingResult.Continue;
			}
			if (templateLength == ++currentIndex)
			{
				exceptionType = HtmlExceptionType.MissingQuotes;
				return CssParsingResult.Exception;
			}
			if (template[currentIndex] != '{')
			{
				return CssParsingResult.Continue;
			}
			int num = ++currentIndex;
			if (TextIndexOf(template, '}', ref currentIndex))
			{
				int length = currentIndex - num;
				if (endSymbol.HasValue)
				{
					if (templateLength == ++currentIndex)
					{
						exceptionType = HtmlExceptionType.MissingQuotes;
						return CssParsingResult.Exception;
					}
					if (SkipWhiteSpace(template, template[currentIndex], ref currentIndex, templateLength) == endSymbol)
					{
						currentIndex++;
						if (!Substring(template, num, length, ref fildName))
						{
							return CssParsingResult.Exception;
						}
						return CssParsingResult.Closed;
					}
					exceptionType = HtmlExceptionType.InvalidValue;
					return CssParsingResult.Exception;
				}
				if (!Substring(template, num, length, ref fildName))
				{
					return CssParsingResult.Exception;
				}
				return CssParsingResult.Closed;
			}
			currentIndex = num;
			return CssParsingResult.Continue;
		}

		public static bool Substring(string template, int startIndex, int length, ref string @string)
		{
			if (length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			@string = template.Substring(startIndex, length);
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal static class DxHtmlValueParser
	{
		public static bool TryParseToColor(string value, ref System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			try
			{
				color = ColorTranslator.FromHtml(value);
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryParseToColor(int a, int r, int g, int b, ref System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			try
			{
				color = System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(a, r, g, b);
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool TryParseFloat(string template, char ch, int templateLength, ref int currentIndex, ref float value, bool allowDecimalPart)
		{
			short sign;
			return TryParseFloat(template, ch, templateLength, ref currentIndex, ref value, out sign, allowDecimalPart);
		}

		public static bool TryParseFloat(string template, char ch, int templateLength, ref int currentIndex, ref float value)
		{
			short sign;
			return TryParseFloat(template, ch, templateLength, ref currentIndex, ref value, out sign);
		}

		public static bool TryParseFloat(string template, char ch, int templateLength, ref int currentIndex, ref float value, out short sign, bool allowDecimalPart = true)
		{
			float value2 = 0f;
			float value3 = 0f;
			sign = 1;
			bool flag = false;
			int currentIndex2 = currentIndex;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (ch == '-')
			{
				sign = -1;
				currentIndex2++;
				if (currentIndex2 == templateLength)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ch = template[currentIndex2];
			}
			if (ch == '.')
			{
				currentIndex2++;
				flag = TryParseFloatCore(template, templateLength, isFloat: true, ref currentIndex2, ref value3);
				flag2 = true;
			}
			else
			{
				flag = TryParseFloatCore(template, templateLength, isFloat: false, ref currentIndex2, ref value2);
				if (currentIndex2 < templateLength && template[currentIndex2] == '.')
				{
					currentIndex2++;
					flag |= TryParseFloatCore(template, templateLength, isFloat: true, ref currentIndex2, ref value3);
					flag2 = true;
				}
			}
			if (!allowDecimalPart && flag2)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				value = (float)sign * (value2 + value3);
				currentIndex = currentIndex2;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool TryParseFloatCore(string template, int templateLength, bool isFloat, ref int currentIndex, ref float value)
		{
			int i = currentIndex;
			int num = 1;
			bool flag = false;
			float num2 = 0f;
			for (; i < templateLength; i++)
			{
				char c = template[i];
				if (!char.IsNumber(c))
				{
					break;
				}
				num2 = num2 * 10f + (float)(c - 48);
				num *= 10;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			currentIndex = i;
			value = (isFloat ? (num2 / (float)num) : num2);
			return true;
		}

		public static bool TryParseInt(string template, char ch, int templateLength, ref int currentIndex, ref int value, bool allowRound = true)
		{
			float value2 = 0f;
			if (TryParseFloat(template, ch, templateLength, ref currentIndex, ref value2, out var sign))
			{
				if (allowRound)
				{
					value = (int)((double)value2 + (double)sign * 0.5);
				}
				else
				{
					value = (int)value2;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal static class ValueSets
	{
		private static Dictionary<Type, ValueSet> dict = new Dictionary<Type, ValueSet>();

		public static T Get<T>() where T : ValueSet, new()
		{
			if (dict.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out var value))
			{
				return value as T;
			}
			value = new T();
			dict.Add(typeof(T), value);
			return value as T;
		}
	}
	public class IntellisenceValue
	{
		public string Text { get; }

		public bool IsCombined { get; internal set; }

		public IntellisenceValue(string text)
		{
			Text = text;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Text;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ValueSet
	{
		public static List<string> ValuesGlobal { get; } = new List<string> { "initial", "inherit" };

		public List<IntellisenceValue> Values { get; } = new List<IntellisenceValue>();

		public List<ValueSet> AllowedValueSets { get; } = new List<ValueSet>();

		public virtual bool QuoteWhitespace => false;

		protected abstract void Init();

		public ValueSet()
		{
			Init();
		}

		protected void Add(string val)
		{
			Values.Add(new IntellisenceValue(val));
		}

		protected void Add(params string[] vals)
		{
			foreach (string text in vals)
			{
				Values.Add(new IntellisenceValue(text));
			}
		}

		protected void Add4(ValueSet vset)
		{
			Add(vset);
			Add(vset, vset);
			Add(vset, vset, vset);
			Add(vset, vset, vset, vset);
		}

		protected void Add(params ValueSet[] setArray)
		{
			string[] array = new string[setArray.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				ValueSet valueSet = setArray[i];
				array[i] = valueSet.Values[0].Text;
				if (!AllowedValueSets.Contains(valueSet))
				{
					AllowedValueSets.Add(valueSet);
				}
			}
			Values.Add(new IntellisenceValue(string.Join(" ", array))
			{
				IsCombined = (array.Length > 1)
			});
		}
	}
	internal class SimpleValueSet : ValueSet
	{
		public SimpleValueSet(params string[] keywords)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < keywords.Length; i++)
			{
				base.Values.Add(new IntellisenceValue(keywords[i]));
			}
		}

		private SimpleValueSet()
		{
		}

		protected override void Init()
		{
		}
	}

	{

		public readonly int LineHeight;

		public readonly float FontSize;

		public readonly int InterCharacterSpacing;

		public static DxHtmlElementTextMetrics Default => defaultCore;

		private DxHtmlElementTextMetrics()
		{
		}

		public DxHtmlElementTextMetrics(IGraphicsCache cache, Font font, int interCharacterSpacing, int lineHeight)

	}
	public abstract class DxHtmlChildInfoCollectionBase : IEnumerable<DxHtmlElementInfoBase>, IEnumerable
	{
		private DxHtmlNode ownerCore;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DXBrowsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public DxHtmlNode Owner => ownerCore;

		public DxHtmlElementInfoBase this[int index] => GetInfo(index);

		public abstract int Length { get; }

		public int Count => Length;

		public abstract int FirstLogicalItemIndex { get; }

		public abstract int LastLogicalItemIndex { get; }

		public DxHtmlChildInfoCollectionBase(DxHtmlNode owner)
		{
			ownerCore = owner;
		}

		public virtual void AddBefore(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
		}

		public virtual void AddMarker(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
		}

		public virtual void AddAfter(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
		}

		public abstract IEnumerator<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> GetEnumerator();

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetEnumerator();
		}

		protected abstract DxHtmlElementInfoBase GetInfo(int index);

		private bool CheckIsLogicalItem(DxHtmlElementInfoBase infoBase)
		{
			return infoBase.Element.NodeType != DxHtmlNodeType.WhitespaceNode;
		}

		protected int FindFirstLogicalItemIndex(bool backDirection = false)
		{
			if (Count == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (backDirection)
			{
				for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (CheckIsLogicalItem(this[num]))
					{
						return num;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (CheckIsLogicalItem(this[i]))
					{
						return i;
					}
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlChildInfoCollection : DxHtmlChildInfoCollectionBase
	{
		private DxHtmlElementInfoBase markerCore;

		private DxHtmlElementInfoBase beforeCore;

		private DxHtmlElementInfoBase afterCore;

		private int firstElementCountCore;

		private int lastElementCountCore;

		private DxHtmlNodeList childNodeCore;

		private int firstLogicalItemIndexCore;

		private int lastLogicalItemIndexCore;

		public override int Length => childNodeCore.Count + firstElementCountCore + lastElementCountCore;

		public override int FirstLogicalItemIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (childNodeCore.recalcLogicalIndixes)
				{
					CalcLogicalItemIndexes();
				}
				return firstLogicalItemIndexCore;
			}
		}

		public override int LastLogicalItemIndex
		{
			get
			{
				if (childNodeCore.recalcLogicalIndixes)
				{
					CalcLogicalItemIndexes();
				}
				return lastLogicalItemIndexCore;
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlChildInfoCollection(DxHtmlElementBase owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
			childNodeCore = base.Owner.ChildNodes;
		}

		protected override DxHtmlElementInfoBase GetInfo(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (index >= firstElementCountCore)
			{
				int num = index - firstElementCountCore;
				if (num < childNodeCore.Length)
				{
					return GetInfoCore(num);
				}
				return afterCore;
			}
			if (index == 0)
			{
				if (markerCore == null)
				{
					return beforeCore;
				}
				return markerCore;
			}
			return beforeCore;
		}

		public override void AddBefore(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
			SetPseudoElement(ref beforeCore, elementInfo, ref firstElementCountCore);
		}

		public override void AddMarker(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
			SetPseudoElement(ref markerCore, elementInfo, ref firstElementCountCore);
		}

		public override void AddAfter(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
			SetPseudoElement(ref afterCore, elementInfo, ref lastElementCountCore);
		}

		public override IEnumerator<DxHtmlElementInfoBase> GetEnumerator()
		{
			DxHtmlNodeList childNodes = childNodeCore;
			if (markerCore != null)
			{
				yield return markerCore;
			}
			if (beforeCore != null)
			{
				yield return beforeCore;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < childNodes.Count; i++)
			{
				yield return GetInfoCore(i);
			}
			if (afterCore != null)
			{
				yield return afterCore;
			}
		}

		private void SetPseudoElement(ref DxHtmlElementInfoBase curInfo, DxHtmlElementInfoBase newInfo, ref int count)
		{
			if (curInfo != null)
			{
				(curInfo.Element as IPseudoElement)?.SetViewInfo(null);
				count--;
			}
			curInfo = newInfo;
			if (newInfo != null)
			{
				(newInfo.Element as IPseudoElement)?.SetViewInfo(newInfo);
				count++;
			}
		}

		private DxHtmlElementInfoBase GetInfoCore(int index)
		{
			return ((DxHtmlElementBase)childNodeCore[index]).ViewInfo;
		}

		private void CalcLogicalItemIndexes()
		{
			if (firstElementCountCore > 0)
			{
				firstLogicalItemIndexCore = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				firstLogicalItemIndexCore = FindFirstLogicalItemIndex();
			}
			if (lastElementCountCore > 0)
			{
				lastLogicalItemIndexCore = Length - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				lastLogicalItemIndexCore = FindFirstLogicalItemIndex(backDirection: true);
			}
			childNodeCore.recalcLogicalIndixes = false;
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses : IEquatable<DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses>
	{
		public SizeF TopLeft;

		public SizeF TopRight;

		public SizeF BottomLeft;

		public SizeF BottomRight;

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (TopLeft.IsEmpty && TopRight.IsEmpty && BottomLeft.IsEmpty)
				{
					return BottomRight.IsEmpty;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public void Assign(DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses other)
		{
			TopLeft = other.TopLeft;
			TopRight = other.TopRight;
			BottomLeft = other.BottomLeft;
			BottomRight = other.BottomRight;
		}

		public DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses Clone()
		{
			DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses = new DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses();
			dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses.Assign(this);
			return dxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			TopLeft = SizeF.Empty;
			TopRight = SizeF.Empty;
			BottomLeft = SizeF.Empty;
			BottomRight = SizeF.Empty;
		}

		public bool Equals(DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses other)
		{
			if (TopLeft == other.TopLeft && TopRight == other.TopRight && BottomLeft == other.BottomLeft)
			{
				return BottomRight == other.BottomRight;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlElementBordersInfo
	{
		public DxHtmlElementBorderInfo this[DxHtmlElementBorder type] => type switch
		{
			DxHtmlElementBorder.Left => Left, 
			DxHtmlElementBorder.Top => Top, 
			DxHtmlElementBorder.Right => Right, 
			_ => Bottom, 
		};

		public System.Drawing.Color? CommonColor { get; set; }

		public bool IsEmpty
		{
			get
			{
				if (Left.Width == 0 && Right.Width == 0 && Top.Width == 0)
				{
					return Bottom.Width == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlElementBorderInfo Left { get; }

		public DxHtmlElementBorderInfo Right { get; }

		public DxHtmlElementBorderInfo Top { get; }

		public DxHtmlElementBorderInfo Bottom { get; }

		public DxHtmlElementBordersInfo()
		{
			Left = new DxHtmlElementBorderInfo(DxHtmlElementBorder.Left);
			Right = new DxHtmlElementBorderInfo(DxHtmlElementBorder.Right);
			Top = new DxHtmlElementBorderInfo(DxHtmlElementBorder.Top);
			Bottom = new DxHtmlElementBorderInfo(DxHtmlElementBorder.Bottom);
		}

		public void CalcCommonColor()
		{
			CommonColor = null;
			System.Drawing.Color? color = TryGetColor(Left) ?? TryGetColor(Top) ?? TryGetColor(Right) ?? TryGetColor(Bottom);
			if (color.HasValue)
			{
				System.Drawing.Color value = color.Value;
				if ((Left.Width <= 0 || !(Left.Color != value)) && (Top.Width <= 0 || !(Top.Color != value)) && (Right.Width <= 0 || !(Right.Color != value)) && (Bottom.Width <= 0 || !(Bottom.Color != value)))
				{
					CommonColor = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private System.Drawing.Color? TryGetColor(DxHtmlElementBorderInfo border)
		{
			if (border.Width != 0)
			{
				return border.Color;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public PortablePadding ToPadding()
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new PortablePadding(Left.Width, Top.Width, Right.Width, Bottom.Width);
		}
	}

		{
			Type = type;
		}

		public void Clear()

			Width = 0;

	public class BackgroundImageInfo : IEquatable<BackgroundImageInfo>
	{
		public RectangleF ClientRectangle { get; set; }

		public HashSet<RectangleF> ImageRects { get; set; }

		public CssProperty<string> ImagePath { get; set; }

		public CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat> RepeatHorz { get; set; }

		public CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat> RepeatVert { get; set; }

		public CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> PositionHorz { get; set; }

		public CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> PositionVert { get; set; }

		public CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize> Width { get; set; }

		public CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize> Height { get; set; }

		public bool Equals(BackgroundImageInfo other)
		{
			if (ClientRectangle == other.ClientRectangle && ImagePath == other.ImagePath && RepeatHorz == other.RepeatHorz && RepeatVert == other.RepeatVert && PositionHorz == other.PositionHorz && PositionVert == other.PositionVert && Width == other.Width)
			{
				return Height == other.Height;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Assign(BackgroundImageInfo source)
		{
			ClientRectangle = source.ClientRectangle;
			ImagePath = source.ImagePath;
			RepeatHorz = source.RepeatHorz;
			RepeatVert = source.RepeatVert;
			PositionHorz = source.PositionHorz;
			PositionVert = source.PositionVert;
			Width = source.Width;
			Height = source.Height;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			ClientRectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
			ImageRects = new HashSet<RectangleF>();
			ImagePath = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundImagePath;
			RepeatHorz = PropertyDefaultValues.CssBackgroundRepeatHorz;
			RepeatVert = PropertyDefaultValues.CssBackgroundRepeatVert;
			PositionHorz = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundPositionHorz;
			PositionVert = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundPositionVert;
			Width = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundSizeWidth;
			Height = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundSizeHeight;
		}

		internal bool IsChanged(RectangleF client, CssBackgroundImageProperties properties)
		{
			if (ClientRectangle != client)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ImagePath == properties.ImagePath && RepeatHorz == properties.RepeatHorz && RepeatVert == properties.RepeatVert && PositionHorz == properties.PositionHorz && PositionVert == properties.PositionVert && Width == properties.Width)
			{
				return Height == properties.Height;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class CssProperty
	{
		public readonly int Weight;

		public readonly CssPropertyInheritance Inheritance;

		public bool IsEmpty => Weight < 0;

		public bool IsSpecified => Weight > 0;

		public CssProperty(int weight)
		{
			Weight = weight;
		}

		internal CssProperty(CssProperty source, int weight)
		{
			Inheritance = source.Inheritance;
			Weight = weight;
		}

		internal CssProperty(CssPropertyInheritance inheritance, int weight)
		{
			Weight = weight;
			Inheritance = inheritance;
		}

		public bool IsLess(CssProperty property)
		{
			return Weight < property.Weight;
		}
	}
	public class CssProperty<T> : CssProperty
	{
		public readonly T Value;

		public CssProperty(T value, int weight)
			: base(CssPropertyInheritance.None, weight)
		{
			Value = value;
		}

		internal CssProperty(CssProperty<T> source, int weight)
			: base(source.Inheritance, weight)
		{
			Value = source.Value;
		}

		internal CssProperty(T value, CssPropertyInheritance inheritance, int weight)
			: base(inheritance, weight)
		{
			Value = value;
		}

		public bool IsLess(CssProperty<T> property)
		{
			return Weight < property.Weight;
		}
	}

	public class CssUnit : CssProperty<float>
	{
		public static readonly CssUnit Empty = new CssUnit(0f, CssUnitValueType.Px, -1);

		public readonly CssUnitValueType ValueType;

		public CssUnit(float value, CssUnitValueType type, int weight)
			: base(value, weight)
		{
			ValueType = type;
		}

		internal CssUnit(CssUnit source, int weight)
			: base((CssProperty<float>)source, weight)
		{
			ValueType = source.ValueType;
		}

		internal CssUnit(float value, CssUnitValueType type, CssPropertyInheritance inheritance, int weight)
			: base(value, inheritance, weight)
		{
			ValueType = type;
		}

		internal CssUnit(CssPropertyInheritance inheritance, int weight)
			: base(0f, inheritance, weight)
		{
			ValueType = CssUnitValueType.Px;
		}

		protected float ConvertToPixels(SizeF clientSize, float parentValue, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			if (ValueType == CssUnitValueType.NoScaling)
			{
				return Value;
			}
			if (ValueType == CssUnitValueType.Number)
			{
				return Value * scaleFactor;
			}
			int num = 96;
			float num2 = 2.54f;
			return ValueType switch
			{
				CssUnitValueType.Px => Value * scaleFactor, 
				CssUnitValueType.Mm => Value / (10f * num2) * (float)num * scaleFactor, 
				CssUnitValueType.Cm => Value / num2 * (float)num * scaleFactor, 
				CssUnitValueType.In => Value * (float)num * scaleFactor, 
				CssUnitValueType.Pc => Value * 12f / 72f * (float)num * scaleFactor, 
				CssUnitValueType.Pt => Value / 72f * (float)num * scaleFactor, 
				CssUnitValueType.Em => currentFontSize * Value, 
				CssUnitValueType.Rem => rootFontSize * Value, 
				CssUnitValueType.Percentage => parentValue * Value / 100f, 
				_ => 0f, 
			};
		}

		public float GetValue(SizeF clientSize, float parentValue, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			return ConvertToPixels(clientSize, parentValue, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
		}

		public int GetRoundValue(SizeF clientSize, float parentValue, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			return Round(ConvertToPixels(clientSize, parentValue, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor));
		}

		private int Round(float val)
		{
			float num = ((ValueType < CssUnitValueType.Em) ? 0.49f : 0.5f);
			if (val >= 0f)
			{
				return (int)(val + num);
			}
			return (int)(val - num);
		}
	}
