	internal class CssProperties
	{
		protected void MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited<T>(ref T property, T parentProperty, T rootProperty, bool allowInherit = true) where T : CssProperty
		{
			if (property.IsEmpty)
			{
				if (allowInherit)
				{
					property = parentProperty;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MergeParentProperty(ref property, parentProperty, rootProperty, allowInherit);
			}
		}

		protected bool MergeParentProperty<T>(ref T property, T parentProperty, T rootProperty, bool allowInherit = true) where T : CssProperty
		{
			if (property.Inheritance == CssPropertyInheritance.None)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (property.Inheritance == CssPropertyInheritance.Inherit)
			{
				if (!allowInherit)
				{
					property = rootProperty;
					return false;
				}
				property = parentProperty;
			}
			else if (property.Inheritance == CssPropertyInheritance.Initial)
			{
				property = rootProperty;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected void MergeParentPropertyAutoInheritedBasedOnValue<T>(ref T property, T parentProperty, T rootProperty, bool condition) where T : CssProperty
		{
			if (condition)
			{
				property = parentProperty;
			}
			else
			{
				MergeParentProperty(ref property, parentProperty, rootProperty);
			}
		}

		protected void MergeProperty<T>(ref T property, T sourceProperty) where T : CssProperty
		{
			if (property.IsLess(sourceProperty))
			{
				property = sourceProperty;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CssTextProperties : CssProperties
	{
		private CssTextPropertyName changedCore;

		private CssProperty<CssWordWrap> wordWrapCore = PropertyDefaultValues.WordWrap;

		private CssProperty<CssTextAlign> textAlignCore = PropertyDefaultValues.TextAlign;

		private CssColor textDecorationColorCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Black;

		private CssProperty<CssTextDecorationLine> textDecorationLineCore = PropertyDefaultValues.TextDecorationLine;

		private CssProperty<CssTextDecorationStyle> textDecorationStyleCore = PropertyDefaultValues.TextDecorationStyle;

		private CssProperty<CssTextOverflow> textOverflowCore = PropertyDefaultValues.TextOverflow;

		private CssProperty<CssWritingMode> writingModeCore = PropertyDefaultValues.WritingMode;

		private CssProperty<CssOverflow> overflowXCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Overflow;

		private CssProperty<CssOverflow> overflowYCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Overflow;

		private CssProperty<CssWhiteSpace> whiteSpaceCore = PropertyDefaultValues.WhiteSpace;

		public CssColor TextDecorationColor => textDecorationColorCore;

		public CssProperty<CssTextDecorationLine> TextDecorationLine => textDecorationLineCore;

		public CssProperty<CssTextDecorationStyle> TextDecorationStyle => textDecorationStyleCore;

		public CssProperty<CssTextAlign> TextAlign => textAlignCore;

		public CssProperty<CssWordWrap> WordWrap => wordWrapCore;

		public CssProperty<CssWhiteSpace> WhiteSpace => whiteSpaceCore;

		public CssProperty<CssTextOverflow> TextOverflow => textOverflowCore;

		public CssProperty<CssWritingMode> WritingMode => writingModeCore;

		public CssProperty<CssOverflow> OverflowX => overflowXCore;

		public CssProperty<CssOverflow> OverflowY => overflowYCore;

		public bool HasChanges => changedCore > CssTextPropertyName.None;

		private void OnChanged(CssTextPropertyName propertyName)
		{
			changedCore |= propertyName;
		}

		internal bool CheckPropertyChanged(CssTextPropertyName propertyName)
		{
			return (changedCore & propertyName) != 0;
		}

		public void Merge(CssTextProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!HasChanges)
				{
					Assign(properties);
					return;
				}
				MergeProperty(ref textAlignCore, properties.textAlignCore);
				MergeProperty(ref wordWrapCore, properties.wordWrapCore);
				MergeProperty(ref textDecorationColorCore, properties.textDecorationColorCore);
				MergeProperty(ref textDecorationLineCore, properties.textDecorationLineCore);
				MergeProperty(ref textDecorationStyleCore, properties.textDecorationStyleCore);
				MergeProperty(ref overflowXCore, properties.overflowXCore);
				MergeProperty(ref overflowYCore, properties.overflowYCore);
				MergeProperty(ref writingModeCore, properties.writingModeCore);
				MergeProperty(ref textOverflowCore, properties.textOverflowCore);
				MergeProperty(ref whiteSpaceCore, properties.whiteSpaceCore);
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssTextProperties parentProperties, CssTextProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (parentProperties.HasChanges || (HasChanges && rootProperties.HasChanges))
			{
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref overflowXCore, parentProperties.overflowXCore, rootProperties.overflowXCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssTextPropertyName.Overflow;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref overflowYCore, parentProperties.overflowYCore, rootProperties.overflowYCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssTextPropertyName.Overflow;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref textOverflowCore, parentProperties.textOverflowCore, rootProperties.textOverflowCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssTextPropertyName.TextOverflow;
				}
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref textAlignCore, parentProperties.textAlignCore, rootProperties.textAlignCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref wordWrapCore, parentProperties.wordWrapCore, rootProperties.wordWrapCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref textDecorationColorCore, parentProperties.textDecorationColorCore, rootProperties.textDecorationColorCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref textDecorationLineCore, parentProperties.textDecorationLineCore, rootProperties.textDecorationLineCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref textDecorationStyleCore, parentProperties.textDecorationStyleCore, rootProperties.textDecorationStyleCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref writingModeCore, parentProperties.writingModeCore, rootProperties.writingModeCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref whiteSpaceCore, parentProperties.whiteSpaceCore, rootProperties.whiteSpaceCore);
				changedCore |= parentProperties.changedCore & CssTextPropertyName.PropertyAutoInherited;
			}
		}

		public void Assign(CssTextProperties properties)
		{
			textAlignCore = properties.textAlignCore;
			wordWrapCore = properties.wordWrapCore;
			textDecorationColorCore = properties.textDecorationColorCore;
			textDecorationLineCore = properties.textDecorationLineCore;
			textDecorationStyleCore = properties.textDecorationStyleCore;
			overflowXCore = properties.overflowXCore;
			overflowYCore = properties.overflowYCore;

			changedCore = properties.changedCore;
			whiteSpaceCore = properties.whiteSpaceCore;
		}

	internal class CssAutoInheritedProperties : CssProperties
	{
		private CssAutoInheretedPropertyName changedCore;

		private CssCursor cursorCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Cursor;

		private CssProperty<CssVisibility> visibilityCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Visibility;

		private CssColor foreColorCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Black;

		private CssUnit borderVerticalSpacingCore = PropertyDefaultValues.BorderSpacing;

		private CssUnit borderHorizontelSpacingCore = PropertyDefaultValues.BorderSpacing;

		private CssProperty<CssBorderCollapse> borderCollapseCore = PropertyDefaultValues.BorderCollapse;

		private CssProperty<CssListStylePosition> listStylePositionCore = PropertyDefaultValues.ListStylePosition;

		private CssProperty<CssListStyleType> listStyleTypeCore = PropertyDefaultValues.ListStyleType;

		private CssProperty<CssCaptionSide> captionSideCore = PropertyDefaultValues.CaptionSide;

		private CssProperty<CssDirection> directionCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Direction;

		private CssProperty<CssUserSelect> userSelectCore = PropertyDefaultValues.UserSelect;

		public CssCursor Cursor => cursorCore;

		public CssProperty<CssVisibility> Visibility => visibilityCore;

		public CssColor ForeColor => foreColorCore;

		public CssUnit BorderVerticalSpacing => borderVerticalSpacingCore;

		public CssUnit BorderHorizontalSpacing => borderHorizontelSpacingCore;

		public CssProperty<CssBorderCollapse> BorderCollapse => borderCollapseCore;

		public CssProperty<CssListStylePosition> ListStylePosition => listStylePositionCore;

		public CssProperty<CssListStyleType> ListStyleType => listStyleTypeCore;

		public CssProperty<CssCaptionSide> CaptionSide => captionSideCore;

		public CssProperty<CssDirection> Direction => directionCore;

		public CssProperty<CssUserSelect> UserSelect => userSelectCore;

		public bool HasChanges => changedCore > CssAutoInheretedPropertyName.None;

		private void OnChanged(CssAutoInheretedPropertyName propertyName)
		{
			changedCore |= propertyName;
		}

		internal void MergeForeColor(CssColor color)
		{
			if (!color.IsEmpty)
			{
				MergeProperty(ref foreColorCore, color);
				OnChanged(CssAutoInheretedPropertyName.ForeColor);
			}
		}

		public void Merge(CssAutoInheritedProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!HasChanges)
				{
					Assign(properties);
					return;
				}
				MergeProperty(ref foreColorCore, properties.foreColorCore);
				MergeProperty(ref visibilityCore, properties.visibilityCore);
				MergeProperty(ref borderHorizontelSpacingCore, properties.borderHorizontelSpacingCore);
				MergeProperty(ref borderVerticalSpacingCore, properties.borderVerticalSpacingCore);
				MergeProperty(ref borderCollapseCore, properties.borderCollapseCore);
				MergeProperty(ref listStylePositionCore, properties.listStylePositionCore);
				MergeProperty(ref listStyleTypeCore, properties.listStyleTypeCore);
				MergeProperty(ref cursorCore, properties.cursorCore);
				MergeProperty(ref userSelectCore, properties.userSelectCore);
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssAutoInheritedProperties parentProperties, CssAutoInheritedProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (parentProperties.HasChanges || (HasChanges && rootProperties.HasChanges))
			{
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref foreColorCore, parentProperties.foreColorCore, rootProperties.foreColorCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref visibilityCore, parentProperties.visibilityCore, rootProperties.visibilityCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref borderVerticalSpacingCore, parentProperties.borderVerticalSpacingCore, rootProperties.borderVerticalSpacingCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref borderHorizontelSpacingCore, parentProperties.borderHorizontelSpacingCore, rootProperties.borderHorizontelSpacingCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref borderCollapseCore, parentProperties.borderCollapseCore, rootProperties.borderCollapseCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref listStylePositionCore, parentProperties.listStylePositionCore, rootProperties.listStylePositionCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref listStyleTypeCore, parentProperties.listStyleTypeCore, rootProperties.listStyleTypeCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref cursorCore, parentProperties.cursorCore, rootProperties.cursorCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInheritedBasedOnValue(ref userSelectCore, parentProperties.userSelectCore, rootProperties.userSelectCore, QueryInheritUserSelectProperty());
				changedCore |= parentProperties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		private bool QueryInheritUserSelectProperty()
		{
			if (userSelectCore.IsEmpty)
			{
				return true;
			}
			CssUserSelect value = userSelectCore.Value;
			if (value == CssUserSelect.Auto)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return !userSelectCore.IsSpecified;
		}

		public void Assign(CssAutoInheritedProperties properties)
		{
			foreColorCore = properties.foreColorCore;
			visibilityCore = properties.visibilityCore;
			borderHorizontelSpacingCore = properties.borderHorizontelSpacingCore;
			borderVerticalSpacingCore = properties.borderVerticalSpacingCore;
			borderCollapseCore = properties.borderCollapseCore;
			listStylePositionCore = properties.listStylePositionCore;
			listStyleTypeCore = properties.listStyleTypeCore;
			cursorCore = properties.cursorCore;
			userSelectCore = properties.userSelectCore;
			changedCore = properties.changedCore;
		}

		internal void Assign(CssAutoInheritedProperties properties, int weight)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!properties.foreColorCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					foreColorCore = new CssColor(properties.foreColorCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.visibilityCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					visibilityCore = new CssProperty<CssVisibility>(properties.visibilityCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.borderCollapseCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					borderCollapseCore = new CssProperty<CssBorderCollapse>(properties.borderCollapseCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.borderVerticalSpacingCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					borderVerticalSpacingCore = new CssUnit(properties.borderVerticalSpacingCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.borderHorizontelSpacingCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					borderHorizontelSpacingCore = new CssUnit(properties.borderHorizontelSpacingCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.listStylePositionCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					listStylePositionCore = new CssProperty<CssListStylePosition>(properties.listStylePositionCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.listStyleTypeCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					listStyleTypeCore = new CssProperty<CssListStyleType>(properties.listStyleTypeCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.cursorCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					cursorCore = new CssCursor(properties.cursorCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.userSelectCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					userSelectCore = new CssProperty<CssUserSelect>(properties.UserSelect, weight);
				}
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		public void SetVisibility(CssProperty<CssVisibility> visibility)
		{
			visibilityCore = visibility;
			OnChanged(CssAutoInheretedPropertyName.Visibility);
		}

		public void SetForeColor(CssColor color)
		{
			foreColorCore = color;
			OnChanged(CssAutoInheretedPropertyName.ForeColor);
		}

		public void SetBorderSpacing(CssUnit spacing)
		{
			borderHorizontelSpacingCore = (borderVerticalSpacingCore = spacing);
			OnChanged(CssAutoInheretedPropertyName.BorderSpacing);
		}

		public void SetBorderSpacing(CssUnit verticalSpacing, CssUnit horizontelSpacing)
		{
			borderHorizontelSpacingCore = horizontelSpacing;
			borderVerticalSpacingCore = verticalSpacing;
			OnChanged(CssAutoInheretedPropertyName.BorderSpacing);
		}

		}

		}

	internal class CssMainProperties : CssProperties
	{
		private CssMainPropertyName changedCore;

		private CssColor backgroundColorCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Transparent;

		private CssColor fillCore = PropertyDefaultValues.EmptyColor;

		private CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> widthCore = PropertyDefaultValues.AutoUnit;

		private CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> heightCore = PropertyDefaultValues.AutoUnit;

		private CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> leftCore = PropertyDefaultValues.AutoUnit;

		private CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> rightCore = PropertyDefaultValues.AutoUnit;

		private CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> topCore = PropertyDefaultValues.AutoUnit;

		private CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> bottomCore = PropertyDefaultValues.AutoUnit;

		private CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> zIndexCore = PropertyDefaultValues.AutoUnit;

		private CssProperty<CssDisplay> displayCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Display;

		private CssProperty<float> opacityCore = PropertyDefaultValues._0F;

		private CssUnit<CssVerticalAlign> verticalAlignCore = PropertyDefaultValues.VerticalAlign;

		private CssProperty<CssPosition> positionCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Position;

		private CssProperty<int> orderCore = PropertyDefaultValues._0;

		private CssUnit<CssObjectFit> objectFitCore = PropertyDefaultValues.ObjectFitFill;

		private CssContent contentCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Content;

		public CssContent Content => contentCore;

		public CssColor Fill => fillCore;

		public CssColor BackgroundColor => backgroundColorCore;

		public CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> Width => widthCore;

		public CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> Height => heightCore;

		public CssProperty<CssDisplay> Display => displayCore;

		public CssProperty<float> Opacity => opacityCore;

		public CssUnit<CssVerticalAlign> VerticalAlign => verticalAlignCore;

		public CssProperty<CssPosition> Position => positionCore;

		public CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> Left => leftCore;

		public CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> Top => topCore;

		public CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> Right => rightCore;

		public CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> Bottom => bottomCore;

		public CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> ZIndex => zIndexCore;

		public CssProperty<int> Order => orderCore;

		public CssUnit<CssObjectFit> ObjectFit => objectFitCore;

		public bool HasChanges => changedCore > CssMainPropertyName.None;

		public static System.Drawing.Size CalcSize(CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> widthUnit, CssUnit<CssUnitAuto> heightUnit, SizeF clientSize, SizeF containerSize, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, SizeF scaleFactor)
		{
			int roundValue = widthUnit.GetRoundValue(clientSize, containerSize.Width, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor.Width);
			int roundValue2 = heightUnit.GetRoundValue(clientSize, containerSize.Height, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor.Height);
			return new System.Drawing.Size(roundValue, roundValue2);
		}

		private void OnChanged(CssMainPropertyName propertyName)
		{
			changedCore |= propertyName;
		}

		public System.Drawing.Size CalcSize(SizeF clientSize, SizeF containerSize, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, SizeF scaleFactor)
		{
			return CalcSize(widthCore, heightCore, clientSize, containerSize, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
		}

		public void Merge(CssMainProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!HasChanges)
				{
					Assign(properties);
					return;
				}
				MergeProperty(ref backgroundColorCore, properties.backgroundColorCore);
				MergeProperty(ref fillCore, properties.fillCore);
				MergeProperty(ref displayCore, properties.displayCore);
				MergeProperty(ref heightCore, properties.heightCore);
				MergeProperty(ref widthCore, properties.widthCore);
				MergeProperty(ref leftCore, properties.leftCore);
				MergeProperty(ref topCore, properties.topCore);
				MergeProperty(ref rightCore, properties.rightCore);
				MergeProperty(ref bottomCore, properties.bottomCore);
				MergeProperty(ref zIndexCore, properties.zIndexCore);
				MergeProperty(ref opacityCore, properties.opacityCore);
				MergeProperty(ref verticalAlignCore, properties.verticalAlignCore);
				MergeProperty(ref positionCore, properties.positionCore);
				MergeProperty(ref orderCore, properties.orderCore);
				MergeProperty(ref objectFitCore, properties.objectFitCore);
				MergeProperty(ref contentCore, properties.contentCore);
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeParentBackground(CssMainProperties parentProperties, CssMainProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (parentProperties.HasChanges || rootProperties.HasChanges)
			{
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref backgroundColorCore, parentProperties.backgroundColorCore, rootProperties.backgroundColorCore);
				changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.BackgroundColor;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssMainProperties parentProperties, CssMainProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (HasChanges && (parentProperties.HasChanges || rootProperties.HasChanges))
			{
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref backgroundColorCore, parentProperties.backgroundColorCore, rootProperties.backgroundColorCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.BackgroundColor;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref fillCore, parentProperties.fillCore, rootProperties.fillCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Fill;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref displayCore, parentProperties.displayCore, rootProperties.displayCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Display;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref heightCore, parentProperties.heightCore, rootProperties.heightCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Height;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref widthCore, parentProperties.widthCore, rootProperties.widthCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Width;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref leftCore, parentProperties.leftCore, rootProperties.leftCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Left;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref topCore, parentProperties.topCore, rootProperties.topCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Top;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref rightCore, parentProperties.rightCore, rootProperties.rightCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Right;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref bottomCore, parentProperties.bottomCore, rootProperties.bottomCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Bottom;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref zIndexCore, parentProperties.zIndexCore, rootProperties.zIndexCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.ZIndex;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref opacityCore, parentProperties.opacityCore, rootProperties.opacityCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Opacity;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref verticalAlignCore, parentProperties.verticalAlignCore, rootProperties.verticalAlignCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.VerticalAlign;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref positionCore, parentProperties.positionCore, rootProperties.positionCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Position;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref orderCore, parentProperties.orderCore, rootProperties.orderCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Order;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref objectFitCore, parentProperties.objectFitCore, rootProperties.objectFitCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.ObjectFit;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref contentCore, parentProperties.contentCore, rootProperties.contentCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssMainPropertyName.Content;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Assign(CssMainProperties properties)
		{
			backgroundColorCore = properties.backgroundColorCore;
			fillCore = properties.fillCore;
			displayCore = properties.displayCore;
			heightCore = properties.heightCore;
			widthCore = properties.widthCore;
			leftCore = properties.leftCore;
			rightCore = properties.rightCore;
			topCore = properties.topCore;
			bottomCore = properties.bottomCore;
			verticalAlignCore = properties.verticalAlignCore;
			opacityCore = properties.opacityCore;
			positionCore = properties.positionCore;
			orderCore = properties.orderCore;
			changedCore = properties.changedCore;
			objectFitCore = properties.objectFitCore;
			zIndexCore = properties.zIndexCore;
			contentCore = properties.contentCore;
		}

		internal void Assign(CssMainProperties properties, int weight)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!properties.backgroundColorCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					backgroundColorCore = new CssColor(properties.backgroundColorCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.fillCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					fillCore = new CssColor(properties.fillCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.displayCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					displayCore = new CssProperty<CssDisplay>(properties.displayCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.heightCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					heightCore = new CssUnit<CssUnitAuto>(properties.heightCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.widthCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					widthCore = new CssUnit<CssUnitAuto>(properties.widthCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.leftCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					leftCore = new CssUnit<CssUnitAuto>(properties.leftCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.topCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					topCore = new CssUnit<CssUnitAuto>(properties.topCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.rightCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					rightCore = new CssUnit<CssUnitAuto>(properties.rightCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.bottomCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					bottomCore = new CssUnit<CssUnitAuto>(properties.bottomCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.zIndexCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					bottomCore = new CssUnit<CssUnitAuto>(properties.zIndexCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.opacityCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					opacityCore = new CssProperty<float>(properties.opacityCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.positionCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					positionCore = new CssProperty<CssPosition>(properties.positionCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.verticalAlignCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					verticalAlignCore = new CssUnit<CssVerticalAlign>(properties.verticalAlignCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.orderCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					orderCore = new CssProperty<int>(properties.orderCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.objectFitCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					objectFitCore = new CssUnit<CssObjectFit>(properties.objectFitCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.contentCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					contentCore = new CssContent(properties.contentCore, weight);
				}
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

	internal class CssPaddingProperties : CssProperties
	{
		private CssPaddingPropertyName changedCore;

		private CssUnit topCore;

		private CssUnit bottomCore;

		private CssUnit leftCore;

		private CssUnit rightCore;

		public CssUnit Top => topCore;

		public CssUnit Bottom => bottomCore;

		public CssUnit Left => leftCore;

		public CssUnit Right => rightCore;

		public bool HasChanges => changedCore > CssPaddingPropertyName.None;

		private void OnChanged(CssPaddingPropertyName propertyName)
		{
			changedCore |= propertyName;
		}

		internal CssPaddingProperties(CssUnit defaultValue)
		{
			bottomCore = (topCore = (leftCore = (rightCore = defaultValue)));
		}

		public PortablePadding Calc(SizeF clientSize, System.Drawing.Size containerSize, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, SizeF scaleFactor)
		{
			//IL_0080: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int roundValue = topCore.GetRoundValue(clientSize, containerSize.Height, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor.Height);
			int roundValue2 = bottomCore.GetRoundValue(clientSize, containerSize.Height, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor.Height);
			int roundValue3 = leftCore.GetRoundValue(clientSize, containerSize.Width, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor.Width);
			int roundValue4 = rightCore.GetRoundValue(clientSize, containerSize.Width, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor.Width);
			return new PortablePadding(roundValue3, roundValue, roundValue4, roundValue2);
		}

		public void SetAll(CssUnit all)
		{
			SetAll(all, all, all, all);
		}

		public void SetAll(CssUnit top, CssUnit right)
		{
			SetAll(top, right, top, right);
		}

		public void SetAll(CssUnit top, CssUnit right, CssUnit bottom)
		{
			SetAll(top, right, bottom, right);
		}

		public void SetAll(CssUnit top, CssUnit right, CssUnit bottom, CssUnit left)
		{
			topCore = top;
			leftCore = left;
			bottomCore = bottom;
			rightCore = right;
			OnChanged((CssPaddingPropertyName)15);
		}

		public void Merge(CssPaddingProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!HasChanges)
				{
					Assign(properties);
					return;
				}
				MergeProperty(ref leftCore, properties.leftCore);
				MergeProperty(ref topCore, properties.topCore);
				MergeProperty(ref rightCore, properties.rightCore);
				MergeProperty(ref bottomCore, properties.bottomCore);
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssPaddingProperties parentProperties, CssPaddingProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (HasChanges && (parentProperties.HasChanges || rootProperties.HasChanges))
			{
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref leftCore, parentProperties.leftCore, rootProperties.leftCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssPaddingPropertyName.Left;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref topCore, parentProperties.topCore, rootProperties.topCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssPaddingPropertyName.Top;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref rightCore, parentProperties.rightCore, rootProperties.rightCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssPaddingPropertyName.Right;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref bottomCore, parentProperties.bottomCore, rootProperties.bottomCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssPaddingPropertyName.Bottom;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Assign(CssPaddingProperties properties)
		{
			leftCore = properties.leftCore;
			topCore = properties.topCore;
			rightCore = properties.rightCore;
			bottomCore = properties.bottomCore;
			changedCore = properties.changedCore;
		}

		internal void Assign(CssPaddingProperties properties, int weight)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!properties.leftCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					leftCore = new CssUnit(properties.leftCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.topCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					topCore = new CssUnit(properties.topCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.rightCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					rightCore = new CssUnit(properties.rightCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.bottomCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					bottomCore = new CssUnit(properties.bottomCore, weight);
				}
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		public void SetLeft(CssUnit left)
		{
			leftCore = left;
			OnChanged(CssPaddingPropertyName.Left);
		}

		public void SetRigth(CssUnit right)
		{
			rightCore = right;
			OnChanged(CssPaddingPropertyName.Right);
		}

		public void SetBottom(CssUnit bottom)
		{
			bottomCore = bottom;
			OnChanged(CssPaddingPropertyName.Bottom);
		}

		public void SetTop(CssUnit top)
		{
			topCore = top;
			OnChanged(CssPaddingPropertyName.Top);
		}
	}

	internal class CssSizeProperties : CssProperties
	{
		private CssSizePropertyName changedCore;

		private CssUnit widthCore = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssUnit heightCore = CssUnit.Empty;

		public CssUnit Width => widthCore;

		public CssUnit Height => heightCore;

		public bool HasChanges => changedCore > CssSizePropertyName.None;

		public bool HasWidth => (changedCore & CssSizePropertyName.Width) == CssSizePropertyName.Width;

		public bool HasHeight => (changedCore & CssSizePropertyName.Height) == CssSizePropertyName.Height;

		private void OnChanged(CssSizePropertyName propertyName)
		{
			changedCore |= propertyName;
		}

		public System.Drawing.Size Calc(SizeF clientSize, System.Drawing.Size containerSize, float rootFontHeight, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			if (!HasChanges)
			{
				return System.Drawing.Size.Empty;
			}
			int roundValue = widthCore.GetRoundValue(clientSize, containerSize.Width, rootFontHeight, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			int roundValue2 = heightCore.GetRoundValue(clientSize, containerSize.Height, rootFontHeight, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			return new System.Drawing.Size(roundValue, roundValue2);
		}

		public void Merge(CssSizeProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!HasChanges)
				{
					Assign(properties);
					return;
				}
				MergeProperty(ref widthCore, properties.widthCore);
				MergeProperty(ref heightCore, properties.heightCore);
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssSizeProperties parentProperties, CssSizeProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (HasChanges && (parentProperties.HasChanges || rootProperties.HasChanges))
			{
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref widthCore, parentProperties.widthCore, rootProperties.widthCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssSizePropertyName.Width;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref heightCore, parentProperties.heightCore, rootProperties.heightCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssSizePropertyName.Height;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Assign(CssSizeProperties properties)
		{
			widthCore = properties.widthCore;
			heightCore = properties.heightCore;
			changedCore = properties.changedCore;
		}

		internal void Assign(CssSizeProperties properties, int weight)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!properties.widthCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					widthCore = new CssUnit(properties.widthCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.heightCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					heightCore = new CssUnit(properties.heightCore, weight);
				}
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		public void SetWidth(CssUnit width)
		{
			widthCore = width;
			OnChanged(CssSizePropertyName.Width);
		}

		public void SetHeight(CssUnit height)
		{
			heightCore = height;
			OnChanged(CssSizePropertyName.Height);
		}
	}
	internal class CssBorderRadiusProperties : CssProperties
	{
		private CssBorderRadiusPropertyName changedCore;

		private CssUnit topLeftHCore = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssUnit bottomLeftHCore = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssUnit topRightHCore = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssUnit bottomRightHCore = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssUnit topLeftVCore = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssUnit bottomLeftVCore = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssUnit topRightVCore = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssUnit bottomRightVCore = CssUnit.Empty;

		public CssUnit TopLeftH => topLeftHCore;

		public CssUnit BottomLeftH => bottomLeftHCore;

		public CssUnit TopRightH => topRightHCore;

		public CssUnit BottomRightH => bottomRightHCore;

		public CssUnit TopLeftV => topLeftVCore;

		public CssUnit BottomLeftV => bottomLeftVCore;

		public CssUnit TopRightV => topRightVCore;

		public CssUnit BottomRightV => bottomRightVCore;

		public bool IsEmpty { get; private set; }

		public bool HasChanges => changedCore > CssBorderRadiusPropertyName.None;

		public CssBorderRadiusProperties()
		{
			IsEmpty = true;
		}

		private void OnChanged(CssBorderRadiusPropertyName propertyName)
		{
			IsEmpty = false;
			changedCore |= propertyName;
		}

		public SizeF CalcTopLeft(SizeF clientSize, float containerSize, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			float value = topLeftVCore.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			float value2 = topLeftHCore.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			return new SizeF(value, value2);
		}

		public SizeF CalcTopRight(SizeF clientSize, float containerSize, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			float value = topRightVCore.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			float value2 = topRightHCore.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			return new SizeF(value, value2);
		}

		public SizeF CalcBottomRight(SizeF clientSize, float containerSize, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			float value = bottomRightVCore.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			float value2 = bottomRightHCore.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			return new SizeF(value, value2);
		}

		public SizeF CalcBottomLeft(SizeF clientSize, float containerSize, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			float value = bottomLeftVCore.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			float value2 = bottomLeftHCore.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			return new SizeF(value, value2);
		}

		public void SetRadius(CssUnit topLeft, CssUnit topRight, CssUnit bottomRight, CssUnit botomLeft)
		{
			topLeftHCore = (topLeftVCore = topLeft);
			bottomRightVCore = (bottomRightHCore = bottomRight);
			bottomLeftVCore = (bottomLeftHCore = botomLeft);
			topRightHCore = (topRightVCore = topRight);
			OnChanged(CssBorderRadiusPropertyName.All);
			IsEmpty = false;
		}

		public void Merge(CssBorderRadiusProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				IsEmpty = false;
				if (!HasChanges)
				{
					Assign(properties);
					return;
				}
				MergeProperty(ref topLeftHCore, properties.topLeftHCore);
				MergeProperty(ref topLeftVCore, properties.topLeftVCore);
				MergeProperty(ref bottomLeftHCore, properties.bottomLeftHCore);
				MergeProperty(ref bottomLeftVCore, properties.bottomLeftVCore);
				MergeProperty(ref topRightHCore, properties.topRightHCore);
				MergeProperty(ref topRightVCore, properties.topRightVCore);
				MergeProperty(ref bottomRightHCore, properties.bottomRightHCore);
				MergeProperty(ref bottomRightVCore, properties.bottomRightVCore);
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssBorderRadiusProperties parentProperties, CssBorderRadiusProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (HasChanges && (parentProperties.HasChanges || rootProperties.HasChanges))
			{
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref topLeftHCore, parentProperties.topLeftHCore, rootProperties.topLeftHCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBorderRadiusPropertyName.TopLeft;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref topLeftVCore, parentProperties.topLeftVCore, rootProperties.topLeftVCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBorderRadiusPropertyName.TopLeft;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref bottomLeftHCore, parentProperties.bottomLeftHCore, rootProperties.bottomLeftHCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBorderRadiusPropertyName.BottomLeft;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref bottomLeftVCore, parentProperties.bottomLeftVCore, rootProperties.bottomLeftVCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBorderRadiusPropertyName.BottomLeft;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref topRightHCore, parentProperties.topRightHCore, rootProperties.topRightHCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBorderRadiusPropertyName.TopRight;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref topRightVCore, parentProperties.topRightVCore, rootProperties.topRightVCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBorderRadiusPropertyName.TopRight;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref bottomRightHCore, parentProperties.bottomRightHCore, rootProperties.bottomRightHCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBorderRadiusPropertyName.BottomRight;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref bottomRightVCore, parentProperties.bottomRightVCore, rootProperties.bottomRightVCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBorderRadiusPropertyName.BottomRight;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Assign(CssBorderRadiusProperties properties)
		{
			IsEmpty = false;
			topLeftHCore = properties.topLeftHCore;
			topLeftVCore = properties.topLeftVCore;
			bottomLeftHCore = properties.bottomLeftHCore;
			bottomLeftVCore = properties.bottomLeftVCore;
			topRightHCore = properties.topRightHCore;
			topRightVCore = properties.topRightVCore;
			bottomRightHCore = properties.bottomRightHCore;
			bottomRightVCore = properties.bottomRightVCore;
			changedCore = properties.changedCore;
		}

		internal void Assign(CssBorderRadiusProperties properties, int weight)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				IsEmpty = false;
				if (!properties.topLeftHCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					topLeftHCore = new CssUnit(properties.topLeftHCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.topLeftVCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					topLeftVCore = new CssUnit(properties.topLeftVCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.bottomLeftHCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					bottomLeftHCore = new CssUnit(properties.bottomLeftHCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.bottomLeftVCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					bottomLeftVCore = new CssUnit(properties.bottomLeftVCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.topRightHCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					topRightHCore = new CssUnit(properties.topRightHCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.topRightVCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					topRightVCore = new CssUnit(properties.topRightVCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.bottomRightHCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					bottomRightHCore = new CssUnit(properties.bottomRightHCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.bottomRightVCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					bottomRightVCore = new CssUnit(properties.bottomRightVCore, weight);
				}
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		public void SetTopLeft(CssUnit topLeftH, CssUnit topLeftV)
		{
			topLeftHCore = topLeftH;
			topLeftVCore = topLeftV;
			OnChanged(CssBorderRadiusPropertyName.TopLeft);
		}

		public void SetBottomLeft(CssUnit bottomLeftH, CssUnit bottomLeftV)

			bottomRightVCore = bottomRightV;

	internal class CssBorderProperties : CssProperties
	{
		private CssBorderPropertyName changedCore;

		private CssStyle parentCore;

		private CssUnit<CssBorderWidth> widthCore = PropertyDefaultValues.BorderWidth;

		private CssColor colorCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Black;

		private CssProperty<CssBorderStyle> styleCore = PropertyDefaultValues.BorderStyle;

		private const int ThinWidth = 1;

		private const int MediumWidth = 3;

		private const int ThickWidth = 5;

		public bool HasChanges => changedCore > CssBorderPropertyName.None;

		public bool AllowBorder { get; private set; }

		public CssProperty<CssBorderStyle> Style => styleCore;

		public CssColor Color => colorCore;

		public CssUnit<CssBorderWidth> Width => widthCore;

		public CssBorderProperties(CssStyle parent)
		{
			parentCore = parent;
		}

		private void OnChanged(CssBorderPropertyName propertyName)
		{
			changedCore |= propertyName;
		}

		public float CalcWidth(SizeF clientSize, float containerSize, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			return widthCore.UnitType switch
			{
				CssBorderWidth.Medium => 3f * scaleFactor, 
				CssBorderWidth.Thick => 5f * scaleFactor, 
				CssBorderWidth.Thin => 1f * scaleFactor, 
				_ => widthCore.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor), 
			};
		}

		public void Merge(CssBorderProperties properties)
		{
			if (!properties.HasChanges)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!HasChanges)
			{
				Assign(properties);
				return;
			}
			MergeProperty(ref colorCore, properties.colorCore);
			MergeProperty(ref widthCore, properties.widthCore);
			if (styleCore.IsLess(properties.styleCore))
			{
				styleCore = properties.styleCore;
				AllowBorder = properties.AllowBorder;
			}
			changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			parentCore.AllowBorder |= AllowBorder;
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssBorderProperties parentProperties, CssBorderProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (HasChanges && (parentProperties.HasChanges || rootProperties.HasChanges))
			{
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref styleCore, parentProperties.styleCore, rootProperties.styleCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBorderPropertyName.Style;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref colorCore, parentProperties.colorCore, rootProperties.colorCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBorderPropertyName.Color;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref widthCore, parentProperties.widthCore, rootProperties.widthCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBorderPropertyName.Width;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Assign(CssBorderProperties borderProperties)
		{
			colorCore = borderProperties.colorCore;
			styleCore = borderProperties.styleCore;
			widthCore = borderProperties.widthCore;
			AllowBorder = borderProperties.AllowBorder;
			parentCore.AllowBorder |= AllowBorder;
			changedCore = borderProperties.changedCore;
		}

		internal void Assign(CssBorderProperties borderProperties, int weight)
		{
			if (borderProperties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!borderProperties.colorCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					colorCore = new CssColor(borderProperties.colorCore, weight);
				}
				if (!borderProperties.styleCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					styleCore = new CssProperty<CssBorderStyle>(borderProperties.styleCore, weight);
					AllowBorder = borderProperties.AllowBorder;
				}
				if (!borderProperties.widthCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					widthCore = new CssUnit<CssBorderWidth>(borderProperties.widthCore, weight);
				}
				changedCore |= borderProperties.changedCore;
				parentCore.AllowBorder |= AllowBorder;
			}
		}

		public void SetColor(CssColor color)
		{
			colorCore = color;
			OnChanged(CssBorderPropertyName.Color);
		}

		public void SetStyle(CssProperty<CssBorderStyle> style)
		{
			styleCore = style;
			AllowBorder = style.Weight > -1;
			parentCore.AllowBorder |= AllowBorder;
			OnChanged(CssBorderPropertyName.Style);
		}

		public void SetWidth(CssUnit<CssBorderWidth> width)
		{
			widthCore = width;
			OnChanged(CssBorderPropertyName.Width);
		}
	}
	internal class CssBoxShadowProperties : CssProperties
	{
		private CssProperty<bool> inset = PropertyDefaultValues.False;

		private CssUnit offsetX = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssUnit offsetY = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssUnit blurRadius = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssUnit spreadDistance = CssUnit.Empty;

		private CssColor colorCore = PropertyDefaultValues.Black;

		private CssBoxShadowPropertyName changedCore;

		public CssUnit OffsetX => offsetX;

		public CssUnit OffsetY => offsetY;

		public CssUnit BlurRadius => blurRadius;

		public CssUnit SpreadDistance => spreadDistance;

		public CssColor Color => colorCore;

		public CssProperty<bool> Inset => inset;

		public bool HasChanges => changedCore > CssBoxShadowPropertyName.None;

		private void OnChanged(CssBoxShadowPropertyName propertyName)
		{
			changedCore |= propertyName;
		}

		public float CalcOffsetX(SizeF clientSize, float containerSize, float rootFontHeight, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			return offsetX.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontHeight, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
		}

		public float CalcOffsetY(SizeF clientSize, float containerSize, float rootFontHeight, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			return offsetY.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontHeight, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
		}

		public float CalcBlurRadius(SizeF clientSize, float containerSize, float rootFontHeight, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			return blurRadius.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontHeight, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
		}

		public float CalcSpreadDistance(SizeF clientSize, float containerSize, float rootFontHeight, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			return spreadDistance.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontHeight, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
		}

		public void Merge(CssBoxShadowProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!HasChanges)
				{
					Assign(properties);
					return;
				}
				MergeProperty(ref offsetX, properties.offsetX);
				MergeProperty(ref offsetY, properties.offsetY);
				MergeProperty(ref blurRadius, properties.blurRadius);
				MergeProperty(ref spreadDistance, properties.spreadDistance);
				MergeProperty(ref colorCore, properties.colorCore);
				MergeProperty(ref inset, properties.inset);
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssBoxShadowProperties parentProperties, CssBoxShadowProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (HasChanges && (parentProperties.HasChanges || rootProperties.HasChanges))
			{
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref offsetX, parentProperties.offsetX, rootProperties.offsetX))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBoxShadowPropertyName.OffsetX;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref offsetY, parentProperties.offsetY, rootProperties.offsetY))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBoxShadowPropertyName.OffsetY;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref blurRadius, parentProperties.blurRadius, rootProperties.blurRadius))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBoxShadowPropertyName.BlurRadius;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref spreadDistance, parentProperties.spreadDistance, rootProperties.spreadDistance))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBoxShadowPropertyName.SpreadDistance;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref colorCore, parentProperties.colorCore, rootProperties.colorCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBoxShadowPropertyName.Color;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref inset, parentProperties.inset, rootProperties.inset))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBoxShadowPropertyName.Inset;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Assign(CssBoxShadowProperties boxShadowProperties)
		{
			offsetX = boxShadowProperties.OffsetX;
			offsetY = boxShadowProperties.OffsetY;
			blurRadius = boxShadowProperties.BlurRadius;
			spreadDistance = boxShadowProperties.SpreadDistance;
			colorCore = boxShadowProperties.Color;
			inset = boxShadowProperties.Inset;
			changedCore = boxShadowProperties.changedCore;
		}

		internal void Assign(CssBoxShadowProperties boxShadowProperties, int weight)
		{
			if (boxShadowProperties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!boxShadowProperties.offsetX.IsEmpty)
				{
					offsetX = new CssUnit(boxShadowProperties.OffsetX, weight);
				}
				if (!boxShadowProperties.offsetY.IsEmpty)
				{
					offsetY = new CssUnit(boxShadowProperties.OffsetX, weight);
				}
				if (!boxShadowProperties.blurRadius.IsEmpty)
				{
					blurRadius = new CssUnit(boxShadowProperties.OffsetX, weight);
				}
				if (!boxShadowProperties.spreadDistance.IsEmpty)
				{
					spreadDistance = new CssUnit(boxShadowProperties.OffsetX, weight);
				}
				if (!boxShadowProperties.inset.IsEmpty)
				{
					inset = new CssProperty<bool>(boxShadowProperties.Inset, weight);
				}
				if (!boxShadowProperties.colorCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					colorCore = new CssColor(boxShadowProperties.colorCore, weight);
				}
				changedCore |= boxShadowProperties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		public void SetOffsetX(CssUnit offsetX)
		{
			this.offsetX = offsetX;
			OnChanged(CssBoxShadowPropertyName.OffsetX);
		}

		public void SetOffsetY(CssUnit offsetY)
		{
			this.offsetY = offsetY;
			OnChanged(CssBoxShadowPropertyName.OffsetY);
		}

		public void SetBlurRadius(CssUnit blurRadius)
		{
			this.blurRadius = blurRadius;
			OnChanged(CssBoxShadowPropertyName.BlurRadius);
		}

		public void SetSpreadDistance(CssUnit spreadDistance)
		{
			this.spreadDistance = spreadDistance;
			OnChanged(CssBoxShadowPropertyName.SpreadDistance);
		}

		public void SetColor(CssColor color)
		{
			colorCore = color;
			OnChanged(CssBoxShadowPropertyName.Color);
		}

		public void SetInset(CssProperty<bool> inset)
		{
			this.inset = inset;
			OnChanged(CssBoxShadowPropertyName.Inset);
		}
	}
	internal class CssFlexProperties : CssProperties

			changedCore |= propertyName;
		}

		public float Calc(SizeF clientSize, float containerSize, float rootFontHeight, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			if (CssUnitAuto.Length == basisCore.UnitType)
			{
				return basisCore.GetValue(clientSize, containerSize, rootFontHeight, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			}
			return containerSize;
		}

		public void Merge(CssFlexProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!HasChanges)
				{
					Assign(properties);
					return;

				MergeProperty(ref basisCore, properties.basisCore);
				MergeProperty(ref alignContentCore, properties.alignContentCore);
				MergeProperty(ref alignItemsCore, properties.alignItemsCore);
				MergeProperty(ref shrinkCore, properties.shrinkCore);
				MergeProperty(ref growCore, properties.growCore);
				MergeProperty(ref alignSelfCore, properties.alignSelfCore);
				MergeProperty(ref wrapCore, properties.wrapCore);
				MergeProperty(ref directionCore, properties.directionCore);
				MergeProperty(ref justifyContentCore, properties.justifyContentCore);
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssFlexProperties parentProperties, CssFlexProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (HasChanges && (parentProperties.HasChanges || rootProperties.HasChanges))

				{
					changedCore |= CssFlexPropertyName.Basis;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref alignContentCore, parentProperties.alignContentCore, rootProperties.alignContentCore))
				{

				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref alignItemsCore, parentProperties.alignItemsCore, rootProperties.alignItemsCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssFlexPropertyName.AlignItems;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref shrinkCore, parentProperties.shrinkCore, rootProperties.shrinkCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssFlexPropertyName.Shrink;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref growCore, parentProperties.growCore, rootProperties.growCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssFlexPropertyName.Grow;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref alignSelfCore, parentProperties.alignSelfCore, rootProperties.alignSelfCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssFlexPropertyName.AlignSelf;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref wrapCore, parentProperties.wrapCore, rootProperties.wrapCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssFlexPropertyName.Wrap;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref directionCore, parentProperties.directionCore, rootProperties.directionCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssFlexPropertyName.Direction;

			justifyContentCore = properties.justifyContentCore;

	internal class CssFontProperties : CssProperties
	{
		private CssFontPropertyName changedCore;

		private CssProperty<CssFontStyle> styleCore = PropertyDefaultValues.FontStyle;

		private CssUnit<CssFontSize> sizeCore = PropertyDefaultValues.FontSize;

		private CssProperty<CssFontWeight> weightCore = PropertyDefaultValues.FontWeight;

		private CssProperty<string> familyCore = PropertyDefaultValues.FontFamily;

		private CssUnit lineHeightCore = PropertyDefaultValues.LineHeight;

		public bool HasChanges => changedCore > CssFontPropertyName.None;

		public CssProperty<CssFontStyle> Style => styleCore;

		public CssProperty<CssFontWeight> Weight => weightCore;

		public CssUnit<CssFontSize> Size => sizeCore;

		public CssProperty<string> Family => familyCore;

		public CssUnit LineHeight => lineHeightCore;

		public bool IsAbsoluteSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (sizeCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					return false;
				}
				CssFontSize unitType = sizeCore.UnitType;
				if ((uint)unitType <= 6u)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void OnChanged(CssFontPropertyName propertyName)
		{
			changedCore |= propertyName;
		}

		public float CalcFontSize(SizeF clientSize, float defaultFontSize, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			if (sizeCore.IsEmpty)
			{
				return currentFontSize;
			}
			return sizeCore.UnitType switch
			{
				CssFontSize.Large => defaultFontSize * 6f / 5f, 
				CssFontSize.Larger => currentFontSize * 6f / 5f, 
				CssFontSize.Medium => defaultFontSize, 
				CssFontSize.Small => defaultFontSize * 8f / 9f, 
				CssFontSize.Smaller => currentFontSize * 8f / 9f, 
				CssFontSize.XXlarge => defaultFontSize * 2f, 
				CssFontSize.XXsmall => defaultFontSize * 3f / 5f, 
				CssFontSize.Xlarge => defaultFontSize * 3f / 2f, 
				CssFontSize.Xsmall => defaultFontSize * 3f / 4f, 
				_ => sizeCore.GetValue(clientSize, currentFontSize, defaultFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor), 
			};
		}

		public GraphicsUnit GetUnit(Font parentFont, Font defaultFont)
		{
			if (sizeCore.IsEmpty)
			{
				return parentFont.Unit;
			}
			if (IsAbsoluteSize)
			{
				return defaultFont.Unit;
			}
			CssUnitValueType valueType = sizeCore.ValueType;
			if (valueType == CssUnitValueType.Em || valueType == CssUnitValueType.Percentage)
			{
				return parentFont.Unit;
			}
			return GraphicsUnit.Pixel;
		}

		public void Merge(CssFontProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!HasChanges)
				{
					Assign(properties);
					return;
				}
				MergeProperty(ref styleCore, properties.styleCore);
				MergeProperty(ref familyCore, properties.familyCore);
				MergeProperty(ref weightCore, properties.weightCore);
				MergeProperty(ref sizeCore, properties.sizeCore);
				MergeProperty(ref lineHeightCore, properties.lineHeightCore);
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssFontProperties parentProperties, CssFontProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (parentProperties.HasChanges || (HasChanges && rootProperties.HasChanges))
			{
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref weightCore, parentProperties.weightCore, rootProperties.weightCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref styleCore, parentProperties.styleCore, rootProperties.styleCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref familyCore, parentProperties.familyCore, rootProperties.familyCore);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref sizeCore, parentProperties.sizeCore, rootProperties.sizeCore, parentProperties.sizeCore.ValueType != CssUnitValueType.Em && parentProperties.sizeCore.ValueType != CssUnitValueType.Percentage);
				MergeParentPropertyAutoInherited(ref lineHeightCore, parentProperties.lineHeightCore, rootProperties.lineHeightCore);
				changedCore |= parentProperties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		public void Assign(CssFontProperties properties)
		{
			styleCore = properties.styleCore;
			familyCore = properties.familyCore;
			weightCore = properties.weightCore;
			sizeCore = properties.sizeCore;
			lineHeightCore = properties.lineHeightCore;
			changedCore = properties.changedCore;
		}

		internal void Assign(CssFontProperties properties, int weight)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!properties.styleCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					styleCore = new CssProperty<CssFontStyle>(properties.styleCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.familyCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					familyCore = new CssProperty<string>(properties.familyCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.weightCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					weightCore = new CssProperty<CssFontWeight>(properties.weightCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.sizeCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					sizeCore = new CssUnit<CssFontSize>(properties.sizeCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.lineHeightCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					lineHeightCore = new CssUnit(properties.lineHeightCore, weight);
				}
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		public void SetSize(CssUnit<CssFontSize> size)
		{
			sizeCore = size;
			OnChanged(CssFontPropertyName.Size);
		}

		public void SetLineHeight(CssUnit lineHeight)
		{
			lineHeightCore = lineHeight;
			OnChanged(CssFontPropertyName.LineHeight);
		}

		public void SetWeight(CssProperty<CssFontWeight> fontWeight)
		{
			weightCore = fontWeight;
			OnChanged(CssFontPropertyName.Weight);
		}

		public void SetStyle(CssProperty<CssFontStyle> style)
		{
			styleCore = style;
			OnChanged(CssFontPropertyName.Style);
		}

		public void SetFamily(CssProperty<string> family)
		{
			familyCore = family;
			OnChanged(CssFontPropertyName.Family);
		}
	}
	internal class CssBackgroundImagePropertiesCollection : Collection<CssBackgroundImageProperties>
	{
		internal int PositionCount;

		internal int RepeatCount;

		internal int SizeCount;

		public CssBackgroundImageProperties this[string id] => this.FirstOrDefault((CssBackgroundImageProperties properties) => properties.ImagePath.Value == id);

		public void MergeParent(CssBackgroundImagePropertiesCollection parentProperties, CssBackgroundImagePropertiesCollection rootProperties)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (parentProperties.Count > i && rootProperties.Count > i)
				{
					base.Items[i].MergeParent(parentProperties[i], rootProperties[i]);
				}
			}
			Synchronize();
		}

		public void Merge(CssBackgroundImagePropertiesCollection collection)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < collection.Count; i++)
			{
				CssBackgroundImageProperties cssBackgroundImageProperties = collection.Items[i];
				if (base.Items.Count <= i)
				{
					CssBackgroundImageProperties item = new CssBackgroundImageProperties(cssBackgroundImageProperties.parentCore);
					Add(item);
				}
				base.Items[i].Merge(cssBackgroundImageProperties);
			}
			Synchronize();
		}

		public void Assign(CssBackgroundImagePropertiesCollection collection)
		{
			Clear();
			foreach (CssBackgroundImageProperties item in collection.Items)
			{
				CssBackgroundImageProperties cssBackgroundImageProperties = new CssBackgroundImageProperties(item.parentCore);
				Add(cssBackgroundImageProperties);
				cssBackgroundImageProperties.Assign(item);
			}
			PositionCount = collection.PositionCount;
			RepeatCount = collection.RepeatCount;
			SizeCount = collection.SizeCount;
		}

		public void Assign(CssBackgroundImagePropertiesCollection collection, int weight)
		{
			Clear();
			foreach (CssBackgroundImageProperties item in collection.Items)
			{
				CssBackgroundImageProperties cssBackgroundImageProperties = new CssBackgroundImageProperties(item.parentCore);
				Add(cssBackgroundImageProperties);
				cssBackgroundImageProperties.Assign(item, weight);
			}
			PositionCount = collection.PositionCount;
			RepeatCount = collection.RepeatCount;
			SizeCount = collection.SizeCount;
		}

		public void Synchronize()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				CssBackgroundImageProperties cssBackgroundImageProperties = base[i];
				if (i >= PositionCount && PositionCount > 0)
				{
					cssBackgroundImageProperties.SetPositionHorz(base[i % PositionCount].PositionHorz);
					cssBackgroundImageProperties.SetPositionVert(base[i % PositionCount].PositionVert);
				}
				if (i >= RepeatCount && RepeatCount > 0)
				{
					cssBackgroundImageProperties.SetRepeatHorz(base[i % RepeatCount].RepeatHorz);
					cssBackgroundImageProperties.SetRepeatVert(base[i % RepeatCount].RepeatVert);
				}
				if (i >= SizeCount && SizeCount > 0)
				{
					cssBackgroundImageProperties.SetWidth(base[i % SizeCount].Width);
					cssBackgroundImageProperties.SetHeight(base[i % SizeCount].Height);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CssBackgroundImageProperties : CssProperties
	{
		internal CssBackgroundImagePropertyName changedCore;

		internal CssStyle parentCore;

		internal CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat> repeatHorzCore = PropertyDefaultValues.CssBackgroundRepeatHorz;

		internal CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat> repeatVertCore = PropertyDefaultValues.CssBackgroundRepeatVert;

		internal CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> positionHorzCore = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundPositionHorz;

		internal CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> positionVertCore = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundPositionVert;

		internal CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize> sizeWidthCore = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundSizeWidth;

		internal CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize> sizeHeightCore = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundSizeHeight;

		internal CssProperty<string> imagePathCore = PropertyDefaultValues.BackgroundImagePath;

		public CssProperty<string> ImagePath => imagePathCore;

		public CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat> RepeatHorz => repeatHorzCore;

		public CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat> RepeatVert => repeatVertCore;

		public CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> PositionHorz => positionHorzCore;

		public CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> PositionVert => positionVertCore;

		public CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize> Width => sizeWidthCore;

		public CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize> Height => sizeHeightCore;

		public bool HasImagePath => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ImagePath.Value);

		public bool HasChanges => changedCore > CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.None;

		public CssBackgroundImageProperties(CssStyle parent)
		{
			parentCore = parent;
		}

		internal void SetRepeatHorz(CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat> repeat)
		{
			if (repeat.Value != CssBackgroundRepeat.RepeatY)
			{
				repeatHorzCore = repeat;
				OnChanged(CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Repeat);
			}
			else
			{
				SetRepeatVert(repeat);
			}
		}

		internal void SetRepeatVert(CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat> repeat)
		{
			if (repeat.Value != CssBackgroundRepeat.RepeatX)
			{
				repeatVertCore = repeat;
				OnChanged(CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Repeat);
			}
			else
			{
				SetRepeatHorz(repeat);
			}
		}

		internal void SetPositionHorz(CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> x)
		{
			positionHorzCore = x;
			OnChanged(CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.X);
		}

		internal void SetPositionVert(CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition> y)
		{
			positionVertCore = y;
			OnChanged(CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Y);
		}

		internal void SetWidth(CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize> width)
		{
			sizeWidthCore = width;
			OnChanged(CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Width);
		}

		internal void SetHeight(CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize> height)
		{
			sizeHeightCore = height;
			OnChanged(CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Height);
		}

		internal void CheckSize()
		{
			if (Width.UnitType == CssBackgroundSize.Contain || Width.UnitType == CssBackgroundSize.Cover)
			{
				sizeHeightCore = Width;
			}
			if (Height.UnitType == CssBackgroundSize.Contain || Height.UnitType == CssBackgroundSize.Cover)
			{
				sizeWidthCore = Height;
			}
		}

		internal void SetImagePath(CssProperty<string> path)
		{
			imagePathCore = path;
			OnChanged(CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Image);
		}

		private void OnChanged(CssBackgroundImagePropertyName propertyName)
		{
			changedCore |= propertyName;
		}

		internal void MergeParent(CssBackgroundImageProperties parentProperties, CssBackgroundImageProperties rootProperties)
		{
			if (HasChanges && (parentProperties.HasChanges || rootProperties.HasChanges))
			{
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref imagePathCore, parentProperties.imagePathCore, rootProperties.imagePathCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Image;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref positionHorzCore, parentProperties.positionHorzCore, rootProperties.positionHorzCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.X;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref positionVertCore, parentProperties.positionVertCore, rootProperties.positionVertCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Y;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref sizeWidthCore, parentProperties.sizeWidthCore, rootProperties.sizeWidthCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Width;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref sizeHeightCore, parentProperties.sizeHeightCore, rootProperties.sizeHeightCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Height;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref repeatHorzCore, parentProperties.repeatHorzCore, rootProperties.repeatHorzCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Repeat;
				}
				if (MergeParentProperty(ref repeatVertCore, parentProperties.repeatVertCore, rootProperties.repeatVertCore))
				{
					changedCore |= CssBackgroundImagePropertyName.Repeat;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Merge(CssBackgroundImageProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!HasChanges)
				{
					Assign(properties);
					return;
				}
				MergeProperty(ref imagePathCore, properties.imagePathCore);
				MergeProperty(ref positionHorzCore, properties.positionHorzCore);
				MergeProperty(ref positionVertCore, properties.positionVertCore);
				MergeProperty(ref sizeWidthCore, properties.sizeWidthCore);
				MergeProperty(ref sizeHeightCore, properties.sizeHeightCore);
				MergeProperty(ref repeatHorzCore, properties.repeatHorzCore);
				MergeProperty(ref repeatVertCore, properties.repeatVertCore);
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		public void Assign(CssBackgroundImageProperties properties)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				imagePathCore = properties.imagePathCore;
				repeatHorzCore = properties.repeatHorzCore;
				repeatVertCore = properties.repeatVertCore;
				positionVertCore = properties.positionVertCore;
				positionHorzCore = properties.positionHorzCore;
				sizeWidthCore = properties.sizeWidthCore;
				sizeHeightCore = properties.sizeHeightCore;
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		internal void Assign(CssBackgroundImageProperties properties, int weight)
		{
			if (properties.HasChanges)
			{
				if (!properties.imagePathCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					imagePathCore = new CssProperty<string>(properties.imagePathCore.Value, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.positionVertCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					positionVertCore = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(properties.positionVertCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.positionHorzCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					positionHorzCore = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundPosition>(properties.positionHorzCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.sizeWidthCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					sizeWidthCore = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize>(properties.sizeWidthCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.sizeHeightCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					sizeHeightCore = new CssUnit<CssBackgroundSize>(properties.sizeHeightCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.repeatHorzCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					repeatHorzCore = new CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat>(properties.repeatHorzCore, weight);
				}
				if (!properties.repeatVertCore.IsEmpty)
				{
					repeatVertCore = new CssProperty<CssBackgroundRepeat>(properties.repeatVertCore, weight);
				}
				changedCore |= properties.changedCore;
			}
		}

		public PointF CalcBackgroundImageLocation(SizeF clientSize, float parentValue, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			float value = PositionHorz.GetValue(clientSize, parentValue, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			float value2 = PositionVert.GetValue(clientSize, parentValue, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			return new PointF(value, value2);
		}

		public SizeF CalcBackgroundImageSize(SizeF clientSize, float parentValue, float rootFontSize, float currentFontSize, float scaleFactor)
		{
			float value = Width.GetValue(clientSize, parentValue, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			float value2 = Height.GetValue(clientSize, parentValue, rootFontSize, currentFontSize, scaleFactor);
			return new SizeF(value, value2);
		}
	}
