	internal abstract class CssSelectorBase
	{
		public short Weight { get; internal set; }

		public short Position { get; internal set; }

		public CssPseudoElement PseudoElement { get; internal set; }

		public CssPseudoClass PseudoClass { get; internal set; }

		public string CustomState { get; internal set; }

		public CssSelectorBase(short weight)
		{
			Weight = weight;
		}

		public CssStyle GetOrCreateStyle(CssStyleSheet styleSheet)
		{
			CssStyle cssStyle = null;
			cssStyle = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(CustomState)) ? GetOrCreateStyleSet(styleSheet).GetOrCreateStyle(CustomState) : GetOrCreateStyleSet(styleSheet).GetOrCreateStyle(PseudoClass));
			if (PseudoElement != CssPseudoElement.None)
			{
				return cssStyle.GetOrCreateStyle(PseudoElement);
			}
			return cssStyle;
		}

		public abstract CssStyleSet GetOrCreateStyleSet(CssStyleSheet styleSheet);
	}
	internal abstract class CssSelector : CssSelectorBase
	{
		public CssCombinator Combinator { get; internal set; }

		public string Name { get; internal set; }

		public CssSelector(short weight)
			: base(weight)
		{
		}

		internal abstract bool IsMatch(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator element);

		public bool Equals(CssSelector selector)
		{
			if (base.Weight == selector.Weight && Combinator == selector.Combinator && base.PseudoClass == selector.PseudoClass && base.CustomState == selector.CustomState)
			{
				return Name == selector.Name;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class CssIDSelector : CssSelector
	{
		public CssIDSelector()
			: base(100)
		{
		}

		internal override bool IsMatch(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator element)
		{
			return element.GetId() != null;
		}

		public override CssStyleSet GetOrCreateStyleSet(CssStyleSheet styleSheet)
		{
			return styleSheet.GetOrCreateIdStyleSet(base.Name);
		}
	}
	internal class CssClassSelector : CssSelector
	{
		public CssClassSelector()
			: base(10)
		{
		}

		internal override bool IsMatch(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator element)
		{
			return element.ContainsClass(base.Name);
		}

		public override CssStyleSet GetOrCreateStyleSet(CssStyleSheet styleSheet)
		{
			return styleSheet.GetOrCreateClassStyleSet(base.Name);
		}
	}
	internal class CssTagSelector : CssSelector
	{
		public CssTagSelector()
			: base(1)
		{
		}

		internal override bool IsMatch(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator element)
		{
			return element.GetTagName() == base.Name;
		}

		public override CssStyleSet GetOrCreateStyleSet(CssStyleSheet styleSheet)
		{
			return styleSheet.GetOrCreateTagStyleSet(base.Name);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class CssCombinatorsSelectorBase : CssSelectorBase
	{
		private CssSelector keyCore;

		public CssSelector Key => keyCore;

		public CssCombinatorsSelectorBase(CssSelector key, short weight)
			: base((short)(weight + key.Weight))
		{
			keyCore = key;
			base.PseudoClass = key.PseudoClass;
			base.CustomState = key.CustomState;
		}

		public override CssStyleSet GetOrCreateStyleSet(CssStyleSheet styleSheet)
		{
			CssStyleSet orCreateStyleSet = keyCore.GetOrCreateStyleSet(styleSheet);
			return orCreateStyleSet.GetOrCreateCombinatorStyle(this).StyleSet;
		}

		public virtual bool Equals(CssCombinatorsSelectorBase complexSelector)
		{
			return Key.Name == complexSelector.Key.Name;
		}

		public abstract void Apply(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator element, CssStyleSet styleSet);
	}
	internal class CssCombinatorSelector : CssCombinatorsSelectorBase
	{
		private CssSelector selectorCore;

		public CssSelector Selector => selectorCore;

		public CssCombinatorSelector(CssSelector key, CssSelector context, short weight)
			: base(key, weight)
		{
			selectorCore = context;
		}

		public override bool Equals(CssCombinatorsSelectorBase selector)
		{
			if (base.Equals(selector))
			{
				return EqualsCore(selector);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool EqualsCore(CssCombinatorsSelectorBase selector)
		{
			if (selector is CssCombinatorSelector)
			{
				return selectorCore.Equals(((CssCombinatorSelector)selector).selectorCore);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Apply(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator element, CssStyleSet styleSet)
		{
			if (element.Parent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IDxHtmlSupportCombinator dxHtmlSupportCombinator = element;
			if (selectorCore.Combinator.IsMatch(selectorCore, ref element))
			{
				if (selectorCore.PseudoClass != CssPseudoClass.Normal || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(selectorCore.CustomState))
				{
					dxHtmlSupportCombinator.AddCombinator(element, selectorCore, styleSet);
				}
				else
				{
					dxHtmlSupportCombinator.StyleSet.Merge(styleSet);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CsCombinatorsSelector : CssCombinatorsSelectorBase
	{
		private List<CssSelector> contextCore;

		public int Count => contextCore.Count;

		public CssSelector this[int index] => contextCore[index];

		public CsCombinatorsSelector(CssSelector key, List<CssSelector> context, short weight)
			: base(key, weight)
		{
			contextCore = new List<CssSelector>(context);
		}

		public override bool Equals(CssCombinatorsSelectorBase selector)
		{
			if (base.Equals(selector))
			{
				return EqualsCore(selector);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool EqualsCore(CssCombinatorsSelectorBase selector)
		{
			if (selector is CsCombinatorsSelector)
			{
				CsCombinatorsSelector csCombinatorsSelector = (CsCombinatorsSelector)selector;
				if (Count != csCombinatorsSelector.Count)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (!contextCore[i].Equals(csCombinatorsSelector[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Apply(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator element, CssStyleSet styleSet)
		{
			if (element.Parent == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<Tuple<CssSelector, IDxHtmlSupportCombinator>> list = new List<Tuple<CssSelector, IDxHtmlSupportCombinator>>();
			IDxHtmlSupportCombinator dxHtmlSupportCombinator = element;
			int num = contextCore.Count - 1;
			while (num > -1)
			{
				CssSelector cssSelector = contextCore[num];
				if (cssSelector.Combinator.IsMatch(cssSelector, ref element))
				{
					if (cssSelector.PseudoClass != CssPseudoClass.Normal || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(cssSelector.CustomState))
					{
						list.Add(new Tuple<CssSelector, IDxHtmlSupportCombinator>(cssSelector, element));
					}
					num--;
					continue;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				dxHtmlSupportCombinator.StyleSet.Merge(styleSet);
			}
			else
			{
				dxHtmlSupportCombinator.AddCombinator(list, styleSet);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CssSelectorManager
	{
		private List<CssSelectorBase> selectorsCore = new List<CssSelectorBase>();

		private List<CssSelector> combinatorsCore = new List<CssSelector>();

		private CssSelector combinatorCore;

		private CssSelectorBase selectorCore;

		private int combinatorCountCore;

		private int selectorCountCore;

		private short complexSelectorWeightCore;

		internal bool HasCombinators => combinatorCountCore > 0;

		public bool IsEmpty => selectorCountCore == 0;

		public void Add(CssSelector selector, short position)
		{
			selectorCountCore++;
			CssSelectorBase cssSelectorBase = selector;
			if (HasCombinators)
			{
				cssSelectorBase = CreateComplexSelector(selector);
			}
			if (selectorCore != null)
			{
				selectorsCore.Add(selectorCore);
			}
			cssSelectorBase.Position = position;
			selectorCore = cssSelectorBase;
		}

		public void AddCombinator(CssSelector selector, CssCombinator combinator)
		{
			combinatorCountCore++;
			complexSelectorWeightCore += selector.Weight;
			selector.Combinator = combinator;
			if (combinatorCore != null)
			{
				combinatorsCore.Add(combinatorCore);
			}
			combinatorCore = selector;
		}

		public void ApplyStyle(CssStyleSheet styleSheet, CssStyle style)
		{
			if (selectorCountCore > 1)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < selectorsCore.Count; i++)
				{
					ApplyStyleCore(styleSheet, style, selectorsCore[i]);
				}
				ApplyStyleCore(styleSheet, style, selectorCore);
			}
			Clear();
		}

		public CssStyle GetStyle(CssStyleSheet styleSheet, ref int weigth)
		{
			if (selectorCountCore == 1)
			{
				weigth = (selectorCore.Weight << 16) + selectorCore.Position;
				return selectorCore.GetOrCreateStyle(styleSheet);
			}
			return new CssStyle();
		}

		public void ClearCombinators()
		{
			if (HasCombinators)
			{
				combinatorCountCore = 0;
				complexSelectorWeightCore = 0;
				combinatorCore = null;
				combinatorsCore.Clear();
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			selectorCountCore = 0;
			selectorsCore.Clear();
			selectorCore = null;
			ClearCombinators();
		}

		private void ApplyStyleCore(CssStyleSheet styleSheet, CssStyle style, CssSelectorBase selector)
		{
			CssStyle orCreateStyle = selector.GetOrCreateStyle(styleSheet);
			orCreateStyle.Assign(style, (selector.Weight << 16) + selector.Position);
		}

		private CssSelectorBase CreateComplexSelector(CssSelector key)
		{
			CssCombinatorsSelectorBase cssCombinatorsSelectorBase = null;
			if (combinatorCountCore == 1)
			{
				cssCombinatorsSelectorBase = new CssCombinatorSelector(key, combinatorCore, complexSelectorWeightCore);
			}
			else
			{
				combinatorsCore.Add(combinatorCore);
				cssCombinatorsSelectorBase = new CsCombinatorsSelector(key, combinatorsCore, complexSelectorWeightCore);
			}
			ClearCombinators();
			return cssCombinatorsSelectorBase;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class CssCombinator
	{
		public abstract bool IsMatch(CssSelector selector, ref IDxHtmlSupportCombinator currentElement);
	}
	internal class CssDescendantCombinator : CssCombinator
	{
		public static readonly CssDescendantCombinator Combinator = new CssDescendantCombinator();

		public override bool IsMatch(CssSelector selector, ref IDxHtmlSupportCombinator currentElement)
		{
			currentElement = currentElement.Parent;
			while (!selector.IsMatch(currentElement))
			{
				currentElement = currentElement.Parent;
				if (currentElement == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class CssChildCombinator : CssCombinator
	{
		public static readonly CssChildCombinator Combinator = new CssChildCombinator();

		public override bool IsMatch(CssSelector selector, ref IDxHtmlSupportCombinator currentElement)
		{
			currentElement = currentElement.Parent;
			return selector.IsMatch(currentElement);
		}
	}
	internal class CssNextSiblingCombinator : CssCombinator
	{
		public static readonly CssNextSiblingCombinator Combinator = new CssNextSiblingCombinator();

		public override bool IsMatch(CssSelector selector, ref IDxHtmlSupportCombinator currentElement)
		{
			if (currentElement.Index == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IDxHtmlSupportCombinator parent = currentElement.Parent;
			IDxHtmlSupportCombinator dxHtmlSupportCombinator = parent[currentElement.Index - 1];
			if (dxHtmlSupportCombinator.SkipInCombinators)
			{
				if (currentElement.Index == 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				dxHtmlSupportCombinator = parent[currentElement.Index - 2];
			}
			currentElement = dxHtmlSupportCombinator;
			return selector.IsMatch(dxHtmlSupportCombinator);
		}
	}
	internal class CssSubsequentSiblingCombinator : CssCombinator
	{
		public static readonly CssSubsequentSiblingCombinator Combinator = new CssSubsequentSiblingCombinator();

		public override bool IsMatch(CssSelector selector, ref IDxHtmlSupportCombinator currentElement)
		{
			if (currentElement.Index == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IDxHtmlSupportCombinator parent = currentElement.Parent;
			for (int num = currentElement.Index - 1; num > -1; num--)
			{
				IDxHtmlSupportCombinator dxHtmlSupportCombinator = parent[num];
				if (selector.IsMatch(dxHtmlSupportCombinator))
				{
					currentElement = dxHtmlSupportCombinator;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class CssDynamicCondition
	{
		public readonly CssDynamicState Action;

		public readonly string CustomAction;

		public readonly int Index;

		public bool DefaultValue;

		public CssDynamicCondition(CssSelector selector, int index)
		{
			Index = index;
			Action = (CssDynamicState)selector.PseudoClass;
			CustomAction = selector.CustomState;
		}

		public bool Check(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			if (Action == CssDynamicState.Normal || (element.DynamicState & Action) != Action)
			{
				return CheckCustomAction(element);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckCustomAction(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			if (element.Internals == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(CustomAction))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return element.Internals.States.Has(CustomAction);
		}

		public void CheckDefault(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			DefaultValue = Check(element);
		}
	}
	internal class CssDynamicStyleSet
	{
		public readonly CssStyleSet StyleSet;

		public readonly DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicCondition> Condition;

		public CssDynamicStyleSet(DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicCondition> condition, CssStyleSet styleSet)
		{
			Condition = condition;
			StyleSet = styleSet;
		}
	}
	internal class CssConditionsManager
	{
		private Dictionary<int, CssConditionExecutorCollection> triggerConditionCollection;

		private int triggerCounter;

		public CssConditionsManager()
		{
			triggerConditionCollection = new Dictionary<int, CssConditionExecutorCollection>();
		}

		private CssConditionExecutorCollection GetExecutorCollection(int currentIndex, bool create = false)
		{
			if (currentIndex < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!triggerConditionCollection.TryGetValue(currentIndex, out var value) && create)
			{
				value = new CssConditionExecutorCollection();
				triggerConditionCollection.Add(currentIndex, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void RemoveCondition(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			int conditionIndex = element.ConditionIndex;
			CssConditionExecutorCollection executorCollection = GetExecutorCollection(conditionIndex);
			if (executorCollection != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < executorCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					Remove(executorCollection[i].Trigger, conditionIndex);
				}
			}
			triggerConditionCollection.Remove(conditionIndex);
		}

		private void Remove(CssConditionTrigger trigger, int currentIndex)
		{
			DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<int> conditionIndexes = trigger.ConditionIndexes;
			if (conditionIndexes.Count == 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < conditionIndexes.Count; i++)
			{
				int num = conditionIndexes[i];
				if (num != currentIndex)
				{
					if (triggerConditionCollection.TryGetValue(currentIndex, out var value))
					{
						value.Remove(trigger);
					}
					if (value.Count == 0)
					{
						triggerConditionCollection.Remove(num);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool RefreshCondition(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			List<DxHtmlElement> list = new List<DxHtmlElement>();
			if (element.ConditionIndex > 0)
			{
				triggerConditionCollection.Remove(element.ConditionIndex);
			}
			DxHtmlNodeList childNodes = element.ParentElement.ChildNodes;
			DxHtmlElementIterator dxHtmlElementIterator = new DxHtmlElementIterator();
			dxHtmlElementIterator.Prepare(element, childNodes);
			while (dxHtmlElementIterator.MoveNext())
			{
				DxHtmlElement currentElement = dxHtmlElementIterator.CurrentElement;
				if (currentElement.ConditionIndex > -1)
				{
					triggerConditionCollection.Remove(currentElement.ConditionIndex);
				}
				if (currentElement.Tag.HasCombinators)
				{
					list.Add(currentElement);
				}
			}
			element.ResetStyleSet();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (DxHtmlElement item in list)
			{
				item.ResetStyleSet();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Register(DxHtmlElement element, DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<CssDynamicStyleSet> inputCollection)
		{
			if (inputCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (CssDynamicStyleSet item in inputCollection)
			{
				CssConditionTrigger cssConditionTrigger = new CssConditionTrigger(element, item.StyleSet, triggerCounter++);
				foreach (CssDynamicCondition item2 in item.Condition)
				{
					cssConditionTrigger.ConditionIndexes.Add(item2.Index);
					GetExecutorCollection(item2.Index, create: true).Add(new CssConditionExecutor(item2, cssConditionTrigger));
				}
			}
		}

		public void CheckChanges(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			GetExecutorCollection(element.ConditionIndex)?.Execute(element);
		}
	}
	internal class CssConditionExecutorCollection
	{
		private List<CssConditionExecutor> innerListCore = new List<CssConditionExecutor>();

		public int Count => innerListCore.Count;

		public CssConditionExecutor this[int index] => innerListCore[index];

		public void Add(CssConditionExecutor conditionExecutor)
		{
			innerListCore.Add(conditionExecutor);
		}

		public void Execute(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < innerListCore.Count; i++)
			{
				innerListCore[i].Execute(element);
			}
		}

		public void Remove(CssConditionTrigger trigger)
		{
			for (int num = Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
			{
				if (innerListCore[num].Trigger == trigger)
				{
					innerListCore.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CssConditionExecutor
	{
		private CssConditionTrigger triggerCore;

		private CssDynamicCondition conditionCore;

		private bool resultCore;

		public CssConditionTrigger Trigger => triggerCore;

		public CssConditionExecutor(CssDynamicCondition condition, CssConditionTrigger trigger)
		{
			conditionCore = condition;
			triggerCore = trigger;
			ExecuteCore(condition.DefaultValue);
		}

		public void Execute(DxHtmlElement element)
		{
			ExecuteCore(conditionCore.Check(element));
		}

		private void ExecuteCore(bool value)
		{
			if (value != resultCore)
			{
				resultCore = value;
				triggerCore.Trigger(value);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CssConditionTrigger
	{
		private DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<int> conditionIndexesCore;

		private CssStyleSet styleSetCore;

		private bool enabledCore;

		private int resultCore;

		private int keyCore;

		private DxHtmlElement elementCore;

		public DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<int> ConditionIndexes => conditionIndexesCore;

		public CssConditionTrigger(DxHtmlElement element, CssStyleSet style, int key)
		{
			elementCore = element;
			styleSetCore = style;
			resultCore = 0;
			keyCore = key;
			conditionIndexesCore = new DxHtmlReadOnlyCollection<int>();
			enabledCore = false;
		}

		public void Trigger(bool value)
		{
			resultCore += (value ? 1 : (-1));
			bool flag = resultCore == conditionIndexesCore.Count;
			if (enabledCore != flag)
			{
				enabledCore = flag;
				if (flag)
				{
					elementCore.ActivateStyleSet(styleSetCore, keyCore);
				}
				else
				{
					elementCore.DeactivateStyleSet(keyCore);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class DxHtmlEvent : IEquatable<DxHtmlEvent>
	{
		private Delegate eventCore;

		private int argsCountCore;

		public DxHtmlEvent(Delegate @event, int argsCount)
		{
			eventCore = @event;
			argsCountCore = argsCount;
		}

		public void Invoke(object sender, DxHtmlElementEventArgs e)
		{
			if (argsCountCore == 2)
			{
				((Action<object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs>)eventCore)(sender, e);
			}
			else if (argsCountCore == 1)
			{
				((Action<DxHtmlElementEventArgs>)eventCore)(e);
			}
			else
			{
				((Action)eventCore)();
			}
		}

		public bool Equals(DxHtmlEvent other)
		{
			return eventCore == other.eventCore;
		}
	}

		public static System.Windows.Forms.Control FindContainer(System.Windows.Forms.Control control)
		{
			while (control != null)
			{
				if (control is Form || control is System.Windows.Forms.UserControl)
				{
					return control;
				}
				control = control.Parent;
			}
			return null;
		}

	internal class DxHtmlActionWithTwoArgsExpression : DxHtmlActionExpression
	{
		protected override string Key => "SenderEvent";

		public DxHtmlActionWithTwoArgsExpression(string methodName)
			: base(methodName)
		{
		}

		public override Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs> Compile(object container, MethodInfo mi)
		{
			if (mi == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod("", typeof(void), new Type[3]
			{
				typeof(object),
				typeof(object),
				typeof(DxHtmlElementEventArgs)
			}, container.GetType(), skipVisibility: true);
			ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_1);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_2);
			Type parameterType = mi.GetParameters()[1].ParameterType;
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Castclass, parameterType);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Call, mi);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Nop);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
			return (Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs>)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs>));
		}
	}

	internal class DxHtmlActionExpression : IEquatable<DxHtmlActionExpression>
	{

		public readonly string Name;

		protected virtual string Key => string.Empty;

		public DxHtmlActionExpression(string methodName)
		{

		}

		public virtual Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs> Compile(object container, MethodInfo mi)
		{
			if (mi == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod("", typeof(void), new Type[3]
			{
				typeof(object),
				typeof(object),
				typeof(DxHtmlElementEventArgs)
			}, container.GetType(), skipVisibility: true);
			ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ldarg_0);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Call, mi);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Nop);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
			return (Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs>)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs>));
		}

		public bool Equals(DxHtmlActionExpression other)
		{
			return other.Name == Name;
		}

	internal class DxHtmlEventBinder
	{
		private sealed class DxHtmlEntry : IEquatable<DxHtmlEntry>
		{
			private static Type argsType = typeof(DxHtmlElementEventArgs);

			private static Type senderType = typeof(object);

			private readonly Type typeCore;

			private Dictionary<string, MethodInfo> methodsInfoCacheCore;

			private Dictionary<string, Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs>> delegateCacheCore;

			public DxHtmlEntry(Type type)
			{
				typeCore = type;
				FillHandlers();
			}

			public bool TryGetDelegate(DxHtmlActionExpression expression, out Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs> @delegate)
			{
				if (delegateCacheCore == null)
				{
					@delegate = null;
					return false;
				}
				return delegateCacheCore.TryGetValue(expression.Name, out @delegate);
			}

			public Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs> GetDelegate(object container, DxHtmlActionExpression expression)
			{
				return GetDelegateCore(container, expression);
			}

			private Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs> GetDelegateCore(object container, DxHtmlActionExpression expression)
			{
				if (methodsInfoCacheCore.Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (delegateCacheCore == null)
				{
					delegateCacheCore = new Dictionary<string, Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs>>();
				}
				if (methodsInfoCacheCore.TryGetValue(expression.Name, out var value))
				{
					Action<object, object, DxHtmlElementEventArgs> action = expression.Compile(container, value);
					delegateCacheCore.Add(expression.Name, action);
					return action;
				}
				return null;
			}

			private void FillHandlers()
			{
				methodsInfoCacheCore = new Dictionary<string, MethodInfo>();
				MethodInfo[] methods = typeCore.GetMethods(BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
				foreach (MethodInfo methodInfo in methods)
				{
					ParameterInfo[] parameters = methodInfo.GetParameters();
					if (parameters.Length > 2)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (parameters.Length == 0)
					{
						methodsInfoCacheCore.Add(methodInfo.Name, methodInfo);
					}
					else if (parameters.Length == 1)
					{
						if (argsType.IsAssignableFrom(parameters[0].ParameterType))
						{
							methodsInfoCacheCore.Add("Event" + methodInfo.Name, methodInfo);
						}
					}
					else if (parameters[0].ParameterType == senderType && argsType.IsAssignableFrom(parameters[1].ParameterType))
					{
						methodsInfoCacheCore.Add("SenderEvent" + methodInfo.Name, methodInfo);
					}
				}
			}

			public bool Equals(DxHtmlEntry other)
			{
				if (other != null)
				{
					return typeCore == other.typeCore;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public sealed override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				return Equals(obj as DxHtmlEntry);
			}

			public sealed override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return typeCore.MetadataToken;
			}
		}

		private DxHtmlEntry entryCore;

		private object containerCore;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<Type, DxHtmlEntry> typeHandlersEntriesCore;

		public DxHtmlEventBinder(object container)
		{
			containerCore = container;
			if (containerCore != null)
			{
				entryCore = EnsureHandlersEntry(container.GetType());
			}
		}

		public void DoDelegate(object sender, DxHtmlElementEventArgs e, DxHtmlActionExpression expression)
		{
			if (entryCore != null)
			{
				if (!entryCore.TryGetDelegate(expression, out var @delegate))
				{
					@delegate = entryCore.GetDelegate(containerCore, expression);
				}
				@delegate?.Invoke(containerCore, sender, e);
			}
		}

		private static DxHtmlEntry EnsureHandlersEntry(Type containerType)
		{
			if (typeHandlersEntriesCore == null)
			{
				typeHandlersEntriesCore = new Dictionary<Type, DxHtmlEntry>();
			}
			if (!typeHandlersEntriesCore.TryGetValue(containerType, out var value))
			{
				typeHandlersEntriesCore.Add(containerType, value = new DxHtmlEntry(containerType));
			}
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfoCollection : DxHtmlChildInfoCollectionBase
	{
		private List<DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo> childNodeCore;

		private int firstLogicalItemIndexCore;

		private int lastLogicalItemIndexCore;

		private bool recalcLogicalIndixesCore;

		public new DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo this[int index] => base[index] as DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo;

		public override int Length => childNodeCore.Count;

		public override int FirstLogicalItemIndex
		{
			get

				if (recalcLogicalIndixesCore)

	internal abstract class DxHtmlElementLayoutInfo
	{
		public readonly bool IsDirectXPaint;

		public readonly CssDisplay Display;

		public readonly SizeF ScaleFactor;

		public bool IsReady;

		public DxHtmlElementLayoutInfo(CssDisplay display, SizeF scaleFactor, bool isDirectXPaint)
		{
			Display = display;
			ScaleFactor = scaleFactor;
			IsDirectXPaint = isDirectXPaint;
		}

		public bool IsValidFor(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
			if (Display == elementInfo.Style.Display && ScaleFactor == elementInfo.RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor)
			{
				return elementInfo.RootElementInfo.UseDirectX == IsDirectXPaint;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			OnClear();
			IsReady = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnClear()
		{
		}
	}
	internal class DxHtmlElementSpanLayoutInfo
	{
		public DxHtmlElementInfoBase ElementInfo { get; }

		public DxHtmlElementInlineInfo StartItem { get; set; }

		public List<DxHtmlElementInlineInfo> WrapItems { get; set; }

		public DxHtmlElementInlineInfo EndItem { get; set; }

		public DxHtmlElementSpanLayoutInfo(DxHtmlElementInfoBase elementInfo)
		{
			ElementInfo = elementInfo;
			WrapItems = new List<DxHtmlElementInlineInfo>();
		}

		public void Calc(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ae: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rectangle absoluteBounds = StartItem.ElementInfo.AbsoluteBounds;
			PortablePadding margin = StartItem.ElementInfo.Margin;
			int left = ((PortablePadding)(ref margin)).Left;
			margin = ElementInfo.Margin;
			int num = left - ((PortablePadding)(ref margin)).Left;
			absoluteBounds.Offset(-num, 0);
			for (int i = 0; i <= WrapItems.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlElementInlineInfo dxHtmlElementInlineInfo = ((i == WrapItems.Count) ? EndItem : WrapItems[i]);
				Rectangle absoluteBounds2 = dxHtmlElementInlineInfo.ElementInfo.AbsoluteBounds;
				if (dxHtmlElementInlineInfo == EndItem)
				{
					margin = EndItem.ElementInfo.Margin;
					int right = ((PortablePadding)(ref margin)).Right;
					margin = ElementInfo.Margin;
					int num2 = right - ((PortablePadding)(ref margin)).Right;
					absoluteBounds2.Width += num2;
				}
				Rectangle lineBounds = dxHtmlElementInlineInfo.LineBounds;
				int num3 = ((i == 0) ? absoluteBounds.X : lineBounds.X);
				Rectangle absoluteRect = new Rectangle(num3, lineBounds.Y, absoluteBounds2.Right - num3, lineBounds.Height);
				DxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo dxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo = new DxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo(ElementInfo, ElementInfo.GetRelativeRect(absoluteRect));
				dxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo.StartItem = dxHtmlElementInlineInfo.LineStartElementInfo ?? StartItem.ElementInfo;
				if (WrapItems.Count > 0)
				{
					if (i == 0)
					{
						dxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo.Type = DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition.Start;
					}
					else if (i == WrapItems.Count)
					{
						dxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo.Type = DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition.End;
					}
					else
					{
						dxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo.Type = DxHtmlElementSpanItemPosition.Inside;
					}
				}
				dxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo.Calc(cache, args);
				ElementInfo.SpanItems.Add(dxHtmlElementSpanItemInfo);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class DxHtmlElementLayoutRepository
	{
		private static DxHtmlFlowLayout defaultLayoutCore = new DxHtmlFlowLayout();

		private static DxHtmlTableLayout tableLayoutCore = new DxHtmlTableLayout();

		private static DxHtmlListItemLayout listItemLayoutCore = new DxHtmlListItemLayout();

		private static DxHtmlFlexLayout flexLayoutCore = new DxHtmlFlexLayout();

		public static DxHtmlElementLayout Get(DxHtmlElementInfoBase info)
		{
			switch (info.Style.Display)
			{
			case CssDisplay.ListItem:
				return listItemLayoutCore;
			case CssDisplay.InlineTable:
			case CssDisplay.Table:
				return tableLayoutCore;
			case CssDisplay.Flex:
			case CssDisplay.InlineFlex:
				return flexLayoutCore;
			default:
				return GetDefault();
			}
		}

		public static DxHtmlElementLayout GetDefault()
		{
			return defaultLayoutCore;
		}
	}
	internal class DxHtmlElementPainterRepository
	{
		private static DxHtmlImagePainter imagePainterCore = new DxHtmlImagePainter();

		private static DxHtmlListPainter listPainterCore = new DxHtmlListPainter();

		private static DxHtmlTextElementPainter textPainterCore = new DxHtmlTextElementPainter();

		private static DxHtmlInputPainter inputPainterCore = new DxHtmlInputPainter();

		private static DxHtmlElementPainter defaultPainterCore = new DxHtmlElementPainter();

		public static DxHtmlElementPainter Get(DxHtmlElementInfoBase info)
		{
			switch (info.Element.NodeName)
			{
			case "text":
				return textPainterCore;
			case "ol":
			case "ul":
				return listPainterCore;
			case "img":
				return imagePainterCore;
			case "input":
				return inputPainterCore;
			default:
				return GetDefault();
			}
		}

		public static DxHtmlElementPainter GetDefault()
		{
			return defaultPainterCore;
		}
	}
	internal class DxHtmlSelectionHandler
	{
		private bool inProcess;

		private System.Drawing.Point startPoint;

		private DxHtmlHandler owner;

		private DxHtmlElementBase startElement;

		private DxHtmlElementBase currentElement;

		private DxHtmlElementBase prevHoveredElement;

		private DxHtmlSelectionRange currentRange;

		public bool InProcess => inProcess;

		private DxHtmlHitInfo HoveredHitInfo => owner.HoveredHitInfo;

		public DxHtmlSelectionHandler(DxHtmlHandler handler)
		{
			owner = handler;
			currentRange = DxHtmlSelectionRange.Empty;
		}

		public void RestoreStateFrom(DxHtmlRootElement root)
		{
			startElement = root.Selection.GetStartElement();
			currentElement = startElement;
		}

		public void OnMouseDown(DxHtmlRootElement root, DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!root.ViewInfo.SelectionSupported || e.Button != MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				return;
			}
			(startElement?.RootElement)?.Selection.Clear();
			root.Selection.Clear();
			DxHtmlElementBase dxHtmlElementBase = hitInfo.ActualElement ?? root.Body;
			if (dxHtmlElementBase == null || dxHtmlElementBase.ViewInfo.UserSelect == CssUserSelect.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			root.Selection.SelectionMode = TextSelectionMode.Character;
			DxHtmlElementBase startCandidate = ChooseElement(dxHtmlElementBase, hitInfo.Location);
			if (CanStartSelection(startCandidate))
			{
				startElement = startCandidate;
				currentElement = startElement;
				startPoint = hitInfo.Location;
				inProcess = true;
				if (e.Clicks > 1)
				{
					root.Selection.SelectionMode = TextSelectionMode.Word;
					currentRange.Set(startElement, currentElement);
					root.Selection.Select(currentRange, startPoint, startPoint);
				}
				startPoint.Offset(-root.ViewInfo.X, -root.ViewInfo.Y);
			}
		}

		private bool CanStartSelection(DxHtmlElementBase startCandidate)
		{
			if (startCandidate.ViewInfo.Selectable && startCandidate.ViewInfo.CanStartSelection)
			{
				return startCandidate.RootElement.Callback.GetAllowSelectionStart(startCandidate);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void OnMouseUp(DxHtmlRootElement root, DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (root.ViewInfo.SelectionSupported && inProcess && e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				inProcess = false;
				if (currentElement != null)
				{
					SetCursor(currentElement);
				}
				currentElement = null;
			}
		}

		public void OnMouseMove(DxHtmlRootElement root, DxHtmlHitInfo hitInfo, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!root.ViewInfo.SelectionSupported)
			{
				return;
			}
			DxHtmlElementBase dxHtmlElementBase = hitInfo.ActualElement ?? root.Body;
			if (inProcess && dxHtmlElementBase != null)
			{
				if (startElement.RootElement == root)
				{
					currentElement = ChooseElement(dxHtmlElementBase, hitInfo.Location);
				}
				else
				{
					root = startElement.RootElement;
				}
				currentRange.Set(startElement, currentElement);
				System.Drawing.Point point = new System.Drawing.Point(startPoint.X + root.ViewInfo.X, startPoint.Y + root.ViewInfo.Y);
				root.Selection.Select(currentRange, point, hitInfo.Location);
			}
			DxHtmlElementBase dxHtmlElementBase2 = HoveredHitInfo?.ActualElement;
			if (dxHtmlElementBase2 != prevHoveredElement)
			{
				SetCursor(dxHtmlElementBase2);
			}
			prevHoveredElement = dxHtmlElementBase2;
		}

		public void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			prevHoveredElement = null;
		}

		private void SetCursor(DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			owner.Callback.SetCursor(element);
		}

		private DxHtmlElementBase ChooseElement(DxHtmlElementBase current, System.Drawing.Point pt)
		{
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase viewInfo = current.ViewInfo;
			if (viewInfo.IsTextElement)
			{
				return current;
			}
			pt = viewInfo.ParentElementInfo.GetRelativePoint(pt);
			return FindClosestElement(viewInfo, pt)?.Element ?? current;
		}

		private DxHtmlElementInfoBase FindClosestElement(DxHtmlElementInfoBase element, System.Drawing.Point point)
		{
			if (!element.IsDisplayed)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (element.IsTextElement)
			{
				return element;
			}
			point.Offset(-element.X, -element.Y);
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase dxHtmlElementInfoBase = element.FindClosestChild(point);
			if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase != element)
			{
				dxHtmlElementInfoBase = FindClosestElement(dxHtmlElementInfoBase, point);
			}
			if (dxHtmlElementInfoBase is DxHtmlTextLineBlockInfo)
			{
				dxHtmlElementInfoBase = dxHtmlElementInfoBase.ParentElementInfo;
			}
			return dxHtmlElementInfoBase;
		}
	}
	internal enum TextSelectionMode
	{
		Character,
		Word
	}
	public interface IDxHtmlSelection
	{
		bool IsEmpty { get; }

		DxHtmlSelectionRange Current { get; set; }

		void Clear();
	}
	public struct DxHtmlSelectionRange
	{
		private static DxHtmlSelectionRange empty = new DxHtmlSelectionRange(0, 0, null, null);

		private bool isForwardDirection;

		private int startPlainIndex;

		private int endPlainIndex;

		private int? startCaretPosition;

		private int? endCaretPosition;

		public static DxHtmlSelectionRange Empty => empty;

		public bool IsEmpty => Equals(this, Empty);

		internal bool IsForwardDirection => isForwardDirection;

		internal int StartElementPlainIndex => startPlainIndex;

		internal int EndElementPlainIndex => endPlainIndex;

		internal int? StartCaretPosition => startCaretPosition;

		internal int? EndCaretPosition => endCaretPosition;

		private static bool Equals(DxHtmlSelectionRange first, DxHtmlSelectionRange second)
		{
			if (first.startPlainIndex == second.startPlainIndex && first.endPlainIndex == second.endPlainIndex && first.startCaretPosition == second.startCaretPosition)
			{
				return first.endCaretPosition == second.endCaretPosition;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public DxHtmlSelectionRange(DxHtmlElementBase start, DxHtmlElementBase end)
			: this(start.PlainIndex, end.PlainIndex, null, null)
		{
		}

		public DxHtmlSelectionRange(DxHtmlElementBase start, DxHtmlElementBase end, int startCaretPosition, int endCaretPosition)
			: this(start.PlainIndex, end.PlainIndex, startCaretPosition, endCaretPosition)
		{
		}

		private DxHtmlSelectionRange(int startElementPlainIndex, int endElementPlainIndex, int? startCaretPosition, int? endCaretPosition)
		{
			isForwardDirection = false;
			startPlainIndex = (endPlainIndex = 0);
			this.startCaretPosition = (this.endCaretPosition = null);
			SetCore(startElementPlainIndex, endElementPlainIndex, startCaretPosition, endCaretPosition);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(DxHtmlSelectionRange first, DxHtmlSelectionRange second)
		{
			return Equals(first, second);
		}

		public static bool operator !=(DxHtmlSelectionRange first, DxHtmlSelectionRange second)
		{
			return !(first == second);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is DxHtmlSelectionRange))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Equals(this, (DxHtmlSelectionRange)obj);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return HashCodeHelper.CalcHashCode(new int[4]
			{
				startPlainIndex,
				endPlainIndex,
				startCaretPosition.GetHashCode(),
				endCaretPosition.GetHashCode()
			});
		}

		internal void EnsureCaretPositions(DxHtmlElementBase start, DxHtmlElementBase end)
		{
			DxHtmlTextElementInfo dxHtmlTextElementInfo = start.ViewInfo as DxHtmlTextElementInfo;
			DxHtmlTextElementInfo dxHtmlTextElementInfo2 = end.ViewInfo as DxHtmlTextElementInfo;
			bool flag = dxHtmlTextElementInfo == dxHtmlTextElementInfo2;
			if (dxHtmlTextElementInfo != null && dxHtmlTextElementInfo.SelectionLength > 0)
			{
				startCaretPosition = dxHtmlTextElementInfo.SelectionStart;
			}
			else
			{
				startCaretPosition = null;
			}
			if (dxHtmlTextElementInfo2 != null && dxHtmlTextElementInfo2.SelectionLength > 0)
			{
				endCaretPosition = (flag ? (dxHtmlTextElementInfo2.SelectionStart + dxHtmlTextElementInfo2.SelectionLength) : dxHtmlTextElementInfo2.SelectionLength);
			}
			else
			{
				endCaretPosition = null;
			}
		}

		internal void Set(DxHtmlElementBase start, DxHtmlElementBase end)
		{
			int plainIndex = start.PlainIndex;
			int plainIndex2 = end.PlainIndex;
			SetCore(plainIndex, plainIndex2, null, null);
		}

		private void SetCore(int startPlainIndex, int endPlainIndex, int? startCaretPosition, int? endCaretPosition)
		{
			isForwardDirection = startPlainIndex <= endPlainIndex;
			if (isForwardDirection)
			{
				this.startCaretPosition = startCaretPosition;
				this.startPlainIndex = startPlainIndex;
				this.endPlainIndex = endPlainIndex;
				this.endCaretPosition = endCaretPosition;
			}
			else
			{
				this.startCaretPosition = endCaretPosition;
				this.startPlainIndex = endPlainIndex;
				this.endPlainIndex = startPlainIndex;
				this.endCaretPosition = startCaretPosition;
			}
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlSelection : IDxHtmlSelection
	{
		private string text;

		private DxHtmlRootElement root;

		private List<DxHtmlElementBase> elements;

		private DxHtmlNodeIterator nodesIterator;

		private System.Drawing.Point startPoint;

		private System.Drawing.Point endPoint;

		private DxHtmlSelectionRange range;

		internal TextSelectionMode SelectionMode;

		public string Text => text ?? (text = GetSelectedText());

		public bool IsEmpty => elements.Count == 0;

		internal System.Drawing.Point StartPoint => startPoint;

		internal System.Drawing.Point EndPoint => endPoint;

		internal int? StartCaretPosition => range.StartCaretPosition;

		internal int? EndCaretPosition => range.EndCaretPosition;

		DxHtmlSelectionRange IDxHtmlSelection.Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsEmpty)
				{
					return range;
				}
				return DxHtmlSelectionRange.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				Select(value);
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlSelection(DxHtmlRootElement root)
		{
			this.root = root;
			range = DxHtmlSelectionRange.Empty;
			nodesIterator = new DxHtmlNodeIterator();
			elements = new List<DxHtmlElementBase>();
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (ClearCore())
			{
				root.Callback.OnSelectionChanged(root);
			}
		}

		private bool ClearCore()
		{
			text = null;
			range = DxHtmlSelectionRange.Empty;
			if (!IsEmpty)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < elements.Count; i++)
				{
					DxHtmlElementBase dxHtmlElementBase = elements[i];
					if (dxHtmlElementBase.RootElement != null)
					{
						dxHtmlElementBase.SelectContent(value: false);
					}
				}
				elements.Clear();
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void CalcSelectionBounds()
		{
			if (IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < elements.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlElementBase dxHtmlElementBase = elements[i];
				if (dxHtmlElementBase.RootElement != null)
				{
					dxHtmlElementBase.ViewInfo.CalcSelectionBounds();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsBackwardRelativeTo(DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			if (!IsStartElement(element))
			{
				return range.EndElementPlainIndex > range.StartElementPlainIndex;
			}
			return range.EndElementPlainIndex < range.StartElementPlainIndex;
		}

		internal bool IsStartElement(DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			return element.PlainIndex == range.StartElementPlainIndex;
		}

		internal bool IsEndElement(DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			return element.PlainIndex == range.EndElementPlainIndex;
		}

		internal bool HasCaretPosition(DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			if (!IsStartElement(element) || !StartCaretPosition.HasValue)
			{
				if (IsEndElement(element))
				{
					return EndCaretPosition.HasValue;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal int GetCaretPosition(DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			if (IsStartElement(element) && StartCaretPosition.HasValue)
			{
				return StartCaretPosition.Value;
			}
			if (IsEndElement(element) && EndCaretPosition.HasValue)
			{
				return EndCaretPosition.Value;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal bool QuerySelectAll(DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			bool flag = IsStartElement(element);
			bool flag2 = IsEndElement(element);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return !flag2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool InsideElement(DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			bool flag = IsStartElement(element);
			bool flag2 = IsEndElement(element);
			return flag && flag2;
		}

		internal System.Drawing.Point QueryCursorPoint(DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			if (!IsStartElement(element))
			{
				return endPoint;
			}
			return startPoint;
		}

		internal DxHtmlElementBase GetStartElement()
		{
			if (!IsEmpty)
			{
				return elements[0];
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal DxHtmlElementBase GetEndElement()
		{
			if (!IsEmpty)
			{
				return elements[elements.Count - 1];
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void Select(DxHtmlSelectionRange range, System.Drawing.Point startPoint, System.Drawing.Point endPoint)
		{
			ClearCore();
			DxHtmlSelectionRange dxHtmlSelectionRange = this.range;
			this.range = range;
			this.startPoint = (range.IsForwardDirection ? startPoint : endPoint);
			this.endPoint = (range.IsForwardDirection ? endPoint : startPoint);
			SelectElements(range.StartElementPlainIndex, range.EndElementPlainIndex);
			this.range.EnsureCaretPositions(elements[0], elements[elements.Count - 1]);
			if (this.range != dxHtmlSelectionRange)
			{
				root.Callback.OnSelectionChanged(root);
			}
		}

		internal void Select(DxHtmlSelectionRange range)
		{
			Rectangle absoluteBounds = root.AbsoluteBounds;
			System.Drawing.Point empty = System.Drawing.Point.Empty;
			System.Drawing.Point point = new System.Drawing.Point(absoluteBounds.Right, absoluteBounds.Bottom);
			Select(range, empty, point);
		}

		private void SelectElements(int from, int to)
		{
			nodesIterator.Prepare(root.Body, root.ChildNodes);
			while (nodesIterator.MoveNext())
			{
				DxHtmlNode currentNode = nodesIterator.CurrentNode;
				DxHtmlNodeType nodeType = currentNode.NodeType;
				if (nodeType <= DxHtmlNodeType.WhitespaceNode || nodeType >= DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
				{
					DxHtmlElementBase dxHtmlElementBase = nodesIterator.CurrentNode as DxHtmlElementBase;
					int plainIndex = dxHtmlElementBase.PlainIndex;
					if (plainIndex >= from && plainIndex <= to)
					{
						elements.Add(dxHtmlElementBase);
						dxHtmlElementBase.SelectContent(value: true);
					}
				}
			}
			nodesIterator.Clear();
		}

		private string GetSelectedText()
		{
			if (IsEmpty)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < elements.Count; i++)
			{
				AppendText(stringBuilder, elements[i]);
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private void AppendText(StringBuilder sb, DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			if (TryGetSelectedText(element, out var value))
			{
				sb.Append(value);
			}
		}

		private bool TryGetSelectedText(DxHtmlElementBase element, out string text)
		{
			DxHtmlElementInfoBase viewInfo = element.ViewInfo;
			text = null;
			if (!viewInfo.IsTextElement || !viewInfo.CanSelectContent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(viewInfo is DxHtmlTextElementInfo dxHtmlTextElementInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dxHtmlTextElementInfo.SelectionLength == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			text = dxHtmlTextElementInfo.TextInfo.GetSubstring(dxHtmlTextElementInfo.SelectionStart, dxHtmlTextElementInfo.SelectionLength);
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class DxHtmlSelectionStateHolder
	{
		private string selectedText;

		private DxHtmlContextBase htmlContext;

		private int stateKey = -1;

		private DxHtmlSelectionRange range = DxHtmlSelectionRange.Empty;

		public string SelectedText => selectedText;

		public DxHtmlSelectionStateHolder(DxHtmlContextBase htmlContext)
		{
			this.htmlContext = htmlContext;
			selectedText = string.Empty;
		}

		public void Save(DxHtmlRootElement root, int stateKey)
		{
			DxHtmlSelectionRange selection = htmlContext.GetSelection(root);
			if (!selection.IsEmpty)
			{
				selectedText = root.Selection.Text;
				range = selection;
				this.stateKey = stateKey;
			}
		}

		public bool Restore(DxHtmlRootElement root, int stateKey)
		{
			if (this.stateKey != stateKey || range.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			htmlContext.RestoreSelection(root, range);
			Clear();
			return true;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			selectedText = string.Empty;
			stateKey = -1;
			range = DxHtmlSelectionRange.Empty;
		}
	}

		public override bool IsSelfClosing => true;

		public InputTag()
			: base("input", CssDisplay.InlineBlock)

		{
			return parser.ParseInputTagAttributes(this, ch, mode, value);

		{
			return new InputTag();

		{
			InputTag inputTag = (InputTag)source;
			ControlType = CloneAttributeValue(inputTag.ControlType);
			ControlName = CloneAttributeValue(inputTag.ControlName);
			Alt = CloneAttributeValue(inputTag.Alt);
			Value = CloneAttributeValue(inputTag.Value);
			base.AssignCore(source);
		}

	internal class TextElementTag : DxHtmlDocumentTag
	{
		public string Text;

		public string[] Fields;

		internal HtmlTextType TextType;

		private Type[] fieldTypes;

		private bool fieldTypesChanged;

		private bool hasInvalidFieldsFormat;

		private bool? hasInvalidFormat;

		public TextElementTag()
			: base("text", CssDisplay.Inline)
		{
		}

		public string GetText(IDxHtmlClient client, DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			HtmlTextType textType = TextType;
			string text = ((textType != HtmlTextType.Field) ? GetTextCore(client, element) : client.GetDisplayValue(Fields[0], element));
			return text ?? string.Empty;
		}

		private string GetTextCore(IDxHtmlClient client, DxHtmlElementBase element)
		{
			if (Fields == null || Fields.Length == 0 || (hasInvalidFormat.HasValue && hasInvalidFormat.Value))
			{
				return Text;
			}
			try
			{
				if (!hasInvalidFormat.HasValue)
				{
					string text = Text;
					object[] fields = Fields;
					string.Format(text, fields);
					hasInvalidFormat = false;
				}
				string formattedText = GetFormattedText(client, element);
				if (hasInvalidFieldsFormat)
				{
					hasInvalidFieldsFormat = !fieldTypesChanged;
				}
				return formattedText;
			}
			catch (FormatException)
			{
				if (!hasInvalidFormat.HasValue)
				{
					hasInvalidFormat = true;
					return Text;
				}
				hasInvalidFieldsFormat = true;
				return GetFormattedText(client, element, getDisplayValue: true);
			}
		}

		private string GetFormattedText(IDxHtmlClient client, DxHtmlElementBase element, bool getDisplayValue = false)
		{
			int num = Fields.Length;
			if (fieldTypes == null)
			{
				fieldTypes = new Type[num];
			}
			fieldTypesChanged = false;
			if (num < 4)
			{
				return num switch
				{
					1 => string.Format(Text, GetFieldValue(client, 0, element, getDisplayValue)), 
					2 => string.Format(Text, GetFieldValue(client, 0, element, getDisplayValue), GetFieldValue(client, 1, element, getDisplayValue)), 
					_ => string.Format(Text, GetFieldValue(client, 0, element, getDisplayValue), GetFieldValue(client, 1, element, getDisplayValue), GetFieldValue(client, 2, element, getDisplayValue)), 
				};
			}
			object[] array = new object[num];
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				array[i] = GetFieldValue(client, i, element, getDisplayValue);
			}
			return string.Format(Text, array);
		}

		private object GetFieldValue(IDxHtmlClient client, int fieldIndex, DxHtmlElementBase element, bool getDisplayValue)
		{
			string fieldName = Fields[fieldIndex];
			if (getDisplayValue)
			{
				return client.GetDisplayValue(fieldName, element);
			}
			object obj = client.GetValue(fieldName, element);
			Type type = obj?.GetType();
			if (hasInvalidFieldsFormat)
			{
				Type type2 = fieldTypes[fieldIndex];
				if (type == type2)
				{
					obj = client.GetDisplayValue(fieldName, element);
				}
				if (type2 != type)
				{
					fieldTypesChanged = true;
				}
			}
			fieldTypes[fieldIndex] = type;
			return obj ?? string.Empty;
		}

		internal override DxHtmlElementBase CreateElement(DxHtmlDocumentNode node)
		{
			return new DxHtmlTextElement(node);
		}

		protected override DxHtmlDocumentTag CloneCore()
		{
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}

		private Dictionary<string, DxHtmlObjectAttribute> customAttributesCore = new Dictionary<string, DxHtmlObjectAttribute>();

		internal CssStyleSet StyleSet;

		internal DxHtmlDictionary<string, CssStyleSet> ClassStyleSets;

		internal int BindableAttributeCount;

		internal CssStyleSet IdStyleSet;

		public DxHtmlStringAttribute Id = DxHtmlAttributeDefaultValues.Id;

		public DxHtmlActionExpression OnKeyPress;

		public static DxHtmlDocumentTag EmptyTag => emptyTagCore;

		public virtual bool IsSelfClosing => false;

		public string Name => nameCore;

		public bool HasBinding => BindableAttributeCount > 0;

		public bool HasCombinators
		{
			get
			{
				if (IdStyleSet != null && IdStyleSet.CombinatorStyleSetCollection != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ClassStyleSets != null)
				{
					foreach (CssStyleSet classStyleSet in ClassStyleSets)
					{
						if (classStyleSet != null && classStyleSet.CombinatorStyleSetCollection != null)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (StyleSet != null && StyleSet.CombinatorStyleSetCollection != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public DxHtmlDocumentTag(string name, CssDisplay display)
		{
			displayCore = display;
			nameCore = name;
		}

		internal void CreateClassConditions()
		{
			ClassConditions = (DxClass.IsDefault ? new List<ClassCondition>() : ClassConditionParser.Default.Parse(DxClass.Value));
		}

		public DxHtmlObjectAttribute GetCustomAttribute(string attributeName)
		{
			if (!customAttributesCore.TryGetValue(attributeName, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void AddCustomAttribute(string attributeName, DxHtmlObjectAttribute attribute)
		{
			if (customAttributesCore.ContainsKey(attributeName))
			{
				customAttributesCore[attributeName] = attribute;
			}
			else
			{
				customAttributesCore.Add(attributeName, attribute);
			}
		}

		public bool RemoveCustomAttribute(string attributeName)
		{
			if (!customAttributesCore.TryGetValue(attributeName, out var value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			BindableAttributeCount -= value.Bindable;
			return customAttributesCore.Remove(attributeName);
		}

		public bool ContainsClass(string className)
		{
			if (ClassStyleSets == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ClassStyleSets.Contains(className);
		}

		protected void ApplyStyles(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator element)
		{
			if (IdStyleSet != null)
			{
				IdStyleSet.Apply(element);
			}
			if (ClassStyleSets != null)
			{
				foreach (CssStyleSet classStyleSet in ClassStyleSets)
				{
					classStyleSet?.Apply(element);
				}
			}
			if (StyleSet != null)
			{
				StyleSet.Apply(element);
			}
			CheckStyles(element.StyleSet);
			ApplyDefaultStyle(element.StyleSet);
		}

		internal virtual DxHtmlElementBase CreateElement(DxHtmlDocumentNode node)
		{
			return new DxHtmlElement(node);
		}

		protected virtual void CheckStyles(CssStyleSet styleSet)
		{
			styleSet.CheckNormalStyle();
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyDefaultStyle(CssStyleSet styleSet)
		{
			CssDefaultStyle.SetDefaultDisplay(styleSet, displayCore);
		}

		public virtual IDxHtmlAttribute ParseAttribute(DxHtmlParser parser, char ch, ParseAttributeMode mode, object value)
		{
			return parser.ParseDefaultTagAttributes(this, ch, mode, value);
		}

		public virtual bool ParseEvent(DxHtmlParser parser, char ch)
		{
			return parser.ParseDefaultTagEvents(this, ch);
		}

		public void Apply(IDxHtmlSupportCombinator htmlElement)
		{
			ApplyStyles(htmlElement);
		}

		public DxHtmlDocumentTag Clone()
		{
			DxHtmlDocumentTag dxHtmlDocumentTag = CloneCore();
			dxHtmlDocumentTag.AssignCore(this);
			return dxHtmlDocumentTag;
		}

		protected virtual DxHtmlDocumentTag CloneCore()
		{
			return new DxHtmlDocumentTag(nameCore, displayCore);
		}

		protected virtual void AssignCore(DxHtmlDocumentTag source)
		{
			OnClick = source.OnClick;
			OnMouseMove = source.OnMouseMove;
			OnMouseUp = source.OnMouseUp;
			OnMouseDown = source.OnMouseDown;
			OnMouseOver = source.OnMouseOver;
			OnMouseOut = source.OnMouseOut;
			OnDbClick = source.OnDbClick;
			OnFocus = source.OnFocus;
			OnBlur = source.OnBlur;
			OnLoad = source.OnLoad;
			OnKeyDown = source.OnKeyDown;
			OnKeyUp = source.OnKeyUp;
			OnKeyPress = source.OnKeyPress;
			StyleSet = source.StyleSet;
			if (source.ClassStyleSets != null)
			{
				ClassStyleSets = new DxHtmlDictionary<string, CssStyleSet>(source.ClassStyleSets);
			}
			if (source.IdStyleSet != null)
			{
				IdStyleSet = new CssStyleSet();
				IdStyleSet.Merge(source.IdStyleSet);
			}
			Class = CloneAttributeValue(source.Class);
			DxClass = CloneAttributeValue(source.DxClass);
			if (source.ClassConditions != null)
			{
				ClassConditions = new List<ClassCondition>(source.ClassConditions);
			}
			Id = CloneAttributeValue(source.Id);
			Hidden = CloneAttributeValue(source.Hidden);
			TabIndex = CloneAttributeValue(source.TabIndex);
			ContextMenu = CloneAttributeValue(source.ContextMenu);
			Style = CloneAttributeValue(source.Style);
			Title = CloneAttributeValue(source.Title);
			Slot = CloneAttributeValue(source.Slot);
			Role = CloneAttributeValue(source.Role);
			BindableAttributeCount = source.BindableAttributeCount;
			PositionInCode = source.PositionInCode;
			customAttributesCore = new Dictionary<string, DxHtmlObjectAttribute>(source.customAttributesCore);
		}

		protected T CloneAttributeValue<T>(T source) where T : class, IDxHtmlAttribute
		{
			if (source.IsBindable)
			{
				return (T)source.Clone();
			}
			return source;
		}
	}
	[DXBrowsable(false)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public abstract class DxHtmlShadowBase : IDxHtmlShadow, IDisposable
	{
		private class ShadowInfo : IEquatable<ShadowInfo>
		{
			public System.Drawing.Color Color { get; set; }

			public PointF Offset { get; set; }

			public float BlurRadius { get; set; }

			public float SpreadDistance { get; set; }

			public bool Inset { get; set; }

			public System.Drawing.Size BoxSize { get; set; }

			public DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses BoxCornerRadiuses { get; set; }

			public ShadowInfo()
			{
				BoxCornerRadiuses = new DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses();
			}

			public bool Equals(ShadowInfo other)
			{
				if (Inset == other.Inset && Color == other.Color && Offset == other.Offset && BlurRadius == other.BlurRadius && SpreadDistance == other.SpreadDistance && BoxCornerRadiuses.Equals(other.BoxCornerRadiuses))
				{
					return BoxSize == other.BoxSize;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public void Assign(ShadowInfo source)
			{
				Color = source.Color;
				Offset = source.Offset;
				BlurRadius = source.BlurRadius;
				SpreadDistance = source.SpreadDistance;
				Color = source.Color;
				Inset = source.Inset;
				BoxSize = source.BoxSize;
				BoxCornerRadiuses.Assign(source.BoxCornerRadiuses);
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				Color = System.Drawing.Color.Empty;
				Offset = PointF.Empty;
				BlurRadius = 0f;
				SpreadDistance = 0f;
				Inset = false;
				BoxCornerRadiuses.Clear();
				BoxSize = System.Drawing.Size.Empty;
			}
		}

		private DxHtmlElementInfoBase owner;

		private ShadowInfo shadowInfo;

		private ShadowInfo paintShadowInfo;

		public bool IsDisplay
		{
			get
			{
				if (shadowInfo.Offset.IsEmpty && !(shadowInfo.BlurRadius > 0f))
				{
					return shadowInfo.SpreadDistance > 0f;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsInset => shadowInfo.Inset;

		public DxHtmlShadowBase()
		{
			shadowInfo = new ShadowInfo();
			paintShadowInfo = new ShadowInfo();
		}

		public abstract void Dispose();

		public void SetOwner(DxHtmlElementInfoBase owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public void Calc(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, DxHtmlElementCalculationArgs args)
		{
			if (!owner.Style.BoxShadow.HasChanges)
			{
				shadowInfo.Clear();
				return;
			}
			shadowInfo.Inset = owner.Style.BoxShadow.Inset.Value;
			PointF offset = System.Drawing.Point.Empty;
			offset.X = owner.Style.BoxShadow.CalcOffsetX(args.Size - owner.NonClientSize, args.Width, owner.RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, owner.TextMetrics.FontSize, owner.RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Width);
			offset.Y = owner.Style.BoxShadow.CalcOffsetY(args.Size - owner.NonClientSize, args.Height, owner.RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, owner.TextMetrics.FontSize, owner.RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Height);
			shadowInfo.Offset = offset;
			shadowInfo.BlurRadius = owner.Style.BoxShadow.CalcBlurRadius(args.Size - owner.NonClientSize, args.Width, owner.RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, owner.TextMetrics.FontSize, owner.RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Width);
			shadowInfo.SpreadDistance = owner.Style.BoxShadow.CalcSpreadDistance(args.Size - owner.NonClientSize, args.Width, owner.RootElementInfo.TextMetrics.FontSize, owner.TextMetrics.FontSize, owner.RootElementInfo.ScaleFactor.Width);
			shadowInfo.Color = owner.ApplyOpacityOnColor(owner.Style.BoxShadow.Color.GetColor(cache), owner.Opacity);
			shadowInfo.BoxCornerRadiuses.Assign(owner.CornerRadiuses);
		}

		public void Draw(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, IDxGraphicsPath path, Rectangle pathBounds, DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses radius)
		{
			CheckUpdate(path, pathBounds.Size, radius);
			DrawCore(cache, pathBounds.Location);
		}

		private void CheckUpdate(IDxGraphicsPath path, System.Drawing.Size size, DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses radius)
		{
			shadowInfo.BoxSize = owner.Size;
			if (!shadowInfo.Equals(paintShadowInfo) && IsDisplay)
			{
				Update(path, shadowInfo.Color, shadowInfo.Offset, shadowInfo.BlurRadius, shadowInfo.SpreadDistance, shadowInfo.Inset, size, radius);
				paintShadowInfo.Assign(shadowInfo);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void Update(IDxGraphicsPath path, System.Drawing.Color shadowColor, PointF shadowOffset, float blurRadius, float spreadDistance, bool inset, System.Drawing.Size size, DxHtmlElementCornerRadiuses radius);

		protected abstract void DrawCore(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, System.Drawing.Point location);
	}

	public static class DxHtmlPlaceholderImageHelper
	{
		private const string PlaceholderImageResLocation = "DevExpress.Data.Utils.Html.Resources.PlaceholderImage.svg";

		private const string PlaceholderImageColor = "DisabledText";

		private const int ColoredPlaceholderImagesCapacity = 20;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static SvgImage sourcePlaceholderImageCore;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Dictionary<System.Drawing.Color, SvgImage> coloredPlaceholderImagesCore;

		private static SvgImage SourcePlaceholderImage
		{
			get
			{
				if (sourcePlaceholderImageCore == null)
				{
					sourcePlaceholderImageCore = SvgImage.FromResources("DevExpress.Data.Utils.Html.Resources.PlaceholderImage.svg", typeof(DxHtmlPlaceholderImageHelper).Assembly);
				}
				return sourcePlaceholderImageCore;
			}
		}

		private static Dictionary<System.Drawing.Color, SvgImage> ColoredPlaceholderImages
		{
			get
			{
				if (coloredPlaceholderImagesCore == null)
				{
					coloredPlaceholderImagesCore = new Dictionary<System.Drawing.Color, SvgImage>(20);
				}
				return coloredPlaceholderImagesCore;
			}
		}

		public static SvgImage GetImage(IDxHtmlGraphicsCache cache, out System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			color = cache.GetColor("DisabledText");
			return GetPlaceholderImageBy(color);
		}

		public static SvgImage GetPlaceholderImageBy(System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			if (!ColoredPlaceholderImages.TryGetValue(color, out var value))
			{
				value = SourcePlaceholderImage.Clone();
				SetSvgImageColor(value, color);
				ColoredPlaceholderImages.Add(color, value);
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static void SetSvgImageColor(SvgImage image, System.Drawing.Color color)
		{
			SvgElement val = ((SvgElement)image.Root).Elements[0];
			SvgElementCreator.SetPropertyValue(val, "fill", ColorTranslator.ToHtml(color), (List<string>)null);
			if (color.A < byte.MaxValue)
			{
				SvgElementCreator.SetPropertyValue(val, "opacity", ((float)(int)color.A / 255f).ToString(), (List<string>)null);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DxHtmlResourceProvider
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static DxHtmlResourceProvider current;

		private Dictionary<string, object> imagesCore = new Dictionary<string, object>();

		private Dictionary<string, Cursor> cursorsCore = new Dictionary<string, Cursor>();

		public static DxHtmlResourceProvider Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (current == null)
				{
					current = new DxHtmlResourceProvider();
				}
				return current;
			}
		}

		protected Dictionary<string, Cursor> Cursors => cursorsCore;

		protected Dictionary<string, object> Images => imagesCore;

		public ResourceManager ResourceManager => ResourceImageProvider.Current.ResourceManager;

		protected object GetObject(string id)
		{
			return ResourceManager?.GetObject(id);
		}

		protected T GetObject<T>(string id)
		{
			ResourceManager resourceManager = ResourceManager;
			if (resourceManager != null)
			{
				object obj = resourceManager.GetObject(id);
				if (obj is T)
				{
					return (T)obj;
				}
			}
			return default(T);
		}

		public Cursor GetCursor(CssCursors cursor)
		{
			switch (cursor)
			{
			case CssCursors.Auto:
			case CssCursors.Default:
				return System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Default;
			case CssCursors.None:

				return System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.SizeAll;
			case CssCursors.Cell:
			case CssCursors.ContextMenu:
				return System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Arrow;
			case CssCursors.NoDrop:
			case CssCursors.NotAllowed:
				return System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.No;
			case CssCursors.Crosshair:
				return System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Cross;
			case CssCursors.Grab:
			case CssCursors.Grabbing:
			case CssCursors.Pointer:
				return System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Hand;
			case CssCursors.EResize:

				return System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Default;
			}
		}

		public bool CheckCursor(string uri)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(uri))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (cursorsCore.TryGetValue(uri, out var _))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (uri[0] == '#')
			{
				object obj = GetObject(uri.Substring(1));
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (obj is Cursor)
				{
					cursorsCore.Add(uri, (Cursor)obj);
					return true;
				}
				if (obj is Bitmap)
				{
					cursorsCore.Add(uri, new Cursor(((Bitmap)obj).GetHicon()));
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public Cursor GetCursor(string uri)
		{
			if (cursorsCore.TryGetValue(uri, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return System.Windows.Forms.Cursors.Default;
		}

		public object GetImage(string id)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) || id.Length < 2 || id[0] != '#')
			{
				return null;
			}
			id = id.Substring(1);
			if (!Images.TryGetValue(id, out var value))
			{
				object obj = GetObject(id);
				if (obj is System.Drawing.Image || obj is SvgImage)
				{
					value = obj;
					Images.Add(id, value);
				}
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

	[DXBrowsable(false)]
	[Browsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class CustomStateSet : IEnumerable<string>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly HashSet<string> statesCore = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

		private EventHandler stateChangedCore;

		public int Count => statesCore.Count;

		public event EventHandler StateChanged
		{
			add
			{
				stateChangedCore = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(stateChangedCore, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				stateChangedCore = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(stateChangedCore, value);
			}
		}

		public bool Has(string state)
		{
			return statesCore.Contains(state);
		}

		public void Add(string state)
		{
			if (statesCore.Add(state))
			{
				RaiseStateChanged();
			}
		}

		public void Delete(string state)
		{
			if (statesCore.Remove(state))
			{
				RaiseStateChanged();
			}
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (statesCore.Count != 0)
			{
				statesCore.Clear();
				RaiseStateChanged();
			}
		}

		private void RaiseStateChanged()
		{
			stateChangedCore?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public IEnumerator<string> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return statesCore.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return statesCore.GetEnumerator();
		}
	}

	internal static class CustomDxHtmlComponentsCache
	{
		private sealed class ComponentFactory
		{
			private readonly Type Type;

			public readonly Func<DxHtmlComponent> Create;

			public readonly bool Browsable;

			private IReadOnlyCollection<string> attributeNames;

			private static Pattern getAttribute_Pattern;

			public ComponentFactory(Type type, Func<DxHtmlComponent> create, bool browsable)
			{
				Type = type;
				Create = create;
				Browsable = browsable;
			}

			public IReadOnlyCollection<string> GetAttributeNames()
			{
				//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0055: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (attributeNames == null)
				{
					PropertyInfo[] properties = Type.GetProperties();
					HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>();
					PropertyInfo[] array = properties;
					foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in array)
					{
						if (propertyInfo.CanRead)
						{
							MethodInfo getMethod = propertyInfo.GetGetMethod();
							if (!(getMethod == null) && EnsurePattern().Match(new ILReader((MethodBase)getMethod)))
							{
								hashSet.Add(propertyInfo.Name);
							}
						}
					}
					attributeNames = (IReadOnlyCollection<string>)(object)hashSet.OrderBy((string x) => x).ToArray();
				}
				return attributeNames;
			}

			private static Pattern EnsurePattern()
			{
				return getAttribute_Pattern ?? (getAttribute_Pattern = GetGetAttributePattern());
			}

			private static Pattern GetGetAttributePattern()
			{
				//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
				return new Pattern(new Func<Instruction, bool>[1]
				{
					(Instruction i) => ILAnalyzer.IsCall(((InstructionBase)i).OpCode) && IsGetAttributeMethod(((InstructionBase)i).Operand as MethodBase)
				});
			}

			private static bool IsGetAttributeMethod(MethodBase method)
			{
				if (method != null && method.Name == "GetAttribute")
				{
					return typeof(DxHtmlComponent) == method.DeclaringType;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, ComponentFactory> factories;

		public static bool IsEmpty => factories.Count == 0;

		static CustomDxHtmlComponentsCache()
		{
			factories = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, ComponentFactory>();
			DxCollectionComponent.Register();
		}

		private static Func<T> GetCreateCustomHtmlElement<T>() where T : DxHtmlComponent
		{
			ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(T).GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes);
			DynamicMethod dynamicMethod = new DynamicMethod("__create_" + typeof(T).Name, MethodAttributes.Public | MethodAttributes.Static, CallingConventions.Standard, typeof(T), Type.EmptyTypes, typeof(CustomDxHtmlComponentsCache), skipVisibility: true);
			ILGenerator iLGenerator = dynamicMethod.GetILGenerator();
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Newobj, constructor);
			iLGenerator.Emit(OpCodes.Ret);
			return (Func<T>)dynamicMethod.CreateDelegate(typeof(Func<T>));
		}

		public static IReadOnlyCollection<string> GetTagNames()
		{
			KeyValuePair<string, ComponentFactory>[] array = factories.ToArray();
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i].Value.Browsable)
				{
					list.Add(array[i].Key);
				}
			}
			return (IReadOnlyCollection<string>)(object)list.ToArray();
		}

		public static IReadOnlyCollection<string> GetTagAttributes(string tagName)
		{
			if (factories.TryGetValue(tagName, out var value))
			{
				return value.GetAttributeNames();
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static bool Define<T>(string tag) where T : DxHtmlComponent
		{
			if (!DxHtmlParser.CheckCustomTagName(tag))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool browsable = !(typeof(T).GetCustomAttribute(typeof(EditorBrowsableAttribute)) is EditorBrowsableAttribute editorBrowsableAttribute) || editorBrowsableAttribute.State != EditorBrowsableState.Never;
			return factories.AddOrUpdate(tag, new ComponentFactory(typeof(T), GetCreateCustomHtmlElement<T>(), browsable), (string t, ComponentFactory factory) => factory) != null;
		}

		public static DxHtmlComponent Create(string customTagName)
		{
			if (!factories.TryGetValue(customTagName, out var value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return value.Create();
		}

		public static bool IsDefined(string customTagName)
		{
			return factories.ContainsKey(customTagName);
		}

		public static void Reset()
		{
			factories.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class DxCollectionComponent : DxHtmlComponent
	{
		private static Stack<string> parentTemplates = new Stack<string>();

		private const string itemCompName = "dx-collection-item";

		private const string tagName = "dx-collection";

		private static string[] knownAttributes = new string[2]
		{
			"Items".ToLower(),
			"ItemTemplate".ToLower()
		};

		public string ItemTemplate => (GetAttribute("ItemTemplate") as string) ?? string.Empty;

		public object Items => GetAttribute("Items");

		public static void Register()
		{
			DxHtmlDocument.Define<DxCollectionComponent>("dx-collection");
			DxHtmlDocument.Define<DxCollectionItemComponent>("dx-collection-item");
		}

		public static bool TryGetDesignTimeValue(string fieldName, DxHtmlElementBase element, out object result)
		{
			if (element is DxHtmlCustomElement dxHtmlCustomElement && string.Equals(dxHtmlCustomElement.TagName, "dx-collection"))
			{
				result = new object[1] { fieldName + " item" };
				return true;
			}
			result = null;
			return false;
		}

		public override void ConnectedCallback()
		{
			base.ConnectedCallback();
			if (base.Element.RootElement != null)
			{
				BuildItems();
			}
		}

		public override void AttributeChangedCallback(string attributeName)
		{
			base.AttributeChangedCallback(attributeName);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(attributeName) || knownAttributes.Contains(attributeName))
			{
				BuildItems();
			}
		}

		private void BuildItems()
		{
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ClearChildren();
			object items = Items;
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string itemTemplate = ItemTemplate;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(itemTemplate) || parentTemplates.Contains(itemTemplate))
			{
				return;
			}
			DxHtmlDocumentFragment dxHtmlDocumentFragment = base.Element.RootElement?.FindTemplate(itemTemplate);
			if (dxHtmlDocumentFragment == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ListSourceDataController val = new ListSourceDataController();
			((BaseListSourceDataController)val).SetDataSource(items);
			int visibleCount = ((DataController)val).VisibleCount;
			if (visibleCount != 0)
			{
				base.Element.RootElement.EnsureClientDetails();
				parentTemplates.Push(itemTemplate);
				for (int i = 0; i < visibleCount; i++)
				{
					DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = DxHtmlDocument.CreateElement("dx-collection-item");
					AppendChild(dxHtmlElement);
					dxHtmlElement.SetAttribute("rowindex", i);
					dxHtmlElement.SetAttribute("controller", val);
					dxHtmlElement.SetAttribute("template", dxHtmlDocumentFragment);
					dxHtmlElement.SetAttribute("controller", null);
				}
				parentTemplates.Pop();
				((BaseListSourceDataController)val).SetDataSource((object)null);
			}
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	internal class DxCollectionItemComponent : DxHtmlComponent
	{
		public override void ConnectedCallback()
		{
			base.ConnectedCallback();
		}

		public override void AttributeChangedCallback(string attributeName)
		{
			base.AttributeChangedCallback(attributeName);
			if (attributeName == "template")
			{
				BuildItem();
			}
		}

		private void BuildItem()
		{
			ClearChildren();
			int rowIndex = (int)GetAttribute("rowindex");
			if (!(GetAttribute("template") is DxHtmlDocumentFragment dxHtmlDocumentFragment))
			{
				return;
			}
			object attribute = GetAttribute("controller");
			ListSourceDataController val = (ListSourceDataController)((attribute is ListSourceDataController) ? attribute : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DxHtmlNode dxHtmlNode = dxHtmlDocumentFragment.CloneNode();
			List<DxHtmlElementBase> list = new List<DxHtmlElementBase>();
			CollectBindableElements(dxHtmlNode, list);
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				Dictionary<string, object> details = CollectRowValues(val, rowIndex);
				if (base.Element.RootElement.ClientServices.GetService(typeof(DxHtmlRootElement.DxHtmlClientDetails)) is DxHtmlRootElement.DxHtmlClientDetails dxHtmlClientDetails)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
					{
						dxHtmlClientDetails.AddDetails(list[i], details);
					}
				}
			}
			List<DxHtmlNode> nodes = new List<DxHtmlNode>(dxHtmlNode.ChildNodes);
			AppendChild(dxHtmlNode);
			NotifyConnected(nodes);
		}

		private void NotifyConnected(IEnumerable<DxHtmlNode> nodes)
		{
			foreach (DxHtmlNode node in nodes)
			{
				if (node is DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement)
				{
					dxHtmlElement.OnConnected();
					NotifyConnected(dxHtmlElement.ChildNodes);
				}
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<string, object> CollectRowValues(ListSourceDataController dataController, int rowIndex)
		{
			Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((CollectionBase)(object)((DataControllerBase)dataController).Columns).Count; i++)
			{
				DataColumnInfo val = ((DataControllerBase)dataController).Columns[i];
				object rowValue = ((DataController)dataController).GetRowValue(rowIndex, val);
				dictionary[val.Name] = rowValue;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < ((CollectionBase)(object)((DataControllerBase)dataController).DetailColumns).Count; j++)
			{
				DataColumnInfo val2 = ((DataControllerBase)dataController).DetailColumns[j];
				object rowValue2 = ((DataController)dataController).GetRowValue(rowIndex, val2);
				dictionary[val2.Name] = rowValue2;
			}
			if (((CollectionBase)(object)((DataControllerBase)dataController).Columns).Count == 1 && ((CollectionBase)(object)((DataControllerBase)dataController).DetailColumns).Count == 0)
			{
				DataColumnInfo val3 = ((DataControllerBase)dataController).Columns[0];
				if (val3.Name == "Column" && val3.Type == typeof(object))
				{
					object rowValue3 = ((DataController)dataController).GetRowValue(rowIndex, val3);
					dictionary["value"] = rowValue3;
				}
			}
			int visibleCount = ((DataController)dataController).VisibleCount;
			bool flag = rowIndex % 2 == 0;
			dictionary["dx-first"] = rowIndex == 0;
			dictionary["dx-last"] = rowIndex == visibleCount - 1;
			dictionary["dx-even"] = flag;
			dictionary["dx-odd"] = !flag;
			return dictionary;
		}

		private void CollectBindableElements(DxHtmlNode node, List<DxHtmlElementBase> result)
		{
			if (node.NodeType == DxHtmlNodeType.TextNode)
			{
				if (node is DxHtmlTextElement dxHtmlTextElement)
				{
					string[] fields = dxHtmlTextElement.Tag.Fields;
					if (fields != null && fields.Length != 0)
					{
						result.Add(dxHtmlTextElement);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (node.NodeType == DxHtmlNodeType.ElementNode)
			{
				DxHtmlElement dxHtmlElement = node as DxHtmlElement;
				if (dxHtmlElement.Tag.BindableAttributeCount > 0)
				{
					result.Add(dxHtmlElement);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < node.ChildNodes.Count; i++)
			{
				DxHtmlNode node2 = node.ChildNodes[i];
				CollectBindableElements(node2, result);
			}
		}
	}
