namespace DevExpress.Utils.Localization
{
	public static class XtraLocalizerTraceSource
	{
		public sealed class Data : BindingList<DataItem>, IDisposable
		{
			private readonly MemoryMappedFile buffer;

			private long currentOffset;

			private readonly long countOffset;

			private readonly string name;

			public string CultureName { get; private set; }

			public string ExecutableName { get; private set; }

			public Data(string name)
			{
				this.name = name;
				base.AllowNew = (base.AllowRemove = (base.AllowEdit = false));
				buffer = MemoryMappedFile.OpenExisting(name, MemoryMappedFileRights.Read);
				using (MemoryMappedViewAccessor accessor = buffer.CreateViewAccessor(0L, 0L, MemoryMappedFileAccess.Read))
				{
					CultureName = ReadString(accessor);
					ExecutableName = ReadString(accessor);
				}
				countOffset = currentOffset;
				currentOffset += 4L;
			}

			public void Dispose()
			{
				buffer?.Dispose();
				if (sources.TryRemove(name, out var _))
				{
					base.Items.Clear();
				}
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}

			public void Update()
			{
				using MemoryMappedViewAccessor memoryMappedViewAccessor = buffer.CreateViewAccessor(0L, 0L, MemoryMappedFileAccess.Read);
				int num = memoryMappedViewAccessor.ReadInt32(countOffset);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					if (i >= base.Count)
					{
						string[] data = new string[5];
						ReadData(memoryMappedViewAccessor, data);
						InsertItem(base.Count, new DataItem(data));
					}
				}
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private string ReadString(MemoryMappedViewAccessor accessor)
			{
				int num = accessor.ReadInt32(currentOffset);
				char[] array = new char[num];
				accessor.ReadArray(currentOffset + 4, array, 0, array.Length);
				currentOffset += 4 + array.Length * 2;
				return new string(array);
			}

			[SecuritySafeCritical]
			private void ReadData(UnmanagedMemoryAccessor accessor, string[] data)
			{
				int[] array = new int[data.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < data.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = accessor.ReadInt32(currentOffset);
					currentOffset += 4L;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < data.Length; j++)
				{
					char[] array2 = new char[array[j]];
					accessor.ReadArray(currentOffset, array2, 0, array2.Length);
					currentOffset += 2 * array2.Length;
					data[j] = new string(array2);
				}
			}
		}

		public sealed class DataItem
		{
			public string ID { get; private set; }

			public string Container { get; private set; }

			public string Element { get; private set; }

			public string Value { get; private set; }

			public string InvariantValue { get; private set; }

			public DataItem(string[] data)
			{
				ID = data[0];
				Container = data[1];
				Element = data[2];
				Value = data[3];
				InvariantValue = data[4];
			}
		}

		private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, IBindingList> sources = new ConcurrentDictionary<string, IBindingList>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

		public static bool CanAttach(string applicationName)
		{
			return CanAttachCore("DX$XtraLocalizerTraceSource#" + applicationName);
		}

		public static bool CanAttachNonTranslated(string applicationName)
		{
			return CanAttachCore("DX$XtraLocalizerNonTranslatedTraceTraceSource#" + applicationName);
		}

		public static Data Attach(string applicationName)
		{
			return AttachToData("DX$XtraLocalizerTraceSource#" + applicationName);
		}

		public static Data AttachNonTranslated(string applicationName)
		{
			return AttachToData("DX$XtraLocalizerNonTranslatedTraceTraceSource#" + applicationName);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static bool CanAttachCore(string sourceName)
		{
			if (!Mutex.TryOpenExisting(sourceName + "#Mutex", out var result))
			{
				return false;
			}
			using (result)
			{
				return true;
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Data AttachToData(string sourceName)
		{
			if (!Mutex.TryOpenExisting(sourceName + "#Mutex", out var result))
			{
				return null;
			}
			using (result)
			{
				return sources.GetOrAdd(sourceName, (string x) => new Data(x)) as Data;
			}
		}
	}

	public class DXInheritedPropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
	{
		private class ReadOnlyCollectionConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return "Read-only";
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		private object defaultValue;

		private static object noDefault;

		private object originalValue;

		private PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor;

		public override Type ComponentType => propertyDescriptor.ComponentType;

		public override bool IsReadOnly
		{
			get
			{
				if (!propertyDescriptor.IsReadOnly)
				{
					return Attributes[typeof(ReadOnlyAttribute)].Equals(ReadOnlyAttribute.Yes);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public object OriginalValue => originalValue;

		public ICollection OriginalCollection => OriginalValue as ICollection;

		public bool IsCollection => OriginalCollection != null;

		public bool IsEmptyOriginalCollection
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsCollection)
				{
					return OriginalCollection.Count == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public PropertyDescriptor PropertyDescriptor
		{
			get
			{
				return propertyDescriptor;
			}
			set
			{
				propertyDescriptor = value;
			}
		}

		public override Type PropertyType => propertyDescriptor.PropertyType;

		static DXInheritedPropertyDescriptor()
		{
			noDefault = new object();
		}

		public DXInheritedPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor, object component, bool rootComponent)
			: base(propertyDescriptor, new Attribute[0])
		{
			this.propertyDescriptor = propertyDescriptor;
			InitInheritedDefaultValue(component, rootComponent);
			bool flag = false;
			if (typeof(ICollection).IsAssignableFrom(propertyDescriptor.PropertyType) && propertyDescriptor.Attributes.Contains(DesignerSerializationVisibilityAttribute.Content) && propertyDescriptor.Attributes[typeof(InheritableCollectionAttribute)] == null && propertyDescriptor.GetValue(component) is ICollection { Count: >0 } collection)
			{
				MethodInfo[] methods = TypeDescriptor.GetReflectionType(collection).GetMethods(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
				foreach (MethodInfo methodInfo in methods)
				{
					ParameterInfo[] parameters = methodInfo.GetParameters();
					if (parameters.Length == 1)
					{
						string text = methodInfo.Name;
						Type type = null;
						if (text.Equals("AddRange") && parameters[0].ParameterType.IsArray)
						{
							type = parameters[0].ParameterType.GetElementType();
						}
						else if (text.Equals("Add"))
						{
							type = parameters[0].ParameterType;
						}
						if (type != null && !typeof(IComponent).IsAssignableFrom(type))
						{
							Attribute[] attributeArray = new List<Attribute>(AttributeArray)
							{
								DesignerSerializationVisibilityAttribute.Hidden,
								ReadOnlyAttribute.Yes,
								new EditorAttribute(typeof(UITypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor)),
								new TypeConverterAttribute(typeof(ReadOnlyCollectionConverter))
							}.ToArray();
							AttributeArray = attributeArray;
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag && defaultValue != noDefault)
			{
				List<Attribute> list = new List<Attribute>(AttributeArray)
				{
					new DefaultValueAttribute(defaultValue)
				};
				Attribute[] array = new Attribute[list.Count];
				list.CopyTo(array, 0);
				AttributeArray = array;
			}
		}

		public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
		{
			if (defaultValue == noDefault)
			{
				return propertyDescriptor.CanResetValue(component);
			}
			return !object.Equals(GetValue(component), defaultValue);
		}

		private object ClonedDefaultValue(object value)
		{
			DesignerSerializationVisibility designerSerializationVisibility = ((DesignerSerializationVisibilityAttribute)propertyDescriptor.Attributes[typeof(DesignerSerializationVisibilityAttribute)])?.Visibility ?? DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible;
			if (value != null && designerSerializationVisibility == DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)
			{
				if (value is ICloneable)
				{
					value = ((ICloneable)value).Clone();
					return value;
				}
				value = noDefault;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override void FillAttributes(IList attributeList)
		{
			base.FillAttributes(attributeList);
			foreach (Attribute attribute in propertyDescriptor.Attributes)
			{
				attributeList.Add(attribute);
			}
		}

		public override object GetValue(object component)
		{
			return propertyDescriptor.GetValue(component);
		}

		private void InitInheritedDefaultValue(object component, bool rootComponent)
		{
			try
			{
				object value;
				if (!propertyDescriptor.ShouldSerializeValue(component))
				{
					DefaultValueAttribute defaultValueAttribute = (DefaultValueAttribute)propertyDescriptor.Attributes[typeof(DefaultValueAttribute)];
					if (defaultValueAttribute != null)
					{
						defaultValue = defaultValueAttribute.Value;
						value = defaultValue;
					}
					else
					{
						defaultValue = noDefault;
						value = propertyDescriptor.GetValue(component);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					defaultValue = propertyDescriptor.GetValue(component);
					value = defaultValue;
					defaultValue = ClonedDefaultValue(defaultValue);
				}
				SaveOriginalValue(value);
			}
			catch
			{
				defaultValue = noDefault;
			}
		}

		public override void ResetValue(object component)
		{
			if (defaultValue == noDefault)
			{
				propertyDescriptor.ResetValue(component);
			}
			else
			{
				SetValue(component, defaultValue);
			}
		}

		private void SaveOriginalValue(object value)
		{
			if (value is ICollection)
			{
				originalValue = new object[((ICollection)value).Count];
				((ICollection)value).CopyTo((Array)originalValue, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				originalValue = value;
			}
		}

		public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
		{
			propertyDescriptor.SetValue(component, value);
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
		{
			if (IsReadOnly)
			{
				if (propertyDescriptor.ShouldSerializeValue(component))
				{
					return Attributes.Contains(DesignerSerializationVisibilityAttribute.Content);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (defaultValue == noDefault)
			{
				return propertyDescriptor.ShouldSerializeValue(component);
			}
			return !object.Equals(GetValue(component), defaultValue);
		}
	}
	public class InheritanceHelper
	{
		private class Provider : IServiceProvider
		{
			internal static Provider NullServiceProvider = new Provider();

			object IServiceProvider.GetService(Type serviceType)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static object disableVisualInheritance;

		public static bool DisableVisualInheritance
		{
			get
			{
				if (disableVisualInheritance == null)
				{
					disableVisualInheritance = true;
					try
					{
						RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey("Software\\WOW6432Node\\Developer Express");
						if (registryKey == null)
						{
							registryKey = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey("Software\\Developer Express");
						}
						if (registryKey != null)
						{
							disableVisualInheritance = bool.Parse(registryKey.GetValue("DisableVisualInheritance", "true").ToString());
						}
					}
					catch
					{
						disableVisualInheritance = true;
					}
				}
				return (bool)disableVisualInheritance;
			}
		}

		public static Component GetComponent(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is IDesigner designer)
			{
				return designer.Component as Component;
			}
			if (obj is Component result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static IServiceProvider GetServiceProvider(object obj)
		{
			Component component = GetComponent(obj);
			if (component != null && component.Site != null)
			{
				return component.Site;
			}
			IServiceProvider serviceProvider = obj as IServiceProvider;
			if (serviceProvider == null)
			{
				serviceProvider = Provider.NullServiceProvider;
			}
			return serviceProvider;
		}

		public static object GetService(object obj, Type type)
		{
			return GetServiceProvider(obj).GetService(type);
		}

		public static IInheritanceService GetInheritanceService(object obj)
		{
			return GetService(obj, typeof(IInheritanceService)) as IInheritanceService;
		}

		public static InheritanceAttribute GetInheritanceAttribute(object obj)
		{
			Component component = GetComponent(obj);
			if (component == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetInheritanceService(component)?.GetInheritanceAttribute(component);
		}

		public static bool AllowCollectionModify(Component baseComponent, PropertyDescriptor collectionDescriptor, ICollection collection)
		{
			InheritanceAttribute inheritanceAttribute = (InheritanceAttribute)TypeDescriptor.GetAttributes(baseComponent)[typeof(InheritanceAttribute)];
			if (inheritanceAttribute != null && inheritanceAttribute.Equals(InheritanceAttribute.InheritedReadOnly))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (collectionDescriptor.Converter.GetType().Name == "ReadOnlyCollectionConverter")
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (collectionDescriptor is DXInheritedPropertyDescriptor dXInheritedPropertyDescriptor)
			{
				if (!dXInheritedPropertyDescriptor.IsEmptyOriginalCollection)
				{
					return IsComponentCollection(collection);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return IsComponentCollection(collection);
		}

		public static bool AllowCollectionItemEdit(Component baseComponent, PropertyDescriptor collectionDescriptor, ICollection collection)
		{
			InheritanceAttribute inheritanceAttribute = (InheritanceAttribute)TypeDescriptor.GetAttributes(baseComponent)[typeof(InheritanceAttribute)];
			if (inheritanceAttribute != null && inheritanceAttribute.Equals(InheritanceAttribute.InheritedReadOnly))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsComponentCollection(collection);
		}

		public static bool AllowCollectionItemEdit(Component baseComponent, PropertyDescriptor collectionDescriptor, ICollection collection, object item)
		{
			InheritanceAttribute inheritanceAttribute = (InheritanceAttribute)TypeDescriptor.GetAttributes(item)[typeof(InheritanceAttribute)];
			if (inheritanceAttribute != null && inheritanceAttribute.InheritanceLevel == InheritanceLevel.InheritedReadOnly)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsComponentCollection(collection);
		}

		public static bool AllowCollectionItemRemove(Component baseComponent, PropertyDescriptor collectionDescriptor, ICollection collection, object item)
		{
			if (!AllowCollectionModify(baseComponent, collectionDescriptor, collection))
			{
				return false;
			}
			InheritanceAttribute inheritanceAttribute = (InheritanceAttribute)TypeDescriptor.GetAttributes(item)[typeof(InheritanceAttribute)];
			if (inheritanceAttribute != null && inheritanceAttribute.InheritanceLevel != InheritanceLevel.NotInherited)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsComponentCollection(ICollection collection)
		{
			Type indexerPropertyType = GetIndexerPropertyType(collection);
			if (indexerPropertyType != null)
			{
				return typeof(IComponent).IsAssignableFrom(indexerPropertyType);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static Type GetIndexerPropertyType(ICollection collection)
		{
			if (collection == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			PropertyInfo[] properties = collection.GetType().GetProperties();
			for (int i = 0; i < properties.Length; i++)
			{
				if ("Item".Equals(properties[i].Name) && properties[i].PropertyType != typeof(object))
				{
					return properties[i].PropertyType;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Utils.Editors
{
	public class ObjectEditor : Form
	{
		public enum ObjectType
		{
			String,
			Int16,
			Int32,
			Int64,
			Single,
			Double,
			Byte,
			Decimal,
			Char,
			Boolean,
			DateTime,
			Null
		}

		private System.Windows.Forms.Button btnOK;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Button btnCancel;

		private System.Windows.Forms.ComboBox cmbType;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Label lblType;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Label lblValue;

		private System.Windows.Forms.TextBox txtEditor;

		private System.Windows.Forms.ComboBox cmbEditor;

		private DateTimePicker dtEditor;

		private Container components;

		private string objEditValue;

		public static string[] ObjectTypeNames = new string[12]
		{
			"String", "Numeric (Int16)", "Numeric (Int32)", "Numeric (Int64)", "Numeric (Single)", "Numeric (Double)", "Numeric (Byte)", "Numeric (Decimal)", "Char", "Boolean",
			"DateTime", "<Null>"
		};

		private System.Windows.Forms.Control oldEditor;

		private bool lockUpdate;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Control Editor => cmbType.SelectedIndex switch
		{
			9 => cmbEditor, 
			10 => dtEditor, 
			11 => null, 
			_ => txtEditor, 
		};

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public object EditValue
		{
			get
			{
				switch ((ObjectType)cmbType.SelectedIndex)
				{
				case ObjectType.Int16:
					return Convert.ToInt16(txtEditor.Text);
				case ObjectType.Int32:
					return Convert.ToInt32(txtEditor.Text);
				case ObjectType.Int64:
					return Convert.ToInt64(txtEditor.Text);
				case ObjectType.Single:
					return Convert.ToSingle(txtEditor.Text);
				case ObjectType.Double:
					return Convert.ToDouble(txtEditor.Text);
				case ObjectType.Byte:
					return Convert.ToByte(txtEditor.Text);
				case ObjectType.Decimal:
					return Convert.ToDecimal(txtEditor.Text);
				case ObjectType.Char:
				{
					string text = txtEditor.Text.Trim();
					if (text.Length > 0)
					{
						return Convert.ToChar(text[0]);
					}
					return null;
				}
				case ObjectType.Boolean:
					return cmbEditor.SelectedIndex == 0;
				case ObjectType.DateTime:
					return dtEditor.Value;
				case ObjectType.Null:
					return null;
				default:
					return txtEditor.Text;
				}
			}
		}

		public ObjectEditor(object editValue)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			cmbType.Items.Clear();
			string[] objectTypeNames = ObjectTypeNames;
			foreach (string item in objectTypeNames)
			{
				cmbType.Items.Add(item);
			}
			objEditValue = ConvertObjectToString(editValue);
			cmbType.SelectedIndex = (int)GetObjectType(editValue);
			btnOK.Enabled = false;
		}

		public static ObjectType GetObjectType(object val)
		{
			ObjectType result = ObjectType.Null;
			if (val != null)
			{
				string text = "";
				try
				{
					text = val.GetType().ToString().Split('.')[1].ToLower(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				switch (text)
				{
				case "boolean":
					return ObjectType.Boolean;
				case "datetime":
					return ObjectType.DateTime;
				case "int16":
					return ObjectType.Int16;
				case "int32":
					return ObjectType.Int32;
				case "int64":
					return ObjectType.Int64;
				case "single":
					return ObjectType.Single;
				case "double":
					return ObjectType.Double;
				case "byte":
					return ObjectType.Byte;
				case "decimal":
					result = ObjectType.Decimal;
					break;
				case "char":
					result = ObjectType.Char;
					break;
				default:
					result = ObjectType.String;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static object ConvertObject(ObjectType type, object val)
		{
			try
			{
				return type switch
				{
					ObjectType.Null => null, 
					ObjectType.DateTime => (val == null) ? DateTime.MinValue : DateTime.Parse(val.ToString()), 
					ObjectType.Int16 => Convert.ToInt16(val), 
					ObjectType.Int32 => Convert.ToInt32(val), 
					ObjectType.Int64 => Convert.ToInt64(val), 
					ObjectType.Single => Convert.ToSingle(val), 
					ObjectType.Double => Convert.ToDouble(val), 
					ObjectType.Byte => Convert.ToByte(val), 
					ObjectType.Decimal => Convert.ToDecimal(val), 
					ObjectType.Boolean => Convert.ToBoolean(val), 
					ObjectType.Char => Convert.ToChar(val), 
					_ => (val == null) ? "" : val.ToString(), 
				};
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string ConvertObjectToString(object val)
		{
			ObjectType objectType = GetObjectType(val);
			if (objectType == ObjectType.Null)
			{
				return ObjectEditorTypeConverter.NullString;
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				return "";
			}
			return val.ToString();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{
			this.btnOK = new System.Windows.Forms.Button();
			this.btnCancel = new System.Windows.Forms.Button();
			this.cmbType = new System.Windows.Forms.ComboBox();
			this.lblType = new System.Windows.Forms.Label();
			this.lblValue = new System.Windows.Forms.Label();
			this.txtEditor = new System.Windows.Forms.TextBox();
			this.cmbEditor = new System.Windows.Forms.ComboBox();
			this.dtEditor = new System.Windows.Forms.DateTimePicker();
			base.SuspendLayout();
			this.btnOK.DialogResult = System.Windows.Forms.DialogResult.OK;
			this.btnOK.FlatStyle = System.Windows.Forms.FlatStyle.Popup;

		private void cmbType_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			lockUpdate = true;
			System.Windows.Forms.Control editor = Editor;
			if (editor != null)
			{
				if (oldEditor != null && oldEditor.Equals(txtEditor))
				{
					objEditValue = oldEditor.Text;
				}
				txtEditor.Visible = editor.Equals(txtEditor);
				cmbEditor.Visible = editor.Equals(cmbEditor);
				dtEditor.Visible = editor.Equals(dtEditor);
				if (editor.Equals(cmbEditor))
				{
					try
					{
						cmbEditor.SelectedIndex = ((!Convert.ToBoolean(objEditValue)) ? 1 : 0);
					}
					catch
					{
						cmbEditor.SelectedIndex = 0;
					}
				}
				else if (editor.Equals(dtEditor))
				{
					try
					{
						dtEditor.Value = Convert.ToDateTime(objEditValue);
					}
					catch
					{
						dtEditor.Value = DateTime.Now;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					txtEditor.Text = objEditValue;
				}
				oldEditor = editor;
			}
			else
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.TextBox textBox = txtEditor;
				System.Windows.Forms.ComboBox comboBox = cmbEditor;
				bool flag = (dtEditor.Visible = false);
				bool visible = (comboBox.Visible = flag);
				textBox.Visible = visible;
			}
			btnOK.Enabled = true;
			lockUpdate = false;
		}

		private void editor_TextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!lockUpdate)
			{
				btnOK.Enabled = true;
			}
		}
	}
	public class UIObjectEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object objValue)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
			{
				edSvc = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
				if (edSvc != null)
				{
					try
					{
						ObjectEditor objectEditor = new ObjectEditor(objValue);
						if (edSvc.ShowDialog(objectEditor) == DialogResult.OK)
						{
							objValue = objectEditor.EditValue;
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return objValue;
		}

		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
			}
			return base.GetEditStyle(context);
		}
	}
	public class SimpleTypeEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		public class SimpleTypeEditorListBox : System.Windows.Forms.ListBox
		{
			private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

			public SimpleTypeEditorListBox(IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc)
			{
				this.edSvc = edSvc;
			}

			protected override void OnDoubleClick(EventArgs e)
			{
				edSvc.CloseDropDown();
			}
		}

		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
			}
			return base.GetEditStyle(context);
		}

		private static Type GetTypeFromTypeCode(TypeCode value)
		{
			return value switch
			{
				TypeCode.Boolean => typeof(bool), 
				TypeCode.Byte => typeof(byte), 
				TypeCode.Char => typeof(char), 
				TypeCode.DateTime => typeof(DateTime), 
				TypeCode.Decimal => typeof(decimal), 
				TypeCode.Double => typeof(double), 
				TypeCode.Int16 => typeof(short), 
				TypeCode.Int32 => typeof(int), 
				TypeCode.Int64 => typeof(long), 
				TypeCode.SByte => typeof(sbyte), 
				TypeCode.Single => typeof(float), 
				TypeCode.String => typeof(string), 
				TypeCode.UInt16 => typeof(ushort), 
				TypeCode.UInt32 => typeof(uint), 
				TypeCode.UInt64 => typeof(ulong), 
				_ => typeof(object), 
			};
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object obj)
		{
			try
			{
				if (context != null && provider != null && context.PropertyDescriptor != null)
				{
					IWindowsFormsEditorService windowsFormsEditorService = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
					if (windowsFormsEditorService != null && context.OnComponentChanging())
					{
						System.Windows.Forms.ListBox listBox = new SimpleTypeEditorListBox(windowsFormsEditorService);
						listBox.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None;
						int num = -1;
						if (context.PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType == typeof(Type))
						{
							TypeCode typeCode = Type.GetTypeCode((Type)obj);
							foreach (TypeCode value in Enum.GetValues(typeof(TypeCode)))
							{
								if (value != TypeCode.Empty)
								{
									int num2 = listBox.Items.Add(value);
									if (typeCode == value)
									{
										num = num2;
									}
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							foreach (object value2 in Enum.GetValues(context.PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType))
							{
								if ((int)value2 != 0)
								{
									int num3 = listBox.Items.Add(value2);
									if (object.Equals(obj, value2))
									{
										num = num3;
									}
								}
							}
						}
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							listBox.SelectedIndex = num;
						}
						windowsFormsEditorService.DropDownControl(listBox);
						int num4 = ((listBox.SelectedItem != null) ? ((int)listBox.SelectedItem) : 0);
						if (context.PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType == typeof(Type))
						{
							object typeFromTypeCode = GetTypeFromTypeCode((TypeCode)num4);
							if (obj == null || !object.Equals(obj, typeFromTypeCode))
							{
								obj = typeFromTypeCode;
								context.OnComponentChanged();
							}
						}
						else if (obj == null || (int)obj != num4)
						{
							Type propertyType = context.PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType;
							obj = Activator.CreateInstance(propertyType);
							propertyType.GetFields()[0].SetValue(obj, num4);
							context.OnComponentChanged();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public class SimpleToStringTypeConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			return destinationType == typeof(string);
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (destinationType == typeof(string))
			{
				return value.ToString();
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException();
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Utils.CommonDialogs.Internal

	public sealed class CommonDialogProvider : CommonDialogProviderBase
	{
		private static object syncRoot = new object();

		private static CommonDialogProvider instanceCore;

		public static CommonDialogProvider Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (instanceCore == null)
				{
					lock (syncRoot)
					{
						if (instanceCore == null)
						{
							instanceCore = new CommonDialogProvider();
						}
					}
				}
				return instanceCore;
			}
		}

		private CommonDialogProvider()
		{
		}

		protected override IOpenFileDialog StandardOpenFileDialogFactory()
		{
			return (IOpenFileDialog)(object)new OpenFileDialogWrapper();
		}

		protected override ISaveFileDialog StandardSaveFileDialogFactory()
		{
			return (ISaveFileDialog)(object)new SaveFileDialogWrapper();
		}

		protected override IFolderBrowserDialog StandardFolderBrowserDialogFactory()
		{
			return (IFolderBrowserDialog)(object)new FolderBrowserDialogWrapper();
		}
	}
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public abstract class BaseCommonDialogWrapper<T> : System.Windows.Forms.CommonDialog, ICommonDialog, IDisposable where T : System.Windows.Forms.CommonDialog
	{
		protected T Dialog { get; private set; }

		protected BaseCommonDialogWrapper(T dialog)
		{
			Dialog = dialog;
			SubscribeDialogEvents();
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeDialogEvents()
		{
			Dialog.HelpRequest += Dialog_HelpRequest;
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeDialogEvents()
		{
			Dialog.HelpRequest -= Dialog_HelpRequest;
		}

		private void Dialog_HelpRequest(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnHelpRequest(e);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			Dialog.Reset();
		}

		protected override bool RunDialog(IntPtr hwndOwner)
		{
			return CommonDialogRuntimeHelper.RunDialog(Dialog, hwndOwner);
		}

		DialogResult ICommonDialog.ShowDialog(object owner)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DialogResult dialogResult = ((!(owner is System.Windows.Forms.IWin32Window owner2)) ? ShowDialog() : ShowDialog(owner2));
			return Convert(dialogResult);
		}

		DialogResult ICommonDialog.ShowDialog()
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DialogResult dialogResult = ShowDialog();
			return Convert(dialogResult);
		}

		private DialogResult Convert(DialogResult dialogResult)
		{
			return (DialogResult)(dialogResult switch
			{
				DialogResult.OK => 1, 
				DialogResult.Cancel => 2, 
				DialogResult.Abort => 2, 
				DialogResult.Retry => 4, 
				DialogResult.Ignore => 5, 
				DialogResult.Yes => 6, 
				DialogResult.No => 7, 
				_ => 0, 
			});
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				DisposeCore();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected virtual void DisposeCore()
		{
			UnsubscribeDialogEvents();
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ICommonDialog.add_HelpRequest(EventHandler value)
		{
			base.HelpRequest += value;
		}

		[SpecialName]
		void ICommonDialog.remove_HelpRequest(EventHandler value)
		{
			base.HelpRequest -= value;
		}
	}
	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	public abstract class FileDialogWrapperBase<T> : BaseCommonDialogWrapper<T>, IFileDialog, ICommonDialog, IDisposable where T : System.Windows.Forms.FileDialog
	{
		private class FileDialogCustomPlacesCollectionWrapper : FileDialogCustomPlacesCollection
		{
			private readonly FileDialogCustomPlacesCollection nativeDialogCollection;

			public FileDialogCustomPlacesCollectionWrapper(FileDialogCustomPlacesCollection nativeDialogCollection)
			{
				this.nativeDialogCollection = nativeDialogCollection;
			}

			protected override void ClearItems()
			{
				((Collection<FileDialogCustomPlace>)this).ClearItems();
				nativeDialogCollection.Clear();
			}

			protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
			{
				((Collection<FileDialogCustomPlace>)this).RemoveItem(index);
				nativeDialogCollection.RemoveAt(index);
			}

			protected override void InsertItem(int index, FileDialogCustomPlace item)
			{
				((Collection<FileDialogCustomPlace>)this).InsertItem(index, item);
				nativeDialogCollection.Insert(index, Convert(item));
			}

			protected override void SetItem(int index, FileDialogCustomPlace item)
			{
				((Collection<FileDialogCustomPlace>)this).SetItem(index, item);
				nativeDialogCollection[index] = Convert(item);
			}

			private System.Windows.Forms.FileDialogCustomPlace Convert(FileDialogCustomPlace item)
			{
				if (item.KnownFolderGuid != Guid.Empty)
				{
					return new System.Windows.Forms.FileDialogCustomPlace(item.KnownFolderGuid);
				}
				return new System.Windows.Forms.FileDialogCustomPlace(item.Path);
			}
		}

		private FileDialogCustomPlacesCollectionWrapper customPlacesCore;

	public static class BaseFileDialogCustomPlaceHelper
	{
		public static System.Windows.Forms.FileDialogCustomPlace ConvertTo(FileDialogCustomPlace item)
		{
			if (item.KnownFolderGuid != Guid.Empty)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Forms.FileDialogCustomPlace(item.KnownFolderGuid);
			}
			return new System.Windows.Forms.FileDialogCustomPlace(item.Path);
		}

		public static FileDialogCustomPlace ConvertFrom(System.Windows.Forms.FileDialogCustomPlace item)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!(item.KnownFolderGuid != Guid.Empty))
			{
				return new FileDialogCustomPlace(item.Path);
			}
			return new FileDialogCustomPlace(item.KnownFolderGuid);
		}
	}

	public static class CommonDialogRuntimeHelper
	{
		internal static readonly MethodInfo runDialog = typeof(System.Windows.Forms.CommonDialog).GetMethod("RunDialog", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);

		private static MethodInfo onHelpRequestMethodInfo = typeof(System.Windows.Forms.CommonDialog).GetMethod("OnHelpRequest", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);

		private static MethodInfo onFileOkMethodInfo = typeof(System.Windows.Forms.FileDialog).GetMethod("OnFileOk", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);

		public static void InvokeHelpRequest<TDialog>(TDialog dialog, EventArgs args) where TDialog : System.Windows.Forms.CommonDialog
		{
			if (dialog != null)
			{
				onHelpRequestMethodInfo.Invoke(dialog, new object[1] { args });
			}
		}

		public static bool RunDialog<TDialog>(TDialog dialog, IntPtr hwndOwner) where TDialog : System.Windows.Forms.CommonDialog
		{
			if (dialog == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (bool)runDialog.Invoke(dialog, new object[1] { hwndOwner });
		}

		public static void InvokeFileOk<TDialog>(TDialog dialog, CancelEventArgs args) where TDialog : System.Windows.Forms.FileDialog
		{
			if (dialog != null)
			{
				onFileOkMethodInfo.Invoke(dialog, new object[1] { args });
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class PlatformCursorsServiceBaseDesktop<TPortableCursorType>
	{
		private DesktopCursor defaultCursor;

		private CurrentCursorWrapper currentCursor;

		private Dictionary<TPortableCursorType, DesktopCursor> cursors;

		private Dictionary<TPortableCursorType, Func<DesktopCursor>> cursorFactory;

		public IPortableCursor Current
		{
			get
			{
				return (IPortableCursor)(object)currentCursor;
			}
			set
			{
				currentCursor.Apply(value);
			}
		}

		protected Dictionary<TPortableCursorType, Func<DesktopCursor>> CursorFactory => cursorFactory;

		protected PlatformCursorsServiceBaseDesktop()
		{
			currentCursor = new CurrentCursorWrapper();
			defaultCursor = CreateDefaultCursor();
			cursors = new Dictionary<TPortableCursorType, DesktopCursor>();
			cursorFactory = new Dictionary<TPortableCursorType, Func<DesktopCursor>>();
			RegisterCursorCreators();
		}

		protected abstract DesktopCursor CreateDefaultCursor();

		protected abstract void RegisterCursorCreators();

		public IPortableCursor GetCursor(TPortableCursorType cursorType)
		{
			try
			{
				if (cursors.TryGetValue(cursorType, out var value))
				{
					return (IPortableCursor)(object)value;
				}
				if (cursorFactory.TryGetValue(cursorType, out var value2))
				{
					value = value2();
					cursors[cursorType] = value;
					return (IPortableCursor)(object)value;
				}
				return (IPortableCursor)(object)defaultCursor;
			}
			catch
			{
				return (IPortableCursor)(object)defaultCursor;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class PlatformCursorsServiceDesktop : PlatformCursorsServiceBaseDesktop<PortableCursorType>, IPlatformCursorsService
	{
		private const int IMAGE_CURSOR = 2;

		private const int LR_LOADFROMFILE = 16;

		private static bool dragAndDropCursorsLoaded;

		private static Cursor moveEffectCursor;

		private static Cursor copyEffectCursor;

		private static Cursor linkEffectCursor;

		protected override DesktopCursor CreateDefaultCursor()

			AddCursorCreator((PortableCursorType)29, () => GetDragMoveEffectCursor());
			AddCursorCreator((PortableCursorType)30, () => GetDragCopyEffectCursor());
			AddCursorCreator((PortableCursorType)31, () => GetDragLinkEffectCursor());
		}

		protected void AddCursorCreator(PortableCursorType cursorType, Func<Cursor> getPlatformCursor)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Func<DesktopCursor> value = () => new DesktopCursor
			{
				CursorType = cursorType,
				PlatformCursor = getPlatformCursor()
			};
			base.CursorFactory[cursorType] = value;
		}

		private Cursor GetDragNoneEffectCursor()
		{
			LoadDragAndDropCursors();
			return noneEffectCursor;
		}

		private Cursor GetDragMoveEffectCursor()
		{
			LoadDragAndDropCursors();
			return moveEffectCursor;
		}

		private Cursor GetDragCopyEffectCursor()
		{
			LoadDragAndDropCursors();
			return copyEffectCursor;
		}

		private Cursor GetDragLinkEffectCursor()
		{
			LoadDragAndDropCursors();
			return linkEffectCursor;
		}

		[DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
		private static extern IntPtr LoadLibraryEx(string lpFileName, IntPtr hFile, uint dwFlags);

		[DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
		private static extern IntPtr FreeLibrary(IntPtr hModule);

		[DllImport("user32.dll")]
		private static extern IntPtr LoadCursor(IntPtr hModule, uint cursorIndex);

		[DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
		internal static extern IntPtr LoadImage(IntPtr hInst, string stName, int nType, int cxDesired, int cyDesired, int nFlags);

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static void LoadDragAndDropCursors()
		{
			if (dragAndDropCursorsLoaded)
			{
				return;
			}
			IntPtr intPtr = IntPtr.Zero;
			try
			{
				intPtr = LoadLibraryEx("ole32.dll", IntPtr.Zero, 2u);
				if (intPtr == IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					noneEffectCursor = Cursors.No;
					moveEffectCursor = Cursors.Default;
					copyEffectCursor = Cursors.Default;
					linkEffectCursor = Cursors.Default;
				}
				else
				{
					noneEffectCursor = LoadCursor(intPtr, 1u, Cursors.No);
					moveEffectCursor = LoadCursor(intPtr, 2u, Cursors.Default);
					copyEffectCursor = LoadCursor(intPtr, 3u, Cursors.Default);
					linkEffectCursor = LoadCursor(intPtr, 4u, Cursors.Default);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				noneEffectCursor = Cursors.No;
				moveEffectCursor = Cursors.Default;
				copyEffectCursor = Cursors.Default;
				linkEffectCursor = Cursors.Default;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (intPtr != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					FreeLibrary(intPtr);
				}
				dragAndDropCursorsLoaded = true;
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static Cursor LoadCursor(IntPtr hModule, uint cursorIndex, Cursor defaultCursor)
		{
			IntPtr intPtr = LoadCursor(hModule, cursorIndex);
			if (!(intPtr != IntPtr.Zero))
			{
				return defaultCursor;
			}
			return new Cursor(intPtr);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static IntPtr CreateCursor(Stream cursorStream)
		{
			IntPtr result = IntPtr.Zero;
			string tempFileName = Path.GetTempFileName();
			try
			{
				using (BinaryReader binaryReader = new BinaryReader(cursorStream))
				{
					using FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(tempFileName, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None);
					byte[] array = binaryReader.ReadBytes(4096);
					int num;
					for (num = array.Length; num >= 4096; num = binaryReader.Read(array, 0, 4096))
					{
						fileStream.Write(array, 0, 4096);
					}
					fileStream.Write(array, 0, num);
				}
				result = LoadImage(IntPtr.Zero, tempFileName, 2, 0, 0, 16);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				try
				{
					if (File.Exists(tempFileName))
					{
						File.Delete(tempFileName);
					}
				}
				catch (IOException)
				{
				}
				catch (UnauthorizedAccessException)
				{
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public IPortableCursor FromResources(string resourceName, Assembly asm)
		{
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IntPtr intPtr = CreateCursor(asm.GetManifestResourceStream(resourceName));
			Cursor platformCursor = ((intPtr != IntPtr.Zero) ? new Cursor(intPtr) : ResourceImageHelper.CreateCursorFromResources(resourceName, asm));
			PortableCursorType cursorType = (PortableCursorType)(-1);
			return (IPortableCursor)(object)new DesktopCursor
			{
				PlatformCursor = platformCursor,
				CursorType = cursorType
			};
		}
	}

	public abstract class LocalizableTypedList : Component, IDisplayNameProvider, ITypedList
	{
		private readonly ITypedList typedList;

		private static FieldInfo fi_displayName;

		public LocalizableTypedList(ITypedList typedList)
		{
			this.typedList = typedList;
		}

		PropertyDescriptorCollection ITypedList.GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			fi_displayName = fi_displayName ?? NativeField<MemberDescriptor>.Ensure("displayName");
			string[] first = ((listAccessors != null) ? ToFieldAccessors(listAccessors) : new string[0]);
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = typedList.GetItemProperties(listAccessors);
			for (int i = 0; i < itemProperties.Count; i++)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = itemProperties[i];
				string[] array = first.Concat(new string[1] { propertyDescriptor.Name }).ToArray();
				string fieldDisplayName = ((IDisplayNameProvider)this).GetFieldDisplayName(array);
				fi_displayName.SetValue(propertyDescriptor, fieldDisplayName);
			}
			return itemProperties;
		}

		private static string[] ToFieldAccessors(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			string[] array = new string[listAccessors.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < listAccessors.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = listAccessors[i].Name;
			}
			return array;
		}

		string ITypedList.GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			if (listAccessors == null || listAccessors.Length == 0)
			{
				return ((IDisplayNameProvider)this).GetDataSourceDisplayName();
			}
			return typedList.GetListName(listAccessors);
		}

		string IDisplayNameProvider.GetDataSourceDisplayName()
		{
			return GetDataSourceDisplayName();
		}

		string IDisplayNameProvider.GetFieldDisplayName(string[] fieldAccessors)
		{
			return GetFieldDisplayName(fieldAccessors);
		}

		protected abstract string GetDataSourceDisplayName();

		protected abstract string GetFieldDisplayName(string[] fieldAccessors);
	}

	public static class ShellHelper
	{
		public static void TryCreateShortcut(string applicationId, string name, string iconPath = null)
		{
			string shortcutPath = GetShortcutPath(name);
			if (!File.Exists(shortcutPath))
			{
				InstallShortcut(shortcutPath, applicationId, iconPath);
			}
		}

		public static void TryCreateShortcut(string exePath, string applicationId, string name, string iconPath = null)
		{
			string shortcutPath = GetShortcutPath(name);
			if (!File.Exists(shortcutPath))
			{
				InstallShortcut(exePath, shortcutPath, applicationId, iconPath);
			}
		}

		public static void TryCreateShortcut(string applicationId, string name, string iconPath, Type activatorType)
		{
			TryCreateShortcut(null, applicationId, name, iconPath, activatorType);
		}

		public static void TryCreateShortcut(string exePath, string applicationId, string name, string iconPath, Type activatorType)
		{
			exePath = PatchExePath(exePath);
			string shortcutPath = GetShortcutPath(name);
			if (!File.Exists(shortcutPath))
			{
				InstallShortcut(exePath, shortcutPath, applicationId, iconPath, activatorType);
			}
		}

		public static void TryRemoveShortcut(string name)
		{
			string shortcutPath = GetShortcutPath(name);
			if (File.Exists(shortcutPath))
			{
				File.Delete(shortcutPath);
			}
		}

		public static bool IsApplicationShortcutExist(string name)
		{
			string shortcutPath = GetShortcutPath(name);
			return File.Exists(shortcutPath);
		}

		private static string GetShortcutPath(string name)
		{
			return Path.Combine(GetProgramsFolder(), name + ".lnk");
		}

		private static void InstallShortcut(string shortcutPath, string applicationId, string iconPath)
		{
			InstallShortcut(GetSourcePath(), shortcutPath, applicationId, iconPath);
		}

		private static void InstallShortcut(string exePath, string shortcutPath, string applicationId, string iconPath)
		{
			InstallShortcut(exePath, shortcutPath, applicationId, iconPath, null);
		}

		private static void InstallShortcut(string exePath, string shortcutPath, string applicationId, string iconPath, Type activatorType)
		{
			IShellLinkW shellLinkW = (IShellLinkW)new CShellLink();
			SetExePath(exePath, shellLinkW);
			SetArguments(shellLinkW);
			SetIconLocation(iconPath, shellLinkW);
			IPropertyStore newShortcutProperties = (IPropertyStore)shellLinkW;
			SetAppId(applicationId, newShortcutProperties);
			SetActivatorId(activatorType, newShortcutProperties);
			SaveShortcut(shortcutPath, shellLinkW);
		}

		private static void SaveShortcut(string shortcutPath, IShellLinkW newShortcut)
		{
			DevExpress.Internal.WinApi.IPersistFile persistFile = (DevExpress.Internal.WinApi.IPersistFile)newShortcut;
			ErrorHelper.VerifySucceeded(persistFile.Save(shortcutPath, fRemember: true));
		}

		private static void SetArguments(IShellLinkW newShortcut)
		{
			ErrorHelper.VerifySucceeded(newShortcut.SetArguments(""));
		}

		private static void SetExePath(string exePath, IShellLinkW newShortcut)
		{
			ErrorHelper.VerifySucceeded(newShortcut.SetPath(exePath));
		}

		private static void SetIconLocation(string iconPath, IShellLinkW newShortcut)
		{
			if (iconPath != null)
			{
				newShortcut.SetIconLocation(iconPath, 0);
			}
		}

		private static void SetActivatorId(Type activatorType, IPropertyStore newShortcutProperties)
		{
			if (activatorType == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			using PropVariant pv = new PropVariant(activatorType.GUID);
			PropertyKey key = new PropertyKey(new Guid("{9F4C2855-9F79-4B39-A8D0-E1D42DE1D5F3}"), 26);
			SetShortcutPropertiesValue(newShortcutProperties, key, pv);
		}

		private static void SetAppId(string applicationId, IPropertyStore newShortcutProperties)
		{
			using PropVariant pv = new PropVariant(applicationId);
			PropertyKey key = new PropertyKey(new Guid("{9F4C2855-9F79-4B39-A8D0-E1D42DE1D5F3}"), 5);
			SetShortcutPropertiesValue(newShortcutProperties, key, pv);
		}

		private static void SetShortcutPropertiesValue(IPropertyStore newShortcutProperties, PropertyKey key, PropVariant pv)
		{
			PropertyKey key2 = key;
			ErrorHelper.VerifySucceeded(newShortcutProperties.SetValue(ref key2, pv));
			CommitShortcutProperties(newShortcutProperties);
		}

		private static void CommitShortcutProperties(IPropertyStore newShortcutProperties)
		{
			ErrorHelper.VerifySucceeded(newShortcutProperties.Commit());
		}

		private static string GetProgramsFolder()
		{
			return Environment.GetFolderPath(Environment.SpecialFolder.Programs);
		}

		private static string GetSourcePath()
		{
			return Process.GetCurrentProcess().MainModule.FileName;
		}

		private static string PatchExePath(string exePath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(exePath))
			{
				exePath = GetSourcePath();
			}
			return exePath;
		}

		private static string GetRegistryKeyName(Type activatorType)
		{
			return $"SOFTWARE\\Classes\\CLSID\\{{{activatorType.GUID.ToString()}}}\\LocalServer32";
		}

		public static void UnregisterComServer(Type activatorType)
		{
			string registryKeyName = GetRegistryKeyName(activatorType);
			try
			{
				using (RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(registryKeyName))
				{
					if (registryKey == null)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				Registry.CurrentUser.DeleteSubKeyTree(registryKeyName);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		public static void RegisterApplicationActivator(Type activatorType)
		{
			ToastNotificationActivatorBase.Register(activatorType);
		}

		public static void UnregisterApplicationActivator()
		{
			ToastNotificationActivatorBase.Unregister();
		}

		public static void RegisterComServer(Type activatorType)
		{
			RegisterComServer(null, activatorType);
		}

		public static void RegisterComServer(string exePath, Type activatorType)
		{
			if (!WindowsVersionProvider.IsWindows10)
			{
				return;
			}
			ToastNotificationActivatorBase.CheckType(activatorType);
			string registryKeyName = GetRegistryKeyName(activatorType);
			exePath = PatchExePath(exePath);
			using (RegistryKey registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(registryKeyName))
			{
				if (string.Equals((registryKey == null) ? null : (registryKey.GetValue(null) as string), exePath, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			using RegistryKey registryKey2 = Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey(registryKeyName);
			registryKey2.SetValue(null, exePath);
		}
	}

	public class CurrencyDataController : BaseGridController
	{
		private enum CurrencyManagerSyncReason
		{
			ItemMoved,
			ItemDeleted,
			ItemAdded,
			General
		}

		private delegate void ListChangedDelegate(ListChangedEventArgs e);

		private BindingContext bindingContext;

		private CurrencyManager currencyManager;

		private int lockPositionChange;

		private int lockCurrencyResetEvent;

		private bool refreshFired;

		private bool fieldRequested;

		private FieldInfo suspendPushDataInCurrentChangedInfo;

		private bool syncPositionOnItemChanged;

		private CurrencyManagerSyncReason? requireSyncCurrencyManager;

		private int deleteProgress;

		private int deleteSavedVisibleIndex;

		private int tempDeatchedListSourceRow = int.MinValue;

		internal bool finishingNewItemRowEdit;

		private int cancelingRowEdit;

		protected override object BindingContext
		{
			get
			{
				return bindingContext;
			}
			set
			{
				((BaseGridController)this).SetDataSource(value, ((BaseGridController)this).DataSource, ((BaseGridController)this).DataMember);
			}
		}

		protected CurrencyManager CurrencyManager
		{
			get
			{
				return currencyManager;
			}
			set
			{
				if (CurrencyManager != value)
				{
					if (CurrencyManager != null)
					{
						CurrencyManager.CurrentChanged -= OnCurrencyManager_CurrentChanged;
						CurrencyManager.ItemChanged -= OnCurrencyManager_ItemChanged;
						CurrencyManager.PositionChanged -= OnCurrencyManager_PositionChanged;
					}
					currencyManager = value;
					if (CurrencyManager != null)
					{
						CurrencyManager.CurrentChanged += OnCurrencyManager_CurrentChanged;
						CurrencyManager.ItemChanged += OnCurrencyManager_ItemChanged;
						CurrencyManager.PositionChanged += OnCurrencyManager_PositionChanged;
					}
					OnCurrencyManagerChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected int CurrencyManagerPosition
		{
			get
			{
				if (CurrencyManager != null)
				{
					return CurrencyManager.Position;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			set
			{
				if (CurrencyManager == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value < 0 || value >= CurrencyManager.Count)
				{
					value = 0;
				}
				if (CurrencyManager.Position == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					CurrencyManager.Position = value;
				}
				catch (IndexOutOfRangeException)
				{
					if (!((BaseGridController)this).IsCurrentRowEditing)
					{
						throw;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool IsPositionNotificationLocked => lockPositionChange != 0;

		private bool IsDeletingRow => deleteProgress != 0;

		[Obsolete("The multithreading issue detection is disabled. You may encounter inconsistent or corrupted data.")]
		public static bool DisableThreadingProblemsDetection
		{
			get
			{
				return BaseGridController._DisableThreadingProblemsDetection;
			}
			set
			{
				BaseGridController._DisableThreadingProblemsDetection = value;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsCurrencyResetEventLocked => lockCurrencyResetEvent != 0;

		static CurrencyDataController()
		{
			DesktopBridge.Install();
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			((DataControllerBase)this).ClearClients();
			CurrencyManager = null;
			((BaseGridController)this).Dispose();
		}

		public override void RefreshData()
		{
			refreshFired = false;
			if (((DataControllerBase)this).IsReady && CurrencyManager != null)
			{
				CurrencyManager.Refresh();
				if (refreshFired)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			((BaseGridController)this).RefreshData();
		}

		protected override void DoRefresh(bool useRowsKeeper)
		{
			refreshFired = true;
			((DataController)this).DoRefresh(useRowsKeeper);
		}

		public override bool IsControllerRowValid(int controllerRow)
		{
			if (((DataControllerBase)this).IsReady && controllerRow == -2147483647 && ((DataControllerBase)this).Helper.GetNewItemRowIndex() != int.MinValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((DataController)this).IsControllerRowValid(controllerRow);
		}

		public override int GetListSourceRowIndex(int controllerRow)
		{
			if (controllerRow == -2147483647)
			{
				if (cancelingRowEdit != 0)
				{
					return int.MinValue;
				}
				return ((DataControllerBase)this).Helper.GetNewItemRowIndex();
			}
			return ((DataController)this).GetListSourceRowIndex(controllerRow);
		}

		protected override void OnRefreshed()
		{
			((BaseGridController)this).OnRefreshed();
			((BaseGridController)this).SyncCurrentRow();
		}

		protected override SelectionController CreateSelectionController()
		{
			return (SelectionController)(object)new CurrencySelectionController((DataController)(object)this);
		}

		public override void SetDataSource(object context, object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			DataSourceInfo val = ((DataController)this).CreateSourceInfo(((DataController)this).AllowSmartDataSourceChange);
			try
			{
				if (dataMember == null)
				{
					dataMember = string.Empty;
				}

	public class CalculatedColumnExpressionEditorLogic : ExpressionEditorLogic
	{
		private CalculatedColumn calculatedColumn;

		public CalculatedColumnExpressionEditorLogic(IExpressionEditor editor, CalculatedColumn calculatedColumn)
			: base(editor, (object)calculatedColumn)
		{
			this.calculatedColumn = calculatedColumn;
		}

		protected override object[] GetListOfInputTypesObjects()
		{
			return new object[4]
			{
				base.editor.GetResourceString("Functions.Text"),
				base.editor.GetResourceString("Operators.Text"),
				base.editor.GetResourceString("Fields.Text"),
				base.editor.GetResourceString("Constants.Text")
			};
		}

		protected internal override void FillParametersTable(Dictionary<string, string> itemsTable)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void FillFieldsTable(Dictionary<string, string> itemsTable)
		{
			if (calculatedColumn == null || calculatedColumn.owner == null || calculatedColumn.owner.ComparativeDataSource == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor basePropertyDescriptor in calculatedColumn.owner.ComparativeDataSource.BasePropertyDescriptors)
			{
				string key = ConvertString(EscapeFieldName(basePropertyDescriptor.Name));
				itemsTable[key] = string.Format(base.editor.GetResourceString("GridFields Description Prefix"), basePropertyDescriptor.Name, basePropertyDescriptor.DisplayName, basePropertyDescriptor.PropertyType.ToString());
			}
		}

		private static string ConvertString(string expression)
		{
			try
			{
				return CriteriaOperator.ToString(CriteriaOperator.Parse(expression, new object[0]));
			}
			catch
			{
				return expression;
			}
		}

		private static string EscapeFieldName(string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return ((object)new OperandProperty(fieldName)).ToString();
		}

		protected override void ValidateExpressionEx(string expression)
		{
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Expected O, but got Unknown
			expression = ((ExpressionEditorLogic)this).ConvertToFields(expression);
			CriteriaOperator val = CriteriaOperator.Parse(expression, (object[])null);
			if (calculatedColumn != null && calculatedColumn.owner != null && calculatedColumn.owner.ComparativeDataSource != null)
			{
				ExpressionEvaluator val2 = new ExpressionEvaluator(calculatedColumn.owner.ComparativeDataSource.BasePropertyDescriptors, val);
			}
		}

		protected override string GetExpressionMemoEditText()
		{
			if (calculatedColumn != null)
			{
				return calculatedColumn.Expression;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}

	{
		private ComparativeDataSourceCore comparativeDataSourceCore;

		private object dataSource;

		private bool isDisposed;

		private IList outputSource;

		internal ComparativeDataSourceCore ComparativeDataSource
		{
			get
			{
				if (comparativeDataSourceCore == null)
				{
					comparativeDataSourceCore = CreateComparativeDataSourceCore();
				}
				return comparativeDataSourceCore;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public CalculatedColumnCollection CalculatedColumns => ComparativeDataSource.CalculatedColumns;

		[AttributeProvider(typeof(IListSource))]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Category("Data")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[Description("")]
		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				if (outputSource == null)
				{
					return dataSource;
				}
				return comparativeDataSourceCore.DataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isDisposed)
				{
					return;
				}
				IList list;
				if (value != null)
				{
					if (value is IList)
					{
						list = (IList)value;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!(value is IListSource))
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException("DataSource");
						}
						if (((IListSource)value).ContainsListCollection)
						{
							return;
						}
						list = ((IListSource)value).GetList();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list = null;
				}
				if (outputSource == null)
				{
					if (dataSource != list)
					{
						dataSource = list;
					}
				}
				else if (outputSource == comparativeDataSourceCore && comparativeDataSourceCore.DataSource != list)
				{
					comparativeDataSourceCore.DataSource = list;
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(ShowValues.All)]
		public ShowValues ShowValues
		{
			get
			{
				return ComparativeDataSource.ShowValues;
			}
			set
			{
				ComparativeDataSource.ShowValues = value;
			}
		}

		bool IListSource.ContainsListCollection => false;

		public event EventHandler<CustomAttributesEventArgs> CustomAttributes;

		public event EventHandler<CustomEqualsAttributesEventArgs> CustomEquals;

		public ComparativeSource()
		{
			outputSource = ComparativeDataSource;
		}

		private ComparativeDataSourceCore CreateComparativeDataSourceCore()
		{
			return new ComparativeDataSourceCore(DataSource, this);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			isDisposed = true;
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		internal void RaiseCustomAttributes(CustomAttributesEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (this.CustomAttributes != null)
			{
				this.CustomAttributes(this, eventArgs);
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseCustomEquals(CustomEqualsAttributesEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (this.CustomEquals != null)
			{
				this.CustomEquals(this, eventArgs);
			}
		}

		IList IListSource.GetList()
		{
			if (outputSource == null)
			{
				if (isDisposed)
				{
					throw new ObjectDisposedException(ToString());
				}
				outputSource = ComparativeDataSource;
			}
			return outputSource;
		}

		{
			if (e.ListChangedType == ListChangedType.Reset || e.ListChangedType >= ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorAdded)

				UpdateInnerProperties();
			}
			if (this.ListChanged != null)

			}

		{

				this.ListChanged(this, new ListChangedEventArgs(ListChangedType.Reset, -1));

	public class ComparativePropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
	{
		private AttributeCollection attributeCollectionCore;

		private HashSet<object> blackList = new HashSet<object>();

		private bool isReadOnly = true;

		private Dictionary<object, PropertyDescriptor> propertyDescriptorDictionary = new Dictionary<object, PropertyDescriptor>();

		private PropertyDescriptor realPropertyDescriptor;

		internal HashSet<AttributeCollection> attributeFromAllDescriptors = new HashSet<AttributeCollection>();

		private ComparativeSource owner;

		public override AttributeCollection Attributes
		{
			get
			{
				if (attributeCollectionCore == null)
				{
					attributeCollectionCore = attributeFromAllDescriptors.First();
					foreach (AttributeCollection attributeFromAllDescriptor in attributeFromAllDescriptors)
					{
						foreach (Attribute item in attributeFromAllDescriptor)
						{
							attributeCollectionCore = AttributeCollection.FromExisting(attributeCollectionCore, item);
						}
					}
				}
				if (owner != null)
				{
					CustomAttributesEventArgs e = new CustomAttributesEventArgs(Name, isCalculatedColumn: false);
					owner.RaiseCustomAttributes(e);
					attributeCollectionCore = AttributeCollection.FromExisting(attributeCollectionCore, e.Attributes.ToArray());
				}
				return attributeCollectionCore;
			}
		}

		public override string Category => realPropertyDescriptor.Category;

		public override Type ComponentType => realPropertyDescriptor.ComponentType;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => isReadOnly;

		public override Type PropertyType => realPropertyDescriptor.PropertyType;

		public ComparativePropertyDescriptor(ComparativeSource owner, PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor)
			: base(propertyDescriptor)
		{
			realPropertyDescriptor = propertyDescriptor;
			attributeFromAllDescriptors.Add(propertyDescriptor.Attributes);
			isReadOnly = propertyDescriptor.IsReadOnly;
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		private void FirstCheckComponent(object component)
		{
			if (!propertyDescriptorDictionary.ContainsKey(component))
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(component);
				int num = properties.IndexOf(realPropertyDescriptor);
				if (num == -1)
				{
					blackList.Add(component);
				}
				PropertyDescriptor value = ((num == -1) ? null : properties[num]);
				propertyDescriptorDictionary.Add(component, value);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateProperties(AttributeCollection attributeCollection, bool isReadOnly)
		{
			if (!isReadOnly)
			{
				this.isReadOnly = isReadOnly;
			}
			attributeFromAllDescriptors.Add(attributeCollection);
		}

		public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
		{
			FirstCheckComponent(component);
			if (blackList.Contains(component))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return propertyDescriptorDictionary[component].CanResetValue(component);
		}

		public override object GetValue(object component)
		{
			FirstCheckComponent(component);
			if (blackList.Contains(component))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return propertyDescriptorDictionary[component].GetValue(component);
		}

		public override void ResetValue(object component)
		{
			FirstCheckComponent(component);
			if (!blackList.Contains(component))
			{
				propertyDescriptorDictionary[component].ResetValue(component);
			}
		}

		public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
		{
			FirstCheckComponent(component);
			if (!blackList.Contains(component))
			{
				propertyDescriptorDictionary[component].SetValue(component, value);
			}
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
		{
			FirstCheckComponent(component);
			if (blackList.Contains(component))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return propertyDescriptorDictionary[component].ShouldSerializeValue(component);
		}
	}
	public class ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection : PropertyDescriptorCollection
	{
		public new static readonly ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection Empty = new ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection(null, readOnly: true);

		public ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection(PropertyDescriptor[] properties)
			: base(properties)
		{
		}

		public ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection(PropertyDescriptor[] properties, bool readOnly)
			: base(properties, readOnly)
		{
		}

		private static void AddCalculatedPropertyDescriptors(CalculatedColumnCollection calculatedColumnCollection, ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection comparativePropertyDesriptorCollection)
		{
			foreach (CalculatedColumn item in calculatedColumnCollection)
			{
				comparativePropertyDesriptorCollection.Add((PropertyDescriptor)(object)new CalculatedColumnPropertyDescriptor(item, comparativePropertyDesriptorCollection));
			}
		}

		private static void AddComparativePropertyDescriptor(Dictionary<PropertyDescriptor, ComparativePropertyDescriptor> result, PropertyDescriptorCollection collection, ComparativeSource owner)
		{
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in collection)
			{
				if (!result.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
				{
					value = new ComparativePropertyDescriptor(owner, item);
					result.Add(item, value);
				}
				else
				{
					value.UpdateProperties(item.Attributes, item.IsReadOnly);
				}
			}
		}

		private static ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection FilterByShowValues(IBindingList DataSourceAdapter, ComparativeSource owner, ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection comparativePropertyDescriptorCollection)
		{
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			switch (owner.ShowValues)
			{
			case ShowValues.Same:
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in comparativePropertyDescriptorCollection)
				{
					bool flag2 = true;
					for (int j = 0; j < DataSourceAdapter.Count - 1; j++)
					{
						object value3 = item.GetValue(DataSourceAdapter[j]);
						object value4 = item.GetValue(DataSourceAdapter[j + 1]);
						CustomEqualsAttributesEventArgs e2 = new CustomEqualsAttributesEventArgs(value3, value4, item);
						owner.RaiseCustomEquals(e2);
						if (!e2.CustomEquals)
						{
							flag2 = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				return new ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
			case ShowValues.Different:
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item2 in comparativePropertyDescriptorCollection)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					for (int i = 0; i < DataSourceAdapter.Count - 1; i++)
					{
						object value = item2.GetValue(DataSourceAdapter[i]);
						object value2 = item2.GetValue(DataSourceAdapter[i + 1]);
						CustomEqualsAttributesEventArgs e = new CustomEqualsAttributesEventArgs(value, value2, item2);
						owner.RaiseCustomEquals(e);
						if (!e.CustomEquals)
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						list.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				return new ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
			default:
				return comparativePropertyDescriptorCollection;
			}
		}

		internal static ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection CreatePropertyDescriptorCollectionBase(IBindingList dataSourceAdapter, ComparativeSource owner)
		{
			if (dataSourceAdapter == null)
			{
				return Empty;
			}
			Dictionary<PropertyDescriptor, ComparativePropertyDescriptor> dictionary = new Dictionary<PropertyDescriptor, ComparativePropertyDescriptor>();
			if (dataSourceAdapter is ITypedList)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = ((ITypedList)dataSourceAdapter).GetItemProperties(null);
				AddComparativePropertyDescriptor(dictionary, itemProperties, owner);
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (object item in dataSourceAdapter)
				{
					PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(item);
					AddComparativePropertyDescriptor(dictionary, itemProperties, owner);
				}
			}
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = dictionary.Values.ToArray();
			return new ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
		}

		internal static ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection CreateFullPropertyDescriptorCollection(IBindingList DataSourceAdapter, ComparativeSource owner)
		{
			ComparativePropertyDescriptorCollection comparativePropertyDescriptorCollection = CreatePropertyDescriptorCollectionBase(DataSourceAdapter, owner);
			if (comparativePropertyDescriptorCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return Empty;
			}
			AddCalculatedPropertyDescriptors(owner.CalculatedColumns, comparativePropertyDescriptorCollection);
			return FilterByShowValues(DataSourceAdapter, owner, comparativePropertyDescriptorCollection);
		}
	}
	public enum ShowValues
	{
		All,
		Same,
		Different
	}
