	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public static class ClipboardAccessTrace
	{
		internal abstract class ClipboardAccessPolicyViolationException : SecurityException
		{
			private const string articleMessage = "See the https://go.devexpress.com/.NET_SafeClipboard.aspx article for additional information.";

			protected ClipboardAccessPolicyViolationException(string message)
				: base(message + " See the https://go.devexpress.com/.NET_SafeClipboard.aspx article for additional information.")
			{
			}
		}

		internal sealed class ClipboardAccessNotAllowedException : ClipboardAccessPolicyViolationException
		{
			private const string messageFormat = "The clipboard '{0}' operation for '{1}' data format is not allowed due to security reasons.";

			private ClipboardAccessNotAllowedException(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
				: base($"The clipboard '{operation.ToString()}' operation for '{dataFormat}' data format is not allowed due to security reasons.")
			{
			}

			public static void Throw(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
			{
				throw new ClipboardAccessNotAllowedException(operation, dataFormat);
			}
		}

		private sealed class AlreadyInDiagnosticsContextException : ClipboardAccessPolicyViolationException
		{
			private const string messageFormat = "You cannot enter the {0} security context within another security context.";

			private AlreadyInDiagnosticsContextException(string level)
				: base($"You cannot enter the {level} security context within another security context.")
			{
			}

			public static void Throw(string levelName)
			{
				throw new AlreadyInDiagnosticsContextException(levelName);
			}
		}

		private sealed class Context : IDisposable
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static Context Instance;

			private readonly ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel level;

			private ClipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver resolver;

			private readonly ClipboardAccessAllowedContext allowedContext;

			public static readonly ClipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver DefaultResolver = (ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat, ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel _) => ResolveCore(operation, dataFormat, diagnosticsLevel);

			public Context(ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel level, ClipboardAccessAllowedContext allowedContext)
			{
				EnsureAlreadyInDiagnosticsContext(this);
				this.level = level;
				resolver = allowedContext.Resolve;
				this.allowedContext = allowedContext;
			}

			private static void EnsureAlreadyInDiagnosticsContext(Context @this)
			{
				if (Instance != null)
				{
					AlreadyInDiagnosticsContextException.Throw(Instance.level.ToString());
				}
				Instance = @this;
			}

			private ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel Resolve(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
			{
				return (resolver ?? ((ClipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver)((ClipboardOperation o, string df, ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel l) => l)))(operation, dataFormat, level);
			}

			private ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel Resolve(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat, ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel? level)
			{
				if (resolver != DefaultResolver && resolver != null)
				{
					return resolver(operation, dataFormat, level.GetValueOrDefault(this.level));
				}
				return this.level;
			}

			public static ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel Resolve(ClipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver resolver, ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat, ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel? level)
			{
				if (Instance != null && resolver != DefaultResolver)
				{
					return Instance.Resolve(operation, dataFormat, level);
				}
				return level.GetValueOrDefault();
			}

			private static ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel ResolveCore(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat, ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel? level)
			{
				if (Instance != null)
				{
					ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel clipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel = Instance.Resolve(operation, dataFormat);
					if (clipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel != ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel.Default)
					{
						return clipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel;
					}
				}
				return level ?? ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel.Default;
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
				Instance = null;
				((IDisposable)allowedContext)?.Dispose();
				resolver = null;
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}
		}

		internal static ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel? diagnosticsLevel;

		internal static ClipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver diagnosticsLevelResolver;

		private static TraceSource traceSource;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal static void SetLevel(ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel level, ClipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver resolver)
		{
			diagnosticsLevel = level;
			diagnosticsLevelResolver = resolver;
		}

		internal static IDisposable Enter(ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel level, Action<ClipboardAccessAllowedContext> setup)
		{
			return new Context(level, new ClipboardAccessAllowedContext(setup));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		internal static bool ShouldThrowAlways()
		{
			return diagnosticsLevel == ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel.Throw;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void Allowed(Action allowedAction, Action<ClipboardAccessAllowedContext> setup)
		{
			using (Enter(ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel.Default, setup))
			{
				allowedAction?.Invoke();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void Allowed(Action allowedAction, ClipboardOperation operation)
		{
			Allowed(allowedAction, delegate(ClipboardAccessAllowedContext x)
			{
				x.Allowed(operation);
			});
		}

		internal static void Assert(ClipboardOperation operation)
		{
			Assert(operation, string.Empty, ResolveTraceLevel(operation, string.Empty));
		}

		internal static void Assert(ClipboardOperation operation, ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel actualTraceLevel)
		{
			Assert(operation, string.Empty, actualTraceLevel);
		}

		internal static void Assert(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
		{
			Assert(operation, dataFormat, ResolveTraceLevel(operation, dataFormat));
		}

		internal static void Assert(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat, ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel actualTraceLevel)
		{
			switch (actualTraceLevel)
			{
			case ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel.Disable:
				return;
			case ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel.Throw:
				Trace(TraceEventType.Critical, operation, dataFormat);
				ClipboardAccessNotAllowedException.Throw(operation, dataFormat);
				break;
			}
			if (actualTraceLevel == ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel.Trace)
			{
				Trace(TraceEventType.Warning, operation, dataFormat);
			}
			else
			{
				Trace(TraceEventType.Information, operation, dataFormat);
			}
		}

		internal static ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel ResolveTraceLevel(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
		{
			ClipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver clipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver = diagnosticsLevelResolver ?? Context.DefaultResolver;
			return clipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver(operation, dataFormat, Context.Resolve(clipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver, operation, dataFormat, diagnosticsLevel));
		}

		private static void Trace(TraceEventType eventType, ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
		{
			if (traceSource == null)
			{
				traceSource = new TraceSource("DevExpress.Data.Diagnostics.ClipboardAccessPolicyTrace", SourceLevels.Critical);
			}
			traceSource.TraceEvent(eventType, 0, operation.ToString() + " - " + dataFormat);
		}
	}
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public static class ProcessStartTrace
	{
		internal abstract class ProcessStartPolicyViolationException : SecurityException
		{
			private const string articleMessage = "See the https://go.devexpress.com/.NET_SafeProcess_Start.aspx article for additional information.";

			protected ProcessStartPolicyViolationException(string message)
				: base(message + " See the https://go.devexpress.com/.NET_SafeProcess_Start.aspx article for additional information.")
			{
			}
		}

		private sealed class NonTrustedProcessStartException : ProcessStartPolicyViolationException
		{
			private const string messageFormat = "The {0} process is not allowed to start due to security reasons.";

			private NonTrustedProcessStartException(string typeName)
				: base($"The {typeName} process is not allowed to start due to security reasons.")
			{
			}

			public static void Throw(ProcessStartInfo startInfo)
			{
				throw new NonTrustedProcessStartException(startInfo.FileName);
			}
		}

		internal sealed class ProcessStartConfirmationNeededException : ProcessStartPolicyViolationException
		{
			private const string messageFormat = "The {0} process is not allowed to start without confirmation due to security reasons.";

			public bool ConfirmationPlatformAvailable { get; private set; }

			private ProcessStartConfirmationNeededException(string typeName, bool confirmationPlatformAvailable)
				: base($"The {typeName} process is not allowed to start without confirmation due to security reasons.")
			{
				ConfirmationPlatformAvailable = confirmationPlatformAvailable;
			}

			public static void Throw(ProcessStartInfo startInfo, bool confirmationAvailable)
			{
				throw new ProcessStartConfirmationNeededException(startInfo.FileName, confirmationAvailable);
			}
		}

		private sealed class AlreadyInDiagnosticsContextException : ProcessStartPolicyViolationException
		{
			private const string messageFormat = "You cannot enter the {0} security context within another security context.";

			private AlreadyInDiagnosticsContextException(string level)
				: base($"You cannot enter the {level} security context within another security context.")
			{
			}

			public static void Throw(string levelName)
			{
				throw new AlreadyInDiagnosticsContextException(levelName);
			}
		}

		private sealed class Context : IDisposable
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static Context Instance;

			private readonly ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel level;

			private ProcessStartTraceLevelResolver resolver;

			private readonly ProcessStartTrustedContext trustedContext;

			public static readonly ProcessStartTraceLevelResolver DefaultResolver = (ProcessStartInfo startInfo, ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel _) => ResolveCore(startInfo, diagnosticsLevel);

			public Context(ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel level, ProcessStartTrustedContext trustedContext)
			{
				EnsureAlreadyInDiagnosticsContext(this);
				this.level = level;
				resolver = trustedContext.Resolve;
				this.trustedContext = trustedContext;
			}

			private static void EnsureAlreadyInDiagnosticsContext(Context @this)
			{
				if (Instance != null)
				{
					AlreadyInDiagnosticsContextException.Throw(Instance.level.ToString());
				}
				Instance = @this;
			}

			private ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel Resolve(ProcessStartInfo startInfo)
			{
				return (resolver ?? ((ProcessStartTraceLevelResolver)((ProcessStartInfo psi, ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel _) => _)))(startInfo, level);
			}

			private ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel Resolve(ProcessStartInfo startInfo, ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel? level)
			{
				if (resolver != DefaultResolver && resolver != null)
				{
					return resolver(startInfo, level.GetValueOrDefault(this.level));
				}
				return this.level;
			}

			public static ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel Resolve(ProcessStartTraceLevelResolver resolver, ProcessStartInfo startInfo, ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel? level)
			{
				if (Instance != null && resolver != DefaultResolver)
				{
					return Instance.Resolve(startInfo, level);
				}
				return level.GetValueOrDefault();
			}

			private static ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel ResolveCore(ProcessStartInfo startInfo, ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel? level)
			{
				if (Instance != null)
				{
					ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel processStartDiagnosticsLevel = Instance.Resolve(startInfo);
					if (processStartDiagnosticsLevel != ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Default)
					{
						return processStartDiagnosticsLevel;
					}
				}
				if (DXLinks.IsDXLink(startInfo))
				{
					return ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Disable;
				}
				return level ?? ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Default;
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
				Instance = null;
				((IDisposable)trustedContext)?.Dispose();
				resolver = null;
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}
		}

		internal static ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel? diagnosticsLevel;

		internal static ProcessStartTraceLevelResolver diagnosticsLevelResolver;

		private static TraceSource traceSource;

		internal static void SetLevel(ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel level, ProcessStartTraceLevelResolver resolver)
		{
			diagnosticsLevel = level;
			diagnosticsLevelResolver = resolver;
		}

		internal static IDisposable Enter(ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel level, Action<ProcessStartTrustedContext> setup)
		{
			return new Context(level, new ProcessStartTrustedContext(setup));
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void Trusted(Action trustedAction, Action<ProcessStartTrustedContext> setup)
		{
			using (Enter(ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Default, setup))
			{
				trustedAction?.Invoke();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void Trusted(Action trustedAction, string fileName)
		{
			Trusted(trustedAction, delegate(ProcessStartTrustedContext x)
			{
				x.Trusted(fileName);
			});
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static void Trusted(Action trustedAction, string fileName, string arguments)
		{
			Trusted(trustedAction, delegate(ProcessStartTrustedContext x)
			{
				x.Trusted(fileName, arguments);
			});
		}

		internal static void Assert(ProcessStartInfo startInfo)
		{
			Assert(startInfo, ResolveTraceLevel(startInfo));
		}

		internal static void Assert(ProcessStartInfo startInfo, ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel actualTraceLevel)
		{
			switch (actualTraceLevel)
			{
			case ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Disable:
				return;
			case ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Throw:
				Trace(startInfo, TraceEventType.Critical);
				NonTrustedProcessStartException.Throw(startInfo);
				break;
			}
			if (actualTraceLevel == ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Confirm)
			{
				Trace(startInfo, TraceEventType.Warning);
				ProcessStartConfirmationNeededException.Throw(startInfo, MessageLoop.IsAvailable);
			}
			if (actualTraceLevel == ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Trace)
			{
				Trace(startInfo, TraceEventType.Warning);
			}
			else
			{
				Trace(startInfo, TraceEventType.Information);
			}
		}

		internal static ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel ResolveTraceLevel(ProcessStartInfo startInfo)
		{
			ProcessStartTraceLevelResolver processStartTraceLevelResolver = diagnosticsLevelResolver ?? Context.DefaultResolver;
			return processStartTraceLevelResolver(startInfo, Context.Resolve(processStartTraceLevelResolver, startInfo, diagnosticsLevel));
		}

		private static void Trace(ProcessStartInfo startInfo, TraceEventType eventType)
		{
			if (traceSource == null)
			{
				traceSource = new TraceSource("DevExpress.Data.Diagnostics.ProcessStartPolicyTrace", SourceLevels.Critical);
			}
			traceSource.TraceEvent(eventType, 0, startInfo.FileName);
		}
	}
	internal static class DXLinks
	{
		private static readonly HashSet<string> links = new HashSet<string>
		{
			"https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_Competitive_Discounts.aspx", "https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_CompareSubscriptions.aspx", "https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_DownloadTrial.aspx", "Https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_Chat.aspx", "Https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_Help.aspx", "Https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_BuyNow.aspx", "https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_BuyNow_ASP.aspx", "Https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_13_2_WhatsNew.aspx", "Https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_GetSupport.aspx", "Https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_GetStartedOverall.aspx",
			"https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_RegisterTrial.aspx", "https://go.devexpress.com/Demo_2013_GetStartedWinGrid.aspx", "mailto:info@devexpress.com", "http://www.devexpress.com", "http://www.devexpress.com/products", "http://www.devexpress.com/downloads", "http://www.devexpress.com/Support/KnowledgeBase/"
		};

		public static bool IsDXLink(ProcessStartInfo startInfo)
		{
			string fileName = startInfo.FileName ?? string.Empty;
			string arguments = startInfo.Arguments ?? string.Empty;
			return IsDXLink(fileName, arguments);
		}

		public static bool IsDXLink(string fileName, string arguments)
		{
			if (!links.Contains(fileName + "," + arguments))
			{
				if (links.Contains(fileName))
				{
					return string.IsNullOrEmpty(arguments);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Data.Diagnostics
{
	public enum ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel
	{
		Default,
		Trace,
		Throw,
		Disable
	}
	public delegate ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel ClipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat, ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel traceLevel);
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public sealed class ClipboardAccessAllowedContext : IDisposable
	{
		private struct ClipboardAccessAllowedData : IEquatable<ClipboardAccessAllowedData>
		{
			public readonly ClipboardOperation Operation;

			public readonly string DataFormat;

			public ClipboardAccessAllowedData(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
			{
				Operation = operation;
				DataFormat = dataFormat;
			}

			public bool Match(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
			{
				if ((Operation & operation) != operation)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataFormat) && DataFormat != dataFormat)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public bool Equals(ClipboardAccessAllowedData other)
			{
				if (other.Operation == Operation)
				{
					return other.DataFormat == DataFormat;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj is ClipboardAccessAllowedData)
				{
					return Equals((ClipboardAccessAllowedData)obj);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return HashCodeHelper.CalculateGeneric<int, string>((int)Operation, DataFormat);
			}
		}

		private readonly ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel? initialDiagnosticsLevel;

		private readonly ClipboardAccessTraceLevelResolver initialResolver;

		private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<ClipboardAccessAllowedData, bool> allowed = new ConcurrentDictionary<ClipboardAccessAllowedData, bool>();

		internal ClipboardAccessAllowedContext(Action<ClipboardAccessAllowedContext> setup)
		{
			initialDiagnosticsLevel = ClipboardAccessTrace.diagnosticsLevel;
			initialResolver = ClipboardAccessTrace.diagnosticsLevelResolver;
			setup?.Invoke(this);
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			allowed.Clear();
			ClipboardAccessTrace.diagnosticsLevel = initialDiagnosticsLevel;
			ClipboardAccessTrace.diagnosticsLevelResolver = initialResolver;
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public ClipboardAccessAllowedContext Allowed(ClipboardOperation operation)
		{
			allowed.TryAdd(new ClipboardAccessAllowedData(operation, string.Empty), value: false);
			return this;
		}

		public ClipboardAccessAllowedContext Allowed(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
		{
			allowed.TryAdd(new ClipboardAccessAllowedData(operation, dataFormat), value: false);
			return this;
		}

		public ClipboardAccessAllowedContext Allowed(string[] dataFormats)
		{
			foreach (string dataFormat in dataFormats)
			{
				allowed.TryAdd(new ClipboardAccessAllowedData(ClipboardOperation.All, dataFormat), value: false);
			}
			return this;
		}

		internal ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel Resolve(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat, ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel traceLevel)
		{
			if (allowed.Any((KeyValuePair<ClipboardAccessAllowedData, bool> x) => x.Key.Match(operation, dataFormat)))
			{
				return ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel.Disable;
			}
			return traceLevel;
		}
	}
	public enum ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel
	{
		Default,
		Trace,
		Confirm,
		Throw,
		Disable
	}
	public delegate ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel ProcessStartTraceLevelResolver(ProcessStartInfo startInfo, ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel traceLevel);
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public sealed class ProcessStartTrustedContext : IDisposable
	{
		private readonly ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel? initialDiagnosticsLevel;

		private readonly ProcessStartTraceLevelResolver initialResolver;

		private readonly HashSet<string> fileNames = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

		private readonly HashSet<string> fileNamesAndArguments = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);

		internal ProcessStartTrustedContext(Action<ProcessStartTrustedContext> setup)
		{
			initialDiagnosticsLevel = ProcessStartTrace.diagnosticsLevel;
			initialResolver = ProcessStartTrace.diagnosticsLevelResolver;
			setup?.Invoke(this);
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			fileNames.Clear();
			fileNamesAndArguments.Clear();
			ProcessStartTrace.diagnosticsLevel = initialDiagnosticsLevel;
			ProcessStartTrace.diagnosticsLevelResolver = initialResolver;
			GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
		}

		public ProcessStartTrustedContext Trusted(string fileName)
		{
			fileNames.Add(fileName ?? string.Empty);
			return this;
		}

		public ProcessStartTrustedContext Trusted(string fileName, string arguments)
		{
			fileNamesAndArguments.Add((fileName ?? string.Empty) + "," + (arguments ?? string.Empty));
			return this;
		}

		internal ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel Resolve(ProcessStartInfo startInfo, ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel traceLevel)
		{
			string text = startInfo.FileName ?? string.Empty;
			string text2 = startInfo.Arguments ?? string.Empty;
			if (DXLinks.IsDXLink(text, text2))
			{
				return ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Disable;
			}
			if (fileNamesAndArguments.Contains(text + "," + text2))
			{
				return ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Disable;
			}
			if (fileNames.Contains(text))
			{
				return ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Disable;
			}
			return traceLevel;
		}
	}
}

					}
					return instanceCore;
				}

			}

			{
				((WeakEventHandler<ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs, EventHandler<ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs>>)Instance).Purge();
				((WeakEventHandler<ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs, EventHandler<ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs>>)Instance).Add((Delegate)value);
			}

			internal static void RemoveHandler(EventHandler<ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs> value)
			{
				((WeakEventHandler<ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs, EventHandler<ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs>>)Instance).Remove((Delegate)value);
			}

			internal static bool Raise()
			{
				if (instanceCore == null)
				{
					return !IsClearOperationSuppressed;
				}
				ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs e = new ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs(ClipboardOperation.Clear, (IPortableDataObject)null, IsClearOperationSuppressed);
				((WeakEventHandler<ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs, EventHandler<ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs>>)Instance).Raise(syncObj, e);

			}
		}

		public class ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs : CancelEventArgs
		{
			[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
			public bool IsClearOperation => (Operation & ClipboardOperation.Clear) == ClipboardOperation.Clear;

			[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
			public bool IsCopyOperation => (Operation & ClipboardOperation.Copy) == ClipboardOperation.Copy;

			[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
			public bool IsPasteOperation => (Operation & ClipboardOperation.Paste) == ClipboardOperation.Paste;

			public bool IsUIStateQuery => (Operation & ClipboardOperation.UIStateQuery) == ClipboardOperation.UIStateQuery;

			public ClipboardOperation Operation { get; private set; }

			public string DataFormat { get; private set; }

			public bool IsDataObjectRequested { get; internal set; }

			[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
			public IPortableDataObject DataObject { get; private set; }

			internal ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat, bool cancel)
				: base(cancel)
			{
				Operation = operation;
				DataFormat = dataFormat;
			}

			internal ClipboardOperationRequestEventArgs(ClipboardOperation operation, IPortableDataObject data, bool cancel)
				: base(cancel)
			{
				Operation = operation;
				DataObject = data;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				if (DataObject != null || IsDataObjectRequested)
				{
					return Operation.ToString() + " with dataobject requested. Will be cancelled: " + base.Cancel + ".";
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataFormat))
				{
					return Operation.ToString() + " requested. DataFormat: " + DataFormat + ". Will be cancelled: " + base.Cancel + ".";
				}
				return Operation.ToString() + " requested. Will be cancelled: " + base.Cancel + ".";
			}
		}

		public class ClipboardOperationEventArgs : EventArgs
		{
			[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
			public bool IsClearOperation => (Operation & ClipboardOperation.Clear) == ClipboardOperation.Clear;

			[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
			public bool IsCopyOperation => (Operation & ClipboardOperation.Copy) == ClipboardOperation.Copy;

			[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
			public bool IsPasteOperation => (Operation & ClipboardOperation.Paste) == ClipboardOperation.Paste;

			public ClipboardOperation Operation { get; private set; }

			public string DataFormat { get; private set; }

			public IPortableDataObject DataObject { get; private set; }

			internal ClipboardOperationEventArgs(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
			{
				Operation = operation;
				DataFormat = dataFormat;
			}

			internal ClipboardOperationEventArgs(ClipboardOperation operation, IPortableDataObject data)
			{
				Operation = operation;
				DataObject = data;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				if (DataObject != null)
				{
					return Operation.ToString() + " with dataobject complete.";
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataFormat))
				{
					return Operation.ToString() + " complete. DataFormat: " + DataFormat;
				}
				return Operation.ToString() + " complete";
			}
		}

		public class FailedEventArgs : ClipboardOperationEventArgs
		{
			public Exception Exception { get; private set; }

			public bool Throw { get; set; }

			internal FailedEventArgs(Exception exception, ClipboardOperation operation)
				: base(operation, (IPortableDataObject)null)
			{
				Exception = exception;
				Throw = ShouldThrow(exception);
			}

			internal FailedEventArgs(Exception exception, ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
				: base(operation, dataFormat)
			{
				Exception = exception;
				Throw = ShouldThrow(exception);
			}

			internal FailedEventArgs(Exception exception, ClipboardOperation operation, IPortableDataObject data)
				: base(operation, data)
			{
				Exception = exception;
				Throw = ShouldThrow(exception);
			}

			internal static bool ShouldThrow(Exception exception)
			{
				if (ShouldThrowOnErrors)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (exception is ClipboardAccessTrace.ClipboardAccessPolicyViolationException)
				{
					return ClipboardAccessTrace.ShouldThrowAlways();
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				if (Exception == null)
				{
					return base.Operation.ToString() + " failed. Will throw: " + Throw;
				}
				return base.Operation.ToString() + " failed due to " + (Exception?.GetType().Name ?? string.Empty) + " Will throw: " + Throw;
			}
		}

		private static readonly object syncObj = new object();

		private static int throwOnErrorsCounter;

		private static int allSuppressionCounter;

		private static int containsSuppressionCounter;

		private static int clearSuppressionCounter;

		private static int copySuppressionCounter;

		private static int pasteSuppressionCounter;

		private static readonly Lazy<ClipboardAccessAllowedContext> registrations = new Lazy<ClipboardAccessAllowedContext>(() => CreateRegistrations());

		internal static bool ShouldThrowOnErrors => throwOnErrorsCounter > 0;

		internal static bool IsContainsOperationSuppressed
		{
			get
			{
				if (containsSuppressionCounter <= 0)
				{
					return allSuppressionCounter > 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsClearOperationSuppressed
		{
			get
			{
				if (clearSuppressionCounter <= 0)
				{
					return allSuppressionCounter > 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsCopyOperationSuppressed
		{
			get
			{
				if (copySuppressionCounter <= 0)
				{
					return allSuppressionCounter > 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsPasteOperationSuppressed
		{
			get
			{
				if (pasteSuppressionCounter <= 0)
				{
					return allSuppressionCounter > 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private static ClipboardAccessAllowedContext Registrations => registrations.Value;

		public static void ThrowAlways()
		{
			ClipboardAccessTrace.SetLevel(ClipboardAccessDiagnosticsLevel.Throw, ClipboardAccessTrace.diagnosticsLevelResolver);
		}

		public static void ThrowOnErrors()
		{
			throwOnErrorsCounter++;
		}

		public static void SuppressAllOperations()
		{
			allSuppressionCounter++;
		}

		public static void SuppressContainsOperations()
		{
			containsSuppressionCounter++;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static void SuppressClearOperations()
		{
			clearSuppressionCounter++;
		}

		public static void SuppressCopyOperations()
		{
			copySuppressionCounter++;
		}

		public static void SuppressPasteOperations()
		{
			pasteSuppressionCounter++;
		}

		public static void AllowOperation(ClipboardOperation operation)
		{
			Registrations.Allowed(operation);
		}

		public static void AllowOperation(ClipboardOperation operation, string dataFormat)
		{
			Registrations.Allowed(operation, dataFormat);
		}

		public static void AllowDataFormats(params string[] dataFormats)
		{
			Registrations.Allowed(dataFormats);
		}

		{

			ClipboardAccessTrace.diagnosticsLevelResolver = clipboardAccessAllowedContext.Resolve;
			return clipboardAccessAllowedContext;
		}

	public static class NativeWindowGuard
	{
		private static class HWNDStructProxy
		{
			public static object Zero = IntPtr.Zero;

			private static MethodInfo implicitCastMethod;

			private static MethodInfo explicitCastMethod;

			public static bool EnsureHandleObject(object handleObject, out IntPtr handle)
			{
				if (handleObject == null)
				{
					handle = IntPtr.Zero;
					return true;
				}
				Type type = handleObject.GetType();
				if (type == typeof(IntPtr))
				{
					handle = (IntPtr)handleObject;
					return true;
				}
				handle = IntPtr.Zero;
				if (type == hwndStructType)
				{
					if (!EnsureImplicitCastToIntPtrMethod())
					{
						return false;
					}
					object[] parameters = new object[1] { handleObject };
					handle = (IntPtr)implicitCastMethod.Invoke(null, parameters);
					if (explicitCastMethod == null || Zero is IntPtr)
					{
						if (!EnsureExplicitCastFromIntPtrMethod())
						{
							return false;
						}
						Zero = explicitCastMethod.Invoke(null, new object[1] { IntPtr.Zero });
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			internal static bool EnsureImplicitCastToIntPtrMethod()
			{
				if (implicitCastMethod == null && hwndStructType != null)
				{
					implicitCastMethod = hwndStructType.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public).FirstOrDefault((MethodInfo x) => x.Name == "op_Implicit" && Returns(x, typeof(IntPtr)));
				}
				return implicitCastMethod != null;
			}

			private static bool Returns(MethodInfo method, Type returnType)
			{
				return method.ReturnType == returnType;
			}

			internal static bool EnsureExplicitCastFromIntPtrMethod()
			{
				if (explicitCastMethod == null && hwndStructType != null)
				{
					explicitCastMethod = hwndStructType.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public).FirstOrDefault((MethodInfo x) => x.Name == "op_Explicit" && Accepts(x, typeof(IntPtr)));
				}
				return explicitCastMethod != null;
			}

			private static bool Accepts(MethodInfo method, Type parameterType)
			{
				ParameterInfo[] parameters = method.GetParameters();
				if (parameters.Length == 1)
				{
					return parameters[0].ParameterType == parameterType;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static readonly Type hwndStructType;

		private static FieldInfo fi_Handle;

		static NativeWindowGuard()
		{
			if (PlatformHelpers.IsNet8OrGreater)
			{
				hwndStructType = typeof(NativeWindow).GetProperty("HWND", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic)?.PropertyType ?? typeof(IntPtr);
			}
		}

		public static IntPtr PerformActionWithoutHandle(NativeWindow nativeWindow, Action action)
		{
			fi_Handle = fi_Handle ?? NativeField<NativeWindow>.Try("handle", "Handle") ?? NativeField<NativeWindow>.Ensure("HWND", "HWND");
			if (fi_Handle != null)
			{
				object value = fi_Handle.GetValue(nativeWindow);
				if (HWNDStructProxy.EnsureHandleObject(value, out var handle))
				{
					fi_Handle.SetValue(nativeWindow, HWNDStructProxy.Zero);
					action?.Invoke();
					fi_Handle.SetValue(nativeWindow, value);
				}
				else
				{
					action?.Invoke();
				}
				return handle;
			}
			return IntPtr.Zero;
		}
	}
	public static class ProcessStartPolicy
	{
		public class ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs : EventArgs
		{
			public Exception Exception { get; private set; }

			public bool Throw { get; set; }

			public ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs(Exception exception)
			{
				Exception = exception;
				Throw = throwOnErrorsCounter > 0;
			}
		}

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static int suppressionCounter;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static int throwOnErrorsCounter;

		private static readonly Lazy<ProcessStartTrustedContext> registrations = new Lazy<ProcessStartTrustedContext>(() => CreateRegistrations());

		private static SafeProcess.IConfirmationService defaultConfirmationServiceCore;

		internal static bool IsProcessStartSuppressed => suppressionCounter > 0;

		private static ProcessStartTrustedContext Registrations => registrations.Value;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public static SafeProcess.IConfirmationService DefaultConfirmationService
		{
			get

				return defaultConfirmationServiceCore ?? DevExpress.Data.Utils.DefaultConfirmationService.Instance;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == null && defaultConfirmationServiceCore != null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException();
				}
				defaultConfirmationServiceCore = value;
			}
		}

		public static event CancelEventHandler Starting
		{
			add

		}

		{

			remove

		public static void ThrowAlways()

		}

			ProcessStartTrace.SetLevel(ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Confirm, ProcessStartTrace.diagnosticsLevelResolver);
		}

		}

		}

	public static class SafeProcess
	{
		public interface IConfirmationService
		{
			bool? Confirm(IConfirmationInfo info);
		}

		public interface IConfirmationInfo
		{
			string Title { get; }

			string Header { get; }

			string Location { get; }

			string FileName { get; }

			string Message { get; }
		}

		private sealed class ProcessStartResult
		{
			public readonly Process Process;

			public readonly Exception Exception;

			public static ProcessStartResult NotStarted = new ProcessStartResult(null, null);

			public bool Failed => Exception != null;

			private ProcessStartResult(Process process, Exception exception)
			{
				Process = process;
				Exception = exception;
			}

			public static ProcessStartResult FromProcess(Process process)
			{
				return new ProcessStartResult(process, null);
			}

			public static ProcessStartResult FromException(Exception exception)
			{
				return new ProcessStartResult(null, exception);
			}
		}

		internal sealed class StartingWeakEventHandler : WeakEventHandler<CancelEventArgs, CancelEventHandler>
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static StartingWeakEventHandler instanceCore;

			private static StartingWeakEventHandler Instance
			{
				get
				{
					if (instanceCore == null)
					{
						Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref instanceCore, new StartingWeakEventHandler(), null);
					}
					return instanceCore;
				}
			}

			private StartingWeakEventHandler()
			{
			}

			internal static void AddHandler(CancelEventHandler value)
			{
				((WeakEventHandler<CancelEventArgs, CancelEventHandler>)Instance).Purge();
				((WeakEventHandler<CancelEventArgs, CancelEventHandler>)Instance).Add((Delegate)value);
			}

			internal static void RemoveHandler(CancelEventHandler value)
			{
				((WeakEventHandler<CancelEventArgs, CancelEventHandler>)Instance).Remove((Delegate)value);
			}

			internal static bool RaiseStarting(ProcessStartInfo startInfo)
			{
				CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs(ProcessStartPolicy.IsProcessStartSuppressed);
				((WeakEventHandler<CancelEventArgs, CancelEventHandler>)Instance).Raise((object)startInfo, e);
				return !e.Cancel;
			}
		}

		internal sealed class StartedWeakEventHandler : WeakEventHandler<EventArgs, EventHandler>
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static StartedWeakEventHandler instanceCore;

			private static StartedWeakEventHandler Instance
			{
				get
				{
					if (instanceCore == null)
					{
						Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref instanceCore, new StartedWeakEventHandler(), null);
					}
					return instanceCore;
				}
			}

			private StartedWeakEventHandler()
			{
			}

			internal static void AddHandler(EventHandler value)
			{
				((WeakEventHandler<EventArgs, EventHandler>)Instance).Purge();
				((WeakEventHandler<EventArgs, EventHandler>)Instance).Add((Delegate)value);
			}

			internal static void RemoveHandler(EventHandler value)
			{
				((WeakEventHandler<EventArgs, EventHandler>)Instance).Remove((Delegate)value);
			}

			internal static void RaiseStarted(Process process)
			{
				((WeakEventHandler<EventArgs, EventHandler>)Instance).Raise((object)process, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		internal sealed class FailedWeakEventHandler : WeakEventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs, EventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs>>
		{
			[ThreadStatic]
			private static FailedWeakEventHandler instanceCore;

			private static FailedWeakEventHandler Instance
			{
				get
				{
					if (instanceCore == null)
					{
						Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref instanceCore, new FailedWeakEventHandler(), null);
					}
					return instanceCore;
				}
			}

			private FailedWeakEventHandler()
			{
			}

			internal static void AddHandler(EventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs> value)
			{
				((WeakEventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs, EventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs>>)Instance).Purge();
				((WeakEventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs, EventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs>>)Instance).Add((Delegate)value);
			}

			internal static void RemoveHandler(EventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs> value)
			{
				((WeakEventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs, EventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs>>)Instance).Remove((Delegate)value);
			}

			internal static bool RaiseFailed(ProcessStartInfo startInfo, Exception exception)
			{
				ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs e = new ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs(exception);
				((WeakEventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs, EventHandler<ProcessStartPolicy.ProcessStartFailedExceptionEventArgs>>)Instance).Raise((object)startInfo, e);
				return e.Throw;
			}
		}

		private sealed class ConfirmationInfo : IConfirmationInfo
		{
			private readonly ProcessStartInfo startInfo;

			public string FileName
			{
				get
				{
					if (startInfo == null)
					{
						return string.Empty;
					}
					return startInfo.FileName;
				}
			}

			public string Title => ProcessStartConfirmationLocalizer.GetString((ProcessStartConfirmationStringId)0);

			public string Header => ProcessStartConfirmationLocalizer.GetString((ProcessStartConfirmationStringId)1);

			public string Location => ProcessStartConfirmationLocalizer.GetString((ProcessStartConfirmationStringId)2);

			public string Message => ProcessStartConfirmationLocalizer.GetString((ProcessStartConfirmationStringId)3);

			public ConfirmationInfo(ProcessStartInfo startInfo)
			{
				this.startInfo = startInfo;
			}
		}

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static IntegrityContainer serviceContainer;

		public static void RegisterConfirmationService(IConfirmationService service)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (serviceContainer == null)
			{
				Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref serviceContainer, new IntegrityContainer(), null);
			}
			serviceContainer.RegisterInstance<IConfirmationService>(service);
		}

		public static Process Start(string fileName, string arguments = null, Action<ProcessStartInfo> setup = null)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return StartCore(CreateProcessStartInfoCore(fileName, arguments), setup).Process;
		}

		public static bool TryStart(string fileName, string arguments = null, Action<ProcessStartInfo> setup = null)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !StartCore(CreateProcessStartInfoCore(fileName, arguments), setup).Failed;
		}

		public static Process Open(string fileName, string arguments = null, Action<ProcessStartInfo> setup = null)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return OpenCore(fileName, arguments, setup).Process;
		}

		public static bool TryOpen(string fileName, string arguments = null, Action<ProcessStartInfo> setup = null)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !OpenCore(fileName, arguments, setup).Failed;
		}

		public static void Wait(string fileName, string arguments = null, Action<ProcessStartInfo> setup = null)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				Process process = StartCore(CreateProcessStartInfoCore(fileName, arguments), setup).Process;
				if (process != null && !process.HasExited)
				{
					process.WaitForExit();
				}
			}
		}

		public static Process StartConfirmed(string fileName, string arguments = null, Action<ProcessStartInfo> setup = null)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fileName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return StartConfirmedCore(CreateProcessStartInfoCore(fileName, arguments), setup).Process;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static ProcessStartResult StartCore(ProcessStartInfo processStartInfo, Action<ProcessStartInfo> setup)
		{
			setup?.Invoke(processStartInfo);
			if (!StartingWeakEventHandler.RaiseStarting(processStartInfo))
			{
				return ProcessStartResult.NotStarted;
			}
			try
			{
				ProcessStartTrace.Assert(processStartInfo);
			}
			catch (ProcessStartTrace.ProcessStartConfirmationNeededException ex)
			{
				if (!ex.ConfirmationPlatformAvailable)
				{
					throw;
				}
				bool? flag = ConfirmCore(processStartInfo);
				if (!flag.HasValue)
				{
					throw;
				}
				if (!flag.Value)
				{
					return ProcessStartResult.NotStarted;
				}
			}
			return StartCore(processStartInfo);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static ProcessStartResult StartConfirmedCore(ProcessStartInfo processStartInfo, Action<ProcessStartInfo> setup)
		{
			setup?.Invoke(processStartInfo);
			if (!StartingWeakEventHandler.RaiseStarting(processStartInfo))
			{
				return ProcessStartResult.NotStarted;
			}
			ProcessStartTrace.Assert(processStartInfo, ProcessStartDiagnosticsLevel.Trace);
			if (ProcessStartPolicy.IsProcessStartSuppressed)
			{
				return ProcessStartResult.NotStarted;
			}
			return StartCore(processStartInfo);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static ProcessStartResult StartCore(ProcessStartInfo processStartInfo)
		{
			try
			{
				Process process = Process.Start(processStartInfo);
				StartedWeakEventHandler.RaiseStarted(process);
				return ProcessStartResult.FromProcess(process);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (FailedWeakEventHandler.RaiseFailed(processStartInfo, exception))
				{
					throw;
				}
				return ProcessStartResult.FromException(exception);
			}
		}

		private static ProcessStartResult OpenCore(string fileName, string arguments, Action<ProcessStartInfo> setup)
		{
			ProcessStartInfo processStartInfo = CreateProcessStartInfoCore(fileName, arguments);
			processStartInfo.Verb = "Open";
			processStartInfo.WindowStyle = ProcessWindowStyle.Normal;
			return StartCore(processStartInfo, setup);
		}

		private static ProcessStartInfo CreateProcessStartInfoCore(string fileName, string arguments)
		{
			return new ProcessStartInfo(fileName, arguments)
			{
				UseShellExecute = true
			};
		}

		private static bool? ConfirmCore(ProcessStartInfo processStartInfo)
		{
			if (ProcessStartPolicy.IsProcessStartSuppressed)
			{
				return true;
			}
			try
			{
				IConfirmationService confirmationService = ProcessStartPolicy.DefaultConfirmationService;
				if (serviceContainer != null)
				{
					confirmationService = serviceContainer.Resolve<IConfirmationService>();
				}
				return confirmationService.Confirm(new ConfirmationInfo(processStartInfo));
			}
			catch (ResolutionFailedException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
	public static class RegistryHelper
	{
		private static readonly string InstallationRegistryKey = BuildInstallationKey();

		private static string BuildInstallationKey()
		{
			string text = "SOFTWARE\\DevExpress\\Components\\v23.2";
			if (Environment.Is64BitProcess)
			{
				return text.Replace("SOFTWARE", "SOFTWARE\\WOW6432Node");
			}
			return text;
		}

		public static RegistryKey OpenInstallationRegistryKey()
		{
			return Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey(InstallationRegistryKey);
		}

		public static string GetDevExpressRootDirectory()
		{
			RegistryKey registryKey = OpenInstallationRegistryKey();
			if (registryKey == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			using (registryKey)
			{
				return (string)registryKey.GetValue("RootDirectory");
			}
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DefaultConfirmationService : SafeProcess.IConfirmationService
	{
		public static readonly SafeProcess.IConfirmationService Instance = new DefaultConfirmationService();

		private static bool IsWPF
		{
			get
			{
				try
				{
					return SynchronizationContext.Current is DispatcherSynchronizationContext;
				}
				catch
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		private DefaultConfirmationService()
		{
		}

		bool? SafeProcess.IConfirmationService.Confirm(SafeProcess.IConfirmationInfo info)
		{
			string text = info.Header + Environment.NewLine + Environment.NewLine + info.Location + info.FileName + Environment.NewLine + Environment.NewLine + info.Message;
			if (IsWPF)
			{
				return ShowWpfConfirmation(info, text);
			}
			return ShowWinConfirmation(info, text);
		}

		private static bool ShowWinConfirmation(SafeProcess.IConfirmationInfo info, string text)
		{
			return System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox.Show(text, info.Title, MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation) == DialogResult.Yes;
		}

		private static bool ShowWpfConfirmation(SafeProcess.IConfirmationInfo info, string text)
		{
			return System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(text, info.Title, MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation) == MessageBoxResult.Yes;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Data.Utils.Clipboard
{
	public abstract class SafeClipboardBase : ISafeClipboard
	{
		protected internal abstract class InvalidImageTypeException : InvalidOperationException
		{
			public InvalidImageTypeException(string platform, Type expectedImageType, Type usedImageType)
				: base("Clipboard in " + platform + " platform expectes image of type " + expectedImageType.FullName + ". Instead, image of the " + usedImageType.FullName + " was passed.")
			{
			}
		}

		protected internal static readonly string[] EmptyFormats = new string[0];

		private const string DefaultTextFormat = "Text";

		private const string DefaultImageFormat = "Bitmap";

		bool ISafeClipboard.Clear()
		{
			if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.ClearingWeakEventHandler.Raise())
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Clear);
				ClearCore();
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.ClearedWeakEventHandler.Raise();
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.ClearFailed(exception))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.ContainsText()
		{
			if (ClipboardAccessPolicy.IsContainsOperationSuppressed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Contains, "Text");
				return ContainsTextCore();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.ContainsFailed(exception, "Text"))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.ContainsImage()
		{
			if (ClipboardAccessPolicy.IsContainsOperationSuppressed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Contains, "Bitmap");
				return ContainsImageCore();
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.ContainsFailed(exception, "Bitmap"))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.ContainsData(string format)
		{
			if (ClipboardAccessPolicy.IsContainsOperationSuppressed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Contains, format);
				return ContainsDataCore(format, autoConvert: false);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.ContainsFailed(exception, format))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.ContainsData(string format, bool autoConvert)
		{
			if (ClipboardAccessPolicy.IsContainsOperationSuppressed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Contains, format);
				return ContainsDataCore(format, autoConvert);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.ContainsFailed(exception, format))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.QueryAllowPasting(string format, bool isUIStateQuery)
		{
			if (!isUIStateQuery)
			{
				return ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastingWeakEventHandler.Raise(format);
			}
			return ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastingWeakEventHandler.QueryUIState(format);
		}

		string ISafeClipboard.GetText()
		{
			if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastingWeakEventHandler.Raise("Text"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Paste, "Text");
				string textCore = GetTextCore();
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastedWeakEventHandler.Raise("Text");
				return textCore;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.PasteFailed(exception, "Text"))
				{
					return null;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		object ISafeClipboard.GetImage()
		{
			if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastingWeakEventHandler.Raise("Bitmap"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Paste, "Bitmap");
				object imageCore = GetImageCore();
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastedWeakEventHandler.Raise("Bitmap");
				return imageCore;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.PasteFailed(exception, "Bitmap"))
				{
					return null;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		object ISafeClipboard.GetData(string format)
		{
			if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastingWeakEventHandler.Raise(format, isDataObjectRequested: true))
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Paste, format);
				object dataCore = GetDataCore(format);
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastedWeakEventHandler.Raise(format);
				return dataCore;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.PasteFailed(exception, format))
				{
					return null;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		IPortableDataObject ISafeClipboard.GetDataObject(bool? allowPasting)
		{
			if (allowPasting != true)
			{
				if (allowPasting.HasValue)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastingWeakEventHandler.Raise(null, isDataObjectRequested: true))
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Paste);
				IPortableDataObject dataObjectCore = GetDataObjectCore();
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastedWeakEventHandler.Raise(dataObjectCore);
				return dataObjectCore;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.PasteFailed(exception))
				{
					return null;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.QueryAllowCopying(string format, bool isUIStateQuery)
		{
			if (!isUIStateQuery)
			{
				return ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopyingWeakEventHandler.Raise(format);
			}
			return ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopyingWeakEventHandler.QueryUIState(format);
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.SetText(string text)
		{
			if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopyingWeakEventHandler.Raise("Text"))
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Copy, "Text");
				SetTextCore(text);
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopiedWeakEventHandler.Raise("Text");
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.CopyFailed(exception, "Text"))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.SetImage(object image)
		{
			if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopyingWeakEventHandler.Raise("Bitmap"))
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Copy, "Bitmap");
				SetImageCore(image);
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopiedWeakEventHandler.Raise("Bitmap");
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				if (ex is InvalidImageTypeException)
				{
					throw;
				}
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.CopyFailed(ex, "Bitmap"))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.SetData(string format, object data)
		{
			if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopyingWeakEventHandler.Raise(format))
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Copy, format);
				SetDataCore(format, data);
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopiedWeakEventHandler.Raise(format);
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.CopyFailed(exception, format))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.SetDataObject(IPortableDataObject dataObject)
		{
			if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopyingWeakEventHandler.Raise(dataObject))
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Copy);
				SetDataObjectCore(dataObject);
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopiedWeakEventHandler.Raise(dataObject);
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.CopyFailed(exception, dataObject))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.SetDataObject(IPortableDataObject dataObject, bool copy)
		{
			if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopyingWeakEventHandler.Raise(dataObject))
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Copy);
				SetDataObjectCore(dataObject, copy);
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopiedWeakEventHandler.Raise(dataObject);
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.CopyFailed(exception, dataObject))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.PerformCopy(Action nativeCopy, string format, bool? allowCopying)
		{
			format = format ?? string.Empty;
			if (allowCopying != true)
			{
				if (allowCopying.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopyingWeakEventHandler.Raise(format))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Copy, format);
				nativeCopy?.Invoke();
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.CopiedWeakEventHandler.Raise(format);
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.CopyFailed(exception, format))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		bool ISafeClipboard.PerformPaste(Action nativeCopy, string format, bool? allowPasting)
		{
			format = format ?? string.Empty;
			if (allowPasting != true)
			{
				if (allowPasting.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastingWeakEventHandler.Raise(format))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				ClipboardAccessTrace.Assert(ClipboardOperation.Paste, format);
				nativeCopy?.Invoke();
				ClipboardAccessPolicy.PastedWeakEventHandler.Raise(format);
				return true;
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				if (!ClipboardAccessPolicy.FailedWeakEventHandler.PasteFailed(exception, format))
				{
					return false;
				}
				throw;
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ClearCore();

		protected abstract bool ContainsTextCore();

		protected abstract bool ContainsImageCore();

		protected abstract bool ContainsDataCore(string format, bool autoConvert);

		protected abstract string GetTextCore();

		protected abstract object GetImageCore();

		protected abstract object GetDataCore(string format);

		protected abstract IPortableDataObject GetDataObjectCore();

		protected abstract void SetTextCore(string text);

		protected abstract void SetImageCore(object image);

		protected abstract void SetDataCore(string format, object data);

		protected abstract void SetDataObjectCore(IPortableDataObject data);

		protected abstract void SetDataObjectCore(IPortableDataObject data, bool copy);
	}
}

		private sealed class BitmapSourceTypeExpectedException : InvalidImageTypeException
		{
			private BitmapSourceTypeExpectedException(Type usedImageType)
				: base("WPF", typeof(BitmapSource), usedImageType)
			{
			}

			public static void EnsureImageType(object image)
			{
				if (image != null && !(image is BitmapSource))
				{
					throw new BitmapSourceTypeExpectedException(image.GetType());
				}
			}
		}

		private static ISafeClipboard instanceCore;

		public static ISafeClipboard Instance
		{
			get
			{
				if (instanceCore == null)
				{
					Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref instanceCore, new WpfClipboard(), null);
				}
				return instanceCore;
			}
		}

		private WpfClipboard()
		{
		}

		protected override void ClearCore()
		{
			System.Windows.Clipboard.Clear();
		}

		{
			return System.Windows.Clipboard.ContainsText();
		}

		protected override bool ContainsImageCore()
		{
			return System.Windows.Clipboard.ContainsImage();
		}

		}

		protected override IPortableDataObject GetDataObjectCore()

		}

		protected override void SetTextCore(string text)
		{
			System.Windows.Clipboard.SetText(text);
		}

		protected override void SetImageCore(object image)
		{
			BitmapSourceTypeExpectedException.EnsureImageType(image);
			System.Windows.Clipboard.SetImage((BitmapSource)image);
		}

		protected override void SetDataCore(string format, object data)
		{
			System.Windows.Clipboard.SetData(format, data);
		}

		protected override void SetDataObjectCore(IPortableDataObject data)
		{
			System.Windows.Clipboard.SetDataObject(data.ToPlatform());
		}

		protected override void SetDataObjectCore(IPortableDataObject data, bool copy)
		{
			System.Windows.Clipboard.SetDataObject(data.ToPlatform(), copy);
		}

	public static class IPortableDataObjectExtensions
	{
		private sealed class PortableDataObjectWpf : System.Windows.IDataObject, IPortableDataObjectWrapper
		{
			private readonly IPortableDataObject dataObject;

			IPortableDataObject IPortableDataObjectWrapper.PortableDataObject => dataObject;

			public PortableDataObjectWpf(IPortableDataObject portableDataObject)
			{
				dataObject = portableDataObject;
			}

			public object GetData(string format, bool autoConvert)
			{
				IPortableDataObject obj = dataObject;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return obj.GetData(format, autoConvert);
			}

			public object GetData(string format)
			{
				IPortableDataObject obj = dataObject;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return obj.GetData(format);
			}

			public object GetData(Type format)
			{
				IPortableDataObject obj = dataObject;
				if (obj == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return obj.GetData(format);
			}

			public bool GetDataPresent(string format, bool autoConvert)
			{
				if (dataObject != null)
				{
					return dataObject.GetDataPresent(format, autoConvert);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public bool GetDataPresent(string format)
			{
				if (dataObject != null)
				{
					return dataObject.GetDataPresent(format);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public bool GetDataPresent(Type format)
			{
				if (dataObject != null)
				{
					return dataObject.GetDataPresent(format);
				}
				return false;
			}

			public string[] GetFormats(bool autoConvert)
			{
				if (dataObject != null)
				{
					return dataObject.GetFormats(autoConvert);
				}
				return SafeClipboardBase.EmptyFormats;
			}

			public string[] GetFormats()
			{
				if (dataObject != null)
				{
					return dataObject.GetFormats();
				}
				return SafeClipboardBase.EmptyFormats;
			}

			public void SetData(string format, object data, bool autoConvert)
			{
				IPortableDataObject obj = dataObject;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					obj.SetData(format, autoConvert, data);
				}
			}

			public void SetData(string format, object data)
			{
				IPortableDataObject obj = dataObject;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					obj.SetData(format, data);
				}
			}

			public void SetData(Type format, object data)
			{
				IPortableDataObject obj = dataObject;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					obj.SetData(format, data);
				}
			}

			public void SetData(object data)
			{
				IPortableDataObject obj = dataObject;
				if (obj != null)
				{
					obj.SetData(data);
				}
			}
		}

		public static System.Windows.IDataObject ToPlatform(this IPortableDataObject portableDataObject)
		{
			if (portableDataObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (portableDataObject is IDataObjectWrapper dataObjectWrapper)
			{
				return dataObjectWrapper.OriginalDataObject as System.Windows.IDataObject;
			}
			return new PortableDataObjectWpf(portableDataObject);
		}
	}

			}
		}

		public static IPortableDataObject ToPortable(this System.Windows.IDataObject dataObject)
		{
			if (dataObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (dataObject is IPortableDataObjectWrapper portableDataObjectWrapper)
			{
				return portableDataObjectWrapper.PortableDataObject;
			}
			return (IPortableDataObject)(object)new DataObjectWrapperWpf(dataObject);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Data.Helpers
{
	public class EnumerableObservableWrapper<T> : List<T>, INotifyCollectionChanged, IWeakEventListener, IRefreshable
	{
		private readonly IEnumerable enumerable;

		public event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler CollectionChanged;

		public EnumerableObservableWrapper(IEnumerable enumerable)
		{
			this.enumerable = enumerable;
			if (enumerable is INotifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				CollectionChangedEventManager.AddListener((INotifyCollectionChanged)enumerable, this);
			}
			Repopulate();
		}

		private void Repopulate()
		{
			Clear();
			foreach (T item in enumerable)
			{
				Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void OnInnerCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Repopulate();
			if (this.CollectionChanged != null)
			{
				this.CollectionChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(CollectionChangedEventManager))
			{
				OnInnerCollectionChanged((NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs)e);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IRefreshable.Refresh()
		{
			Repopulate();
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Data.Platform.Compatibility
{
	internal class NullableTypeConverterStandardPropertyGridAspect : IConverterAspect
	{
		private int propertyGridSubscribeLocker;

		public void OnConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			try
			{
				if (context == null || IsPopUpVisible(context))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return;
			}
			PropertyInfo property = context.GetType().GetProperty("OwnerGrid");
			if (!(property == null))
			{
				PropertyGrid propertyGrid = property.GetValue(context, null) as PropertyGrid;
				Subscribe(propertyGrid);
			}
		}

		public void OnConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			MethodInfo methodInfo = context?.GetType().GetMethod("Refresh");
			InvokeMethod(methodInfo, context, null);
		}

		private static void InvokeMethod(MethodInfo methodInfo, object obj, object[] parameters)
		{
			if (!(methodInfo == null))
			{
				methodInfo.Invoke(obj, parameters);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsPopUpVisible(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			PropertyInfo property = context.GetType().GetProperty("GridEntryHost", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
			if (property == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object value = property.GetValue(context, null);
			FieldInfo fieldInfo = NativeField.Ensure(value.GetType(), "dropDownHolder");
			if (!(fieldInfo.GetValue(value) is System.Windows.Forms.Control control))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return control.Visible;
		}

		private void PropertyGrid_PropertyValueChanged(object sender, PropertyValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is PropertyGrid propertyGrid)
			{
				UnSubscribe(propertyGrid);
				propertyGrid.Refresh();
			}
		}

		private void Subscribe(PropertyGrid propertyGrid)
		{
			if (propertyGrid != null && propertyGridSubscribeLocker == 0)
			{
				propertyGrid.PropertyValueChanged += PropertyGrid_PropertyValueChanged;
				propertyGridSubscribeLocker++;
			}
		}

		private void UnSubscribe(PropertyGrid propertyGrid)
		{
			if (propertyGrid != null && propertyGridSubscribeLocker != 0)
			{
				propertyGrid.PropertyValueChanged -= PropertyGrid_PropertyValueChanged;
				propertyGridSubscribeLocker--;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class EditableCollectionHelperDesktop : EditableCollectionHelperCore
	{
		private IEditableCollectionView GetEditableCollectionView(object collection)
		{
			if (collection is ISupportEditableCollectionView)
			{
				if (!((ISupportEditableCollectionView)collection).IsSupportEditableCollectionView)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (IEditableCollectionView)collection;
			}
			return collection as IEditableCollectionView;
		}

		public override bool IsEditableCollectionView(object collection)
		{
			return collection is ISupportEditableCollectionView;
		}

		public override bool IsInstance(object collection)
		{
			return GetEditableCollectionView(collection) != null;
		}

		public override bool CanAddNew(object collection)
		{
			return GetEditableCollectionView(collection)?.CanAddNew ?? false;
		}

		public override object CurrentAddItem(object collection)
		{
			return GetEditableCollectionView(collection)?.CurrentAddItem;
		}

		public override void CommitNew(object collection)
		{
			GetEditableCollectionView(collection)?.CommitNew();
		}

		public override void CancelNew(object collection)
		{
			GetEditableCollectionView(collection)?.CancelNew();
		}

		public override object AddNew(object collection)
		{
			return GetEditableCollectionView(collection)?.AddNew();
		}

		public override void Remove(object collection, object value)
		{
			GetEditableCollectionView(collection)?.Remove(value);
		}

				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Keys modifierKeys = System.Windows.Forms.Control.ModifierKeys;
				PortableKeyState val = (PortableKeyState)0;
				if ((modifierKeys & Keys.Shift) != Keys.None)
				{
					val = (PortableKeyState)(val | 4);
				}
				if ((modifierKeys & Keys.Control) != Keys.None)
				{
					val = (PortableKeyState)(val | 8);
				}
				if ((modifierKeys & Keys.Alt) != Keys.None)
				{
					val = (PortableKeyState)(val | 0x20);
				}
				return val;
			}
		}

		bool IDesktopBridge.GetListSource(object dataSource, string dataMember, out IList result)
		{
			result = null;
			if (dataSource == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			try
			{
				if (dataSource is DataSet dataSet && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
				{
					DataTable dataTable = dataSet.Tables[dataMember];
					if (dataTable != null)
					{
						result = dataTable.DefaultView;
						return true;
					}
				}
				if (dataSource is IListSource)
				{
					result = ListBindingHelper.GetList(dataSource, dataMember) as IList;
					return true;
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetItemProperties(IList list)
		{
			if (!(list is IItemProperties itemProperties))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList<ItemPropertyInfo> itemProperties2 = itemProperties.ItemProperties;
			if (itemProperties2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list2 = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			foreach (ItemPropertyInfo item in itemProperties2)
			{
				if (item.Descriptor is PropertyDescriptor)
				{
					list2.Add((PropertyDescriptor)item.Descriptor);
				}
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list2.ToArray());
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.AggressiveInlining)]
		private Type ReplaceByFirstRowType(Type elementType)
		{
			if (elementType == null)
			{
				return elementType;
			}
			if (elementType == typeof(object) || elementType.FullName == ListDataControllerHelper.UseFirstRowTypeWhenPopulatingColumnsTypeName)
			{
				foreach (object item in collection.SourceCollection)
				{
					Type type = item.GetType();
					if (elementType.IsAssignableFrom(type))
					{
						return type;
					}
				}
			}
			return elementType;
		}

		private void ResetCaches()
		{
			fitPredicate = null;
			rootGroup = null;
		}

		public ICollectionViewHelper(ICollectionView collection, object newItemPlaceHolder)
			: this(null, collection, newItemPlaceHolder)
