		public ICollectionViewHelper(Type elementType, ICollectionView collection, object newItemPlaceHolder)
		{
			AllowSyncSortingAndGrouping = true;
			this.newItemPlaceHolder = newItemPlaceHolder;
			this.collection = collection;
			ElementType = elementType;
			AttachedProperty.SetAttachedProperty(Collection, "isFilterSortGroupLocked", false);
			CollectionChangedEventManager.AddListener(GetUnderlyingView(), this);
			SyncLastCollections();
		}

		private ICollectionView GetUnderlyingView()
		{
			if (!(collection is ICollectionViewWrapper collectionViewWrapper))
			{
				return collection;
			}
			return collectionViewWrapper.WrappedView;
		}

		private void FilterCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(bool)AttachedProperty.GetAttachedProperty(Collection, "isFilterSortGroupLocked"))
			{
				bool needRefresh = false;
				if (Collection.CanFilter && lastFilter != Collection.Filter)
				{
					needRefresh = true;
				}
				if (Collection.CanSort && !CollectionExtensions.AreEqual(lastSortDescriptions, Collection.SortDescriptions))
				{
					needRefresh = true;
				}
				if (Collection.CanGroup && !CollectionExtensions.AreEqual(lastGroupDescriptions, Collection.GroupDescriptions))
				{
					needRefresh = true;
				}
				Reset();
				isFilterSortGroupLocked = true;
				try
				{
					RaiseFilterSortGroupInfoChanged(needRefresh);
				}
				finally
				{
					isFilterSortGroupLocked = false;
				}
				if (Collection.CanFilter)
				{
					lastFilter = Collection.Filter;
				}
				SyncLastCollections();
			}
		}

		private void RaiseFilterSortGroupInfoChanged(bool needRefresh)
		{
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (filterSortGroupInfoChanged != null)
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (Collection.CanGroup)
				{
					num = Collection.GroupDescriptions.Count;
				}
				filterSortGroupInfoChanged.Invoke((object)this, new CollectionViewFilterSortGroupInfoChangedEventArgs(CreateSortInfo(), num, Collection.CanFilter && lastFilter != Collection.Filter, needRefresh));
			}
		}

		public void Initialize()
		{
			isInitialized = true;
			RaiseFilterSortGroupInfoChanged(needRefresh: true);
		}

		internal List<ListSortInfo> CreateSortInfo()
		{
			//IL_00ef: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f9: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bd: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<ListSortInfo> list = new List<ListSortInfo>();
			if (!Collection.CanSort)
			{
				return list;
			}
			List<SortDescription> list2 = new List<SortDescription>(Collection.SortDescriptions);
			if (Collection.CanGroup)
			{
				foreach (GroupDescription groupDescription in Collection.GroupDescriptions)
				{
					PropertyGroupDescription propertyGroupDescription = groupDescription as PropertyGroupDescription;
					SortDescription item = list2.Find((SortDescription sortDescription2) => sortDescription2.PropertyName == propertyGroupDescription.PropertyName);
					list2.Remove(item);
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.PropertyName))
					{
						item = new SortDescription(propertyGroupDescription.PropertyName, ListSortDirection.Ascending);
					}
					list.Add(new ListSortInfo(item.PropertyName, item.Direction));
				}
			}
			for (int num = 0; num < list2.Count; num++)
			{
				SortDescription sortDescription = list2[num];
				list.Add(new ListSortInfo(sortDescription.PropertyName, sortDescription.Direction));
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal ServerModeOrderDescriptor CreateServerModeOrderDescriptor(SortDescription sd)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new ServerModeOrderDescriptor((CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(sd.PropertyName), sd.Direction == ListSortDirection.Descending);
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			ResetCaches();
		}

		public virtual void Apply(CriteriaOperator filterCriteria, ICollection<ServerModeOrderDescriptor[]> sortInfo_new, int groupCount, ICollection<ServerModeSummaryDescriptor> groupSummaryInfo, ICollection<ServerModeSummaryDescriptor> totalSummaryInfo)
		{
			if (sortInfo_new == null)
			{
				sortInfo_new = new ServerModeOrderDescriptor[0][];
			}
			if (sortInfo_new.Any((ServerModeOrderDescriptor[] sis) => sis.Length != 1))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("merged column grouping");
			}
			ICollection<ServerModeOrderDescriptor> collection = sortInfo_new.Select((ServerModeOrderDescriptor[] sis) => sis[0]).ToArray();
			TotalSummaryInfo = ((totalSummaryInfo == null) ? new List<ServerModeSummaryDescriptor>() : new List<ServerModeSummaryDescriptor>(totalSummaryInfo));
			GroupSummaryInfo = ((groupSummaryInfo == null) ? new List<ServerModeSummaryDescriptor>() : new List<ServerModeSummaryDescriptor>(groupSummaryInfo));
			GroupSummaryEvaluators = null;
			if (!isInitialized)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (isFilterSortGroupLocked)
			{
				ResetCaches();
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				using (Collection.DeferRefresh())
				{
					try
					{
						AttachedProperty.SetAttachedProperty(Collection, "isFilterSortGroupLocked", true);
						ResetCaches();
						if (FilterCriteria != filterCriteria && Collection.CanFilter)
						{
							Collection.Filter = null;
							Collection.Filter = filterPredicate;
							lastFilter = filterPredicate;
						}
						FilterCriteria = filterCriteria;
						ICollection<ServerModeOrderDescriptor> collection2 = (ICollection<ServerModeOrderDescriptor>)(((object)collection) ?? ((object)new ServerModeOrderDescriptor[0]));
						if (!AllowSyncSortingAndGrouping || !NeedSortGroupRefresh(collection2, groupCount))
						{
							return;
						}
						if (Collection.CanSort)
						{
							Collection.SortDescriptions.Clear();
						}
						else if (collection2.Count > 0)
						{
							throw new NotSupportedException("Sorting is not supported");
						}
						if (Collection.CanGroup)
						{
							Collection.GroupDescriptions.Clear();
						}
						else if (groupCount > 0)
						{
							throw new NotSupportedException("Grouping is not supported");
						}
						int num = groupCount;
						foreach (ServerModeOrderDescriptor item in collection2)
						{
							string operandPropertyName = GetOperandPropertyName(item);
							ListSortDirection direction = (item.IsDesc ? ListSortDirection.Descending : ListSortDirection.Ascending);
							SortDescription? sortDescription = FindSortDescriptionByName(operandPropertyName);
							if (sortDescription.HasValue)
							{
								SortDescription value = sortDescription.Value;
								int index = Collection.SortDescriptions.IndexOf(value);
								Collection.SortDescriptions.Remove(value);
								Collection.SortDescriptions.Insert(index, new SortDescription(operandPropertyName, direction));
							}
							else
							{
								Collection.SortDescriptions.Add(new SortDescription(operandPropertyName, direction));
							}
							if (num > 0)
							{
								PropertyGroupDescription propertyGroupDescription = FindGroupDescriptionByName(operandPropertyName);
								if (propertyGroupDescription != null)
								{
									int index2 = Collection.GroupDescriptions.IndexOf(propertyGroupDescription);
									Collection.GroupDescriptions.Remove(propertyGroupDescription);
									Collection.GroupDescriptions.Insert(index2, new PropertyGroupDescription(operandPropertyName));
								}
								else
								{
									Collection.GroupDescriptions.Add(new PropertyGroupDescription(operandPropertyName));
								}
								num--;
							}
						}
						SyncLastCollections();
					}
					finally
					{
						AttachedProperty.SetAttachedProperty(Collection, "isFilterSortGroupLocked", false);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (InvalidOperationException)
			{
			}
		}

		private string GetOperandPropertyName(ServerModeOrderDescriptor od)
		{
			CriteriaOperator sortExpression = od.SortExpression;
			OperandProperty val = (OperandProperty)(object)((sortExpression is OperandProperty) ? sortExpression : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				CriteriaOperator sortExpression2 = od.SortExpression;
				FunctionOperator val2 = (FunctionOperator)(object)((sortExpression2 is FunctionOperator) ? sortExpression2 : null);
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					CriteriaOperator obj = ((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)val2.Operands).FirstOrDefault();
					val = (OperandProperty)(object)((obj is OperandProperty) ? obj : null);
				}
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Sorting by expression " + CriteriaOperator.ToString(od.SortExpression));
			}
			return val.PropertyName;
		}

		private SortDescription? FindSortDescriptionByName(string name)
		{
			foreach (SortDescription sortDescription in Collection.SortDescriptions)
			{
				if (sortDescription.PropertyName == name)
				{
					return sortDescription;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private PropertyGroupDescription FindGroupDescriptionByName(string name)
		{
			foreach (GroupDescription groupDescription in Collection.GroupDescriptions)
			{
				if (groupDescription is PropertyGroupDescription propertyGroupDescription && propertyGroupDescription.PropertyName == name)
				{
					return propertyGroupDescription;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool NeedSortGroupRefresh(ICollection<ServerModeOrderDescriptor> sortInfo, int groupCount)
		{
			if (Collection.GroupDescriptions == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (sortInfo.Count != Collection.SortDescriptions.Count || groupCount != Collection.GroupDescriptions.Count)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ServerModeOrderDescriptor item in sortInfo)
			{
				SortDescription sortDescription = Collection.SortDescriptions[num];
				string operandPropertyName = GetOperandPropertyName(item);
				if (operandPropertyName != sortDescription.PropertyName || item.IsDesc != (sortDescription.Direction == ListSortDirection.Descending))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (num < groupCount)
				{
					PropertyGroupDescription propertyGroupDescription = Collection.GroupDescriptions[num] as PropertyGroupDescription;
					if (propertyGroupDescription.PropertyName != operandPropertyName)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				num++;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SyncLastCollections()
		{
			if (Collection.CanSort)
			{
				lastSortDescriptions.Clear();
				lastSortDescriptions.AddRange(Collection.SortDescriptions);
			}
			if (Collection.CanGroup)
			{
				lastGroupDescriptions.Clear();
				lastGroupDescriptions.AddRange(Collection.GroupDescriptions);
			}
		}

		private CollectionViewListSourceGroupInfo CreateTopGroup()
		{
			CollectionViewListSourceGroupInfo collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo = new CollectionViewListSourceGroupInfo();
			((ListSourceGroupInfo)collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo).Level = -1;
			if (Collection.Groups != null)
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				foreach (object group in Collection.Groups)
				{
					if (group is CollectionViewGroup collectionViewGroup)
					{
						CollectionViewListSourceGroupInfo collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo2 = CreateListSourceGroupInfo(collectionViewGroup, 0);
						collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo.ChildrenGroups.Add((ListSourceGroupInfo)(object)collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo2);
						list.AddRange(collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo2.Rows.Cast<object>());
					}
				}
				collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo.Rows = list.ToArray();
			}
			else
			{
				collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo.Rows = (from object x in Collection
					where x != NewItemPlaceHolder
					select x).ToArray();
			}
			if (TotalSummaryInfo != null && TotalSummaryInfo.Count > 0)
			{
				Func<IEnumerable, object>[] array = MakeSummaryEvaluators(TotalSummaryInfo);
				foreach (Func<IEnumerable, object> func in array)
				{
					((ListSourceGroupInfo)collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo).Summary.Add(func(collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo.Rows));
				}
			}
			return collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo;
		}

		private CollectionViewListSourceGroupInfo CreateListSourceGroupInfo(CollectionViewGroup group, int level)
		{
			CollectionViewListSourceGroupInfo collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo = new CollectionViewListSourceGroupInfo();
			((ListSourceGroupInfo)collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo).ChildDataRowCount = (group.IsBottomLevel ? group.ItemCount : 0);
			((ListSourceGroupInfo)collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo).GroupValue = group.Name;
			((ListSourceGroupInfo)collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo).Level = level;
			if (group.IsBottomLevel)
			{
				collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo.Rows = group.Items.Where((object x) => x != NewItemPlaceHolder).ToArray();
			}
			else
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				foreach (object item in group.Items)
				{
					if (item is CollectionViewGroup collectionViewGroup)
					{
						CollectionViewListSourceGroupInfo collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo2 = CreateListSourceGroupInfo(collectionViewGroup, level + 1);
						((ListSourceGroupInfo)collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo).ChildDataRowCount = ((ListSourceGroupInfo)collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo).ChildDataRowCount + ((ListSourceGroupInfo)collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo2).ChildDataRowCount;
						collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo.ChildrenGroups.Add((ListSourceGroupInfo)(object)collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo2);
						list.AddRange(collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo2.Rows.Cast<object>());
					}
				}
				collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo.Rows = list.ToArray();
			}
			if (GroupSummaryInfo != null)
			{
				if (GroupSummaryEvaluators == null)
				{
					GroupSummaryEvaluators = MakeSummaryEvaluators(GroupSummaryInfo);
				}
				Func<IEnumerable, object>[] groupSummaryEvaluators = GroupSummaryEvaluators;
				foreach (Func<IEnumerable, object> func in groupSummaryEvaluators)
				{
					((ListSourceGroupInfo)collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo).Summary.Add(func(collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo.Rows));
				}
			}
			return collectionViewListSourceGroupInfo;
		}

					}
					else

		private bool filterPredicate(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (fitPredicate == null)
			{
				if (FilterCriteria == null)
				{
					fitPredicate = (object x) => true;
				}
				else
				{
					try
					{
						if (!Collection.CanFilter)
						{
							throw new NotSupportedException("Source can't filterCriteria");
						}
						fitPredicate = CriteriaCompiler.ToUntypedPredicate(FilterCriteria, CriteriaCompilerDescriptor.Get(ElementType));
					}
					catch
					{
						fitPredicate = (object x) => false;
					}
				}
			}
			return fitPredicate(obj);
		}

	internal static class AttachedProperty
	{
		private static Dictionary<WeakReference, Dictionary<string, object>> Values = new Dictionary<WeakReference, Dictionary<string, object>>();

		private static WeakReference GetKey(object o)
		{
			List<WeakReference> list = new List<WeakReference>();
			try
			{
				foreach (WeakReference key in Values.Keys)
				{
					if (!key.IsAlive)
					{
						list.Add(key);
					}
					else if (key.Target == o)
					{
						return key;
					}
				}
				WeakReference weakReference = new WeakReference(o);
				Values.Add(weakReference, new Dictionary<string, object>());
				return weakReference;
			}
			finally
			{
				foreach (WeakReference item in list)
				{
					Values.Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void SetAttachedProperty(object o, string name, object value)
		{
			WeakReference key = GetKey(o);
			Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = Values[key];
			if (dictionary.ContainsKey(name))
			{
				dictionary[name] = value;
			}
			else
			{
				dictionary.Add(name, value);
			}
		}

		public static object GetAttachedProperty(object o, string name)
		{
			WeakReference key = GetKey(o);
			if (Values[key].TryGetValue(name, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal static class CollectionExtensions
	{
		public static bool AreEqual(IList list1, IList list2)
		{
			if (list1.Count != list2.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list1.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!list1[i].Equals(list2[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Data.Mask.Internal
{
	[DefaultProperty("MaskManagerType")]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
	[DesignerSerializer("DevExpress.XtraEditors.Design.MaskSettingsCodeDomSerializer, DevExpress.Design.v23.2, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a", "System.ComponentModel.Design.Serialization.CodeDomSerializer, System.Design, Version=4.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b03f5f7f11d50a3a")]
	public abstract class MaskSettings<T> : IEnumerable<Tuple<string, Type, object>>, IEnumerable, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>, IReadOnlyCollection<KeyValuePair<string, object>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, object>>, ICustomTypeDescriptor, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private abstract class MaskSettingsDescriptorBase : PropertyDescriptor
		{
			public sealed override Type ComponentType => typeof(MaskSettings<T>);

			public sealed override bool IsReadOnly => false;

			protected MaskSettingsDescriptorBase(string name, Attribute[] attributes)
				: base(name, attributes)
			{
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				MaskSettings<T> settings = component as MaskSettings<T>;
				return GetValueCore(settings);
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				MaskSettings<T> maskSettings = component as MaskSettings<T>;
				if (!object.Equals(GetValueCore(maskSettings), value))
				{
					maskSettings.maskParameters[Name] = value;
					OnValueChanged(maskSettings);
				}
			}

			protected virtual object GetValueCore(MaskSettings<T> settings)
			{
				return settings.GetValueOrDefaultCore(Name, GetDefaultValue);
			}

			protected virtual object GetDefaultValue()
			{
				if (!PropertyType.IsValueType)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return DefaultValuesCache.Get(PropertyType);
			}

			public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
			{
				MaskSettings<T> maskSettings = component as MaskSettings<T>;
				return maskSettings.maskParameters.ContainsKey(Name);
			}

			public override void ResetValue(object component)
			{
				MaskSettings<T> maskSettings = component as MaskSettings<T>;
				if (maskSettings.maskParameters.Remove(Name))
				{
					OnResetValue(maskSettings);
				}
			}

			public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
			{
				MaskSettings<T> maskSettings = component as MaskSettings<T>;
				return maskSettings.maskParameters.ContainsKey(Name);
			}

			protected virtual void OnValueChanged(MaskSettings<T> settings)
			{
				settings.RaisePropertyChanged(Name);
			}

			protected virtual void OnResetValue(MaskSettings<T> settings)
			{
				OnValueChanged(settings);
			}

			protected static bool Match(Attribute[] attributes, Attribute[] defaultAttributes)
			{
				if (attributes == null || attributes.Length == 0 || defaultAttributes == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return MatchCore(attributes, new AttributeCollection(defaultAttributes));
			}

			internal static bool Match(PropertyDescriptor descriptor, Attribute[] attributes)
			{
				if (attributes == null || attributes.Length == 0 || descriptor == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return MatchCore(attributes, descriptor.Attributes);
			}

			private static bool MatchCore(Attribute[] attributes, AttributeCollection collection)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < attributes.Length; i++)
				{
					Attribute attribute = collection[attributes[i].GetType()];
					if (attribute == null)
					{
						return !attributes[i].IsDefaultAttribute();
					}
					if (attribute.Match(attributes[i]))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public abstract class Fluent
		{
			internal Dictionary<string, object> maskParameters = new Dictionary<string, object>();

			internal Action<string> onChanged;

			private int lockUpdate;

			private int queuedChangesCount;

			public string MaskExpression
			{
				get
				{
					return GetValue("mask", string.Empty);
				}
				set
				{
					if (value == null)
					{
						ResetValue("mask");
					}
					else
					{
						SetValue("mask", value);
					}
				}
			}

			protected internal void BeginUpdate()
			{
				lockUpdate++;
			}

			protected internal void CancelUpdate()
			{
				lockUpdate--;
			}

			protected internal void EndUpdate()
			{
				if (--lockUpdate == 0 && queuedChangesCount > 0)
				{
					queuedChangesCount = 0;
					onChanged(string.Empty);
				}
			}

			protected TValue GetValue<TValue>(string propertyName, TValue defalutValue)
			{
				if (!maskParameters.TryGetValue(propertyName, out var value))
				{
					return defalutValue;
				}
				return (TValue)value;
			}

			protected void SetValue<TValue>(string propertyName, TValue value)
			{
				if (!maskParameters.TryGetValue(propertyName, out var value2) || !object.Equals(value, value2))
				{
					maskParameters[propertyName] = value;
					if (lockUpdate == 0)
					{
						onChanged(propertyName);
					}
					else
					{
						queuedChangesCount++;
					}
				}
			}

			protected void ResetValue(string propertyName)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName) && maskParameters.Remove(propertyName))
				{
					if (lockUpdate == 0)
					{
						onChanged(propertyName);
					}
					else
					{
						queuedChangesCount++;
					}
				}
			}

			[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
			protected internal abstract Type GetMaskManagerType();
		}

		private sealed class MaskManagerParameterDescriptor : MaskSettingsDescriptorBase
		{
			private static readonly Attribute[] defaultAttributes = new Attribute[2]
			{
				new CategoryAttribute("Settings"),
				new DesignerSerializationVisibilityAttribute(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)
			};

			private static readonly Attribute[] defaultAttributesForMaskExpression = new Attribute[2]
			{
				new CategoryAttribute("Expression"),
				new DesignerSerializationVisibilityAttribute(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)
			};

			private readonly Tuple<string, Type, string> displayParameter;

			public sealed override string Name => displayParameter.Item1;

			public sealed override Type PropertyType => displayParameter.Item2;

			public sealed override string DisplayName => displayParameter.Item3;

			private static Attribute[] GetDefaultAttributes(string name)
			{
				if (!(name == "mask"))
				{
					return defaultAttributes;
				}
				return defaultAttributesForMaskExpression;
			}

			internal static bool Match(Attribute[] attributes)
			{
				return MaskSettingsDescriptorBase.Match(attributes, defaultAttributes);
			}

			public MaskManagerParameterDescriptor(Tuple<string, Type, string> displayParameter)
				: base(displayParameter.Item1, GetDefaultAttributes(displayParameter.Item1))
			{
				this.displayParameter = displayParameter;
			}

			protected sealed override object GetDefaultValue()
			{
				return MaskManager.EnsureDisplayParameterOptionalValue(displayParameter, base.GetDefaultValue());
			}
		}

		private sealed class MaskManagerTypeDescriptor : MaskSettingsDescriptorBase
		{
			private static readonly Attribute[] defaultAttributes = new Attribute[3]
			{
				new CategoryAttribute("Design"),
				new DesignerSerializationVisibilityAttribute(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden),
				new TypeConverterAttribute("DevExpress.XtraEditors.Design.MaskManagerTypeConverter, DevExpress.Design.v23.2, Version=23.2.4.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=b88d1754d700e49a")
			};

			public static readonly MaskManagerTypeDescriptor Instance = new MaskManagerTypeDescriptor();

			public sealed override string Name => "MaskManagerType";

			public sealed override Type PropertyType => typeof(TypeInfo);

			public sealed override string DisplayName => "(Mask Type)";

			internal static bool Match(Attribute[] attributes)
			{
				return MaskSettingsDescriptorBase.Match(attributes, defaultAttributes);
			}

			private MaskManagerTypeDescriptor()
				: base("MaskManagerType", defaultAttributes)
			{
			}

			protected sealed override object GetValueCore(MaskSettings<T> settings)
			{
				return GetMaskManagerTypeInfo(settings);
			}

			protected sealed override object GetDefaultValue()
			{
				return null;
			}

			public sealed override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				TypeInfo val = (TypeInfo)((value is TypeInfo) ? value : null);
				if (val == null && value is Type)
				{
					Type type = value as Type;
					if (typeof(MaskManager).IsAssignableFrom(type) && type != typeof(MaskManager))
					{
						val = (TypeInfo)type;
					}
				}
				MaskSettings<T> maskSettings = component as MaskSettings<T>;
				object valueCore = GetValueCore(maskSettings);
				TypeInfo objA = (TypeInfo)((valueCore is TypeInfo) ? valueCore : null);
				if (object.Equals(objA, val))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (val == null)
				{
					if (maskSettings.maskParameters.Remove("MaskManagerType") || maskSettings.maskParameters.Remove("MaskManagerSignature"))
					{
						maskSettings.showAdvancedSettings = null;
						OnResetValue(maskSettings);
					}
					return;
				}
				maskSettings.showAdvancedSettings = null;
				maskSettings.maskParameters.Clear();
				maskSettings.maskParameters["MaskManagerType"] = val.Type;
				string value2 = val.key as string;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
				{
					maskSettings.maskParameters.Remove("MaskManagerSignature");
				}
				else
				{
					maskSettings.maskParameters["MaskManagerSignature"] = value2;
				}
				OnValueChanged(maskSettings);
			}

			public sealed override void ResetValue(object component)
			{
				MaskSettings<T> maskSettings = component as MaskSettings<T>;
				if (maskSettings.maskParameters.Remove("MaskManagerType") || maskSettings.maskParameters.Remove("MaskManagerSignature"))
				{
					OnResetValue(maskSettings);
				}
			}

			protected sealed override void OnResetValue(MaskSettings<T> settings)
			{
				settings.showAdvancedSettings = null;
				settings.maskParameters.Clear();
				base.OnResetValue(settings);
			}

			protected sealed override void OnValueChanged(MaskSettings<T> settings)
			{
				settings.ResetMaskManagerType();
				settings.RaisePropertyChanged(string.Empty);
				TypeDescriptor.Refresh(settings);
			}

			public TypeInfo GetMaskManagerTypeInfo(MaskSettings<T> settings)
			{
				//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_008c: Expected O, but got Unknown
				object valueCore = base.GetValueCore(settings);
				TypeInfo val = (TypeInfo)((valueCore is TypeInfo) ? valueCore : null);
				if (val == null)
				{
					Type type = (settings.GetValueOrDefaultCore("MaskManagerType", GetDefaultValue) as Type) ?? settings.GetDefaultMaskManagerType();
					if (type == null || type == typeof(MaskManager))
					{
						return null;
					}
					string text = settings.GetValueOrDefaultCore("MaskManagerSignature", GetDefaultValue) as string;
					val = (TypeInfo)((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text)) ? ((object)new TypeInfo((object)text, type)) : ((object)(TypeInfo)type));
				}
				return val;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public struct MaskSettingsState : IEquatable<MaskSettingsState>, IEquatable<MaskSettings<T>>
		{
			private readonly KeyValuePair<string, object>[] pairs;

			private static readonly UTF8Encoding DefaultEncoding = new UTF8Encoding(encoderShouldEmitUTF8Identifier: false, throwOnInvalidBytes: true);

			public MaskSettingsState(Dictionary<string, object> parameters)
			{
				pairs = parameters.ToArray();
			}

			internal MaskSettingsState(Stream stream)
			{
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000d: Expected O, but got Unknown
				TypedBinaryReader val = new TypedBinaryReader(stream, (Encoding)DefaultEncoding, true);
				try
				{
					int num = ((BinaryReader)(object)val).ReadInt32();
					pairs = new KeyValuePair<string, object>[num];
					for (int i = 0; i < pairs.Length; i++)
					{
						string text = ((BinaryReader)(object)val).ReadString();
						switch (text)
						{
						case "MaskManagerType":
						case "MaskManagerDataType":
						case "valueType":
							pairs[i] = new KeyValuePair<string, object>(text, val.ReadType((Func<string, Type>)MaskManager.ResolveMaskManagerType));
							break;
						default:
							pairs[i] = new KeyValuePair<string, object>(text, val.ReadTypedObject());
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}

			public void Save(Stream stream)
			{
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000d: Expected O, but got Unknown
				TypedBinaryWriter val = new TypedBinaryWriter(stream, (Encoding)DefaultEncoding, true);
				try
				{
					((BinaryWriter)(object)val).Write(pairs.Length);
					for (int i = 0; i < pairs.Length; i++)
					{
						string key = pairs[i].Key;
						((BinaryWriter)(object)val).Write(key);
						switch (key)
						{
						case "MaskManagerType":
						case "MaskManagerDataType":
						case "valueType":
							val.WriteType((Type)pairs[i].Value);
							break;
						default:
							val.WriteTypedObject(pairs[i].Value);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}

			public bool Apply(Dictionary<string, object> parameters)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				HashSet<string> pairKeys = new HashSet<string>();
				for (int i = 0; i < pairs.Length; i++)
				{
					string key = pairs[i].Key;
					if (!pairKeys.Add(key) || !parameters.TryGetValue(key, out var value) || !object.Equals(value, pairs[i].Value))
					{
						parameters[key] = pairs[i].Value;
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(parameters.Keys.Where((string x) => !pairKeys.Contains(x)));
				foreach (string item in hashSet)
				{
					flag |= parameters.Remove(item);
				}
				return flag;
			}

			public bool Equals(MaskSettings<T> settings)
			{
				if (settings != null)
				{
					return Equals(settings.Save());
				}
				return false;
			}

			public bool Equals(MaskSettingsState state)
			{
				if (pairs.Length != state.pairs.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				HashSet<string> pairKeys = new HashSet<string>();
				Dictionary<string, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, object>();
				for (int i = 0; i < state.pairs.Length; i++)
				{
					dictionary.Add(state.pairs[i].Key, state.pairs[i].Value);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < pairs.Length; j++)
				{
					string key = pairs[j].Key;
					if (pairKeys.Add(key) && dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value) && !object.Equals(value, pairs[j].Value))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				HashSet<string> hashSet = new HashSet<string>(dictionary.Keys.Where((string x) => !pairKeys.Contains(x)));
				foreach (string item in hashSet)
				{
					if (dictionary.Remove(item))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public TMaskSettings Configure<TMaskSettings>(Action<TMaskSettings> setup = null) where TMaskSettings : Fluent, new()
		{
			TMaskSettings val = new TMaskSettings();
			Type maskManagerType = val.GetMaskManagerType();
			if (typeof(MaskManager).IsAssignableFrom(maskManagerType) && maskManagerType != typeof(MaskManager))
			{
				val.maskParameters = maskParameters;
				val.onChanged = OnMaskSettingsChanged;
				if (setup != null)
				{
					val.BeginUpdate();
					setup(val);
					val.EndUpdate();
				}
				if (SetMaskManagerTypeParameters(maskManagerType))
				{
					showAdvancedSettings = null;
					ResetMaskManagerType();
					RaisePropertyChanged(string.Empty);
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		private bool SetMaskManagerTypeParameters(Type maskManagerType)
		{
			TypeInfo maskManagerTypeInfo = MaskManagerTypeDescriptor.Instance.GetMaskManagerTypeInfo(this);
			TypeInfo val = (TypeInfo)maskManagerType;
			if (object.Equals(maskManagerTypeInfo, val))
			{
				return false;
			}
			string value = val.key as string;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				maskParameters.Remove("MaskManagerSignature");
			}
			else
			{
				maskParameters["MaskManagerSignature"] = value;
			}
			maskParameters["MaskManagerType"] = maskManagerType;
			return true;
		}

			hasValueCore = new Lazy<bool>(HasMaskManagerType);

		{
			if (--lockUpdates == 0)

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual MaskManager CreateMaskManager()
		{
			AnnotationAttributes val = getAttributes();
			Type maskManagerDataType = GetMaskManagerDataType(val);
			Type maskManagerType = GetMaskManagerType(maskManagerDataType, val);
			if (val == null && maskManagerDataType == typeof(void) && maskManagerType == typeof(MaskManager))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (val == null || (maskManagerType != null && maskManagerType != typeof(MaskManager)))
			{
				return MaskManager.Create(maskManagerDataType, maskManagerType, (IEnumerable<Tuple<string, Type, object>>)this);
			}
			return MaskManager.Create(MaskAttributes.Ensure(val, maskManagerDataType), (IEnumerable<Tuple<string, Type, object>>)this);
		}

		internal static bool IsSpecialProperty(string property)
		{
			if (!(property == "MaskManagerType") && !(property == "MaskManagerDataType"))
			{
				return property == "MaskManagerSignature";
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected string GetMaskManagerSignature()
		{
			if (!maskParameters.TryGetValue("MaskManagerSignature", out var value))
			{

		protected Type GetMaskManagerDataType(AnnotationAttributes annotationAttributes)
		{
			if (!maskParameters.TryGetValue("MaskManagerDataType", out var value))
			{
				value = MaskAttributes.GetDataType(annotationAttributes);
			}
			return value as Type;
		}

		protected Type GetMaskManagerType(AnnotationAttributes annotationAttributes)
		{
			if (!GetMaskManagerTypeCore(out var managerType))
			{
				Func<Type> func = () => GetMaskManagerDataType(annotationAttributes);
				managerType = MaskManager.ResolveMaskManagerType((object)TypeKey, func, annotationAttributes);
			}
			return managerType as Type;
		}

		protected Type GetMaskManagerType(Type dataType, AnnotationAttributes annotationAttributes)
		{
			if (!GetMaskManagerTypeCore(out var managerType))
			{
				managerType = MaskManager.ResolveMaskManagerType((object)TypeKey, (Func<Type>)(() => dataType), annotationAttributes);
			}
			return managerType as Type;
		}

		private bool GetMaskManagerTypeCore(out object managerType)
		{
			if (!maskParameters.TryGetValue("MaskManagerType", out managerType))
			{
				managerType = GetDefaultMaskManagerType();
			}
			return managerType != null;
		}

		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual bool AllowMaskManagerType(Type maskManagerType)
		{
			if (maskManagerType == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return typeof(MaskManager).IsAssignableFrom(maskManagerType);
		}

		protected void ResetMaskManagerType()
		{
			if (hasValueCore.IsValueCreated)
			{
				hasValueCore = new Lazy<bool>(HasMaskManagerType);
			}
		}

		private bool HasMaskManagerType()
		{
			return HasMaskManagerType(() => GetMaskManagerDataType(getAttributes()));
		}

		protected bool HasMaskManagerType(Func<Type> getDataType)
		{
			if (!GetMaskManagerTypeCore(out var managerType) || !(managerType is Type))
			{
				managerType = MaskManager.ResolveMaskManagerType((object)TypeKey, getDataType, getAttributes());
			}
			if (managerType is Type)
			{
				return (Type)managerType != typeof(MaskManager);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IEnumerable<Tuple<string, Type, object>> GetMaskManagerSettings(HashSet<string> parameters)
		{
			return from x in maskParameters
				where !parameters.Contains(x.Key)
				select new Tuple<string, Type, object>(x.Key, (x.Value != null) ? x.Value.GetType() : typeof(object), x.Value);
		}

		private IReadOnlyDictionary<string, Type> GetDisplayParameterNamesAndTypes(IEnumerable<Tuple<string, Type, string>> displayParameters)
		{
			Dictionary<string, Type> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, Type>();
			foreach (Tuple<string, Type, string> displayParameter in displayParameters)
			{
				dictionary.Add(displayParameter.Item1, displayParameter.Item2);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private PropertyDescriptorCollection GetPropertiesCore(AnnotationAttributes annotationAttributes, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Type maskManagerDataType = GetMaskManagerDataType(annotationAttributes);
			Type maskManagerType = GetMaskManagerType(maskManagerDataType, annotationAttributes);
			bool flag = MaskManagerTypeDescriptor.Match(attributes);
			PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[flag ? 1 : 0];
			if (maskManagerType != null || maskManagerType == typeof(MaskManager))
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(this, noCustomTypeDesc: true);
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = properties["ShowAdvancedSettings"];
				bool flag2 = MaskSettingsDescriptorBase.Match(propertyDescriptor, attributes);
				if (MaskManagerParameterDescriptor.Match(attributes))
				{
					ParameterVisibility val = (ParameterVisibility)((!flag2) ? 1 : ((int)GetPropertiesVisibility()));
					MaskManagerParameterDescriptor[] array2 = (from x in MaskManager.GetDisplayParameters(maskManagerDataType, maskManagerType, val)
						select new MaskManagerParameterDescriptor(x) into x
						where MaskSettingsDescriptorBase.Match(x, attributes)
						select x).ToArray();
					int num = (flag ? 1 : 0) + (flag2 ? 1 : 0);
					array = new PropertyDescriptor[array2.Length + num];
					for (int num2 = 0; num2 < array2.Length; num2++)
					{
						array[num2 + num] = array2[num2];
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					array[1] = propertyDescriptor;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				array[0] = MaskManagerTypeDescriptor.Instance;
			}
			return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array, readOnly: true);
		}

		protected virtual ParameterVisibility GetPropertiesVisibility()

			return (ParameterVisibility)0;
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<Tuple<string, Type, object>> GetParameters(Func<string, bool> hasParameter)
		{

		}

		IEnumerator<Tuple<string, Type, object>> IEnumerable<Tuple<string, Type, object>>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return GetParameters(AnnotationAttributes);
		}

		{

		}

		private IEnumerator<Tuple<string, Type, object>> GetParameters(AnnotationAttributes annotationAttributes)
		{
			HashSet<string> parameters = new HashSet<string> { "MaskManagerDataType", "MaskManagerType", "MaskManagerSignature" };
			Type maskManagerDataType = GetMaskManagerDataType(annotationAttributes);
			IEnumerable<Tuple<string, Type, string>> displayParameters = MaskManager.GetDisplayParameters(maskManagerDataType, GetMaskManagerType(maskManagerDataType, annotationAttributes), GetMaskManagerSignature(), GetMaskManagerSettings(parameters));
			IReadOnlyDictionary<string, Type> displayParameterNamesAndTypes = GetDisplayParameterNamesAndTypes(displayParameters);
			foreach (Tuple<string, Type, object> parameter in GetParameters((Func<string, bool>)displayParameterNamesAndTypes.ContainsKey))
			{
				if (parameters.Add(parameter.Item1))
				{
					yield return parameter;
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> maskParameter in maskParameters)
			{
				if (parameters.Add(maskParameter.Key) && displayParameterNamesAndTypes.TryGetValue(maskParameter.Key, out var value))
				{
					yield return new Tuple<string, Type, object>(maskParameter.Key, value, maskParameter.Value);
				}
			}
			foreach (Tuple<string, Type, object> predefinedParameter in MaskManager.GetPredefinedParameters(displayParameters))
			{
				if (parameters.Add(predefinedParameter.Item1))
				{
					yield return predefinedParameter;
				}
			}
		}

		}

		protected abstract void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName);

		protected abstract void AddPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventHandler handler);

		protected abstract void RemovePropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventHandler handler);

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return maskParameters.Count > 0;
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Reset()
		{
			if (ResetCore())
			{
				ResetMaskManagerType();
				RaisePropertyChanged(string.Empty);
				TypeDescriptor.Refresh(this);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ResetCore()
		{
			bool result = maskParameters.Count > 0 || showAdvancedSettings.HasValue;
			maskParameters.Clear();
			showAdvancedSettings = null;
			return result;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			Type maskManagerType = GetMaskManagerType(AnnotationAttributes);
			if (maskManagerType == null || maskManagerType == typeof(MaskManager))
			{
				return "(None)";
			}
			string name = MaskManager.GetName((object)TypeKey, maskManagerType, GetMaskManagerSignature());
			int num = 0;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(name);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> maskParameter in maskParameters)
			{
				if (IsSpecialProperty(maskParameter.Key))
				{
					continue;
				}
				string text = ((maskParameter.Value != null) ? maskParameter.Value.ToString() : string.Empty);
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					if (num++ == 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(": ");
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(maskParameter.Key + " = {" + text + "}");
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public void Assign(MaskSettings<T> settings)
		{
			if (settings != null && settings != this)
			{
				Restore(settings.Save());
			}
		}

		public MaskSettingsState Save()
		{
			return new MaskSettingsState(maskParameters);
		}

		public MaskSettingsState Save(Stream stream)
		{
			MaskSettingsState result = Save();
			if (stream != null && stream.CanWrite)
			{
				result.Save(stream);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void Restore(MaskSettingsState state)
		{
			ResetMaskManagerType();
			if (state.Apply(maskParameters))
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged(string.Empty);
				TypeDescriptor.Refresh(this);
			}
		}

		public void Restore(Stream stream)
		{
			if (stream != null && stream.CanRead)
			{
				if (stream.CanSeek)
				{
					stream.Seek(0L, SeekOrigin.Begin);
				}
				Restore(new MaskSettingsState(stream));
			}
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Data.Controls

	public enum ControlRows
	{
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		Source,
		Visible,
		Selected
	}
	public interface IControlRowSource
	{
		object RowSource { get; }

		event ControlRowSourceChangedEventHandler Changed;

		IEnumerable GetRows(ControlRows rows);
	}
	public delegate void ControlRowSourceChangedEventHandler(object sender, ControlRowSourceChangedEventArgs e);
	public class ControlRowSourceChangedEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		public ControlRows ChangedRows { get; private set; }

		public ControlRowSourceChangedEventArgs(ControlRows changedRows)
		{
			ChangedRows = changedRows;
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxItem(false)]
	[ToolboxTabName("DX.23.2: Data & Analytics")]
	[ToolboxBitmap(typeof(ResFinder), "Bitmaps256.ControlRowSource.bmp")]
	[Description("A data source that provides visible or selected data-aware control rows as a data source.")]
	public class ControlRowSource : Component, ITypedList, ISupportInitialize, IDXCloneable, IControlRowSourceComponent, IListSource, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private static class RowsCache
		{
			internal static readonly PropertyDescriptorCollection EmptyProperties = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(new PropertyDescriptor[0], readOnly: true);

			internal static readonly IList EmptyRows = new Rows<object>(null);

			private static readonly IDictionary<Type, Func<ControlRowSource, IList>> createCache = new Dictionary<Type, Func<ControlRowSource, IList>> { 
			{
				typeof(DataRowView),
				(ControlRowSource rs) => new DataViewRows(rs)
			} };

			private static readonly ParameterExpression pRowSource = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(ControlRowSource), "rowSource");

			private static readonly IDictionary<Type, Func<IList, IEnumerable, bool>> reloadCache = new Dictionary<Type, Func<IList, IEnumerable, bool>>();

			private static readonly ParameterExpression pList = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(IList), "list");

			private static readonly ParameterExpression pControlRows = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Parameter(typeof(IEnumerable), "controlRows");

			internal static IList Create(ControlRowSource rowSource, Type rowType, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (rowType == null)
				{
					return EmptyRows;
				}
				Func<ControlRowSource, IList> value = null;
				if (!createCache.TryGetValue(rowType, out value))
				{
					Type type = GenericTypeHelper.MakeGenericType(EnsureRowsType(sourceType, rowType), rowType);
					ConstructorInfo constructor = type.GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(ControlRowSource) });
					value = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda<Func<ControlRowSource, IList>>(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.New(constructor, pRowSource), new ParameterExpression[1] { pRowSource }).Compile();
					createCache.Add(rowType, value);
				}
				return value(rowSource);
			}

			private static Type EnsureRowsType(Type sourceType, Type type)
			{
				if (IsExcelDataViewRow(sourceType, type) || IsSqlResultTableRow(sourceType, type))
				{
					return typeof(TypedListRows<>);
				}
				return typeof(Rows<>);
			}

			private static bool IsSqlResultTableRow(Type sourceType, Type type)
			{
				if (sourceType.FullName == "DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultTable")
				{
					return type.FullName == "DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Sql.ResultRow";
				}
				return false;
			}

			private static bool IsExcelDataViewRow(Type sourceType, Type type)
			{
				if (sourceType.FullName == "DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Excel.DataView")
				{
					return type.FullName == "DevExpress.DataAccess.Native.Excel.ViewRow";
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal static bool Reload(IList rows, Type type, IEnumerable controlRows)
			{
				if (rows == null || type == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Func<IList, IEnumerable, bool> value = null;
				if (!reloadCache.TryGetValue(type, out value))
				{
					Type type2 = GenericTypeHelper.MakeGenericType(typeof(RowsBase<>), type);
					MethodInfo method = type2.GetMethod("Reload", BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic, null, new Type[1] { typeof(IEnumerable) }, null);
					value = System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Lambda<Func<IList, IEnumerable, bool>>(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Call(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression.Convert(pList, type2), method, pControlRows), new ParameterExpression[2] { pList, pControlRows }).Compile();
					reloadCache.Add(type, value);
				}
				return value(rows, controlRows);
			}
		}

		private abstract class RowsBase<T> : ReadOnlyCollection<T>, INotifyCollectionChanged, IDisposable
		{
			private readonly ControlRowSource rowSource;

			private static readonly NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs resetArgs = new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset);

			private static readonly object collectionChanged = new object();

			event NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler INotifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged
			{
				add
				{
					if (rowSource != null)
					{
						rowSource.Events.AddHandler(collectionChanged, value);
					}
				}
				remove
				{
					if (rowSource != null)
					{
						rowSource.Events.RemoveHandler(collectionChanged, value);
					}
				}
			}

			protected RowsBase(ControlRowSource rowSource)
				: base((IList<T>)new List<T>())
			{
				this.rowSource = rowSource;
			}

			void IDisposable.Dispose()
			{
				base.Items.Clear();
				GC.SuppressFinalize(this);
			}

			protected object GetSource()
			{
				if (rowSource == null || rowSource.Control == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return rowSource.Control.RowSource;
			}

			private bool Reload(IEnumerable controlRows)
			{
				if (rowSource != null)
				{
					int count = base.Items.Count;
					base.Items.Clear();
					foreach (T item in controlRows.OfType<T>())
					{
						base.Items.Add(item);
					}
					if (count != base.Items.Count || count > 0)
					{
						RaiseResetCollection();
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal void RaiseResetCollection()
			{
				if (rowSource.Events[collectionChanged] is NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler notifyCollectionChangedEventHandler)
				{
					notifyCollectionChangedEventHandler(this, resetArgs);
				}
			}
		}

		private sealed class Rows<T> : RowsBase<T>, ITypedList
		{
			public Rows(ControlRowSource rowSource)
				: base(rowSource)
			{
			}

			string ITypedList.GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
			{
				return ListBindingHelper.GetListName(typeof(T), listAccessors);
			}

			PropertyDescriptorCollection ITypedList.GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
			{
				return ListBindingHelper.GetListItemProperties(typeof(T), listAccessors);
			}
		}

		private sealed class DataViewRows : RowsBase<DataRowView>, ITypedList
		{
			private DataView dataViewCore;

			private DataView DataView
			{
				get
				{
					if (dataViewCore == null)
					{
						dataViewCore = GetDataView();
					}
					return dataViewCore;
				}
			}

			public DataViewRows(ControlRowSource rowSource)
				: base(rowSource)
			{
			}

			private DataView GetDataView()
			{
				object source = UnwrapBindingSource(GetSource());
				return GetDataView(source);
			}

			private DataView GetDataView(object source)
			{
				return (source as DataView) ?? MayBe.Get<DataTable, DataView>(source as DataTable, (Func<DataTable, DataView>)((DataTable t) => t.DefaultView), (DataView)null);
			}

			string ITypedList.GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
			{
				if (DataView == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((ITypedList)DataView).GetListName(listAccessors);
			}

			PropertyDescriptorCollection ITypedList.GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
			{
				if (DataView == null)
				{
					return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(null);
				}
				return ((ITypedList)DataView).GetItemProperties(listAccessors);
			}
		}

		private sealed class TypedListRows<T> : RowsBase<T>, ITypedList
		{
			private ITypedList typedListCore;

			private ITypedList TypedList
			{
				get
				{
					if (typedListCore == null)
					{
						typedListCore = UnwrapBindingSource(GetSource()) as ITypedList;
					}
					return typedListCore;
				}
			}

			public TypedListRows(ControlRowSource rowSource)
				: base(rowSource)
			{
			}

			string ITypedList.GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
			{
				if (TypedList == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return TypedList.GetListName(listAccessors);
			}

			PropertyDescriptorCollection ITypedList.GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
			{
				if (TypedList == null)
				{
					return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(null);
				}
				return TypedList.GetItemProperties(listAccessors);
			}
		}

		private IList rowsCore;

		private Type rowTypeCore;

		private IControlRowSource controlCore;

		private ControlRows controlRowsCore = ControlRows.Visible;

		private int initializing;

		private static readonly object propertyChanged = new object();

		bool IListSource.ContainsListCollection => false;

		private IList List
		{
			get
			{
				if (rowsCore == null)
				{
					rowsCore = CreateList();
				}
				return rowsCore;
			}
		}

		protected internal Type ControlRowType
		{
			get
			{
				if (rowTypeCore == null)
				{
					rowTypeCore = GetRowType(Control);
				}
				return rowTypeCore;
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the control that provides its data rows to another control.")]
		[Category("Data")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public IControlRowSource Control
		{
			get
			{
				return controlCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (controlCore != value)
				{
					UnsubscribeControlEvents();
					Type prevRowType = rowTypeCore;
					controlCore = value;
					rowsCore = null;
					rowTypeCore = null;
					SubscribeControlEvents();
					RaisePropertyChangedChanged("Control");
					ReloadRows(prevRowType);
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the type of rows that the source control provides.")]
		[Category("Data")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[DefaultValue(ControlRows.Visible)]
		public ControlRows ControlRows
		{
			get
			{
				return controlRowsCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (controlRowsCore != value)
				{
					controlRowsCore = value;
					RaisePropertyChangedChanged("ControlRows");
					ReloadRows(raiseList: false);
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged
		{
			add
			{
				base.Events.AddHandler(propertyChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				base.Events.RemoveHandler(propertyChanged, value);
			}
		}

		object IDXCloneable.DXClone()
		{
			return DXClone();
		}

		protected virtual object DXClone()
		{
			ControlRowSource controlRowSource = DXCloneCreate();
			controlRowSource.controlCore = controlCore;
			controlRowSource.controlRowsCore = controlRowsCore;
			return controlRowSource;
		}

		protected virtual ControlRowSource DXCloneCreate()
		{
			return new ControlRowSource();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			UnsubscribeControlEvents();
			controlCore = null;
			rowsCore = null;
			rowTypeCore = null;
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		IList IListSource.GetList()
		{
			return List;
		}

		protected virtual IList CreateList()
		{
			if (Control == null || Control.RowSource == null)
			{
				return RowsCache.EmptyRows;
			}
			return RowsCache.Create(this, ControlRowType, GetSourceType(Control));
		}

		private static Type GetRowType(IControlRowSource source)
		{
			if (source == null || source.RowSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object rowSource = source.RowSource;
			return GetBindingSourceItemType(rowSource) ?? DataBrowserHelperBase.GetListItemType(rowSource) ?? ListBindingHelper.GetListItemType(rowSource);
		}

		private static Type GetSourceType(IControlRowSource source)
		{
			if (source == null || source.RowSource == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = UnwrapBindingSource(source.RowSource);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return typeof(object);
			}
			return obj.GetType();
		}

		private static object UnwrapBindingSource(object source)
		{
			while (source is BindingSource bindingSource)
			{
				source = ListBindingHelper.GetList(bindingSource.DataSource, bindingSource.DataMember);
			}
			return source;
		}

		private static Type GetBindingSourceItemType(object dataSource)
		{
			if (dataSource is BindingSource bindingSource && bindingSource.DataSource is Type)
			{
				return bindingSource.DataSource as Type;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IEnumerable GetControlRows()
		{
			if (Control == null)
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<object>();
			}
			return Control.GetRows(ControlRows);
		}

		string ITypedList.GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			return GetListName(Control, listAccessors);
		}

		PropertyDescriptorCollection ITypedList.GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			return GetRowProperties(Control, listAccessors);
		}

		private static string GetListName(IControlRowSource source, PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			if (source == null || source.RowSource == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return ListBindingHelper.GetListName(source.RowSource, listAccessors);
		}

		private static PropertyDescriptorCollection GetRowProperties(IControlRowSource source, PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
		{
			if (source == null || source.RowSource == null)
			{
				return RowsCache.EmptyProperties;
			}
			return ListBindingHelper.GetListItemProperties(source.RowSource, listAccessors);
		}

		protected virtual void SubscribeControlEvents()
		{
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.Changed += Source_Changed;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeControlEvents()
		{
			if (Control != null)
			{
				Control.Changed -= Source_Changed;
			}
		}

		private void Source_Changed(object sender, ControlRowSourceChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangedRows == ControlRows.Source)
			{
				Type prevRowType = rowTypeCore;
				rowsCore = null;
				rowTypeCore = null;
				ReloadRows(prevRowType);
			}
			else
			{
				ReloadRows(raiseList: false);
			}
		}

		private void ReloadRows(Type prevRowType)
		{
			if (initializing <= 0 && !base.DesignMode && prevRowType != ControlRowType)
			{
				RowsCache.Reload(List, ControlRowType, GetControlRows());
				RaisePropertyChangedChanged("List");
			}
		}

		public void ReloadRows(bool raiseList)
		{
			if (initializing <= 0 && !base.DesignMode)
			{
				RowsCache.Reload(List, ControlRowType, GetControlRows());
				if (raiseList)
				{
					RaisePropertyChangedChanged("List");
				}
			}
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			initializing++;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			if (--initializing == 0)
			{
				OnInitialized();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnInitialized()
		{
			ReloadRows(Control != null && Control.RowSource != null);
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChangedChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (base.Events[propertyChanged] is PropertyChangedEventHandler propertyChangedEventHandler)
			{
				propertyChangedEventHandler(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace DevExpress.Data.Camera
{
	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	public class CameraDeviceBase : IDisposable
	{
		private IGraphBuilder graph;

		private ISampleGrabber grabber;

		private ICaptureGraphBuilder2 captureGraphBuilder;

		private IBaseFilter sourceFilter;

		private IBaseFilter grabberFilter;

		private IMediaControl mediaControl;

		private IMediaEventEx mediaEventEx;

		private CaptureGrabber capGrabber;

		private AMMediaType mediaType;

		private IntPtr framePtr;

		private DeviceCapabilities currentCaps;

		private FrameRateCounter rateCounter = new FrameRateCounter();

		private string deviceMoniker;

		private string name;

		private ICameraDeviceClient client;

		private bool isRunning;

		private System.Drawing.Size PreferredResolution;

		[Description("Gets the string representation of the moniker for the current device.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public string DeviceMoniker => deviceMoniker;

		[Description("Gets the UI display name of the video capture device.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public string Name => name;

		[Description("Gets whether the video capture device is already in use in another application.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool IsBusy { get; private set; }

		[Description("Gets whether the device is currently capturing video.")]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool IsRunning
		{
			get
			{
				return isRunning;
			}
			private set
			{
				isRunning = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool UseLegacyCaptureMode => false;

		protected internal int BitsPerPixel => System.Drawing.Image.GetPixelFormatSize(CurrentPixelFormat);

		protected System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat CurrentPixelFormat => System.Drawing.Imaging.PixelFormat.Format24bppRgb;

		[Description("Gets or sets the resolution of a video stream captured by the current device.")]
		public System.Drawing.Size Resolution
		{
			get
			{
				return GetCurrentResolution();
			}
			set
			{
				SetResolution(value);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void SetClient(ICameraDeviceClient client)
		{
			this.client = client;
		}

		public CameraDeviceBase(CameraDeviceInfo deviceInfo)
		{
			deviceMoniker = deviceInfo.MonikerString;
			name = deviceInfo.Name;
		}

		public void Start()
		{
			if (!IsRunning)
			{
				capGrabber = new CaptureGrabber(this);
				capGrabber.UseLegacyCaptureMode = UseLegacyCaptureMode;
				SubscribeOnCaptureGrabber(capGrabber);
				IsBusy = false;
				currentCaps = BuildGraph(runDevice: true);
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeOnCaptureGrabber(CaptureGrabber cg)
		{
			cg.NewFrame += cg_NewFrame;
			cg.SizeChanged += cg_SizeChanged;
		}

		private void UnSubscribeOnCaptureGrabber(CaptureGrabber cg)
		{
			cg.NewFrame -= cg_NewFrame;
			cg.SizeChanged -= cg_SizeChanged;
		}

		private void cg_SizeChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnGrabberSizeChanged();
		}

		private void cg_NewFrame(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			OnNewFrame();
		}

		protected virtual void OnNewFrame()
		{
			client?.OnNewFrame();
			rateCounter.Inc();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			Stop();
			SetClient(null);
			rateCounter.Free();
			rateCounter = null;
		}

		public Bitmap TakeSnapshot()
		{
			if (capGrabber != null && capGrabber.FramePtr != IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(capGrabber.Width, capGrabber.Height, CurrentPixelFormat);
				int length = bitmap.Width * bitmap.Height * BitsPerPixel / 8;
				BitmapData bitmapData = bitmap.LockBits(new Rectangle(0, 0, bitmap.Width, bitmap.Height), ImageLockMode.ReadWrite, CurrentPixelFormat);
				CameraImport.CopyMemory(bitmapData.Scan0, capGrabber.FramePtr, length);
				bitmap.UnlockBits(bitmapData);
				return bitmap;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void OnGrabberSizeChanged()
		{
			if (capGrabber.Width != 0 && capGrabber.Height != 0)
			{
				uint num = (uint)(capGrabber.Width * capGrabber.Height * BitsPerPixel / 8);
				IntPtr intPtr = CameraImport.CreateFileMapping(new IntPtr(-1), IntPtr.Zero, 4u, 0u, num, null);
				framePtr = CameraImport.MapViewOfFile(intPtr, 983071u, 0u, 0u, num);
				capGrabber.FramePtr = framePtr;
				CreateFrameCore(intPtr, capGrabber.Width, capGrabber.Height, framePtr);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CreateFrameCore(IntPtr section, int width, int height, IntPtr stride)
		{
		}

		private void SubscribeOnMediaEventNotifying(IGraphBuilder iGraphBuilder)
		{
			if (iGraphBuilder != null)
			{
				mediaEventEx = iGraphBuilder as IMediaEventEx;
				if (mediaEventEx != null && client != null)
				{
					mediaEventEx.SetNotifyWindow(client.Handle, CameraImport.WM_GRAPHNOTIFY, IntPtr.Zero);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeFromMediaEventNotifying()
		{
			if (mediaEventEx != null)
			{
				mediaEventEx.SetNotifyWindow(IntPtr.Zero, CameraImport.WM_GRAPHNOTIFY, IntPtr.Zero);
			}
		}

		private IBaseFilter CreateSourceFilter()
		{
			try
			{
				return CameraDeviceInfo.CreateFilter(DeviceMoniker);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private DeviceCapabilities BuildGraph(bool runDevice)
		{
			DeviceCapabilities deviceCapabilities = new DeviceCapabilities();
			try
			{
				graph = Activator.CreateInstance(Type.GetTypeFromCLSID(CameraImport.FilterGraph)) as IGraphBuilder;
				SubscribeOnMediaEventNotifying(graph);
				sourceFilter = CreateSourceFilter();
				if (sourceFilter == null)
				{
					return deviceCapabilities;
				}
				grabber = Activator.CreateInstance(Type.GetTypeFromCLSID(CameraImport.SampleGrabber)) as ISampleGrabber;
				grabberFilter = grabber as IBaseFilter;
				graph.AddFilter(sourceFilter, "Camera");
				graph.AddFilter(grabberFilter, "Output");
				captureGraphBuilder = (ICaptureGraphBuilder2)new CaptureGraphBuilder2();
				captureGraphBuilder.SetFiltergraph(graph);
				mediaType = new AMMediaType();
				mediaType.MajorType = MediaTypes.Video;
				mediaType.SubType = MediaSubTypes.RGB24;
				grabber.SetMediaType(mediaType);
				IAMStreamConfig streamCfg = GetStreamCfg(captureGraphBuilder, sourceFilter, PinCategory.Capture);
				GetAvailiableResolutions(streamCfg, deviceCapabilities.VideoResolutions);
				if (runDevice)
				{
					ConfigureStream(streamCfg);
					if (captureGraphBuilder.RenderStream(PinCategory.Capture, MediaTypes.Video, sourceFilter, null, grabberFilter) < 0)
					{
						throw new Exception("Device is busy");
					}
					if (grabber.GetConnectedMediaType(mediaType) == 0)
					{
						VideoInfoHeader videoInfoHeader = (VideoInfoHeader)Marshal.PtrToStructure(mediaType.FormatPtr, typeof(VideoInfoHeader));
						capGrabber.SetSize(videoInfoHeader.BmiHeader.Width, videoInfoHeader.BmiHeader.Height);
					}
					grabber.SetBufferSamples(bufferThem: false);
					grabber.SetOneShot(oneShot: false);
					grabber.SetCallback(capGrabber, 1);
					IVideoWindow videoWindow = (IVideoWindow)graph;
					videoWindow.put_AutoShow(autoShow: false);
					videoWindow = null;
					mediaControl = (IMediaControl)graph;
					int errorCode = mediaControl.Run();
					Marshal.ThrowExceptionForHR(errorCode);
					rateCounter.Start();
					IsRunning = true;
				}
				else
				{
					mediaType.Dispose();
					Stop(forced: true);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				Stop(forced: true);
				IsBusy = true;
				OnDeviceLost();
				deviceCapabilities = null;
			}
			return deviceCapabilities;
		}

		private IAMStreamConfig GetStreamCfg(ICaptureGraphBuilder2 graphBuilder, IBaseFilter baseFilter, Guid pinCategory)
		{
			graphBuilder.FindInterface(pinCategory, MediaTypes.Video, baseFilter, typeof(IAMStreamConfig).GUID, out var ppint);
			if (ppint != null && ppint is IAMStreamConfig result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ConfigureStream(IAMStreamConfig streamCfg)
		{
			if (streamCfg != null)
			{
				AMMediaType pmt = new AMMediaType();
				streamCfg.GetFormat(out pmt);
				bool flag = false;
				AMMediaType result = null;
				if (TryGetMediaTypeByResolution(streamCfg, PreferredResolution, out result))
				{
					pmt.Dispose();
					pmt = result;
					flag = true;
				}
				VideoInfoHeader structure = (VideoInfoHeader)Marshal.PtrToStructure(pmt.FormatPtr, typeof(VideoInfoHeader));
				if (!flag)
				{
					structure.BmiHeader.Height = PreferredResolution.Height;
					structure.BmiHeader.Width = PreferredResolution.Width;
				}
				structure.AverageTimePerFrame = 333333L;
				Marshal.StructureToPtr(structure, pmt.FormatPtr, fDeleteOld: false);
				streamCfg.SetFormat(pmt);
			}
		}

		private System.Drawing.Size GetCurrentResolution()
		{
			if (IsRunning)
			{
				return new System.Drawing.Size(capGrabber.Width, capGrabber.Height);
			}
			List<System.Drawing.Size> availiableResolutions = GetAvailiableResolutions();
			if (availiableResolutions.Count > 0)
			{
				return availiableResolutions[0];
			}
			return PreferredResolution;
		}

		private void SetResolution(System.Drawing.Size resolution)
		{
			if (IsRunning)
			{
				Stop();
				PreferredResolution = resolution;
				Start();
				client?.OnResolutionChanged();
			}
			else
			{
				PreferredResolution = resolution;
			}
		}

		public List<System.Drawing.Size> GetAvailableResolutions()
		{
			return GetAvailiableResolutions();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public List<System.Drawing.Size> GetAvailiableResolutions()
		{
			if (IsRunning)
			{
				if (currentCaps != null)
				{
					return currentCaps.VideoResolutions;
				}
				return new List<System.Drawing.Size>();
			}
			DeviceCapabilities deviceCapabilities = BuildGraph(runDevice: false);
			if (deviceCapabilities != null)
			{
				return deviceCapabilities.VideoResolutions;
			}
			return new List<System.Drawing.Size>();
		}

		private void GetAvailiableResolutions(IAMStreamConfig streamCfg, List<System.Drawing.Size> result)
		{
			if (streamCfg == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			VideoStreamConfigCaps videoStreamConfigCaps = new VideoStreamConfigCaps();
			streamCfg.GetNumberOfCapabilities(out var piCount, out var _);
			for (int i = 0; i < piCount; i++)
			{
				if (streamCfg.GetStreamCaps(i, out var ppmt, videoStreamConfigCaps) == 0)
				{
					System.Drawing.Size inputSize = videoStreamConfigCaps.InputSize;
					if (!result.Contains(inputSize))
					{
						result.Add(inputSize);
					}
					ppmt.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool TryGetMediaTypeByResolution(IAMStreamConfig streamCfg, System.Drawing.Size resolution, out AMMediaType result)
		{
			result = null;
			if (resolution.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (streamCfg == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			VideoStreamConfigCaps videoStreamConfigCaps = new VideoStreamConfigCaps();
			AMMediaType ppmt = new AMMediaType();
			streamCfg.GetNumberOfCapabilities(out var piCount, out var _);
			for (int i = 0; i < piCount; i++)
			{
				if (streamCfg.GetStreamCaps(i, out ppmt, videoStreamConfigCaps) == 0)
				{
					if (videoStreamConfigCaps.InputSize == resolution)
					{
						result = ppmt;
						return true;
					}
					ppmt.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Stop()
		{
			Stop(forced: false);
		}

		private void Stop(bool forced)
		{
			if (forced || IsRunning)
			{
				UnsubscribeFromMediaEventNotifying();
				IsRunning = false;
				if (mediaControl != null)
				{
					mediaControl.StopWhenReady();
				}
				if (capGrabber != null)
				{
					UnSubscribeOnCaptureGrabber(capGrabber);
					CameraImport.UnmapViewOfFile(capGrabber.FramePtr);
					capGrabber.FramePtr = IntPtr.Zero;
				}
				if (sourceFilter != null)
				{
					sourceFilter.Stop();
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(sourceFilter);
					sourceFilter = null;
				}
				if (grabberFilter != null)
				{
					grabberFilter.Stop();
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(grabberFilter);
					grabberFilter = null;
				}
				if (graph != null)
				{
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(graph);
					graph = null;
				}
				if (grabber != null)
				{
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(grabber);
					grabber = null;
				}
				if (captureGraphBuilder != null)
				{
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(captureGraphBuilder);
					captureGraphBuilder = null;
				}
				if (mediaControl != null)
				{
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(mediaControl);
					mediaControl = null;
				}
				if (mediaEventEx != null)
				{
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(mediaEventEx);
					mediaEventEx = null;
				}
				currentCaps = null;
				capGrabber = null;
				mediaType = null;
				rateCounter.Stop();
				FreeFrame();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void FreeFrame()
		{
		}

		private int GetVideoProcessingProperty(VideoProcAmpProperty videoProperty, bool getValue, string subPropName)
		{
			if (sourceFilter is IAMVideoProcAmp iAMVideoProcAmp)
			{
				VideoProcAmpFlags pCapsFlags;
				int pMin;
				int pMax;
				int pSteppingDelta;
				int pDefault;
				if (getValue)
				{
					if (iAMVideoProcAmp.Get(videoProperty, out var lValue, out pCapsFlags) == 0)
					{
						return lValue;
					}
				}
				else if (iAMVideoProcAmp.GetRange(videoProperty, out pMin, out pMax, out pSteppingDelta, out pDefault, out pCapsFlags) == 0)
				{
					return subPropName switch
					{
						"Min" => pMin, 
						"Max" => pMax, 
						"SteppingDelta" => pSteppingDelta, 
						"Default" => pDefault, 
						_ => 0, 
					};
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal int GetVideoProcessingPropertyByName(string propName, bool getValue, string subPropName)
		{
			VideoProcAmpProperty videoProperty = (VideoProcAmpProperty)Enum.Parse(typeof(VideoProcAmpProperty), propName, ignoreCase: true);
			return GetVideoProcessingProperty(videoProperty, getValue, subPropName);
		}

		internal void SetVideoProcessingProperty(VideoProcAmpProperty videoProperty, int value)
		{
			if (sourceFilter is IAMVideoProcAmp iAMVideoProcAmp)
			{
				iAMVideoProcAmp.Set(videoProperty, value, VideoProcAmpFlags.Manual);
			}
		}

		internal void SetVideoProcessingPropertyByName(string propName, int val)
		{
			VideoProcAmpProperty videoProperty = (VideoProcAmpProperty)Enum.Parse(typeof(VideoProcAmpProperty), propName, ignoreCase: true);
			SetVideoProcessingProperty(videoProperty, val);
		}

		internal void HandleGraphEvent()
		{
			EventCode lEventCode = (EventCode)0;
			IntPtr lParam;
			IntPtr lParam2;
			while (mediaEventEx != null && mediaEventEx.GetEvent(out lEventCode, out lParam, out lParam2, 0) == 0)
			{
				mediaEventEx.FreeEventParams(lEventCode, lParam, lParam2);
				if (lEventCode == EventCode.DeviceLost)
				{
					OnDeviceLost();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnDeviceLost()
		{
			client?.OnDeviceLost(this);
			Stop();
		}

		public virtual void WndProc(ref Message m)
		{
			if (m.Msg == CameraImport.WM_GRAPHNOTIFY)
			{
				HandleGraphEvent();
			}
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is CameraDeviceBase cameraDeviceBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DeviceMoniker.Equals(cameraDeviceBase.DeviceMoniker);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}

	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	internal class CaptureGrabber : ISampleGrabberCB
	{
		private int stride;

		public CameraDeviceBase Device { get; }

		public IntPtr FramePtr { get; set; }

		public int Width { get; private set; }

		public int Height { get; private set; }

		public bool UseLegacyCaptureMode { get; set; }

		public event EventHandler NewFrame;

		public event EventHandler SizeChanged;

		public CaptureGrabber(CameraDeviceBase device)
		{
			Device = device;
		}

		public void SetSize(int width, int height)
		{
			Width = width;
			Height = height;
			stride = width * Device.BitsPerPixel / 8;
			this.SizeChanged?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public int SampleCB(double sampleTime, IntPtr sample)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public int BufferCB(double sampleTime, IntPtr buffer, int bufferLen)
		{
			if (FramePtr != IntPtr.Zero && Device.IsRunning)
			{
				if (UseLegacyCaptureMode)
				{
					byte[] array = new byte[bufferLen];
					byte[] array2 = new byte[bufferLen];
					Marshal.Copy(buffer, array, 0, bufferLen);
					for (int i = 0; i < Height; i++)
					{
						Array.Copy(array, bufferLen - stride * i - stride, array2, i * stride, stride);
					}
					Marshal.Copy(array2, 0, FramePtr, bufferLen);
				}
				else
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < Height; j++)
					{
						CameraImport.CopyMemory(IntPtr.Add(FramePtr, j * stride), IntPtr.Add(buffer, bufferLen - stride * j - stride), stride);
					}
				}
				this.NewFrame?.Invoke(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	public class CameraDeviceInfo : IComparable
	{
		public readonly string Name;

		public readonly string MonikerString;

		public CameraDeviceInfo(string monikerString)
		{
			MonikerString = monikerString;
			Name = GetName(monikerString);
		}

		public CameraDeviceInfo(string monikerString, string name)
		{
			MonikerString = monikerString;
			Name = name;
		}

		internal CameraDeviceInfo(IMoniker moniker)
		{
			MonikerString = GetMonikerString(moniker);
			Name = GetName(moniker);
		}

		public int CompareTo(object value)
		{
			CameraDeviceInfo cameraDeviceInfo = (CameraDeviceInfo)value;
			if (cameraDeviceInfo == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return Name.CompareTo(cameraDeviceInfo.Name);
		}

		internal static IBaseFilter CreateFilter(string filterMoniker)
		{
			object ppvResult = null;
			IBindCtx ppbc = null;
			IMoniker ppmk = null;
			int pchEaten = 0;
			if (CameraImport.CreateBindCtx(0, out ppbc) == 0)
			{
				if (CameraImport.MkParseDisplayName(ppbc, filterMoniker, ref pchEaten, out ppmk) == 0)
				{
					Guid riidResult = typeof(IBaseFilter).GUID;
					ppmk.BindToObject(null, null, ref riidResult, out ppvResult);
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ppmk);
				}
				Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ppbc);
			}
			return ppvResult as IBaseFilter;
		}

		internal static IMoniker GetMoniker(string filterMoniker)
		{
			IBindCtx ppbc = null;
			IMoniker ppmk = null;
			int pchEaten = 0;
			if (CameraImport.CreateBindCtx(0, out ppbc) == 0)
			{
				CameraImport.MkParseDisplayName(ppbc, filterMoniker, ref pchEaten, out ppmk);
				Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ppbc);
			}
			return ppmk;
		}

		private string GetMonikerString(IMoniker moniker)
		{
			moniker.GetDisplayName(null, null, out var ppszDisplayName);
			return ppszDisplayName;
		}

		private string GetName(IMoniker moniker)
		{
			object ppvObj = null;
			IPropertyBag propertyBag = null;
			try
			{
				Guid riid = typeof(IPropertyBag).GUID;
				moniker.BindToStorage(null, null, ref riid, out ppvObj);
				propertyBag = (IPropertyBag)ppvObj;
				object pVar = string.Empty;
				int num = propertyBag.Read("FriendlyName", ref pVar, IntPtr.Zero);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					Marshal.ThrowExceptionForHR(num);
				}
				string text = (string)pVar;
				if (text == null || text.Length < 1)
				{
					throw new ApplicationException();
				}
				return text;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			finally
			{
				propertyBag = null;
				if (ppvObj != null)
				{
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ppvObj);
					ppvObj = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private string GetName(string monikerString)
		{
			IBindCtx ppbc = null;
			IMoniker ppmk = null;
			string result = string.Empty;
			int pchEaten = 0;
			if (CameraImport.CreateBindCtx(0, out ppbc) == 0)
			{
				if (CameraImport.MkParseDisplayName(ppbc, monikerString, ref pchEaten, out ppmk) == 0)
				{
					result = GetName(ppmk);
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ppmk);
					ppmk = null;
				}
				Marshal.ReleaseComObject(ppbc);
				ppbc = null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Name;
		}
	}
	[SecuritySafeCritical]
	public static class DeviceHelper
	{
		public static CameraDeviceInfo[] DeviceMonikers => DeviceMonikes;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static CameraDeviceInfo[] DeviceMonikes
		{
			get
			{
				List<CameraDeviceInfo> list = new List<CameraDeviceInfo>();
				IMoniker[] array = new IMoniker[1];
				ICreateDevEnum createDevEnum = Activator.CreateInstance(Type.GetTypeFromCLSID(CameraImport.SystemDeviceEnum)) as ICreateDevEnum;
				Guid type = CameraImport.VideoInputDevice;
				if (createDevEnum.CreateClassEnumerator(ref type, out var enumMoniker, 0) == 0)
				{
					while (enumMoniker.Next(1, array, IntPtr.Zero) == 0 && array[0] != null)
					{
						list.Add(new CameraDeviceInfo(array[0]));
						Marshal.ReleaseComObject(array[0]);
						array[0] = null;
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		internal static IPin GetPin(this IBaseFilter filter, PinDirection dir, int num)
		{
			IPin[] array = new IPin[1];
			IEnumPins enumPins = null;
			if (filter.EnumPins(out enumPins) == 0)
			{
				int pinsFetched;
				while (enumPins.Next(1, array, out pinsFetched) == 0)
				{
					array[0].QueryDirection(out var pinDirection);
					if (pinDirection == dir)
					{
						if (num == 0)
						{
							return array[0];
						}
						num--;
					}
					Marshal.ReleaseComObject(array[0]);
					array[0] = null;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static List<CameraDeviceInfo> GetDevices()
		{
			return DeviceMonikes.ToList();
		}
	}
	internal class FrameRateCounter
	{
		private System.Timers.Timer timer;

		private int count;

		public int FrameRate { get; private set; }

		public FrameRateCounter()
		{
			timer = new System.Timers.Timer(1000.0);
			timer.Elapsed += timer_Elapsed;
		}

		private void timer_Elapsed(object sender, ElapsedEventArgs e)
		{
			FrameRate = count;
			Interlocked.Exchange(ref count, 0);
		}

		public void Inc()
		{
			Interlocked.Increment(ref count);
		}

		public void Start()
		{
			timer.Start();
		}

		public void Stop()
		{
			timer.Stop();
		}

		public void Free()
		{
			Stop();
			timer.Elapsed -= timer_Elapsed;
			timer.Dispose();
		}
	}
