	[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
	public class DeviceVideoSettings : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private ICameraDeviceClient _deviceClient;

		private List<DeviceVideoProperty> propsList = new List<DeviceVideoProperty>();

		public DeviceVideoProperty Brightness { get; private set; }

		public DeviceVideoProperty Contrast { get; private set; }

		public DeviceVideoProperty Hue { get; private set; }

		public DeviceVideoProperty Saturation { get; private set; }

		public DeviceVideoProperty Sharpness { get; private set; }

		public DeviceVideoProperty Gamma { get; private set; }

		public DeviceVideoProperty ColorEnable { get; private set; }

		public DeviceVideoProperty WhiteBalance { get; private set; }

		public DeviceVideoProperty BacklightCompensation { get; private set; }

		public DeviceVideoProperty Gain { get; private set; }

		private CameraDeviceBase Device
		{
			get
			{
				if (_deviceClient != null)
				{
					return _deviceClient.Device;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private bool DeviceIsAvailable => Device != null;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public DeviceVideoSettings(ICameraDeviceClient client)
		{
			_deviceClient = client;
			InitProps();
		}

		private void InitProps()
		{
			List<DeviceVideoProperty> list = propsList;
			DeviceVideoProperty item = (Brightness = new DeviceVideoProperty(this, "Brightness"));
			list.Add(item);
			List<DeviceVideoProperty> list2 = propsList;
			item = (Contrast = new DeviceVideoProperty(this, "Contrast"));
			list2.Add(item);
			List<DeviceVideoProperty> list3 = propsList;
			item = (Hue = new DeviceVideoProperty(this, "Hue"));
			list3.Add(item);
			List<DeviceVideoProperty> list4 = propsList;
			item = (Saturation = new DeviceVideoProperty(this, "Saturation"));
			list4.Add(item);
			List<DeviceVideoProperty> list5 = propsList;
			item = (Sharpness = new DeviceVideoProperty(this, "Sharpness"));
			list5.Add(item);
			List<DeviceVideoProperty> list6 = propsList;
			item = (Gamma = new DeviceVideoProperty(this, "Gamma"));
			list6.Add(item);
			List<DeviceVideoProperty> list7 = propsList;
			item = (ColorEnable = new DeviceVideoProperty(this, "ColorEnable"));
			list7.Add(item);
			List<DeviceVideoProperty> list8 = propsList;
			item = (WhiteBalance = new DeviceVideoProperty(this, "WhiteBalance"));
			list8.Add(item);
			List<DeviceVideoProperty> list9 = propsList;
			item = (BacklightCompensation = new DeviceVideoProperty(this, "BacklightCompensation"));
			list9.Add(item);
			List<DeviceVideoProperty> list10 = propsList;
			item = (Gain = new DeviceVideoProperty(this, "Gain"));
			list10.Add(item);
		}

		public void ResetToDefaults()
		{
			foreach (DeviceVideoProperty props in propsList)
			{
				props.ResetToDefault();
			}
		}

		internal void SetProp(string propName, int val)
		{
			if (DeviceIsAvailable)
			{
				Device.SetVideoProcessingPropertyByName(propName, val);
			}
		}

		internal int GetPropMin(string name)
		{
			if (DeviceIsAvailable)
			{
				return Device.GetVideoProcessingPropertyByName(name, getValue: false, "Min");
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal int GetPropMax(string name)
		{
			if (DeviceIsAvailable)
			{
				return Device.GetVideoProcessingPropertyByName(name, getValue: false, "Max");
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal int GetPropDefault(string name)
		{
			if (DeviceIsAvailable)
			{
				return Device.GetVideoProcessingPropertyByName(name, getValue: false, "Default");
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal int GetPropSteppingDelta(string name)
		{
			if (DeviceIsAvailable)
			{
				return Device.GetVideoProcessingPropertyByName(name, getValue: false, "SteppingDelta");
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal int GetPropValue(string name)
		{
			if (DeviceIsAvailable)
			{
				return Device.GetVideoProcessingPropertyByName(name, getValue: true, "Value");
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string property)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(property));
		}
	}
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
	public class DeviceVideoProperty : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly DeviceVideoSettings settings;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public string Name { get; private set; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool IsActive
		{
			get
			{
				if (Max != Min)
				{
					return SteppingDelta != 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public int Min => settings.GetPropMin(Name);

		public int Max => settings.GetPropMax(Name);

		public int SteppingDelta => settings.GetPropSteppingDelta(Name);

		public int Default => settings.GetPropDefault(Name);

		public int Value
		{
			get
			{
				return settings.GetPropValue(Name);
			}
			set
			{
				settings.SetProp(Name, value);
				RaisePropertyChanged("Value");
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		internal DeviceVideoProperty(DeviceVideoSettings settings, string name)
		{
			this.settings = settings;
			Name = name;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string property)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(property));
		}

		public void ResetToDefault()
		{
			Value = Default;
		}
	}
